1904.04821|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对目标检测中所有样本被平等对待、以平均性能为目标的问题，重新审视了不同样本对mAP的贡献。提出了Prime Sample的概念，并设计了Prime Sample Attention (PISA)采样与学习策略，将训练重点引向这些关键样本。在MS COCO数据集上，PISA在单阶段和两阶段检测器上均比随机采样及OHEM、Focal Loss等难例挖掘方法稳定提升约2% mAP，即使使用强骨干ResNeXt-101也有效。
1904.04821|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits the common paradigm of treating all samples equally in object detection and studies how different samples contribute to mAP. It introduces the notion of Prime Samples and proposes PrIme Sample Attention (PISA), a sampling and learning strategy that focuses training on such samples. On MS COCO, PISA consistently improves mAP by around 2% over random sampling and hard mining schemes like OHEM and Focal Loss on both single-stage and two-stage detectors, even with a strong ResNeXt-101 backbone.
1904.04821|v2.assessment: 该工作从样本重要性角度切入，提出的PISA简单有效，在多个检测器上验证了通用性，对检测训练策略有启发意义。
1904.04821|v2.contribution: 提出Prime Sample概念及PISA采样与学习策略，引导检测器关注对性能贡献大的样本。
1904.04821|v2.innovation: 首次系统研究样本对mAP的贡献差异，并设计注意力机制聚焦Prime Samples。
1904.04821|v2.result: 在MS COCO上比随机采样和OHEM、Focal Loss等提升约2% mAP。

2003.12063|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对视频目标检测中单帧质量退化导致遮挡目标难以识别的问题，指出全局语义信息和局部定位信息是两个关键线索。提出了记忆增强的全局-局部聚合网络（MEGA），并设计了长程记忆（LRM）模块，使关键帧能访问比以往方法更多的内容。在ImageNet VID数据集上取得了当时最优性能。
2003.12063|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses video object detection where degraded single-frame quality makes occluded objects hard to recognize, arguing that global semantic and local localization cues are both crucial. It proposes the Memory Enhanced Global-Local Aggregation (MEGA) network with a Long Range Memory (LRM) module, enabling key frames to access much more content than previous methods. MEGA achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ImageNet VID dataset.
2003.12063|v2.assessment: 该工作同时利用全局和局部信息，并通过长程记忆扩展关键帧的信息访问范围，在视频目标检测任务上表现突出。
2003.12063|v2.contribution: 提出MEGA网络，结合全局语义与局部定位信息，并引入长程记忆模块增强关键帧特征。
2003.12063|v2.innovation: 首次同时考虑全局和局部信息，并通过LRM模块使关键帧访问更长的时序内容。
2003.12063|v2.result: 在ImageNet VID数据集上取得当时最优性能。

2001.03398|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对基于图像的3D目标检测与LiDAR方法之间存在较大性能差距的问题，指出关键在于3D场景的表示方式。提出了深度立体几何网络（DSGN），在可微的3D几何体积（3D geometric volume）上检测3D目标，该表示有效编码了3D规则空间的几何结构，并同时学习深度信息和语义线索。这是首个简单有效的一阶段立体3D检测流程，端到端联合估计深度和检测3D目标。在KITTI 3D目标检测基准上，比之前基于立体的3D检测器AP高出约10，甚至与部分LiDAR方法性能相当。
2001.03398|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the large performance gap between image-based and LiDAR-based 3D object detection, attributing it to the way 3D representations are formed. It proposes Deep Stereo Geometry Network (DSGN), which detects 3D objects on a differentiable 3D geometric volume that encodes 3D geometric structure and jointly learns depth and semantic cues. As the first simple and effective one-stage stereo-based 3D detection pipeline, DSGN outperforms previous stereo-based detectors by about 10 AP and achieves comparable performance to several LiDAR-based methods on the KITTI 3D object detection leaderboard.
2001.03398|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了新颖的3D几何体积表示，显著缩小了立体与LiDAR方法在3D检测上的差距，对基于视觉的自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
2001.03398|v2.contribution: 提出DSGN，在可微3D几何体积上端到端联合估计深度和检测3D目标，大幅缩小立体与LiDAR方法的性能差距。
2001.03398|v2.innovation: 首次提出可微的3D几何体积表示，并实现一阶段立体3D检测的端到端学习。
2001.03398|v2.result: 在KITTI上比之前立体3D检测器AP高约10，与部分LiDAR方法性能相当。

2006.12884|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对弱监督目标检测中MIL方法倾向于定位判别性部位而非完整目标的问题，提出了空间似然投票（SLV）模块。该模块在训练中让所有区域提议作为投票者，对每个类别的空间似然进行投票，经膨胀对齐后正则化为边界框，用于最终分类和定位。基于SLV进一步提出端到端多任务学习框架，分类与定位任务相互促进。在PASCAL VOC 2007和2012数据集上取得了优越性能。
2006.12884|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue in weakly supervised object detection where MIL-based methods tend to localize discriminative parts instead of whole objects. It proposes a Spatial Likelihood Voting (SLV) module that lets all region proposals vote for the spatial likelihood of each category, then regularizes the voting results into bounding boxes for final classification and localization. An end-to-end multi-task learning framework is further proposed, where classification and localization mutually improve. Extensive experiments on PASCAL VOC 2007 and 2012 demonstrate superior performance.
2006.12884|v2.assessment: 该工作通过投票机制缓解弱监督检测中的部分定位问题，方法思路清晰，但仅在小规模数据集上验证，与自动驾驶场景关联较弱。
2006.12884|v2.contribution: 提出空间似然投票模块及端到端多任务框架，改善弱监督目标检测的完整目标定位。
2006.12884|v2.innovation: 利用区域提议投票生成空间似然并正则化为边界框，无需边界框标注。
2006.12884|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2007和2012上取得优越性能。

1912.01106|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对移动端目标检测架构设计大多依赖手工、现有自动化搜索未考虑设备延迟的问题，提出了MnasFPN——一种面向移动端的检测头搜索空间，并结合延迟感知架构搜索生成高效检测模型。学习到的MnasFPN头与MobileNetV2主干结合，在Pixel上相似延迟下比MobileNetV3+SSDLite高1.8 mAP，比NAS-FPNLite精度高1.0 mAP且快10%。消融实验表明大部分性能提升来自搜索空间的创新，并揭示了搜索空间设计与搜索算法之间的耦合关系。
1912.01106|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of on-device object detection architectures and the lack of latency guidance in existing automated search efforts. It proposes MnasFPN, a mobile-friendly search space for the detection head, combined with latency-aware architecture search. The learned MnasFPN head paired with MobileNetV2 outperforms MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.8 mAP at similar latency on Pixel, and is both 1.0 mAP more accurate and 10% faster than NAS-FPNLite. Ablation studies show most gains come from search space innovations and reveal a coupling between search space and search algorithm.
1912.01106|v2.assessment: 该工作将延迟感知NAS应用于移动端检测头设计，实验扎实，对移动端目标检测部署有实用价值。
1912.01106|v2.contribution: 提出移动友好的MnasFPN检测头搜索空间，并结合延迟感知架构搜索生成高效检测模型。
1912.01106|v2.innovation: 设计移动端检测头搜索空间，并揭示搜索空间与搜索算法之间的耦合关系。
1912.01106|v2.result: 在Pixel上比MobileNetV3+SSDLite高1.8 mAP，比NAS-FPNLite高1.0 mAP且快10%。

A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对点云3D目标检测中现有方法难以有效建模物体间关系与全局上下文的问题，本文提出层次化图网络（Hierarchical Graph Network）。该方法在点云上构建多层级图结构，通过图卷积聚合局部几何与全局语义信息，从而增强特征表达。相比已有基于体素或点的方法，其改进在于显式建模点、物体与场景间的层次关系。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称在标准点云检测基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of modeling inter-object relationships and global context in point cloud 3D object detection by proposing a Hierarchical Graph Network. The method constructs multi-level graph structures over point clouds and aggregates local geometric and global semantic information via graph convolutions. It improves over voxel- or point-based methods by explicitly modeling hierarchical relations among points, objects, and scenes. The abstract lacks quantitative results but claims competitive performance on standard benchmarks.
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.assessment: 将图网络引入点云3D检测的思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验验证与效率。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.contribution: 提出层次化图网络用于点云3D目标检测，显式建模多层级空间关系。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.innovation: 利用层次图结构同时捕获局部几何与全局上下文信息。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在点云检测基准上取得有竞争力结果。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje._arxiv_id: A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Object Detection on Point Clouds.

2003.00504|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中遮挡样本因信息缺失而检测困难的问题，本文提出MonoPair，利用相邻物体对的空间关系进行联合优化。方法对相邻物体对的位置和3D距离进行不确定性感知预测，并通过非线性最小二乘联合优化，同时设计了一阶段预测结构与后优化模块以保证实时性。在KITTI 3D检测基准上，该方法大幅超越当时最优方法，尤其在困难样本上提升显著。
2003.00504|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of occluded samples in monocular 3D object detection by proposing MonoPair, which exploits pairwise spatial relationships between adjacent objects. It computes uncertainty-aware predictions for object locations and 3D distances of adjacent pairs, jointly optimized via nonlinear least squares, with a one-stage structure and post-optimization module for runtime efficiency. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on the KITTI 3D benchmark with large margins, especially on hard samples.
2003.00504|v2.assessment: 利用物体间空间约束提升遮挡场景下的单目3D检测，思路简洁有效，KITTI上提升显著，值得关注。
2003.00504|v2.contribution: 提出基于成对空间关系与不确定性联合优化的单目3D检测框架MonoPair。
2003.00504|v2.innovation: 将相邻物体对的空间约束编码为不确定性感知预测，并通过非线性最小二乘联合优化。
2003.00504|v2.result: 在KITTI 3D检测基准上大幅超越当时最优方法，困难样本提升尤为明显。

1912.04799|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测缺乏准确深度信息、传统2D卷积难以捕捉物体尺度与局部结构的问题，本文提出深度引导的动态深度可分离空洞卷积网络D⁴LCN。该方法不依赖伪LiDAR表示，而是从图像深度图自动学习卷积核及其感受野，使不同像素拥有不同滤波器，从而缩小图像表示与3D点云表示之间的差距。大量实验表明D⁴LCN在单目3D检测上取得显著提升。
1912.04799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of accurate depth and the inability of conventional 2D convolutions to capture object scale in monocular 3D detection by proposing Depth-guided Dynamic-Depthwise-Dilated LCN (D⁴LCN). Instead of pseudo-LiDAR, it learns filters and receptive fields from image-based depth maps, allowing different pixels to have different filters, bridging image and 3D point cloud representations. Extensive experiments show significant improvements on monocular 3D detection.
1912.04799|v2.assessment: 从卷积算子层面改进单目3D检测，避免伪LiDAR的深度误差传播，思路新颖且实验充分。
1912.04799|v2.contribution: 提出深度引导的动态卷积网络D⁴LCN，用于单目3D目标检测。
1912.04799|v2.innovation: 利用深度图自动学习卷积核与感受野，实现像素级自适应卷积。
1912.04799|v2.result: 大量实验表明D⁴LCN显著提升单目3D检测性能，缩小与点云方法的差距。

2003.09119|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于关键点的检测器中角点匹配错误频发的问题，本文提出CentripetalNet，利用向心偏移将同一实例的角点配对。方法预测角点位置及向心偏移，通过偏移对齐匹配角点，并设计十字星可变形卷积进行特征自适应，同时扩展了实例分割模块。在MS-COCO test-dev上取得48.0% AP，超越所有现有anchor-free检测器，Mask AP达40.2%，与最优实例分割方法相当。
2003.09119|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses incorrect keypoint matching in keypoint-based detectors by proposing CentripetalNet, which pairs corner keypoints of the same instance using centripetal shift. It predicts corner positions and centripetal shifts, matches corners via shift alignment, and introduces cross-star deformable convolution for feature adaptation, plus a mask prediction module. On MS-COCO test-dev, it achieves 48.0% AP, outperforming all anchor-free detectors, and 40.2% Mask AP, comparable to state-of-the-art instance segmentation.
2003.09119|v2.assessment: 角点匹配是anchor-free检测的关键瓶颈，CentripetalNet用向心偏移简洁有效地解决，COCO上表现优异。
2003.09119|v2.contribution: 提出基于向心偏移的角点配对方法CentripetalNet，并扩展至实例分割。
2003.09119|v2.innovation: 利用向心偏移对齐角点实现更准确的实例匹配，并设计十字星可变形卷积增强角点特征。
2003.09119|v2.result: MS-COCO test-dev上AP达48.0%，Mask AP达40.2%，超越所有anchor-free检测器。

2006.04356|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中因空间遮挡和点密度变化导致同一物体外观差异大的问题，本文提出Associate-3Ddet，采用类域适应方法增强特征鲁棒性。方法在真实场景的感知域与无遮挡增强场景的概念域之间建立关联，模拟人脑物体感知机制。大量实验表明该简单有效的方法显著提升3D点云检测性能，并达到当时最优结果。
2006.04356|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses appearance variation in point cloud 3D detection caused by spatial occlusion and density changes by proposing Associate-3Ddet, a domain-adaptation-like approach. It bridges the perceptual domain from real scenes and the conceptual domain from augmented non-occluded point clouds, mimicking human object perception. Extensive experiments show the simple yet effective method substantially boosts 3D detection and achieves state-of-the-art results.
2006.04356|v2.assessment: 将域适应思想引入点云3D检测以应对遮挡与密度变化，视角新颖，实验验证充分。
2006.04356|v2.contribution: 提出感知域到概念域的关联方法Associate-3Ddet，增强点云3D检测特征鲁棒性。
2006.04356|v2.innovation: 以类域适应方式桥接真实场景与无遮挡增强场景的特征表示。
2006.04356|v2.result: 大量实验表明该方法显著提升3D点云检测性能，达到当时最优结果。

1908.01998|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统目标检测需要大量标注数据、难以检测新类别的问题，本文提出少样本目标检测网络，核心包括Attention-RPN、Multi-Relation Detector和对比训练策略，利用支持集与查询集的相似性检测新类别并抑制背景误检。同时贡献了一个包含1000类高质量标注的新数据集，是首批专为少样本检测设计的数据集之一。方法训练后无需微调即可检测未见类别，在多个数据集上取得当时最优性能。
1908.01998|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy annotation requirement of conventional object detection by proposing a few-shot detection network with Attention-RPN, Multi-Relation Detector, and contrastive training, exploiting support-query similarity to detect novel categories while suppressing background false positives. It also contributes a new dataset with 1000 categories and high-quality annotations, one of the first for few-shot detection. Once trained, the network detects unseen categories without fine-tuning, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple datasets.
1908.01998|v2.assessment: 少样本检测的重要工作，方法设计系统且贡献了大规模数据集，对开放类别检测有参考价值。
1908.01998|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力RPN与多关系检测器的少样本目标检测框架，并发布1000类少样本检测数据集。
1908.01998|v2.innovation: 利用支持-查询相似性与对比训练实现无需微调的未见类别检测。
1908.01998|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得少样本检测当时最优性能，且无需额外微调。

Camouflaged Object Detection.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对伪装物体检测（Camouflaged Object Detection）问题，即前景与背景高度相似导致难以分割/检测的场景。由于提供的摘要为空，无法确认其具体方法、改进点与实验数据。从题目看，工作应聚焦于提升对低对比度、纹理融合目标的识别能力，但缺少可核验的技术细节与量化结果。
Camouflaged Object Detection.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses camouflaged object detection, where foreground objects are visually indistinguishable from the background. As the abstract is unavailable, the specific method, improvements, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The work presumably targets low-contrast, texture-blended object recognition, but lacks inspectable technical details.

Camouflaged Object Detection.|v2.contribution: 面向伪装物体检测任务提出方法（具体贡献因摘要缺失无法确认）。

Taking a Deeper Look at Co-Salient Objec.summary_cn: 该论文研究共显著物体检测（Co-Salient Object Detection），即在一组相关图像中共同出现的显著目标检测问题。由于摘要为空，无法确认其提出的具体方法、与已有工作的差异以及实验指标。该方向属于2D图像显著性/分割范畴，与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联有限。
Taking a Deeper Look at Co-Salient Objec.summary_en: This paper studies co-salient object detection, which aims to detect salient objects consistently appearing across a group of related images. With the abstract missing, the proposed method, differences from prior work, and experimental metrics cannot be verified. This topic belongs to 2D saliency/segmentation and has limited direct relevance to autonomous driving 3D perception.
Taking a Deeper Look at Co-Salient Objec.assessment: 属于2D显著性检测方向，与用户关注的3D/BEV/自动驾驶感知相关性低，且摘要缺失难以评估。
Taking a Deeper Look at Co-Salient Objec.contribution: 面向共显著物体检测任务开展研究（具体贡献因摘要缺失无法确认）。
Taking a Deeper Look at Co-Salient Objec.innovation: 创新点无法从现有信息中确认。

Taking a Deeper Look at Co-Salient Objec._arxiv_id: Taking a Deeper Look at Co-Salient Object Detection.

2004.08515|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGB-D显著物体检测中RGB与深度信息被独立处理、易受训练数据量限制或过度依赖复杂训练流程的问题，提出JL-DCF联合学习与密集协作融合框架。方法采用Siamese网络同时学习RGB与深度输入，包含联合学习（JL）模块进行鲁棒显著性特征学习，以及密集协作融合（DCF）模块挖掘互补特征。在六个挑战性数据集上，相比当时最优的D3Net模型，S-measure平均提升约1.9%，展现出良好的泛化能力。
2004.08515|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses RGB-D salient object detection where RGB and depth are typically processed independently, leading to data-hungry or training-process-dependent models. It proposes JL-DCF, a Siamese-based joint learning and densely-cooperative fusion framework comprising a joint learning module for robust saliency features and a densely-cooperative fusion module for complementary feature discovery. Across six challenging datasets, JL-DCF improves the top-1 D3Net by ~1.9% in S-measure on average, demonstrating strong generalization.
2004.08515|v2.assessment: 作为RGB-D多模态融合的早期代表性工作，其联合学习与密集融合思路对多模态感知有一定借鉴意义，但与自动驾驶3D检测场景距离较远。
2004.08515|v2.contribution: 提出JL-DCF联合学习与密集协作融合框架，实现RGB-D显著物体检测的鲁棒跨模态特征学习。
2004.08515|v2.innovation: 用Siamese网络统一处理RGB与深度输入，并通过JL与DCF模块实现互补特征发现，避免独立分支设计。
2004.08515|v2.result: 在六个数据集上S-measure平均超越D3Net约1.9%，泛化性良好。

1912.05384|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对FPN特征金字塔中多尺度特征利用不充分的设计缺陷，提出AugFPN特征金字塔架构。方法包含三个组件：Consistent Supervision在融合前缩小不同尺度特征的语义鸿沟；Residual Feature Augmentation在融合中提取比例不变上下文信息，减少最高金字塔层的信息损失；Soft RoI Selection在融合后自适应学习更好的RoI特征。将Faster R-CNN中的FPN替换为AugFPN后，以ResNet50和MobileNet-v2为骨干时AP分别提升2.3和1.6个点。
1912.05384|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies design defects in FPN that prevent full exploitation of multi-scale features and proposes AugFPN, comprising Consistent Supervision to narrow semantic gaps before fusion, Residual Feature Augmentation to extract ratio-invariant context and reduce information loss at the highest pyramid level, and Soft RoI Selection for adaptive RoI feature learning after fusion. Replacing FPN with AugFPN in Faster R-CNN improves AP by 2.3 and 1.6 points with ResNet50 and MobileNet-v2 backbones, respectively.
1912.05384|v2.assessment: 对FPN的缺陷分析清晰，三个改进模块针对性强且即插即用，对2D检测器多尺度特征学习有实用价值，可迁移至BEV/多尺度3D检测的特征融合设计。
1912.05384|v2.contribution: 提出AugFPN特征金字塔架构，通过一致性监督、残差特征增强与软RoI选择改进多尺度特征学习。
1912.05384|v2.innovation: 系统分析FPN设计缺陷并针对性设计三个互补模块，实现即插即用的多尺度特征增强。
1912.05384|v2.result: 在Faster R-CNN上以ResNet50/MobileNet-v2为骨干分别提升AP 2.3/1.6个点。

2003.11818|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有目标检测NAS方法仅搜索检测器单一组件（骨干或特征融合层）、其余组件仍手工设计导致性能受限的问题，提出层次化三位一体搜索框架Hit-Detector，端到端同时搜索骨干、neck和head。作者发现检测器不同部分偏好不同算子，因此设计自动筛选不同子搜索空间的方案，在各组件对应子空间上高效搜索。搜索得到的Hit-Detector在COCO minival上以27M参数达到41.4% mAP。
2003.11818|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of prior detection NAS methods that search only a single component while leaving others hand-designed, causing inconsistency and suboptimal performance. It proposes a hierarchical trinity search framework, Hit-Detector, that jointly searches backbone, neck, and head end-to-end, with an automatic sub-search-space screening scheme motivated by the observation that different detector parts prefer different operators. The searched architecture achieves 41.4% mAP on COCO minival with 27M parameters.
2003.11818|v2.assessment: 端到端联合搜索检测器三大组件是NAS用于检测的重要推进，参数效率与精度平衡良好，对自动化检测器设计有参考价值。
2003.11818|v2.contribution: 提出层次化三位一体NAS框架，端到端联合搜索检测器的骨干、neck与head。
2003.11818|v2.innovation: 发现不同组件偏好不同算子，并设计自动子搜索空间筛选方案实现高效联合搜索。
2003.11818|v2.result: Hit-Detector在COCO minival上以27M参数取得41.4% mAP。

Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.summary_cn: 该论文研究基于点云的单阶段3D目标检测，题目强调结构感知（Structure Aware）。由于摘要为空，无法确认其具体方法、改进点与实验数据。从题目判断，工作应聚焦于利用点云几何结构信息提升单阶段3D检测精度，但缺少可核验的技术细节与量化结果。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.summary_en: This paper targets structure-aware single-stage 3D object detection from point clouds. As the abstract is unavailable, the specific method, improvements, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The title suggests exploiting geometric structure of point clouds to improve single-stage 3D detection, but inspectable technical details are missing.
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.assessment: 主题与自动驾驶3D检测高度相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与效果，需获取全文后再判断。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.contribution: 面向点云单阶段3D检测提出结构感知方法（具体贡献因摘要缺失无法确认）。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.innovation: 创新点无法从现有信息中确认。

Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D._arxiv_id: Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object Detection From Point Cloud.

1912.04986|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对LiDAR等3D传感器数据本质上是2.5D、而主流表示（如PointNet）将其当作真正3D点云处理、从而丢失自由空间（freespace）可见性信息的问题。作者提出通过3D raycasting高效恢复可见性信息，并将其体素化为可见性图（visibility map）作为额外输入流，与现有体素网络结合；同时证明该可见性可与虚拟物体合成数据增强和多帧LiDAR时序聚合两种SOTA检测器常用技巧兼容。在NuScenes 3D检测基准上，仅增加一路可见性输入即可显著提升检测精度（摘要中具体数值被截断）。该工作为2.5D传感器数据的表示学习提供了新视角。
1912.04986|v2.summary_en: The paper argues that 3D sensor data such as LiDAR sweeps are inherently 2.5D, and representing them as unordered (x,y,z) point sets destroys hidden freespace/visibility information. It proposes recovering this knowledge via 3D raycasting and feeding a voxelized visibility map as an additional input stream to voxel-based detectors, compatible with virtual-object augmentation and temporal LiDAR aggregation. On the NuScenes 3D detection benchmark, adding the visibility stream significantly improves detection accuracy.
1912.04986|v2.assessment: 该工作从2.5D数据本质出发重新审视可见性信息，思路简洁且与现有体素检测器即插即用，对自动驾驶3D感知研究者有较高参考价值。
1912.04986|v2.contribution: 提出将3D raycasting得到的体素化可见性图作为额外输入流，显式建模LiDAR数据中的自由空间信息以提升3D检测。
1912.04986|v2.innovation: 指出2.5D传感器数据被当作纯3D点云处理会丢失可见性信息，并给出可高效恢复并融入批量梯度学习的可见性表示。
1912.04986|v2.result: 在NuScenes 3D检测基准上，仅增加可见性输入流即可显著提升检测性能，并与虚拟物体增强和时序聚合兼容。

2011.09094|v2.summary_cn: DETR 依赖大规模数据和超长训练周期，从头训练收敛极慢。本文提出无监督预训练方法 UP-DETR，通过随机裁剪图像块作为 query 输入解码器，让模型在预训练阶段检测这些 query patch，并引入多任务学习与多 query 定位（注意力掩码）解决分类与定位偏好冲突。相比从头训练，UP-DETR 显著加速收敛并提升性能，同时为微调检测和 one-shot 检测提供统一视角。
2011.09094|v2.summary_en: DETR suffers from slow convergence and requires large-scale data due to scratch transformer training. This paper proposes UP-DETR, an unsupervised pre-training method with a random query patch detection pretext task, addressing multi-task learning by freezing the CNN backbone and multi-query localization via attention masks. It accelerates convergence and improves detection performance, also providing a unified perspective for fine-tuning and one-shot detection.
2011.09094|v2.assessment: 首次将无监督预训练引入 DETR 框架，对后续 DETR 系列预训练研究有启发意义，实验扎实。
2011.09094|v2.contribution: 提出随机 query patch 检测的无监督预训练任务，解决 DETR 训练数据依赖和收敛慢的问题。
2011.09094|v2.innovation: 利用随机裁剪 patch 作为 decoder query 进行自监督预训练，并设计注意力掩码支持多 query 定位。
2011.09094|v2.result: 显著加速 DETR 收敛并提升检测性能，同时支持 one-shot 检测微调。

Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节。从标题推断，本文针对 DETR 的注意力机制进行动态化改进，旨在实现端到端目标检测。可能通过动态注意力提升检测精度或效率，但缺乏摘要信息难以评估具体贡献与效果。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.summary_en: The abstract is missing, so specific details are unavailable. Based on the title, this work likely improves DETR with dynamic attention for end-to-end object detection, but the exact contributions and results cannot be assessed.
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.assessment: 摘要缺失导致无法充分评估，但动态注意力在 DETR 改进中具有一定潜力，需查阅全文确认。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.contribution: 提出动态注意力机制改进 DETR 的端到端目标检测。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.innovation: 将动态注意力引入 DETR 框架。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.result: 因摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。

2010.04159|v2.summary_cn: DETR 因 Transformer 注意力处理图像特征图的局限，存在收敛慢和特征空间分辨率受限的问题。本文提出 Deformable DETR，其注意力模块仅关注参考点周围少量采样点，从而在更少训练轮次下取得更优性能，尤其在小目标上提升明显。在 COCO 基准上，Deformable DETR 以 10 倍更少的训练 epoch 超越 DETR，代码已开源。
2010.04159|v2.summary_en: DETR suffers from slow convergence and limited feature spatial resolution due to Transformer attention limitations. This paper proposes Deformable DETR, whose attention modules attend to a small set of key sampling points around a reference, achieving better performance (especially on small objects) with 10× fewer training epochs than DETR. Extensive COCO experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2010.04159|v2.assessment: Deformable DETR 是 DETR 系列里程碑式工作，可变形注意力被广泛采用，实验充分且影响深远。
2010.04159|v2.contribution: 提出可变形注意力模块，解决 DETR 收敛慢和小目标性能差的问题。
2010.04159|v2.innovation: 将可变形卷积思想引入 Transformer 注意力，仅采样参考点周围少量关键点。
2010.04159|v2.result: 在 COCO 上以 10 倍更少训练 epoch 超越 DETR，小目标性能显著提升。

2104.02628|v2.summary_cn: 显著目标检测（SOD）与伪装目标检测（COD）任务目标相反，但可互相利用矛盾信息。本文提出联合检测范式：将 COD 中的易正样本作为 SOD 的难正样本以增强鲁棒性，引入相似性度量模块建模两任务的矛盾属性，并针对标注不确定性设计对抗学习网络实现高阶相似性度量和置信度估计。在基准数据集上两个任务均达到 SOTA。
2104.02628|v2.summary_en: SOD and COD are contradictory tasks, but their information can be mutually beneficial. This paper proposes a joint paradigm that uses easy positives from COD as hard positives for SOD, introduces a similarity measure module to model contradictory attributes, and designs an adversarial learning network for higher-order similarity and confidence estimation. Experiments show SOTA performance on both tasks.
2104.02628|v2.assessment: 跨任务矛盾信息利用的思路新颖，但主要面向通用视觉检测，与自动驾驶感知领域关联度有限。
2104.02628|v2.contribution: 提出联合显著目标与伪装目标检测的范式，利用矛盾信息互相增强。
2104.02628|v2.innovation: 将 COD 易正样本作为 SOD 难正样本，并设计对抗学习网络处理标注不确定性。
2104.02628|v2.result: 在基准数据集上两个任务均达到 SOTA 性能。

2104.02323|v2.summary_cn: 单目 3D 目标检测中，现有方法对所有目标采用统一处理，导致截断目标性能受限。本文提出灵活框架 MonoFlex，显式解耦截断目标，将特征图边缘解耦以预测长尾截断目标，避免影响正常目标优化；同时将目标深度估计建模为直接回归深度与关键点求解深度的不确定性引导集成。在 KITTI 测试集上，中等难度相对提升 27%，困难难度提升 30%，并保持实时效率。
2104.02323|v2.summary_en: Monocular 3D detection struggles with truncated objects due to uniform treatment. This paper proposes MonoFlex, a flexible framework that decouples truncated objects by separating feature map edges, and formulates depth estimation as an uncertainty-guided ensemble of direct regression and keypoint-solved depths. It outperforms SOTA by 27% (moderate) and 30% (hard) on KITTI while maintaining real-time efficiency.
2104.02323|v2.assessment: 针对截断目标的解耦设计和不确定性深度集成思路实用，KITTI 上提升显著且保持实时性，对单目 3D 检测有参考价值。
2104.02323|v2.contribution: 提出解耦截断目标并自适应融合多种深度估计的单目 3D 检测框架 MonoFlex。
2104.02323|v2.innovation: 将特征图边缘解耦处理长尾截断目标，并用不确定性引导集成直接回归与关键点求解深度。
2104.02323|v2.result: KITTI 测试集中等难度相对提升 27%，困难难度提升 30%，保持实时效率。

2103.11402|v2.summary_cn: 监督目标检测依赖大量人工标注，半监督目标检测（SSOD）可利用无标注数据提升性能。本文提出 Instant-Teaching，一种完全端到端的 SSOD 框架，在每次训练迭代中使用即时伪标签和扩展的弱-强数据增强进行教学；进一步提出基于协同矫正的 Instant-Teaching* 以缓解确认偏差并提升伪标注质量。在 MS-COCO 和 PASCAL VOC 上，使用 2% 标注数据时超越 SOTA 4.2 mAP，全监督下仍超越约 1.0 mAP，VOC 上提升超 5 mAP。
2103.11402|v2.summary_en: Supervised object detection requires costly annotations, and SSOD leverages unlabeled data. This paper proposes Instant-Teaching, a fully end-to-end SSOD framework using instant pseudo labeling with extended weak-strong augmentations, and Instant-Teaching* with a co-rectify scheme to alleviate confirmation bias. It surpasses SOTA by 4.2 mAP on MS-COCO with 2% labels, and by ~1.0 mAP under full supervision, with >5 mAP improvement on PASCAL VOC.
2103.11402|v2.assessment: 端到端半监督检测框架设计简洁有效，在低标注场景下提升显著，对降低自动驾驶数据标注成本有实际意义。
2103.11402|v2.contribution: 提出完全端到端的半监督目标检测框架 Instant-Teaching 及其协同矫正版本。
2103.11402|v2.innovation: 即时伪标签结合扩展弱-强数据增强，并引入协同矫正方案缓解确认偏差。
2103.11402|v2.result: MS-COCO 2% 标注下超越 SOTA 4.2 mAP，全监督下仍提升约 1.0 mAP，VOC 上提升超 5 mAP。

2104.07434|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱半监督目标检测中标注成本高的问题，提出了一种新的点标注设定：少量全标注图像加大量仅点标注图像。为充分利用点标注，设计了Point DETR，在DETR基础上增加点编码器。在MS-COCO上，使用20%全标注数据时达到33.3 AP，比FCOS基线高2.0 AP，且点标注在多种AR指标上带来超过10个点的提升。
2104.07434|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces a point-annotated setting for weakly semi-supervised object detection, combining a small set of fully annotated images with a large set of point-annotated images. It proposes Point DETR, which extends DETR with a point encoder to better exploit point annotations. On MS-COCO with 20% fully labeled data, it achieves 33.3 AP, outperforming FCOS by 2.0 AP, and point annotations improve various AR metrics by over 10 points.
2104.07434|v2.assessment: 点标注设定平衡了标注成本与检测性能，Point DETR设计合理，实验充分，对弱监督检测有参考价值。
2104.07434|v2.contribution: 提出了点标注的弱半监督检测设定及Point DETR检测器。
2104.07434|v2.innovation: 在DETR中引入点编码器以有效利用点标注。
2104.07434|v2.result: 在COCO 20%全标注下达到33.3 AP，超越FCOS 2.0 AP，AR指标提升超10点。

2103.17202|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中NMS仅在推理阶段使用导致训练与推理不匹配的问题，提出了GrooMeD-NMS，一种分组可微NMS。将NMS表述为矩阵操作，通过无监督分组和掩码获得闭式表达，使网络能端到端训练并优化NMS后的框。在KITTI上取得了单目3D检测的最优结果，性能与基于视频的方法相当。
2103.17202|v2.summary_en: To address the mismatch between training and inference in monocular 3D detection due to NMS being used only at inference, this paper proposes GrooMeD-NMS, a grouped mathematically differentiable NMS. It formulates NMS as a matrix operation and derives a closed-form expression via unsupervised grouping and masking, enabling end-to-end training with a loss on post-NMS boxes. It achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection on KITTI, comparable to video-based methods.
2103.17202|v2.assessment: 将NMS可微化并融入训练，解决了训练推理不一致问题，对单目3D检测有重要推动。
2103.17202|v2.contribution: 提出了可微分的分组NMS，实现端到端训练。
2103.17202|v2.innovation: 将NMS表达为矩阵操作并分组掩码得到闭式解。
2103.17202|v2.result: 在KITTI上取得单目3D检测最优，媲美视频方法。

2012.04355|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测标注成本高的问题，提出了半监督方法3DIoUMatch，适用于室内外场景。采用教师-学生互学习框架生成伪标签，并引入基于置信度的过滤机制，进一步利用估计的3D IoU作为定位度量，设置类别自适应阈值过滤低质量伪标签。在室内VoteNet和室外KITTI PV-RCNN上均取得一致提升。
2012.04355|v2.summary_en: To reduce the annotation burden in 3D object detection, this paper proposes 3DIoUMatch, a semi-supervised method for both indoor and outdoor scenes. It uses a teacher-student mutual learning framework to generate pseudo-labels, with confidence-based filtering and a 3D IoU-based localization metric with category-aware self-adjusted thresholds. It consistently improves upon VoteNet on indoor datasets and PV-RCNN on KITTI.
2012.04355|v2.assessment: 半监督3D检测的重要工作，伪标签过滤策略有效，实验覆盖室内外场景，实用性强。
2012.04355|v2.contribution: 提出了基于3D IoU估计的半监督3D检测框架。
2012.04355|v2.innovation: 利用3D IoU作为定位度量并设置类别自适应阈值过滤伪标签。
2012.04355|v2.result: 在室内外数据集上均取得一致性能提升。

2106.11346|v2.summary_cn: 针对不同下游任务对延迟、数据分布等有不同需求，而大规模预训练迁移成本高的问题，提出了GAIA迁移学习系统。该系统能自动高效地生成定制化检测方案，包括提供预训练权重、根据延迟约束和数据域选择模型、以及为数据稀缺任务收集相关数据。在COCO、Objects365、Open Images等多个数据集上取得良好结果。
2106.11346|v2.summary_en: To address the high cost of adapting large-scale pre-training to diverse downstream needs such as latency constraints and specialized data distributions, this paper presents GAIA, a transfer learning system for object detection. GAIA automatically provides pre-trained weights, selects models conforming to latency and domain requirements, and collects relevant data for tasks with few datapoints. It achieves promising results on COCO, Objects365, Open Images, and other datasets.
2106.11346|v2.assessment: 系统性强，面向实际部署需求，但方法创新性一般，更偏向工程集成。
2106.11346|v2.contribution: 提出了面向多样化下游需求的自动迁移学习系统GAIA。
2106.11346|v2.innovation: 集成了预训练权重提供、模型选择和自动数据收集的端到端流程。
2106.11346|v2.result: 在多个检测数据集上取得有竞争力的结果。

2106.13381|v2.summary_cn: 针对距离图像视图下的3D目标检测，提出直接从距离图像学习3D表示。设计了一种2D卷积网络架构，在网络中携带每个像素的3D球坐标，并支持多种卷积核：密集核、Transformer、PointNet和Edge Convolution图核。在Waymo开放数据集上，行人检测AP从69.7%提升至75.5%，且最小模型比PointPillars质量更好，FLOPS和参数量少180倍。
2106.13381|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes to learn 3D representations directly from range images for 3D object detection. It designs a 2D convolutional architecture that carries 3D spherical coordinates of each pixel and supports various convolution kernels including dense, Transformer, PointNet, and Edge Convolution. On the Waymo Open Dataset, it improves pedestrian detection AP from 69.7% to 75.5%, and its smallest model outperforms PointPillars with 180x fewer FLOPS and parameters.
2106.13381|v2.assessment: 在距离图像上直接进行3D检测，效率高且性能强，图卷积核的探索有启发性。
2106.13381|v2.contribution: 提出了在距离图像上携带3D坐标的2D卷积网络及多种图卷积核。
2106.13381|v2.innovation: 将3D球坐标贯穿网络并支持多种图卷积核进行局部几何建模。
2106.13381|v2.result: Waymo上行人AP从69.7%提升至75.5%，且计算效率极高。

2103.12605|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中3D定位困难且依赖难以获取的物体几何真值的问题，提出了MonoRUn框架。通过自监督方式学习密集对应和几何，仅需简单3D框标注。采用区域重建网络回归像素相关3D坐标并感知不确定性，提出Robust KL损失最小化不确定性加权重投影误差。测试时传播不确定性，使用不确定性驱动的PnP估计位姿及协方差。在KITTI上取得优异结果。
2103.12605|v2.summary_en: To address the difficulty of 3D localization in monocular 3D detection and the reliance on hard-to-obtain object geometry ground truth, this paper proposes MonoRUn, a framework that learns dense correspondences and geometry self-supervisedly with only 3D bounding box annotations. It employs a regional reconstruction network with uncertainty awareness and a Robust KL loss to minimize uncertainty-weighted reprojection error. During testing, uncertainty is propagated through an uncertainty-driven PnP for pose and covariance estimation, achieving strong results on KITTI.
2103.12605|v2.assessment: 自监督学习密集对应和不确定性传播是亮点，减少了对几何真值的依赖，对单目3D检测有重要贡献。
2103.12605|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督学习密集对应和不确定性传播的单目3D检测框架MonoRUn。
2103.12605|v2.innovation: 利用不确定性驱动的PnP和Robust KL损失实现自监督几何学习。
2103.12605|v2.result: 在KITTI上取得优异性能，无需物体几何真值。

Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.summary_cn: 针对单样本目标检测（one-shot object detection）中查询图像与目标图像外观差异大、难以泛化的问题，论文提出自适应图像Transformer（Adaptive Image Transformer）。方法通过自适应地调整Transformer中的注意力/特征交互机制，使模型能够根据查询样本动态聚焦于目标图像中的相关区域，从而提升跨类别、跨域的单样本检测能力。相比已有依赖固定匹配策略或微调的方法，该工作强调图像级自适应建模。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.summary_en: This paper addresses one-shot object detection, where large appearance gaps between query and target images hinder generalization. It proposes an Adaptive Image Transformer that dynamically modulates attention/feature interaction conditioned on the query, enabling flexible matching to target regions. Unlike prior fixed-matching or fine-tuning approaches, it emphasizes image-level adaptation, though the abstract does not report quantitative results.
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.assessment: 单样本检测与Transformer结合的方向有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需看实验验证其实际增益。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.contribution: 提出面向单样本目标检测的自适应图像Transformer框架。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.innovation: 利用查询条件动态调整Transformer注意力以实现图像级自适应匹配。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与量化指标。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot._arxiv_id: Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot Object Detection.

2103.16148|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测模型易受对抗攻击且以往防御多集中于分类任务的问题，论文提出类别感知的鲁棒对抗训练范式。方法为每张图像生成一个通用对抗扰动，通过联合最大化图像中所有目标的损失同时攻击所有实例，并将总损失按类别分解、用各类别目标数归一化，从而平衡各类别影响。相比以往防御方法，该类别加权损失能更均匀地提升所有目标类别的对抗鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
2103.16148|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles adversarial robustness in object detection, where prior defenses mainly target classification. It proposes a class-aware robust adversarial training paradigm that generates a universal perturbation jointly maximizing per-object losses, and decomposes the total loss into class-wise terms normalized by class object counts. This balances class influence and evenly improves robustness across all object classes compared with prior defenses.
2103.16148|v2.assessment: 将对抗训练从分类迁移到检测并引入类别平衡，思路合理，对鲁棒感知研究有参考价值。
2103.16148|v2.contribution: 提出类别感知的通用对抗训练范式用于目标检测鲁棒性提升。
2103.16148|v2.innovation: 按类别分解并归一化对抗损失以平衡各类别鲁棒性。
2103.16148|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

2103.17220|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中数据增强策略依赖人工设计、缺乏尺度感知的问题，论文提出Scale-aware AutoAug自动搜索增强策略。方法定义了同时包含图像级与框级增强的尺度感知搜索空间以维持尺度不变性，并提出Pareto Scale Balance搜索指标以提升搜索效率。在RetinaNet、Faster R-CNN、Mask R-CNN、FCOS等检测器上取得显著且一致的提升，甚至优于强多尺度训练基线，且搜索策略可迁移到实例分割与关键点估计等任务，搜索成本远低于以往检测自动增强方法。
2103.17220|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Scale-aware AutoAug to learn augmentation policies for object detection. It defines a scale-aware search space with both image- and box-level augmentations to preserve scale invariance, and introduces a Pareto Scale Balance metric for efficient search. It yields consistent gains on RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, and FCOS, transfers to instance segmentation and keypoint estimation, and incurs much lower search cost than prior automated augmentation methods.
2103.17220|v2.assessment: 搜索空间与指标设计针对检测尺度问题，实验覆盖多检测器且可迁移，实用性强，值得关注。
2103.17220|v2.contribution: 提出尺度感知的自动数据增强搜索框架Scale-aware AutoAug。
2103.17220|v2.innovation: 设计图像/框级尺度感知搜索空间与Pareto Scale Balance搜索指标。
2103.17220|v2.result: 在多种检测器上一致提升并优于多尺度训练基线，搜索成本显著降低。

2007.06919|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测在边缘设备上低比特量化（如2-bit）性能严重下降且效率难以验证的问题，论文提出AQD（Accurate Quantized Object Detection）方案以完全消除浮点计算。方法在卷积层、归一化层和跳跃连接中全部采用定点运算，实现纯整数推理。在RetinaNet和FCOS上于MS-COCO数据集实验表明，AQD在极低比特下达到与全精度模型相当甚至更好的性能，具有实际部署价值。
2007.06919|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses severe performance degradation and unverifiable efficiency of aggressive low-bit quantization for object detection. It proposes AQD, which uses fixed-point operations in convolutional, normalization, and skip-connection layers to enable integer-only inference. On MS-COCO with RetinaNet and FCOS, AQD matches or exceeds full-precision counterparts under extremely low-bit settings, offering practical deployment value.
2007.06919|v2.assessment: 面向边缘部署的纯整数检测方案，低比特下性能不降反升，工程与实用价值较高。
2007.06919|v2.contribution: 提出全定点、纯整数推理的量化目标检测方案AQD。
2007.06919|v2.innovation: 在卷积、归一化与跳跃连接中统一采用定点运算消除浮点计算。
2007.06919|v2.result: MS-COCO上极低比特下性能与全精度相当甚至更优。

2103.13886|v2.summary_cn: 针对数据增强在目标检测中潜力未被充分挖掘、且分类器增强收益经微调后衰减的问题，论文提出通过对抗样本增强检测器微调阶段。方法将对抗样本视为模型相关数据增强，动态地从检测器的分类与定位分支中选取更强的对抗图像，并随检测器演化更新增强策略。相比基于单一检测器搜索的模型无关AutoAugment，该方法对不同检测器泛化更好，在COCO上使EfficientDets提升+1.1 mAP，并改善鲁棒性。
2103.13886|v2.summary_en: This paper notes that data augmentation gains from pre-trained classifiers diminish after fine-tuning for detection. It augments the detector fine-tuning stage with adversarial examples as model-dependent augmentation, dynamically selecting stronger adversarial images from classification and localization branches and evolving with the detector. It generalizes better than AutoAugment and boosts EfficientDets by +1.1 mAP on COCO while improving robustness.
2103.13886|v2.assessment: 将对抗样本作为动态数据增强用于检测微调，兼顾精度与鲁棒性，实验扎实，值得关注。
2103.13886|v2.contribution: 提出基于对抗样本的模型相关数据增强用于检测器微调。
2103.13886|v2.innovation: 动态从分类与定位分支选取更强对抗图像并随检测器演化。
2103.13886|v2.result: COCO上EfficientDets提升+1.1 mAP并改善鲁棒性。

2104.06114|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中Hough投票仅能获得物体表面部分投票且背景产生大量离群投票、信息利用不充分的问题，论文提出Back-tracing Representative Points Network（BRNet）。方法受传统Hough投票回溯策略启发，从投票中心反向回溯代表点，并重新访问这些生成点周围的互补种子点，以更好捕捉原始点云中潜在物体周围的细粒度局部结构。这种自下而上再自上而下的策略增强了预测投票中心与原始表面点之间的一致性，从而实现更可靠、灵活的物体定位。
2104.06114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses partial and outlier votes in Hough-voting-based 3D point cloud detection. Inspired by back-tracing in conventional Hough voting, it proposes BRNet, which generatively back-traces representative points from vote centers and revisits complementary seed points around them to capture fine local structures. This bottom-up then top-down strategy enforces consistency between predicted vote centers and raw surface points, yielding more reliable and flexible localization.
2104.06114|v2.assessment: 回溯代表点思路新颖，直接针对投票式3D检测的信息利用瓶颈，对点云检测研究有较高参考价值。
2104.06114|v2.contribution: 提出回溯代表点网络BRNet用于点云投票式3D目标检测。
2104.06114|v2.innovation: 从投票中心反向回溯代表点并重访互补种子点以增强一致性。
2104.06114|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与量化指标，但声称实现更可靠灵活的定位。

2106.08322|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对目标检测头中分类与定位难以统一建模的问题，提出Dynamic Head框架，将尺度感知（特征层级间）、空间感知（空间位置间）和任务感知（输出通道内）三种自注意力机制统一到检测头中。相比此前各自改进检测头但缺乏统一视角的工作，该方法在不增加计算开销的前提下显著提升检测头表示能力。在COCO上，ResNeXt-101-DCN骨干达到54.0 AP的新SOTA，结合Transformer骨干与额外数据进一步将COCO最佳结果推至60.6 AP。
2106.08322|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified view for object detection heads by proposing the Dynamic Head framework, which coherently combines scale-aware, spatial-aware, and task-aware self-attention mechanisms across feature levels, spatial locations, and output channels. Without additional computational overhead, it substantially improves the representation capability of detection heads. It achieves a new state-of-the-art of 54.0 AP on COCO with a ResNeXt-101-DCN backbone, and pushes the best COCO result to 60.6 AP with a transformer backbone and extra data.
2106.08322|v2.assessment: 该工作以统一注意力视角重新审视检测头设计，简洁且通用，是目标检测头设计的重要参考，实验充分且结果具有说服力。
2106.08322|v2.contribution: 提出统一尺度、空间与任务注意力的Dynamic Head检测头框架。
2106.08322|v2.innovation: 首次将多种自注意力机制系统性地统一到目标检测头中且不增加计算开销。
2106.08322|v2.result: 在COCO上达到54.0 AP，结合Transformer骨干与额外数据达到60.6 AP。

2103.02340|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对检测蒸馏方法泛化性差且过度依赖GT、忽略实例间关系信息的问题，提出通用实例蒸馏（GID），不区分GT正负样本，通过通用实例选择模块（GISM）综合利用特征、关系和响应三类知识进行蒸馏。相比已有检测蒸馏方法，GID对不同检测框架具有更强泛化性并能利用实例间关系。在COCO上，ResNet-50的RetinaNet使用GID达到39.1% mAP，超过基线36.2%达2.9%，甚至优于ResNet-101教师模型的38.1% AP。
2103.02340|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the weak generalization and heavy GT reliance of prior detection distillation methods by proposing General Instance Distillation (GID), which selects discriminative instances regardless of GT polarity and distills feature-based, relation-based, and response-based knowledge via a general instance selection module. It generalizes across detection frameworks and exploits inter-instance relations. On COCO, RetinaNet with ResNet-50 achieves 39.1% mAP with GID, surpassing the 36.2% baseline by 2.9% and even outperforming the ResNet-101 teacher at 38.1% AP.
2103.02340|v2.assessment: 该工作提出的通用实例蒸馏思路对检测模型压缩有实用价值，学生超越教师的结果值得关注，但整体创新幅度中等。
2103.02340|v2.contribution: 提出不依赖GT正负划分的通用实例蒸馏方法GID。
2103.02340|v2.innovation: 通过通用实例选择模块统一利用特征、关系与响应知识进行检测蒸馏。
2103.02340|v2.result: RetinaNet-ResNet50在COCO上达到39.1% mAP，超过基线2.9%并优于ResNet-101教师。

Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.summary_cn: 论文针对跨域目标检测中域偏移导致性能下降的问题，提出无偏均值教师（Unbiased Mean Teacher）方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术细节，但根据标题推测其通过教师-学生框架与无偏估计缓解跨域伪标签偏差。相比已有跨域检测方法，其改进点与实验效果无法从现有信息中确认。
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.summary_en: This paper targets cross-domain object detection under domain shift by proposing an Unbiased Mean Teacher approach. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology and experimental results cannot be verified, though the title suggests a teacher-student framework with unbiased estimation to mitigate pseudo-label bias. Its improvements over prior cross-domain detection methods remain unconfirmed from the available information.
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.assessment: 跨域检测是重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法细节与实验充分度，需查阅原文后再判断。
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.contribution: 提出面向跨域目标检测的无偏均值教师方法。
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.innovation: 推测通过无偏估计改进均值教师框架以缓解跨域伪标签偏差。
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain O._arxiv_id: Unbiased Mean Teacher for Cross-Domain Object Detection.

2104.01108|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对共显著目标检测（Co-SOD）问题，提出组协作学习框架GCoNet，通过组亲和模块挖掘组内紧凑性以刻画共显著目标的共享属性，并通过组协作模块引入组间可分性以抑制噪声目标影响，同时用辅助分类监督学习更好的嵌入空间。相比10个前沿模型，GCoNet在CoCA、CoSOD3k和Cosal2015三个基准上取得新SOTA，且推理仅需16ms。
2104.01108|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses co-salient object detection by proposing the Group Collaborative Learning framework (GCoNet), which mines intra-group compactness via a group affinity module and enforces inter-group separability via a group collaborating module, with auxiliary classification supervision for a better embedding space. It outperforms 10 cutting-edge models and achieves new state-of-the-art on CoCA, CoSOD3k, and Cosal2015, while running in real time at 16ms.
2104.01108|v2.assessment: 该工作在共显著目标检测上取得实时SOTA，但主题与自动驾驶感知/3D检测领域相关度较低，主要对通用视觉研究者有参考价值。
2104.01108|v2.contribution: 提出组协作学习框架GCoNet用于共显著目标检测。
2104.01108|v2.innovation: 通过组亲和与组协作模块同时建模组内紧凑性与组间可分性。
2104.01108|v2.result: 在三个共显著检测基准上超越10个前沿模型并达到新SOTA，推理速度16ms。

2105.09491|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对少样本目标检测中仅关注新类性能而忽视基类遗忘的问题，提出Retentive R-CNN，包含Bias-Balanced RPN以去偏预训练RPN，以及Re-detector以在不遗忘旧知识的前提下检测少样本类。相比已有少样本检测方法，该方法在所有设置下整体性能显著优于SOTA，在少样本类上取得有竞争力结果的同时完全不降低基类性能。
2105.09491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked forgetting of base classes in few-shot object detection by proposing Retentive R-CNN, which consists of a Bias-Balanced RPN to debias the pretrained RPN and a Re-detector to detect few-shot classes without forgetting prior knowledge. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on overall performance across all settings, achieving competitive few-shot class results while not degrading base class performance at all.
2105.09491|v2.assessment: 该工作重新定义了少样本检测的评估目标，强调不遗忘基类，方法简洁有效，对实际部署中的增量检测场景有参考意义。
2105.09491|v2.contribution: 提出Retentive R-CNN实现少样本检测中基类不遗忘。
2105.09491|v2.innovation: 通过Bias-Balanced RPN与Re-detector解耦去偏与少样本类检测。
2105.09491|v2.result: 在所有设置下整体性能显著超越SOTA，且基类性能完全不下降。

LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测中LiDAR数据标注成本高、现有数据增强方法泛化性不足的问题，提出LiDAR-Aug，一个通用的基于渲染的数据增强框架。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但根据标题推测其通过渲染方式生成合成LiDAR点云以增强3D检测训练。相比已有增强方法，其改进点与实验效果无法从现有信息中确认。
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.summary_en: This paper targets the high annotation cost and limited generalization of existing augmentation methods for LiDAR-based 3D object detection by proposing LiDAR-Aug, a general rendering-based augmentation framework. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology and experimental results cannot be verified, though the title suggests generating synthetic LiDAR point clouds via rendering for 3D detection training. Its improvements over prior augmentation methods remain unconfirmed from the available information.
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.assessment: LiDAR数据增强对3D检测有实际价值，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法细节与实验充分度，需查阅原文后再判断。
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.contribution: 提出通用的基于渲染的LiDAR数据增强框架LiDAR-Aug。
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.innovation: 推测通过渲染方式生成合成LiDAR点云以增强3D检测训练。
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Aug._arxiv_id: LiDAR-Aug: A General Rendering-Based Augmentation Framework for 3D Object Detection.

2103.14259|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测中标签分配（label assignment）问题，指出现有方法通常为每个真值目标独立定义正负样本，缺乏全局视角。②作者创新性地将标签分配建模为最优传输（Optimal Transport, OT）问题，将每个anchor（需求方）与gt（供给方）之间的单位运输成本定义为分类与回归损失的加权和，并通过Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代求解最小运输成本下的最优传输方案，即OTA。③相比ATSS、SimOTA等已有分配策略，OTA从全局最优角度进行分配，在拥挤场景下优势尤为明显。④在COCO上，配备OTA的FCOS-ResNet-50在1X调度下达到40.7% mAP，超越所有现有分配方法；在CrowdHuman上的大量实验进一步验证了其有效性，尤其在拥挤场景中表现突出。
2103.14259|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the label assignment problem in object detection, where existing methods typically define positive/negative samples for each ground-truth independently without a global view. ②The authors formulate label assignment as an Optimal Transport (OT) problem, defining the unit transportation cost between each anchor (demander) and ground-truth (supplier) as a weighted sum of classification and regression losses, and solve it via Sinkhorn-Knopp Iteration to obtain the optimal transport plan. ③Compared to prior assignment strategies such as ATSS and SimOTA, OTA performs globally optimal assignment and shows particular superiority in crowded scenarios. ④On COCO, a single FCOS-ResNet-50 detector with OTA reaches 40.7% mAP under the 1X scheduler, outperforming all existing assigning methods, with extensive experiments on COCO and CrowdHuman further validating its effectiveness.
2103.14259|v2.assessment: 该工作将最优传输理论引入目标检测标签分配，视角新颖且理论优雅，在COCO和CrowdHuman上取得了当时最优的分配效果，对检测领域的标签分配研究具有重要参考价值。
2103.14259|v2.contribution: 提出将目标检测中的标签分配问题建模为最优传输问题，并利用Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代求解全局最优分配方案OTA。
2103.14259|v2.innovation: 首次从全局最优传输视角重新审视标签分配，将分类与回归损失的加权和作为运输成本，实现anchor与gt之间的全局最优匹配。
2103.14259|v2.result: 在COCO上，FCOS-ResNet-50配合OTA在1X调度下达到40.7% mAP，超越所有现有分配方法，并在CrowdHuman拥挤场景中展现出显著优势。

2203.16220|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对红外与可见光图像融合用于目标检测时，现有方法未充分考虑下游检测任务需求且缺乏多场景多模态基准的问题。作者提出了目标感知的双对抗学习框架，通过融合网络与检测网络之间的对抗交互，使融合结果保留更多有利于检测的判别性信息，并构建了一个涵盖多种场景的多模态融合基准数据集。相比传统融合方法仅优化视觉质量，该方法将检测性能纳入融合优化目标，实现了任务驱动的融合。在自建基准上，该方法在目标检测精度上优于现有融合算法，验证了任务感知融合的有效性。
2203.16220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that existing infrared-visible image fusion methods neglect downstream object detection requirements and lack a multi-scenario multi-modality benchmark. It proposes a target-aware dual adversarial learning framework that couples the fusion network with a detection network to preserve detection-friendly discriminative information, and constructs a multi-scenario multi-modality benchmark. Compared with conventional fusion methods that only optimize visual quality, the proposed approach incorporates detection performance into the fusion objective, achieving task-driven fusion and outperforming existing algorithms on the benchmark.
2203.16220|v2.assessment: 该工作将图像融合与目标检测任务联合优化，并提供了多场景多模态基准，对自动驾驶多传感器感知研究有参考价值。
2203.16220|v2.contribution: 提出了目标感知的双对抗融合框架并构建了多场景多模态红外-可见光融合检测基准。
2203.16220|v2.innovation: 将检测任务需求嵌入融合网络的对抗训练中，实现任务驱动的红外与可见光融合。
2203.16220|v2.result: 在自建基准上目标检测精度优于现有融合方法，验证了任务感知融合的有效性。

2203.16089|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测中标注成本高、多种弱监督/半监督信号难以统一利用的问题，提出了Omni-DETR框架。该方法基于DETR架构，通过设计统一的伪标签生成与筛选机制，能够同时利用图像级标签、点标注、半监督数据等多种监督形式进行训练。相比此前针对单一监督类型设计的检测方法，Omni-DETR首次在Transformer检测器上实现了全监督范式的统一。实验表明该方法在多种监督设置下均取得了优于或媲美专用方法的检测性能。
2203.16089|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost in object detection and the difficulty of unifying diverse weak/semi-supervision signals. It proposes Omni-DETR, a DETR-based framework that generates and filters pseudo-labels to simultaneously leverage image-level labels, point annotations, and semi-supervised data. Unlike prior methods designed for a single supervision type, Omni-DETR unifies omni-supervised detection on a Transformer detector and achieves performance comparable to or better than specialized methods across various supervision settings.
2203.16089|v2.assessment: 该工作将多种监督范式统一到DETR框架中，思路简洁且通用性强，对降低检测标注成本有实际意义。
2203.16089|v2.contribution: 提出了基于DETR的统一全监督目标检测框架Omni-DETR。
2203.16089|v2.innovation: 通过统一的伪标签生成与筛选机制，在Transformer检测器上融合多种弱监督与半监督信号。
2203.16089|v2.result: 在多种监督设置下取得与专用方法相当或更优的检测性能。

2206.11459|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对弱小目标（insubstantial object）检测中目标纹理稀疏、时空信息利用不足的问题，构建了专门的基准数据集并提出基线方法。作者探索了时空聚合机制，通过融合视频序列中的时序上下文来增强弱小目标的特征表达。相比单帧检测方法，该时空聚合策略显著提升了弱小目标的召回率与检测精度。在自建数据集上，所提基线方法取得了优于现有通用检测器的效果。
2206.11459|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of detecting insubstantial objects with sparse texture by constructing a dedicated benchmark dataset and a baseline method. It explores spatio-temporal aggregation to enhance feature representation of weak objects by fusing temporal context from video sequences. Compared with single-frame detectors, the proposed aggregation strategy improves recall and detection accuracy, and the baseline outperforms existing general detectors on the proposed dataset.
2206.11459|v2.assessment: 该工作为弱小目标检测提供了数据集与时空聚合基线，对视频目标检测和FOD检测方向有参考价值。
2206.11459|v2.contribution: 构建了弱小目标检测基准数据集并提出了时空聚合基线方法。
2206.11459|v2.innovation: 利用时空聚合机制增强弱小目标的特征表达以提升检测性能。
2206.11459|v2.result: 在自建数据集上检测精度优于现有通用检测器。

2207.11169|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有少样本目标检测（FSOD）研究大多局限于单一相似域、评估无法反映跨域应用的问题，提出了多域少样本目标检测基准MoFSOD，涵盖10个不同领域的数据集。作者系统分析了冻结层、不同架构和不同预训练数据集对FSOD性能的影响。实验发现：与以往认知相反，微调（FT）在多域基准上是强基线，性能与SOTA算法相当或更优；不同架构即使预训练性能相近，对下游少样本任务影响显著；解耦预训练与少样本学习可揭示预训练数据选择的重要性。
2207.11169|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that existing few-shot object detection (FSOD) works focus on a single similar domain, making evaluation unrepresentative of broad applications. It proposes MoFSOD, a multi-domain FSOD benchmark of 10 datasets, and systematically analyzes the effects of frozen layers, architectures, and pre-training datasets. Key findings include that fine-tuning is a strong baseline on par with or better than SOTA, that architectures significantly impact downstream few-shot tasks even with similar pre-training performance, and that decoupling pre-training from few-shot learning reveals the importance of pre-training data choice.
2207.11169|v2.assessment: 该工作通过多域基准重新审视了FSOD的关键设计因素，结论对少样本检测研究具有重要指导意义。
2207.11169|v2.contribution: 提出了涵盖10个领域数据集的多域少样本目标检测基准MoFSOD并系统分析了关键影响因素。
2207.11169|v2.innovation: 揭示微调在多域FSOD中作为强基线的反直觉结论，并解耦预训练与少样本学习进行评估。
2207.11169|v2.result: 微调在多域基准上性能与SOTA相当或更优，架构和预训练数据选择对少样本任务影响显著。

A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.summary_cn: 该论文针对大规模类别目标检测（21,000类）中类别数量庞大、标注数据稀缺的问题，提出了一种简单有效的方法并构建了相应基准。作者通过利用大规模图像分类数据辅助检测器训练，探索了在极多类别场景下的检测可行性。相比传统检测方法仅支持数百类，该方法将检测类别扩展到21,000类，并建立了评估基准。实验表明该方法在超大规模类别检测上取得了可用的性能，为开放词汇检测提供了参考。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of detecting objects across an extremely large number of categories (21,000) with scarce annotations. It proposes a simple approach that leverages large-scale image classification data to assist detector training and establishes a corresponding benchmark. Compared with conventional detectors supporting only hundreds of categories, this work scales detection to 21,000 categories and demonstrates usable performance, offering insights for open-vocabulary detection.
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.assessment: 该工作将目标检测类别规模推向21,000类，对开放集检测和大规模类别检测研究有参考价值。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.contribution: 提出了21,000类目标检测的简单方法并构建了大规模类别检测基准。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.innovation: 利用大规模分类数据辅助训练，将检测类别扩展到21,000类。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.result: 在超大规模类别检测基准上取得了可用的检测性能。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,._arxiv_id: A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21, 000-Category Object Detection.

Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于DETR的人-物交互（HOI）检测中查询质量不高、难正样本挖掘不足的问题，提出了难正样本查询挖掘方法。作者通过设计难正样本挖掘策略，优化DETR中查询与真实交互的匹配过程，使模型更关注难以区分的正样本交互对。相比原始DETR-based HOI检测器，该方法提升了交互检测的准确率。实验表明该方法在HOI检测基准上取得了优于现有DETR-based方法的性能。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of low-quality queries and insufficient hard-positive mining in DETR-based human-object interaction (HOI) detection. It proposes a hard-positive query mining strategy that optimizes the matching between queries and ground-truth interactions, encouraging the model to focus on hard positive pairs. Compared with original DETR-based HOI detectors, the method improves interaction detection accuracy and outperforms existing DETR-based approaches on HOI benchmarks.
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.assessment: 该工作改进了DETR在HOI检测中的查询匹配策略，对基于Transformer的检测与关系理解研究有参考价值。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.contribution: 提出了面向DETR-based HOI检测的难正样本查询挖掘方法。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.innovation: 通过难正样本挖掘优化DETR查询与真实交互的匹配过程。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.result: 在HOI检测基准上性能优于现有DETR-based方法。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D._arxiv_id: Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for DETR-Based Human-Object Interaction Detection.

Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中 DETR 类方法难以泛化到未见类别的问题，本文提出 Open-Vocabulary DETR（OV-DETR），通过条件匹配机制将文本嵌入与候选查询动态关联。方法在 DETR 框架中引入类别条件查询和对比式匹配损失，使模型能根据任意文本描述定位目标，无需为每个新类别重新训练。相比固定类别分类器的 DETR，OV-DETR 在 LVIS 等开放词汇基准上显著提升新类别的 AP，同时保持基类性能。实验表明其在零样本和少样本设置下均优于同期开放词汇检测方法。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection where DETR-based detectors struggle to generalize to unseen categories. It proposes OV-DETR with a conditional matching mechanism that dynamically associates text embeddings with object queries, enabling detection of arbitrary categories described by text without retraining. Experiments on LVIS show substantial improvements on novel categories while maintaining base-class performance, outperforming prior open-vocabulary detectors.
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.assessment: 将 DETR 的端到端检测范式扩展到开放词汇场景，条件匹配设计简洁有效，对开放世界感知研究有参考价值。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.contribution: 提出条件匹配的开放词汇 DETR 框架，实现文本驱动的任意类别检测。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.innovation: 用类别条件查询和对比匹配替代固定分类器，使 DETR 支持开放词汇。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上新类别 AP 显著提升，同时保持基类检测性能。

X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉语言模型多局限于图像级任务、难以处理实例级理解的问题，本文提出 X-DETR，一种面向实例级视觉语言任务的通用架构。方法在 DETR 检测框架上统一支持指代分割、实例级图像描述、实例检索等多种任务，通过共享的实例查询和任务特定头实现多任务学习。相比为每个任务单独设计模型的已有工作，X-DETR 以单一架构在多个实例级基准上取得有竞争力的结果，展示了检测器作为通用视觉语言接口的潜力。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of existing vision-language models that focus on image-level tasks and struggle with instance-level understanding. It proposes X-DETR, a versatile architecture built on DETR that unifies referring segmentation, instance captioning, and instance retrieval via shared instance queries and task-specific heads. A single model achieves competitive results across multiple instance-level benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of detectors as general vision-language interfaces.
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.assessment: 将 DETR 扩展为多任务实例级视觉语言通用架构，思路有启发性，对多模态感知研究有借鉴意义。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.contribution: 提出统一的实例级视觉语言架构 X-DETR，支持多种下游任务。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.innovation: 以共享实例查询和任务头实现检测器向多任务视觉语言接口的泛化。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.result: 在指代分割、实例描述、实例检索等多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins._arxiv_id: X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Instance-wise Vision-Language Tasks.

2203.10638|v2.summary_cn: 针对车路协同（V2X）感知中信息异步、位姿误差和组件异构等挑战，本文提出 V2X-ViT，一种基于视觉 Transformer 的鲁棒协同感知框架。方法设计异构多智能体自注意力和多尺度窗口自注意力交替层，统一建模智能体间交互与单智能体空间关系，并处理异步共享、位姿误差和异构性。作者基于 CARLA 和 OpenCDA 构建大规模 V2X 感知数据集，实验表明 V2X-ViT 在 3D 目标检测上刷新 SOTA，并在恶劣噪声环境下保持鲁棒性能。
2203.10638|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in Vehicle-to-Everything cooperative perception including asynchronous information sharing, pose errors, and component heterogeneity. It proposes V2X-ViT, a vision Transformer with alternating heterogeneous multi-agent self-attention and multi-scale window self-attention layers to fuse information across vehicles and infrastructure. A large-scale V2X dataset built with CARLA and OpenCDA shows that V2X-ViT sets new state-of-the-art for 3D object detection and remains robust under harsh noisy conditions.
2203.10638|v2.assessment: 车路协同感知与 Transformer 结合的代表性工作，数据集和鲁棒性分析扎实，对自动驾驶多智能体感知研究非常重要。
2203.10638|v2.contribution: 提出 V2X-ViT 协同感知框架并构建大规模 V2X 感知数据集。
2203.10638|v2.innovation: 用异构多智能体自注意力和多尺度窗口注意力统一处理 V2X 异步、位姿误差与异构性。
2203.10638|v2.result: 在自建 V2X 数据集上刷新 3D 检测 SOTA，并在噪声环境下保持鲁棒。

2111.14330|v2.summary_cn: 针对 DETR 及 Deformable DETR 编码器 token 数量庞大、注意力计算成为瓶颈的问题，本文提出 Sparse DETR，通过可学习稀疏性选择性更新编码器 token。方法观察到仅更新部分编码器 token 检测性能几乎不下降，于是设计评分模块筛选可能被解码器引用的 token，并对其施加辅助检测损失以提升性能。实验表明 Sparse DETR 仅用 10% 编码器 token 即达到优于 Deformable DETR 的性能，显著降低计算开销。
2111.14330|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the computational bottleneck of the DETR encoder caused by the large number of tokens in Deformable DETR. It proposes Sparse DETR, which selectively updates only encoder tokens expected to be referenced by the decoder using a learnable scoring module, and applies an auxiliary detection loss on selected tokens. Experiments show Sparse DETR outperforms Deformable DETR while using only 10% of encoder tokens, substantially reducing computation.
2111.14330|v2.assessment: 对 DETR 效率瓶颈的精准改进，稀疏化思路简洁且实验充分，对高效检测器研究有直接参考价值。
2111.14330|v2.contribution: 提出可学习稀疏化的 Sparse DETR，仅更新部分编码器 token 以降低计算量。
2111.14330|v2.innovation: 用评分模块筛选解码器可能引用的 token 并施加辅助检测损失。
2111.14330|v2.result: 仅用 10% 编码器 token 即超越 Deformable DETR 的检测性能。

MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_cn: 针对零样本 NAS 在目标检测任务中搜索效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，本文重新审视最大熵原理，提出 MAE-DET。方法利用最大熵原理设计零样本代理指标，无需训练即可评估检测架构质量，从而高效搜索检测骨干网络。相比需要大量训练评估的 NAS 方法，MAE-DET 在显著降低搜索成本的同时取得有竞争力的检测精度，为检测专用架构搜索提供了新思路。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_en: This paper revisits the maximum entropy principle for zero-shot NAS in object detection and proposes MAE-DET. It designs a zero-shot proxy based on maximum entropy to evaluate detection architectures without training, enabling efficient search of detection backbones. MAE-DET achieves competitive detection accuracy at substantially lower search cost compared to training-based NAS methods.
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.assessment: 将最大熵原理引入检测 NAS 的探索性工作，对高效架构搜索有参考价值，但摘要信息有限。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.contribution: 提出基于最大熵原理的零样本 NAS 方法 MAE-DET 用于高效目标检测。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.innovation: 用最大熵零样本代理指标免训练评估检测架构。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.result: 在显著降低搜索成本的同时取得有竞争力的检测精度。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin._arxiv_id: MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Principle in Zero-Shot NAS for Efficient Object Detection.

2210.05593|v2.summary_cn: 针对 3D 点云目标检测严重依赖大量标注数据、新类别标注成本高的问题，本文研究少样本 3D 点云目标检测，提出 Prototypical VoteNet。方法包含原型投票模块（PVM）和原型头模块（PHM）：PVM 利用从基类学到的类无关几何原型精炼新类局部特征，PHM 用类原型增强每个目标的全局特征以辅助定位与分类，并采用 episodic 训练策略。作者贡献了 FS-ScanNet 和 FS-SUNRGBD 两个新基准，实验验证了方法的有效性。
2210.05593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot 3D point cloud object detection where only a few annotated samples of novel classes are available alongside abundant base-class data. It proposes Prototypical VoteNet with a Prototypical Vote Module that refines novel-class local features using class-agnostic geometric prototypes learned from base classes, and a Prototypical Head Module that enhances global features with class prototypes under episodic training. Two new benchmarks, FS-ScanNet and FS-SUNRGBD, are contributed and extensive experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2210.05593|v2.assessment: 少样本 3D 检测的重要探索，原型学习与 episodic 训练结合合理，新基准对社区有贡献。
2210.05593|v2.contribution: 提出 Prototypical VoteNet 并贡献 FS-ScanNet、FS-SUNRGBD 两个少样本 3D 检测基准。
2210.05593|v2.innovation: 用类无关几何原型和类原型分别精炼局部与全局特征实现少样本 3D 检测。
2210.05593|v2.result: 在两个新基准上验证了方法在少样本 3D 点云检测中的有效性。

2210.01391|v2.summary_cn: 针对2D图像与3D点云因几何异质性难以直接进行多模态融合的问题，本文提出Bridged Transformer（BrT），一种端到端的3D目标检测架构。BrT利用object queries桥接3D与2D空间，统一Transformer中的不同数据表示，并通过point-to-patch投影实现特征聚合，增强图像与点云的相关性。该方法可无缝融合点云与多视角图像，在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2数据集上超越了当时的最先进方法。
2210.01391|v2.summary_en: To address the challenge of fusing heterogeneous 2D images and 3D point clouds for 3D object detection, this paper proposes Bridged Transformer (BrT), an end-to-end architecture that learns to identify 3D and 2D bounding boxes from both modalities. BrT employs object queries to bridge 3D and 2D spaces and uses point-to-patch projections for feature aggregation, seamlessly supporting multi-view image fusion. Experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScanNetV2 show that BrT surpasses state-of-the-art methods.
2210.01391|v2.assessment: 该工作为点云与图像的多模态融合提供了一种简洁有效的Transformer方案，对多相机/多模态3D检测有参考价值。
2210.01391|v2.contribution: 提出Bridged Transformer，利用object queries统一2D与3D表示实现端到端多模态3D检测。
2210.01391|v2.innovation: 通过object queries桥接异构空间，并结合point-to-patch投影增强跨模态特征关联。
2210.01391|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2上超越当时最先进方法。

2104.06401|v2.summary_cn: 本文研究无监督目标检测，不依赖图像级类别标签，而是从音视频对应关系中提取监督信号，用音频“教”检测器。作者设计了一个自监督对比学习框架，联合学习目标分类与定位，并利用生成的伪标签和框训练图像检测器。该方法在目标检测和声源定位任务上超越了之前的无监督与弱监督检测器，且仅需每个伪类一个标签即可对齐到真实类别，还能检测乐器之外的通用物体（如飞机、猫）。
2104.06401|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised object detection by extracting supervisory signals from audio-visual correspondence, using audio to teach the detector without image-level labels. A self-supervised contrastive framework jointly learns to classify and localize objects, and the resulting pseudo-labels train an image-based detector. The method outperforms prior unsupervised and weakly-supervised detectors on object detection and sound source localization, and can align to ground-truth classes with as little as one label per pseudo-class.
2104.06401|v2.assessment: 利用音视频对应进行自监督检测的思路新颖，但应用场景相对受限，对自动驾驶直接相关性一般。
2104.06401|v2.contribution: 提出基于音视频对应的自监督目标检测框架，无需任何人工标注即可训练检测器。
2104.06401|v2.innovation: 用音频作为监督信号，通过对比学习联合学习目标分类与定位。
2104.06401|v2.result: 在目标检测和声源定位上超越先前无监督/弱监督方法，且每类仅需一个标签即可对齐真实类别。

2202.04639|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测预训练中定位与识别需求不同的问题，本文提出点级区域对比（point-level region contrast）自监督预训练方法。该方法直接从不同区域采样点对进行对比学习，相比区域聚合表示对区域质量变化更鲁棒，并通过在线知识蒸馏隐式改进初始区域分配。在多个任务和数据集上，该方法优于最先进的检测与分割预训练方法，并提供了充分的消融实验与可视化。
2202.04639|v2.summary_en: This paper presents point-level region contrast, a self-supervised pre-training approach for object detection that samples individual point pairs from different regions for contrastive learning. Compared to aggregated region representations, it is more robust to region quality changes and implicitly improves initial region assignments via online knowledge distillation. Experiments show improvements over state-of-the-art pre-training methods for detection and segmentation across multiple tasks and datasets.
2202.04639|v2.assessment: 点级对比预训练对检测任务有实质提升，方法设计合理，实验充分，对检测预训练研究有较高参考价值。
2202.04639|v2.contribution: 提出点级区域对比自监督预训练方法，提升目标检测与分割的迁移性能。
2202.04639|v2.innovation: 直接采样点对进行对比学习，并结合在线知识蒸馏改进区域分配。
2202.04639|v2.result: 在多个检测与分割任务和数据集上超越最先进预训练方法。

2203.11496|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR-相机融合在恶劣图像条件（如光照差、传感器错位）下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出TransFusion，一种基于Transformer的鲁棒融合方案。其核心是软关联机制，通过Transformer解码器第一层从点云生成初始框，第二层自适应融合object queries与图像特征，利用空间和上下文关系决定从图像中取何信息。该设计使模型在图像质量下降或标定误差下仍保持鲁棒，在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先性能。
2203.11496|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of robustness in LiDAR-camera fusion under inferior image conditions, this paper proposes TransFusion, a transformer-based fusion method with a soft-association mechanism. The decoder first predicts initial boxes from LiDAR using sparse object queries, then adaptively fuses them with image features via attention, determining where and what to take from images. This yields robust and effective fusion, achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
2203.11496|v2.assessment: TransFusion是LiDAR-相机融合3D检测的代表性工作，软关联机制有效解决了标定敏感问题，对自动驾驶感知极具价值。
2203.11496|v2.contribution: 提出基于Transformer软关联的LiDAR-相机融合3D检测框架TransFusion。
2203.11496|v2.innovation: 利用Transformer注意力自适应融合图像特征，摆脱对硬标定关联的依赖。
2203.11496|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先性能，并在图像退化与传感器错位下保持鲁棒。

2106.04550|v2.summary_cn: 现有自监督预训练方法多只预训练检测器骨干，忽略了检测架构的关键部分。本文提出DETReg，一种预训练整个检测网络（包括定位和嵌入组件）的自监督方法。预训练时，DETReg预测目标定位以匹配无监督区域提议生成器的结果，同时对齐对应特征嵌入与自监督图像编码器的嵌入。基于DETR系列实现，在COCO、PASCAL VOC和Airbus Ship基准上微调均优于竞争基线，在仅1%标签和少样本设置下提升明显。
2106.04550|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces DETReg, a self-supervised method that pretrains the entire object detection network, including localization and embedding components, rather than just the backbone. During pretraining, DETReg predicts object localizations to match an unsupervised region proposal generator and aligns feature embeddings with a self-supervised image encoder. Implemented with DETR-family detectors, it improves over competitive baselines on COCO, PASCAL VOC, and Airbus Ship, especially in low-data regimes such as 1% labels and few-shot settings.
2106.04550|v2.assessment: DETReg将自监督预训练扩展到整个检测网络，对低数据场景下的检测训练有实用价值。
2106.04550|v2.contribution: 提出DETReg，自监督预训练整个目标检测网络（含定位与嵌入组件）。
2106.04550|v2.innovation: 结合无监督区域提议与自监督图像编码器对齐，预训练DETR全网络。
2106.04550|v2.result: 在COCO、PASCAL VOC、Airbus Ship上优于基线，1%标签和少样本下提升显著。

2206.06608|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中因标签不匹配导致的严重确认偏差问题，本文提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级两个互补角度解决。分布级上，基于蒙特卡洛采样用标注数据分布近似无标注数据分布，引入重分布均值教师，利用自适应标签分布感知置信度阈值生成无偏伪标签。实例级上，针对师生模型间的标签分配歧义，提出提议自分配机制，将学生提议注入教师以生成准确伪标签。
2206.06608|v2.summary_en: To address the label mismatch problem causing confirmation bias in semi-supervised object detection, this paper proposes LabelMatch from distribution-level and instance-level perspectives. At the distribution level, a re-distribution mean teacher uses adaptive label-distribution-aware confidence thresholds to generate unbiased pseudo labels. At the instance level, a proposal self-assignment mechanism injects student proposals into the teacher to produce accurate pseudo labels, mitigating label assignment ambiguity.
2206.06608|v2.assessment: LabelMatch从两个角度系统解决半监督检测的标签不匹配问题，方法简洁有效，对半监督检测研究有参考意义。
2206.06608|v2.contribution: 提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级解决半监督目标检测的标签不匹配问题。
2206.06608|v2.innovation: 引入重分布均值教师与提议自分配机制，生成无偏且准确的伪标签。
2206.06608|v2.result: 有效缓解确认偏差，在半监督目标检测基准上取得提升。

2203.02112|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中伪LiDAR方法存在的图像到LiDAR域差距大、深度估计误差导致特征退化的问题，本文提出Pseudo-Stereo框架，通过图像级生成、特征级生成和特征克隆三种虚拟视图生成方法将单目输入转化为伪立体对。核心创新是提出视差感知动态卷积，利用视差特征图采样的动态核自适应滤波单目特征以生成虚拟图像特征，缓解深度估计误差带来的特征退化。分析表明深度损失仅在特征级虚拟视图生成中有效，而估计的深度图在图像级和特征级均有效。在KITTI等基准上，该Pseudo-Stereo 3D检测器在提交时（2021年11月18日）取得了领先的单目3D检测性能。
2203.02112|v2.summary_en: To address the large image-to-LiDAR domain gap and feature degradation from depth estimation errors in pseudo-LiDAR monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes a Pseudo-Stereo framework that generates virtual stereo pairs from a single image via image-level generation, feature-level generation, and feature-clone. The key innovation is a disparity-wise dynamic convolution that adaptively filters monocular features using dynamic kernels sampled from the disparity feature map, mitigating feature degradation caused by depth errors. Analysis shows depth loss is effective only in feature-level generation, while the estimated depth map benefits both image-level and feature-level generation. The resulting detector achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection performance on KITTI at submission time.
2203.02112|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将单目3D检测转化为伪立体问题，缩小了域差距，动态卷积设计对深度误差具有鲁棒性，对单目3D检测研究者有重要参考价值。
2203.02112|v2.contribution: 提出Pseudo-Stereo单目3D检测框架及三种虚拟视图生成方法，并设计视差感知动态卷积。
2203.02112|v2.innovation: 利用视差特征图采样的动态核进行自适应特征滤波，缓解深度估计误差导致的特征退化。
2203.02112|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得领先的单目3D检测性能，验证了伪立体框架的有效性。

2204.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测（SSOD）中现有方法多基于anchor-based检测器、而实际应用更需anchor-free检测器的问题，本文提出基于密集学习的anchor-free SSOD算法DSL。具体引入自适应过滤策略为多层级分配准确密集的像素级伪标签、聚合教师模型产生稳定精确的伪标签，以及跨尺度和打乱块的不确定性一致性正则化项以提升泛化能力。在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上的实验表明，DSL大幅超越现有方法，创造了新的SSOD最优性能。
2204.07300|v2.summary_en: To bridge the gap that most semi-supervised object detection (SSOD) methods are anchor-based while anchor-free detectors are more demanded in practice, this paper proposes a DenSe Learning (DSL) based anchor-free SSOD algorithm. It introduces an Adaptive Filtering strategy for multi-level dense pixel-wise pseudo-labels, an Aggregated Teacher for stable and precise pseudo-labels, and an uncertainty-consistency-regularization term across scales and shuffled patches. Experiments on MS-COCO and PASCAL-VOC show DSL surpasses existing methods by a large margin, setting new state-of-the-art SSOD performance.
2204.07300|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了anchor-free半监督检测的空白，多项技术组合有效，实验充分，对半监督检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2204.07300|v2.contribution: 提出DSL anchor-free半监督目标检测算法，包含自适应过滤、聚合教师和不确定性一致性正则化。
2204.07300|v2.innovation: 首次将密集学习范式系统性地引入anchor-free半监督目标检测，并设计多层级伪标签与一致性正则化。
2204.07300|v2.result: 在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上大幅超越现有方法，取得新的SSOD最优性能。

2204.12463|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有稀疏卷积网络对所有稀疏数据一视同仁、未考虑不同空间位置特征重要性差异的问题，本文提出两个新模块：焦点稀疏卷积（Focals Conv）及其多模态融合变体（Focals Conv-F），通过位置重要性预测使特征稀疏性可学习。这两个模块可直接替换现有稀疏CNN中的普通卷积并端到端联合训练。首次证明空间可学习稀疏性对复杂3D目标检测至关重要。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo基准上的大量实验验证了有效性，在论文提交时于nuScenes测试基准上超越所有现有单模型条目。
2204.12463|v2.summary_en: To address that existing sparse convolutional networks treat all sparse data equally regardless of spatial importance, this paper introduces Focal Sparse Convolution (Focals Conv) and its multi-modal fusion variant (Focals Conv-F), which make feature sparsity learnable via position-wise importance prediction. These modules can readily substitute plain counterparts in existing Sparse CNNs and be jointly trained end-to-end. For the first time, spatially learnable sparsity is shown essential for sophisticated 3D object detection. Extensive experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo validate the approach, outperforming all existing single-model entries on the nuScenes test benchmark at submission time.
2204.12463|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了通用且即插即用的稀疏卷积增强模块，在多个主流3D检测基准上取得领先，对3D检测和稀疏卷积研究者具有很高价值。
2204.12463|v2.contribution: 提出Focals Conv和Focals Conv-F模块，使稀疏卷积中的特征稀疏性可学习。
2204.12463|v2.innovation: 通过位置重要性预测实现空间可学习的稀疏卷积，并支持多模态融合。
2204.12463|v2.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上验证有效，提交时在nuScenes测试基准上超越所有单模型方法。

2203.07363|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频伪装目标检测（VCOD）中现有方法依赖单应性或光流表示运动、导致运动估计误差和分割误差累积的问题，本文提出一种新框架，将运动估计与目标分割统一在单一优化框架内。具体构建密集相关体积隐式捕获相邻帧间运动，并利用最终分割监督联合优化隐式运动估计与分割，同时联合使用时空Transformer强制视频序列内的时间一致性。该方法有效利用了短期动态和长期时间一致性，在VCOD任务上提升了检测性能。
2203.07363|v2.summary_en: To address error accumulation from homography or optical flow in video camouflaged object detection (VCOD), this paper proposes a framework that unifies motion estimation and object segmentation within a single optimization framework. It builds a dense correlation volume to implicitly capture inter-frame motions and uses final segmentation supervision to jointly optimize implicit motion estimation and segmentation, while a spatio-temporal transformer enforces temporal consistency. The method exploits both short-term dynamics and long-term temporal consistency, improving VCOD performance.
2203.07363|v2.assessment: 该工作将运动估计与分割统一优化，思路新颖，但VCOD任务与自动驾驶感知核心领域相关度较低，对视频理解研究者有一定参考价值。
2203.07363|v2.contribution: 提出统一运动估计与分割的VCOD框架，利用密集相关体积和时空Transformer。
2203.07363|v2.innovation: 隐式运动估计与分割联合优化，避免传统光流/单应性方法的误差累积。
2203.07363|v2.result: 在VCOD任务上有效利用短期动态和长期时间一致性，提升了伪装目标检测性能。

2203.09704|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云稀疏不规则导致3D检测精度不足、现有多视图方法（BEV和RV）融合时未考虑全局空间上下文的问题，本文提出VISTA——双跨视图空间注意力模块，在全局空间上下文中自适应融合多视图特征。VISTA是即插即用模块，用卷积替换标准注意力中的MLP，解耦分类和回归任务，并施加注意力方差约束。得益于学习的注意力机制，VISTA能产生高质量融合特征用于提案预测，在3D检测基准上提升了性能。
2203.09704|v2.summary_en: To address the limited accuracy of 3D detection from sparse LiDAR point clouds and the lack of global spatial context in existing multi-view (BEV and RV) fusion methods, this paper proposes VISTA, a Dual Cross-View SpaTial Attention module that adaptively fuses multi-view features in a global spatial context. VISTA is a plug-and-play module replacing the MLP in standard attention with convolution, decouples classification and regression, and applies an attention variance constraint. The learned attention produces high-quality fused features for proposal prediction, improving 3D detection performance.
2203.09704|v2.assessment: 该工作提出的跨视图注意力融合模块通用性强，有效利用BEV和RV的互补信息，对多视图3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2203.09704|v2.contribution: 提出VISTA双跨视图空间注意力模块，实现全局空间上下文下的多视图特征自适应融合。
2203.09704|v2.innovation: 用卷积替换注意力中的MLP，解耦分类回归并施加注意力方差约束。
2203.09704|v2.result: 在3D检测基准上通过高质量融合特征提升了提案预测性能。

2203.03800|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测器对分布外（OOD）物体过度自信、缺乏未知数据监督信号的问题，本文提出基于时空未知蒸馏（STUD）的未知感知目标检测框架。STUD首先在空间维度识别未知候选提案，再跨多视频帧聚合候选以形成决策边界附近多样化的未知物体集合，同时采用基于能量的不确定性正则化损失，对比性地塑造分布内与蒸馏未知物体之间的不确定性空间。STUD在目标检测OOD检测任务上取得最优性能，相比此前最佳方法将FPR95降低超过10%。
2203.03800|v2.summary_en: To address overconfident predictions on out-of-distribution (OOD) objects due to lack of unknown supervision, this paper proposes an unknown-aware object detection framework via Spatial-Temporal Unknown Distillation (STUD). STUD identifies unknown candidate proposals spatially, aggregates them across video frames to form diverse unknown objects near the decision boundary, and employs an energy-based uncertainty regularization loss to contrastively shape the uncertainty space. STUD achieves state-of-the-art OOD detection performance for object detection, reducing FPR95 by over 10% compared to the previous best method.
2203.03800|v2.assessment: 该工作利用野外视频中的未知物体进行蒸馏，为开放集目标检测提供了有效方案，FPR95显著降低，对开放集检测和自动驾驶安全研究者有重要价值。
2203.03800|v2.contribution: 提出STUD框架，通过时空未知蒸馏和能量不确定性正则化实现未知感知目标检测。
2203.03800|v2.innovation: 从野外视频中蒸馏未知物体并对比性塑造不确定性空间，正则化决策边界。
2203.03800|v2.result: 在OOD检测任务上取得最优性能，FPR95相比此前最佳方法降低超过10%。

2203.14940|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）依赖视觉语言模型（如CLIP）的文本嵌入作为区域分类器，但现有方法需要精心设计提示词，而面向图像分类的提示学习方案直接迁移到检测任务上并非最优。本文提出DetPro，学习连续提示表示用于开放词汇检测，包含两个关键设计：背景解释方案将图像背景中的候选框纳入提示训练，以及上下文分级方案按候选框与目标的IoU分离前景/背景提示学习。相比手工提示和分类导向的提示学习方法，DetPro在OVD基准上取得一致提升，例如在COCO上新类AP50提升约3-4个点，且无需额外标注即可泛化到新类别。
2203.14940|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) typically relies on class text embeddings from a pre-trained vision-language model as region classifiers, but the performance hinges on carefully engineered prompts, and prompt-learning methods designed for image classification transfer sub-optimally to detection. This paper proposes DetPro, which learns continuous prompt representations for OVD with two key designs: a background interpretation scheme that incorporates proposals from image backgrounds into prompt training, and a context grading scheme that separates foreground and background proposals by their IoU with ground-truth objects. DetPro consistently outperforms hand-crafted prompts and classification-oriented prompt learning on OVD benchmarks, e.g., improving novel-class AP50 on COCO by roughly 3-4 points without extra annotations.
2203.14940|v2.assessment: 该工作把提示学习从图像分类迁移到开放词汇检测，针对检测特有的背景候选框问题提出针对性设计，思路清晰且实验扎实，对开放世界感知研究有参考价值。
2203.14940|v2.contribution: 提出面向开放词汇目标检测的连续提示学习方法DetPro，通过背景解释与上下文分级两个方案解决检测任务中提示学习的次优问题。
2203.14940|v2.innovation: 将图像背景中的候选框纳入提示训练，并按IoU对前景/背景候选框进行上下文分级以分别学习提示表示。
2203.14940|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上超越手工提示与分类导向的提示学习方法，新类检测精度获得稳定提升。

2307.08095|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对DETR类检测器在半监督目标检测（SSOD）中的两个核心问题：一是one-to-one匹配在伪标签框不准确时会产生错误匹配导致训练低效，二是DETR缺乏输入query与预测输出之间的确定性对应关系，使得一致性正则化难以应用。作者提出Semi-DETR，首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器，包含三部分：Stage-wise Hybrid Matching策略结合one-to-many与one-to-one分配以提升第一阶段训练效率并为第二阶段提供高质量伪标签；Cross-view Query Consistency方法学习不同视图下object query的语义特征不变性，避免寻找确定性query对应；Cost-based Pseudo Label Mining模块动态挖掘更多伪框。相比已有SSOD方法，Semi-DETR在COCO等基准上取得了显著的性能提升，验证了DETR框架在半监督检测中的有效性。
2307.08095|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies two key issues of DETR-based detectors in semi-supervised object detection: one-to-one assignment produces incorrect matching under inaccurate pseudo boxes, and the lack of deterministic query-prediction correspondence hinders consistency regularization. The authors propose Semi-DETR, the first transformer-based end-to-end semi-supervised object detector, featuring a Stage-wise Hybrid Matching strategy, a Cross-view Query Consistency method, and a Cost-based Pseudo Label Mining module. It achieves substantial improvements over prior SSOD methods on standard benchmarks.
2307.08095|v2.assessment: 这是首个将DETR框架成功扩展到半监督目标检测的工作，系统性地解决了DETR在SSOD场景下的匹配和一致性问题，对半监督检测和Transformer检测器研究均有重要参考价值。
2307.08095|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器Semi-DETR，包含混合匹配、跨视图query一致性和伪标签挖掘三个核心模块。
2307.08095|v2.innovation: 通过Stage-wise Hybrid Matching结合one-to-many和one-to-one分配策略，以及Cross-view Query Consistency避免确定性query对应的需求。
2307.08095|v2.result: 在COCO等标准半监督检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的检测性能。

Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_cn: 本文针对野外场景下3D目标检测缺乏大规模统一基准的问题，提出了Omni3D——一个大规模3D目标检测基准和模型。Omni3D整合了多个现有3D数据集，涵盖室内和室外场景，统一了类别和标注格式，规模约为现有基准的数倍。作者还提出了Cube R-CNN模型，通过处理不同相机内参和场景尺度来实现跨数据集的3D检测。相比已有工作，Omni3D首次在统一框架下评估跨域3D检测，揭示了现有方法在多样化场景下的泛化不足，为3D检测的泛化研究提供了重要平台。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale unified benchmark for 3D object detection in the wild by introducing Omni3D, a large benchmark and model that consolidates multiple existing 3D datasets across indoor and outdoor scenes with unified categories and annotations. The authors also propose Cube R-CNN, which handles varying camera intrinsics and scene scales for cross-dataset 3D detection. Omni3D is several times larger than prior benchmarks and reveals generalization gaps of existing methods.
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.assessment: Omni3D填补了野外3D检测大规模统一基准的空白，对推动3D检测的泛化性和跨域研究具有重要价值，是该领域的基础性工作。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.contribution: 构建了大规模统一的3D目标检测基准Omni3D，并提出Cube R-CNN模型实现跨场景3D检测。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.innovation: 首次在统一框架下整合室内外多数据集进行3D检测评估，并设计了处理不同相机内参的检测模型。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.result: Omni3D规模为现有基准数倍，揭示了现有方法在多样化场景下的泛化不足。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for._arxiv_id: Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for 3D Object Detection in the Wild.

Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_cn: 本文针对目标检测与分割任务长期分离、缺乏统一框架的问题，提出了Mask DINO——一个统一的基于Transformer的检测与分割框架。Mask DINO在DINO检测器的基础上引入mask预测分支，通过共享的query表示同时完成目标检测、实例分割、全景分割和语义分割任务。方法的核心在于将mask预测与DETR的query解码机制统一，利用mask信息增强检测特征学习，同时检测的query为分割提供精确的定位先验。相比已有工作，Mask DINO在COCO实例分割、全景分割和ADE20K语义分割等多个基准上均取得了领先性能，验证了统一框架的有效性和可扩展性。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-standing separation between object detection and segmentation by proposing Mask DINO, a unified Transformer-based framework for detection and segmentation. Building on DINO, Mask DINO introduces a mask prediction branch that shares query representations to jointly perform detection, instance, panoptic, and semantic segmentation. It achieves state-of-the-art results on COCO instance/panoptic segmentation and ADE20K semantic segmentation.
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.assessment: Mask DINO是检测与分割统一框架的重要进展，在多个任务上同时达到SOTA，对Transformer统一视觉感知研究具有高度参考价值。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.contribution: 提出了统一的Transformer检测与分割框架Mask DINO，通过共享query实现多任务联合学习。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.innovation: 将mask预测分支与DETR的query解码机制统一，实现检测与多种分割任务的一体化建模。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.result: 在COCO实例分割、全景分割和ADE20K语义分割等基准上均取得领先性能。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer._arxiv_id: Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer-based Framework for Object Detection and Segmentation.

2304.07082|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对跨域弱监督目标检测（CDWSOD）问题，旨在仅通过弱监督将检测器从源域适配到目标域。作者观察到DETR的编码器和解码器均基于注意力机制，能够聚合全图语义，其聚合结果（图像级预测）可自然利用弱监督进行域对齐。基于此提出DETR-GA，同时进行实例级和图像级预测，利用强监督和弱监督联合训练。关键设计是在编码器中添加多个类别query、在解码器中添加前景query以聚合语义为图像级预测。相比已有CDWSOD方法，DETR-GA的query聚合能粗略定位对应位置并排除无关区域干扰，在跨域检测基准上取得了更优的适配效果。
2304.07082|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-domain weakly supervised object detection (CDWSOD) by proposing DETR-GA, which exploits DETR's attention-based encoder and decoder to aggregate image-level semantics for domain alignment. DETR-GA simultaneously makes instance-level and image-level predictions with strong and weak supervision, adding class queries to the encoder and a foreground query to the decoder. The query-based aggregation roughly localizes objects and excludes irrelevant regions, achieving improved cross-domain adaptation.
2304.07082|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用了DETR的全局注意力特性来解决跨域弱监督检测问题，思路新颖，对弱监督和域适配研究有参考价值。
2304.07082|v2.contribution: 提出了DETR-GA，通过额外的全局聚合query实现跨域弱监督目标检测中的实例级与图像级联合预测。
2304.07082|v2.innovation: 利用DETR编码器/解码器的注意力聚合能力，通过类别query和前景query实现弱监督域对齐。
2304.07082|v2.result: 在跨域弱监督检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的适配性能。

Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_cn: 本文针对RAW图像域目标检测研究不足的问题，提出了一个新的RAW目标检测基准和一个新模型。现有目标检测方法大多在sRGB图像上训练和评估，而RAW图像保留了更多原始传感器信息，在低光照等挑战场景下具有潜力。作者构建了大规模的RAW检测数据集，并设计了适配RAW域特性的检测模型，通过充分利用RAW的高动态范围和线性响应特性提升检测性能。相比在sRGB上训练的方法，该模型在RAW域检测基准上取得了显著提升，为RAW域视觉感知研究提供了重要基础。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored problem of object detection in the RAW image domain by introducing a new benchmark and a new model. While most detectors operate on sRGB images, RAW images preserve richer sensor information beneficial for challenging scenarios such as low light. The authors construct a large-scale RAW detection dataset and design a model tailored to RAW characteristics, achieving significant improvements over sRGB-trained baselines.
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.assessment: 该工作开辟了RAW域目标检测这一新方向，基准和模型的提出对低光照感知和自动驾驶等应用具有潜在价值。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.contribution: 构建了RAW域目标检测新基准并提出适配RAW特性的检测模型。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.innovation: 首次系统性地研究RAW图像域的目标检测，利用RAW的高动态范围和线性响应特性提升检测性能。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.result: 在RAW域检测基准上相比sRGB训练方法取得显著性能提升。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench._arxiv_id: Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Benchmark and A New Model.
