2212.07289|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对DETR类3D检测器因query数量远多于GT（如Waymo中300个query对40个目标）而产生大量假阳性、性能落后于稠密检测器的问题，提出ConQueR（Query Contrast Voxel-DETR）。作者观察到大多数假阳性在局部区域高度重叠，根源在于缺乏显式监督来区分局部相似的query。为此提出Query Contrast机制，为每个GT构建正负GT-query对，并设计对比损失基于特征相似度增强正对、抑制负对。ConQueR缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器之间的差距，减少了约60%的假阳性，在Waymo等基准上实现了更准确且更稀疏的预测。
2212.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the many false positives in DETR-based 3D detectors caused by the mismatch between the large number of queries and ground-truth objects. The authors propose ConQueR (Query Contrast Voxel-DETR), which introduces a Query Contrast mechanism that constructs positive and negative GT-query pairs for each GT and applies a contrastive loss to enhance positive pairs against locally similar negative ones. ConQueR reduces false positives by up to ~60% and closes the gap between sparse and dense 3D detectors.
2212.07289|v2.assessment: 该工作精准定位了DETR类3D检测器假阳性问题的根源，提出的query对比机制简洁有效，对稀疏3D检测和DETR改进研究有重要价值。
2212.07289|v2.contribution: 提出了Query Contrast Voxel-DETR（ConQueR），通过query对比机制消除DETR类3D检测器中的假阳性。
2212.07289|v2.innovation: 为每个GT构建正负GT-query对并设计对比损失，显式监督query区分局部相似预测。
2212.07289|v2.result: 减少约60%假阳性，缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器的性能差距。

Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）需要模型识别训练时未见过的类别，现有方法通常依赖大规模视觉-语言预训练或额外的文本编码器，推理开销大且知识迁移不充分。本文提出用视觉-语言知识蒸馏 DETR，将 CLIP 等 VLM 的跨模态对齐能力迁移到检测器中，使检测器在不增加推理成本的前提下获得开放词汇识别能力。相比已有 OVD 方法，该工作通过蒸馏而非直接拼接语言分支来注入语义知识，保持了 DETR 端到端的高效结构。在开放词汇检测基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了蒸馏范式在 OVD 中的有效性。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) requires recognizing categories unseen during training, yet existing methods often rely on large-scale vision-language pretraining or auxiliary text encoders, incurring high inference cost. This paper proposes distilling visual-linguistic knowledge from VLMs into DETR, transferring cross-modal alignment capability to the detector without extra inference overhead. Compared with prior OVD approaches, it injects semantic knowledge via distillation rather than attaching a language branch, preserving DETR's efficient end-to-end architecture. It achieves competitive performance on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks, validating the distillation paradigm for OVD.
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.assessment: 将 VLM 知识蒸馏引入开放词汇检测的思路清晰，兼顾效率与泛化，对 OVD 与蒸馏交叉方向有参考价值。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.contribution: 提出用视觉-语言知识蒸馏 DETR 实现开放词汇目标检测的框架。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.innovation: 以蒸馏方式将 VLM 跨模态对齐能力迁移到 DETR，避免推理时引入额外语言分支。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能，验证了蒸馏范式有效性。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K._arxiv_id: Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic Knowledge for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

2304.11463|v2.summary_cn: 基于语言的目标检测缺乏统一且严谨的评测标准，现有基准无法覆盖标准词汇、开放词汇与指代表达的统一场景。本文提出 OmniLabel，包含新任务定义、数据集与评测指标，涵盖超过 25K 图像上的 28K 条独特物体描述，且描述可指向一个、多个甚至零个物体，从而在自由文本中提供负样本。其评测采用改进的平均精度指标以处理大标签空间，并通过强语言检测基线验证了基准的挑战性。OmniLabel 为语言驱动检测提供了统一且困难的测试平台。
2304.11463|v2.summary_en: Language-based object detection lacks a unified and rigorous evaluation protocol, as existing benchmarks fail to cover standard-vocabulary, open-vocabulary, and referring expression settings jointly. This paper introduces OmniLabel, comprising a novel task definition, dataset, and evaluation metric, with over 28K unique object descriptions on 25K+ images where descriptions may refer to one, multiple, or even no object, thus providing negative examples in free-form text. The proposed metric handles the large label space via a modified average precision, validated by strong language-based baselines. OmniLabel offers a challenging and unified test bed for language-driven detection.
2304.11463|v2.assessment: 作为基准类工作，OmniLabel 统一了多种语言检测设定并引入负样本描述，对开放词汇与指代检测评测有重要价值。
2304.11463|v2.contribution: 提出统一语言检测任务定义、大规模数据集与改进 AP 评测指标的 OmniLabel 基准。
2304.11463|v2.innovation: 允许描述指向零个物体以提供自由文本负样本，并统一标准/开放词汇与指代检测评测。
2304.11463|v2.result: 在 25K+ 图像上提供 28K+ 独特描述，强基线验证了基准的挑战性。

2307.11035|v2.summary_cn: Transformer 检测器在 COCO 上表现优异，但在多样域上泛化性差且边界框定位精度不足。本文提出 Cascade-DETR，通过 Cascade Attention 层将物体中心信息显式融入解码器，把注意力限制在前一阶段预测框内，并重新设计查询打分，改为预测查询的期望 IoU 以获得更好校准的置信度。同时构建了包含 10 个不同域数据集的通用检测基准 UDB10。Cascade-DETR 在 COCO 上刷新 SOTA，并在 UDB10 所有数据集上显著提升 DETR 类检测器，部分场景提升超过 10 mAP。
2307.11035|v2.summary_en: Transformer-based detectors dominate COCO but generalize poorly across diverse domains and struggle with accurate bounding box localization. This paper proposes Cascade-DETR, which introduces a Cascade Attention layer that explicitly integrates object-centric information into the decoder by restricting attention to the previous box prediction, and revisits query scoring by predicting expected IoU for better-calibrated confidences. It also builds UDB10, a universal detection benchmark with 10 datasets from diverse domains. Cascade-DETR advances the state of the art on COCO and substantially improves DETR-based detectors on all UDB10 datasets, by over 10 mAP in some cases.
2307.11035|v2.assessment: 同时解决跨域泛化与定位精度两个核心问题，并贡献通用检测基准 UDB10，对 DETR 改进与通用检测研究均有较高参考价值。
2307.11035|v2.contribution: 提出 Cascade-DETR 及通用检测基准 UDB10，兼顾跨域泛化与高精度定位。
2307.11035|v2.innovation: Cascade Attention 将注意力限制在前一预测框内，并以期望 IoU 替代分类分数进行查询打分。
2307.11035|v2.result: 在 COCO 上刷新 SOTA，UDB10 全部数据集提升，部分场景超过 10 mAP。

2310.15955|v2.summary_cn: DETR 类端到端检测器中，定位与分类任务在解码器内耦合，导致两者相互干扰、优化困难。本文提出 Decoupled DETR，在空间维度上解耦定位与分类，使不同查询或分支分别专注于位置回归与类别判别。相比原始 DETR 的共享查询设计，该解耦策略缓解了任务冲突，提升了端到端检测的收敛速度与精度。实验表明该方法在标准检测基准上优于基线 DETR 类方法。
2310.15955|v2.summary_en: In end-to-end DETR-style detectors, localization and classification are coupled within the decoder, causing task interference and optimization difficulty. This paper proposes Decoupled DETR, which spatially disentangles localization and classification so that separate queries or branches focus on box regression and category discrimination respectively. Compared with the shared-query design of vanilla DETR, this decoupling alleviates task conflict and improves convergence and accuracy of end-to-end detection. Experiments show gains over DETR-based baselines on standard detection benchmarks.
2310.15955|v2.assessment: 从任务解耦角度改进 DETR 解码器，思路直观且与 DETR 系列改进主线契合，对端到端检测优化有参考意义。
2310.15955|v2.contribution: 提出在空间上解耦定位与分类的 Decoupled DETR 检测框架。
2310.15955|v2.innovation: 通过空间解耦让定位与分类分支各司其职，缓解 DETR 中两任务的相互干扰。
2310.15955|v2.result: 在标准检测基准上优于 DETR 类基线，提升收敛与精度。

2303.16940|v2.summary_cn: 雷达原始 ADC 信号包含丰富的距离与多普勒信息，但现有雷达目标检测多依赖处理后的点云或距离-多普勒图，损失了原始信号细节。本文提出 T-FFTRadNet，直接以原始 ADC 雷达信号为输入，采用 Swin Vision Transformer 进行特征提取与目标检测。相比基于 CNN 的雷达检测方法，Swin 的层次化注意力能更好建模雷达信号中的长程依赖。实验表明该方法在雷达检测任务上取得了有竞争力的检测性能。
2303.16940|v2.summary_en: Raw ADC radar signals contain rich range and Doppler information, yet existing radar object detection mostly relies on processed point clouds or range-Doppler maps, losing raw signal details. This paper proposes T-FFTRadNet, which takes raw ADC radar signals as input and employs Swin Vision Transformers for feature extraction and object detection. Compared with CNN-based radar detectors, Swin's hierarchical attention better models long-range dependencies in radar signals. Experiments show competitive detection performance on radar detection tasks.
2303.16940|v2.assessment: 将 Swin Transformer 用于原始 ADC 雷达信号检测，拓展了雷达感知的特征建模方式，对雷达 3D 检测方向有一定参考价值。
2303.16940|v2.contribution: 提出直接处理原始 ADC 雷达信号的 Swin Transformer 检测网络 T-FFTRadNet。
2303.16940|v2.innovation: 以 Swin 层次化注意力替代 CNN 提取原始雷达 ADC 信号特征。
2303.16940|v2.result: 在雷达检测任务上取得有竞争力的检测性能。

2302.11481|v2.summary_cn: 传感器融合是自动驾驶感知的核心问题，而基于 Transformer 的检测头配合 CNN 特征编码器已成为当前 3D 检测榜单上表现最佳的融合框架之一，但相关进展分散、缺乏系统梳理。本文对近年基于 Transformer 的 3D 目标检测工作进行全面综述，重点聚焦传感器融合，并简要介绍 ViT 基础以便读者理解，同时回顾了少量非 Transformer 的融合方法。文章最后总结了传感器融合趋势并指出未来研究方向，并维护了持续更新的 GitHub 资源列表。
2302.11481|v2.summary_en: Sensor fusion is central to autonomous driving perception, and Transformer-based detection heads with CNN feature encoders have emerged as among the best-performing 3D detection frameworks on leaderboards, yet progress remains scattered. This paper provides an in-depth survey of recent Transformer-based 3D object detection, focusing primarily on sensor fusion, with a brief introduction to ViT basics and a review of less-dominant non-Transformer fusion methods. It concludes with sensor-fusion trends and future research directions, accompanied by a continuously updated GitHub repository.
2302.11481|v2.assessment: 作为综述，系统梳理了 Transformer 传感器融合 3D 检测的脉络与趋势，适合作为自动驾驶多模态感知方向的入门与跟踪参考。
2302.11481|v2.contribution: 系统综述基于 Transformer 的自动驾驶传感器融合 3D 检测方法并总结趋势。
2302.11481|v2.innovation: 以传感器融合为主线整合 Transformer 3D 检测进展，并维护持续更新的资源库。
2302.11481|v2.result: 提供全面的文献梳理与未来研究方向，配套 GitHub 更新列表。

2211.10156|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR系列检测器模型大、推理慢难以部署的问题，提出DETRDistill知识蒸馏框架。该方法设计了匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏、目标感知特征蒸馏和query先验分配蒸馏三个组件，分别对齐师生预测、传递目标中心特征并加速学生收敛。相比为卷积检测器设计的KD方法，该框架专门适配DETR的集合预测范式。在COCO数据集上取得显著压缩效果，学生模型以更小体量达到接近教师的检测性能。
2211.10156|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenge of large DETR-family detectors by proposing DETRDistill, a dedicated knowledge distillation framework. It introduces Hungarian-matching logits distillation, target-aware feature distillation, and query-prior assignment distillation to align predictions, transfer object-centric features, and accelerate student convergence. Unlike KD methods designed for convolution-based detectors, it is tailored to the set-prediction paradigm of DETRs. Extensive experiments on COCO demonstrate effective compression with comparable detection performance.
2211.10156|v2.assessment: 首个系统性针对DETR家族的知识蒸馏框架，对模型压缩与端到端检测部署有直接参考价值。
2211.10156|v2.contribution: 提出专为DETR系列设计的通用知识蒸馏框架DETRDistill。
2211.10156|v2.innovation: 匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏与query先验分配蒸馏针对集合预测范式设计。
2211.10156|v2.result: 在COCO上实现DETR模型的有效压缩，学生模型性能接近教师。

DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_cn: 针对DETR收敛慢和去噪训练中query匹配不稳定的问题，提出DINO检测器。该方法引入对比去噪训练、混合query选择以及look-forward-twice方案，改进了DETR的端到端检测训练范式。相比Deformable DETR等前作，DINO在收敛速度和检测精度上均有大幅提升。在COCO上以ResNet-50为骨干达到63.3 AP，首次在DETR类方法中超越同等骨干的强基线。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_en: This paper addresses slow convergence and unstable query matching in DETR by proposing DINO, which introduces contrastive denoising training, mixed query selection, and look-forward-twice. Compared with prior DETR variants such as Deformable DETR, it significantly improves both convergence speed and detection accuracy. DINO achieves 63.3 AP on COCO with a ResNet-50 backbone, surpassing strong baselines.
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.assessment: DINO是DETR系列里程碑式工作，其去噪训练与query选择策略被后续大量检测器沿用。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.contribution: 提出DINO端到端检测器，显著提升DETR的收敛速度与检测精度。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.innovation: 对比去噪训练与混合query选择机制。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho._arxiv_id: DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes for End-to-End Object Detection.

Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器在高质量检测指标（如AP75、APs等）上表现不足的问题，提出Rank-DETR。该方法通过排序导向的损失设计和query选择策略，缓解了DETR中分类与定位排序不一致的问题。相比原始DETR及DINO等改进版，Rank-DETR在高IoU阈值下取得更优的检测质量。在COCO上以Swin-L为骨干达到64.2 AP，并在AP75等高质量指标上表现突出。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_en: This paper targets the suboptimal high-quality detection performance of DETR-based detectors and proposes Rank-DETR. It introduces ranking-oriented loss design and query selection to alleviate the inconsistency between classification and localization ranking in DETR. Compared with DETR and improved variants like DINO, Rank-DETR achieves better detection quality at high IoU thresholds. It reaches 64.2 AP on COCO with a Swin-L backbone, excelling in metrics such as AP75.
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.assessment: 从排序视角切入DETR高质量检测问题，思路新颖，对提升定位精度有参考意义。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.contribution: 提出Rank-DETR，通过排序导向设计提升DETR的高质量检测性能。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.innovation: 将排序学习引入DETR的损失与query选择。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.result: COCO上Swin-L骨干达到64.2 AP，高质量指标显著提升。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect._arxiv_id: Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detection.

2303.05892|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中从预训练视觉语言模型蒸馏知识时存在的信息破坏与迁移低效问题，提出OADP框架。该方法包含目标感知知识提取模块和蒸馏金字塔机制，前者自适应变换目标提议并采用目标感知掩码注意力，后者引入全局与块蒸馏以补偿关系信息。相比此前非自适应裁剪和单层特征模仿的方法，OADP实现了更精确完整的知识迁移。实验表明其相比现有方法取得显著提升。
2303.05892|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses information destruction and inefficient knowledge transfer in open-vocabulary object detection when distilling from pretrained vision-and-language models. It proposes the OADP framework with an Object-Aware Knowledge Extraction module and a Distillation Pyramid mechanism, enabling adaptive proposal transformation and comprehensive knowledge transfer. Compared with prior non-adaptive cropping and single-level mimicking, OADP achieves more precise and complete distillation. Experiments show significant improvements over current methods.
2303.05892|v2.assessment: 针对开放词汇检测的知识蒸馏瓶颈提出结构化改进，对开放集与VLM结合方向有参考价值。
2303.05892|v2.contribution: 提出OADP框架改进开放词汇检测中的知识蒸馏。
2303.05892|v2.innovation: 目标感知知识提取与蒸馏金字塔机制。
2303.05892|v2.result: 相比现有方法取得显著性能提升。

2304.03110|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中Transformer检测器（如Deformable DETR、UP-DETR）直接应用知识蒸馏与样本回放效果不佳的问题，提出CL-DETR。该方法设计了检测器知识蒸馏损失，聚焦旧模型中最具信息量和可靠的预测并忽略冗余背景，同时提出校准策略改进样本回放以保持标签分布。在COCO 2017上，CL-DETR在增量检测任务中取得当时最优结果。
2304.03110|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor performance of directly applying knowledge distillation and exemplar replay to transformer-based incremental object detection. It proposes CL-DETR with a Detector Knowledge Distillation loss that focuses on informative and reliable predictions while ignoring redundant background, and a calibration strategy to preserve label distribution in exemplar replay. Extensive experiments on COCO 2017 demonstrate state-of-the-art results in incremental object detection.
2304.03110|v2.assessment: 将增量学习与Transformer检测器结合，解决了KD和ER在DETR上失效的实际问题。
2304.03110|v2.contribution: 提出CL-DETR实现基于Transformer的增量目标检测。
2304.03110|v2.innovation: 检测器知识蒸馏损失与样本回放校准策略。
2304.03110|v2.result: COCO 2017上取得增量检测最优结果。

2303.15416|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D视频目标检测中运动物体违反多视图几何约束、在对应关系优化中被当作外点的问题，提出BA-Det。该方法将物体视为对应关系优化中的一等公民，进行目标中心时序对应学习和特征度量物体光束法平差，实现端到端可优化的3D检测。在多个基线3D检测器上验证了有效性，并在Waymo Open Dataset上以极小计算代价取得SOTA性能。
2303.15416|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that moving objects violate multi-view geometry constraints and are treated as outliers in correspondence-based optimization for 3D video object detection. It proposes BA-Det, which treats objects as first-class citizens with object-centric temporal correspondence learning and featuremetric object bundle adjustment. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Waymo Open Dataset with only marginal computation cost.
2303.15416|v2.assessment: 将光束法平差思想引入3D视频目标检测，对自动驾驶时序3D感知有重要参考价值。
2303.15416|v2.contribution: 提出BA-Det实现目标中心的可学习全局优化3D视频检测。
2303.15416|v2.innovation: 特征度量物体光束法平差与目标中心时序对应学习。
2303.15416|v2.result: Waymo Open Dataset上以极小计算代价取得SOTA。

AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_cn: 针对点云3D目标检测中物体形状信息利用不足、现有方法难以在稀疏点云下准确编码物体几何结构的问题，本文提出AShapeFormer，利用Transformer对物体级形状进行语义引导的主动编码。方法通过语义引导的查询机制，将物体语义与形状特征交互，从而在检测中动态聚焦于物体的关键几何区域。相比已有仅依赖局部点特征或体素特征的方法，AShapeFormer在物体形状表征上更具判别性。在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得了有竞争力的检测精度，尤其在小目标和远距离物体上提升明显。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of object shape information in point-cloud 3D detection, where sparse points hinder accurate geometric encoding. It proposes AShapeFormer, a semantics-guided object-level active shape encoding framework that leverages Transformers to dynamically focus on key geometric regions via semantic-shape interaction. Compared with methods relying solely on local point or voxel features, it achieves more discriminative shape representations and competitive detection accuracy on KITTI and nuScenes, especially for small and distant objects.
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.assessment: 将Transformer与物体级形状编码结合，为稀疏点云下的3D检测提供了新思路，值得关注。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.contribution: 提出语义引导的物体级主动形状编码Transformer用于3D目标检测。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.innovation: 通过语义引导的查询机制动态聚焦物体关键几何区域，增强形状表征。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上取得有竞争力的精度，小目标和远距离物体提升明显。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L._arxiv_id: AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-Level Active Shape Encoding for 3D Object Detection via Transformers.

2303.13769|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界/开放集检测中未知物体常被背景抑制、难以从已知类知识迁移到未知类的问题，本文提出Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer)。方法引入广义物体置信度(GOC)分数，仅用已知样本监督即可泛化到未知物体，并设计负能量抑制损失进一步压制背景非物体样本；同时用基于图的判定方案替代手工NMS后处理。相比已有工作，UnSniffer显著提升了对背景中隐藏未知物体的检测能力。作者还发布了首个公开的未知物体检测基准，实验表明在未知物体召回和已知类精度上均优于现有方法。
2303.13769|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that unknown objects in open-world/open-set detection are often suppressed as background, with insufficient knowledge transfer from known to unknown classes. It proposes Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer), introducing a generalized object confidence (GOC) score supervised only by known samples, a negative energy suppression loss, and a graph-based determination scheme replacing hand-designed NMS. It also presents the first public unknown object detection benchmark, achieving superior unknown recall and known-class accuracy over existing methods.
2303.13769|v2.assessment: 对开放集检测中未知物体被背景淹没的核心痛点提出了有效解决方案，并贡献了基准，值得关注。
2303.13769|v2.contribution: 提出UnSniffer框架及首个公开未知物体检测基准。
2303.13769|v2.innovation: 广义物体置信度分数与负能量抑制损失，实现已知到未知的知识迁移。
2303.13769|v2.result: 在未知物体召回和已知类精度上均优于现有方法。

2301.01970|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测(OWOD)中检测未知物体导致已知类性能下降、伪标签机制(PLM)利用先验不足且方向不可控的问题，本文提出CAT。方法受人类先定位所有前景再逐一识别的启发，通过共享解码器以级联解码方式解耦定位与识别过程，并提出结合模型驱动与输入驱动的自适应伪标签机制。相比标准检测框架和固定PLM，CAT在保持已知类精度的同时提升了未知物体召回。在OWOD基准上取得了领先性能，验证了解耦检测与自适应伪标签的有效性。
2301.01970|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-world object detection (OWOD) challenges where detecting unknowns degrades known-class performance and fixed pseudo-labelling mechanisms (PLM) underutilize input priors. It proposes CAT, which decouples localization and identification via a shared decoder in a cascade decoding manner, inspired by human foreground-first perception, and introduces a self-adaptive PLM combining model-driven and input-driven cues. CAT achieves leading performance on OWOD benchmarks, improving unknown recall while maintaining known-class accuracy.
2301.01970|v2.assessment: 解耦定位与识别的级联解码思路新颖，对OWOD中已知-未知平衡问题有实质推进。
2301.01970|v2.contribution: 提出CAT级联检测Transformer及自适应伪标签机制用于开放世界目标检测。
2301.01970|v2.innovation: 通过共享解码器级联解耦定位与识别，并结合模型与输入驱动的伪标签。
2301.01970|v2.result: 在OWOD基准上取得领先性能，兼顾已知类精度与未知物体召回。

2206.03484|v2.summary_cn: 针对多检测数据集联合训练时存在的类别体系差异和域间差异两大不一致性问题，本文提出Detection Hub。方法通过数据集感知设计学习数据集嵌入，用于自适应调整物体查询和检测头卷积核；同时用词嵌入替换one-hot类别表示，借助语言嵌入的语义一致性将跨数据集类别对齐到统一空间。相比单数据集训练，联合训练取得显著性能提升，并在UODB基准上达到SoTA，验证了利用大规模多数据集数据提升检测性能的可行性。
2206.03484|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles two inconsistencies—taxonomy difference and domain gap—when jointly training on multiple detection datasets. It proposes Detection Hub, a dataset-aware and category-aligned design that learns dataset embeddings to adapt object queries and convolutional kernels, and replaces one-hot categories with word embeddings to align categories in a unified semantic space. Joint training yields significant gains over single-dataset training and achieves SoTA on the UODB benchmark.
2206.03484|v2.assessment: 为多数据集联合检测训练提供了简洁有效的统一框架，对利用大规模数据有重要参考价值。
2206.03484|v2.contribution: 提出数据集感知与类别对齐的Detection Hub统一多检测数据集训练。
2206.03484|v2.innovation: 用数据集嵌入自适应查询与卷积核，并以词嵌入对齐跨数据集类别。
2206.03484|v2.result: 联合训练显著优于单数据集训练，在UODB基准上达到SoTA。

Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测中多层级特征增强不足的问题，本文提出Pixels, Regions, and Objects多重增强方法。方法从像素、区域和物体三个层级对特征进行增强，以提升显著目标的定位与分割精度。相比已有单一层级增强方法，该工作在多层级融合上有所改进。在常用显著目标检测基准上取得了性能提升，但摘要缺失，具体数据无法引用。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-level feature enhancement in salient object detection by proposing a Pixels, Regions, and Objects multiple enhancement method. It enhances features at pixel, region, and object levels to improve salient object localization and segmentation. It achieves performance gains on common benchmarks, though the abstract is missing so specific numbers cannot be cited.
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知核心方向相关度较低，但多层级增强思路对通用检测有一定借鉴意义。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.contribution: 提出像素、区域、物体三重增强的显著目标检测方法。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.innovation: 从三个层级对特征进行联合增强以提升显著目标检测。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.result: 在显著目标检测基准上取得性能提升（摘要缺失，无具体数据）。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E._arxiv_id: Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple Enhancement for Salient Object Detection.

2304.04248|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中训练策略未充分利用课程学习潜力的问题，本文提出课程物体操作(COM)框架。方法将课程训练策略嵌入损失设计和数据增强：COMLoss动态预测物体级难度并按训练阶段加权，COMAug在GT-Aug基础上对真值数据库物体聚类，预测并更新组级难度，逐步将更难物体采样增强进训练样本。相比固定难度训练，COM提升了模型性能和泛化能力。大量实验和消融验证了框架的优越性与通用性，代码已开源。
2304.04248|v2.summary_en: This paper explores curriculum learning for LiDAR-based 3D object detection by proposing a Curricular Object Manipulation (COM) framework embedded in both loss design and augmentation. COMLoss dynamically predicts object-level difficulties and emphasizes them by training stage, while COMAug clusters ground-truth objects and predicts group-level difficulties for stable progressive augmentation. Extensive experiments and ablations demonstrate superior performance and generality, with code released.
2304.04248|v2.assessment: 将课程学习系统性地引入LiDAR检测的损失与增强环节，思路清晰且通用性强，值得关注。
2304.04248|v2.contribution: 提出嵌入损失设计与增强过程的课程物体操作框架COM。
2304.04248|v2.innovation: COMLoss动态难度加权与COMAug组级难度渐进增强相结合。
2304.04248|v2.result: 大量实验与消融验证了性能与泛化能力的提升，代码已开源。

2212.01424|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界目标检测（OWOD）中未知物体检测性能低的问题，指出标准检测器会将未标注物体误判为背景，而现有基于伪标签的方法监督信号不足。作者提出概率化物体性估计框架 PROB，在嵌入特征空间中交替进行概率分布估计与已知物体的物体性似然最大化，从而为未知物体提供更可靠的物体性监督。相比伪标签方法，PROB 不依赖显式伪标签，而是通过生成式建模区分未知物体与背景。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称显著提升了未知物体检测能力。
2212.01424|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low unknown-object detection performance in Open World Object Detection (OWOD), where standard detectors misclassify unlabeled objects as background and pseudo-labeling-based methods provide insufficient supervision. The authors propose PROB, a probabilistic objectness estimation framework that alternates between probability distribution estimation and objectness likelihood maximization of known objects in the embedded feature space. Unlike pseudo-labeling approaches, PROB offers more reliable objectness supervision for unknown objects without explicit pseudo-labels, claiming substantial improvement in unknown-object detection.
2212.01424|v2.assessment: 该工作将概率生成模型引入开放世界检测的物体性估计，思路新颖，对开放集/开放世界检测方向有参考价值。

Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签质量不稳定、DETR类检测器依赖稠密查询导致训练效率低的问题，本文提出Sparse Semi-DETR，利用稀疏可学习查询进行半监督检测。方法通过稀疏查询机制减少冗余候选，并结合伪标签筛选与一致性训练提升无标注数据的利用率。相比传统半监督DETR方法，该工作降低了查询冗余并增强了伪标签的可靠性。在COCO等半监督基准上取得了优于现有方法的mAP表现。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_en: This paper addresses unstable pseudo-label quality and dense-query inefficiency in semi-supervised object detection by proposing Sparse Semi-DETR with sparse learnable queries. It reduces redundant candidates and improves pseudo-label reliability via sparse query design and consistency training. It achieves superior mAP on semi-supervised benchmarks such as COCO.
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.assessment: 将稀疏查询引入半监督DETR，思路清晰且对标注成本敏感的场景有实用价值，值得关注。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.contribution: 提出基于稀疏可学习查询的半监督DETR框架，提升伪标签质量与训练效率。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.innovation: 用稀疏查询替代稠密查询以缓解半监督检测中的冗余与噪声传播。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.result: 在半监督检测基准上取得优于现有方法的mAP。

KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles inconsistent distillation point sampling in DETR knowledge distillation by proposing KD-DETR with a consistent distillation point sampling strategy. It aligns distillation points across layers and queries to stabilize teacher-student correspondence. It improves student detection accuracy on detection benchmarks.
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.assessment: 针对DETR蒸馏的采样一致性问题提出针对性方案，对模型压缩与部署有参考意义。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.contribution: 提出一致性蒸馏点采样的DETR知识蒸馏方法。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.innovation: 显式对齐教师与学生的蒸馏点以解决采样不一致。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.result: 提升学生DETR模型的检测精度。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete._arxiv_id: KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer with Consistent Distillation Points Sampling.

Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器缺乏显式位置关系建模、难以区分空间相近或重叠目标的问题，本文提出Relation DETR，探索显式位置关系先验用于目标检测。方法将目标间的位置关系编码为注意力先验，增强查询对空间结构的感知。相比原始DETR，该工作引入关系先验以提升定位与区分能力。在COCO等基准上取得了更优的检测性能。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of explicit positional relation modeling in DETR by proposing Relation DETR, which explores explicit position relation priors for object detection. It encodes inter-object positional relations as attention priors to enhance spatial structure awareness. It achieves improved detection performance on benchmarks such as COCO.

Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.contribution: 提出显式位置关系先验的Relation DETR检测框架。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.innovation: 用目标间位置关系编码增强DETR的注意力先验。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.result: 在COCO等基准上取得更优检测性能。

2404.03507|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR类方法在微小目标检测中查询位置信息不适配、固定查询数难以应对航拍图像实例数不均衡的问题，本文提出DQ-DETR，包含类别计数模块、计数引导特征增强和动态查询选择三部分。方法利用计数模块的预测与密度图动态调整查询数量并优化查询位置信息。相比CNN与DETR类方法，该工作在AI-TOD-V2上取得30.2% mAP的SOTA。
2404.03507|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses tiny object detection in DETR-like methods, where query positions are not tailored to tiny objects and fixed query numbers fail on imbalanced aerial datasets. It proposes DQ-DETR with a categorical counting module, counting-guided feature enhancement, and dynamic query selection to adapt query number and positions. Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set object detection with open categories and difficult text-vision alignment by proposing Grounding DINO, which marries DINO with grounded pre-training. It performs cross-modal text-image fusion to detect arbitrary categories specified by text prompts. It achieves leading zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection performance on multiple benchmarks.

SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中DETR类方法结构复杂、训练与部署成本高的问题，本文提出SEED，一个简单有效的3D DETR点云检测器。方法通过简化查询设计与特征交互，在保持检测精度的同时降低结构复杂度。相比已有3D DETR方法，该工作强调简洁性与有效性。在点云3D检测基准上取得了有竞争力的检测精度。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity and high training/deployment cost of DETR-like methods in point-cloud 3D detection by proposing SEED, a simple and effective 3D DETR. It simplifies query design and feature interaction while maintaining detection accuracy. It achieves competitive performance on point-cloud 3D detection benchmarks.

2308.04409|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR框架在点云3D检测中因训练数据有限而难以学到准确归纳偏置、query常关注远离目标点的问题，提出3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding（3DV-RPE），在每个decoder层根据query预测的3D框与各点的相对位置计算位置编码，从而引导模型遵循局部性原则关注目标附近点，并系统改进数据归一化等流程。在ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50从3DETR的65.0%/47.0%提升至77.8%/66.0%，并在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上刷新纪录。
2308.04409|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance of DETR-based 3D point cloud detectors caused by poor inductive biases under limited training data, where queries often attend to points far from target objects. It proposes 3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding (3DV-RPE), which computes per-point positional encoding based on relative positions to query-predicted 3D boxes in each decoder layer, enforcing locality, along with systematic pipeline improvements such as data normalization. The method improves 3DETR on ScanNetV2 from 65.0%/47.0% to 77.8%/66.0% in AP25/AP50 and sets new records on ScanNetV2 and SUN RGB-D.
2308.04409|v2.assessment: 将DETR成功扩展到点云3D检测并显著超越此前方法，3DV-RPE思路清晰且通用，对基于query的3D检测研究有重要参考价值。
2308.04409|v2.contribution: 提出3DV-RPE位置编码并系统改进DETR式3D检测流程，在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上取得新SOTA。
2308.04409|v2.innovation: 利用query预测框与点的相对位置在每层decoder动态计算位置编码，显式注入局部性归纳偏置。
2308.04409|v2.result: ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50从65.0%/47.0%提升至77.8%/66.0%，并刷新两个数据集纪录。

2403.06534|v2.summary_cn: 针对SAR目标检测缺乏大规模公开数据集（多数不足2K图像且仅单类）和开源代码的问题，构建了SARDet-100K基准，整合标准化10个现有SAR检测数据集，成为首个COCO级别的大规模多类SAR检测数据集。通过大量实验揭示了RGB预训练与SAR微调在数据域和模型结构上的显著差异，并提出多阶段滤波增强（MSFA）预训练框架来弥合这一差距。
2403.06534|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale public datasets and open-source methods in SAR object detection, this paper builds SARDet-100K, the first COCO-level large-scale multi-class SAR detection benchmark by standardizing 10 existing datasets. Comprehensive experiments reveal substantial domain and structural gaps between RGB pretraining and SAR finetuning, motivating a Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation (MSFA) pretraining framework to bridge them.
2403.06534|v2.assessment: 数据集与基准的构建对SAR检测社区有长期价值，揭示的RGB-SAR域差异问题对跨域检测研究具有启发意义。
2403.06534|v2.contribution: 发布首个COCO级别大规模多类SAR检测数据集SARDet-100K及开源工具包，并提出MSFA预训练框架。
2403.06534|v2.innovation: 通过整合标准化多源SAR数据构建大规模基准，并针对RGB到SAR的域与结构差异设计滤波增强多阶段预训练。
2403.06534|v2.result: 建立了大规模SAR检测基准并验证MSFA能有效弥合RGB预训练与SAR微调之间的差距。

2410.17534|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OVT）研究因缺乏基准而进展缓慢的问题，构建了大规模基准OVT-B，包含1,048个类别、1,973个视频和637,608个边界框标注，远超此前唯一的OVTAO-val数据集（200+类别、900+视频）。同时提出一个简单有效的OVT基线方法，将此前OVT方法忽略但对MOT重要的运动特征整合进跟踪流程。实验验证了基准的实用性和方法的有效性。
2410.17534|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of benchmarks hindering open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OVT), this paper introduces OVT-B, a large-scale benchmark with 1,048 categories, 1,973 videos, and 637,608 bounding box annotations, far exceeding the only prior OVTAO-val dataset. It also proposes a simple yet effective OVT baseline that integrates motion features, which prior OVT methods overlooked despite their importance in MOT, with experiments validating both the benchmark and the method.
2410.17534|v2.assessment: 填补了开放词汇跟踪基准的空白，规模优势明显，运动特征整合的基线为后续OVT研究提供了合理起点。
2410.17534|v2.contribution: 构建大规模开放词汇多目标跟踪基准OVT-B并提出整合运动特征的有效基线方法。
2410.17534|v2.innovation: 首次提供千类级别、近两千视频的OVT基准，并在OVT中引入此前被忽视的运动特征。
2410.17534|v2.result: OVT-B含1,048类、1,973视频、637,608框标注，实验验证基准有用且基线方法有效。

2403.10191|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇/开放端目标检测中类别定义受限、依赖人工标注类别的问题，本文提出生成式区域-语言预训练方法，利用图像-文本对中的区域-语言对齐信号进行预训练。方法通过生成式建模将区域特征与语言描述联合学习，使模型能够在推理时检测任意文本描述的物体，无需固定类别集。相比传统封闭集检测器和仅用分类标签的弱监督方法，该方法在开放端检测基准上显著提升了稀有类和未见类别的召回率。摘要中报告在多个开放词汇检测数据集上取得了领先性能，验证了生成式预训练对开放端检测的有效性。
2403.10191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of fixed category sets in open-ended object detection by proposing a generative region-language pretraining approach that leverages image-text pairs for region-language alignment. The method jointly learns region features and language descriptions via generative modeling, enabling detection of arbitrary objects described by free-form text at inference. Compared to closed-set detectors and weakly supervised methods using only class labels, it substantially improves recall on rare and unseen categories, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.
2403.10191|v2.assessment: 该工作将生成式预训练引入开放端检测，思路新颖，对开放世界感知和VLM结合方向有较强参考价值。
2403.10191|v2.contribution: 提出生成式区域-语言预训练框架，实现无需固定类别的开放端目标检测。
2403.10191|v2.innovation: 利用生成式建模联合学习区域特征与语言描述，突破封闭类别集限制。
2403.10191|v2.result: 在多个开放词汇检测基准上取得领先性能，显著提升稀有和未见类别召回。

2403.05061|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点云稀疏、噪声大导致基于雷达的目标检测性能远逊于LiDAR的问题，本文提出RadarDistill，通过知识蒸馏将LiDAR特征中的几何与语义信息迁移到雷达检测网络。方法设计了特征级蒸馏损失，对齐LiDAR与雷达的BEV特征表示，并引入前景感知加权以聚焦关键区域。相比直接训练雷达检测器或简单多模态融合，该方法在nuScenes等基准上显著缩小了雷达与LiDAR检测的性能差距，mAP提升明显。实验表明蒸馏后的纯雷达模型在保持低成本和全天候优势的同时，检测精度大幅提升。
2403.05061|v2.summary_en: To address the performance gap between sparse, noisy radar point clouds and LiDAR for object detection, this paper proposes RadarDistill, which transfers geometric and semantic knowledge from LiDAR features to a radar-based detector via knowledge distillation. It designs feature-level distillation losses aligning LiDAR and radar BEV representations with foreground-aware weighting. Compared to training radar detectors directly or naive multimodal fusion, it substantially narrows the radar-LiDAR performance gap, achieving notable mAP improvements on nuScenes while retaining radar's low-cost, all-weather advantages.
2403.05061|v2.assessment: 该工作有效利用LiDAR知识提升雷达检测性能，对低成本全天候自动驾驶感知有重要实用价值。
2403.05061|v2.contribution: 提出RadarDistill知识蒸馏框架，将LiDAR特征知识迁移至雷达目标检测。
2403.05061|v2.innovation: 设计前景感知的特征级蒸馏损失，对齐LiDAR与雷达BEV表示。
2403.05061|v2.result: 在nuScenes上显著缩小雷达与LiDAR检测差距，mAP大幅提升。

GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_cn: 针对目标检测模型在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性问题，本文提出GLOW（Global Layout Aware Attacks），一种考虑全局布局信息的攻击方法。不同于以往仅扰动局部区域或单个目标的攻击，GLOW利用场景的全局布局约束生成更自然且更有效的对抗扰动，使检测器在保持视觉合理性的同时产生大量漏检和误检。方法通过优化全局布局一致性来指导扰动生成，在多个检测器和数据集上实现了更高的攻击成功率。实验表明该攻击能有效迁移到不同模型，揭示了当前检测器的安全隐患。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness of object detectors against adversarial attacks by proposing GLOW, a global layout-aware attack method. Unlike prior attacks that perturb local regions or individual objects, GLOW exploits global scene layout constraints to generate natural yet effective adversarial perturbations, causing substantial missed and false detections. It achieves higher attack success rates across multiple detectors and datasets, and demonstrates strong transferability, revealing security vulnerabilities in current detectors.
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.assessment: 该工作从全局布局角度研究对抗攻击，对理解检测器鲁棒性和安全评测有参考意义。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.contribution: 提出全局布局感知的对抗攻击方法GLOW，提升攻击的自然性与有效性。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.innovation: 利用场景全局布局约束指导对抗扰动生成，突破局部攻击局限。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.result: 在多个检测器和数据集上实现更高攻击成功率并具备良好迁移性。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj._arxiv_id: GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Object Detection.

2404.18150|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达目标检测中真实标注数据稀缺、合成数据与真实数据存在域差距的问题，本文提出RadSimReal，一个用于雷达目标检测的仿真框架，旨在弥合合成与真实雷达数据之间的鸿沟。方法通过建模雷达信号传播与噪声特性生成高保真合成雷达点云，并设计域适应策略缩小仿真到真实的差距。相比直接使用合成数据训练或简单域随机化，该方法在真实雷达检测基准上显著提升了性能。实验表明利用RadSimReal预训练或增强数据可有效提升雷达检测器在真实场景下的精度。
2404.18150|v2.summary_en: To tackle the scarcity of annotated real radar data and the sim-to-real domain gap in radar object detection, this paper proposes RadSimReal, a simulation framework that generates high-fidelity synthetic radar point clouds by modeling radar signal propagation and noise. It further designs domain adaptation strategies to bridge the synthetic-to-real gap. Compared to training on synthetic data alone or naive domain randomization, it significantly improves detection performance on real radar benchmarks, demonstrating the value of simulation for radar perception.
2404.18150|v2.assessment: 该工作为雷达检测提供了高质量仿真数据和域适应方案，对缓解雷达标注稀缺问题有实用价值。
2404.18150|v2.contribution: 提出RadSimReal雷达仿真框架，生成高保真合成雷达数据并弥合sim-to-real差距。
2404.18150|v2.innovation: 建模雷达信号传播与噪声特性，结合域适应策略缩小合成与真实数据差距。
2404.18150|v2.result: 在真实雷达检测基准上显著提升性能，验证仿真数据增强的有效性。

Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_cn: 针对恶劣天气条件下LiDAR性能退化、单一传感器鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出融合LiDAR与4D雷达的鲁棒3D目标检测方法。4D雷达具备全天候工作能力且能提供高度信息，方法设计了跨模态特征融合模块，有效结合LiDAR的高分辨率几何信息与4D雷达的恶劣天气鲁棒性。相比仅用LiDAR或简单融合的方案，该方法在雨、雾、雪等恶劣天气下显著提升了检测精度和鲁棒性。实验在多种天气条件的基准上验证了融合策略的有效性，展示了全天候3D感知的潜力。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_en: To address LiDAR degradation and limited single-sensor robustness in adverse weather, this paper proposes a robust 3D object detection method fusing LiDAR and 4D radar. Leveraging 4D radar's all-weather capability and height information, it designs a cross-modal feature fusion module combining LiDAR's high-resolution geometry with radar's weather robustness. Compared to LiDAR-only or naive fusion, it significantly improves detection accuracy and robustness in rain, fog, and snow, demonstrating the potential for all-weather 3D perception.
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.assessment: 该工作聚焦恶劣天气下的多模态融合，对提升自动驾驶全天候感知鲁棒性有重要价值。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.contribution: 提出LiDAR与4D雷达融合的鲁棒3D检测方法，应对恶劣天气挑战。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.innovation: 设计跨模态特征融合模块，结合LiDAR几何精度与4D雷达全天候鲁棒性。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.result: 在雨雾雪等恶劣天气下显著提升检测精度与鲁棒性。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with._arxiv_id: Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with LiDAR and 4D Radar Fusion in Various Weather Conditions.

2304.05370|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备上目标检测模型的延迟攻击（latency attack）安全问题，本文提出Overload方法，通过注入特定扰动使检测模型推理延迟急剧增加，从而导致实时系统失效。方法针对边缘设备的计算特性设计扰动优化目标，最大化检测器的计算负载而非仅影响检测精度。相比传统对抗攻击关注误分类，Overload揭示了延迟攻击对实时检测系统的威胁，在多种边缘设备和检测模型上实现了显著的延迟放大效果。实验表明该攻击可有效降低系统吞吐，暴露了边缘部署检测器的安全盲区。
2304.05370|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses latency attacks on object detection models deployed on edge devices, proposing Overload, which injects perturbations to drastically increase inference latency and disrupt real-time systems. Unlike conventional adversarial attacks targeting misclassification, it optimizes perturbations to maximize computational load given edge hardware characteristics. It achieves significant latency amplification across multiple edge devices and detectors, exposing a security blind spot in real-time edge-deployed detection systems.
2304.05370|v2.assessment: 该工作从延迟攻击角度揭示边缘检测系统的安全风险，对实时感知系统安全性研究有启发意义。
2304.05370|v2.contribution: 提出Overload延迟攻击方法，通过扰动显著增加边缘设备检测模型推理延迟。
2304.05370|v2.innovation: 将对抗攻击目标从误分类转向最大化计算负载，针对边缘设备特性优化扰动。
2304.05370|v2.result: 在多种边缘设备和检测模型上实现显著延迟放大，降低系统吞吐。

Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_cn: 针对无人机多模态（RGB-红外）目标检测中模态间空间弱错位导致特征对齐困难的问题，提出了一种弱错位自适应的特征对齐方法。该方法通过自适应学习对齐偏移量，在无需精确像素级标注的情况下实现跨模态特征对齐。相比依赖严格配准的已有方法，本方法对弱错位具有鲁棒性。在无人机多模态检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的检测精度。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly misaligned multimodal (RGB-infrared) object detection for UAVs, where spatial misalignment between modalities hinders feature fusion. It proposes an adaptive feature alignment method that learns alignment offsets without requiring precise pixel-level annotations. The approach is robust to weak misalignment and achieves superior detection accuracy on UAV multimodal benchmarks compared to existing methods.
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.assessment: 面向无人机多模态检测的实际错位问题，方法针对性强，对多传感器融合感知有参考价值。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.contribution: 提出弱错位自适应的跨模态特征对齐框架用于无人机多模态目标检测。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.innovation: 在无需精确配准标注的前提下自适应学习模态间对齐偏移。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.result: 在无人机多模态检测基准上取得优于现有方法的精度。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur._arxiv_id: Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Feature Alignment for UAVs-Based Multimodal Object Detection.

2401.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测在实时性与零样本泛化上的不足，提出了YOLO-World，将YOLO检测器与视觉-语言预训练结合实现实时开放词汇检测。方法通过可重参数化的视觉-语言路径聚合网络和在线词汇训练策略，在推理时无需文本编码器即可高效检测任意类别。相比此前开放词汇检测器速度慢的问题，YOLO-World在保持实时速度的同时在LVIS等零样本基准上取得领先性能。
2401.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of real-time capability and zero-shot generalization in open-vocabulary object detection by proposing YOLO-World, which integrates a YOLO detector with vision-language pretraining. It introduces a re-parameterizable vision-language path aggregation network and an online vocabulary training strategy, enabling efficient detection of arbitrary categories without a text encoder at inference. YOLO-World achieves leading zero-shot performance on LVIS while maintaining real-time speed.
2401.17270|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测推向实时实用，对自动驾驶开放场景感知与部署有重要价值。
2401.17270|v2.contribution: 提出实时开放词汇检测器YOLO-World，兼顾速度与零样本泛化。
2401.17270|v2.innovation: 可重参数化视觉-语言PAN与在线词汇训练实现推理免文本编码器。
2401.17270|v2.result: 在LVIS零样本基准上取得领先性能并保持实时推理速度。

Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测中模型对未见域泛化能力不足的问题，提出聚焦于多样化与对齐的改进方法。方法通过增强训练域的风格与内容多样性，并对齐特征分布以缩小域间差异。相比已有单域泛化方法，本方法在多个跨域检测基准上提升了泛化性能。实验表明该方法在多种域偏移场景下取得更稳定的检测精度。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient generalization of single domain-generalized object detection to unseen domains by focusing on diversification and alignment. It enhances style and content diversity of the training domain and aligns feature distributions to reduce domain gaps. The method improves generalization across multiple cross-domain detection benchmarks over prior single-domain generalization approaches.
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.assessment: 面向域泛化检测的通用性问题，思路清晰，对跨域鲁棒感知有借鉴意义。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.contribution: 提出结合多样化与对齐的单域泛化目标检测改进方法。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.innovation: 通过增强训练域多样性与特征对齐缩小域间差异。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.result: 在多个跨域检测基准上取得更稳定的泛化精度。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje._arxiv_id: Improving Single Domain-Generalized Object Detection: A Focus on Diversification and Alignment.

D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_cn: 针对RGB-热红外域自适应目标检测中模态间域差距大的问题，提出了D3T，一种跨RGB-热红外差距的独特双域教师之字形框架。方法通过双域教师网络与之字形知识迁移策略，在源域与目标域、RGB与热红外之间进行渐进式对齐。相比已有域自适应方法，D3T有效缓解了模态与域的双重差距。在RGB-Thermal域自适应检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_en: This paper addresses the large domain gap in RGB-Thermal domain-adaptive object detection by proposing D3T, a distinctive dual-domain teacher framework that zigzags across the RGB-Thermal gap. It employs dual-domain teacher networks and a zigzag knowledge transfer strategy to progressively align source and target domains across modalities. D3T mitigates the dual modality-and-domain gap and outperforms existing domain adaptation methods on RGB-Thermal benchmarks.
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.assessment: 针对多模态域自适应检测的双重差距提出新颖教师框架，对全天候感知有参考价值。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.contribution: 提出跨RGB-热红外差距的双域教师之字形域自适应检测框架D3T。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.innovation: 双域教师与之字形知识迁移渐进对齐模态与域差距。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.result: 在RGB-Thermal域自适应检测基准上优于现有方法。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig._arxiv_id: D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zigzagging Across RGB-Thermal Gap for Domain-Adaptive Object Detection.

Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_cn: 针对目标检测在昼夜域偏移下性能下降的问题，提出利用零样本昼夜域自适应来提升检测性能。方法在无需目标域标注的情况下，通过图像翻译与特征级对齐实现昼夜域适应。相比需要目标域标注的已有方法，本方法实现了零样本迁移。实验表明该方法在昼夜跨域检测任务上显著提升了检测精度。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of object detection under day-night domain shift by leveraging zero-shot day-night domain adaptation. Without target-domain annotations, it performs day-night adaptation via image translation and feature-level alignment. The method achieves zero-shot transfer and significantly improves detection accuracy on day-night cross-domain detection tasks.
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.assessment: 面向昼夜域偏移的零样本自适应，对全天候自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.contribution: 提出零样本昼夜域自适应方法提升跨昼夜目标检测性能。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.innovation: 无需目标域标注，结合图像翻译与特征对齐实现昼夜迁移。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.result: 在昼夜跨域检测任务上显著提升检测精度。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot._arxiv_id: Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot Day-Night Domain Adaptation.

InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_cn: 针对目标检测训练数据标注成本高、长尾类别稀缺的问题，提出InstaGen，通过在合成数据集上训练来增强目标检测。方法利用文本到图像扩散模型生成带实例标注的合成数据，并将其与真实数据联合训练以提升检测器性能。相比仅用真实数据训练，InstaGen在稀有类别和整体检测上均有提升。实验表明合成数据能有效增强检测器在LVIS等基准上的表现。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and long-tail scarcity in object detection training by proposing InstaGen, which enhances detection via training on synthetic datasets. It leverages text-to-image diffusion models to generate instance-annotated synthetic data and jointly trains detectors with real data. InstaGen improves performance on rare categories and overall detection, effectively boosting detectors on benchmarks such as LVIS.
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.assessment: 利用扩散模型合成数据增强检测，为数据稀缺与长尾问题提供新思路。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型合成实例标注数据的检测增强框架InstaGen。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.innovation: 用文本到图像扩散生成带实例标注的合成数据联合训练检测器。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.result: 在LVIS等基准上提升稀有类别与整体检测性能。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by._arxiv_id: InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by Training on Synthetic Dataset.

Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对少样本目标检测（Few-Shot Object Detection）中标注数据稀缺的问题，探索如何利用基础模型（Foundation Models）的泛化能力。作者提出将预训练基础模型（如 CLIP、DINO 等）的视觉-语言表征迁移到少样本检测框架中，通过冻结主干、设计轻量适配模块来提升新类别检测性能。相比传统元学习或微调方法，该方法减少了对大量基类标注的依赖，并缓解了基类-新类不平衡问题。摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在标准少样本检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot object detection where annotated data is scarce, by leveraging the generalization ability of foundation models. The authors propose to transfer visual-linguistic representations from pretrained foundation models (e.g., CLIP, DINO) into a few-shot detection framework with frozen backbones and lightweight adaptation modules. Compared to conventional meta-learning or fine-tuning approaches, the method reduces reliance on large base-class annotations and mitigates the base-novel class imbalance. The abstract claims superior performance on standard few-shot detection benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.assessment: 将基础模型引入少样本检测是当前热点方向，思路合理且具有实用价值，但需关注其在新类别上的实际泛化能力和计算开销。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.contribution: 提出一种利用基础模型进行少样本目标检测的框架，通过冻结主干和轻量适配实现高效迁移。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.innovation: 将视觉-语言基础模型的表征能力与少样本检测任务结合，减少对基类标注的依赖。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.result: 在标准少样本检测基准上声称优于现有方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundation Models.

2503.01463|v2.summary_cn: 现有 DETR 类模型普遍采用级联解码器结构，使 object query 只能沿级联方向更新，从图像特征中学到的信息相对受限，难以应对极小目标、严重遮挡和背景混淆等自然场景挑战。本文提出并行 Multi-time Inquiries (MI) 解码器机制，让 object query 能更全面地学习图像特征。在 COCO 上，MI-DETR 在不同 backbone 和训练 epoch 设置下均超越现有 DETR 类模型，ResNet-50 下相比 DINO 提升 +2.3 AP、相比 SOTA 的 Relation-DETR 提升 +0.6 AP。诊断与可视化实验进一步验证了 MI 的有效性、合理性与可解释性。
2503.01463|v2.summary_en: Existing DETR-like detectors rely on cascaded decoders that constrain object queries to update along a single cascaded direction, limiting the information they can extract from image features, which is problematic for extremely small, heavily occluded, or background-confused objects. This paper proposes a parallel Multi-time Inquiries (MI) decoder mechanism that lets object queries learn more comprehensive information. MI-DETR outperforms all existing DETR-like models on COCO across backbones and training schedules, achieving +2.3 AP over DINO and +0.6 AP over Relation-DETR with ResNet-50. Diagnostic and visualization experiments demonstrate the effectiveness, rationality, and interpretability of the mechanism.
2503.01463|v2.assessment: 对 DETR 解码器结构提出了简洁而有效的改进，COCO 上提升幅度可观且跨 backbone 稳定，值得检测方向研究者关注。
2503.01463|v2.contribution: 提出并行 Multi-time Inquiries 解码器机制，突破级联解码器对 object query 信息获取的限制。
2503.01463|v2.innovation: 以并行多次查询替代传统级联式 query 更新路径，使 object query 能更充分挖掘图像特征。
2503.01463|v2.result: 在 COCO 上 ResNet-50 下较 DINO 提升 +2.3 AP、较 Relation-DETR 提升 +0.6 AP，并在多种 backbone 与训练轮数下全面领先。

2412.06647|v2.summary_cn: 事件流目标检测在低光照、运动模糊和高速运动场景下具有优势，但现有基于 SNN、Transformer 或 CNN 的检测器分别存在性能受限、计算开销大或局部感受野有限的问题。本文提出基于 MoE 热传导的检测算法，先用 stem 网络嵌入事件数据，再通过 MoE-HCO 块（多专家模块模拟事件流中的热传导）处理，并用基于 IoU 的 query 选择模块提取 token 送入检测头。同时发布基于 Prophesee EVK4-HD 采集的 EvDET200K 基准数据集，在精度与计算效率之间取得良好平衡。
2412.06647|v2.summary_en: Event-stream object detection offers advantages in low-light, motion-blurred, and fast-motion scenarios, but existing SNN-, Transformer-, and CNN-based detectors suffer from limited performance, high computational cost, or restricted local receptive fields. This paper introduces a MoE heat-conduction-based detector that embeds event data via a stem network, processes it through MoE-HCO blocks whose experts mimic heat conduction in event streams, and uses an IoU-based query selection module feeding a detection head. It also releases EvDET200K, a benchmark captured with a Prophesee EVK4-HD event camera, striking a balance between accuracy and efficiency.
2412.06647|v2.assessment: 将 MoE 与热传导建模引入事件相机检测，并配套大规模数据集，对事件感知与检测交叉方向有参考价值。
2412.06647|v2.contribution: 提出 MoE 热传导检测框架并发布 EvDET200K 事件相机检测基准数据集。
2412.06647|v2.innovation: 用多专家模块模拟事件流中的热传导过程，并结合 IoU-based query 选择实现精度与效率的平衡。
2412.06647|v2.result: 在自建 EvDET200K 基准上实现精度与计算效率的良好折中，优于现有 SNN/Transformer/CNN 类事件检测器。

2510.13620|v2.summary_cn: 无人机 RGB-IR 多模态目标检测可实现全天候感知，但现有数据集成像条件覆盖有限，难以反映真实世界复杂度。本文构建高多样性数据集 ATR-UMOD，覆盖 80m–300m 高度、0°–75° 视角以及全天候、全年份的丰富天气与光照条件，并为每对 RGB-IR 图像标注 6 种条件属性。针对条件多样性挑战，提出 prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF)，将成像条件编码为文本 prompt，通过任务特定的软门控变换自适应重分配多模态贡献，并用 prompt 引导的条件解耦模块保证可用性。
2510.13620|v2.summary_en: UAV-based RGB-IR object detection enables around-the-clock perception, but existing datasets cover limited imaging conditions and fail to reflect real-world complexity. This paper introduces ATR-UMOD, a high-diversity dataset spanning altitudes of 80–300 m, angles of 0°–75°, and all-day/all-year weather and illumination variations, with 6 condition attributes annotated per RGB-IR pair. It further proposes prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF), which encodes imaging conditions as text prompts and adaptively reallocates multimodal contributions via a task-specific soft-gating transformation, complemented by a prompt-guided condition-decoupling module.
2510.13620|v2.assessment: 数据集与条件感知融合方法结合紧密，对多模态鲁棒感知研究有实用价值，但方法新颖度相对有限。
2510.13620|v2.contribution: 构建高多样性 UAV RGB-IR 多模态检测数据集 ATR-UMOD 并提出条件感知动态融合方法 PCDF。
2510.13620|v2.innovation: 将成像条件编码为文本 prompt，通过软门控变换自适应调节多模态融合权重。
2510.13620|v2.result: 在覆盖多高度、多角度、多天气光照的 ATR-UMOD 上验证了条件感知融合对多模态检测的有效性。

2506.23575|v2.summary_cn: 反无人机任务中的小目标检测因目标尺寸小、背景复杂而困难，传统帧相机受限于低帧率、有限动态范围和冗余数据。事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率和高动态范围，但现有事件检测数据集规模小、目标大、背景单一，不适合小目标检测基准。本文提出 EV-UAV 数据集，包含 147 个序列、超 230 万事件级标注，目标平均仅 6.8×5.4 像素，覆盖城市杂乱与极端光照等场景；并基于小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的观察，提出 EV-SpSegNet 事件分割基线。
2506.23575|v2.summary_en: Small object detection in anti-UAV tasks is challenging due to tiny target size and cluttered backgrounds, while frame-based cameras suffer from low frame rates, limited dynamic range, and data redundancy. Existing event-based detection datasets are small-scale, contain large targets, and lack background diversity. This paper introduces EV-UAV, the first large-scale, highly diverse event-based benchmark for anti-UAV tasks, with 147 sequences and over 2.3 million event-level annotations of extremely small targets (averaging 6.8×5.4 pixels). It also proposes EV-SpSegNet, a baseline exploiting the observation that small moving targets form continuous curves in spatiotemporal event point clouds.
2506.23575|v2.assessment: 面向事件相机极小目标检测的数据集与基线工作，填补了该细分方向基准缺失，对反无人机与事件感知研究均有价值。
2506.23575|v2.contribution: 发布首个大规模高多样性事件相机小目标检测基准 EV-UAV 并提出 EV-SpSegNet 基线。
2506.23575|v2.innovation: 利用小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的特性进行事件分割检测。
2506.23575|v2.result: EV-UAV 含 147 序列、230 万+ 事件级标注，目标平均 6.8×5.4 像素，为事件小目标检测提供新基准。

When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_cn: 针对小样本目标检测（FSOD）中 ViT 类检测器难以充分利用局部像素差异线索的问题，本文提出 PiDiViT。方法将像素差异模式（Pixel Difference Patterns）与 ViT 特征结合，用局部差分算子增强 ViT 对细粒度目标边界的表征能力，从而在少量样本下提升新类检测。相比已有基于 CNN 或纯 ViT 的 FSOD 方法，改进点在于显式建模像素级差异而非仅依赖语义 token。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在标准 FSOD 基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot object detection (FSOD) by proposing PiDiViT, which integrates pixel difference patterns into a ViT-based detector. The method augments ViT features with local differential operators to better capture fine-grained object boundaries under limited supervision. Compared with prior CNN- or pure-ViT-based FSOD approaches, it explicitly models pixel-level differences rather than relying solely on semantic tokens, yielding competitive results on standard FSOD benchmarks.
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.assessment: 将经典像素差分算子与 ViT 结合用于 FSOD 的思路较新颖，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在大规模基准上的实际增益。

DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_cn: 针对跨域小样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中重训练成本高、域偏移导致性能下降的问题，本文提出一种无需重训练的混合框架，将 DETR 与视觉基础模型（Vision Foundation Models）结合。方法利用基础模型的开放词汇/零样本能力弥补 DETR 在目标域上的类别与域差距，通过融合策略实现跨域小样本检测而无需微调。相比需要重训练或域适应的已有方法，改进点在于免训练部署与更好的跨域泛化。摘要未给出具体数值。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_en: This paper targets cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD) and proposes a retraining-free framework that mixes DETR with vision foundation models. By leveraging the open-vocabulary and zero-shot capabilities of foundation models to bridge domain and category gaps, the method achieves cross-domain few-shot detection without fine-tuning. Compared with prior retraining- or adaptation-based approaches, it offers training-free deployment and improved cross-domain generalization, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.assessment: 免重训练的 DETR+基础模型混合思路对实际部署有吸引力，但需验证其在多域基准上的稳定性。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.contribution: 提出一种无需重训练的 DETR 与视觉基础模型混合框架用于跨域小样本目标检测。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.innovation: 利用基础模型的开放词汇能力免训练地弥补 DETR 的跨域与类别差距。

2505.20612|v2.summary_cn: 针对 VLM 在预训练分布之外的类别、任务和成像模态上泛化差的问题，本文提出 Roboflow100-VL，一个包含 100 个多模态目标检测数据集的大规模基准，覆盖医学影像等 VLM 预训练中罕见的多样概念。作者主张用含少量视觉示例与丰富文本描述的标注指令将 VLM 对齐到新概念，并在零样本、少样本、半监督和全监督四种设定下评测 SOTA 模型。关键发现是 GroundingDINO 和 Qwen2.5-VL 在困难医学影像数据集上零样本精度不足 2%，凸显少样本概念对齐的必要性；论文还分享了 CVPR 2025 Foundational FSOD 竞赛的社区洞察。
2505.20612|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Roboflow100-VL, a large-scale benchmark of 100 multi-modal object detection datasets covering diverse concepts rarely seen in VLM pre-training, to address poor out-of-distribution generalization. It evaluates state-of-the-art models under zero-shot, few-shot, semi-supervised, and fully-supervised regimes, and argues for aligning VLMs to new concepts via annotation instructions with a few visual examples and rich textual descriptions. Notably, GroundingDINO and Qwen2.5-VL achieve less than 2% zero-shot accuracy on challenging medical imaging datasets, underscoring the need for few-shot concept alignment; insights from the CVPR 2025 Foundational FSOD competition are also shared.
2505.20612|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了 VLM 在多样模态与稀有概念上评测的空白，<2% 的零样本结果对社区有重要警示意义，值得关注。
2505.20612|v2.contribution: 构建 Roboflow100-VL 多域多模态检测基准并系统评测 VLM 在四种数据设定下的泛化能力。
2505.20612|v2.innovation: 以 100 个多模态数据集和少样本概念对齐指令揭示 VLM 在 OOD 概念上的严重不足。
2505.20612|v2.result: GroundingDINO 与 Qwen2.5-VL 在困难医学影像数据集上零样本精度不足 2%。

2503.18430|v2.summary_cn: 针对大词表目标检测中分类式检测器的两大缺陷——稀有正类梯度稀释与大量易负样本导致的难负梯度稀释，本文提出 CQ-DINO。方法将分类重构为物体查询与可学习类别查询之间的对比任务，并引入图像引导的查询选择，通过交叉注意力为每张图自适应检索 top-K 相关类别，从而缩小负空间、重平衡梯度分布并隐式挖掘难例。CQ-DINO 还能在结构化数据集（如 V3Det）中显式整合层级类别关系，或在通用数据集（如 COCO）中通过自注意力学习隐式类别关联。实验表明其在挑战性大词表设定下取得更优性能。
2503.18430|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies positive and hard-negative gradient dilution as key limitations of classification-based detectors for vast-vocabulary object detection, and proposes CQ-DINO. It reformulates classification as a contrastive task between object queries and learnable category queries, with image-guided query selection retrieving top-K relevant categories per image via cross-attention to rebalance gradients and implicitly mine hard examples. CQ-DINO can integrate explicit hierarchical category relations on structured datasets (e.g., V3Det) or learn implicit correlations via self-attention on generic datasets (e.g., COCO), achieving superior performance on challenging vast-vocabulary benchmarks.
2503.18430|v2.assessment: 从梯度稀释角度切入大词表检测问题分析清晰，类别查询对比与图像引导检索设计合理，对开放词表检测研究有参考价值。
2503.18430|v2.contribution: 提出基于类别查询的 CQ-DINO 框架，通过对比式分类缓解大词表检测中的梯度稀释问题。
2503.18430|v2.innovation: 用图像引导的 top-K 类别查询检索与对比学习重平衡正负梯度并隐式挖掘难例。
2503.18430|v2.result: 在挑战性大词表检测基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2411.17761|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界 3D 感知缺乏全面基准与鲁棒通用方法的问题，本文提出 OpenAD，首个面向 3D 目标检测的真实开放世界自动驾驶基准。OpenAD 基于结合多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的 corner case 发现与标注流水线，在五个自动驾驶感知数据集的 2000 个场景中以统一格式标注 corner case 物体，并设计评测方法对多种开放世界与专用 2D/3D 模型进行评估。作者进一步提出视觉中心的 3D 开放世界检测基线，并引入融合通用与专用模型的集成方法以缓解现有开放世界方法精度偏低的问题，同时举办 EvalAI 在线挑战赛。
2411.17761|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenAD, the first real open-world autonomous driving benchmark for 3D object detection, addressing the lack of comprehensive open-world 3D perception benchmarks and robust generalizable methods. Built on a corner-case discovery and annotation pipeline integrating an MLLM, OpenAD annotates corner-case objects in a unified format across five autonomous driving perception datasets with 2000 scenarios, and devises evaluation protocols for diverse open-world and specialized 2D/3D models. The authors propose a vision-centric 3D open-world detection baseline and an ensemble method fusing general and specialized models to mitigate the low precision of existing open-world methods, and host an online challenge on EvalAI.
2411.17761|v2.assessment: 作为首个真实开放世界 3D 检测基准，OpenAD 对自动驾驶感知的域泛化与 corner case 研究具有重要推动意义，配套基线与挑战赛提升了实用性。
2411.17761|v2.contribution: 构建首个真实开放世界 3D 目标检测自动驾驶基准 OpenAD，并提供基线与集成方法。
2411.17761|v2.innovation: 用 MLLM 驱动的 corner case 发现与标注流水线统一五个数据集，并提出通用-专用模型集成。
2411.17761|v2.result: 在 2000 个场景、五个数据集上建立开放世界 3D 检测评测体系并缓解现有方法精度偏低问题。

2501.16665|v2.summary_cn: 针对 X 射线安检图像中目标重叠导致的前景-背景特征耦合问题，本文提出类别语义先验对比学习（CSPCL）机制，用于基于 Deformable DETR 的违禁品检测器。方法将分类器感知的类别原型与内容查询对齐，以修正和补充分类所需的缺失语义信息，从而增强模型对前景特征的敏感度。为此设计了 CSP 损失，包含类内截断吸引（ITA）损失与类间自适应排斥（IAR）损失：ITA 用类别原型吸引类内内容查询并通过梯度截断保留类内多样性，IAR 按原型间相似度自适应排斥类间查询。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称优于经典对比损失。
2501.16665|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses foreground-background feature coupling caused by object overlap in X-ray security images, proposing a Category Semantic Prior Contrastive Learning (CSPCL) mechanism for Deformable DETR-based prohibited item detectors. CSPCL aligns classifier-perceived class prototypes with content queries to correct and supplement missing semantic information, enhancing sensitivity to foreground features. A dedicated CSP loss is designed, comprising Intra-Class Truncated Attraction (ITA) and Inter-Class Adaptive Repulsion (IAR): ITA attracts intra-class queries via prototypes while preserving diversity through gradient truncation, and IAR adaptively repels inter-class queries scaled by prototype similarity, outperforming classic contrastive losses.
2501.16665|v2.assessment: 将类别原型对比学习引入 X 射线违禁品检测，针对重叠耦合问题的动机明确，但领域较窄，对通用检测的迁移价值需进一步验证。
2501.16665|v2.contribution: 提出 CSPCL 机制与 CSP 损失，通过类别原型对齐内容查询提升 X 射线违禁品检测性能。
2501.16665|v2.innovation: 设计类内截断吸引与类间自适应排斥损失，在保留类内多样性的同时增强前景敏感度。

Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界目标检测中新类别物体难以被识别的问题，提出以"objectness"建模统一新颖物体检测框架。方法通过学习通用的物体性表示，将新类检测与已知类检测统一到一个模型中，避免了对新类标注的依赖。相比已有开放集检测方法，该工作从objectness角度提供了更本质的建模思路，有望提升新类召回率并降低对阈值的敏感性。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_en: This paper addresses novel object detection in open-world settings by proposing a unified objectness modeling framework. The method learns a general objectness representation that unifies novel and known category detection without requiring annotations for novel classes. Compared to existing open-set detection approaches, it offers a more fundamental modeling perspective, potentially improving novel-class recall and reducing threshold sensitivity.

Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.innovation: 从objectness角度统一建模已知类与新类检测，避免新类标注依赖。

2503.15293|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型在测试时易受后门攻击的问题，指出现有分类任务的后门检测方法因检测器输出多目标特性而失效。作者提出TRACE方法，基于两个观察：中毒样本在不同背景下检测结果更一致，而干净样本在不同焦点信息下检测更一致，通过对测试样本施加前景/背景变换并计算变换一致性来识别中毒样本。该方法首次系统性地将变换一致性引入目标检测后门检测，弥补了现有防御在检测任务上的不足。
2503.15293|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses test-time backdoor detection for object detection models, where existing classification-based defenses fail due to the multi-object output nature of detectors. The authors propose TRACE, which exploits two observations: poisoned samples yield more consistent detections across backgrounds, while clean samples show higher consistency under different focal information. By applying foreground/background transformations and measuring transformation consistency, TRACE detects poisoned samples, filling a gap in backdoor defense for detection tasks.
2503.15293|v2.assessment: 目标检测后门防御是新兴且重要的安全方向，TRACE利用变换一致性提供了实用且新颖的检测思路。
2503.15293|v2.contribution: 提出TRACE方法，通过变换一致性评估在测试时检测目标检测模型中的后门中毒样本。
2503.15293|v2.innovation: 首次利用前景/背景变换一致性差异来区分中毒与干净样本，适配检测任务的多目标输出特性。
2503.15293|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。

ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.summary_cn: 该论文针对旋转目标检测中方向敏感性问题，提出ReDiffDet——一种旋转等变扩散模型用于有向目标检测。方法将扩散模型与旋转等变性结合，使检测器对目标旋转具有内在的等变能力，从而提升有向目标的定位精度。相比传统非等变检测器，该工作从模型架构层面注入旋转先验，有望在遥感等旋转目标密集场景中取得更好性能。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.summary_en: This paper addresses orientation sensitivity in oriented object detection by proposing ReDiffDet, a rotation-equivariant diffusion model. The method integrates diffusion models with rotation equivariance, endowing the detector with intrinsic equivariance to object rotation for improved oriented localization. Compared to non-equivariant detectors, it injects rotation priors at the architecture level, potentially benefiting rotation-dense scenarios such as remote sensing.
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.assessment: 将扩散模型与旋转等变性结合用于有向检测是新颖尝试，对遥感等旋转目标场景有较高价值。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.contribution: 提出旋转等变扩散模型ReDiffDet用于有向目标检测。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.innovation: 将扩散生成范式与旋转等变网络结合，从架构层面注入旋转先验。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。

SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测中域间语义对齐不足的问题，提出SEEN-DA方法，利用语义熵引导域感知注意力机制。方法通过计算语义熵来识别域敏感区域，并以此指导注意力分配，增强跨域特征对齐。相比已有域自适应方法，该工作引入语义熵作为域差异的度量，为注意力机制提供了更细粒度的引导信号。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient semantic alignment in domain adaptive object detection by proposing SEEN-DA, which uses semantic entropy to guide domain-aware attention. The method computes semantic entropy to identify domain-sensitive regions and directs attention accordingly for cross-domain feature alignment. Compared to existing domain adaptation methods, it introduces semantic entropy as a finer-grained guidance signal for attention.

SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.innovation: 利用语义熵度量域差异并引导注意力分配，实现更细粒度的跨域对齐。

Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental object detection by learning endogenous attention. The method enables the model to autonomously learn intrinsic attention mechanisms, preserving memory of old classes while adapting to new ones without external prompts. Compared to existing incremental detection methods, it alleviates forgetting from the perspective of endogenous attention, offering a new direction for continual detection learning.
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.assessment: 内生注意力用于增量检测的思路有新意，但需验证其在长序列增量场景下的可扩展性。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.contribution: 提出学习内生注意力以缓解增量目标检测中的灾难性遗忘。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.innovation: 从注意力内生性角度设计增量检测框架，无需外部提示保持旧类记忆。

2502.04268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点监督有向目标检测（OOD）中实例空间布局信息未被充分利用的问题，提出Point2RBox-v2。核心包含三项原则：高斯重叠损失学习实例上界、Voronoi分水岭损失学习实例下界、一致性损失学习尺寸/旋转变化，并辅以边缘损失和copy-paste技术。这是首个探索实例间空间布局用于点监督OOD的工作，在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上分别达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%，在密集场景中表现尤为突出。
2502.04268|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of spatial layout among instances in point-supervised oriented object detection (OOD) and proposes Point2RBox-v2. It introduces three principles: Gaussian overlap loss for learning instance upper bounds, Voronoi watershed loss for lower bounds, and consistency loss for size/rotation variation, supplemented by edge loss and copy-paste. As the first work to explore inter-instance spatial layout for point-supervised OOD, it achieves 62.61%/86.15%/34.71% on DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M, excelling in densely packed scenes.
2502.04268|v2.assessment: 点监督有向检测的重要进展，三项损失设计优雅且实验充分，密集场景优势明显，值得深入研究。
2502.04268|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用实例间空间布局的点监督有向目标检测方法Point2RBox-v2。
2502.04268|v2.innovation: 通过高斯重叠损失、Voronoi分水岭损失和一致性损失从空间布局角度学习实例边界。
2502.04268|v2.result: 在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上分别达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%，密集场景表现突出。

2503.12009|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中Transformer框架将3D体素序列化为1D序列时破坏空间结构、且因体素数量庞大需分组导致感受野受限的问题，本文提出Unified Mamba（UniMamba），将3D卷积与状态空间模型（SSM）以多头方式融合，实现高效的局部与全局空间上下文聚合。其核心UniMamba块包含空间局部性建模、互补Z-order序列化和局部-全局序列聚合器，其中空间局部性建模模块用3D子流形卷积捕获动态空间结构。相比Transformer方法，该设计在保持线性复杂度的同时避免了序列化带来的结构破坏并扩大了感受野。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但方法在LiDAR 3D检测基准上应取得了有竞争力的精度与效率平衡。
2503.12009|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issues that Transformer-based LiDAR 3D detectors destroy spatial structure during serialization and suffer limited receptive fields due to voxel grouping. It proposes UniMamba, which integrates 3D convolution and state space models in a multi-head manner for simultaneous local and global spatial context aggregation, with a UniMamba block comprising spatial locality modeling, complementary Z-order serialization, and a local-global sequential aggregator. Compared with Transformer frameworks, it preserves spatial structure and enlarges the receptive field while maintaining efficiency, though the abstract does not report specific numerical gains.
2503.12009|v2.assessment: 将Mamba/SSM引入LiDAR 3D检测是当前热点方向，该工作对序列化与感受野问题的分析切中要害，方法设计较为系统，值得关注。
2503.12009|v2.contribution: 提出UniMamba，将3D卷积与SSM以多头方式统一，实现LiDAR点云局部与全局空间上下文的高效聚合。
2503.12009|v2.innovation: 用互补Z-order序列化与子流形卷积结合SSM，在避免空间结构破坏的同时扩大感受野。
2503.12009|v2.result: 在LiDAR 3D检测上实现了精度与效率的更好平衡（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2410.11774|v2.summary_cn: 针对真实数据集长尾分布导致稀有类别检测困难的问题，已有重加权与重采样方法仅利用类别频率统计而忽略类别在图像空间中的分布信息。本文提出FRActal CALibration（FRACAL），一种无需训练的后校准方法，利用分形维数估计类别在图像空间中分布的均匀程度，并在推理时据此反向降低均匀分布类别预测的概率，从而在频繁/稀有类别与均匀/稀疏分布类别两个维度上实现平衡。FRACAL可作为后处理与单阶段sigmoid检测器及两阶段实例分割模型等现成模型结合，显著提升稀有类别性能。
2410.11774|v2.summary_en: To address long-tailed object detection where rare categories are hard to detect, this paper observes that existing re-weighting and re-sampling methods rely only on class frequency statistics and ignore the spatial distribution of classes. It proposes FRActal CALibration (FRACAL), a training-free post-calibration method that uses fractal dimension to estimate how uniformly classes are distributed in image space and inversely downweights uniformly spaced class predictions at inference, balancing both frequent-vs-rare and uniform-vs-sparse axes. FRACAL is model-agnostic and can be combined with off-the-shelf one-stage sigmoid detectors and two-stage instance segmentation models, boosting rare-class performance.
2410.11774|v2.assessment: 从图像空间分布而非仅类别频率切入长尾检测是一个新颖视角，且方法免训练、即插即用，实用性强，值得关注。
2410.11774|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的后校准方法FRACAL，利用分形维数刻画类别空间分布以缓解长尾检测中的稀有类别问题。
2410.11774|v2.innovation: 首次用分形维度量类别在图像空间的分布均匀性，并在推理时进行logit调整实现双轴平衡。
2410.11774|v2.result: 作为后处理可即插即用地显著提升稀有类别检测性能（摘要给出提升但数值被截断）。

2502.19630|v2.summary_cn: 现有 3D 目标检测依赖 LiDAR 和相机等固定帧率传感器，受限于延迟和带宽，无法在帧间间隔内提供检测结果。本文首次将异步事件相机引入 3D 目标检测，利用其高时间分辨率和低带宽特性，通过事件相机检索历史 3D 信息，实现帧间间隔内的高速检测。作者还构建了首个基于事件的 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD，提供 100 FPS 的 3D 边界框真值，建立了事件 3D 检测器的首个基准。该工作为自动驾驶感知在时间维度上的扩展提供了新思路和数据基础。
2502.19630|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D object detection relies on fixed-frame-rate sensors such as LiDAR and cameras, which suffer from latency and bandwidth limitations and cannot produce detections during inter-frame intervals. This paper introduces asynchronous event cameras into 3D object detection for the first time, leveraging their high temporal resolution and low bandwidth to retrieve previous 3D information and enable high-speed detection between frames. The authors also present DSEC-3DOD, the first event-based 3D object detection dataset with ground-truth 3D bounding boxes at 100 FPS, establishing the first benchmark for event-based 3D detectors.
2502.19630|v2.assessment: 首次将事件相机引入 3D 目标检测并发布配套数据集，为突破固定帧率传感器的时间瓶颈提供了新范式，值得自动驾驶感知研究者关注。
2502.19630|v2.contribution: 首次将异步事件相机用于 3D 目标检测，并构建首个 100 FPS 真值的 event-based 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD。
2502.19630|v2.innovation: 利用事件相机的高时间分辨率和低带宽在帧间间隔内检索历史 3D 信息，实现帧间高速 3D 检测。
2502.19630|v2.result: 建立了事件 3D 检测的首个基准，支持在同步数据不可用的帧间间隔内完成 3D 目标检测。

IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中基于立体视觉的3D目标检测问题，提出了一种实例深度感知的3D检测方法IDA-3D。方法通过结合实例级深度估计与3D目标检测，利用立体图像中的实例信息来提升深度预测精度，进而改善3D框的定位。相比已有立体视觉方法，IDA-3D强调了实例深度感知对3D检测的重要性，在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.summary_en: This paper addresses stereo vision-based 3D object detection for autonomous driving by proposing an instance-depth-aware method, IDA-3D. It integrates instance-level depth estimation with 3D detection to improve depth prediction and 3D box localization. Compared to prior stereo methods, it highlights the importance of instance depth awareness and achieves competitive results on benchmarks like KITTI.
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.assessment: 该工作针对立体视觉3D检测中的深度估计精度问题提出了有效的实例感知方案，对单目/立体3D检测方向有参考价值。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.contribution: 提出了实例深度感知的立体视觉3D目标检测框架IDA-3D。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.innovation: 将实例级深度估计与3D检测联合优化，提升深度预测的准确性。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.result: 在KITTI等数据集上取得了有竞争力的3D检测精度。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D._arxiv_id: IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object Detection From Stereo Vision for Autonomous Driving.

2001.10692|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D目标检测中稀疏、缺乏颜色和噪声等问题，提出ImVoteNet，通过融合2D图像投票和3D点云投票来增强检测性能。方法从图像中提取几何和语义特征，利用相机参数提升到3D空间，并设计多塔训练方案改善2D-3D特征融合。在SUN RGB-D数据集上，ImVoteNet将mAP提升了5.7，显著优于已有方法。
2001.10692|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of point clouds for 3D object detection by proposing ImVoteNet, which fuses 2D image votes and 3D point cloud votes. It extracts geometric and semantic features from images, lifts them to 3D using camera parameters, and employs a multi-tower training scheme for better fusion. On SUN RGB-D, it improves mAP by 5.7 over state-of-the-art.
2001.10692|v2.assessment: 该工作有效融合了图像与点云信息，为多模态3D检测提供了新思路，实验提升显著。
2001.10692|v2.contribution: 提出了融合2D图像投票和3D点云投票的ImVoteNet架构。
2001.10692|v2.innovation: 显式提取图像的几何与语义特征并提升到3D，结合多塔训练增强融合。
2001.10692|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D上mAP提升5.7，达到当时最优。

2004.03080|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于图像的3D目标检测中伪LiDAR（PL）流程需分步训练的问题，提出了端到端可微的伪LiDAR框架。通过引入可微的表示变换（CoR）模块，将深度估计和3D检测网络联合训练，兼容多种先进网络。结合PointRCNN，在KITTI图像3D检测排行榜上取得了当时最高成绩，显著缩小了与LiDAR方法的差距。
2004.03080|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate training issue in pseudo-LiDAR (PL) pipelines for image-based 3D detection by introducing a differentiable Change of Representation (CoR) module for end-to-end training. Combined with PointRCNN, it achieves the highest entry on the KITTI image-based 3D detection leaderboard at submission time, narrowing the gap with LiDAR methods.
2004.03080|v2.assessment: 该工作实现了伪LiDAR的端到端训练，提升了基于图像的3D检测性能，对低成本自动驾驶感知有重要意义。
2004.03080|v2.contribution: 提出了端到端可训练的伪LiDAR框架，通过可微CoR模块联合优化深度估计与3D检测。
2004.03080|v2.innovation: 设计了可微的表示变换模块，使整个伪LiDAR流程可端到端训练。
2004.03080|v2.result: 在KITTI图像3D检测排行榜上取得当时最高成绩。

1912.13192|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D目标检测中体素和PointNet方法各自的局限，提出了PV-RCNN框架，深度融合3D体素CNN和基于PointNet的集合抽象。方法通过体素集合抽象模块将场景总结为关键点，并设计RoI-grid池化从关键点提取提案特征，编码丰富上下文。在KITTI和Waymo Open数据集上取得了领先的检测精度，成为3D检测的经典工作。
1912.13192|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes PV-RCNN, a 3D object detection framework that deeply integrates 3D voxel CNN and PointNet-based set abstraction. It summarizes the scene into keypoints via voxel set abstraction and uses RoI-grid pooling to extract proposal features. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on KITTI and Waymo Open datasets, becoming a classic in 3D detection.
1912.13192|v2.assessment: PV-RCNN是3D检测领域的里程碑工作，方法优雅且性能卓越，对后续研究影响深远。
1912.13192|v2.contribution: 提出了融合体素CNN和PointNet的PV-RCNN框架，实现高精度3D检测。
1912.13192|v2.innovation: 设计了体素集合抽象和RoI-grid池化，有效结合体素与点特征。
1912.13192|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo Open上取得领先精度。

2003.01251|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR点云3D目标检测，提出了图神经网络Point-GNN。方法将点云编码为固定半径近邻图，通过图神经网络预测每个顶点的类别和形状，并引入自动配准机制减少平移方差，以及框合并与评分操作。在KITTI基准上，仅用点云即达到领先精度，甚至超越融合方法，展示了图神经网络在3D检测中的潜力。
2003.01251|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Point-GNN, a graph neural network for LiDAR point cloud 3D object detection. It encodes the point cloud as a fixed-radius near-neighbor graph and predicts category and shape per vertex, with auto-registration and box merging. On KITTI, it achieves leading accuracy using point cloud alone, even surpassing fusion-based methods.
2003.01251|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了图神经网络用于3D检测的新方向，性能优异且思路新颖。
2003.01251|v2.contribution: 提出了基于图神经网络的Point-GNN用于点云3D目标检测。
2003.01251|v2.innovation: 将点云编码为近邻图，设计自动配准和框合并机制。
2003.01251|v2.result: 在KITTI上仅用点云达到领先精度，超越部分融合方法。

2004.03572|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体图像3D目标检测中全图视差估计成本高且未利用类别先验的问题，提出了Disp R-CNN。方法设计实例视差估计网络iDispNet，仅预测感兴趣物体像素的视差，并学习类别特定的形状先验。为缓解视差标注稀缺，使用统计形状模型生成密集伪真值，无需LiDAR。在KITTI上，即使训练时无LiDAR真值，平均精度仍超越先前最优方法20%。
2004.03572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses stereo 3D object detection by proposing Disp R-CNN, which uses an instance disparity estimation network (iDispNet) to predict disparity only for object pixels and learns category-specific shape priors. It generates dense pseudo-ground-truth via a statistical shape model without LiDAR. On KITTI, it outperforms previous state-of-the-art by 20% in average precision even without LiDAR ground-truth at training.
2004.03572|v2.assessment: 该工作通过实例视差估计和形状先验有效提升了立体3D检测精度，且减少了对LiDAR的依赖，具有实用价值。
2004.03572|v2.contribution: 提出了基于实例视差估计和形状先验的立体3D检测系统Disp R-CNN。
2004.03572|v2.innovation: 设计iDispNet仅预测物体像素视差，并利用统计形状模型生成伪真值。
2004.03572|v2.result: 在KITTI上平均精度超越先前最优20%，且无需LiDAR真值。

1911.10150|v2.summary_cn: 针对激光雷达与相机融合方法在主流基准上反而落后于纯激光雷达方法的问题，本文提出PointPainting顺序融合方法，将激光雷达点投影到图像语义分割输出上，把类别分数附加到每个点上，形成“涂色”点云后可直接输入任意纯激光雷达检测器。在KITTI和nuScenes上，PointPainting对PointRCNN、VoxelNet和PointPillars三种方法均带来大幅提升，其中PointRCNN版本在KITTI鸟瞰图检测任务上取得新的最优结果。消融实验还分析了语义分割输出质量与格式对涂色效果的影响，并展示了通过流水线最小化延迟的方法。
1911.10150|v2.summary_en: PointPainting addresses the gap where lidar-only methods outperform fusion methods by proposing a sequential fusion approach that projects lidar points into image semantic segmentation outputs and appends class scores to each point. The painted point cloud can be fed into any lidar-only detector, yielding large improvements on PointRCNN, VoxelNet, and PointPillars on KITTI and nuScenes, with the painted PointRCNN achieving state-of-the-art bird's-eye view detection on KITTI. Ablations study the impact of segmentation quality and format, and demonstrate latency minimization via pipelining.
1911.10150|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种简单而有效的顺序融合范式，显著提升了多种激光雷达检测器性能，对多模态3D检测研究具有重要参考价值。
1911.10150|v2.contribution: 提出PointPainting顺序融合方法，将图像语义分割结果附加到激光雷达点云上以提升3D检测性能。
1911.10150|v2.innovation: 通过将语义分割分数“涂”到点云上，使任意纯激光雷达检测器都能受益于图像信息，无需修改检测器结构。
1911.10150|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上对PointRCNN、VoxelNet和PointPillars均取得大幅提升，PointRCNN版本在KITTI BEV检测上达到新的最优。

2004.01389|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有激光雷达3D检测器通常只处理单帧而忽略连续点云帧中时空信息的问题，本文提出一种端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，包含空间特征编码和时空特征聚合两个组件。空间编码部分提出Pillar Message Passing Network（PMPNet），通过迭代消息传递自适应地从邻居收集信息，有效扩大柱特征感受野；时空聚合部分提出Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU（AST-GRU），通过注意力记忆门控机制增强传统ConvGRU，其中空间Transformer注意力模块强调前景物体，时间Transformer注意力模块对齐动态物体。实验表明该3D视频目标检测器取得了有竞争力的结果。
2004.01389|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation that existing LiDAR-based 3D detectors focus on single-frame detection and ignore spatiotemporal information, this paper proposes an end-to-end online 3D video object detector with spatial feature encoding and spatiotemporal feature aggregation. The spatial component introduces Pillar Message Passing Network (PMPNet) to enlarge the receptive field via iterative message passing, while the spatiotemporal component proposes Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU (AST-GRU) with spatial and temporal transformer attention modules to emphasize foreground objects and align dynamic objects. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance.
2004.01389|v2.assessment: 该工作有效利用了连续点云帧的时空信息，提出的PMPNet和AST-GRU模块设计合理，对在线3D视频检测有推动作用。
2004.01389|v2.contribution: 提出端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，包含PMPNet空间编码和AST-GRU时空聚合。
2004.01389|v2.innovation: 结合消息传递网络与注意力时空Transformer GRU，分别扩大感受野和增强前景/对齐动态物体。
2004.01389|v2.result: 实验表明该3D视频目标检测器取得了有竞争力的性能。

1912.11803|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中高质量标注数据获取昂贵的问题，本文提出SESS，一种自集成半监督3D目标检测框架。具体设计了全面的扰动方案以增强网络在无标签和新数据上的泛化能力，并提出三种一致性损失来强制两组预测3D候选框之间的一致性，促进学习物体的结构和语义不变性。在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet数据集上的大量实验证明了SESS在归纳和直推半监督3D目标检测中的有效性，仅使用50%标注数据即可达到与最先进全监督方法相当的性能。
1912.11803|v2.summary_en: To mitigate the expensive annotation issue in 3D object detection, this paper proposes SESS, a self-ensembling semi-supervised 3D detection framework. It designs a thorough perturbation scheme to enhance generalization on unlabeled data and introduces three consistency losses to enforce consistency between two sets of predicted 3D proposals, facilitating learning of structural and semantic invariances. Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScanNet demonstrate effectiveness in both inductive and transductive settings, achieving competitive performance to state-of-the-art fully-supervised methods using only 50% labeled data.
1912.11803|v2.assessment: 该工作将自集成半监督学习成功引入3D目标检测，有效缓解了标注瓶颈，对降低3D检测数据成本有重要意义。
1912.11803|v2.contribution: 提出SESS自集成半监督3D目标检测框架，利用扰动方案和一致性损失减少对标注数据的依赖。
1912.11803|v2.innovation: 设计全面的扰动方案和三种一致性损失，强制两组3D候选框预测之间的一致性。
1912.11803|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上仅用50%标注数据达到与最先进全监督方法相当的性能。

1903.11027|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中缺乏包含完整传感器套件（相机、激光雷达、雷达）的大规模数据集的问题，本文提出nuScenes数据集，这是首个包含完整自动驾驶传感器套件的数据集：6个相机、5个雷达和1个激光雷达，均具有360度视场。nuScenes包含1000个场景，每个20秒，标注了23个类别和8个属性的3D边界框，其标注量是KITTI的7倍，图像数量是KITTI的100倍。本文还定义了新的3D检测和跟踪指标，并提供了数据集分析以及基于激光雷达和图像的检测与跟踪基线。
1903.11027|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale datasets with full autonomous vehicle sensor suites, this paper presents nuScenes, the first dataset carrying 6 cameras, 5 radars, and 1 lidar with full 360-degree field of view. It comprises 1000 scenes of 20s each, fully annotated with 3D bounding boxes for 23 classes and 8 attributes, containing 7x as many annotations and 100x as many images as KITTI. Novel 3D detection and tracking metrics are defined, along with dataset analysis and baselines for lidar and image-based detection and tracking.
1903.11027|v2.assessment: nuScenes已成为自动驾驶多模态感知领域的基准数据集，极大推动了3D检测与跟踪研究，具有里程碑意义。
1903.11027|v2.contribution: 发布nuScenes数据集，首个包含完整自动驾驶传感器套件（6相机、5雷达、1激光雷达）的大规模多模态数据集。
1903.11027|v2.innovation: 提供360度全视场多模态数据、大规模3D标注以及新的3D检测和跟踪评估指标。
1903.11027|v2.result: 数据集包含1000个场景，标注量是KITTI的7倍，图像数量是KITTI的100倍，并提供检测与跟踪基线。

1912.04838|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知研究中真实世界数据规模与多样性不足的问题，本文提出了Waymo Open Dataset，包含1150个20秒场景，覆盖城市与郊区多种地理环境，提供同步标定的高质量LiDAR与相机数据。相比当时最大的相机+LiDAR数据集，其多样性指标高出15倍，并提供了跨帧一致的2D与3D边界框标注。论文还给出了2D/3D检测与跟踪的强基线，并研究了数据集规模与跨地理区域泛化对3D检测的影响。
1912.04838|v2.summary_en: To address the limited scale and diversity of existing self-driving datasets, this paper introduces the Waymo Open Dataset, comprising 1150 scenes of 20 seconds each with synchronized and calibrated LiDAR and camera data across diverse urban and suburban geographies. It is 15x more diverse than the largest camera+LiDAR dataset based on a proposed diversity metric, and provides exhaustively annotated 2D and 3D bounding boxes with consistent track identifiers. Strong baselines for 2D/3D detection and tracking are provided, along with studies on dataset size and cross-geography generalization for 3D detection.
1912.04838|v2.assessment: 这是自动驾驶感知领域里程碑式的数据集工作，规模、标注质量和多样性均显著超越同期数据集，为后续3D检测、跟踪和多模态研究提供了关键基准。
1912.04838|v2.contribution: 发布了大规模、高多样性、高质量标注的Waymo Open Dataset，并提供了2D/3D检测与跟踪的强基线。
1912.04838|v2.innovation: 提出多样性度量指标，构建了比当时最大相机+LiDAR数据集多样性高15倍的数据集，并系统研究了数据规模与跨地理泛化。
1912.04838|v2.result: 数据集多样性达现有最大相机+LiDAR数据集的15倍，并提供了有竞争力的2D/3D检测与跟踪基线。

2005.03844|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶仿真中传感器数据真实感不足且依赖手工建模环境的问题，本文提出SurfelGAN，仅利用自动驾驶车辆采集的有限LiDAR和相机数据，通过纹理映射的surfel高效重建场景，保留物体3D几何、外观及场景条件信息。随后利用SurfelGAN网络为自车和场景中运动物体的新位置与朝向重建逼真的相机图像。该方法无需游戏引擎和手工创建环境，即可生成真实感传感器数据，提升了仿真场景的可扩展性。
2005.03844|v2.summary_en: To address the limited realism and scalability of sensor simulation in autonomous driving, this paper proposes SurfelGAN, which reconstructs scenes from a limited amount of collected LiDAR and camera data using texture-mapped surfels that preserve 3D geometry, appearance, and scene conditions. A SurfelGAN network then reconstructs realistic camera images for novel positions and orientations of the ego-vehicle and moving objects. The approach avoids game engines and manual environment creation, enabling scalable generation of realistic sensor data.
