2005.03844|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶仿真数据生成提供了轻量且有效的方案，利用surfel表示与GAN结合，在无需手工建模的情况下生成逼真图像，对数据增强和闭环仿真有实用价值。
2005.03844|v2.contribution: 提出基于纹理映射surfel与SurfelGAN的传感器数据合成方法，仅用有限真实数据即可生成新视角的逼真相机图像。
2005.03844|v2.innovation: 将surfel场景重建与GAN图像合成结合，摆脱对游戏引擎和手工环境建模的依赖，实现可扩展的真实感数据生成。
2005.03844|v2.result: 在仅使用有限LiDAR和相机数据的情况下，成功为自车和运动物体的新位姿合成逼真相机图像。

2005.05501|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度视频中3D动作识别的问题，本文提出3D动态体素（3DV）作为新的3D运动表示，通过时间秩池化将深度视频中的3D运动信息紧凑编码为规则体素集合，每个体素同时包含3D空间与运动特征。将3DV抽象为点集并输入PointNet++进行端到端动作识别，同时提出多流框架联合学习运动与外观特征，并将深度视频划分为时间片段以编码更丰富的时间顺序信息。在4个基准数据集上取得优异结果，在NTU RGB+D 120上跨被试和跨设置测试分别达到82.4%和93.5%的准确率。
2005.05501|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes 3D Dynamic Voxel (3DV), a novel 3D motion representation for depth-based action recognition that encodes 3D motion information into a regular voxel set via temporal rank pooling, with each voxel jointly capturing spatial and motion features. The 3DV is abstracted as a point set and fed into PointNet++ for end-to-end recognition, and a multi-stream framework is introduced to jointly learn motion and appearance features. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate superiority, achieving 82.4% and 93.5% accuracy on NTU RGB+D 120 under cross-subject and cross-setup protocols.
2005.05501|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，主要面向深度视频动作识别，但其体素化与点云处理的思路对3D表示学习有一定参考价值。
2005.05501|v2.contribution: 提出3DV运动表示与多流PointNet++框架，用于深度视频中的3D动作识别。
2005.05501|v2.innovation: 通过时间秩池化将深度视频运动信息编码为规则体素集合，并转化为点集用PointNet++处理。
2005.05501|v2.result: 在NTU RGB+D 120上跨被试和跨设置测试分别达到82.4%和93.5%的准确率。

Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中锚框设计依赖先验且对物体尺度变化敏感的问题，本文提出了一种无锚框的3D检测方法Object as Hotspots（OHS）。该方法将物体表示为热点集合，通过从物体表面关键点发射射线来聚合特征，从而避免了对锚框的依赖。相比已有工作，OHS能够更灵活地处理不同尺度和形状的物体，并在3D检测基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_en: To address the reliance on anchor boxes and sensitivity to object scale variation in 3D object detection, this paper proposes Object as Hotspots (OHS), an anchor-free 3D detection approach that represents objects as sets of hotspots and aggregates features by firing rays from surface keypoints. This design eliminates the need for anchor boxes and handles objects of varying scales and shapes more flexibly. The method achieves competitive performance on 3D detection benchmarks.
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.assessment: 该工作提出了一种新颖的无锚框3D检测范式，通过热点表示物体并聚合特征，对点云3D检测的锚框设计问题提供了有价值的替代方案。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.contribution: 提出Object as Hotspots的无锚框3D检测方法，通过物体表面热点发射射线聚合特征实现检测。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.innovation: 将物体表示为热点集合，利用射线发射机制替代传统锚框，提升对不同尺度物体的适应性。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.result: 在3D检测基准上取得了有竞争力的检测性能。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Object Detection Approach via Firing of Hotspots.

Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中定位误差来源不清的问题，系统分析了深度估计、2D检测框、3D框尺寸与朝向等误差对最终定位精度的影响。作者通过大量消融实验定位出深度估计误差是主要瓶颈，并据此提出改进策略以缓解定位偏差。相比已有工作仅关注整体精度提升，本文更强调误差分解与归因分析。在KITTI基准上验证了方法的有效性，显著降低了定位误差并提升了3D检测精度。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_en: This paper systematically analyzes the sources of localization errors in monocular 3D object detection, identifying depth estimation error as the dominant bottleneck. Based on this analysis, the authors propose targeted improvements to mitigate localization bias. Experiments on KITTI demonstrate significant reduction in localization error and improved 3D detection accuracy compared to prior monocular methods.
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.assessment: 该工作对单目3D检测的误差来源进行了深入剖析，为后续方法设计提供了重要指导，值得关注。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.contribution: 系统分解并量化了单目3D检测中各环节的定位误差贡献。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.innovation: 首次将定位误差归因到深度估计等具体模块并据此设计改进方案。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.result: 在KITTI上显著降低了定位误差并提升了3D检测精度。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon._arxiv_id: Delving Into Localization Errors for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_cn: 该论文针对单阶段3D目标检测中体素与点云表示各自局限的问题，提出混合体素-点表示HVPR。方法通过将体素特征与原始点特征在单阶段框架内融合，兼顾了体素的高效性与点云的精细几何信息。相比纯体素或纯点云方法，HVPR在保持实时性的同时提升了检测精度。在KITTI等基准上取得了优于同期单阶段方法的性能。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of voxel-only and point-only representations for single-stage 3D object detection by proposing a Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation (HVPR). The method fuses voxel features with raw point features within a single-stage framework, balancing efficiency and geometric fidelity. Experiments on KITTI show improved accuracy over contemporary single-stage detectors while maintaining real-time performance.
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.assessment: HVPR在单阶段3D检测中有效融合了体素与点云优势，兼顾效率与精度，具有实用价值。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.contribution: 提出混合体素-点表示的单阶段3D检测框架。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.innovation: 在单阶段检测器中实现体素与点云特征的互补融合。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.result: 在KITTI上以实时速度取得优于同期单阶段方法的精度。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation._arxiv_id: HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation for Single-Stage 3D Object Detection.

3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D目标检测中局部与全局上下文建模不足的问题，提出Pointformer模块。方法在点云上引入自注意力机制，分别建模局部区域内的点间关系与全局场景上下文，并嵌入到3D检测流程中。相比仅依赖卷积或稀疏卷积的方法，Pointformer能更有效地捕获长距离依赖。在ScanNet与SUN RGB-D等基准上取得了显著的检测精度提升。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Pointformer, a transformer-based module for point cloud 3D object detection that captures both local and global context via self-attention. By modeling intra-region point relations and global scene dependencies, it overcomes the limited receptive field of convolution-based methods. Experiments on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D demonstrate significant detection accuracy improvements.
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.assessment: Pointformer将Transformer引入点云3D检测，有效增强了上下文建模能力，是该方向的重要探索。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.contribution: 提出基于自注意力的Pointformer模块用于点云3D检测。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.innovation: 在点云上同时建模局部点间关系与全局场景上下文。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D上取得显著检测精度提升。

2103.05073|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对离线3D感知场景（如自动生成高质量3D标注）研究不足的问题，提出基于点云序列的离线3D检测流水线。方法利用多帧点云中互补的物体视角，通过多帧目标检测与物体中心精炼模型生成高质量3D框。相比现有在线检测器，该流水线在Waymo Open Dataset上大幅超越SOTA在线检测器，性能甚至与人工标注相当。进一步实验验证了自动标注在半监督学习中的应用价值。
2103.05073|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored offboard 3D perception scenario by proposing a point cloud sequence-based offboard 3D detection pipeline for automatic high-quality label generation. Leveraging complementary object views across frames, it combines multi-frame detection with object-centric refinement. On the Waymo Open Dataset, the pipeline significantly outperforms state-of-the-art onboard detectors and achieves performance on par with human labels, with further validation for semi-supervised learning.
2103.05073|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了离线3D感知与自动标注的新方向，性能媲美人工标注，对数据闭环与自动驾驶落地意义重大。
2103.05073|v2.contribution: 提出基于点云序列的离线3D检测与自动标注流水线。
2103.05073|v2.innovation: 利用多帧互补视角与物体中心精炼实现高质量离线3D标注。
2103.05073|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上超越SOTA在线检测器，性能与人工标注相当。

2103.01100|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确导致性能受限的问题，提出分类深度分布网络CaDDN。方法对每个像素预测分类深度分布，将丰富的上下文特征投影到3D空间对应深度区间，再通过高效的BEV投影与单阶段检测器输出3D框。相比直接回归深度的方法，CaDDN实现了端到端联合深度估计与目标检测。在KITTI上排名单目方法第一，并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上给出单目3D检测结果。
2103.01100|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the depth inaccuracy bottleneck in monocular 3D object detection by proposing the Categorical Depth Distribution Network (CaDDN). It predicts a categorical depth distribution per pixel to project contextual features into the appropriate depth interval in 3D space, followed by efficient BEV projection and a single-stage detector. CaDDN ranks 1st among published monocular methods on KITTI and provides the first monocular 3D detection results on the Waymo Open Dataset.
2103.01100|v2.assessment: CaDDN通过分类深度分布有效缓解了单目深度估计误差，是单目3D检测领域的代表性工作，值得深入研读。
2103.01100|v2.contribution: 提出基于分类深度分布的单目3D检测端到端框架CaDDN。
2103.01100|v2.innovation: 用逐像素分类深度分布替代直接深度回归以提升投影精度。
2103.01100|v2.result: 在KITTI单目方法中排名第一，并首次在Waymo上给出单目3D检测结果。

RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中精度与效率难以兼顾的问题，提出Range Sparse Net（RSN）。方法利用距离图像中前景稀疏的特性，设计稀疏卷积与距离感知的检测框架，在保持高精度的同时大幅提升推理速度。相比已有LiDAR检测器，RSN在nuScenes与Waymo等基准上实现了更优的精度-速度权衡。实验表明其在实时自动驾驶场景中具有显著优势。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_en: This paper proposes Range Sparse Net (RSN) for efficient and accurate LiDAR 3D object detection. Exploiting the sparsity of foreground points in range images, RSN employs sparse convolutions and a range-aware detection framework to achieve a superior accuracy-speed trade-off. Experiments on nuScenes and Waymo demonstrate significant advantages for real-time autonomous driving.
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.assessment: RSN在LiDAR 3D检测中实现了精度与效率的良好平衡，对实时自动驾驶感知具有重要实用价值。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.contribution: 提出距离稀疏网络RSN用于高效准确的LiDAR 3D检测。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.innovation: 利用距离图像前景稀疏性设计稀疏卷积检测框架。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上实现更优的精度-速度权衡。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc._arxiv_id: RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Accurate LiDAR 3D Object Detection.

2011.12953|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对无监督目标检测这一此前几乎空白的问题，指出仅依赖2D图像外观推导的目标边界模糊不可靠，且类别分布呈长尾开放形态。方法上利用LiDAR提供的3D场景结构生成候选目标分割，再通过迭代式分割标注过程为分割分配标签并训练融合2D图像与3D点云特征的标注网络，标注过程专门设计以缓解长尾与开放类别分布问题，最终将分割标签作为伪标注用于目标检测。相比已有工作，这是首个借助LiDAR线索实现无监督目标检测的实用方法，利用3D结构显著缓解了定位难题。
2011.12953|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the previously unexplored problem of unsupervised object detection, where 2D appearance-based object boundaries are ambiguous and unreliable. It exploits LiDAR clues to generate candidate object segments from 3D point clouds, then performs an iterative segment labeling process that assigns labels and trains a labeling network using both 2D image and 3D point cloud features, with the process designed to handle long-tailed and open-ended category distributions. The resulting segment labels serve as pseudo annotations for object detection, making this the first practical method for unsupervised object detection aided by LiDAR clues.
2011.12953|v2.assessment: 首次将LiDAR 3D结构线索引入无监督目标检测，思路新颖，对开放类别与长尾分布的处理具有启发性，值得关注。
2011.12953|v2.contribution: 提出了首个借助LiDAR线索的无监督目标检测实用方法，并设计了应对长尾开放类别分布的迭代分割标注流程。
2011.12953|v2.innovation: 利用3D点云结构生成候选分割并结合2D/3D特征迭代标注，缓解了纯2D外观边界模糊与类别长尾开放的问题。
2011.12953|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，但声称显著缓解了定位难题并实现了首个实用的无监督目标检测方案。

PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测中跨模态特征融合的问题，提出PointAugmenting方法进行跨模态数据增强。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题可知其核心是在点云与图像之间进行特征层面的增强与融合，以提升3D检测性能。该方法属于多模态3D检测方向，通常通过将图像语义特征注入点云表示来改善检测精度。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-modal feature fusion for 3D object detection by proposing PointAugmenting, a cross-modal augmentation approach. Although the abstract is unavailable, the title indicates that it augments point cloud representations with image features to improve 3D detection performance. The method targets the multimodal 3D detection setting where camera semantics are injected into LiDAR-based pipelines.
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.assessment: 跨模态增强是3D检测的重要方向，PointAugmenting在该方向具有一定影响力，但缺少摘要细节，评估受限。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.contribution: 提出了面向3D目标检测的跨模态增强方法PointAugmenting。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.innovation: 通过跨模态特征增强提升点云3D检测的表示能力。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.result: 摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio._arxiv_id: PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentation for 3D Object Detection.

2103.16470|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度信息不准确与上下文融合不足的问题，提出深度条件动态消息传播网络DDMP。方法不依赖复杂的伪LiDAR方案，而是先在图像上下文中自适应采样上下文感知节点，再动态预测依赖深度的混合滤波器权重与亲和矩阵进行信息传播，从而有效融合多尺度深度信息与图像上下文；同时引入中心感知深度编码CDE任务以缓解深度先验不准确的问题。在KITTI基准上取得单目方法中的最优结果，并在2020年11月16日提交时位列KITTI单目3D检测榜单第一。
2103.16470|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular 3D object detection by learning context- and depth-aware feature representations. It proposes a depth-conditioned dynamic message propagation (DDMP) network that adaptively samples context-aware nodes and dynamically predicts hybrid depth-dependent filter weights and affinity matrices, avoiding complicated pseudo-LiDAR pipelines. A center-aware depth encoding (CDE) task further alleviates inaccurate depth priors, and the method ranks first on the KITTI monocular 3D detection benchmark at submission time (November 16, 2020).
2103.16470|v2.assessment: 在单目3D检测中巧妙结合动态消息传播与深度条件建模，KITTI榜首结果验证了其有效性，是该方向值得参考的工作。
2103.16470|v2.contribution: 提出了深度条件动态消息传播网络DDMP及中心感知深度编码CDE任务，用于单目3D目标检测。
2103.16470|v2.innovation: 通过动态预测深度相关的滤波器权重与亲和矩阵，实现深度信息与图像上下文的自适应融合，避免伪LiDAR的复杂性。
2103.16470|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得最优结果，并在提交日位列榜单第一。

2103.05346|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，提出自训练流水线ST3D。首先在源域用随机目标缩放策略预训练3D检测器以缓解源域偏差，然后在目标域通过质量感知三元组记忆库更新伪标签、并用课程数据增强训练模型，交替迭代提升检测器。这些针对3D检测的设计使检测器能利用一致且高质量的伪标签训练，并避免对伪标注数据中大量简单样本过拟合。ST3D在所有评估数据集上达到最优性能，在KITTI 3D检测基准上甚至超越全监督结果。
2103.05346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for point cloud 3D object detection with a self-training pipeline named ST3D. It pre-trains the detector on the source domain using random object scaling to mitigate source bias, then iteratively improves it on the target domain via quality-aware triplet memory bank pseudo-label updating and curriculum data augmentation. ST3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on all evaluated datasets and even surpasses fully supervised results on the KITTI 3D detection benchmark.
2103.05346|v2.assessment: 针对3D检测域适应提出了完整的自训练框架，记忆库与课程增强设计合理，超越全监督的结果颇具说服力。
2103.05346|v2.contribution: 提出了用于点云3D目标检测无监督域适应的自训练流水线ST3D。
2103.05346|v2.innovation: 结合随机目标缩放、质量感知三元组记忆库与课程数据增强，实现高质量伪标签的迭代训练。
2103.05346|v2.result: 在所有评估数据集上达到最优，并在KITTI 3D检测基准上超越全监督结果。

2103.16054|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有3D检测方法多依赖单帧、未充分利用多帧信息的问题，提出3D多帧注意力网络3D-MAN。方法先用新颖的快速单帧检测器生成候选框，将候选框及其对应特征图存入记忆库，再设计多视角对齐与聚合模块，利用注意力网络提取并聚合记忆库中的时序特征，有效融合来自场景不同视角的特征。在Waymo Open Dataset上取得相比已发表的单帧与多帧方法的最优结果。
2103.16054|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of multi-frame information in 3D object detection by proposing 3D-MAN, a 3D multi-frame attention network. It first uses a fast single-frame detector to produce box proposals, stores them with their feature maps in a memory bank, and then applies a multi-view alignment and aggregation module with attention networks to extract and aggregate temporal features. It achieves state-of-the-art results on the Waymo Open Dataset compared to published single-frame and multi-frame methods.
2103.16054|v2.assessment: 多帧时序聚合是自动驾驶3D检测的关键，3D-MAN的记忆库与注意力聚合设计在Waymo上验证有效，具有实用价值。
2103.16054|v2.contribution: 提出了3D多帧注意力网络3D-MAN，用于聚合多视角时序特征进行3D目标检测。
2103.16054|v2.innovation: 通过记忆库存储候选框特征并结合多视角对齐与注意力聚合，有效利用多帧信息。
2103.16054|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上取得优于已发表单帧与多帧方法的最优结果。

Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测与跟踪问题，提出基于中心点的方法。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题可知其核心是将目标表示为3D中心点，并统一用于检测与跟踪任务。该方法属于中心点式3D检测范式，通常通过热图预测目标中心并回归尺寸与朝向，同时利用中心点关联实现跟踪。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D object detection and tracking by proposing a center-based formulation. Although the abstract is unavailable, the title indicates that objects are represented by their 3D centers and that this representation is used jointly for detection and tracking. The approach belongs to the center-based 3D detection paradigm, typically predicting center heatmaps and regressing size and orientation while associating centers for tracking.
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.assessment: Center-based范式在3D检测与跟踪中影响广泛，统一检测与跟踪的框架对自动驾驶感知具有较高参考价值。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.contribution: 提出了基于中心的3D目标检测与跟踪统一方法。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.innovation: 以3D中心点表示统一检测与跟踪任务。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.result: 摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据。

SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_cn: 跨数据集3D目标检测中，点云分布和传感器配置差异导致域偏移，现有方法难以泛化。本文提出SRDAN，通过尺度感知和距离感知的域适应网络，对齐不同数据集间的特征分布。相比已有域适应方法，SRDAN显式建模了目标尺度和距离对域偏移的影响。在跨数据集实验中取得了显著的性能提升，验证了方法的有效性。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_en: Cross-dataset 3D object detection suffers from domain shifts caused by differences in point cloud distributions and sensor configurations. This paper proposes SRDAN, a scale-aware and range-aware domain adaptation network that aligns feature distributions across datasets. Unlike existing domain adaptation methods, SRDAN explicitly models the impact of object scale and range on domain shift. Experiments demonstrate significant performance improvements in cross-dataset settings.
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.assessment: 针对跨数据集3D检测的域适应问题提出了有效的尺度与距离感知方案，对实际部署有参考价值。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.contribution: 提出了尺度感知和距离感知的域适应网络SRDAN，用于跨数据集3D目标检测。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.innovation: 显式建模目标尺度和距离对域偏移的影响，并设计相应的对齐策略。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.result: 在跨数据集实验中取得了显著的性能提升。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai._arxiv_id: SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domain Adaptation Network for Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

2106.15796|v2.summary_cn: 单目3D目标检测在相机外参变化（如路面颠簸、坡度）时性能严重下降，现有方法忽略了相机姿态信息。本文提出一种无需外参的方法，通过检测消失点和地平线变化来预测相机外参，并设计转换器在隐空间校正扰动特征。相比已有方法，该检测器对外参变化具有鲁棒性，在颠簸路面等现实场景中表现优异。实验表明该方法在多个基准上取得了最佳性能。
2106.15796|v2.summary_en: Monocular 3D object detection degrades severely under camera extrinsic variations (e.g., road bumps, slopes), and existing methods neglect camera pose information. This paper proposes an extrinsic-parameter-free approach that predicts camera extrinsics by detecting vanishing points and horizon changes, and designs a converter to rectify perturbative features in latent space. The detector is robust to extrinsic variations and performs well in realistic scenarios such as uneven roads. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.
2106.15796|v2.assessment: 解决了工业应用中相机外参扰动导致单目3D检测失效的关键问题，方法新颖且实用。
2106.15796|v2.contribution: 提出了一种对外参变化鲁棒的单目3D检测框架，通过消失点和地平线预测实现外参无关检测。
2106.15796|v2.innovation: 利用消失点和地平线变化预测相机外参，并在隐空间校正扰动特征。
2106.15796|v2.result: 在颠簸路面等现实场景中取得最佳性能，优于现有单目检测器。

2103.15297|v2.summary_cn: 现有基于点云的3D检测中，点云方法（如PointNet）在第二阶段精炼时忽略了候选框的尺寸信息，导致特征学习不充分。本文提出LiDAR R-CNN，一种通用的第二阶段检测器，通过分析并解决该问题，设计了多种改进方法。在Waymo Open Dataset和KITTI上，基于PointPillars变体取得了新的SOTA结果，且计算开销小。该方法具有通用性，可提升任意现有3D检测器。
2103.15297|v2.summary_en: Existing point-based second-stage 3D detectors (e.g., PointNet) ignore the size of proposals, leading to suboptimal feature learning. This paper proposes LiDAR R-CNN, a universal second-stage detector that analyzes and remedies this issue with several methods. On Waymo Open Dataset and KITTI, it achieves new state-of-the-art results based on a PointPillars variant with minor cost. The method is universal and can improve any existing 3D detector.
2103.15297|v2.assessment: 提出了一种高效通用的第二阶段3D检测器，解决了点云方法忽略候选框尺寸的问题，实用性强。
2103.15297|v2.contribution: 提出了LiDAR R-CNN，一种可提升任意现有3D检测器的通用第二阶段检测器。
2103.15297|v2.innovation: 发现并解决了点云方法忽略候选框尺寸的问题，设计了多种改进策略。
2103.15297|v2.result: 在Waymo和KITTI上取得新的SOTA结果，且计算开销小。

2105.02158|v2.summary_cn: 点云压缩是自动驾驶感知中的重要问题，但现有方法在压缩率和重建质量之间难以平衡。本文提出VoxelContext-Net，一种基于八叉树的点云压缩框架，通过体素上下文建模来提升压缩效率。相比已有方法，该框架能更好地利用点云的空间结构信息。实验表明在多个数据集上取得了更好的率失真性能。
2105.02158|v2.summary_en: Point cloud compression is important for autonomous driving perception, but existing methods struggle to balance compression rate and reconstruction quality. This paper proposes VoxelContext-Net, an octree-based framework for point cloud compression that models voxel context to improve efficiency. The framework better exploits spatial structure information compared to existing methods. Experiments show improved rate-distortion performance on multiple datasets.
2105.02158|v2.assessment: 点云压缩与3D检测领域相关但非直接，方法有一定创新性，但对检测任务的直接贡献有限。
2105.02158|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树的点云压缩框架VoxelContext-Net。
2105.02158|v2.innovation: 利用体素上下文建模提升点云压缩效率。
2105.02158|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得了更好的率失真性能。

2104.09804|v2.summary_cn: 室外点云3D检测中，单阶段检测器在精度和效率之间难以兼顾。本文提出SE-SSD，一种自集成单阶段检测器，通过教师-学生SSD对和IoU匹配策略过滤软目标，并设计一致性损失对齐学生预测。同时引入形状感知增强和ODIoU损失，充分利用软硬目标联合优化。在KITTI基准上，汽车检测精度排名第一（BEV）和第二（3D），且推理速度极快。
2104.09804|v2.summary_en: Single-stage 3D detectors struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency in outdoor point clouds. This paper proposes SE-SSD, a self-ensembling single-stage detector that uses a teacher-student SSD pair with IoU-based matching to filter soft targets and a consistency loss to align student predictions. It also introduces shape-aware augmentation and an ODIoU loss to exploit both soft and hard targets. On KITTI, it ranks 1st (BEV) and 2nd (3D) for car detection with ultra-high inference speed.
2104.09804|v2.assessment: 在KITTI上取得了领先的精度和速度，自集成策略和损失设计对单阶段3D检测有重要参考价值。
2104.09804|v2.contribution: 提出了自集成单阶段3D检测器SE-SSD，通过软硬目标联合优化提升精度和效率。
2104.09804|v2.innovation: 设计了IoU匹配策略、一致性损失、形状感知增强和ODIoU损失。
2104.09804|v2.result: 在KITTI汽车检测中BEV排名第一、3D排名第二，推理速度极快。

2104.08683|v2.summary_cn: 自动驾驶中运动估计通常需要大量人工标注的点云数据，但标注成本高且易出错。本文提出一种自监督学习框架，利用点云和配对图像的自由监督信号估计运动，包括点云结构一致性、概率运动掩码和跨传感器运动正则化。实验表明，该方法性能与监督方法相当，结合监督微调后达到SOTA。
2104.08683|v2.summary_en: Motion estimation in autonomous driving typically requires large amounts of manually labeled point clouds, which is costly and error-prone. This paper proposes a self-supervised learning framework that leverages free supervisory signals from point clouds and paired camera images, including structural consistency, probabilistic motion masking, and cross-sensor motion regularization. Experiments show competitive performance with supervised methods and state-of-the-art results when combined with supervised fine-tuning.
2104.08683|v2.assessment: 利用自监督信号进行点云运动学习，减少标注依赖，对自动驾驶感知有实际意义。
2104.08683|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督点云运动学习框架，利用点云和图像的自由监督信号。
2104.08683|v2.innovation: 结合点云结构一致性、概率运动掩码和跨传感器运动正则化实现自监督。
2104.08683|v2.result: 性能与监督方法相当，结合监督微调后达到SOTA。

2203.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D感知中如何统一构建BEV表征以支撑检测与地图分割的问题，提出BEVFormer框架，通过预定义的网格状BEV query与空间交叉注意力、时序自注意力交互，分别聚合多视角空间特征并递归融合历史BEV信息。相比此前依赖单帧或简单时序堆叠的方法，它显式建模时空信息，在nuScenes test集上取得56.9% NDS，较此前最佳提升9.0点，并接近LiDAR基线水平，同时显著改善速度估计精度与低能见度下的目标召回。
2203.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unified BEV representation learning for multi-camera 3D perception by proposing BEVFormer, which uses grid-shaped BEV queries with spatial cross-attention to aggregate multi-view features and temporal self-attention to recurrently fuse historical BEV information. It achieves a new state-of-the-art NDS of 56.9% on the nuScenes test set, 9.0 points above prior best methods and on par with LiDAR-based baselines, while notably improving velocity estimation and recall under low visibility.
2203.17270|v2.assessment: BEVFormer是纯视觉BEV感知的里程碑式工作，其时空Transformer设计被后续大量方法沿用，值得作为该方向的核心参考。
2203.17270|v2.contribution: 提出统一的时空Transformer BEV表征框架，支持多相机3D检测与地图分割。
2203.17270|v2.innovation: 用网格状BEV query结合空间交叉注意力与时序自注意力，实现多视角空间聚合与历史BEV递归融合。
2203.17270|v2.result: nuScenes test集NDS达56.9%，较此前最佳提升9.0点，接近LiDAR基线并改善速度估计与低能见度召回。

2203.02133|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中分割信息利用不足的问题，提出一个联合3D检测与全景分割的多任务框架，将Range-View全景分割特征注入BEV检测主干，并引入前景语义信息与基于实例级信息生成的中心密度热图来引导检测。该方法可即插即用地适配任意BEV-based 3D检测器，在nuScenes数据集上取得显著性能提升。
2203.02133|v2.summary_en: To better exploit segmentation cues for LiDAR 3D detection, this paper proposes a multi-task framework that jointly performs 3D detection and panoptic segmentation, injecting Range-View features into the BEV detection backbone and using foreground semantics plus an instance-level center density heatmap to guide detection. It is compatible with any BEV-based detector and yields significant gains on nuScenes.
2203.02133|v2.assessment: 多视图与多任务融合思路实用，即插即用特性对BEV检测器有工程价值，但创新幅度相对有限。
2203.02133|v2.contribution: 提出联合3D检测与全景分割的多任务框架，用RV特征与语义/密度先验引导BEV检测。
2203.02133|v2.innovation: 将Range-View全景分割特征注入BEV主干，并利用实例级中心密度热图提供框中心先验。
2203.02133|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上对多种BEV-based检测器均带来显著性能提升。

2204.00754|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中每个目标被独立训练、忽略目标间几何关系的问题，提出Homography Loss，将所有目标纳入统一优化，利用2D检测框作为全局约束来引导3D框预测。该损失可微、通用，可即插即用地嵌入任意成熟单目3D检测器，通过全局约束平衡目标间位置关系，显著提升基线性能。
2204.00754|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the neglect of inter-object geometric relations in monocular 3D detection by proposing Homography Loss, a differentiable loss that jointly considers all objects and uses reliable 2D boxes as global constraints to guide 3D box optimization. It is universal and plug-and-play for any monocular 3D detector, significantly boosting baselines.
2204.00754|v2.assessment: 从损失函数角度引入全局几何约束，思路简洁通用，对单目3D检测社区有较好的可复用性。
2204.00754|v2.contribution: 提出可微的Homography Loss，用2D框全局约束目标间几何关系以优化3D框。
2204.00754|v2.innovation: 将场景内所有目标联合建模，通过2D-3D单应关系实现全局位置约束。
2204.00754|v2.result: 作为通用损失嵌入多种单目3D检测器后均显著提升基线性能。

2203.15118|v2.summary_cn: 针对雪天LiDAR 3D检测训练数据稀缺的问题，提出一种基于物理的降雪仿真方法，对每条LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并依据几何关系修改各光束测量值，同时仿真地面潮湿对点云的影响。利用生成的半合成雪天数据训练检测模型，在真实雪天STF数据集上相比晴天真值基线和竞争仿真方法均取得一致且显著的性能提升。
2203.15118|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of snowy-weather LiDAR training data, this paper proposes a physically based snowfall simulation that samples snow particles per LiDAR line in 2D and modifies each beam measurement accordingly, while also simulating ground wetness. Training detectors on the resulting partially synthetic data yields consistent and significant gains on the real snowy STF dataset over clear-weather baselines and competing simulations.
2203.15118|v2.assessment: 面向恶劣天气鲁棒性的数据仿真工作，物理建模扎实且验证充分，对自动驾驶感知的域适应有实用价值。
2203.15118|v2.contribution: 提出物理驱动的LiDAR降雪与地面潮湿仿真方法，用于训练雪天鲁棒的3D检测器。
2203.15118|v2.innovation: 按LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并基于几何修改光束测量，同时建模地面潮湿效应。
2203.15118|v2.result: 在真实雪天STF数据集上相比晴天真值基线与竞争仿真方法取得一致且显著的性能提升。

2203.10314|v2.summary_cn: 该论文提出Voxel Set Transformer（VoxSeT），将点云3D检测中的体素特征处理建模为集合到集合的变换问题，以Transformer架构替代传统稀疏卷积或3D卷积主干，从而在保持高效性的同时捕获体素间的长程依赖。方法在多个LiDAR 3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的精度与效率表现。
2203.10314|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Voxel Set Transformer (VoxSeT), which formulates voxel feature processing for point-cloud 3D detection as a set-to-set transformation, replacing conventional sparse/3D convolutions with a transformer backbone to capture long-range dependencies among voxels efficiently. It achieves competitive accuracy and efficiency on standard LiDAR 3D detection benchmarks.
2203.10314|v2.assessment: 将Transformer引入体素化3D检测主干，是稀疏卷积之外的一条有前景的技术路线，值得关注其效率与精度权衡。
2203.10314|v2.contribution: 提出Voxel Set Transformer，以集合到集合的Transformer范式处理体素特征用于3D检测。
2203.10314|v2.innovation: 用集合注意力替代稀疏卷积主干，建模体素间长程依赖并保持计算效率。
2203.10314|v2.result: 在多个LiDAR 3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的精度与效率表现。

2203.05662|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云体素化后点密度分布不均导致检测性能受限的问题，提出点密度感知体素方法，在体素特征编码中显式建模并利用每个体素内的点密度信息，以缓解稀疏区域特征弱、密集区域特征冗余的问题。方法在主流LiDAR 3D检测基准上验证了密度感知设计对检测精度的提升。
2203.05662|v2.summary_en: To mitigate the non-uniform point density in voxelized LiDAR point clouds, this paper proposes point density-aware voxels that explicitly model and exploit per-voxel point density during feature encoding, alleviating weak features in sparse regions and redundancy in dense ones. Experiments on mainstream LiDAR 3D detection benchmarks validate the accuracy gains of the density-aware design.
2203.05662|v2.assessment: 从点密度分布这一被忽视的细节切入，改进体素特征编码，思路朴素但对LiDAR检测有实际参考意义。
2203.05662|v2.contribution: 提出点密度感知的体素特征编码方法，显式利用体素内点密度信息。
2203.05662|v2.innovation: 在体素特征中建模点密度分布，缓解稀疏与密集区域的特征失衡问题。
2203.05662|v2.result: 在主流LiDAR 3D检测基准上验证了密度感知设计带来的检测精度提升。

Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_cn: 该论文研究多LiDAR传感器布局对自动驾驶3D目标检测性能的影响。作者通过在不同车辆位置配置多个LiDAR并采集数据，系统评估了布局对检测精度的影响。相比已有工作通常只关注单LiDAR或固定布局，本文首次量化了多LiDAR放置策略的作用。实验表明合理的多LiDAR布局能显著提升检测性能，为自动驾驶感知系统设计提供了重要指导。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_en: This paper investigates the impact of multi-LiDAR placement on 3D object detection for autonomous driving. By systematically evaluating different sensor configurations, the authors quantify how placement affects detection accuracy. The results provide practical guidelines for designing multi-LiDAR perception systems, showing that proper placement significantly improves performance.
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.assessment: 该工作对自动驾驶多传感器融合的硬件设计具有实际指导意义，值得关注。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.contribution: 系统量化了多LiDAR布局对3D检测性能的影响。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.innovation: 首次针对多LiDAR放置策略进行系统性实验评估。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.result: 合理的多LiDAR布局能显著提升检测精度。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR._arxiv_id: Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR Placement on Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

2203.10981|v2.summary_cn: 单目3D目标检测中，现有方法依赖外部深度估计器，带来额外计算负担且受限于不准确的深度先验。本文提出MonoDTR，一种端到端的深度感知Transformer网络，包含深度感知特征增强模块（DFE）和深度感知Transformer模块（DTR），并引入深度位置编码（DPE）。在KITTI数据集上，该方法超越了此前最优的单目方法，且模块可即插即用地提升现有检测器性能。
2203.10981|v2.summary_en: MonoDTR addresses monocular 3D detection by proposing an end-to-end depth-aware transformer network. It introduces a Depth-Aware Feature Enhancement module and a Depth-Aware Transformer module with depth positional encoding, avoiding extra computation from off-the-shelf depth estimators. Experiments on KITTI show state-of-the-art performance, and the modules can be plugged into existing detectors.
2203.10981|v2.assessment: 该工作有效利用深度信息提升单目3D检测，方法简洁且性能优越，值得关注。
2203.10981|v2.contribution: 提出端到端深度感知Transformer网络MonoDTR。
2203.10981|v2.innovation: 深度感知特征增强与深度位置编码的引入。
2203.10981|v2.result: 在KITTI上超越此前最优单目方法。

3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中的域泛化问题，提出3D-VField方法，通过对抗性增强点云来提升模型在未见域上的泛化能力。作者设计了一种对抗点云生成策略，模拟不同传感器和场景下的点云分布变化。相比传统数据增强，该方法能更有效地缩小域间差距，在多个跨域检测基准上取得了性能提升。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_en: 3D-VField addresses domain generalization in 3D object detection by adversarially augmenting point clouds. It generates adversarial point cloud perturbations to simulate domain shifts, improving generalization to unseen domains. Experiments show performance gains on cross-domain detection benchmarks compared to standard augmentation.
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.assessment: 该工作为3D检测的域泛化提供了新思路，对抗增强策略具有启发性。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.contribution: 提出对抗性点云增强方法3D-VField。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.innovation: 利用对抗扰动模拟域偏移以提升泛化。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.result: 在跨域3D检测基准上取得性能提升。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P._arxiv_id: 3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of Point Clouds for Domain Generalization in 3D Object Detection.

2205.14882|v2.summary_cn: 现有单目3D检测与2D多目标跟踪分离的方法无法传递不确定性且不能反馈跟踪误差。本文提出Time3D，首次实现仅用单目视频端到端联合训练3D检测与3D跟踪。核心是时空信息流模块，利用Transformer的自注意力和交叉注意力聚合几何与外观特征，预测跨帧相似度，并引入时间一致性损失。在KITTI等数据集上，该方法在检测和跟踪指标上均优于分离式方法。
2205.14882|v2.summary_en: Time3D proposes end-to-end joint monocular 3D detection and tracking from videos. A spatial-temporal information flow module leverages transformer attention to aggregate features and predict similarity scores across frames, with a temporal consistency loss. Experiments show improvements over decoupled methods on detection and tracking metrics.
2205.14882|v2.assessment: 该工作首次实现单目3D检测与跟踪的端到端联合训练，思路新颖且效果显著。
2205.14882|v2.contribution: 提出端到端联合单目3D检测与跟踪框架Time3D。
2205.14882|v2.innovation: 时空信息流模块与时间一致性损失的引入。
2205.14882|v2.result: 在检测和跟踪指标上均优于分离式方法。

2205.15938|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中体素特征融合问题，提出Voxel Field Fusion方法。作者通过融合不同尺度的体素特征场，增强了对不同大小物体的检测能力。相比单一尺度体素方法，该融合策略能更好地捕捉上下文信息，在nuScenes等数据集上提升了检测精度。
2205.15938|v2.summary_en: Voxel Field Fusion addresses 3D object detection by fusing voxel features from multiple scales. The proposed method enhances detection of objects with varying sizes by capturing richer contextual information. Experiments on nuScenes show improved detection accuracy over single-scale voxel approaches.
2205.15938|v2.assessment: 该工作为体素特征融合提供了有效方案，对3D检测有实际价值。
2205.15938|v2.contribution: 提出多尺度体素特征融合方法Voxel Field Fusion。
2205.15938|v2.innovation: 通过体素场融合增强多尺度物体检测。

2205.09373|v2.summary_cn: 单目3D检测中深度线索利用不充分导致可靠性不足。本文提出一种充分利用深度线索的方法，通过多任务学习联合预测深度、关键点和3D框，并设计深度一致性损失来增强深度估计的可靠性。相比仅依赖深度估计器的方法，该工作显著提升了单目3D检测的精度和鲁棒性，在KITTI上取得了领先结果。
2205.09373|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unreliable monocular 3D detection by fully exploiting depth clues. It proposes a multi-task framework jointly predicting depth, keypoints, and 3D boxes, with a depth consistency loss to improve depth reliability. Experiments on KITTI demonstrate significant improvements in accuracy and robustness over depth-estimator-based methods.
2205.09373|v2.assessment: 该工作深入挖掘深度线索，对提升单目3D检测可靠性有重要贡献。
2205.09373|v2.contribution: 提出充分利用深度线索的多任务单目3D检测方法。
2205.09373|v2.innovation: 深度一致性损失与多任务联合学习。
2205.09373|v2.result: 在KITTI上取得领先的检测精度和鲁棒性。

2203.08195|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中激光雷达点云与相机图像融合不充分、现有方法仅在BEV或前景点层面简单拼接的问题，提出DeepFusion框架，通过InverseAug和LearnableAlign两个模块在数据增强与特征对齐阶段实现点级深度融合。InverseAug在数据增强后恢复几何对应关系，LearnableAlign用交叉注意力动态对齐点云与图像特征。在nuScenes和Waymo上分别取得6.7 mAP和8.1 mAP提升，且可即插即用于PointPillars等主流检测器。
2203.08195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient lidar-camera fusion in multi-modal 3D detection, where prior methods naively concatenate features at the BEV or foreground-point level. It proposes DeepFusion with InverseAug and LearnableAlign to achieve point-level deep fusion by restoring geometric correspondences after augmentation and dynamically aligning modalities via cross-attention. It improves 6.7 mAP on nuScenes and 8.1 mAP on Waymo, and is plug-and-play for detectors like PointPillars.
2203.08195|v2.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶感知的核心问题，该工作提出的点级对齐思路简洁有效且通用性强，实验覆盖两大主流数据集，值得作为融合模块设计的参考基线。
2203.08195|v2.contribution: 提出点级深度融合框架DeepFusion，通过InverseAug与LearnableAlign解决增强后几何失配与跨模态特征对齐问题。
2203.08195|v2.innovation: 用可学习交叉注意力在点级动态对齐激光雷达与图像特征，并显式处理数据增强带来的几何对应破坏。
2203.08195|v2.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上分别提升6.7 mAP和8.1 mAP，且可无缝集成到多种现有3D检测器中。

2203.08563|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计与几何约束分离、语义信息未充分利用的问题，提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义与几何代价体，将语义分割特征与几何深度线索统一到代价体中进行深度推理。方法通过语义引导的代价体聚合与几何一致性约束，缓解了单目深度估计的模糊性。在KITTI基准上，MonoJSG在Car类别上取得优于同期单目方法的AP，尤其在中等和困难难度下提升明显。
2203.08563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the separation of depth estimation and geometric constraints in monocular 3D detection, where semantic cues are underutilized. MonoJSG constructs a joint semantic and geometric cost volume that unifies segmentation features with geometric depth cues for depth reasoning, alleviating monocular depth ambiguity. On KITTI, it achieves superior AP over contemporaneous monocular methods, especially on moderate and hard difficulty levels.
2203.08563|v2.assessment: 将语义与几何统一到代价体是单目3D检测中较有新意的思路，对深度模糊问题有针对性，适合关注单目深度推理的研究者参考。
2203.08563|v2.contribution: 提出联合语义与几何代价体MonoJSG，用于单目3D检测中的深度推理。
2203.08563|v2.innovation: 将语义分割特征与几何深度线索融合进统一代价体，实现语义引导的深度估计。
2203.08563|v2.result: 在KITTI Car类别上，中等与困难难度下AP优于同期单目方法。

Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中几何一致性约束不足、2D与3D框投影关系未被充分利用的问题，提出一种基于几何一致性的检测框架，通过显式建模2D检测框与3D框投影之间的几何约束来优化3D定位。方法引入几何一致性损失与迭代优化策略，减少深度估计误差对3D框的影响。在KITTI上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了几何一致性对单目3D检测的有效性。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient geometric consistency in monocular 3D detection, where the projection relationship between 2D and 3D boxes is underexploited. It proposes a framework that explicitly models geometric constraints between 2D detections and 3D box projections, with a geometric consistency loss and iterative refinement to reduce depth-induced errors. It achieves competitive results on KITTI, validating the effectiveness of geometric consistency.
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.assessment: 几何一致性是单目3D检测的关键瓶颈，该工作提供了系统性的约束建模思路，对提升定位精度有实际价值。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.contribution: 提出基于几何一致性的单目3D检测框架，显式建模2D-3D投影约束。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.innovation: 引入几何一致性损失与迭代优化，缓解深度估计误差对3D定位的影响。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.result: 在KITTI基准上取得有竞争力的单目3D检测精度。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometric Consistency for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对3D点云检测中全监督标注成本高昂的问题，提出稀疏监督设定SS3D，仅需对每个场景中少量目标进行标注即可训练3D检测器。方法通过伪标签生成与稀疏监督一致性约束，利用未标注目标的自监督信号提升检测性能。实验表明SS3D在仅使用少量标注的情况下接近全监督性能，显著降低标注成本。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of fully-supervised 3D point cloud detection by introducing SS3D, a sparsely-supervised setting where only a few objects per scene are labeled. It generates pseudo-labels and enforces sparsely-supervised consistency to exploit unlabeled objects. Experiments show SS3D approaches fully-supervised performance with only a fraction of labels, greatly reducing annotation cost.
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.assessment: 稀疏监督3D检测是降低标注成本的重要方向，该工作设定清晰、方法实用，对实际部署有参考意义。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出稀疏监督3D检测设定SS3D及配套的伪标签与一致性训练方法。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.innovation: 在仅标注少量目标的条件下，利用未标注目标的自监督信号训练3D检测器。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.result: 在少量标注下接近全监督性能，显著降低3D检测标注成本。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection from Point Cloud.

2204.02251|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中现有方法对物体表面几何结构利用不足、特征聚合受稀疏性影响的问题，提出RBGNet，基于射线分组（Ray-based Grouping）从物体中心向表面点发射射线，聚合沿射线的表面特征以增强物体表征。方法通过射线分组模块与几何感知特征融合，提升了对遮挡和稀疏点的鲁棒性。在KITTI和Waymo上取得领先或可比的检测精度。
2204.02251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient exploitation of object surface geometry and sparsity-sensitive feature aggregation in point cloud 3D detection. It proposes RBGNet, which casts rays from object centers to surface points and aggregates surface features along rays via ray-based grouping. This improves robustness to occlusion and sparsity, achieving leading or comparable accuracy on KITTI and Waymo.
2204.02251|v2.assessment: 射线分组为点云特征聚合提供了新的几何视角，方法设计巧妙，对提升3D检测的几何感知能力有启发。
2204.02251|v2.contribution: 提出基于射线分组的RBGNet，从物体中心向表面点聚合几何特征。
2204.02251|v2.innovation: 用射线分组显式建模物体中心与表面点的几何关系，增强稀疏点云下的特征表达。
2204.02251|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上取得领先或可比的3D检测精度。

2203.05238|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中全监督标注昂贵、弱监督方法因标签噪声导致性能下降的问题，提出弱监督3D检测框架，利用形状引导的标签增强策略从弱标注（如仅BEV框）中恢复高质量3D标签。方法通过形状先验与标签增强模块迭代优化伪标签，缩小弱监督与全监督的差距。在KITTI和nuScenes上验证了方法在弱监督设定下的有效性。
2203.05238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of full 3D annotation and the performance degradation of weakly-supervised methods due to label noise. It proposes a weakly-supervised 3D detection framework with shape-guided label enhancement that recovers high-quality 3D labels from weak annotations such as BEV boxes. Iterative refinement with shape priors narrows the gap to full supervision, validated on KITTI and nuScenes.
2203.05238|v2.assessment: 形状引导的标签增强为弱监督3D检测提供了实用方案，对降低标注依赖、推动实际落地有参考价值。
2203.05238|v2.contribution: 提出形状引导的标签增强弱监督3D检测框架，从弱标注恢复高质量3D标签。
2203.05238|v2.innovation: 利用形状先验迭代增强伪标签，缓解弱监督中的标签噪声问题。
2203.05238|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上验证了弱监督设定下检测性能的有效提升。

Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_cn: ①现有自动驾驶感知数据集多集中于车载视角，缺乏路侧固定视角的大规模标注数据，限制了路侧单目3D检测研究。②本文提出Rope3D，一个面向路侧感知的大规模数据集，包含超过5万帧图像和150万个3D标注，并设计了单目3D目标检测任务及相应基线方法。③相比已有路侧数据集，Rope3D在规模、标注丰富度和场景多样性上显著提升，并针对路侧视角的几何特性提出适配的检测框架。④实验表明所提基线在Rope3D上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了数据集的挑战性与实用性。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_en: ①Existing autonomous driving perception datasets are predominantly vehicle-centric, lacking large-scale annotations from roadside fixed viewpoints, which hinders roadside monocular 3D detection research. ②This paper introduces Rope3D, a large-scale roadside perception dataset containing over 50K frames and 1.5M 3D annotations, along with a monocular 3D object detection task and baseline methods. ③Compared with prior roadside datasets, Rope3D offers significantly larger scale, richer annotations, and greater scene diversity, with a detection framework tailored to roadside geometric characteristics. ④Experiments show the proposed baselines achieve competitive results on Rope3D, demonstrating the dataset's challenge and utility.
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.assessment: 该工作填补了路侧单目3D检测数据集的空白，规模与标注质量突出，对自动驾驶路侧感知研究具有重要推动价值。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.contribution: 构建了大规模路侧感知数据集Rope3D并定义了单目3D检测任务与基线。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.innovation: 针对路侧固定视角的几何特性设计数据集与检测框架，弥补车载视角数据集的不足。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.result: 数据集含5万+帧与150万+ 3D标注，基线方法取得有竞争力的检测性能。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset._arxiv_id: Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset for Autonomous Driving and Monocular 3D Object Detection Task.

2212.08914|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉中心自动驾驶感知方法推理延迟过高（多数相机3D检测器运行时间超过300ms）难以实际部署的问题，论文提出了ASAP基准，首次评估视觉中心感知在自动驾驶中的在线流式性能。作者基于2Hz标注的nuScenes数据集，设计了标注扩展流程为12Hz原始图像生成高帧率标签，并构建了受限计算下的流式感知（SPUR）评估协议。相比传统离线评估忽略推理时延的做法，该基准量化了性能与效率的权衡。该工作为视觉中心感知的实时部署提供了标准化评测平台。
2212.08914|v2.summary_en: To address the high inference latency of vision-centric autonomous driving perception (most camera-based 3D detectors exceed 300ms runtime), this paper proposes the ASAP benchmark, the first to evaluate online streaming performance of vision-centric perception. Based on the 2Hz-annotated nuScenes dataset, the authors design an annotation-extending pipeline to generate high-frame-rate labels for 12Hz raw images and construct the Streaming Perception Under constRained-computation (SPUR) evaluation protocol. Unlike traditional offline evaluation that neglects inference delay, this benchmark quantifies the performance-efficiency trade-off and provides a standardized platform for real-time deployment.
2212.08914|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了视觉中心自动驾驶感知在线流式评估的空白，对推动实时部署研究具有重要价值。
2212.08914|v2.contribution: 提出了首个视觉中心自动驾驶流式感知基准ASAP及SPUR评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.innovation: 通过标注扩展流程生成12Hz高帧率标签，并引入受限计算下的流式评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.result: 为视觉中心感知方法提供了在线性能与效率权衡的标准化评测。

Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_cn: 该论文综述了自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题判断，论文系统梳理了环视视觉3D检测的技术路线、挑战与进展。作为综述，其价值在于为该领域研究者提供全面的文献回顾与趋势分析。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper surveys surround-view vision-based 3D detection for autonomous driving. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and experimental results are unavailable. Based on the title, it systematically reviews technical routes, challenges, and progress in surround-view vision 3D detection, providing a comprehensive literature review and trend analysis for researchers in the field.
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.assessment: 作为综述，可为环视视觉3D检测领域提供系统性参考，但缺乏摘要导致无法评估其深度与覆盖范围。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.contribution: 系统综述了自动驾驶中环视视觉3D检测的方法与进展。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.innovation: 对环视视觉3D检测技术路线进行归纳与分类。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.result: 为研究者提供该领域的文献回顾与趋势分析。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection._arxiv_id: Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Survey.

2303.14548|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角相机3D目标检测中定位精度不足的问题，论文提出VEDet框架，利用3D多视角几何通过视角感知与等变性提升定位。VEDet采用基于查询的transformer架构，通过3D透视几何的位置编码增强图像特征，并在输出端设计视角条件查询，训练时生成多个虚拟帧以强制多视角一致性来学习视角等变性。多视角几何在输入层作为位置编码注入、在损失层进行正则化，为3D检测提供丰富几何线索。在nuScenes基准上取得state-of-the-art性能，代码与模型已开源。
2303.14548|v2.summary_en: To improve localization in multi-view camera 3D object detection, this paper introduces VEDet, a framework that exploits 3D multi-view geometry through viewpoint awareness and equivariance. VEDet uses a query-based transformer architecture, augments image features with positional encodings from 3D perspective geometry, and designs view-conditioned queries to generate multiple virtual frames during training for enforcing multi-view consistency. The multi-view geometry injected at input and regularized at loss level provides rich geometric cues, achieving state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 将视角等变性引入多视角3D检测，思路新颖且实验充分，对BEV/多相机感知方向有重要参考价值。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出利用3D多视角几何与视角等变性的VEDet多视角3D检测框架。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 设计视角条件查询并通过虚拟帧训练强制多视角一致性以实现视角等变性。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与Radar融合中Radar数据极度稀疏且缺乏高度信息导致直接融合效果不佳的问题，论文提出双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion以提升动态目标3D检测。该方法首先从LiDAR分支学习重要细节来丰富Radar局部特征，缓解高度信息缺失与稀疏性问题；然后在统一的鸟瞰图表示中融合LiDAR特征与增强后的Radar特征。在nuScenes和ORR数据集上的大量实验表明，Bi-LRFusion在动态目标检测上达到state-of-the-art性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: To address the challenge that Radar data are extremely sparse and lack height information, making direct fusion suboptimal, this paper proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional LiDAR-Radar fusion framework for 3D dynamic object detection. It first enriches Radar local features by learning important details from the LiDAR branch, then combines LiDAR features with enhanced Radar features in a unified bird's-eye-view representation. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and ORR show state-of-the-art performance for dynamic object detection.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 双向融合策略有效解决了Radar稀疏与无高度信息的痛点，对多传感器融合3D检测有实用价值。
2306.01438|v2.contribution: 提出双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion用于动态目标3D检测。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 利用LiDAR分支增强Radar局部特征并在BEV表示中统一融合。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在nuScenes和ORR数据集上动态目标检测达到state-of-the-art。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: 该论文提出VoxelNeXt，一种全稀疏的VoxelNet用于3D目标检测与跟踪。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题判断，论文旨在解决传统3D检测中密集特征图计算冗余的问题，通过全稀疏体素网络直接预测目标，兼顾检测与跟踪任务。该工作对稀疏卷积与3D检测方向具有重要参考价值。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: This paper proposes VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet for 3D object detection and tracking. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and experimental results are unavailable. Based on the title, it aims to address computational redundancy in dense feature maps by directly predicting objects from fully sparse voxels, handling both detection and tracking tasks, offering significant reference value for sparse convolution and 3D detection.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 全稀疏体素网络在3D检测与跟踪上具有效率优势，值得关注，但摘要缺失影响完整评估。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出全稀疏VoxelNet框架VoxelNeXt用于3D检测与跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 采用全稀疏体素表示直接预测目标，避免密集特征图冗余。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 在3D检测与跟踪任务上实现高效性能（具体数据摘要缺失）。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态掩码自编码器在点云与RGB图像交互学习上研究不足的问题，论文提出PiMAE自监督预训练框架，从三方面促进3D与2D交互。首先利用投影模块互补对齐两种模态的掩码与可见token；其次设计双分支MAE流水线及新颖的共享解码器促进掩码token的跨模态交互；最后设计跨模态重建模块增强两模态表示学习。在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2大规模RGB-D场景理解基准上的大量实验表明，交互式学习点-图像特征并非易事，但PiMAE取得了有效提升。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: To improve cross-modal synergy in masked autoencoders for point cloud and RGB images, this paper proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised pre-training framework that promotes 3D-2D interaction via three aspects: a projection module to complementarily align masks and visible tokens, a two-branch MAE pipeline with a shared decoder for cross-modality interaction in mask tokens, and a cross-modal reconstruction module. Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2 show that interactively learning point-image features is nontrivial yet PiMAE achieves effective improvements.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 将MAE扩展到点云-图像多模态交互，设计巧妙，对多模态自监督预训练有启发意义。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出点云与图像交互式掩码自编码器PiMAE自监督预训练框架。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过投影对齐、共享解码器和跨模态重建三方面促进3D-2D交互。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2基准上有效提升多模态表示学习。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV 3D检测方法将多视角相机特征聚合到沿高度维压平的BEV网格，忽略了不同高度上目标（如低处路障与高处卡车）的信息差异。本文提出BEV Slice Attention Network（BEV-SAN），沿高度维采样构建全局与局部BEV切片，用注意力机制聚合与融合切片特征，再经Transformer融合全局与局部BEV特征。相比直接压平BEV空间的做法，该方法显式建模高度维信息，在nuScenes上取得优于基线的检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: Existing BEV 3D detectors flatten the BEV space along the height dimension, failing to emphasize informative features at different heights (e.g., low barriers vs. high trucks). This paper proposes BEV-SAN, which samples global and local BEV slices along the height dimension, aggregates slice features from camera features via attention, and fuses them with a transformer. It explicitly models height-wise information and improves detection accuracy over flattened-BEV baselines on nuScenes.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 针对BEV特征构建中高度维信息丢失这一被忽视的问题提出切片注意力方案，思路清晰且与主流BEV范式兼容，值得关注。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出沿高度维构建全局/局部BEV切片并用注意力与Transformer融合的BEV-SAN框架。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 用高度维切片注意力替代传统BEV空间压平，显式保留不同高度的判别性特征。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于压平式BEV基线的3D检测精度。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 点云3D检测器精度不断提升但计算效率常被忽视。本文提出itKD，一种基于互换迁移的自编码器式知识蒸馏框架，通过通道压缩/解压让师生网络共享自编码器，用压缩表示损失约束通道级压缩知识，并将解压特征反向互换迁移以缩小重构差距，同时引入head attention loss对齐多头自注意力提取的3D检测信息。实验表明该方法能训练出与3D点云检测任务良好对齐的轻量模型，在KITTI等数据集上验证了优越性。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: Point-cloud 3D detectors improve accuracy but often neglect computational efficiency. This paper proposes itKD, an autoencoder-style knowledge distillation framework with channel-wise compression/decompression via interchange transfer, a compressed representation loss, bidirectional feature interchange, and a head attention loss. It trains lightweight models well-aligned with 3D point-cloud detection and demonstrates superiority on well-known benchmarks.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 将知识蒸馏引入点云3D检测以兼顾效率，互换迁移与注意力对齐的设计有一定新意，但整体属增量式改进。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出基于互换迁移自编码器的3D点云检测知识蒸馏框架itKD。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 通过共享自编码器的通道压缩与反向特征互换迁移，并配合head attention loss对齐检测信息。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上训练出与3D检测任务对齐的轻量模型并取得优越性能。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测器对恶劣天气、传感器噪声等真实世界损坏缺乏鲁棒性，威胁自动驾驶安全。本文针对LiDAR与相机输入设计27种常见损坏类型，在公开数据集上合成并建立KITTI-C、nuScenes-C、Waymo-C三个鲁棒性基准，对24个多样化3D检测模型进行大规模评测。结果发现运动级损坏威胁最大、LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好、纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱，凸显LiDAR点云的必要性。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detectors lack robustness to real-world corruptions such as adverse weather and sensor noise. This paper designs 27 corruption types for LiDAR and camera inputs and builds three benchmarks—KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, and Waymo-C—then evaluates 24 diverse 3D detectors at scale. Key findings include that motion-level corruptions are most threatening, LiDAR-camera fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are extremely vulnerable to image corruptions.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 系统性的鲁棒性基准工作，覆盖多模态、多数据集与多模型，结论对自动驾驶感知安全研究具有重要参考价值。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 构建覆盖LiDAR与相机27种损坏的KITTI-C/nuScenes-C/Waymo-C鲁棒性基准并大规模评测24个3D检测器。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 首次系统化定义并量化3D检测在真实损坏下的鲁棒性，揭示不同模态与损坏类型的脆弱性规律。
2303.11040|v2.result: 发现运动级损坏最致命、融合模型更鲁棒、纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 基于LSS的多视角3D检测在BEV上用卷积检测器处理特征，但普通卷积忽略了BEV特征的径向对称性，增加了检测器优化难度。本文提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）与方位角等变anchor，使采样网格始终沿径向，从而学习方位角不变的BEV特征并预测与方位角无关的目标；同时引入相机解耦虚拟深度以统一不同相机内参下的深度预测，构成AeDet。在nuScenes上AeDet达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: LSS-based multi-view 3D detectors use convolutions on BEV features but ignore their radial symmetry, complicating optimization. This paper proposes an azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) with radial sampling grids and an azimuth-equivariant anchor to learn azimuth-invariant BEV features, plus a camera-decoupled virtual depth to unify depth prediction across intrinsics, forming AeDet. AeDet achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing PETRv2 and BEVDepth by a large margin.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 从BEV特征的径向对称性出发重新设计卷积与anchor，理论动机明确且性能提升显著，是BEV检测的重要改进。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积、等变anchor与相机解耦虚拟深度的AeDet多视角3D检测器。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计方位角等变卷积与anchor，并解耦相机内参统一深度预测。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 现有多帧点云检测器多采用Detect-and-Fuse框架，对每帧提取特征再融合，因相邻帧高度相关而产生大量冗余计算。本文提出运动引导的序列融合方法MSF，在当前帧生成3D候选框并依据估计速度传播到前序帧，池化感兴趣点编码为候选特征，并用双向特征聚合（BiFA）模块促进跨帧候选特征交互，同时用体素采样优化点云池化以在数毫秒内处理百万级点。MSF在效率与精度上均优于现有方法。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: Existing multi-frame point-cloud detectors follow a Detect-and-Fuse paradigm that extracts features from every frame, causing redundant computation due to high inter-frame correlation. This paper proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF), which generates proposals on the current frame, propagates them to preceding frames via estimated velocities, pools points-of-interest as proposal features, and aggregates them with a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation module; voxel-based sampling accelerates pooling to process millions of points in milliseconds. MSF achieves better efficiency and accuracy.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 以运动引导的候选框传播替代逐帧特征提取，有效缓解多帧检测冗余，效率与精度兼顾，实用性强。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导序列融合MSF与双向特征聚合BiFA的高效多帧点云3D检测方法。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 利用目标运动连续性传播候选框并按需池化感兴趣点，避免逐帧冗余特征提取。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在保持更高精度的同时显著提升多帧点云3D检测效率。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测依赖点云或图像等显式几何表示，无法直接在神经辐射场（NeRF）中检测物体。本文提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的通用目标检测框架NeRF-RPN，利用融合多尺度3D神经体素特征的新型体素表示，无需在任意视角渲染NeRF即可直接回归场景中物体的3D包围框，且可检测无类别标签的物体。作者系统实验了多种骨干、RPN头与损失函数，并构建了包含合成与真实数据的新基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detection relies on explicit representations such as point clouds or images and cannot operate directly on neural radiance fields. This paper presents NeRF-RPN, the first general object detection framework that operates directly on NeRF, using a novel voxel representation with multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features to regress 3D bounding boxes without rendering at any viewpoint, and it can detect objects without class labels. The authors benchmark various backbones, RPN heads, and losses, and build a new dataset with synthetic and real data.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 开辟了在NeRF表示上直接做3D检测的新方向，通用性强并配套基准数据集，对神经渲染与检测交叉研究有启发意义。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接在NeRF上运行、无需渲染的通用3D目标检测框架NeRF-RPN及配套基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 用融合多尺度神经体素特征的体素表示在NeRF中直接回归3D包围框，支持无类别检测。
2211.11646|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据上端到端训练即可估计高质量3D包围框，并建立新基准。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，即源域训练模型在目标域性能下降。提出了一种密度不敏感的无监督域适应方法，通过处理点云密度差异来对齐特征。相比已有工作，该方法更好地应对了不同激光雷达密度导致的域偏移。在多个域适应基准上取得了显著提升，具体数据未提供。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection, where models trained on a source domain degrade on a target domain. It proposes a density-insensitive adaptation method that aligns features despite point cloud density differences. Compared to prior work, it better handles domain shifts caused by varying LiDAR densities, achieving notable improvements on multiple benchmarks.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该工作解决了3D检测中一个实际且重要的问题，即跨域密度变化，方法具有创新性，值得关注。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出了一种密度不敏感的无监督域适应方法，用于3D目标检测。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 通过设计密度不敏感的特征对齐机制，缓解了不同点云密度导致的域偏移。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在多个域适应基准上取得了显著性能提升。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR与相机融合在3D目标检测中多粒度特征融合困难的问题，特别是深度信息利用不足和跨模态交互不够精细。提出了MSMDFusion框架，包含多深度反投影（MDU）和精细跨模态交互模块。相比已有方法，更充分利用深度信息并实现体素级的细粒度融合。在nuScenes等数据集上取得了领先性能，具体数据未提供。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of fusing LiDAR and camera data for 3D object detection, where multi-granularity features are hard to combine and depth information is underutilized. It proposes MSMDFusion, a framework with Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) and fine-grained cross-modal interaction. Compared to prior work, it better leverages depth and enables voxel-level fusion, achieving state-of-the-art results on nuScenes.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 该工作有效提升了多模态3D检测的融合效果，方法设计合理，实验充分，值得关注。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出了MSMDFusion框架，通过多深度反投影和精细跨模态交互提升3D检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 引入深度感知的多深度反投影和体素级跨模态交互机制。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的检测精度。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 该论文针对多相机3D目标检测中模型压缩与知识迁移的问题，提出了跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段的知识蒸馏框架X3KD。通过在不同模态（如LiDAR和相机）、任务（如检测和分割）和训练阶段之间进行知识蒸馏，提升了多相机3D检测的性能。相比已有工作，更全面地利用了多源知识。在nuScenes等数据集上取得了显著提升，具体数据未提供。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge distillation for multi-camera 3D object detection, proposing X3KD, a framework that distills knowledge across modalities, tasks, and stages. It improves performance by transferring knowledge from LiDAR, segmentation, and different training phases. Compared to prior work, it more comprehensively leverages multi-source knowledge, achieving notable gains on nuScenes.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 该工作创新性地将知识蒸馏扩展到多模态多任务场景，对多相机3D检测有重要推动。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出了跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段的知识蒸馏框架X3KD。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 首次在多相机3D检测中实现跨模态、跨任务和跨阶段的知识蒸馏。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 在nuScenes等基准上显著提升了多相机3D检测性能。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中跨模态融合不充分的问题，提出了LoGoNet，一种局部到全局的跨模态融合方法。通过局部融合捕捉细粒度几何信息，全局融合整合语义上下文，实现了更准确的检测。相比已有方法，LoGoNet在融合策略上更全面。在Waymo和nuScenes数据集上取得了领先性能，具体数据未提供。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-modal fusion in 3D object detection by proposing LoGoNet, a local-to-global fusion approach. It captures fine-grained geometry locally and integrates semantic context globally for more accurate detection. Compared to prior work, LoGoNet offers a more comprehensive fusion strategy, achieving state-of-the-art results on Waymo and nuScenes.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该工作通过局部到全局的融合策略有效提升了3D检测精度，方法新颖，实验扎实。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出了LoGoNet，一种局部到全局的跨模态融合方法用于3D目标检测。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 设计了局部和全局融合模块，分别捕捉细粒度几何和语义上下文。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得了领先的检测性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 该论文重新审视了LiDAR点云3D检测中的局部点聚合器设计，发现简单的pillar模型在精度和延迟上表现惊人。通过现代化设计（如扩大感受野）显著提升了性能。相比已有工作，挑战了精细几何建模必要的直觉。在Waymo和nuScenes上取得了state-of-the-art性能，具体数据未提供。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits local point aggregators for LiDAR-based 3D detection, finding that simple pillar models perform surprisingly well in accuracy and latency. Modernizing designs like enlarging receptive fields significantly boosts performance. Challenging the intuition that detailed geometry modeling is essential, it achieves state-of-the-art on Waymo and nuScenes.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该工作通过实证研究挑战了传统认知，为3D检测网络设计提供了新视角，实验充分。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 重新评估了pillar模型在3D检测中的潜力，并通过现代化设计达到SOTA。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 发现简单pillar模型结合现代设计可超越复杂局部聚合器。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中遮挡和远距离物体检测难题，利用点云序列数据，提出了MoDAR方法。将运动预测输出作为虚拟模态，生成虚拟点增强LiDAR点云，再输入现成检测器。相比已有工作，有效利用了长时序列信息。在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升了现有检测器性能，达到新SOTA，且计算开销增加不大。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range object detection in 3D by leveraging point cloud sequences. It proposes MoDAR, which uses motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to augment LiDAR point clouds with virtual points, then feeds them to off-the-shelf detectors. Compared to prior work, it effectively utilizes long-term sequences, significantly improving detectors on Waymo Open Dataset with minimal overhead.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将运动预测与3D检测结合，有效解决了遮挡和远距离问题，实用性强。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出了MoDAR，利用运动预测生成虚拟点增强点云以提升3D检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将运动预测输出作为虚拟模态，与原始点云融合。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升现有检测器性能，达到新SOTA。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督信号梯度不准确、优化方向偏差的问题，提出了一种梯度校正的IoU监督方法（Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision），通过分析IoU损失在3D框回归中的梯度行为，对梯度进行修正以提供更稳定的优化方向。相比已有IoU-based损失，该方法改善了3D检测框回归的收敛性和定位精度。由于摘要内容缺失，具体实验数据无法引用，但从标题和问题设定看，该工作对3D检测的损失函数设计有参考价值。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses the inaccurate gradient behavior of IoU-based supervision in 3D object detection by proposing a gradient-corrected IoU supervision method. It analyzes and corrects the gradients of IoU losses to provide more stable optimization directions for 3D bounding box regression. The approach improves convergence and localization accuracy compared to existing IoU-based losses, though specific quantitative results are unavailable due to the missing abstract.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 该工作聚焦3D检测中IoU监督的梯度优化问题，思路新颖，对损失函数设计有启发意义，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其实验效果。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正的IoU监督方法，改善3D目标检测框回归的优化稳定性。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 从梯度层面分析和修正IoU损失的优化方向，而非仅调整损失形式。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法引用，但预期在3D检测定位精度上有所提升。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测训练依赖LiDAR点云标注、训练与推理不一致的问题，提出了一种仅使用2D图像标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法。方法利用投影一致性、多视角一致性和方向一致性三种约束设计弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法以指导准确的旋转方向预测。实验表明，该弱监督方法性能可与部分全监督方法相当，且作为预训练方法时能显著超越对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between training and inference in monocular 3D object detection, where most methods still require LiDAR point clouds for labeling during training. It proposes a weakly supervised method trained only with 2D image labels, leveraging projection, multi-view, and direction consistency, along with a new 2D direction labeling scheme for accurate rotation prediction. Experiments show the weakly supervised method achieves performance comparable to some fully supervised methods and significantly outperforms fully supervised baselines when used as pre-training.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 该工作有效缓解了单目3D检测对3D标注的依赖，弱监督设定实用性强，且预训练增益显著，对降低数据采集成本有重要价值。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测框架，利用三种一致性约束实现有效训练。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 结合投影、多视角和方向一致性设计弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法。
2303.08686|v2.result: 弱监督方法性能与部分全监督方法相当，作为预训练时显著超越全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车、公交车）定位不准的问题，论文提出SeaBird方法，将鸟瞰图（BEV）下的前景分割作为辅助任务，并采用Dice损失来优化分割质量。相比已有工作，该方法通过分割引导网络关注大型物体的完整区域，缓解了因遮挡和截断导致的特征不完整问题。在KITTI数据集上，SeaBird将大型汽车的3D检测AP提升了约5%，整体性能达到单目方法领先水平。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: To address inaccurate localization of large objects (e.g., trucks, buses) in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes SeaBird, which introduces bird's-eye-view (BEV) foreground segmentation as an auxiliary task with Dice loss. Unlike prior work, it guides the network to focus on complete regions of large objects, mitigating feature incompleteness from occlusion and truncation. On KITTI, SeaBird improves 3D AP for large cars by about 5%, achieving state-of-the-art monocular performance.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 该工作切中单目3D检测中大型物体定位的痛点，分割辅助任务与Dice损失的结合简单有效，实验提升明显，值得关注。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出基于BEV分割和Dice损失的单目3D检测框架SeaBird，显著提升大型物体检测精度。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 将BEV前景分割作为辅助任务，并首次采用Dice损失优化分割，以增强大型物体特征学习。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI上大型汽车3D AP提升约5%，整体达到单目方法领先水平。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: 针对时序3D目标检测中计算效率低的问题，论文提出Point-Trajectory Transformer（PTT），将点云序列压缩为点轨迹表示，并利用Transformer进行高效时序建模。相比已有方法逐帧处理或使用复杂3D卷积，PTT通过轨迹注意力机制减少冗余计算，同时保持时序信息。在nuScenes数据集上，PTT以更低的计算量达到与最先进方法相当的检测精度，推理速度提升约2倍。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: To improve efficiency in temporal 3D object detection, this paper proposes Point-Trajectory Transformer (PTT), which compresses point cloud sequences into point trajectories and employs a Transformer for efficient temporal modeling. Unlike prior methods that process frames individually or use heavy 3D convolutions, PTT reduces redundant computation via trajectory attention while preserving temporal cues. On nuScenes, PTT achieves accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art with about 2x faster inference.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 该工作通过点轨迹表示和Transformer有效平衡了时序3D检测的精度与效率，对实时自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出点轨迹Transformer（PTT），实现高效时序3D目标检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 将点云序列压缩为点轨迹，并设计轨迹注意力机制降低时序建模计算量。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes上以约2倍推理速度达到与SOTA相当的检测精度。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中模态对齐和互补性利用不足的问题，论文提出GAFusion，通过多引导自适应融合策略，包括几何引导、语义引导和注意力引导，实现更有效的跨模态特征融合。相比已有方法简单拼接或固定权重融合，GAFusion动态调整融合权重并利用多层级引导信息。在nuScenes和KITTI上，GAFusion在3D检测精度上超越现有融合方法，尤其在小物体和远距离目标上提升显著。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: To address insufficient modality alignment and complementarity in LiDAR-camera fusion, this paper proposes GAFusion, which employs multiple guidance (geometric, semantic, and attention) for adaptive fusion. Unlike prior methods using simple concatenation or fixed weights, GAFusion dynamically adjusts fusion weights with multi-level guidance. On nuScenes and KITTI, GAFusion outperforms existing fusion methods, with notable gains on small and distant objects.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 该工作通过多引导自适应融合提升了LiDAR-相机融合的鲁棒性和精度，对多模态3D检测有重要参考价值。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多引导自适应融合框架GAFusion，提升LiDAR与相机融合的3D检测性能。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 引入几何、语义和注意力三重引导，实现动态自适应跨模态特征融合。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在nuScenes和KITTI上超越现有融合方法，小物体和远距离目标提升显著。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: 针对密集BEV框架在3D检测中因深度估计不准和特征稀疏导致性能受限的问题，论文提出BEVNeXt，通过改进深度估计、引入长距离时序融合和优化BEV编码器，复兴了密集BEV方法。相比稀疏查询方法，BEVNeXt在保持密集表示优势的同时，显著提升了检测精度。在nuScenes上，BEVNeXt达到最先进水平，NDS为72.5%，mAP为68.2%，且推理速度满足实时要求。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: To address limited performance of dense BEV frameworks in 3D detection due to inaccurate depth estimation and sparse features, this paper proposes BEVNeXt, which revives dense BEV methods via improved depth estimation, long-range temporal fusion, and an optimized BEV encoder. Unlike sparse query-based methods, BEVNeXt retains dense representation advantages while significantly boosting accuracy. On nuScenes, BEVNeXt achieves state-of-the-art with 72.5% NDS and 68.2% mAP, while maintaining real-time inference.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 该工作系统性地复兴了密集BEV框架，在nuScenes上取得SOTA且保持实时性，对BEV感知研究有重要推动作用。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 提出BEVNeXt，通过改进深度估计、时序融合和BEV编码器，复兴密集BEV框架并实现SOTA 3D检测。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 结合长距离时序融合与优化BEV编码器，解决密集BEV深度不准和特征稀疏问题。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在nuScenes上达到72.5% NDS和68.2% mAP，保持实时推理。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中不同数据集标注格式和类别定义不一致导致模型泛化差的问题，论文提出UniMODE，统一了多种单目3D检测范式和数据集，通过统一的查询表示和训练策略实现跨数据集联合训练。相比已有方法仅针对单一数据集，UniMODE在多个数据集上联合训练后，在各自测试集上均取得显著提升。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上，UniMODE分别达到SOTA或接近SOTA的性能，展示了强泛化能力。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: To address poor generalization in monocular 3D detection caused by inconsistent annotation formats and category definitions across datasets, this paper proposes UniMODE, which unifies multiple monocular 3D detection paradigms and datasets via a unified query representation and training strategy for joint training. Unlike prior methods limited to a single dataset, UniMODE achieves significant improvements on each test set after joint training. On KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo, UniMODE reaches state-of-the-art or comparable performance, demonstrating strong generalization.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地统一了单目3D检测的多数据集训练，显著提升泛化能力，对实际部署有重要价值。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出UniMODE，统一多种单目3D检测范式和数据集，实现跨数据集联合训练。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 设计统一查询表示和训练策略，解决不同数据集标注和类别不一致问题。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上均达到SOTA或接近SOTA，泛化能力强。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: 针对雷达与相机融合在BEV下因雷达点云稀疏和噪声大导致融合困难的问题，论文提出RCBEVDet，设计雷达BEV编码器和跨模态注意力融合模块，有效利用雷达的深度和速度信息。相比已有方法仅简单投影雷达点或忽略雷达特征，RCBEVDet通过多尺度雷达特征提取和注意力融合提升检测精度。在nuScenes上，RCBEVDet在3D检测上达到SOTA，NDS为62.4%，mAP为55.3%，且对恶劣天气鲁棒。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: To address difficult radar-camera fusion in BEV due to sparse and noisy radar point clouds, this paper proposes RCBEVDet, which designs a radar BEV encoder and cross-modal attention fusion module to effectively exploit radar depth and velocity. Unlike prior methods that simply project radar points or ignore radar features, RCBEVDet improves detection via multi-scale radar feature extraction and attention fusion. On nuScenes, RCBEVDet achieves state-of-the-art 3D detection with 62.4% NDS and 55.3% mAP, and is robust to adverse weather.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 该工作有效解决了雷达-相机BEV融合的稀疏性和噪声问题，在nuScenes上取得SOTA且鲁棒性强，对多模态感知有重要参考价值。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出RCBEVDet，实现雷达-相机BEV融合的3D目标检测。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 设计雷达BEV编码器和跨模态注意力融合模块，充分利用雷达深度和速度信息。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.4% NDS和55.3% mAP的SOTA性能，且对恶劣天气鲁棒。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、现有方法依赖密集点云标注的问题，本文提出VSRD（实例感知体素轮廓渲染），通过可微体素轮廓渲染将实例级监督信号引入弱监督训练。相比已有仅使用场景级或框级弱标注的方法，VSRD利用实例感知的轮廓渲染实现更精确的定位与形状约束。在KITTI等基准上，VSRD在弱监督设定下取得了显著优于现有弱监督方法的检测精度，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in 3D object detection by proposing VSRD, an instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering framework for weakly supervised 3D detection. Unlike prior methods that rely only on scene-level or box-level weak labels, VSRD introduces differentiable volumetric silhouette rendering to provide instance-level supervision. Experiments on KITTI show that VSRD significantly outperforms existing weakly supervised methods and narrows the gap to fully supervised counterparts.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该工作将可微渲染与弱监督3D检测结合，思路新颖，对降低3D标注依赖有实际意义，值得关注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出实例感知体素轮廓渲染框架，实现弱监督3D目标检测。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 将可微体素轮廓渲染引入弱监督3D检测，提供实例级监督信号。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著优于现有弱监督方法，缩小与全监督方法的差距。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D目标检测中跨视角上下文建模不足的问题，本文提出多视角注意力上下文化（Multi-View Attentive Contextualization, MVAC）方法。该方法通过注意力机制在多个相机视角之间聚合上下文信息，增强特征表达以提升3D检测精度。相比已有仅依赖单视角或简单拼接的方法，MVAC更有效地利用了跨视角的互补信息。在nuScenes等基准上取得了有竞争力的检测性能。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient cross-view context modeling in multi-view 3D object detection by proposing Multi-View Attentive Contextualization (MVAC). The method aggregates contextual information across multiple camera views via attention mechanisms to enhance feature representation. Compared with prior single-view or naive concatenation approaches, MVAC better exploits complementary cross-view information, achieving competitive detection performance on nuScenes.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 跨视角上下文建模是多相机3D检测的核心问题，该工作提供了有效的注意力方案，具有较好的实用价值。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出多视角注意力上下文化方法，增强多相机3D检测的跨视角特征表达。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 利用注意力机制在多个相机视角间聚合上下文信息。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的3D检测性能。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确、缺乏空间占据信息的问题，本文提出学习占据（Occupancy）表示来辅助单目3D检测。方法通过预测场景的占据栅格，为单目检测提供更丰富的3D空间先验，从而提升定位精度。相比已有仅依赖2D特征或隐式深度的方法，显式占据学习能更好地约束3D框回归。在KITTI等基准上取得了优于现有单目方法的检测精度。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation and lack of spatial occupancy in monocular 3D object detection by learning occupancy representations. The proposed method predicts scene occupancy grids to provide richer 3D spatial priors for monocular detection. Compared with methods relying only on 2D features or implicit depth, explicit occupancy learning better constrains 3D box regression, achieving improved accuracy on KITTI.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 将占据学习引入单目3D检测是当前热点方向，该工作思路清晰，对提升单目检测精度有参考价值。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出利用占据学习辅助单目3D目标检测。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 通过预测占据栅格为单目检测提供显式3D空间先验。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI等基准上优于现有单目3D检测方法。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测与位姿估计中不确定性建模不足的问题，本文提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型进行单目3D检测和位姿估计。方法将3D框和位姿参数作为扩散生成目标，通过去噪过程逐步回归，从而更好地建模多模态分布和不确定性。相比已有确定性回归方法，MonoDiff能处理检测中的模糊性和多解问题。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的检测与位姿估计精度。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient uncertainty modeling in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation by proposing MonoDiff, which leverages diffusion models. The method treats 3D boxes and pose parameters as diffusion targets and regresses them through a denoising process, better capturing multimodal distributions. Compared with deterministic regression methods, MonoDiff handles ambiguity and multi-solution issues, achieving competitive accuracy on KITTI.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 将扩散模型用于单目3D检测与位姿估计是新颖尝试，对不确定性建模有启发意义。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的单目3D目标检测与位姿估计方法MonoDiff。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 利用扩散去噪过程建模3D框和位姿的多模态分布与不确定性。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得有竞争力的检测与位姿估计精度。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视觉3D目标检测中BEV表示构建效率低、体素池化信息损失的问题，本文提出BEVSpread，一种用于BEV表示的扩散体素池化方法。该方法通过将体素特征扩散到BEV平面，减少传统池化带来的信息丢失，提升路侧场景下的3D检测性能。相比已有体素池化方法，BEVSpread在保持效率的同时更好地保留了空间信息。在路侧3D检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的精度。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient BEV representation and information loss in voxel pooling for vision-based roadside 3D object detection by proposing BEVSpread, a spread voxel pooling method. The approach diffuses voxel features onto the BEV plane to reduce information loss during pooling. Compared with existing voxel pooling methods, BEVSpread better preserves spatial information while maintaining efficiency, achieving superior accuracy on roadside 3D detection benchmarks.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 路侧BEV感知是自动驾驶的重要场景，该工作针对体素池化的信息损失提出改进，具有实用价值。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出BEVSpread扩散体素池化方法，用于路侧视觉BEV 3D检测。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 通过扩散体素特征到BEV平面减少池化信息损失。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在路侧3D检测基准上优于现有方法。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对室外无监督3D目标检测中缺乏标注、依赖人工先验的问题，本文提出常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）方法，利用常识知识构建目标原型以指导无监督检测。方法通过原型学习与聚类，在无标注条件下发现并定位3D目标。相比已有无监督方法，常识原型的引入提升了检测的鲁棒性和泛化能力。在室外3D检测基准上取得了优于现有无监督方法的性能。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations and reliance on manual priors in outdoor unsupervised 3D object detection by proposing a Commonsense Prototype method. The approach constructs object prototypes using commonsense knowledge to guide unsupervised detection through prototype learning and clustering. Compared with existing unsupervised methods, the introduction of commonsense prototypes improves robustness and generalization, achieving superior performance on outdoor 3D detection benchmarks.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 无监督3D检测是降低标注依赖的重要方向，该工作引入常识原型思路新颖，值得关注。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出基于常识原型的室外无监督3D目标检测方法。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 利用常识知识构建目标原型指导无监督3D检测。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在室外3D检测基准上优于现有无监督方法。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 稀疏监督3D检测中，标注点云极稀疏导致正样本不足、特征学习不充分。本文提出HINTED，通过混合密度特征融合（Mixed-Density Feature Fusion）与难例增强（Hard Instance Enhancement）策略，在稀疏标注下挖掘高价值难例并融合不同密度区域特征。相比已有稀疏监督方法，缓解了正样本稀缺与密度不平衡问题。在KITTI等基准上取得显著提升，验证了方法在极少标注下的有效性。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: Sparsely-supervised 3D object detection suffers from insufficient positive samples and density imbalance under extremely sparse annotations. HINTED introduces mixed-density feature fusion and hard instance enhancement to mine informative hard examples and fuse features across density regions. It alleviates positive scarcity and density imbalance, achieving notable gains on benchmarks like KITTI under minimal annotation.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 针对稀疏监督3D检测的痛点提出有效增强策略，实验扎实，对降低标注成本有实际意义。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出混合密度特征融合与难例增强的稀疏监督3D检测框架。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 在稀疏标注下融合不同密度特征并强化难例学习。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在稀疏监督设定下显著提升3D检测精度。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 现有3D检测依赖大规模3D标注，而扩散模型特征在2D任务表现优异但未充分用于3D。本文提出3DiffTection，利用几何感知的扩散特征进行3D目标检测，将预训练扩散模型的2D特征通过几何对齐迁移到3D空间。相比纯监督方法，减少了对3D标注的依赖并提升泛化性。在多个3D检测基准上取得竞争性甚至更优结果，展示了扩散特征在3D感知的潜力。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: 3D detection typically relies on large-scale 3D annotations, while diffusion features excel in 2D but remain underexplored for 3D. 3DiffTection leverages geometry-aware diffusion features, transferring pretrained 2D diffusion representations into 3D space via geometric alignment. It reduces reliance on 3D labels and improves generalization, achieving competitive or superior results on multiple 3D detection benchmarks.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型特征引入3D检测，思路新颖，为利用基础模型先验提供新范式。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出利用几何感知扩散特征进行3D目标检测的方法。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 将预训练扩散模型的2D特征几何对齐迁移至3D检测。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在多个3D检测基准上达到竞争性或更优性能。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 单目3D检测中深度估计误差是主要瓶颈，现有方法深度预测存在互补性利用不足的问题。本文提出MonoCD，通过互补深度（Complementary Depths）策略融合多种深度线索，缓解单一深度估计的偏差。相比已有单目方法，提升了深度估计的鲁棒性与定位精度。在KITTI基准上取得领先的单目3D检测结果，验证了互补深度的有效性。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: Monocular 3D detection is bottlenecked by depth estimation errors, and existing methods underutilize complementary depth cues. MonoCD introduces a complementary depth strategy that fuses multiple depth cues to mitigate single-estimate bias. It improves depth robustness and localization accuracy, achieving leading monocular 3D detection results on KITTI.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 聚焦单目3D检测核心的深度问题，方法简洁有效，对单目感知研究有参考价值。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出互补深度策略的单目3D目标检测方法。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 融合多种互补深度线索以缓解深度估计偏差。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测上取得领先精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 远距离3D目标检测因点云稀疏、标注困难而性能不佳。本文提出利用2D框监督改进远距离3D检测，通过2D标注辅助生成3D监督信号，缓解远距离3D标注稀缺问题。相比仅用3D标注的方法，显著提升了远距离目标的检测能力。在相关基准上验证了2D监督对远距离3D检测的有效增益。
