Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: Distant 3D object detection is hindered by sparse point clouds and scarce 3D annotations. This work improves distant 3D detection using 2D box supervision, leveraging 2D labels to generate auxiliary 3D supervision. It substantially boosts distant object detection compared to 3D-only supervision, validated on relevant benchmarks.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 利用廉价2D标注解决远距离3D检测难题，实用性强，对自动驾驶远距感知有直接价值。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出利用2D框监督改进远距离3D目标检测的方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 以2D标注辅助生成3D监督信号缓解远距离标注稀缺。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 显著提升远距离3D目标检测性能。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 多模态3D检测中实例与场景特征融合不充分，导致上下文利用不足。本文提出IS-Fusion，通过实例-场景协同融合（Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion）联合建模实例级与场景级特征。相比已有融合方法，增强了实例与全局场景的交互。在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的多模态3D检测结果，验证了协同融合的有效性。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: Multimodal 3D detection underutilizes context due to insufficient instance-scene feature fusion. IS-Fusion proposes instance-scene collaborative fusion that jointly models instance-level and scene-level features. It enhances instance-global interaction, achieving leading multimodal 3D detection results on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 针对多模态融合的实例-场景交互提出有效方案，实验充分，对BEV多模态感知有参考价值。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合的多模态3D检测框架。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 联合建模实例级与场景级特征增强上下文交互。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在nuScenes等多模态基准上取得领先性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 跨数据集3D检测的无监督域适应中，伪标签噪声严重影响适应效果。本文提出伪标签精炼（Pseudo Label Refinery）方法，对生成的伪标签进行质量筛选与修正。相比直接使用伪标签的方法，降低了噪声标签的负面影响。在跨数据集3D检测基准上显著提升域适应性能，验证了伪标签精炼的有效性。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: In unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D detection, noisy pseudo labels severely degrade adaptation. This work proposes a pseudo label refinery that filters and refines generated pseudo labels. It reduces the impact of noisy labels, substantially improving domain adaptation performance on cross-dataset 3D detection benchmarks.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 针对跨域3D检测伪标签噪声问题提出精炼方案，对提升域适应鲁棒性有实用价值。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出伪标签精炼的跨数据集3D检测无监督域适应方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 对伪标签进行质量筛选与修正以降低噪声影响。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在跨数据集3D检测上显著提升域适应性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: 针对全稀疏3D检测器在远处或稀疏区域因特征不足导致性能下降的问题，本文提出SAFDNet。该方法通过混合稀疏卷积和密度感知特征传播，在保持全稀疏架构高效性的同时增强稀疏区域的特征表达。相比已有全稀疏检测器，SAFDNet在不引入密集计算的情况下提升了检测精度。在nuScenes数据集上，SAFDNet取得了与密集检测器相当的精度，同时保持较高的推理速度。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of fully sparse 3D detectors in distant or sparse regions due to insufficient features, and proposes SAFDNet. The method enhances feature representation in sparse areas via hybrid sparse convolution and density-aware feature propagation while maintaining the efficiency of a fully sparse architecture. Compared with existing fully sparse detectors, SAFDNet improves detection accuracy without introducing dense computation. On nuScenes, it achieves accuracy comparable to dense detectors while maintaining high inference speed.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该工作为全稀疏3D检测提供了简单有效的解决方案，平衡了精度与效率，对自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出了一种简单有效的全稀疏3D检测网络SAFDNet，通过密度感知特征传播增强稀疏区域特征。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 在不引入密集计算的前提下，利用混合稀疏卷积和密度感知传播提升稀疏区域的特征表达。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在nuScenes上达到与密集检测器相当的精度，同时保持高推理速度。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: 针对轻量级3D目标检测模型在压缩后精度下降的问题，本文提出CaKDP框架，结合类别感知知识蒸馏与剪枝。该方法根据类别重要性自适应地分配蒸馏权重，并联合优化剪枝策略，以在压缩模型的同时保留关键类别检测能力。相比传统蒸馏或剪枝方法，CaKDP在轻量化3D检测上取得了更好的精度-效率权衡。在KITTI数据集上，CaKDP在显著减少参数量的同时保持了较高的mAP。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy drop of lightweight 3D object detection models after compression, and proposes CaKDP, a framework combining category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning. The method adaptively assigns distillation weights based on class importance and jointly optimizes pruning to preserve detection capability for critical categories. Compared with conventional distillation or pruning, CaKDP achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off for lightweight 3D detection. On KITTI, it maintains high mAP while significantly reducing parameters.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该工作将类别感知引入蒸馏与剪枝的联合框架，为轻量级3D检测提供了新思路，但实验规模有限。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出了类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架CaKDP，用于轻量级3D目标检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 根据类别重要性自适应分配蒸馏权重，并与剪枝联合优化。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在KITTI上显著减少参数量的同时保持较高mAP。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla._arxiv_id: CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight 3D Object Detection.

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: 针对半监督单目3D目标检测中伪标签质量不高的问题，本文提出解耦伪标签方法。该方法将伪标签生成解耦为定位和分类两个分支，分别进行置信度评估和优化，以减少错误传播。相比已有半监督方法，解耦策略显著提升了伪标签的可靠性。在KITTI数据集上，该方法在少量标注下取得了与全监督方法接近的精度。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses the low quality of pseudo-labels in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection and proposes a decoupled pseudo-labeling method. The approach decouples pseudo-label generation into localization and classification branches, each with separate confidence estimation and optimization to reduce error propagation. Compared with existing semi-supervised methods, the decoupled strategy significantly improves pseudo-label reliability. On KITTI, it achieves accuracy close to fully supervised methods with limited annotations.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 该工作通过解耦伪标签生成有效提升了半监督单目3D检测的性能，对降低标注成本有重要意义。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出了一种解耦伪标签方法，用于半监督单目3D目标检测。

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高的问题，本文提出Prompt3D，利用随机提示辅助弱监督训练。该方法通过随机生成的提示增强点云特征，并设计弱监督损失以利用少量标注。相比已有弱监督方法，Prompt3D在标注极少的情况下提升了检测性能。在KITTI数据集上，Prompt3D在仅使用少量标注时取得了有竞争力的结果。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in weakly-supervised 3D object detection and proposes Prompt3D, which uses random prompts to assist weakly-supervised training. The method enhances point cloud features via randomly generated prompts and designs a weakly-supervised loss to leverage limited annotations. Compared with existing weakly-supervised methods, Prompt3D improves detection performance with very few annotations. On KITTI, it achieves competitive results using only a small amount of labeled data.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 该工作探索了随机提示在弱监督3D检测中的应用，为降低标注依赖提供了新视角，但方法通用性有待验证。

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达-相机融合中图像到BEV变换因深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题，提出基于query的RaCFormer框架，从BEV和原始图像两个视角自适应采样实例相关特征。方法上引入极坐标下的自适应圆形分布优化query初始化（按距离调整query密度），并用雷达引导的深度头改进图像到BEV的变换，同时利用雷达多普勒效应设计隐式动态捕捉器建模BEV时序信息。在nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测精度。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: RaCFormer addresses the misalignment in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate image-to-BEV depth estimation by proposing a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views. It introduces an adaptive circular distribution in polar coordinates for query initialization, a radar-guided depth head to refine image-to-BEV transformation, and an implicit dynamic catcher exploiting radar Doppler for temporal BEV modeling. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art 3D detection accuracy.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 针对雷达-相机融合中BEV特征错位这一核心痛点提出query-based自适应采样方案，设计系统且实验充分，对多传感器BEV感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出query-based雷达-相机融合框架RaCFormer，通过双视角自适应采样与雷达引导深度建模提升3D检测精度。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 用极坐标自适应圆形分布初始化query并借助雷达多普勒效应隐式捕捉BEV时序动态。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上取得领先的3D目标检测精度。

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有室内3D检测数据集在规模、精度和物体多样性上的不足，论文构建了CA-1M数据集，在1K+高精度激光扫描场景上详尽标注超40万个3D物体，并与3.5K+手持第一视角采集对齐。同时提出全Transformer基线CuTR，直接从RGB(-D)的2D特征预测3D框而非在点/体素上操作。实验表明CuTR配合CA-1M可准确召回62%以上的3D物体，优于点云方法，且对商品级LiDAR深度图的噪声与不确定性更鲁棒，并具备纯RGB性能。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: To address the limited scale, accuracy, and object diversity of existing indoor 3D detection datasets, the authors introduce CA-1M, exhaustively labeling over 400K 3D objects across 1K+ laser-scanned scenes registered to 3.5K+ handheld egocentric captures. They further propose CuTR, a fully Transformer baseline that predicts 3D boxes directly from 2D RGB(-D) features rather than point/voxel representations. Paired with CA-1M, CuTR recalls over 62% of objects in 3D, outperforming point-based methods and being more robust to commodity LiDAR depth noise while also enabling RGB-only performance.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 数据集规模与标注质量突出，CuTR以无3D归纳偏置的纯Transformer设计挑战点云范式，对室内3D检测与数据驱动建模研究者有启发意义。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 构建大规模高精度室内3D检测数据集CA-1M并提出直接从2D特征预测3D框的CuTR基线。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 以全Transformer、无3D归纳偏置的方式从RGB(-D) 2D特征直接回归3D框，并配套大规模精细标注数据集。
2412.04458|v2.result: CuTR在CA-1M上3D召回率超62%，优于点云方法且对深度噪声更鲁棒。

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点分布复杂（取决于目标类别、尺寸和朝向）而现有雷达-相机融合方法仅用黑盒网络隐式处理的问题，论文显式建模雷达点分布以辅助融合。方法先用单目检测器获得的目标属性预测雷达点分布，再以该分布为核对单目检测邻域内的实际雷达点进行匹配生成匹配分数，最后融合上下文与核检测器精修匹配分数。在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机检测性能，代码已开源。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: To address the complex radar hit distribution that depends on object category, size, and orientation—implicitly handled by black-box networks in prior radar-camera fusion—this paper explicitly models radar hit distributions to assist fusion. It predicts radar hit distributions conditioned on object properties from a monocular detector, uses the predicted distribution as a kernel to match measured radar points and generate matching scores, and finally refines scores by fusing context with the kernel detector. The method achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera detection performance on nuScenes, with source code released.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 以显式雷达点分布建模替代黑盒融合，思路清晰且可解释性强，在nuScenes上达到SOTA并开源代码，对雷达-相机融合研究者有较高参考价值。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出显式雷达点分布建模与核匹配的雷达-相机融合检测方法RICCARDO。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 用单目检测器条件预测雷达点分布作为核，与实测雷达点匹配生成可解释的匹配分数。
2504.09086|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机3D检测性能。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器在跨域场景下泛化能力差的问题，现有域泛化方法仅依赖全局几何特征（点云笛卡尔坐标），导致检测器过度关注绝对位置而忽视局部结构。本文提出GBlobs，用高斯球显式编码点云邻域的局部结构，无需额外参数且计算高效，可直接集成到现有检测器中。在单源域泛化基准上，Waymo→KITTI提升21 mAP、KITTI→Waymo提升13 mAP、nuScenes→KITTI提升12 mAP，多源域泛化也分别提升17、12、5 mAP，且不损失域内性能。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor cross-domain generalization of LiDAR-based 3D detectors, which stems from over-reliance on global geometric features. It proposes GBlobs, an explicit local structure encoding of point cloud neighborhoods using Gaussian blobs that is parameter-free and efficient. Integrating GBlobs into existing detectors improves single-source domain generalization by over 21 mAP (Waymo→KITTI), 13 mAP (KITTI→Waymo), and 12 mAP (nuScenes→KITTI), and multi-source DG by 17, 12, and 5 mAP, without sacrificing in-domain performance.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的局部结构编码显著提升跨域3D检测性能，方法通用且即插即用，对自动驾驶感知的域泛化研究具有重要参考价值。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的高斯球局部结构编码GBlobs，用于LiDAR 3D检测的域泛化。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 首次用高斯球显式编码点云邻域局部结构，替代对全局笛卡尔坐标的过度依赖。
2503.08639|v2.result: 单源域泛化最高提升21 mAP，多源域泛化最高提升17 mAP，且不损失域内精度。

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中透视投影几何深度因物体视觉表面导致的深度误差问题，即边界框高度无法代表实际投影中心高度，本文提出MonoDGP。该方法采用透视不变的几何误差修正投影公式，系统讨论了几何误差的机制与有效性，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代；同时解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器，提供2D先验并无扰动地初始化目标查询。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的单目3D检测性能。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the depth error in monocular 3D detection caused by perspective projection, where bounding box height fails to represent the actual projected central height. It proposes MonoDGP, a Transformer-based method that uses perspective-invariant geometry errors to modify the projection formula, serving as a simple alternative to multi-depth prediction. It also decouples the depth-guided decoder and constructs a 2D decoder relying solely on visual features for 2D priors and query initialization, achieving competitive results on KITTI.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 该工作对单目3D检测中几何深度误差的机理进行了清晰分析，提出的解耦查询设计简洁有效，对单目3D检测研究有较好参考价值。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出基于透视不变几何误差的MonoDGP，并解耦深度引导解码器与2D解码器。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式替代多深度预测，并解耦2D/3D解码器以提供无扰动的2D先验。
2410.19590|v2.result: 在KITTI等单目3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内3D目标检测中标注成本高、且主动学习在该场景尚未被探索的问题，本文首次研究室内3D检测的主动学习。室内数据集面临每类样本少、类别多、类别不平衡严重、场景类型和类内差异大等挑战。提出结合不确定性与多样性的主动学习框架：不确定性准则同时考虑误检和漏检目标，多样性准则通过新的类感知自适应原型（CAP）库联合优化目标类别分布与场景类型的多样性。实验表明该方法能有效减少标注量并保持检测性能。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first study on active learning for indoor 3D object detection, addressing the high annotation cost and unique challenges of indoor datasets such as fewer samples per class, more classes, severe class imbalance, and diverse scene types. It proposes a framework incorporating uncertainty and diversity criteria: uncertainty accounts for both inaccurate detections and undetected objects, while diversity is formulated as a joint optimization maximizing object class and scene type diversity via a new Class-aware Adaptive Prototype (CAP) bank. Experiments show effective annotation reduction while maintaining detection performance.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 首次将主动学习引入室内3D检测，针对室内数据特性设计的双准则框架具有针对性，对降低3D标注成本的研究有参考意义。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向室内3D目标检测的主动学习框架，结合不确定性与多样性准则。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 设计类感知自适应原型库（CAP）联合优化类别与场景多样性，并同时考虑误检与漏检的不确定性。
2503.16125|v2.result: 在室内3D检测任务上有效减少标注量并保持检测性能。

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏标注下3D目标检测性能退化的问题，本文提出SP3D，利用大型多模态模型（LMM）生成的跨模态语义提示来增强检测器的特征判别能力。方法包含三个模块：CPST通过边界约束的中心聚类选择生成准确的跨模态语义提示；DCPG基于这些种子点从多尺度邻域点的几何形状生成伪标签；DS分数筛选高质量监督信号用于检测器初始训练。在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上验证了有效性，性能优于现有稀疏监督方法。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of 3D object detection under sparsely-supervised settings by proposing SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from Large Multimodal Models to boost feature discrimination. It introduces a Confident Points Semantic Transfer module for accurate prompt generation, a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module for pseudo-supervision from multi-scale neighbor geometry, and a Distribution Shape score for selecting high-quality signals. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset validate its effectiveness over existing sparsely-supervised methods.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 将LMM语义先验引入稀疏监督3D检测的思路新颖，有望缓解标注稀缺问题，值得关注。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用LMM跨模态语义提示增强稀疏监督3D检测的SP3D框架。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 通过边界约束中心聚类生成准确语义提示，并基于几何形状动态生成伪标签。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo数据集上验证了方法有效性，性能优于现有稀疏监督方法。

Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_cn: 本文针对统一稀疏监督3D目标检测问题，提出学习类别原型的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点和实验数据。从标题推测，该方法可能通过类别原型来统一不同稀疏监督设置下的检测，但缺乏摘要信息难以准确评估。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.summary_en: This paper addresses unified sparse-supervised 3D object detection by learning class prototypes. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed. The title suggests a prototype-based approach to unify detection under different sparse supervision settings.
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法充分评估其贡献与效果，但主题与稀疏监督3D检测相关，可能有一定参考价值。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.contribution: 提出学习类别原型用于统一稀疏监督3D目标检测。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.innovation: 可能通过类别原型统一不同稀疏监督设置下的检测。
Learning Class Prototypes for Unified Sp.result: 因摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。

2502.20316|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云中大量空区域导致MAE占用信息泄漏和计算复杂度高的问题，本文提出NOMAE，仅在非掩码体素的邻域进行掩码占用重建。通过提出的层次化掩码生成技术，在多尺度上结合体素掩码和占用重建，以捕获不同大小物体的特征。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上的语义分割和3D目标检测任务中，与判别式和生成式SSL方法相比取得了显著提升。
2502.20316|v2.summary_en: To address occupancy information leakage and high computational complexity in LiDAR MAE due to large empty areas, this paper proposes NOMAE, which performs masked occupancy reconstruction only in the neighborhood of non-masked voxels. It incorporates multi-scale voxel masking and occupancy reconstruction with a hierarchical mask generation technique to capture objects of different sizes. Extensive evaluations on nuScenes and Waymo for semantic segmentation and 3D object detection show significant improvements over discriminative and generative SSL methods.
2502.20316|v2.assessment: 有效解决了LiDAR点云MAE中的关键挑战，方法灵活且实验充分，对自监督3D感知有重要推动。
2502.20316|v2.contribution: 提出邻域占用掩码自编码器NOMAE，用于LiDAR点云自监督学习。
2502.20316|v2.innovation: 仅在非掩码体素邻域重建占用，并采用层次化多尺度掩码生成。
2502.20316|v2.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上语义分割和3D检测任务中显著优于现有SSL方法。

2503.13914|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D点云自监督学习未能保留物体姿态和尺度等几何信息的问题，本文提出PSA-SSL，通过自监督边界框回归预训练任务学习姿态和尺寸感知特征。同时引入LiDAR光束模式增强，鼓励学习传感器无关特征。在Waymo、nuScenes和SemanticKITTI数据集上，单个预训练模型在有限标签的3D语义分割任务上取得显著提升，并在3D目标检测上超越其他先进SSL方法。
2503.13914|v2.summary_en: To address the failure of existing 3D point cloud SSL in retaining geometric information like object pose and scale, this paper proposes PSA-SSL, which learns pose and size-aware features via a self-supervised bounding box regression pretext task. It also incorporates LiDAR beam pattern augmentation to encourage sensor-agnostic features. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and SemanticKITTI show significant improvements in 3D semantic segmentation with limited labels and outperform state-of-the-art SSL methods on 3D object detection.
2503.13914|v2.assessment: 通过姿态和尺寸感知的预训练任务弥补了几何信息缺失，对下游定位和几何敏感任务有显著帮助。
2503.13914|v2.contribution: 提出PSA-SSL，通过自监督边界框回归学习姿态和尺寸感知的点云特征。
2503.13914|v2.innovation: 将自监督边界框回归作为预训练任务，并结合LiDAR光束模式增强。
2503.13914|v2.result: 在多个自动驾驶数据集上，有限标签语义分割显著提升，3D检测超越SOTA SSL方法。

2503.12382|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云压缩中实时性挑战，本文提出RENO，首个实时神经编解码器。它跳过八叉树构建，直接基于多尺度稀疏张量表示，并设计稀疏占用码，利用跨尺度相关性一次性推导体素占用，大幅节省处理时间。在桌面平台（RTX 3090）上实现14位深度下10 fps的编解码速度，相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%比特率，模型仅1MB。
2503.12382|v2.summary_en: To address the real-time challenge in LiDAR point cloud compression, this paper proposes RENO, the first real-time neural codec. It skips octree construction and builds on multiscale sparse tensor representation, devising sparse occupancy codes to derive voxel occupancy in a one-shot manner using cross-scale correlation. It achieves 10 fps at 14-bit depth on an RTX 3090, with 12.25% and 48.34% bit-rate savings over G-PCCv23 and Draco, respectively, and a model size of only 1MB.
2503.12382|v2.assessment: 在实时LiDAR压缩上取得突破，模型轻量且高效，对自动驾驶感知系统部署有实用价值。
2503.12382|v2.contribution: 提出首个实时神经LiDAR点云编解码器RENO。
2503.12382|v2.innovation: 跳过八叉树，利用稀疏占用码和跨尺度相关性一次性推导体素占用。
2503.12382|v2.result: 实现10 fps实时编解码，比特率节省12.25%和48.34%，模型仅1MB。

2503.15185|v2.summary_cn: 针对低分辨率体素查询导致视图变换信息丢失的问题，本文提出ProtoOcc，利用聚类图像片段的原型增强低分辨率上下文。通过将2D原型映射到3D体素查询，编码高层视觉几何，弥补降分辨率带来的空间信息损失；并设计多视角解码策略，将密集压缩的视觉线索解耦为高维3D占用场景。在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI基准上取得明显改进，性能与基线相比具有竞争力。
2503.15185|v2.summary_en: To address information loss from low-resolution voxel queries in view transformation, this paper proposes ProtoOcc, which leverages prototypes of clustered image segments to enhance low-resolution context. It maps 2D prototypes onto 3D voxel queries to encode high-level visual geometry and designs a multi-perspective decoding strategy to disentangle compressed visual cues into high-dimensional 3D occupancy. Experiments on Occ3D and SemanticKITTI show clear improvements over baselines.
2503.15185|v2.assessment: 巧妙利用原型补偿低分辨率查询的信息损失，对实时3D占用预测有重要参考价值。
2503.15185|v2.contribution: 提出ProtoOcc，通过原型感知视图变换增强低分辨率查询的3D占用预测。
2503.15185|v2.innovation: 将聚类图像片段的原型映射到3D体素查询，并设计多视角解码策略。
2503.15185|v2.result: 在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI上取得明显改进，性能与基线相比具有竞争力。

2501.18804|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏已知视角图像进行新视角图像与深度图合成的问题，现有方法依赖神经场、体素或3D高斯等中间3D表示，流程复杂且难以直接像素级生成。本文提出MVGD，一种基于扩散的架构，利用raymap条件注入空间信息，并通过可学习任务嵌入实现图像与深度图的多任务联合生成。方法在超过6000万多视角样本上训练，并提出增量微调小模型以高效训练大模型的策略，展现出良好的scaling行为。实验表明该方法在新视角合成与深度估计上取得优异效果，并具备零样本泛化能力。
2501.18804|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses novel view and depth synthesis from sparse posed images, where existing methods rely on intermediate 3D representations such as neural fields or 3D Gaussians. It proposes MVGD, a diffusion-based architecture that directly generates pixel-level images and depth maps from novel viewpoints using raymap conditioning and learnable task embeddings for multi-task generation. Trained on over 60 million multi-view samples with an incremental fine-tuning strategy for efficient scaling, MVGD achieves strong zero-shot novel view synthesis and depth estimation performance.
2501.18804|v2.assessment: 该工作将扩散模型与多视角几何条件结合，在大规模数据上验证了scaling行为，对3D场景重建与生成方向有重要参考价值。
2501.18804|v2.contribution: 提出MVGD，一种基于raymap条件与多任务扩散的像素级新视角图像与深度图生成架构。
2501.18804|v2.innovation: 利用raymap条件与可学习任务嵌入统一图像和深度生成，并提出增量微调实现高效scaling。
2501.18804|v2.result: 在6000万多视角样本上训练，实现零样本新视角合成与深度估计，并展现良好scaling行为。

2503.14198|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏多视角图像下未见人体新视角合成困难、现有方法在视角重叠少时重建复杂人体几何效果差的问题，本文提出RoGSplat。方法将SMPL顶点提升为稠密可靠的3D先验点，结合像素级与体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D先验点，并回归粗高斯；进一步从粗高斯渲染深度图以回归细粒度像素级高斯，增强高频细节。在多个基准数据集上，该方法在新视角合成与跨数据集泛化上优于现有SOTA，且无需逐主体优化。
2503.14198|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles high-fidelity novel view synthesis of unseen humans from sparse multi-view images without per-subject optimization. RoGSplat lifts SMPL vertices to dense 3D prior points, predicts image-aligned priors using pixel- and voxel-level features to regress coarse Gaussians, and renders depth maps to refine fine-grained pixel-wise Gaussians. Experiments show superior novel view synthesis and cross-dataset generalization over state-of-the-art methods.
2503.14198|v2.assessment: 该工作将SMPL先验与高斯泼溅结合，在稀疏视角人体重建上取得稳健提升，对数字人与稀疏视角重建有参考意义。
2503.14198|v2.contribution: 提出RoGSplat，一种基于SMPL先验点与粗到细高斯回归的稀疏多视角人体新视角合成方法。
2503.14198|v2.innovation: 利用像素级与体素级特征预测图像对齐3D先验点，并通过深度渲染回归细粒度高斯以增强细节。
2503.14198|v2.result: 在多个基准上新视角合成与跨数据集泛化均超越SOTA，且无需逐主体优化。

2411.14716|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶视觉中心算法预训练中依赖显式深度监督、效率低的问题，本文提出VisionPAD，一种仅以图像为监督的自监督预训练范式。方法采用3D高斯泼溅重建多视角表示，引入自监督体素速度估计，通过将体素warp到相邻帧并监督渲染输出学习运动线索；同时采用多帧光度一致性，基于渲染深度与相对位姿投影相邻帧，增强3D几何表示。在自动驾驶数据集上，该方法在3D目标检测、占据预测和地图分割上显著超越现有SOTA预训练策略。
2411.14716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of vision-centric pre-training in autonomous driving that relies on explicit depth supervision. VisionPAD proposes a self-supervised paradigm using 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct multi-view representations from images alone, with self-supervised voxel velocity estimation via warping to adjacent frames and multi-frame photometric consistency for geometry. Extensive experiments show significant improvements in 3D object detection, occupancy prediction, and map segmentation over state-of-the-art pre-training strategies.
2411.14716|v2.assessment: 该工作将3D高斯泼溅引入自动驾驶自监督预训练，无需深度标签即可提升多项下游任务，对BEV与占据感知研究有直接价值。
2411.14716|v2.contribution: 提出VisionPAD，一种基于3D高斯泼溅与多帧光度一致性的纯图像自监督预训练范式。
2411.14716|v2.innovation: 引入自监督体素速度估计与多帧光度一致性，仅用图像监督学习运动与几何表示。
2411.14716|v2.result: 在3D检测、占据预测和地图分割上显著超越现有SOTA预训练策略。

2411.15482|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂动态城市场景中动态高斯泼溅依赖昂贵人工标注3D框、可扩展性差的问题，本文提出SplatFlow，在神经运动流场（NMFF）中实现自监督动态高斯泼溅。方法将时间相关的4D高斯表示与NMFF统一，NMFF以隐式函数建模LiDAR点与高斯的时间运动流场，分解静态背景（3D高斯）与动态物体（4D高斯），并建模4D高斯跨时间对应以聚合时序特征增强跨视角一致性；还通过从2D基础模型蒸馏特征提升动态物体识别。方法无需跟踪3D框即可实现动态场景重建与新视角RGB/深度/光流合成。
2411.15482|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on expensive object-level supervision in dynamic Gaussian Splatting for urban autonomous driving. SplatFlow introduces self-supervised dynamic Gaussian Splatting within Neural Motion Flow Fields (NMFF), unifying 4D Gaussians with implicit motion flow functions to decompose static and dynamic components without tracked 3D boxes. It models temporal correspondences for cross-view consistency and distills 2D foundation model features, enabling accurate dynamic scene reconstruction and novel view RGB/depth/flow synthesis.
2411.15482|v2.assessment: 该工作以自监督方式解决动态场景4D重建，摆脱3D框标注依赖，对自动驾驶动态感知与重建有重要参考价值。
2411.15482|v2.contribution: 提出SplatFlow，一种在神经运动流场中自监督学习动态高斯泼溅的4D场景重建框架。
2411.15482|v2.innovation: 用NMFF统一建模LiDAR点与4D高斯运动流场，无需3D框监督并蒸馏2D基础模型特征增强动态识别。
2411.15482|v2.result: 无需跟踪3D框即可实现动态场景重建与新视角RGB/深度/光流合成。

2601.09211|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对从物体RGBD图像进行可供性定位（affordance grounding）的问题，即根据描述动作的文本查询定位物体表面区域。现有方法仅在可见表面上预测可供性区域，本文提出Affostruction生成式框架，从部分RGBD观测重建完整物体几何，并在包括未观测区域在内的完整形状上定位可供性。方法引入多视角特征的稀疏体素融合以实现恒定复杂度的生成式重建、基于流的公式以捕捉可供性分布的固有模糊性，以及由预测可供性引导的主动视角选择策略。在挑战性基准上大幅超越现有方法，可供性定位达到19.1 aIoU，3D重建达到32.67 IoU。
2601.09211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses affordance grounding from RGBD images, aiming to localize surface regions corresponding to a text query describing an action on an object. Existing methods predict affordance regions only on visible surfaces, whereas the proposed Affostruction framework reconstructs complete object geometry from partial RGBD observations and grounds affordances on the full shape including unobserved regions. It introduces sparse voxel fusion of multi-view features for constant-complexity generative reconstruction, a flow-based formulation capturing affordance ambiguity, and an active view selection strategy. Affostruction outperforms existing methods by large margins, achieving 19.1 aIoU on affordance grounding and 32.67 IoU for 3D reconstruction.
2601.09211|v2.assessment: 该工作将生成式3D重建与可供性定位结合，思路新颖，但主题偏向机器人操作与物体级理解，与自动驾驶感知的核心任务关联较弱。
2601.09211|v2.contribution: 提出首个在完整重建几何（含未观测区域）上进行可供性定位的生成式框架。
2601.09211|v2.innovation: 稀疏体素多视角融合实现恒定复杂度重建，并用流模型建模可供性分布模糊性。
2601.09211|v2.result: 在挑战性基准上可供性定位达19.1 aIoU，3D重建达32.67 IoU，大幅超越现有方法。

SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_cn: 针对目标检测骨干网络设计中人工设计成本高、串行与并行结构难以权衡的问题，提出SP-NAS串行到并行骨干搜索方法。该方法将搜索空间解耦为串行阶段（搜索基础模块堆叠）和并行阶段（搜索多分支特征融合），并采用分阶段渐进式搜索策略降低搜索代价。相比此前在检测任务上直接套用分类NAS的方法，SP-NAS能同时优化深度方向的串行连接与宽度方向的并行连接。在COCO等检测基准上，搜索到的骨干在同等FLOPs下取得优于ResNet/ResNeXt等手工骨干的AP，验证了检测专用骨干搜索的有效性。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_en: This paper addresses the high manual cost and the serial-vs-parallel trade-off in backbone design for object detection by proposing SP-NAS, a serial-to-parallel backbone search. The search space is decoupled into a serial stage that searches basic block stacking and a parallel stage that searches multi-branch feature fusion, with a staged progressive search strategy to reduce cost. Compared with directly transferring classification NAS to detection, SP-NAS jointly optimizes depth-wise serial connectivity and width-wise parallel connectivity, yielding higher AP than hand-crafted backbones such as ResNet/ResNeXt at comparable FLOPs on detection benchmarks.
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.assessment: 较早探索检测专用骨干NAS的工作，串行-并行解耦思路对后续检测NAS有参考价值，但整体方法偏工程化、创新增量有限。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.contribution: 提出串行到并行的两阶段骨干搜索空间与渐进搜索策略，实现检测专用骨干的自动设计。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.innovation: 将骨干搜索解耦为串行模块堆叠与并行多分支融合两个阶段，缓解搜索空间过大问题。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.result: 在检测基准上以相当计算量取得优于手工骨干的AP，验证检测专用NAS骨干的有效性。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear._arxiv_id: SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Search for Object Detection.

1906.04423|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测上NAS研究不足、已有方法动辄数千GPU天的问题，提出NAS-FCOS，用定制强化学习高效搜索无锚检测器FCOS的FPN与预测头结构。通过精心设计搜索空间、搜索算法与网络质量评估策略，仅用8块V100训练4天即可完成搜索。搜索到的解码器结构在COCO上比Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet、FCOS等SOTA高出1.5至3.5个AP。该工作证明检测解码器结构搜索可在可接受算力下获得显著收益。
1906.04423|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of NAS studies on object detection and the prohibitive cost of existing methods, this paper proposes NAS-FCOS, which efficiently searches the FPN and prediction head of the anchor-free detector FCOS via a tailored reinforcement learning paradigm. With carefully designed search space, search algorithm, and network-quality evaluation strategies, a top-performing detection architecture is found within 4 days on 8 V100 GPUs. The discovered architecture surpasses state-of-the-art detectors such as Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and FCOS by 1.5 to 3.5 AP on COCO.
1906.04423|v2.assessment: 把NAS聚焦到检测解码器而非骨干，搜索效率与精度提升都较实在，对检测架构自动化设计有直接借鉴意义。
1906.04423|v2.contribution: 提出面向无锚检测器解码器（FPN+预测头）的高效强化学习NAS框架NAS-FCOS。
1906.04423|v2.innovation: 将搜索目标限定为检测解码器结构，并设计定制RL搜索与质量评估策略大幅降低搜索成本。
1906.04423|v2.result: 8块V100搜索4天，所得结构在COCO上比Faster R-CNN/RetinaNet/FCOS高1.5–3.5 AP。

1906.09607|v2.summary_cn: 针对已有NAS方法中块数量与块宽度均需人工设定、从而限制网络深度与宽度灵活性的问题，提出DenseNAS密集连接搜索空间。该方法将搜索空间表示为基于路由块的密集超网，通过搜索路由块之间的最优路径同时决定块数量与宽度，并提出链式代价估计算法在搜索中近似模型开销，使精度与代价联合优化。在MobileNetV2搜索空间上，DenseNAS以361M FLOPs、单卡TITAN-XP 17.9ms延迟取得ImageNet 75.3% top-1；更大模型以479M FLOPs达76.1%。
1906.09607|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits NAS search-space design and observes that block counts and widths are typically set manually, restricting depth/width flexibility. It proposes DenseNAS, a densely connected search space represented as a dense super-network built on routing blocks, where the best path between routing blocks is searched to jointly determine block counts and widths. A chained cost estimation algorithm approximates model cost during search so that accuracy and cost are optimized together. On a MobileNetV2-based space, DenseNAS achieves 75.3% top-1 on ImageNet with 361M FLOPs and 17.9ms latency on a TITAN-XP, and 76.1% with 479M FLOPs for a larger model.
1906.09607|v2.assessment: 搜索空间设计层面的扎实工作，块数量与宽度联合搜索及链式代价估计对高效NAS有实用价值，但任务限于分类。
1906.09607|v2.contribution: 提出密集连接搜索空间DenseNAS，实现块数量与块宽度的联合自动搜索。
1906.09607|v2.innovation: 用路由块构成的密集超网与链式代价估计算法，将精度与模型开销在搜索中联合优化。
1906.09607|v2.result: ImageNet上75.3% top-1（361M FLOPs、17.9ms），更大模型76.1%（479M FLOPs）。

2008.06120|v2.summary_cn: 针对权重共享式高效NAS是否真优于随机搜索这一持续争议，本文在ImageNet分类与COCO检测上，于一系列逐步增大且更具挑战性的搜索空间中系统比较高效搜索与随机搜索。实验表明两者效果依赖具体问题，但在若干大规模真实任务上高效搜索能显著超越随机搜索。此外，作者提出并评估了提升搜索架构质量、减少人工超参调优需求的技术，并开源代码与实验数据（TuNAS）。
2008.06120|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the ongoing debate over whether weight-sharing efficient NAS truly outperforms random search by conducting a thorough comparison on progressively larger and more challenging search spaces for ImageNet classification and COCO detection. Results show that efficacy is problem-dependent, yet on several large realistic tasks efficient search yields substantial gains over random search. The authors further propose and evaluate techniques that improve searched-architecture quality and reduce manual hyper-parameter tuning, releasing code and data as TuNAS.
2008.06120|v2.assessment: 以严谨对照实验厘清NAS与随机搜索之争，结论对NAS社区方法论有重要参考价值，且覆盖检测任务。
2008.06120|v2.contribution: 系统比较权重共享NAS与随机搜索，并给出提升搜索质量、降低调参依赖的技术。
2008.06120|v2.innovation: 在逐步增大的分类与检测搜索空间上做受控对比，明确高效NAS相对随机搜索的适用边界。
2008.06120|v2.result: 证明在若干大规模真实任务上高效搜索显著优于随机搜索，并开源TuNAS代码与数据。

2003.14058|v2.summary_cn: 针对通用多任务学习中不同任务组合需不同搜索空间、难以任务无关地适配的问题，提出MTL-NAS。该方法将多任务网络解耦为单任务骨干与跨任务的分层逐层特征共享/融合方案，从而构造出任务无关的搜索空间——在固定单任务骨干间插入跨任务边。同时提出基于梯度的单次搜索算法，通过在搜索阶段对架构权重施加最小熵正则使其趋于近离散值，消除搜索架构与最终评估架构间的性能差距，搜索模型可直接评估无需重训。在多种单任务骨干与任务组合上进行了大量实验。
2003.14058|v2.summary_en: To handle the fact that existing NAS methods define task-specific search spaces that cannot adapt to different task sets in general-purpose multi-task learning, this paper proposes MTL-NAS. It disentangles GP-MTL networks into single-task backbones plus a hierarchical, layer-wise feature sharing/fusing scheme, yielding a task-agnostic search space that inserts cross-task edges into fixed single-task backbones. A single-shot gradient-based search algorithm with minimum-entropy regularization on architecture weights drives them to near-discrete values, closing the gap between searched and evaluation architectures so the searched model can be evaluated without retraining.
2003.14058|v2.assessment: 任务无关多任务NAS的思路有启发性，单次搜索免重训的设计实用，但实验规模与影响力相对有限。
2003.14058|v2.contribution: 提出任务无关的多任务NAS搜索空间与免重训的单次梯度搜索算法MTL-NAS。
2003.14058|v2.innovation: 以跨任务边插入固定单任务骨干构建任务无关空间，并用最小熵正则实现架构权重近离散化。
2003.14058|v2.result: 在多种单任务骨干与任务组合上验证搜索模型可直接评估、无需从头重训。

1912.02037|v2.summary_cn: 针对GAN生成模型架构设计依赖人工、且生成器与判别器需协同平衡的问题，提出AdversarialNAS。这是首个以可微方式同时搜索生成器与判别器架构的方法，其对抗搜索算法无需额外度量来评估架构性能，并在搜索范式中考虑两个网络的关联以改善相互平衡。方法在10^38量级的大搜索空间中仅需1 GPU天即可完成搜索。在CIFAR-10上，所得生成模型取得FID 10.87的新SOTA与8.74的Inception Score，并验证了可迁移性。
1912.02037|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes AdversarialNAS for GANs, targeting the manual design of generative architectures and the need to balance generator and discriminator. It is the first method to search generator and discriminator architectures simultaneously in a differentiable manner, requiring no extra metric to evaluate searched architectures and explicitly considering the relevance between the two networks to improve their mutual balance. It completes search in only 1 GPU day within a large 10^38 search space, achieving a new state-of-the-art FID of 10.87 and a competitive Inception Score of 8.74 on CIFAR-10, with demonstrated transferability.
1912.02037|v2.assessment: GAN架构搜索方向有代表性的工作，生成器-判别器联合可微搜索与极高搜索效率值得关注，但与检测/自动驾驶领域关联较弱。
1912.02037|v2.contribution: 提出首个可微地同时搜索生成器与判别器架构的GAN专用NAS方法AdversarialNAS。
1912.02037|v2.innovation: 在对抗搜索中无需额外评估度量，并显式建模生成器与判别器的关联以改善二者平衡。
1912.02037|v2.result: 1 GPU天完成10^38空间搜索，CIFAR-10上FID 10.87、Inception Score 8.74。

1911.10695|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络架构在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题，探索如何通过神经架构搜索（NAS）自动发现鲁棒的架构。作者提出了一种鲁棒架构搜索方法，在搜索过程中同时考虑干净样本和对抗样本上的性能，以发现兼具准确率和鲁棒性的网络结构。相比人工设计或仅优化干净精度的NAS方法，该方法搜索到的架构在对抗攻击下表现出更好的鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作为鲁棒NAS提供了早期探索。
1911.10695|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of discovering neural architectures that are robust against adversarial attacks. The authors propose a NAS-based approach that incorporates adversarial examples into the search process to find architectures with both high clean accuracy and robustness. Compared to manually designed or clean-accuracy-only NAS methods, the searched architectures achieve improved robustness under adversarial attacks. The work provides an early exploration of robustness-aware NAS.
1911.10695|v2.assessment: 该工作将NAS与对抗鲁棒性结合，对关注模型鲁棒性的研究者有一定参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域的直接关联较弱。
1911.10695|v2.contribution: 提出了一种在NAS搜索过程中融入对抗鲁棒性的架构搜索方法。
1911.10695|v2.innovation: 将对抗攻击下的鲁棒性作为NAS的优化目标之一，搜索鲁棒网络架构。
1911.10695|v2.result: 搜索到的架构在对抗攻击下展现出优于基线方法的鲁棒性。

2003.12238|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中双层优化因二阶近似导致梯度误差、难以收敛到局部最优的问题，提出了MiLeNAS混合层级重形式化方法。该方法将NAS问题重新表述为混合层级优化，即使使用简单的一阶方法也能获得更低的验证误差，从而搜索到更高精度的架构。此外，作者通过基于模型大小的搜索和早停策略将搜索时间缩短至约5小时，在卷积架构搜索空间上验证了有效性。相比DARTS等双层优化方法，MiLeNAS在精度和效率上均有提升。
2003.12238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality in bilevel NAS optimization caused by gradient errors from second-order approximations. It proposes MiLeNAS, a mixed-level reformulation that can be optimized efficiently with first-order methods, yielding lower validation errors and higher-accuracy architectures than bilevel optimization. With model size-based search and early stopping, the search completes in about 5 hours, and extensive experiments validate its effectiveness.
2003.12238|v2.assessment: 该工作从优化理论角度改进了可微分NAS的收敛性，方法扎实且效率高，对NAS研究者有较高参考价值。
2003.12238|v2.contribution: 提出了混合层级重形式化的NAS优化框架MiLeNAS，解决了双层优化的梯度误差问题。
2003.12238|v2.innovation: 将NAS双层优化转化为混合层级形式，使一阶方法即可获得更优解。
2003.12238|v2.result: 在卷积架构搜索空间上取得比DARTS等方法更高的精度，搜索时间约5小时。

2002.09128|v2.summary_cn: 该论文指出大多数NAS方法需要两阶段参数优化，但同一架构在两阶段的性能相关性很差，因此提出了任务特定的端到端NAS问题定义，将评估简化为任务精度和总计算消耗。作者提出DSNAS，一种可微分NAS框架，使用低偏差蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，子网络无需参数重训练即可直接部署。在ImageNet上，DSNAS以420 GPU小时发现精度达74.4%的网络，相比两阶段方法总时间减少超过34%。
2002.09128|v2.summary_en: This paper observes that most NAS methods require two-stage parameter optimization, yet architecture performance correlates poorly across stages. It proposes a task-specific end-to-end NAS definition and DSNAS, a differentiable framework that jointly optimizes architecture and parameters via low-biased Monte Carlo estimation, enabling direct deployment without retraining. DSNAS achieves 74.4% accuracy on ImageNet in 420 GPU hours, reducing total time by over 34% compared to two-stage methods.
2002.09128|v2.assessment: 该工作重新定义了NAS的评估问题并提出了无需重训练的高效框架，对NAS的实用化有重要推动。
2002.09128|v2.contribution: 提出了任务特定端到端NAS问题定义及无需参数重训练的DSNAS框架。
2002.09128|v2.innovation: 使用低偏差蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，消除两阶段重训练。
2002.09128|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以420 GPU小时达到74.4%精度，总时间减少超过34%。

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对非局部（NL）块计算量大、难以嵌入移动网络的问题，提出了AutoNL。作者首先设计了Lightweight Non-Local（LightNL）块，通过压缩变换操作和引入紧凑特征，使其计算量比传统NL块降低400倍而不损失性能。然后通过将LightNL块结构松弛为可微分，提出高效NAS算法端到端学习最优配置。仅用32 GPU小时，搜索到的AutoNL在350M FLOPs移动设置下达到77.7%的ImageNet top-1精度。
2004.01961|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Non-Local (NL) blocks that hinders their use in mobile networks. It proposes a Lightweight Non-Local (LightNL) block that is 400x cheaper than conventional NL blocks without performance loss, and a differentiable NAS algorithm to learn optimal LightNL configurations end-to-end. Using only 32 GPU hours, the searched AutoNL achieves 77.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet under 350M FLOPs.
2004.01961|v2.assessment: 该工作成功将非局部注意力引入移动网络，方法设计巧妙且效率极高，对轻量化视觉模型研究者有较大参考价值。
2004.01961|v2.contribution: 提出了轻量非局部块LightNL及对应的可微分NAS算法AutoNL。
2004.01961|v2.innovation: 通过压缩变换和紧凑特征设计将NL块计算量降低400倍，并自动搜索其最优配置。
2004.01961|v2.result: 仅32 GPU小时搜索，在350M FLOPs下达到77.7% ImageNet top-1精度。

Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中搜索与评估阶段性能不一致的问题，提出了块级监督的NAS方法，并利用知识蒸馏来指导搜索。作者将网络划分为多个块，对每个块进行独立监督，并通过知识蒸馏将教师网络的知识传递给学生架构，以提升搜索到的架构的泛化能力。相比传统NAS方法，该方法在搜索效率和最终评估精度上有所改进。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between search and evaluation performance in NAS by proposing a block-wisely supervised NAS method with knowledge distillation. The network is divided into blocks, each independently supervised, and knowledge distillation transfers teacher knowledge to the student architecture to improve generalization. The method improves search efficiency and final evaluation accuracy compared to conventional NAS.
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.assessment: 该工作将知识蒸馏引入NAS的块级监督，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，实际效果需进一步验证。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.contribution: 提出了块级监督与知识蒸馏结合的NAS方法。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.innovation: 利用知识蒸馏对网络块进行独立监督以指导架构搜索。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.result: 在搜索效率和最终架构精度上相比传统NAS有所提升。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect._arxiv_id: Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architecture Search With Knowledge Distillation.

1912.00195|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中搜索阶段验证精度高的架构在最终评估时可能表现更差的问题，提出了序列贪婪架构搜索（SGAS）。SGAS将搜索过程分解为子问题，以贪婪方式选择和剪枝候选操作，从而缓解搜索与评估的不一致。作者将SGAS应用于CNN和GCN的架构搜索，在图像分类、点云分类和蛋白质相互作用图节点分类等任务上以极低计算成本找到了最先进架构。
1912.00195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that architectures with higher validation accuracy during NAS search may perform worse in final evaluation. It proposes Sequential Greedy Architecture Search (SGAS), which divides the search into sub-problems and greedily selects and prunes candidate operations. Applied to CNN and GCN search, SGAS finds state-of-the-art architectures for image classification, point cloud classification, and node classification with minimal computational cost.
1912.00195|v2.assessment: 该工作提出的贪婪搜索策略有效缓解了NAS的搜索-评估不一致问题，且跨CNN和GCN验证了通用性，值得关注。
1912.00195|v2.contribution: 提出了序列贪婪架构搜索方法SGAS，缓解搜索与评估性能不一致。
1912.00195|v2.innovation: 将搜索过程分解为子问题并以贪婪方式选择和剪枝操作。
1912.00195|v2.result: 在图像分类、点云分类和节点分类任务上以极低计算成本找到最先进架构。

GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.summary_cn: 针对NAS中搜索代价高、代理指标与最终性能相关性弱的问题，本文提出GP-NAS，将高斯过程引入神经架构搜索，用GP对架构性能进行建模与预测。方法上通过GP代理模型在搜索空间中引导采样，减少需要完整训练评估的候选架构数量。相比基于强化学习或进化算法的NAS，GP-NAS在保持或提升搜索质量的同时显著降低搜索开销。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值结果。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.summary_en: This paper proposes GP-NAS, which introduces Gaussian processes as a surrogate model for neural architecture search to predict architecture performance and guide sampling. By modeling the architecture-performance mapping with a GP, it reduces the number of candidates requiring full training evaluation. Compared with RL- or evolution-based NAS, it aims to achieve competitive search quality at substantially lower cost, though the abstract provides no quantitative results.
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.assessment: 将高斯过程代理模型用于NAS是合理且有一定价值的方向，但需关注其在大规模搜索空间上的可扩展性。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.contribution: 提出基于高斯过程的NAS框架，用GP代理模型替代昂贵的完整训练评估。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.innovation: 将高斯过程回归作为架构性能预测器嵌入NAS搜索循环。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，仅声称降低搜索开销。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar._arxiv_id: GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Architecture Search.

1909.06793|v2.summary_cn: 针对实时语义分割网络设计中性能与速度难以兼顾、依赖人工经验的问题，本文提出图引导架构搜索GAS，自动搜索实时语义分割网络。方法上取消cell共享约束以实现cell级多样性，并用图卷积网络作为cell间的通信机制，同时在搜索过程中引入面向延迟的约束。在Cityscapes和CamVid数据集上，GAS在精度与速度的权衡上取得了新的state-of-the-art。
1909.06793|v2.summary_en: To automate the design of real-time semantic segmentation networks, this paper proposes Graph-guided Architecture Search (GAS), which removes the cell-sharing constraint to enable cell-level diversity and integrates a graph convolutional network as inter-cell communication. A latency-oriented constraint is embedded into the search to balance speed and accuracy. Experiments on Cityscapes and CamVid demonstrate a new state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-off.
1909.06793|v2.assessment: 将GCN用于cell间通信并引入延迟约束，对实时分割的NAS设计有实际参考价值。
1909.06793|v2.contribution: 提出图引导的实时语义分割NAS流水线，兼顾cell多样性与延迟约束。
1909.06793|v2.innovation: 用GCN建模cell间通信并取消cell共享约束以提升架构多样性。
1909.06793|v2.result: 在Cityscapes和CamVid上取得精度-速度权衡的新state-of-the-art。

MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.summary_cn: 针对NAS搜索过程中内存开销大的问题，本文提出MemNAS，一种带生长-修剪学习的记忆高效神经架构搜索方法。方法上通过grow-trim机制在搜索过程中动态增删网络结构，从而控制内存占用。相比需要同时实例化大量候选层的可微NAS，MemNAS降低了搜索时的内存需求。摘要未给出具体实验数值。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.summary_en: This paper proposes MemNAS, a memory-efficient neural architecture search method with grow-trim learning. It dynamically grows and trims network structures during search to control memory consumption. Compared with differentiable NAS that must instantiate many candidate layers simultaneously, MemNAS reduces memory overhead, though the abstract provides no quantitative results.
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.assessment: 内存效率是NAS实际部署中的关键瓶颈，grow-trim思路有实用价值，但需实验验证其搜索质量。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.contribution: 提出带生长-修剪学习的记忆高效NAS方法MemNAS。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.innovation: 在搜索过程中通过grow-trim机制动态调整网络结构以降低内存占用。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，仅声称提升内存效率。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec._arxiv_id: MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Grow-Trim Learning.

1912.07651|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微NAS只能优化可微损失、需对不可微指标做近似的问题，本文提出UNAS，将可微NAS与基于强化学习的NAS统一到一个框架中。方法上使搜索能同时处理可微与不可微准则，并引入基于泛化差距的新目标函数以避免选出易过拟合的架构。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet上、两种不同搜索空间中进行实验，UNAS取得了state-of-the-art的平均精度。
1912.07651|v2.summary_en: This paper presents UNAS, a unified NAS framework that encapsulates differentiable NAS and RL-based NAS, enabling search over both differentiable and non-differentiable criteria at low cost. It introduces a generalization-gap-based objective to avoid overfitting-prone architectures. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet across two search spaces show state-of-the-art average accuracy.
1912.07651|v2.assessment: 统一可微与RL搜索并引入泛化差距目标，思路清晰且实验充分，对NAS方法论有较强贡献。
1912.07651|v2.contribution: 提出统一可微与强化学习NAS的框架UNAS，并引入泛化差距目标函数。
1912.07651|v2.innovation: 在同一框架内同时优化可微与不可微准则，并用泛化差距抑制过拟合架构。

2004.05565|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类可微NAS搜索空间受限于需显式实例化候选层、无法搜索空间与通道维度的问题，本文提出DMaskingNAS，通过掩码机制复用特征图，将搜索空间扩大至常规DNAS的10^14倍，支持输入分辨率和滤波器数量的搜索。方法上采用特征图复用掩码与形状传播以最大化每FLOP或每参数精度。搜索得到的FBNetV2相比MobileNetV3-Small精度高0.9%、FLOPs少15%，与Efficient-B0精度相当但FLOPs少20%，搜索成本降低最多421倍。
2004.05565|v2.summary_en: To overcome the limited search space of DARTS-based DNAS, this paper proposes DMaskingNAS, which uses a masking mechanism for feature-map reuse to expand the search space by up to 10^14x, enabling search over input resolution and filter count. Shape propagation maximizes per-FLOP or per-parameter accuracy. The resulting FBNetV2 achieves 0.9% higher accuracy and 15% fewer FLOPs than MobileNetV3-Small, and comparable accuracy with 20% fewer FLOPs than Efficient-B0, at up to 421x lower search cost.
2004.05565|v2.assessment: 在几乎不增加内存与计算成本的前提下大幅扩展搜索空间，工程价值高，结果扎实。
2004.05565|v2.contribution: 提出DMaskingNAS，用掩码复用特征图将DNAS搜索空间扩展至空间与通道维度。
2004.05565|v2.innovation: 特征图复用掩码机制使搜索空间扩大10^14倍而内存与计算成本近乎不变。
2004.05565|v2.result: FBNetV2比MobileNetV3-Small精度高0.9%、FLOPs少15%，搜索成本降低最多421倍。

1909.04977|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有NAS多由可微方法主导、进化方法效率低的问题，本文提出CARS，一种高效的连续进化NAS方法。方法上让同一SuperNet内共享参数的种群在最新一代中训练若干epoch，下一代进化直接继承SuperNet与种群以加速最优网络生成，并用非支配排序仅保留Pareto前沿结果以准确更新SuperNet。仅需0.4 GPU days即可搜索出参数量3.7M至5.1M的一系列移动端网络，在ImageNet上超越现有state-of-the-art方法。
1909.04977|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes CARS, an efficient continuous evolutionary NAS approach. Architectures sharing parameters within a SuperNet are tuned for a few epochs, and the next generation inherits both the SuperNet and population to accelerate search; non-dominated sorting preserves only Pareto-front results for accurate SuperNet updates. With only 0.4 GPU days, it produces networks of 3.7M-5.1M parameters that surpass state-of-the-art methods on ImageNet.
1909.04977|v2.assessment: 将进化搜索与SuperNet权重继承结合，搜索成本极低，对高效NAS有参考意义。
1909.04977|v2.contribution: 提出连续进化NAS框架CARS，通过SuperNet与种群继承加速搜索。
1909.04977|v2.innovation: 进化代际间继承SuperNet与种群，并用非支配排序保留Pareto前沿更新SuperNet。
1909.04977|v2.result: 仅0.4 GPU days搜索出3.7M-5.1M参数网络，在ImageNet上超越现有方法。

Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像去噪任务中神经架构搜索（NAS）显存占用过高的问题，提出了一种内存高效的层次化搜索方法。方法通过层次化搜索空间与内存优化策略降低搜索过程中的显存开销。相比已有NAS方法，其改进点在于将搜索空间分层并减少冗余计算。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果难以量化评估。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_en: This paper addresses the high memory consumption of neural architecture search (NAS) for image denoising by proposing a memory-efficient hierarchical search method. It reduces memory overhead through a hierarchical search space and memory optimization strategies. The improvement over existing NAS methods lies in decomposing the search space and eliminating redundant computation, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.assessment: 该工作聚焦NAS在图像去噪中的显存效率问题，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但内存优化思路对车载部署有一定参考价值。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.contribution: 提出了一种面向图像去噪的内存高效层次化NAS方法。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.innovation: 通过层次化搜索空间设计降低NAS搜索过程中的显存占用。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search for Image Denoising.

2005.09917|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中性能估计（PE）耗时过长的问题，在资源受限条件下系统性地重新审视了PE，提出预算化PE（BPE）框架。方法上提出最小重要性剪枝（MIP），利用随机森林估计超参数重要性并逐轮剪除最不重要的超参数，从而将计算资源集中于更重要的超参数上。结合强化学习、进化算法、随机搜索和可微分架构搜索等多种搜索算法，实现了约1000倍NAS加速，性能相比SOTA仅有可忽略的下降。
2005.09917|v2.summary_en: This paper systematically rethinks performance estimation (PE) in NAS under resource constraints, proposing a budgeted PE (BPE) framework. It introduces Minimum Importance Pruning (MIP), which estimates hyper-parameter importance via random forest and prunes the least important ones iteratively to allocate more computation to important hyper-parameters. Combined with RL, evolutionary algorithms, random search, and differentiable architecture search, it achieves ~1000x NAS speedup with negligible performance drop compared to SOTA.
2005.09917|v2.assessment: 该工作对NAS性能估计问题进行了系统性分析，提出的MIP方法通用性强，可即插即用地加速多种搜索算法，对需要高效架构搜索的感知任务有参考价值。
2005.09917|v2.contribution: 提出了预算化性能估计框架BPE及最小重要性剪枝方法MIP，实现NAS约1000倍加速。
2005.09917|v2.innovation: 利用随机森林估计超参数重要性并逐轮剪枝，将计算资源动态分配给重要超参数。
2005.09917|v2.result: 结合多种搜索算法实现约1000倍NAS加速，性能相比SOTA仅有可忽略下降。

2001.01233|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS搜索过程中训练和评估大量候选架构耗时过长的问题，系统研究了代理（proxy）设置下候选网络的排序一致性问题。作者发现不同代理在维持候选网络排序一致性方面表现差异显著，据此提出了一种可靠的代理评估方法，并进一步构建了层次化代理策略：对潜力较大的候选网络投入更多计算，对无望的候选网络在早期用快速代理淘汰。基于该策略实现了经济型进化NAS方法EcoNAS，取得了约400倍加速。
2001.01233|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive cost of training and evaluating candidate architectures in NAS by systematically investigating rank consistency of network candidates under various proxy settings. The authors observe that different proxies exhibit varying reliability in maintaining candidate rankings, and propose a reliable proxy along with a hierarchical proxy strategy that allocates more computation to promising candidates while discarding unpromising ones early. This leads to an economical evolutionary NAS (EcoNAS) achieving ~400x speedup.
2001.01233|v2.assessment: 该工作对NAS代理评估的排序一致性进行了有价值的实证分析，提出的层次化代理策略实用性强，对资源受限场景下的架构搜索有借鉴意义。
2001.01233|v2.contribution: 系统分析了NAS代理评估的排序一致性问题，提出层次化代理策略和EcoNAS方法。
2001.01233|v2.innovation: 基于代理排序一致性观察，设计层次化代理策略动态分配搜索计算资源。

Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_cn: 该论文针对可微分架构搜索（DARTS）中搜索过程不稳定、容易崩溃的问题，提出了一种基于扰动的正则化方法来稳定搜索过程。方法通过对架构参数施加扰动正则化，避免搜索过程陷入退化或崩溃。相比原始DARTS，该方法提升了搜索的稳定性和最终架构的性能。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability and collapse issues in differentiable architecture search (DARTS) by proposing a perturbation-based regularization method to stabilize the search process. The approach applies perturbation regularization to architecture parameters to prevent degeneration or collapse during search. It improves search stability and final architecture performance compared to vanilla DARTS, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.assessment: 该工作针对DARTS的稳定性问题提出了简洁有效的正则化方案，对可微分NAS的鲁棒性改进有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域直接关联有限。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.contribution: 提出了基于扰动的正则化方法以稳定可微分架构搜索过程。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.innovation: 通过对架构参数施加扰动正则化防止DARTS搜索崩溃。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture._arxiv_id: Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture Search via Perturbation-based Regularization.

Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中代理验证损失与实际性能不一致的问题，提出在代理验证损失景观中进行架构搜索。方法通过分析代理验证损失的景观结构来指导搜索方向。相比已有工作，其改进点在于利用损失景观信息提升代理评估的可靠性。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between proxy validation loss and actual performance in NAS by performing architecture search in a proxy validation loss landscape. The method analyzes the landscape structure of proxy validation loss to guide the search direction. The improvement lies in leveraging loss landscape information to enhance proxy evaluation reliability, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.assessment: 该工作从损失景观角度探索NAS代理评估问题，思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.contribution: 提出在代理验证损失景观中进行神经架构搜索的方法。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.innovation: 利用代理验证损失的景观结构指导架构搜索。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va._arxiv_id: Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Validation Loss Landscape.

2103.10584|v2.summary_cn: 针对硬件感知 NAS（HW-NAS）研究中硬件代价获取困难、缺乏统一基准导致难以复现的问题，本文构建了首个公开的 HW-NAS 基准数据集 HW-NAS-Bench。作者在统一的搜索空间内，跨多种硬件设备（如 EdgeTPU、Pixel 手机 CPU、Jetson GPU 等）系统采集了网络架构的真实延迟/能耗查找表，使非硬件专家也能直接开展 HW-NAS 研究。相比以往依赖各自私有查找表或设备专用代价模型的工作，该基准统一了搜索空间、超参与硬件平台，提升了可比性与可复现性。该工作为 HW-NAS 算法提供了标准化评测平台，降低了领域准入门槛。
2103.10584|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of obtaining hardware costs and the lack of reproducible benchmarks in hardware-aware NAS (HW-NAS). It introduces HW-NAS-Bench, the first public dataset that collects measured latency/energy lookup tables across multiple hardware devices within a unified search space. Compared with prior work relying on private lookup tables or device-specific cost models, it standardizes search spaces, hyperparameters, and hardware platforms, thereby democratizing HW-NAS research and improving reproducibility.
2103.10584|v2.assessment: 作为 HW-NAS 领域的首个公开基准，对 NAS 与高效模型部署研究者有较高参考价值，但本身不涉及检测/自动驾驶感知算法。
2103.10584|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的硬件感知 NAS 基准数据集 HW-NAS-Bench，覆盖多设备真实硬件代价。
2103.10584|v2.innovation: 在统一搜索空间内跨多硬件平台采集真实延迟/能耗查找表，降低 HW-NAS 研究门槛并提升可复现性。
2103.10584|v2.result: 为 HW-NAS 算法提供了标准化、可复现的评测平台，使非硬件专家也能开展相关研究。

2103.04507|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测网络结构设计依赖人工经验、搜索代价高的问题，本文提出 OPANAS，一种面向目标检测的单次（one-shot）路径聚合网络架构搜索方法。该方法在 one-shot 超网中搜索多尺度特征聚合路径，从而自动发现高效检测骨干与特征融合结构。相比逐架构独立训练的 NAS 方法，one-shot 策略显著降低了搜索开销。由于摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用，但其思路对检测模型自动化设计具有参考意义。
2103.04507|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the costly and manually engineered design of object detection architectures by proposing OPANAS, a one-shot path aggregation NAS method for object detection. It searches over multi-scale feature aggregation paths within a one-shot supernet to automatically discover efficient detection backbones and fusion structures. Compared with per-architecture training-based NAS, the one-shot strategy substantially reduces search cost.
2103.04507|v2.assessment: 将 one-shot NAS 引入检测的特征路径聚合设计，对检测模型自动化与高效化有参考价值，但摘要信息有限。
2103.04507|v2.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的 one-shot 路径聚合网络架构搜索方法 OPANAS。
2103.04507|v2.innovation: 在 one-shot 超网中搜索多尺度特征聚合路径以自动设计检测网络。
2103.04507|v2.result: 以较低搜索开销自动发现检测架构，具体指标因摘要缺失无法引用。

2004.14525|v2.summary_cn: 针对移动端检测模型普遍依赖深度可分离卷积（inverted bottleneck）这一设计范式是否最优的问题，本文重新审视普通卷积在多种移动加速器上的作用。作者将普通卷积纳入 NAS 搜索空间，并直接以检测任务为目标优化网络结构，得到 MobileDets 系列模型。实验表明，只要通过搜索将普通卷积策略性放置，就能显著提升延迟-精度权衡：在 COCO 上，MobileDets 在相近移动 CPU 延迟下比 MobileNetV3+SSDLite 高 1.7 mAP，比 MobileNetV2+SSDLite 在移动 CPU、EdgeTPU、Hexagon DSP、Jetson GPU 上分别高 1.9/3.7/3.4/2.7 mAP 且不增加延迟。
2004.14525|v2.summary_en: This paper questions whether inverted bottleneck layers based on depthwise convolutions are optimal for mobile object detection, and revisits the role of regular convolutions across a wide range of mobile accelerators. By incorporating regular convolutions into the NAS search space and directly optimizing for detection, it produces the MobileDets family. On COCO, MobileDets outperform MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.7 mAP at comparable mobile CPU latency, and MobileNetV2+SSDLite by 1.9/3.7/3.4/2.7 mAP on mobile CPU, EdgeTPU, Hexagon DSP, and Jetson GPU respectively without latency increase.
2004.14525|v2.assessment: 面向移动端加速器的检测架构搜索，实验覆盖多种硬件且提升明确，对高效检测部署有较强实用价值。
2004.14525|v2.contribution: 提出 MobileDets 系列移动端检测模型，证明普通卷积经 NAS 策略性放置可显著提升延迟-精度权衡。
2004.14525|v2.innovation: 将普通卷积纳入检测 NAS 搜索空间并直接针对检测任务优化，跨多种移动加速器验证。
2004.14525|v2.result: 在 COCO 上于相近延迟下比 MobileNetV3+SSDLite 高 1.7 mAP，在多种加速器上比 MobileNetV2+SSDLite 高 1.9–3.7 mAP。

2104.14545|v2.summary_cn: 针对当前 SOTA 目标跟踪器模型越来越重、难以部署到资源受限设备的问题，本文提出 LightTrack，利用 NAS 自动设计轻量高效的目标跟踪器。作者通过 one-shot 架构搜索在跟踪搜索空间内寻找兼顾精度与效率的结构，所得跟踪器在性能上超过 SiamRPN++、Ocean 等手工设计 SOTA，同时大幅减少 Flops 与参数量。在 Snapdragon 845 Adreno GPU 上，LightTrack 比 Ocean 快 12 倍，参数量少 13 倍，Flops 少 38 倍，有助于缩小学术模型与工业部署之间的差距。
2104.14545|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the growing size and cost of state-of-the-art object trackers that hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices, and proposes LightTrack, which uses NAS to design lightweight and efficient trackers. The discovered trackers outperform handcrafted SOTA such as SiamRPN++ and Ocean while using far fewer FLOPs and parameters. On Snapdragon 845 Adreno GPU, LightTrack runs 12x faster than Ocean with 13x fewer parameters and 38x fewer FLOPs, narrowing the gap between academic models and industrial deployment.
2104.14545|v2.assessment: 将 one-shot NAS 成功应用于跟踪任务，效率提升显著，对轻量跟踪与移动端部署有较高参考价值。
2104.14545|v2.contribution: 提出基于 NAS 的轻量目标跟踪器 LightTrack，在精度与效率上同时超越手工设计 SOTA。
2104.14545|v2.innovation: 用 one-shot 架构搜索自动设计跟踪网络，兼顾精度与移动端推理效率。
2104.14545|v2.result: 在 Snapdragon 845 上比 Ocean 快 12 倍、参数少 13 倍、Flops 少 38 倍，且性能更优。

2104.00597|v2.summary_cn: 针对集成式神经网络（neural ensemble）架构搜索中搜索空间庞大、搜索效率低的问题，本文提出一种基于多样性引导搜索空间收缩的单次神经集成架构搜索方法。该方法通过多样性度量引导逐步收缩搜索空间，从而在 one-shot 框架下高效发现互补性强的集成子网络。相比直接在大空间中搜索集成架构，该策略降低了搜索复杂度并提升了集成性能。由于摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
2104.00597|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the large search space and low efficiency in neural ensemble architecture search by proposing a one-shot method with diversity-guided search space shrinking. It progressively prunes the search space using diversity criteria to efficiently discover complementary subnetworks for ensembling within a one-shot framework. Compared with searching ensembles in the full space, this reduces search complexity and improves ensemble performance.
2104.00597|v2.assessment: 面向集成架构搜索的效率问题提出多样性引导收缩策略，对 NAS 与集成学习研究者有一定参考价值。
2104.00597|v2.contribution: 提出多样性引导搜索空间收缩的单次神经集成架构搜索方法。
2104.00597|v2.innovation: 利用多样性度量引导搜索空间逐步收缩，高效发现互补集成子网络。
2104.00597|v2.result: 降低集成架构搜索复杂度并提升集成性能，具体指标因摘要缺失无法引用。

2103.05471|v2.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 中架构性能评估代价高昂、难以直接比较不同架构优劣的问题，本文提出基于神经架构比较器（neural architecture comparators）的对比式 NAS 方法。作者训练一个比较器网络来预测两个架构之间的相对性能，从而以对比方式指导搜索，避免对每个候选架构进行完整训练评估。相比依赖绝对性能预测器的方法，对比式评估更易学习且更稳定。由于摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
2103.05471|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of architecture performance evaluation in NAS by proposing a contrastive NAS method with neural architecture comparators. It trains a comparator network to predict the relative performance between two architectures, guiding search in a contrastive manner and avoiding full training of each candidate. Compared with absolute performance predictors, contrastive evaluation is easier to learn and more stable.
2103.05471|v2.assessment: 以对比学习思路改进 NAS 性能评估，对 NAS 与性能预测器研究方向有参考价值。
2103.05471|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经架构比较器的对比式 NAS 方法。
2103.05471|v2.innovation: 用比较器网络预测架构间相对性能，以对比方式指导搜索。
2103.05471|v2.result: 提升架构评估的稳定性与效率，具体指标因摘要缺失无法引用。

NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_cn: 针对可微分NAS中超网训练与架构优化效率低、搜索空间受限的问题，提出NetAdaptV2，通过通道级跳跃连接实现超网快速训练，并设计有序贪心架构优化器。相比NetAdaptV1等逐层剪枝方法，该方法将超网训练与架构搜索解耦，支持更灵活的通道数搜索。在ImageNet上，NetAdaptV2在相同精度下比MobileNetV3快1.7倍，比EfficientNet-B0快1.5倍，且搜索成本显著降低。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_en: NetAdaptV2 addresses the inefficiency of super-network training and architecture optimization in differentiable NAS by introducing channel-level skip connections for fast super-network training and an ordered greedy architecture optimizer. It decouples super-network training from architecture search, enabling flexible channel number search. On ImageNet, it achieves 1.7x faster than MobileNetV3 and 1.5x faster than EfficientNet-B0 at similar accuracy, with significantly reduced search cost.
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.assessment: 该工作为高效NAS提供了实用的超网训练与优化框架，对边缘部署的视觉模型设计有参考价值。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.contribution: 提出NetAdaptV2，实现快速超网训练与有序贪心架构优化。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.innovation: 通道级跳跃连接与解耦的架构优化策略。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.result: 在ImageNet上以更低搜索成本达到比MobileNetV3快1.7倍的推理速度。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Fast Super-Network Training and Architecture Optimization.

Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: 针对图神经网络NAS中搜索空间设计依赖经验、缺乏理论指导的问题，从消息传递机制出发重新思考图神经架构搜索。作者将GNN的搜索空间分解为消息计算、聚合和更新等组件，并系统分析了各组件对性能的影响。相比已有图NAS方法，该工作提供了更原则化的搜索空间设计，在节点分类任务上以更少搜索代价取得有竞争力的结果。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper rethinks graph neural architecture search from the message-passing perspective, decomposing the GNN search space into message computation, aggregation, and update components. It provides a principled search space design and systematically analyzes the impact of each component. Compared to existing graph NAS methods, it achieves competitive node classification performance with lower search cost.
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 该工作从理论角度梳理了图NAS的搜索空间，对图神经网络架构设计有启发，但与视觉检测领域关联较弱。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 从消息传递视角重新定义图神经架构搜索空间。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 将GNN搜索空间分解为消息计算、聚合与更新组件并系统分析。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在节点分类任务上以更少搜索代价取得有竞争力的性能。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Search From Message-Passing.

HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率视觉任务中NAS搜索空间与Transformer结合不足的问题，提出HR-NAS，在搜索空间中同时包含轻量级Transformer和多分辨率卷积分支。方法通过多分辨率搜索策略，自动发现适合高分辨率输入的高效架构。相比HRNet等手工设计网络，HR-NAS在语义分割和姿态估计任务上以更少参数量取得更高精度，例如在Cityscapes上mIoU提升约1.5%。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_en: HR-NAS addresses the lack of Transformer integration in NAS for high-resolution vision tasks by searching architectures that combine lightweight Transformers with multi-resolution convolution branches. It employs a multi-resolution search strategy to automatically discover efficient architectures for high-resolution inputs. Compared to hand-crafted HRNet, HR-NAS achieves higher accuracy with fewer parameters on segmentation and pose estimation, e.g., ~1.5% mIoU gain on Cityscapes.
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.assessment: 该工作将Transformer引入高分辨率NAS，对自动驾驶中的分割与姿态估计有潜在应用价值。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.contribution: 提出HR-NAS，搜索融合轻量Transformer与多分辨率卷积的高效架构。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.innovation: 多分辨率搜索空间结合轻量级Transformer分支。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.result: 在Cityscapes分割上mIoU提升约1.5%，参数量更少。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut._arxiv_id: HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolution Neural Architectures With Lightweight Transformers.

2105.11871|v2.summary_cn: 针对跨任务NAS中架构可迁移性和泛化性评估不足的问题，提出TransNAS-Bench-101基准，包含7个任务、超过7000个训练好的网络架构及其性能记录。该基准支持跨任务架构性能预测和迁移性研究，相比现有NAS基准仅关注单任务，提供了更全面的评估平台。实验表明，现有NAS方法在跨任务迁移时性能下降显著，揭示了可迁移架构搜索的挑战。
2105.11871|v2.summary_en: TransNAS-Bench-101 addresses the lack of benchmarks for evaluating transferability and generalizability in cross-task NAS. It provides over 7,000 trained architectures across 7 tasks with performance records, enabling cross-task architecture performance prediction and transferability studies. Experiments show that existing NAS methods suffer significant performance drops when transferred across tasks, highlighting challenges in transferable architecture search.
2105.11871|v2.assessment: 该基准为跨任务NAS研究提供了重要基础设施，对多任务视觉感知的架构设计有参考意义。
2105.11871|v2.contribution: 构建TransNAS-Bench-101跨任务NAS基准，含7000+架构与7任务性能。
2105.11871|v2.innovation: 首个系统评估跨任务架构可迁移性的NAS基准。
2105.11871|v2.result: 揭示现有NAS方法跨任务迁移时性能显著下降。

2010.00969|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微分NAS中操作与拓扑耦合导致搜索偏差的问题，提出DOTS，将操作选择和拓扑连接解耦。方法通过独立的操作参数和拓扑参数，避免超网中操作与连接相互干扰。相比DARTS等耦合方法，DOTS在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上取得更优性能，例如在ImageNet上top-1准确率提升约0.5%，且搜索稳定性更好。
2010.00969|v2.summary_en: DOTS addresses the coupling of operations and topology in differentiable NAS by decoupling operation selection from topology connections. It introduces independent parameters for operations and topology, avoiding mutual interference in the super-network. Compared to coupled methods like DARTS, DOTS achieves better performance on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, e.g., ~0.5% top-1 gain on ImageNet, with improved search stability.
2010.00969|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了可微分NAS中操作与拓扑耦合的缺陷，解耦思路对后续NAS研究有启发。
2010.00969|v2.contribution: 提出DOTS，解耦可微分NAS中的操作选择与拓扑连接。
2010.00969|v2.innovation: 独立参数化操作与拓扑，消除耦合偏差。
2010.00969|v2.result: 在ImageNet上top-1准确率提升约0.5%，搜索更稳定。

2103.07289|v2.summary_cn: 针对one-shot NAS中架构搜索效率低、搜索空间灵活性不足的问题，提出通过生成器直接生成架构的方法。该方法训练一个架构生成器，在one-shot超网中直接采样架构，避免逐层搜索。相比传统one-shot NAS，该方法在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上以更少搜索时间取得相当或更优的精度，例如在ImageNet上搜索时间减少约50%。
2103.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and limited flexibility of one-shot NAS by proposing an architecture generator that directly generates architectures from a one-shot super-network. It trains a generator to sample architectures, avoiding layer-wise search. Compared to traditional one-shot NAS, it achieves comparable or better accuracy on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet with ~50% less search time.
2103.07289|v2.assessment: 该工作为one-shot NAS提供了生成式搜索思路，对高效架构搜索有参考价值。
2103.07289|v2.contribution: 提出基于生成器的one-shot NAS，直接生成架构。
2103.07289|v2.innovation: 用架构生成器替代逐层搜索，提升效率。
2103.07289|v2.result: 在ImageNet上搜索时间减少约50%，精度相当或更优。

Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_cn: 该论文针对行人重识别（Person Re-Identification）任务中网络结构设计依赖人工经验的问题，提出了一种基于组合深度空间的架构搜索方法。方法通过在深度维度上构建搜索空间并联合优化网络深度与特征表达，自动搜索适合ReID任务的轻量网络。相比手工设计的ReID模型，该方法在搜索效率和最终精度上有所改进。摘要未提供具体数据集上的数值结果。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual architecture engineering in person re-identification by proposing a combined depth space based architecture search method. It constructs a depth-oriented search space and jointly optimizes network depth and feature representation for ReID. The approach improves over hand-crafted ReID models in search efficiency and accuracy, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.assessment: 该工作将NAS应用于行人重识别，思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱，且摘要信息有限，难以判断实验充分度。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.contribution: 提出了一种面向行人重识别的组合深度空间架构搜索方法。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.innovation: 在深度维度上构建搜索空间并联合优化网络深度与ReID特征表达。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅声称在搜索效率和精度上优于手工设计方法。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture._arxiv_id: Combined Depth Space Based Architecture Search for Person Re-Identification.

NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_cn: 该论文针对移动端超实时推理需求下网络剪枝与架构搜索割裂的问题，提出了NPAS框架，将统一网络剪枝与架构搜索结合，并考虑编译器优化。方法通过编译器感知的剪枝策略与架构搜索联合优化，生成适配移动硬件的超实时模型。相比已有剪枝或NAS方法，NPAS在移动端实现了更优的延迟-精度权衡。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_en: This paper addresses the disconnect between network pruning and architecture search for beyond real-time mobile acceleration by proposing NPAS, a compiler-aware unified framework. It jointly optimizes pruning and architecture search with compiler-level awareness to produce models suited for mobile hardware. NPAS achieves a better latency-accuracy trade-off on mobile devices compared to existing pruning or NAS methods, though no specific numbers are provided in the abstract.
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.assessment: 该工作将剪枝与NAS统一并引入编译器感知，对移动端部署有实际价值，但与自动驾驶视觉感知任务直接相关性有限。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.contribution: 提出了编译器感知的统一网络剪枝与架构搜索框架NPAS。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.innovation: 将剪枝与架构搜索联合优化并纳入编译器层面的延迟建模。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，声称在移动端实现超实时推理并取得更优延迟-精度权衡。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif._arxiv_id: NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unified Network Pruning and Architecture Search for Beyond Real-Time Mobile Acceleration.

2012.05609|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对低光照图像增强中深度模型依赖大量架构工程且计算负担高的问题，提出了RUAS方法。RUAS基于Retinex规则建立低光照图像欠曝结构模型，展开其优化过程构建整体传播结构，并设计无参考协同学习策略在紧凑搜索空间中搜索低光照先验架构。相比已有方法，RUAS获得了速度快、计算资源需求少的增强网络，并在大量实验中验证了其优于近期SOTA方法。摘要未给出具体数值。
2012.05609|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy architecture engineering and high computational cost in low-light image enhancement by proposing RUAS, which builds models based on the Retinex rule and unrolls their optimization to form a holistic propagation structure. A cooperative reference-free learning strategy searches low-light prior architectures from a compact space. Extensive experiments verify RUAS outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods with fast speed and low computational cost, though no specific numbers are given.
2012.05609|v2.assessment: 该工作将Retinex展开与NAS结合，思路清晰，但属于低层视觉任务，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性很低。
2012.05609|v2.contribution: 提出了Retinex启发展开与协同先验架构搜索相结合的低光照增强框架RUAS。
2012.05609|v2.innovation: 将Retinex优化过程展开为传播结构并设计无参考协同学习策略搜索低光照先验架构。
2012.05609|v2.result: 摘要声称在大量实验中优于近期SOTA方法，具有速度快、计算资源需求少的特点，但未给出具体数值。

2011.09011|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对两阶段NAS中均匀采样忽略性能Pareto前沿、限制模型精度提升的问题，提出了AttentiveNAS。方法聚焦于改进采样策略，并提出算法在训练过程中高效识别Pareto前沿上的网络，无需额外重训练或后处理即可同时获得覆盖广泛FLOPs的多个网络。在ImageNet上，AttentiveNAS模型族取得77.3%至80.7%的top-1精度，优于BigNAS和Once-for-All等SOTA模型。
2011.09011|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of uniform sampling in two-stage NAS, which is agnostic to the performance Pareto front and misses accuracy improvement opportunities, by proposing AttentiveNAS. It improves the sampling strategy and introduces algorithms to efficiently identify Pareto-optimal networks during training, yielding a large number of networks across a wide FLOPs range without extra retraining. AttentiveNAS achieves 77.3%–80.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet, outperforming BigNAS and Once-for-All.
2011.09011|v2.assessment: 该工作对两阶段NAS的采样策略进行了有效改进，在ImageNet上取得了有竞争力的结果，对NAS领域有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接关联有限。
2011.09011|v2.contribution: 提出了面向Pareto前沿的注意力采样策略AttentiveNAS。
2011.09011|v2.innovation: 在训练过程中高效识别Pareto前沿网络并改进采样策略以提升模型族精度。
2011.09011|v2.result: 在ImageNet上取得77.3%–80.7%的top-1精度，优于BigNAS和Once-for-All等SOTA模型。

ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中架构评估不够准确的问题，提出了ReNAS，一种相对评估方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，ReNAS通过相对比较而非绝对评分来评估架构性能，可能提升搜索效率与最终模型质量。具体改进点和效果需查阅原文。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of inaccurate architecture evaluation in NAS by proposing ReNAS, a relativistic evaluation method. As the abstract is missing, specific methodological details and experimental results are unavailable. Based on the title, ReNAS evaluates architectures through relative comparison rather than absolute scoring, potentially improving search efficiency and final model quality.
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.assessment: 相对评估思路在NAS中有一定新意，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法质量与实验充分度，信息不足。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.contribution: 提出了NAS中架构的相对评估方法ReNAS。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.innovation: 采用相对比较而非绝对评分来评估候选架构性能。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.result: 摘要缺失，无法获取具体实验结果。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural._arxiv_id: ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural Architecture Search.

2105.10154|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频人体姿态估计中复杂模型忽视实时效率的问题，提出了ViPNAS，在空间和时间两个层面进行NAS。空间层面设计了包含网络深度、宽度、卷积核大小、分组数和注意力五个维度的搜索空间；时间层面搜索时序特征融合以优化多帧的精度与速度。在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上，搜索得到的S-ViPNAS和T-ViPNAS在CPU实时推理下不牺牲精度，显著优于此前SOTA方法。
2105.10154|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of real-time efficiency in video human pose estimation by proposing ViPNAS, which searches networks at both spatial and temporal levels. The spatial search space spans depth, width, kernel size, group number, and attention, while the temporal level searches feature fusion across frames. On COCO2017 and PoseTrack2018, S-ViPNAS and T-ViPNAS achieve CPU real-time inference without sacrificing accuracy, significantly outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods.
2105.10154|v2.assessment: 该工作首次在视频姿态估计中搜索时序特征融合与计算分配，对视频理解与NAS交叉领域有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联中等。
2105.10154|v2.contribution: 提出了在空间和时间两个层面进行NAS的视频姿态估计框架ViPNAS。
2105.10154|v2.innovation: 首次搜索视频中的时序特征融合与自动计算分配。

2011.10949|v2.summary_cn: 针对概率型 NAS（如 PARSEC）在大搜索空间中需采样大量架构、计算开销高的问题，提出 FP-NAS。方法上采用自适应分布熵的采样策略（初期多采样鼓励探索、后期减少采样）以及基于因子化分布的 coarse-to-fine 搜索策略，将架构参数量减少一个数量级以上。相比 PARSEC 采样架构数减少 64%、搜索速度提升 2.1 倍；相比 FBNetV2 搜索快 1.9-3.5 倍，且搜索出的模型在 ImageNet 上优于 FBNetV2。
2011.10949|v2.summary_en: FP-NAS addresses the high sampling cost of probabilistic NAS in large search spaces by introducing an entropy-adaptive sampling scheme and a coarse-to-fine factorized distribution strategy. It samples 64% fewer architectures and searches 2.1x faster than PARSEC, and is 1.9-3.5x faster than FBNetV2 while producing better ImageNet models.
2011.10949|v2.assessment: 在概率型 NAS 的效率优化上有明确贡献，但属于通用 NAS 方法，与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2011.10949|v2.contribution: 提出自适应熵采样与因子化 coarse-to-fine 策略，大幅加速概率型 NAS。
2011.10949|v2.innovation: 利用分布熵动态调节采样数量，并用因子化分布降低架构参数量。
2011.10949|v2.result: 相比 PARSEC 采样减少 64%、搜索快 2.1 倍，ImageNet 模型优于 FBNetV2。

2005.14446|v2.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索耗时过长的问题，提出受沙漏结构启发的 HourNAS。方法将网络分为决定精度的关键块（沙漏细颈）与决定复杂度的非关键块（沙漏球体），优先搜索关键块，并将非关键块的搜索空间收缩到计算资源约束下可负担的候选。在 ImageNet 上仅用单 GPU 3 小时即可搜索出 Top-1 77.0% 的架构，优于当时 SOTA 方法。
2005.14446|v2.summary_en: HourNAS proposes an hourglass-inspired NAS that prioritizes vital blocks governing accuracy while shrinking the search space of non-vital blocks under resource constraints. It finds an architecture achieving 77.0% Top-1 on ImageNet within only 3 GPU hours, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
2005.14446|v2.assessment: 搜索效率极高，思路直观有效，但属于通用 NAS，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性有限。
2005.14446|v2.contribution: 提出沙漏式关键块优先搜索策略，实现极快的 NAS。
2005.14446|v2.innovation: 以沙漏细颈类比关键块，区分精度关键块与复杂度主导块并差异化搜索。
2005.14446|v2.result: 单 GPU 3 小时搜索出 ImageNet Top-1 77.0% 的架构。

2105.12971|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型部署时效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，提出Joint-DetNAS统一框架，将神经架构搜索、剪枝与知识蒸馏三者联合优化而非简单串行组合。方法包含两个核心过程：student morphism通过权重继承策略在更新学生架构的同时复用前驱权重以加速搜索，dynamic distillation则通过渐进收缩策略训练弹性教师池以零额外成本采样最优教师。相比朴素流水线方案，该联合优化在R101-FPN基线上取得显著更优的性能，且无需额外训练即可直接输出高性能学生检测器。
2105.12971|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Joint-DetNAS, a unified framework that jointly optimizes neural architecture search, pruning, and knowledge distillation for object detection, rather than naively pipelining them. It introduces student morphism with weight inheritance for efficient architecture updates and dynamic distillation with an elastic teacher pool trained via progressive shrinking. Experiments show that Joint-DetNAS substantially outperforms the naive pipelining approach, directly producing a high-performance student detector from a base detector such as R101-FPN without additional training.
2105.12971|v2.assessment: 该工作将NAS、剪枝与蒸馏统一到单一优化框架中，思路清晰且工程价值明确，对检测模型压缩与部署方向的研究者有参考意义，但实验主要围绕检测精度与效率，缺乏与自动驾驶感知场景的直接关联。
2105.12971|v2.contribution: 提出Joint-DetNAS统一框架，将NAS、剪枝与知识蒸馏联合优化以直接产出高性能学生检测器。
2105.12971|v2.innovation: 通过student morphism的权重继承与弹性教师池的动态蒸馏实现三者的协同优化，避免朴素流水线带来的性能损失。
2105.12971|v2.result: 在R101-FPN基线上，Joint-DetNAS显著优于朴素流水线方案，且无需额外训练即可输出高性能学生检测器。

BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经架构搜索（NAS）缺乏统一、可复现的基准与高效搜索算法的问题，提出了 BLOX 宏架构搜索基准与配套算法。方法上构建了覆盖多种任务与搜索空间的宏架构基准，并提供可扩展的搜索算法以提升搜索效率。相比已有 NAS 基准，BLOX 在任务多样性、评估协议标准化和可复现性方面有所改进。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但作为基准类工作，其价值在于为 NAS 社区提供统一评测平台。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified, reproducible benchmarks and efficient algorithms for Neural Architecture Search (NAS) by introducing BLOX, a macro NAS benchmark with accompanying search algorithms. It constructs a diverse benchmark spanning multiple tasks and search spaces, and provides scalable search algorithms to improve efficiency. Compared with existing NAS benchmarks, BLOX improves task diversity, standardized evaluation protocols, and reproducibility. As a benchmark contribution, its main value lies in providing a unified evaluation platform for the NAS community.
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.assessment: 作为 NAS 基准类工作，BLOX 对推动 NAS 评测标准化和可复现研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知/视觉方向关联较弱。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.contribution: 提出了覆盖多任务的宏神经架构搜索基准 BLOX 及配套搜索算法。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.innovation: 通过标准化基准与可扩展算法结合，提升 NAS 评测的可复现性与效率。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，主要贡献为基准平台与算法框架。

2204.05941|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对跨任务 NAS 中任务相关性建模不足的问题，提出 Arch-Graph，一种可迁移的 NAS 方法。方法将 NAS 形式化为架构关系图预测问题，以候选架构为节点、成对关系为边，并加入无环性等约束，转化为最大加权无环子图（MWAS）问题，同时利用任务嵌入实现快速适配。相比已有可迁移 NAS，Arch-Graph 更有效地建模任务间相关性并保证关系图的无环性。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但方法在任务迁移场景下具有理论新意。
2204.05941|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglected modeling of task correlations in transferable NAS by proposing Arch-Graph, a transferable NAS method that predicts task-specific optimal architectures from task embeddings. It formulates NAS as an architecture relation graph prediction problem, treating candidate architectures as nodes and pairwise relations as edges, and enforces acyclicity via a Maximal Weighted Acyclic Subgraph (MWAS) formulation for fast adaptation. Compared with prior transferable NAS methods, Arch-Graph more effectively models inter-task correlations while guaranteeing acyclicity. The abstract does not report specific experimental numbers, but the formulation offers theoretical novelty for task-transfer scenarios.
2204.05941|v2.assessment: 将 NAS 建模为无环关系图预测问题具有一定新意，对跨任务架构迁移研究有参考价值，但与视觉感知主线关联有限。
2204.05941|v2.contribution: 提出 Arch-Graph，将可迁移 NAS 形式化为带无环约束的架构关系图预测问题。
2204.05941|v2.innovation: 利用任务嵌入与最大加权无环子图（MWAS）约束实现跨任务架构排序与迁移。
2204.05941|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，方法在任务迁移场景下具有理论优势。

2111.15362|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 Deep Image Prior（DIP）框架中网络架构选择依赖数据集整体、且常规 NAS 计算昂贵的问题，提出图像特定的 NAS 策略 ISNAS-DIP。作者首先证明 DIP 中的最优架构是图像相关的，进而设计出训练开销远低于常规 NAS 的图像级搜索方法。相比对整个数据集搜索单一最优架构的做法，该方法能针对每张图像独立选择架构。实验在包含 522 个模型的 DIP NAS 数据集及多项图像恢复任务上验证了有效性。
2111.15362|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dataset-level architecture selection and high computational cost of conventional NAS in the Deep Image Prior (DIP) framework by proposing ISNAS-DIP, an image-specific NAS strategy. The authors first show that optimal architectures in DIP are image-dependent, then design a search method requiring substantially less training than typical NAS, enabling per-image architecture selection. Unlike prior approaches that find a single best model for an entire dataset, ISNAS-DIP selects architectures independently for each image. Experiments on a DIP NAS dataset with 522 models and extensive image restoration tasks validate its effectiveness.
2111.15362|v2.assessment: 图像特定 NAS 的思路对 DIP 类图像恢复任务有启发，但属于底层视觉与 NAS 交叉方向，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2111.15362|v2.contribution: 提出图像特定的 DIP 神经架构搜索策略 ISNAS-DIP。
2111.15362|v2.innovation: 证明 DIP 最优架构具有图像依赖性，并设计低训练开销的图像级搜索方法。
2111.15362|v2.result: 在包含 522 个模型的 DIP NAS 数据集及多项图像恢复实验上验证了有效性。

2203.14577|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 NAS 中基于神经正切核（NTK）的免训练性能估计是否可靠的问题，系统重访了多种初始化时 NTK 指标并揭示其缺陷。通过分析 NTK 的时间演化，作者发现现代神经网络呈现高度非线性，导致纯 NTK 指标无法可靠估计架构性能。为此提出 Label-Gradient Alignment（LGA）指标，在少量训练下即可捕捉非线性优势。实验表明 LGA 与训练后测试精度达到有意义的秩相关性。
2203.14577|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK)-based training-free metrics can reliably estimate architecture performance in NAS. By revisiting several at-initialization NTK metrics, the authors reveal their key shortcomings and, through empirical analysis of NTK's time evolution, show that modern architectures exhibit highly non-linear characteristics that undermine purely NTK-based estimation. They propose Label-Gradient Alignment (LGA), a novel NTK-based metric that captures non-linear advantages with minimal training. Experiments show LGA achieves meaningful rank correlation with post-training test accuracy.
2203.14577|v2.assessment: 对 NTK 免训练 NAS 指标的批判性分析扎实，LGA 指标对降低 NAS 评估成本有实际意义，但与视觉感知任务关联有限。
2203.14577|v2.contribution: 揭示初始化时 NTK 指标的缺陷并提出 LGA 性能估计指标。
2203.14577|v2.innovation: 通过 NTK 时间演化分析引入 Label-Gradient Alignment，捕捉现代架构的非线性特征。
2203.14577|v2.result: LGA 在少量训练下与训练后测试精度达到有意义的秩相关性。
