The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_cn: 针对光流和单目深度估计任务，本文探索扩散模型的有效性，提出利用扩散模型进行光流和深度估计的方法。方法将扩散模型作为生成式先验，通过条件生成实现稠密预测。相比已有判别式方法，扩散模型展现出令人惊讶的竞争力，甚至超越专用方法。在KITTI、Sintel等基准上取得了与最先进方法相当或更优的结果，揭示了扩散模型在几何感知任务中的潜力。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_en: This paper investigates the surprising effectiveness of diffusion models for optical flow and monocular depth estimation. The method leverages diffusion models as generative priors for dense prediction via conditional generation. Compared to discriminative approaches, diffusion models show competitive or superior performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on KITTI and Sintel, revealing their potential for geometric perception.
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.assessment: 将扩散模型成功应用于光流和深度估计，挑战了判别式方法的统治地位，对视觉几何感知研究者有重要启发。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.contribution: 证明扩散模型在光流和单目深度估计任务上具有令人惊讶的有效性。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.innovation: 将扩散模型作为生成式先验用于稠密几何预测，超越专用判别式方法。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.result: 在KITTI、Sintel等基准上取得与最先进方法相当或更优的结果。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio._arxiv_id: The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusion Models for Optical Flow and Monocular Depth Estimation.

IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中离散化方法精度不足的问题，本文提出迭代弹性分箱（IEBins），通过迭代细化深度分箱提升估计精度。方法采用弹性分箱策略，在迭代过程中自适应调整分箱边界，逐步逼近真实深度分布。相比固定分箱或均匀分箱方法，IEBins能更灵活地适应不同深度范围。在KITTI等基准上取得了最先进的单目深度估计性能，验证了迭代弹性分箱的有效性。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited precision of discretization in monocular depth estimation by proposing Iterative Elastic Bins (IEBins), which iteratively refines depth bins. The method employs elastic binning to adaptively adjust bin boundaries, progressively approximating the true depth distribution. Compared to fixed or uniform binning, IEBins adapts more flexibly, achieving state-of-the-art results on KITTI.
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.assessment: 深度离散化是单目深度估计的关键环节，IEBins通过迭代弹性分箱显著提升精度，对相关研究者有较高参考价值。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.contribution: 提出迭代弹性分箱（IEBins）用于单目深度估计，通过迭代细化深度分箱提升精度。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.innovation: 采用弹性分箱策略，在迭代中自适应调整分箱边界以逼近真实深度分布。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得最先进的单目深度估计性能。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc._arxiv_id: IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monocular Depth Estimation.

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督单目深度估计中物体边缘深度不准确、边界模糊的问题，本文提出在边缘区域精细化深度预测的方法。方法通过识别深度不连续区域并施加针对性监督/损失，改善边缘处的深度锐度。相比已有稀疏监督方法，主要改进在于显式建模并优化深度边缘。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate and blurred depth at object boundaries in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes to explicitly identify depth-discontinuity regions and refine depth edges with targeted supervision. The main improvement over prior sparsely-supervised methods is explicit edge-aware optimization, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 边缘深度是单目深度估计的常见痛点，该工作针对性强，但需看实验是否带来实质提升。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出面向稀疏监督单目深度估计的深度边缘精细化方法。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 显式建模并优化深度不连续/边缘区域。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计问题，本文提出复用基于扩散的图像生成器（如 Stable Diffusion）来做深度估计。方法利用预训练扩散模型的强先验，将其改造为深度预测器（Marigold 类思路）。相比从零训练或纯判别式方法，改进在于借助生成模型先验提升泛化与零样本能力。摘要未给出具体数据。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This paper repurposes diffusion-based image generators for monocular depth estimation. It leverages the strong priors of pretrained diffusion models and adapts them into a depth predictor. The improvement over prior work lies in exploiting generative priors for better generalization and zero-shot performance, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 将扩散生成先验迁移到深度估计是当前热点方向，思路新颖且泛化潜力大，值得关注。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 提出复用扩散图像生成器进行单目深度估计的框架。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 利用预训练扩散模型的生成先验做深度预测。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera._arxiv_id: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation.

PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率单目度量深度估计中全局一致性与局部细节难以兼顾的问题，本文提出 PatchFusion，一个端到端的基于瓦片（tile）的框架。方法将高分辨率图像分块处理并融合，以在保持度量精度的同时提升细节。相比已有方法，改进在于端到端的分块融合策略。摘要未给出具体数据。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_en: This paper targets high-resolution monocular metric depth estimation, where global consistency and local detail are hard to balance. It proposes PatchFusion, an end-to-end tile-based framework that processes and fuses image patches. The improvement lies in an end-to-end patch fusion strategy, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.assessment: 高分辨率度量深度在自动驾驶感知中有实用价值，分块融合思路合理，需看精度与效率权衡。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.contribution: 提出端到端瓦片式高分辨率单目度量深度估计框架 PatchFusion。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.innovation: 端到端的分块处理与融合策略。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr._arxiv_id: PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Framework for High-Resolution Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中动态物体深度估计困难的问题，本文提出利用地面接触先验进行由粗到细的动态物体深度估计。方法借助物体与地面的接触关系作为先验，逐步细化动态区域深度。相比已有自监督方法，改进在于引入地面接触先验处理动态物体。摘要未给出具体数据。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of depth estimation for dynamic objects in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a coarse-to-fine approach that leverages ground-contact priors to refine depth of dynamic objects. The improvement over prior self-supervised methods is the use of ground-contact priors, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.assessment: 动态物体是自监督深度估计的难点，地面接触先验是合理切入点，对自动驾驶场景有意义。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.contribution: 提出基于地面接触先验的由粗到细动态物体自监督单目深度估计。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.innovation: 引入地面接触先验处理动态区域深度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S._arxiv_id: From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation of Dynamic Objects with Ground Contact Prior.

Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中动态区域监督信号不足的问题，本文提出为动态区域挖掘监督信号的方法。方法通过挖掘/构造动态区域的额外监督来提升其深度估计质量。相比已有自监督方法，改进在于专门针对动态区域增强监督。摘要未给出具体数据。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient supervision for dynamic regions in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes to mine supervision signals specifically for dynamic regions to improve their depth quality. The improvement over prior self-supervised methods is the dedicated supervision mining for dynamic areas, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.assessment: 与第4篇同属动态区域自监督深度方向，思路互补，对自动驾驶动态场景有价值。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.contribution: 提出为动态区域挖掘监督信号的自监督单目深度估计方法。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.innovation: 针对动态区域挖掘额外监督信号。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i._arxiv_id: Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions in Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计问题，本文提出 ECoDepth，通过有效条件化（conditioning）扩散模型来做深度估计。方法设计有效的条件机制，将图像信息注入扩散过程以生成深度。相比已有扩散深度方法，改进在于更有效的条件化设计。摘要未给出具体数据。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_en: This paper proposes ECoDepth, which effectively conditions diffusion models for monocular depth estimation. It designs an effective conditioning mechanism to inject image information into the diffusion process for depth generation. The improvement over prior diffusion-based depth methods lies in more effective conditioning, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.assessment: 扩散模型做深度估计是热点，条件化设计是关键，若实验充分则具参考价值。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.contribution: 提出有效条件化扩散模型的单目深度估计方法 ECoDepth。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.innovation: 面向深度估计的有效扩散条件化机制。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff._arxiv_id: ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diffusion Models for Monocular Depth Estimation.

UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计在跨场景泛化性差、难以输出度量尺度深度的问题，本文提出 UniDepth，一个通用的单目度量深度估计框架。方法通过自提示相机模块预测相机内参，并结合几何不变性设计伪球面输出表示，使模型无需相机内参即可输出度量深度。相比已有方法需针对特定数据集微调或依赖已知内参，UniDepth 在多个零样本基准上取得领先，跨数据集泛化误差显著降低。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor cross-domain generalization and metric ambiguity of monocular depth estimation by proposing UniDepth, a universal metric depth estimation framework. It introduces a self-prompted camera module to predict intrinsics and a pseudo-spherical output representation enforcing geometric invariance, enabling metric depth without camera parameters. UniDepth achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across multiple benchmarks, substantially reducing cross-dataset errors compared to prior methods.
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.assessment: 该工作对单目度量深度估计的泛化性问题给出了系统性方案，零样本跨域表现突出，对自动驾驶感知中的深度估计有直接参考价值。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.contribution: 提出无需相机内参、可零样本泛化的通用单目度量深度估计框架 UniDepth。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.innovation: 自提示相机模块与伪球面几何不变输出表示的联合设计。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.result: 在多个零样本基准上取得领先，跨数据集泛化误差显著降低。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep._arxiv_id: UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计在病态区域（如天空、遮挡）预测不可靠的问题，本文提出 WorDepth，利用语言先验作为变分条件来约束深度估计。方法将文本描述作为变分先验注入深度网络，通过条件变分推断提升深度预测的合理性与鲁棒性。相比纯视觉方法，WorDepth 在深度估计精度和病态区域表现上有所改善。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_en: This paper tackles unreliable depth predictions in ill-posed regions by proposing WorDepth, which leverages language priors as variational conditions for monocular depth estimation. It injects textual descriptions as a variational prior into the depth network via conditional variational inference. WorDepth improves depth accuracy and robustness in ill-posed regions compared to vision-only baselines.
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.assessment: 将语言先验引入单目深度估计的思路新颖，但整体增益有限，属于探索性工作。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.contribution: 提出以语言先验为变分条件的单目深度估计方法 WorDepth。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.innovation: 将文本描述作为变分先验注入深度网络以约束病态区域预测。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.result: 在深度精度与病态区域鲁棒性上较纯视觉方法有所提升。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for._arxiv_id: WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for Monocular Depth Estimation.

MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 目标检测模型在测试时遇到域偏移（如不同数据集、天气）性能下降的问题，本文提出 MonoTTA，首个面向单目 3D 检测的全测试时自适应框架。方法通过设计针对深度与 3D 框的伪标签与自训练策略，在无源数据、无标签条件下在线更新模型。相比已有 TTA 方法主要面向 2D 任务，MonoTTA 在多个跨域基准上显著提升检测精度。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of monocular 3D detectors under test-time domain shifts by proposing MonoTTA, the first fully test-time adaptation framework for monocular 3D object detection. It designs depth- and box-aware pseudo-labeling and self-training strategies to update the model online without source data or labels. MonoTTA substantially improves detection accuracy on multiple cross-domain benchmarks compared to prior TTA methods designed for 2D tasks.
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.assessment: 首次将全测试时自适应引入单目 3D 检测，问题设定贴近实际部署，方法有效且实验充分，值得关注。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.contribution: 提出首个面向单目 3D 目标检测的全测试时自适应框架 MonoTTA。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.innovation: 针对深度与 3D 框的伪标签与自训练在线自适应策略。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.result: 在多个跨域基准上显著提升单目 3D 检测精度。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for._arxiv_id: MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2407.16448|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有单目 3D 检测方法主要在理想天气下工作、难以应对雾天等恶劣天气的问题，本文提出 MonoWAD，一种天气鲁棒的单目 3D 检测器。方法包含天气码本（记忆晴天知识并为任意输入生成天气参考特征）和天气自适应扩散模型（依据天气条件增强输入特征），并引入天气自适应增强损失。在多种天气条件下实验表明 MonoWAD 达到天气鲁棒的单目 3D 检测性能。
2407.16448|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that existing monocular 3D detectors mainly operate under ideal weather by proposing MonoWAD, a weather-robust monocular 3D detector with a weather-adaptive diffusion model. It comprises a weather codebook that memorizes clear-weather knowledge to generate weather-reference features, and a weather-adaptive diffusion model that enhances input features conditioned on weather, trained with a weather-adaptive enhancement loss. Extensive experiments under various weather conditions demonstrate weather-robust monocular 3D detection.
2407.16448|v2.assessment: 将扩散模型与码本机制用于天气鲁棒的单目 3D 检测，问题设定贴近自动驾驶实际需求，方法有创新性。
2407.16448|v2.contribution: 提出天气鲁棒的单目 3D 检测器 MonoWAD。
2407.16448|v2.innovation: 天气码本与天气自适应扩散模型联合增强特征表示。
2407.16448|v2.result: 在多种天气条件下实现天气鲁棒的单目 3D 检测。

GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中尺度模糊、地面区域深度不准的问题，本文提出 GroCo，利用地面约束实现度量自监督单目深度估计。方法通过检测地面平面并施加几何约束，将相对深度恢复为度量尺度。相比已有自监督方法，GroCo 在度量深度精度上有所提升，且无需额外标注。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_en: This paper addresses scale ambiguity and inaccurate ground-region depth in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing GroCo, which enforces a ground constraint for metric depth. It detects the ground plane and applies geometric constraints to recover metric scale from relative depth. GroCo improves metric depth accuracy over prior self-supervised methods without extra annotations.
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.assessment: 利用地面几何约束解决自监督深度尺度问题，思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶场景有实用价值。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.contribution: 提出基于地面约束的度量自监督单目深度估计方法 GroCo。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.innovation: 通过地面平面检测与几何约束恢复度量尺度。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.result: 在度量深度精度上优于已有自监督方法。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self._arxiv_id: GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self-supervised Monocular Depth.

2408.00361|v2.summary_cn: 针对富资源输入（高分辨率、多帧）的自监督单目深度估计方法在推理时受限于输入可用性的问题，本文提出 RPrDepth，仅需单张低分辨率图像即可达到接近富资源方法的精度。方法将富资源数据离线提取为参考特征，推理时从参考特征中检索相似像素作为先验辅助深度估计。实验表明其优于其他单图方法，并可媲美甚至超越富资源输入方法。
2408.00361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited applicability of rich-resource self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing RPrDepth, which requires only a single low-resolution image at inference yet achieves accuracy comparable to rich-resource methods. It extracts rich-resource data as reference features offline and retrieves similar pixels as priors during single-image depth estimation. Experiments show it outperforms other single-image methods and matches or surpasses rich-resource baselines.
2408.00361|v2.assessment: 以离线先验检索替代推理时富资源输入，兼顾精度与实用性，对部署友好的深度估计有参考意义。
2408.00361|v2.contribution: 提出仅需单张低分辨率图像即可逼近富资源精度的深度估计器 RPrDepth。
2408.00361|v2.innovation: 将富资源数据离线提取为参考特征并在线检索相似像素作为先验。
2408.00361|v2.result: 优于其他单图方法，可媲美甚至超越富资源输入方法。

Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中自监督单帧与多帧方法割裂、多帧方法依赖位姿估计且泛化受限的问题，提出统一学习框架 Mono-ViFI。该方法通过虚拟特征交互与统一训练范式，将单帧与多帧自监督深度估计整合到同一框架中，减少对额外位姿网络的依赖。相比已有单帧或多帧独立方案，Mono-ViFI 在 KITTI 等基准上取得更优或相当的深度精度，同时提升跨数据集泛化能力。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation between self-supervised single-frame and multi-frame monocular depth estimation, where multi-frame methods often rely on pose estimation and generalize poorly. Mono-ViFI introduces a unified learning framework with virtual feature interaction to jointly train single- and multi-frame depth estimators without extra pose networks. It achieves competitive or superior depth accuracy on KITTI and improved cross-dataset generalization compared to separate single- or multi-frame baselines.
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.assessment: 统一单帧与多帧自监督深度估计的框架思路清晰，对自动驾驶单目感知有直接参考价值。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.contribution: 提出统一的自监督单帧与多帧单目深度估计学习框架 Mono-ViFI。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.innovation: 通过虚拟特征交互与统一训练范式整合单帧和多帧深度估计，减少对位姿估计的依赖。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.result: 在 KITTI 等基准上取得有竞争力的深度精度并提升跨数据集泛化能力。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework._arxiv_id: Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework for Self-supervised Single and Multi-frame Monocular Depth Estimation.

2403.11192|v2.summary_cn: 针对腹腔镜手术去烟雾中真实配对数据难以获取、合成烟雾泛化差以及单图像非配对方法难以处理浓烟的问题，提出自监督手术视频去烟雾方法 SelfSVD。该方法利用高能设备激活前的清晰帧（PS 帧）作为监督信号，并引入掩码策略和正则项避免平凡解。作者构建了覆盖多种烟雾场景的真实手术视频数据集，实验表明 SelfSVD 能更有效、高效地去除烟雾并恢复更多细节。
2403.11192|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles laparoscopic surgery desmoking where real paired data are scarce, synthetic smoke generalizes poorly, and unpaired single-image methods struggle with dense smoke. SelfSVD leverages pre-smoke (PS) frames captured before high-energy device activation as supervision and introduces a masking strategy and regularization to avoid trivial solutions. The authors build a real surgery video dataset covering diverse smoky scenes, and experiments show SelfSVD removes smoke more effectively and efficiently while recovering more details.
2403.11192|v2.assessment: 医学视频去烟雾任务与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但自监督视频恢复思路有一定借鉴意义。
2403.11192|v2.contribution: 提出基于术前清晰帧监督的自监督手术视频去烟雾框架 SelfSVD 并构建真实数据集。
2403.11192|v2.innovation: 利用高能设备激活前的清晰帧作为监督，结合掩码策略与正则项实现真实场景自监督去烟雾。
2403.11192|v2.result: 在自建真实手术视频数据集上更有效高效地去烟并恢复更多细节。

Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题，提出基于稳定化对抗训练的域泛化改进方法。该方法将对抗训练引入自监督深度估计流程，并通过稳定化策略缓解对抗训练的不稳定性，从而提升模型在未见域上的深度预测鲁棒性。相比标准自监督训练，该方法在多个跨域基准上显著降低深度误差，提升域泛化性能。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor domain generalization of self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a stabilized adversarial training scheme that integrates adversarial perturbations into the self-supervised depth pipeline while mitigating training instability. Compared with standard self-supervised training, the method significantly reduces depth errors on multiple cross-domain benchmarks, improving generalization to unseen domains.
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.assessment: 将对抗训练稳定化用于自监督深度估计域泛化，对自动驾驶跨域部署有实际意义。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.contribution: 提出稳定化对抗训练以提升自监督单目深度估计的域泛化能力。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.innovation: 通过稳定化策略将对抗训练有效融入自监督深度估计，缓解训练不稳定问题。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.result: 在多个跨域基准上显著降低深度误差，提升未见域泛化性能。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-._arxiv_id: Improving Domain Generalization in Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation via Stabilized Adversarial Training.

Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_cn: 针对 LiDAR 3D 检测中类别不平衡导致稀有类别检测性能差的问题，提出通过伪 LiDAR 点云增强来缓解类别不平衡。该方法以低成本方式生成稀有类别的伪点云样本并加入训练，从而在不显著增加标注成本的前提下改善长尾分布下的检测性能。实验表明该方法能有效提升稀有类别的检测精度，同时保持整体性能。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_en: This paper tackles the class-imbalance problem in LiDAR-based 3D detection, where rare classes suffer from poor performance. It proposes augmenting pseudo-LiDAR point clouds with a low-cost strategy to generate samples of rare classes for training. Experiments show improved detection accuracy for rare classes while maintaining overall performance, demonstrating an effective and economical solution.
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.assessment: 以低成本伪点云增强解决 3D 检测长尾问题，思路实用，对自动驾驶稀有目标检测有参考价值。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.contribution: 提出基于伪 LiDAR 点云增强的类别不平衡缓解方法。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.innovation: 以极低成本生成稀有类别伪点云样本并融入训练，改善长尾分布下的 3D 检测。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.result: 有效提升稀有类别检测精度并保持整体性能。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li._arxiv_id: Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-LiDAR Point Cloud for Resolving Class-imbalance Problem.

2406.12849|v2.summary_cn: 针对 360 度全景图像深度估计中透视模型因投影畸变失效、而全景方法受限于标注数据稀缺的问题，提出利用无标注 360 度数据的深度估计框架 Depth Anywhere。该方法以先进透视深度模型为教师，通过六面立方体投影生成伪标签，并结合离线无效区域掩码生成与在线半监督联合训练。在 Matterport3D 和 Stanford2D3D 上，尤其在零样本场景下，深度估计精度显著提升，且该训练流程可增强任意 360 度单目深度估计器。
2406.12849|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 360-degree monocular depth estimation, where perspective models fail due to projection distortion and 360 methods suffer from scarce labeled data. Depth Anywhere uses state-of-the-art perspective depth models as teachers to generate pseudo labels via six-face cube projection, combined with offline invalid-region masking and online semi-supervised joint training. On Matterport3D and Stanford2D3D, it significantly improves depth accuracy, especially in zero-shot settings, and can enhance any 360 monocular depth estimator.
2406.12849|v2.assessment: 利用透视蒸馏与无标注数据增强 360 深度估计，对全景感知与自动驾驶环视有借鉴意义。
2406.12849|v2.contribution: 提出利用透视模型蒸馏与无标注 360 数据增强的全景单目深度估计框架 Depth Anywhere。
2406.12849|v2.innovation: 通过六面立方体投影生成伪标签并结合半监督联合训练，有效利用无标注 360 度数据。
2406.12849|v2.result: 在 Matterport3D 和 Stanford2D3D 上显著提升深度精度，零样本场景尤为明显。

2405.07696|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 检测中普遍存在的物体遮挡导致尺寸、深度和朝向预测退化的问题，提出受掩码自编码器启发的检测器 MonoMAE。该方法包含深度感知掩码和轻量查询补全两个设计：前者根据深度信息自适应地掩码非遮挡物体查询以模拟遮挡，后者学习重建被掩码的查询。通过物体遮挡与补全学习，MonoMAE 在遮挡与非遮挡场景下均取得更优的单目 3D 检测性能。
2405.07696|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses pervasive object occlusion in monocular 3D detection, which degrades predictions of object dimensions, depths, and orientations. MonoMAE, inspired by masked autoencoders, introduces depth-aware masking that adaptively masks non-occluded object queries based on depth to simulate occlusion, and lightweight query completion that reconstructs masked queries. By learning object occlusion and completion, MonoMAE achieves superior monocular 3D detection performance for both occluded and non-occluded objects.
2405.07696|v2.assessment: 将 MAE 思想引入单目 3D 检测以显式建模遮挡，创新性强，对自动驾驶单目感知有重要参考价值。
2405.07696|v2.contribution: 提出深度感知掩码自编码器框架 MonoMAE 用于单目 3D 检测中的遮挡建模。
2405.07696|v2.innovation: 设计深度感知掩码与轻量查询补全，在特征空间模拟并重建遮挡物体查询。
2405.07696|v2.result: 在遮挡与非遮挡场景下均取得更优的单目 3D 检测性能。

MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_cn: 单目3D检测在训练数据中目标放置分布不均衡时性能下降，现有方法缺乏对3D空间布局的显式建模。MonoPlace3D提出学习3D感知的目标放置策略，通过生成合理的3D位置来增强训练样本的多样性。相比已有单目3D检测方法，该方法在数据增强层面引入3D几何先验，提升了模型对稀疏或异常放置场景的鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体数据集和数值结果。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_en: Monocular 3D detection suffers from imbalanced object placement distributions in training data, and existing methods lack explicit modeling of 3D spatial layouts. MonoPlace3D learns a 3D-aware object placement strategy to augment training samples with plausible 3D positions. This introduces 3D geometric priors at the data augmentation level, improving robustness to sparse or unusual placements. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.assessment: 该工作从数据增强角度切入单目3D检测的长尾放置问题，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际检测精度提升幅度。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.contribution: 提出学习3D感知目标放置策略以增强单目3D检测训练数据。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.innovation: 将3D几何先验引入目标放置学习，而非仅依赖2D图像增强。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.result: 摘要未报告具体数据集上的数值提升。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl._arxiv_id: MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Placement for 3D Monocular Detection.

2509.00649|v2.summary_cn: 多视角3D人体姿态估计在新相机配置下泛化能力差，现有注意力Transformer难以准确建模关键点空间排列且易过拟合训练场景。MV-SSM提出多视角状态空间建模框架，在特征级和人体关键点级两个层次显式建模联合空间序列，并设计投影状态空间块与网格令牌引导双向扫描机制。实验表明该方法在新相机配置下泛化性强，超越现有最优方法。
2509.00649|v2.summary_en: Multi-view 3D human pose estimation struggles to generalize to new camera configurations, as attention-based transformers poorly model keypoint spatial arrangements and overfit training scenes. MV-SSM introduces a multi-view state space modeling framework that explicitly models joint spatial sequences at both feature and keypoint levels, with a Projective State Space block and Grid Token-guided Bidirectional Scanning. Experiments show strong generalization and state-of-the-art performance.
2509.00649|v2.assessment: 将Mamba状态空间模型引入多视角3D人体姿态估计，在泛化性上有明确改进，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关度中等。
2509.00649|v2.contribution: 提出MV-SSM多视角状态空间建模框架用于鲁棒3D人体关键点估计。
2509.00649|v2.innovation: 设计投影状态空间块与网格令牌引导双向扫描，显式建模跨视角空间序列。
2509.00649|v2.result: 在新相机配置下泛化性显著优于现有最优方法。

2503.14483|v2.summary_cn: 单目深度估计因任务歧义导致深度值不准确，限制了其在多视角几何重建中的直接应用。本文提出将SfM提供的多视角先验融入深度估计过程，提升深度预测质量并直接用于多视角重建。在公开真实数据集上，深度估计质量显著优于先前单目方法，且在室内、街景和航拍场景中重建质量超越现有最优MVS方法。
2503.14483|v2.summary_en: Monocular depth estimation suffers from inherent ambiguity, limiting its direct use in multi-view reconstruction. This paper incorporates SfM multi-view priors into the depth estimation process to improve depth quality and enable direct application in geometric reconstruction. Experiments on real-world datasets show significant depth improvement and reconstruction quality surpassing state-of-the-art MVS methods across indoor, street, and aerial scenes.
2503.14483|v2.assessment: 将SfM先验与单目深度估计结合以提升多视角重建，思路务实，对自动驾驶街景重建有参考价值。
2503.14483|v2.contribution: 提出SfM引导的单目深度估计方法用于高质量多视角几何重建。
2503.14483|v2.innovation: 将SfM多视角先验显式融入深度估计，弥合单目深度与MVS重建之间的鸿沟。
2503.14483|v2.result: 深度估计质量显著提升，重建质量在室内、街景、航拍场景超越SOTA MVS方法。

2411.18613|v2.summary_cn: 从单目视频创建4D动态3D场景是生成与重建的难题，现有方法难以在任意相机位姿和时间戳下合成新视角。CAT4D训练多视角视频扩散模型，结合新采样方法将单目视频转化为多视角视频，并通过优化可变形3D高斯表示实现鲁棒4D重建。在新视角合成和动态场景重建基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并展示了从真实或生成视频创建4D场景的创意能力。
2411.18613|v2.summary_en: Creating 4D dynamic scenes from monocular video is challenging, especially for novel view synthesis at arbitrary camera poses and timestamps. CAT4D trains a multi-view video diffusion model with a novel sampling approach to transform a single monocular video into multi-view video, enabling robust 4D reconstruction via deformable 3D Gaussian optimization. It achieves competitive performance on novel view synthesis and dynamic reconstruction benchmarks.
2411.18613|v2.assessment: 多视角视频扩散与可变形3D高斯结合的4D生成工作，技术路线完整，对自动驾驶场景仿真与数据生成有潜在价值。
2411.18613|v2.contribution: 提出CAT4D从单目视频生成4D动态场景的多视角视频扩散框架。
2411.18613|v2.innovation: 结合多视角视频扩散模型与可变形3D高斯优化实现任意位姿和时间的4D重建。
2411.18613|v2.result: 在新视角合成和动态场景重建基准上取得有竞争力性能。

GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_cn: 自监督单目深度估计中，逐点建模方式忽略了局部平面结构先验，导致深度边界模糊和平面区域不平滑。GeoDepth提出从点对点建模转向平面对平面建模，利用几何平面先验约束深度估计。相比已有自监督方法，该方法在深度精度和几何一致性上有望提升。摘要未提供具体数值结果。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation typically models point-to-point relations, ignoring local planar structure priors and causing blurred boundaries and non-smooth planar regions. GeoDepth shifts from point-to-depth to plane-to-depth modeling, leveraging geometric plane priors to constrain depth estimation. It is expected to improve depth accuracy and geometric consistency over existing self-supervised methods, though quantitative results are not provided.
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.assessment: 从点建模转向平面建模的思路对自监督深度估计有启发，但摘要缺乏实验数据，需关注其实际效果。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.contribution: 提出GeoDepth将自监督单目深度估计从点对点建模转为平面对平面建模。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.innovation: 引入几何平面先验约束深度估计，改善平面区域和边界质量。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t._arxiv_id: GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-to-Depth Modeling for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.06359|v2.summary_cn: 事件相机适合资源受限的敏捷机器人，但基于对比度最大化的自监督在线学习面临计算效率与感知性能的平衡难题。本文优化对比度最大化流程的时间和内存效率，使低延迟单目深度估计可在设备端在线学习。实验表明，小型无人机在线学习比仅预训练获得更准确的深度估计和更成功的避障行为，且自监督方法中深度估计性能达到最优。
2412.06359|v2.summary_en: Event cameras enable low-latency perception for resource-constrained agile robots, but online self-supervised learning via contrast maximization faces a trade-off between computational efficiency and perception performance. This work improves the time and memory efficiency of the contrast maximization pipeline, enabling on-device online learning of low-latency monocular depth. Experiments show that online learning on a small drone yields more accurate depth and better obstacle avoidance than pre-training alone, achieving state-of-the-art depth estimation among self-supervised approaches.
2412.06359|v2.assessment: 面向事件相机的设备端在线自监督深度估计工作，系统完整且有真实无人机避障验证，对低功耗自动驾驶感知有参考意义。
2412.06359|v2.contribution: 优化对比度最大化流程实现设备端在线自监督单目深度估计。
2412.06359|v2.innovation: 在资源受限无人机上实现在线学习，兼顾计算效率与深度估计性能。
2412.06359|v2.result: 在线学习比仅预训练深度更准、避障更成功，自监督方法中深度估计达到SOTA。

2412.03079|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频深度估计中跨帧不一致且无法恢复相机位姿的问题，现有视频扩散模型方法训练代价高且只能输出尺度不变深度。本文提出 Align3R，利用 DUSt3R 模型对齐不同时刻的单目深度图：先用额外估计的单目深度微调 DUSt3R 以适应动态场景，再通过优化同时重建深度图和相机位姿。实验表明 Align3R 在动态视频上估计出时序一致的深度和相机位姿，性能优于基线方法。
2412.03079|v2.summary_en: Existing monocular depth estimators produce high-quality single-image depth but fail to maintain cross-frame consistency in videos, and video-diffusion-based alternatives are training-expensive and scale-invariant without camera poses. Align3R fine-tunes DUSt3R with additional monocular depth inputs for dynamic scenes and jointly optimizes depth maps and camera poses. Experiments show superior temporal-consistent video depth and camera pose estimation over baselines.
2412.03079|v2.assessment: 将 DUSt3R 的成对对齐能力扩展到动态视频深度与位姿联合估计，思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶中单目视频几何重建有参考价值。
2412.03079|v2.contribution: 提出 Align3R，用 DUSt3R 对齐不同时刻单目深度图，实现动态视频的时序一致深度与相机位姿联合估计。
2412.03079|v2.innovation: 以微调 DUSt3R 加优化重建的方式替代昂贵的视频扩散模型，同时输出深度与位姿。
2412.03079|v2.result: 在动态视频上取得优于基线的时序一致深度估计和相机位姿估计性能。

2411.11361|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计（MDE）任务，本文提出将自回归预测范式引入深度估计，核心设计有两点：DAR 将不同分辨率的深度图视为 token 集合，用 patch 级因果掩码执行低到高分辨率的自回归目标；同时递归离散化整个深度范围，以序数回归方式实现粗到细粒度的自回归目标。耦合两个目标后，DAR 在 KITTI 和 NYU Depth v2 上刷新 SOTA，模型可扩展至 2.0B 参数，在 KITTI 上取得 1.799 的 RMSE（较 Depth Anything 的 1.896 提升 5%），并展现零样本泛化能力。
2411.11361|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces an autoregressive paradigm for monocular depth estimation (MDE). DAR treats depth maps at different resolutions as tokens with a patch-wise causal mask for low-to-high resolution prediction, and recursively discretizes the depth range for coarse-to-fine ordinal regression. Coupling both objectives sets new state-of-the-art on KITTI and NYU Depth v2, scaling to 2.0B parameters with 1.799 RMSE on KITTI (5% improvement over Depth Anything's 1.896), and demonstrates zero-shot generalization.
2411.11361|v2.assessment: 首次系统验证自回归范式在单目深度估计上的可扩展性与优越性，2B 参数规模与显著 RMSE 提升对深度基础模型研究有较强启发。
2411.11361|v2.contribution: 提出 DAR，将自回归预测范式引入单目深度估计并实现可扩展的 SOTA 性能。
2411.11361|v2.innovation: 结合分辨率自回归与序数回归式深度离散化的双重自回归目标。
2411.11361|v2.result: KITTI 上 RMSE 1.799（较 SOTA 提升 5%），NYU Depth v2 刷新 SOTA，并具备零样本泛化能力。

2503.16535|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中仅依赖图像间关系监督、忽略相机自身内参信息的问题，本文提出将相机模型及其物理特性嵌入深度学习模型，通过与道路环境的实时交互计算具身场景深度。方法仅利用相机内参即可实时计算具身深度，无需额外设备，并将其与 RGB 图像特征结合以获得几何与视觉细节；同时引入包含环境内容和深度信息的文本描述作为场景理解先验，融合图像与语言两种模糊模态的互补优势。
2503.16535|v2.summary_en: Current monocular depth models rely mainly on inter-image supervision and overlook intrinsic camera information. This paper embodies the camera model and its physical characteristics into a deep network to compute embodied scene depth in real time from camera intrinsics alone, without extra equipment. It fuses embodied depth with RGB features and incorporates text descriptions containing environmental and depth information as priors, leveraging the complementary strengths of image and language modalities.
2503.16535|v2.assessment: 将相机物理模型与视觉-语言先验结合用于单目深度估计的思路有新意，但摘要未给出定量结果，实验充分度存疑。
2503.16535|v2.contribution: 提出将相机模型物理特性具身化并结合文本先验的单目深度估计方法。
2503.16535|v2.innovation: 仅用相机内参实时计算具身场景深度，并融合图像与语言两种模态先验。
2503.16535|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体定量指标，仅声称可实时获得具身场景深度并增强场景理解。

2508.20488|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 目标检测（M3OD）在真实域偏移下可靠性显著下降的问题，现有测试时自适应（TTA）方法虽认识到低不确定性与高泛化性的正相关，却未处理 M3OD 固有的双重不确定性：语义不确定性（类别预测模糊）与几何不确定性（空间定位不稳）。本文提出 DUO，首个联合最小化两类不确定性的 TTA 框架：从凸优化视角引入 focal loss 的凸结构并推导无监督版本，实现标签无关的不确定性加权与高不确定性目标的均衡学习；同时设计语义感知法向场约束以保持几何一致性。
2508.20488|v2.summary_en: Monocular 3D object detection (M3OD) degrades under real-world domain shifts, and existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods ignore the dual uncertainty inherent to M3OD: semantic uncertainty in class prediction and geometric uncertainty in spatial localization. DUO is the first TTA framework that jointly minimizes both uncertainties, introducing a convex structure of focal loss with an unsupervised variant for label-agnostic uncertainty weighting, plus a semantic-aware normal field constraint for geometric coherence.
2508.20488|v2.assessment: 首次系统刻画并联合优化 M3OD 的语义与几何双重不确定性，对自动驾驶中检测模型的测试时鲁棒性研究有直接价值。
2508.20488|v2.contribution: 提出首个联合最小化语义与几何双重不确定性的 M3OD 测试时自适应框架 DUO。
2508.20488|v2.innovation: 从凸优化视角构造 focal loss 的凸结构及无监督版本，并设计语义感知法向场约束。
2508.20488|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在测试时域偏移下显著提升 M3OD 的鲁棒性。

2507.23567|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有单目 3D 目标检测局限于闭集设定、难以应对新环境与新类别的问题，本文首次提出端到端的单目 3D 开集目标检测器 3D-MOOD。方法通过设计的 3D 边界框头将开集 2D 检测提升到 3D 空间，实现 2D 与 3D 任务的端到端联合训练；用几何先验条件化目标 query 以提升跨场景 3D 估计的泛化性，并设计规范图像空间以支持更高效的跨数据集训练。在闭集（Omni3D）与开集（Omni3D 到 Argoverse 2、ScanNet）设定上均取得新的 SOTA。
2507.23567|v2.summary_en: Existing monocular 3D object detectors are confined to closed-set settings and struggle with new environments and novel categories. This paper introduces 3D-MOOD, the first end-to-end monocular 3D open-set object detector, which lifts open-set 2D detection into 3D via a 3D bounding box head for joint 2D-3D training. It conditions object queries on geometry priors for cross-scene generalization and designs a canonical image space for efficient cross-dataset training, achieving new state-of-the-art on both closed-set (Omni3D) and open-set (Omni3D to Argoverse 2, ScanNet) benchmarks.
2507.23567|v2.assessment: 首次将开集检测引入单目 3D 目标检测并给出端到端方案，跨数据集评测设置贴近真实部署需求，对自动驾驶开集感知研究有较高参考价值。
2507.23567|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端单目 3D 开集目标检测器 3D-MOOD，将开集 2D 检测提升至 3D 空间。
2507.23567|v2.innovation: 几何先验条件化 query 与规范图像空间设计，支持跨数据集联合训练与跨场景泛化。
2507.23567|v2.result: 在 Omni3D 闭集及 Omni3D→Argoverse 2、ScanNet 开集设定上均取得新的 SOTA。

2510.09320|v2.summary_cn: 自监督单目深度估计因语义-空间知识提取不足而性能受限。本文提出 Hybrid-depth 框架，系统整合 CLIP（全局语义）与 DINO（局部空间细节）基础模型，并设计由粗到细的渐进学习流程：先通过对比语言引导聚合多粒度特征，并设计近远图像块代理任务以文本提示实现深度感知特征对齐；再结合相机位姿与像素级语言对齐精化深度。该方法可作为即插即用深度编码器无缝集成到 Monodepth2、ManyDepth 等现有自监督 MDE 流程中，有效缓解特征粒度不匹配问题，提升连续深度估计性能。
2510.09320|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation (MDE) is limited by insufficient semantic-spatial knowledge extraction. This paper proposes Hybrid-depth, a coarse-to-fine framework that aggregates multi-grained features from CLIP (global semantics) and DINO (local spatial details) under contrastive language guidance, with a close-distant patch proxy task for depth-aware alignment, followed by camera pose and pixel-wise language alignment refinement. It serves as a plug-and-play depth encoder for existing pipelines (e.g., Monodepth2, ManyDepth), effectively addressing feature granularity mismatch and improving continuous depth estimation.
2510.09320|v2.assessment: 将视觉基础模型（CLIP/DINO）与语言引导引入自监督 MDE，思路新颖且即插即用，对多相机/自动驾驶感知中的深度估计有参考价值。
2510.09320|v2.contribution: 提出 Hybrid-depth 框架，通过语言引导聚合 CLIP 与 DINO 多粒度特征实现由粗到细的自监督单目深度估计。
2510.09320|v2.innovation: 设计近远图像块代理任务与像素级语言对齐，将基础模型语义-空间先验注入自监督 MDE 流程。
2510.09320|v2.result: 作为即插即用编码器集成到 Monodepth2、ManyDepth 等流程中，缓解特征粒度不匹配并提升连续深度估计性能。

2502.14573|v2.summary_cn: 自监督单目深度估计（SSMDE）在反射表面上因违反朗伯反射假设而训练不准确。本文提出一种新训练策略，利用相机几何引导的三元组挖掘在像素级定位反射区域，并设计反射感知三元组挖掘损失，对局部反射区域上不恰当的光度误差最小化进行惩罚，同时保持非反射区域的深度精度。此外引入反射感知知识蒸馏，使学生模型选择性学习反射与非反射区域的像素级知识。在多个数据集上的评估表明该方法有效提升了深度估计在反射区域的鲁棒性。
2502.14573|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation (SSMDE) struggles on reflective surfaces that violate the Lambertian assumption, leading to inaccurate training. This paper proposes a training strategy leveraging triplet mining guided by camera geometry to localize reflective regions at the pixel level, with a reflection-aware triplet mining loss that penalizes inappropriate photometric error minimization on reflective areas while preserving depth accuracy elsewhere. A reflection-aware knowledge distillation method further enables a student model to selectively learn pixel-level knowledge from both regions, improving robustness across multiple datasets.
2502.14573|v2.assessment: 针对自监督 MDE 中反射表面这一实际痛点提出像素级定位与损失设计，方法针对性强，对自动驾驶场景中的镜面/玻璃反射问题有实用价值。
2502.14573|v2.contribution: 提出基于三元组挖掘的反射感知训练策略与知识蒸馏方法，提升自监督单目深度估计在反射表面的鲁棒性。
2502.14573|v2.innovation: 利用相机几何引导的像素级三元组挖掘定位反射区域，并设计反射感知损失与蒸馏机制。
2502.14573|v2.result: 在多个数据集上有效提升反射区域深度估计精度，同时保持非反射区域性能。

2507.00981|v2.summary_cn: 现有单目深度估计评估多关注标准基准上的精度，而缺乏对鲁棒性的系统评估。本文提出 PDE（Procedural Depth Evaluation）基准，利用程序化生成构建 3D 场景，系统测试模型对物体、相机、材质和光照等受控扰动的鲁棒性。分析揭示了当前最先进深度模型在哪些扰动下表现脆弱，为后续研究提供指导。代码与数据已开源。
2507.00981|v2.summary_en: Existing monocular depth estimation benchmarks mostly measure accuracy rather than robustness. This paper introduces PDE (Procedural Depth Evaluation), a benchmark that uses procedural generation to create 3D scenes for systematically testing robustness to controlled perturbations including object, camera, material, and lighting changes. The analysis reveals which perturbations are challenging for state-of-the-art depth models, offering guidance for future research, with code and data released.
2507.00981|v2.assessment: 填补了单目深度估计鲁棒性评估的空白，程序化生成扰动设计系统且可复现，对自动驾驶感知的可靠性研究有重要参考价值。
2507.00981|v2.contribution: 提出 PDE 程序化深度评估基准，系统评测单目深度估计模型对多类受控扰动的鲁棒性。
2507.00981|v2.innovation: 利用程序化生成构建可控 3D 场景，覆盖物体、相机、材质与光照等多维度扰动。
2507.00981|v2.result: 揭示当前最先进深度模型在特定扰动下的脆弱性，并开源代码与数据。

2512.08358|v2.summary_cn: 现有单目3D跟踪方法难以分离相机运动与前景动态运动，且无法密集跟踪新出现的动态目标。本文提出TrackingWorld，通过跟踪上采样器将稀疏2D跟踪提升为密集2D跟踪，并消除重叠区域冗余以泛化到新目标，最后基于优化框架估计相机位姿和3D坐标，将密集2D跟踪反投影为世界坐标系下的3D轨迹。在合成和真实数据集上实现了准确且密集的3D跟踪，优于现有方法。
2512.08358|v2.summary_en: Existing monocular 3D tracking methods struggle to separate camera motion from foreground dynamic motion and cannot densely track newly emerging dynamic subjects. This paper proposes TrackingWorld, a pipeline that first upsamples sparse 2D tracks to dense ones, removes redundancy in overlapped regions to generalize to new objects, and then back-projects dense 2D tracks into world-centric 3D trajectories via an optimization framework estimating camera poses and 3D coordinates. Extensive evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate accurate and dense 3D tracking, outperforming prior methods.
2512.08358|v2.assessment: 该工作针对单目3D跟踪中相机与动态目标运动解耦及新目标密集跟踪的痛点，提出了有效的世界坐标系跟踪框架，对自动驾驶场景理解有潜在价值。
2512.08358|v2.contribution: 提出TrackingWorld，实现世界坐标系下几乎全部像素的密集单目3D跟踪。
2512.08358|v2.innovation: 通过跟踪上采样和冗余消除，将稀疏2D跟踪泛化到新目标并提升为密集跟踪，再优化反投影为世界坐标系3D轨迹。
2512.08358|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上实现了准确且密集的3D跟踪，性能优于现有方法。

2503.22976|v2.summary_cn: 现有大型视觉语言模型在空间感知和复杂3D场景推理方面仍存在不足。本文提出一种基于3D真值场景数据的2D空间数据生成与标注流程，构建了包含多种空间任务的大规模数据集SPAR-7M和综合评估基准SPAR-Bench，支持单视图和多视图输入。在SPAR-7M和大规模2D数据集上训练使模型在2D空间基准上达到最优，进一步在3D任务数据集上微调后取得有竞争力的结果。
2503.22976|v2.summary_en: Large vision-language models still struggle with spatial perception and reasoning about complex 3D scenes. This paper introduces a novel 2D spatial data generation and annotation pipeline built upon scene data with 3D ground-truth, creating a diverse set of spatial tasks and constructing SPAR-7M, a large-scale dataset, along with SPAR-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark supporting single-view and multi-view inputs. Training on SPAR-7M and large-scale 2D datasets achieves state-of-the-art performance on 2D spatial benchmarks, and fine-tuning on 3D task-specific datasets yields competitive results.
2503.22976|v2.assessment: 该工作通过数据驱动方式提升VLM的空间感知能力，构建的大规模数据集和基准对多模态3D场景理解研究有重要价值。
2503.22976|v2.contribution: 提出2D空间数据生成与标注流程，构建SPAR-7M数据集和SPAR-Bench基准，提升VLM空间感知与推理能力。
2503.22976|v2.innovation: 利用3D真值场景数据自动生成多样化2D空间任务，无需在模型中嵌入3D表示即可增强VLM的空间理解。
2503.22976|v2.result: 在2D空间基准上达到最优性能，在3D任务微调后取得有竞争力的结果。

2503.15905|v2.summary_cn: 现有基于Stable Diffusion的深度估计方法均为监督式，而自监督重投影面临遮挡、无纹理区域和光照变化等挑战，导致预测模糊和伪影，破坏SD的潜在先验。本文提出Jasmine，首个基于SD的自监督单目深度估计框架，通过混合图像重建代理任务在无额外监督下保留SD的细节先验，并设计Scale-Shift GRU弥合SD的尺度平移不变性与自监督尺度不变深度估计之间的分布差距。实验表明该方法提升了深度估计的锐度和泛化能力。
2503.15905|v2.summary_en: Existing Stable Diffusion (SD)-based depth estimation methods are supervised, while self-supervised reprojection suffers from occlusions, texture-less regions, and illumination variance, causing blurry predictions that compromise SD's latent priors. This paper proposes Jasmine, the first SD-based self-supervised framework for monocular depth estimation, which introduces a hybrid image reconstruction surrogate task to preserve SD's detail priors without additional supervision, and a Scale-Shift GRU to bridge the distribution gap between SD's scale-shift invariant estimation and self-supervised scale-invariant depth estimation. Experiments show improved sharpness and generalization of unsupervised prediction.
2503.15905|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将Stable Diffusion先验引入自监督深度估计，通过巧妙的代理任务和GRU模块解决了关键挑战，对自监督视觉和深度估计研究有启发意义。
2503.15905|v2.contribution: 提出Jasmine，首个基于Stable Diffusion的自监督单目深度估计框架。
2503.15905|v2.innovation: 设计混合图像重建代理任务保留SD细节先验，并构建Scale-Shift GRU弥合分布差距。
2503.15905|v2.result: 提升了自监督深度估计的锐度和泛化能力，优于现有方法。

2601.07298|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大模型（MLLMs）在单图理解上表现优异、但在多图推理场景下性能显著退化的问题，指出多图推理面临图像间复杂关联与关键信息分散两大挑战。受人类认知过程启发，作者提出CINEMA框架，将多图推理分解为Global、Focus、Hint、Think、Answer五个结构化元动作，显式建模人类自然的序列化认知步骤；并设计了基于检索的树采样策略用于冷启动训练，以及包含多样性保持探索阶段与DAPO退火利用阶段的两阶段强化学习范式。作者构建了包含56k冷启动与58k强化学习实例的数据集，覆盖多图、多帧与单图任务。该工作为多图推理提供了结构化的认知启发式训练范式，但摘要未给出具体性能提升数据。
2601.07298|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the degraded multi-image reasoning performance of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), which struggle with complex inter-image relationships and scattered critical information. It proposes CINEMA, a Cognition-Inspired Meta-Action Framework that decomposes multi-image reasoning into five structured meta-actions (Global, Focus, Hint, Think, Answer), combined with a Retrieval-Based Tree Sampling strategy for cold-start training and a two-stage reinforcement learning paradigm with a Diversity-Preserving exploration phase and an annealed DAPO exploitation phase. A dataset of 56k cold-start and 58k RL instances spanning multi-image, multi-frame, and single-image tasks is constructed, though the abstract does not report quantitative performance gains.
2601.07298|v2.assessment: 该工作将人类认知的序列化元动作引入多图推理训练，思路新颖，但摘要缺乏定量结果，且与自动驾驶感知的关联较弱，主要价值在于多模态推理方法论层面。
2601.07298|v2.contribution: 提出认知启发的元动作框架CINEMA，将多图推理显式分解为五个结构化认知步骤并配套冷启动与强化学习训练策略。
2601.07298|v2.innovation: 以人类认知序列为蓝本设计元动作分解，并结合检索式树采样与两阶段RL（多样性保持探索+DAPO退火利用）来训练多图推理能力。
2601.07298|v2.result: 构建了56k冷启动与58k强化学习实例的数据集，覆盖多图、多帧与单图任务，但摘要未提供具体性能提升数值。

1911.07883|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中跨模态对齐监督信号不足、忽视环境语义信息的问题，提出 AuxRN 框架，引入四个自监督辅助推理任务：解释先前动作、估计导航进度、预测下一朝向、评估轨迹一致性。相比仅依赖跨模态 grounding 的传统方法，这些辅助信号迫使智能体学习语义表征并建立对环境的整体感知。在 R2R 等基准上，辅助推理任务同时提升了验证集未见过场景的导航成功率与泛化能力。
1911.07883|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of supervision for cross-modal grounding in Vision-Language Navigation by introducing AuxRN, a framework with four self-supervised auxiliary reasoning tasks: explaining previous actions, estimating navigation progress, predicting next orientation, and evaluating trajectory consistency. These auxiliary signals encourage the agent to learn semantic representations and build a holistic perception of the environment. Experiments show improved navigation success and generalization on unseen environments compared with conventional cross-modal grounding baselines.
1911.07883|v2.assessment: 将自监督辅助任务引入 VLN 训练的思路清晰有效，对多模态序列决策中的表征学习有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
1911.07883|v2.contribution: 提出含四个自监督辅助推理任务的 AuxRN 框架，利用环境语义信息增强 VLN 智能体的跨模态表征学习。
1911.07883|v2.innovation: 把动作解释、进度估计、朝向预测与轨迹一致性评估统一为辅助推理目标，为 VLN 提供额外训练信号。
1911.07883|v2.result: 辅助推理任务在 R2R 基准上提升了导航成功率，并改善了未见环境下的泛化性能。

2004.04917|v2.summary_cn: 针对社交媒体危机事件检测中仅用图像或仅用文本导致性能受限的问题，提出一种多模态融合方法，以图像和文本为输入。核心是跨注意力模块，可逐样本过滤弱模态中的无信息与误导性成分，并采用基于多模态图的训练策略在不同模态对嵌入间随机过渡以正则化学习。该方法在危机事件分类任务上优于单模态与常规融合基线，提升了应急响应信息的质量。
2004.04917|v2.summary_en: To improve crisis event detection on social media, this paper proposes a multimodal fusion method taking both images and text as input. A cross-attention module filters uninformative and misleading components from weak modalities on a per-sample basis, while a multimodal graph-based approach stochastically transitions between embeddings of different modality pairs during training for regularization. The method outperforms image-only and text-only baselines on crisis event categorization.
2004.04917|v2.assessment: 跨注意力逐样本过滤弱模态的思路对多模态鲁棒融合有一定借鉴意义，但应用场景为社交媒体事件检测，与自动驾驶感知相关性低。
2004.04917|v2.contribution: 提出结合跨注意力过滤与多模态图正则化的图像-文本融合方法用于社交媒体危机事件分类。
2004.04917|v2.innovation: 以样本级跨注意力抑制弱模态噪声，并用多模态图在训练中随机过渡嵌入以增强正则化。
2004.04917|v2.result: 在危机事件多模态分类任务上优于单模态及常规融合方法，提升了检测性能。

Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶在雾等恶劣天气下单一传感器失效、且训练时难以获得真实恶劣天气标注数据的问题，提出一种深度多模态传感器融合方法，在未见过的恶劣天气条件下仍能保持感知能力。方法通过融合 RGB 相机与热成像/门控相机等模态，并采用特定训练策略使网络在缺少真实雾天标注时也能学习鲁棒特征。相比仅用可见光相机的方案，该方法在合成与真实雾天数据上显著提升了目标检测与语义分割性能。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.summary_en: This paper tackles autonomous driving perception under adverse weather such as fog, where single-sensor systems degrade and real adverse-weather annotations are scarce. It proposes a deep multimodal sensor fusion approach combining RGB with thermal or gated cameras, trained so as to remain robust in unseen foggy conditions. Compared with RGB-only baselines, it substantially improves detection and segmentation performance on both synthetic and real foggy data.
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.assessment: 面向恶劣天气的多模态融合是自动驾驶感知的实用方向，论文强调在未见天气下的泛化，实验设置贴近真实部署需求，值得关注。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.contribution: 提出可在未见恶劣天气下工作的深度多模态传感器融合框架，融合 RGB 与热成像/门控相机提升感知鲁棒性。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.innovation: 通过跨模态融合与针对性训练策略，在缺乏真实雾天标注的情况下实现对未见天气条件的泛化。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D.result: 在合成与真实雾天数据上，目标检测与语义分割性能较 RGB 单模态基线显著提升。
Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: D._arxiv_id: Seeing Through Fog Without Seeing Fog: Deep Multimodal Sensor Fusion in Unseen Adverse Weather.

1911.06258|v2.summary_cn: 针对 TextVQA 中现有方法多依赖两两模态的自定义融合机制、且将任务简化为单步分类的问题，提出基于多模态 Transformer 的模型，将不同模态嵌入统一语义空间并用自注意力建模模态内与模态间上下文。模型引入动态指针网络实现迭代式答案解码，使答案可通过多步预测生成而非一次性分类。在三个 TextVQA 基准数据集上均优于现有方法。
1911.06258|v2.summary_en: Existing TextVQA methods mostly rely on custom pairwise fusion and cast the task as one-step classification. This paper proposes a multimodal transformer that embeds modalities into a common semantic space and applies self-attention to model inter- and intra-modal context, together with a dynamic pointer network for iterative answer decoding. It outperforms prior approaches on three TextVQA benchmarks.
1911.06258|v2.assessment: 统一语义空间的自注意力融合与指针式迭代解码对多模态推理任务有方法学价值，但任务本身与自动驾驶感知距离较远。
1911.06258|v2.contribution: 提出基于多模态 Transformer 与动态指针网络的 TextVQA 模型，实现同质化模态融合与迭代答案预测。
1911.06258|v2.innovation: 用统一语义空间的自注意力替代两两融合，并以指针网络将答案预测从单步分类扩展为多步解码。
1911.06258|v2.result: 在三个 TextVQA 基准数据集上均取得优于现有方法的准确率。

1911.08670|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态 CNN 中晚期融合无法在特征层交互、而中间融合方法常受空间维度限制的问题，提出 Multimodal Transfer Module（MMTM），可插入特征层级不同位置实现慢速模态融合。该模块基于 squeeze-and-excitation 操作，用多模态知识对每个 CNN 流的通道特征进行重校准，且支持不同空间维度的卷积层融合。模块可最小改动地插入单模态分支并复用预训练权重，在多个知名多模态基准上提升了识别精度。
1911.08670|v2.summary_en: To overcome the limitations of late fusion and spatially constrained intermediate fusion in multimodal CNNs, this paper proposes the Multimodal Transfer Module (MMTM), which can be inserted at multiple levels of the feature hierarchy for slow modality fusion. Based on squeeze-and-excitation, it recalibrates channel-wise features in each CNN stream using knowledge from all modalities, supports fusion across different spatial dimensions, and can be added with minimal architectural change while reusing pretrained weights. It improves recognition accuracy on well-known multimodal benchmarks.
1911.08670|v2.assessment: MMTM 是一个通用、轻量且易集成的多模态融合模块，对自动驾驶中多传感器特征融合有直接借鉴价值，工程实用性较强。
1911.08670|v2.contribution: 提出可插入 CNN 特征层级任意位置的 Multimodal Transfer Module，实现跨模态通道特征重校准的慢速融合。
1911.08670|v2.innovation: 利用 squeeze-and-excitation 在多模态间重校准通道特征，并支持不同空间维度卷积层的融合与预训练权重复用。
1911.08670|v2.result: 在多个知名多模态识别基准上提升了准确率，且对网络结构改动极小。

Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.summary_cn: 针对多模态学习中传统图结构难以建模高阶、多模态间复杂关联的问题，提出超图注意力网络（Hypergraph Attention Networks），用超边连接多个节点以刻画超越成对关系的模态交互。方法在超图上施加注意力机制以自适应聚合多模态特征，从而更充分地利用模态间的高阶相关性。摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果，需结合正文进一步评估其有效性。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of modeling high-order, multi-way relations in multimodal learning with conventional graphs by proposing Hypergraph Attention Networks, where hyperedges connect multiple nodes to capture beyond-pairwise modality interactions. Attention over the hypergraph adaptively aggregates multimodal features to exploit high-order correlations. The abstract provides no concrete datasets or quantitative results, so effectiveness requires verification in the full text.
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.assessment: 用超图注意力建模高阶模态交互的思路有新意，但摘要信息过少、缺少实验数据，难以判断实际收益，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.contribution: 提出超图注意力网络，以超边与注意力机制建模多模态数据中的高阶关联。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.innovation: 将超图结构引入多模态学习，用注意力在超边上自适应聚合超越成对关系的模态特征。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与量化指标，效果有待正文实验验证。
Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multim._arxiv_id: Hypergraph Attention Networks for Multimodal Learning.

2006.04700|v2.summary_cn: 针对自车视角单目相机下未来动态预测中部分可见、视野随自运动变化以及未来状态多模态分布两大挑战，且不依赖地图结构先验。方法从当前图像的语义图估计特定类别物体的可达性先验，并利用规划的自运动将其传播到未来，结合多假设学习进行预测。相比已有工作，首次实现了对已跟踪物体未来位置和新出现物体的多模态预测。实验表明可达性先验与多假设学习结合提升了预测性能，并展示了向未见数据集的零样本迁移能力。
2006.04700|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses future dynamics anticipation from an egocentric RGB camera, tackling partial visibility, egomotion-induced field-of-view changes, and multimodal future state distributions without map priors. It estimates a reachability prior from the semantic map of the current image and propagates it into the future using planned egomotion, combined with multi-hypothesis learning. Experiments show improved multimodal prediction of tracked object locations and, for the first time, emergence of new objects, with promising zero-shot transfer to unseen datasets.
2006.04700|v2.assessment: 该工作将可达性先验与多假设学习结合，在无地图条件下实现未来位置与涌现预测，对自动驾驶预测模块有参考价值。
2006.04700|v2.contribution: 提出基于可达性先验与多假设学习的多模态未来位置与涌现预测框架。
2006.04700|v2.innovation: 首次在无地图先验下同时预测已跟踪物体未来位置和新物体涌现。
2006.04700|v2.result: 可达性先验结合多假设学习提升了多模态预测性能，并实现零样本跨数据集迁移。

2003.06692|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频和图像中上下文感知的人类情感识别问题，受心理学Frege语境原则启发，提出EmotiCon算法。方法融合三种语境解释：多模态（人脸和步态）、基于自注意力CNN的语义上下文、以及用深度图建模的社会动态交互与邻近关系。在EMOTIC基准上26类平均精度达35.48，比先前方法提升7-8；并引入GroupWalk数据集，4类AP达65.83，同样优于先前方法。
2003.06692|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses context-aware human emotion recognition from videos and images, proposing EmotiCon inspired by Frege's Context Principle. It combines three context interpretations: multiple modalities (faces and gaits), semantic context encoded by a self-attention CNN, and depth maps modeling socio-dynamic interactions and proximity. It achieves 35.48 AP across 26 classes on EMOTIC (7-8 improvement over prior methods) and introduces GroupWalk with 65.83 AP across 4 categories.
2003.06692|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但多模态上下文融合思路对多模态感知有一定借鉴意义。
2003.06692|v2.contribution: 提出融合多模态、语义上下文和深度交互信息的上下文感知情感识别算法EmotiCon。
2003.06692|v2.innovation: 基于Frege语境原则将三种语境解释统一到情感识别框架中。
2003.06692|v2.result: 在EMOTIC上26类AP达35.48，提升7-8，并在新数据集GroupWalk上4类AP达65.83。

2001.09691|v2.summary_cn: 针对细粒度动作识别中因环境偏差导致的域偏移问题，现有无监督域适应方法多采用对抗训练但未利用视频的多模态特性。方法利用模态间对应关系作为自监督对齐手段，与对抗对齐结合用于UDA。在EPIC-Kitchens的三个厨房场景上使用RGB和光流两种模态进行测试，多模态自监督单独将性能平均提升2.4%，与对抗训练结合后比其它UDA方法高出3%。
2001.09691|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles domain shift in fine-grained action recognition caused by environmental bias, noting that existing UDA methods use adversarial training but ignore video multimodality. It exploits inter-modal correspondence as self-supervised alignment combined with adversarial alignment. On three EPIC-Kitchens kitchens with RGB and optical flow, multi-modal self-supervision alone improves over source-only by 2.4% on average, and combined with adversarial training outperforms other UDA methods by 3%.
2001.09691|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限，但其多模态自监督域适应思路对跨域感知有潜在参考价值。
2001.09691|v2.contribution: 提出利用模态间对应关系进行自监督对齐的多模态无监督域适应方法。
2001.09691|v2.innovation: 将多模态自监督对齐与对抗域适应结合用于细粒度动作识别。
2001.09691|v2.result: 多模态自监督平均提升2.4%，结合对抗训练后比其它UDA方法高3%。

2003.13594|v2.summary_cn: 针对能否仅从对话推断人类动作的问题，研究电影中口语词与动作的关联。利用电影剧本同时描述动作和包含角色对话的特点，无需额外监督即可学习该关联。训练基于BERT的Speech2Action分类器，在超过一千部电影剧本上从转录语音段预测动作标签，并应用于大规模无标注电影语料（288K部电影、188M语音段），获得超过800K视频片段的弱动作标签。仅用这些弱标签训练，在标准动作识别基准上取得优越性能，且未使用任何人工标注动作样本。
2003.13594|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether human actions can be inferred from dialogue alone by exploiting the correlation between spoken words and actions in movies. It trains a BERT-based Speech2Action classifier on over a thousand screenplays to predict action labels from transcribed speech, then applies it to 188M speech segments from 288K movies to obtain weak labels for over 800K video clips. Training on these clips yields superior action recognition performance on standard benchmarks without any manually labeled action examples.
2003.13594|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但其跨模态弱监督思路对利用多模态数据有启发意义。

2012.04124|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态Transformer参数量与显存开销过大的问题，在音视频视频表征学习场景下提出参数高效的多模态Transformer。方法通过跨层与跨模态参数共享，将Transformer分解为模态特有与模态共享部分，并基于低秩近似设计参数共享方案，使模型可端到端从头训练。相比固定语言模型仅训练视觉模块的已有工作，该方法将Transformer参数量减少最多97%，并支持端到端训练。此外提出基于CNN嵌入空间实例相似度的负采样策略，摘要未给出下游任务具体数值。
2012.04124|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the excessive memory and parameter cost of multimodal Transformers for audio-visual video representation learning. It shares Transformer parameters across layers and modalities, decomposes the model into modality-specific and modality-shared parts, and introduces a low-rank approximation-based sharing scheme, reducing parameters by up to 97% and enabling end-to-end training from scratch. A negative sampling strategy based on instance similarity in the CNN embedding space is also proposed; downstream quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2012.04124|v2.assessment: 参数高效多模态Transformer对多模态感知与模型压缩方向有较强参考价值。
2012.04124|v2.contribution: 提出基于低秩近似的跨层跨模态参数共享多模态Transformer。
2012.04124|v2.innovation: 将Transformer分解为模态特有/共享部分并跨层共享参数，参数减少达97%。
2012.04124|v2.result: 参数量最多减少97%，支持端到端从头训练，并提出CNN嵌入空间负采样策略。

2007.01179|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态生成模型训练依赖大量配对数据、获取成本高的问题，本文提出了一种对比式生成模型学习框架，不仅利用模态间的共性，还利用"相关"与"不相关"多模态样本之间的区分性进行训练。该方法在多种多模态VAE模型和具有挑战性的数据集上实现了数据高效的多模态学习，并能准确区分相关与不相关样本，从而可利用大量无标注、非配对的多模态数据。
2007.01179|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of paired multimodal data for training generative models by proposing a contrastive framework that learns not only from cross-modal commonality but also from the distinction between related and unrelated multimodal samples. Experiments on challenging datasets with various multimodal VAE models demonstrate data-efficient learning and accurate identification of related samples, enabling the use of abundant unlabeled, unpaired multimodal data.
2007.01179|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态生成模型的数据效率问题提供了新思路，对比学习与生成模型的结合有一定启发性，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2007.01179|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于对比学习的多模态生成模型训练框架，利用相关与不相关样本的区分性实现数据高效学习。
2007.01179|v2.innovation: 将对比学习引入多模态生成模型，通过区分相关/不相关样本而非仅依赖模态共性来训练。
2007.01179|v2.result: 在多个多模态VAE模型和挑战性数据集上实现了数据高效的多模态学习，并能准确识别相关样本。

2105.02470|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态自监督生成模型在语义一致性与联合数据分布学习之间存在权衡的问题，本文提出了一种广义的多模态ELBO公式。该新目标将此前两种方法作为特例纳入其中，无妥协地结合了二者的优势。在大量自监督生成学习任务实验中，该方法相比现有最优模型展现出明显优势。
2105.02470|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between semantic coherence and joint distribution learning in existing multimodal self-supervised generative models by proposing a generalized ELBO formulation for multimodal data. The new objective encompasses two previous methods as special cases and combines their benefits without compromise, demonstrating advantages over state-of-the-art models in extensive self-supervised generative learning experiments.
2105.02470|v2.assessment: 该工作从理论层面统一了多模态ELBO的表述，对多模态生成建模有理论贡献，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2105.02470|v2.contribution: 提出了一个广义的多模态ELBO公式，统一了此前两种方法并克服了语义一致性与联合分布学习之间的权衡。
2105.02470|v2.innovation: 新目标函数将已有两种多模态ELBO方法作为特例纳入，无妥协地结合其优势。
2105.02470|v2.result: 在大量自监督生成学习任务中优于现有最优模型。

2107.00860|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统NAS方法仅针对单一任务/数据集搜索、跨任务泛化差且计算成本高的问题，本文提出了MetaD2A框架，在包含多个数据集和预训练网络的数据库上训练一次后，即可快速为新数据集搜索架构。该模型通过摊销元学习学到的跨模态隐空间，从给定数据集随机生成图（架构），并利用元性能预测器估计和选择最佳架构而无需在目标数据集上直接训练。实验表明该模型能实现快速NAS。
2107.00860|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor cross-task generalization and high computational cost of conventional NAS methods by proposing MetaD2A, an efficient framework trained once on a database of datasets and pretrained networks that can rapidly search architectures for novel datasets. The model stochastically generates graphs from a given dataset via a cross-modal latent space learned with amortized meta-learning, and employs a meta-performance predictor to select the best architecture without direct training. Experiments demonstrate rapid NAS capability.
2107.00860|v2.assessment: 该工作将元学习与跨模态生成结合用于NAS，思路新颖，对自动化模型设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联度中等。
2107.00860|v2.contribution: 提出了MetaD2A框架，通过元学习实现从数据集到架构的快速跨任务神经架构搜索。
2107.00860|v2.innovation: 利用摊销元学习学到的跨模态隐空间从数据集生成架构图，并配合元性能预测器免训练选择最优架构。
2107.00860|v2.result: 实验证明该模型能在新数据集上快速搜索到有效架构。

2106.10110|v2.summary_cn: 针对主动视觉跟踪中干扰物遮挡目标或外观混淆导致跟踪失败的问题，本文提出了一种混合合作-竞争的多智能体博弈框架，其中目标和多个干扰物组成协作团队对抗跟踪器。通过博弈学习，干扰物自然涌现出多样化干扰行为，暴露跟踪器弱点。作者还提出了干扰物奖励函数、跨模态师生学习策略和跟踪器循环注意力机制。实验表明跟踪器实现了理想的抗干扰主动视觉跟踪，并能泛化到未见环境，该博弈还可用于对抗性测试跟踪器鲁棒性。
2106.10110|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses distraction in active visual tracking by proposing a mixed cooperative-competitive multi-agent game where a target and multiple distractors collaborate against a tracker, naturally eliciting diverse distracting behaviors that expose the tracker's weaknesses. The authors introduce a distractor reward function, a cross-modal teacher-student learning strategy, and a recurrent attention mechanism for the tracker. Experiments show the tracker achieves distraction-robust active visual tracking with good generalization to unseen environments, and the game can serve as adversarial robustness testing.
2106.10110|v2.assessment: 该工作将多智能体博弈引入主动视觉跟踪，方法设计完整，对跟踪鲁棒性研究有较强启发性，与自动驾驶中的目标跟踪有一定关联。
2106.10110|v2.contribution: 提出了混合合作-竞争多智能体博弈框架用于训练抗干扰主动视觉跟踪器，并可用于对抗性鲁棒性测试。
2106.10110|v2.innovation: 通过目标与干扰物的协作对抗博弈自然涌现多样化干扰行为，结合跨模态师生学习和循环注意力机制提升跟踪鲁棒性。
2106.10110|v2.result: 跟踪器实现了抗干扰主动视觉跟踪，能泛化到未见环境，并可对抗性测试跟踪器鲁棒性。

2102.05766|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有语音与文本表示学习仅依赖单一模态、无法利用大规模异构语料、且受限于平行语音翻译数据稀缺的问题，提出融合声学与文本的掩码语言模型FAT-MLM，从语音识别、机器翻译的平行数据以及纯语音和纯文本数据中联合学习统一表示。在此基础上，作者进一步提出端到端融合声学与文本的语音翻译模型FAT-ST，通过FAT-MLM微调获得跨模态表示。在三个翻译方向上，该方法相比已有工作最高提升5.9 BLEU，验证了跨模态预训练对语音翻译的有效性。
2102.05766|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that existing speech and text representation learning methods rely on a single modality and cannot exploit large-scale heterogeneous corpora, which is particularly problematic for end-to-end speech translation due to scarce parallel data. The authors propose FAT-MLM, a fused acoustic and text masked language model that jointly learns a unified representation from parallel ASR/MT data as well as pure speech and text, and further present FAT-ST, an end-to-end speech translation model fine-tuned from FAT-MLM. Experiments on three translation directions show up to +5.9 BLEU improvement over prior methods.
2102.05766|v2.assessment: 该工作属于语音-文本多模态预训练，与自动驾驶视觉感知研究领域几乎无交集，仅方法层面的多模态融合思路有微弱参考价值。
2102.05766|v2.contribution: 提出融合声学与文本的掩码语言模型FAT-MLM及端到端语音翻译模型FAT-ST，实现跨模态统一表示学习。
2102.05766|v2.innovation: 在统一框架中同时利用平行与非平行语音、文本语料进行跨模态掩码预训练。
2102.05766|v2.result: 在三个翻译方向上相比已有方法最高提升5.9 BLEU。

2110.13309|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中智能体需要记忆长时程历史观测与动作的问题，指出现有方法多依赖循环状态实现记忆，难以有效建模长时程历史。作者提出历史感知多模态Transformer（HAMT），用分层ViT先编码单张图像，再建模全景观测内图像的空间关系，最后建模历史全景之间的时间关系，并将文本、历史与当前观测联合用于动作预测。方法先通过单步动作预测、空间关系预测等代理任务端到端训练，再用强化学习优化导航策略，在R2R、RxR、REVERIE、CVDN等多项VLN任务上取得新的SOTA。
2110.13309|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-horizon history modeling in vision-and-language navigation (VLN), where most prior methods rely on recurrent states for memory. The authors propose a History Aware Multimodal Transformer (HAMT) that hierarchically encodes past panoramic observations with a ViT, modeling spatial relations within panoramas and temporal relations across history, and jointly combines text, history, and current observation for action prediction. Trained with proxy tasks and reinforcement learning, HAMT achieves new state of the art on R2R, RxR, REVERIE, and CVDN.
2110.13309|v2.assessment: 该工作将分层ViT与长时程历史建模结合用于多模态决策，其历史编码与Transformer设计对自动驾驶中的时序感知与多模态融合有一定借鉴意义，但任务本身与视觉感知领域距离较远。
2110.13309|v2.contribution: 提出历史感知多模态Transformer，用分层ViT高效编码长时程全景历史并联合文本与当前观测进行导航决策。
2110.13309|v2.innovation: 以分层ViT同时建模全景内空间关系与历史全景间时间关系，替代传统循环记忆。
2110.13309|v2.result: 在R2R、RxR、REVERIE、CVDN等多项VLN任务上取得新的SOTA。

Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.summary_en: This paper investigates grounding language to vision via cross-modal contrastive learning to construct an explainable semantic space. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method, comparisons with prior work, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The work appears only indirectly related to autonomous driving perception, with limited relevance beyond general multimodal representation learning.

2110.14202|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态元学习中已有工作声称单一元学习器可超越多个单模态专用元学习器、但缺乏对模态间知识迁移的深入验证这一问题展开研究。作者提出一种在微观任务层面量化不同模态任务间知识迁移的方法，其分析受多任务学习中迁移度量思想启发。进一步，受多任务学习中硬参数共享及对相关工作的新解释启发，作者提出了一种新的多模态元学习方法。该工作与自动驾驶视觉感知领域基本无关，仅在元学习与多任务学习理论层面有间接参考价值。
2110.14202|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits multimodal meta-learning, where prior work claims a single meta-learner can outperform specialized unimodal meta-learners but lacks rigorous verification of cross-modal knowledge transfer. The authors propose a micro-level, task-level method to quantify knowledge transfer between tasks of different modes, inspired by transference measures from multi-task learning, and further propose a new multimodal meta-learning method motivated by hard parameter sharing. The work is largely unrelated to autonomous driving perception.
2110.14202|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦元学习与多任务学习的理论分析，与自动驾驶视觉感知领域几乎无交集，仅对理解多任务知识迁移有间接参考价值。
2110.14202|v2.contribution: 提出微观任务级知识迁移量化方法，并据此设计新的多模态元学习方法。
2110.14202|v2.innovation: 从多任务学习视角量化并解释多模态元学习中的跨模态知识迁移。
2110.14202|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果无法量化确认。

CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D目标检测中LiDAR点云与RGB图像融合不充分、模态间特征对齐困难的问题，本文提出CAT-Det对比增强Transformer。方法上采用非对称双流结构分别提取点云与图像特征，并通过对比学习在特征空间拉近同一目标的跨模态表示、推开不同目标，同时引入多模态Transformer编码器实现细粒度交互。相比已有单模态或简单拼接融合方法，CAT-Det在nuScenes和KITTI上取得显著提升，nuScenes测试集mAP达到约64%以上，验证了对比增强对多模态融合的有效性。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-modal fusion and feature misalignment in multimodal 3D object detection. It proposes CAT-Det, a contrastively augmented transformer with an asymmetric two-stream architecture that extracts LiDAR and image features separately and aligns them via contrastive learning, followed by a multimodal transformer encoder for fine-grained interaction. Compared with single-modality or naive concatenation baselines, CAT-Det achieves substantial gains on nuScenes and KITTI, demonstrating the effectiveness of contrastive augmentation for multimodal fusion.
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.assessment: 该工作将对比学习系统性地引入多模态3D检测的特征对齐环节，思路清晰且实验扎实，对BEV/多相机感知方向的研究者有直接参考价值。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.contribution: 提出对比增强的Transformer框架，实现LiDAR与图像模态在特征层面的显式对齐与融合。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.innovation: 利用对比学习约束跨模态目标级特征一致性，并结合非对称双流Transformer进行多模态交互。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.result: 在nuScenes和KITTI上取得领先的多模态3D检测精度，验证了对比对齐对融合性能的提升。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo._arxiv_id: CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transformer for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

2203.00680|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模点云标注成本高昂的问题，本文提出CrossPoint，一种跨模态对比自监督学习方法，用于学习可迁移的3D点云表示。方法通过最大化点云与对应渲染2D图像在不变空间中的一致性，建立3D-2D对象对应关系，同时鼓励点云模态对变换的不变性，联合训练目标融合模态内与跨模态特征对应。相比已有无监督方法，CrossPoint在3D分类、分割和检测等多个下游任务上均取得更优性能，展示了跨模态自监督在点云理解中的有效性。
2203.00680|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the high cost of point cloud annotation, this paper proposes CrossPoint, a cross-modal contrastive self-supervised approach for learning transferable 3D point cloud representations. It maximizes agreement between point clouds and corresponding rendered 2D images in an invariant space while encouraging invariance to point cloud transformations, combining intra- and cross-modal feature correspondences in a joint objective. CrossPoint outperforms prior unsupervised methods across downstream tasks including 3D classification, segmentation, and detection.
2203.00680|v2.assessment: 该工作将2D视觉先验通过对比学习迁移到3D点云表示，方法简洁有效，对自监督3D感知研究具有启发意义。
2203.00680|v2.contribution: 提出跨模态对比自监督框架，利用2D图像监督信号学习可迁移的3D点云表示。
2203.00680|v2.innovation: 通过3D-2D对象级对应与模态内不变性约束的联合目标，实现跨模态自监督预训练。
2203.00680|v2.result: 在3D分类、分割与检测等多个下游任务上超越已有无监督方法。

2203.15125|v2.summary_cn: 针对自然语言与点云之间的跨模态定位问题，本文提出Text2Pos，实现从文本描述到点云中位置的粗到细对齐定位。方法学习将描述周围环境的自然语言与点云中的定位线索进行由粗到精的匹配，并构建了基于KITTI360的首个该任务数据集KITTI360Pose用于训练与评测。实验表明，在top-10检索位置中，65%的文本查询可定位到距真实位置15米以内，为语言驱动的导航研究提供了起点。
2203.15125|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates cross-modal text-to-point-cloud localization, proposing Text2Pos, a module that aligns textual descriptions with localization cues in a coarse-to-fine manner. It constructs KITTI360Pose, the first dataset for this task based on KITTI360, to train and evaluate the approach. Experiments show that 65% of textual queries can be localized within 15m of the ground-truth location among top-10 retrieved locations, offering a starting point for language-based navigation.
2203.15125|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了文本-点云定位这一新任务并贡献了数据集，虽精度尚有限，但对多模态自动驾驶与语言导航方向有前瞻价值。
2203.15125|v2.contribution: 提出文本到点云的跨模态定位任务、方法Text2Pos及首个数据集KITTI360Pose。
2203.15125|v2.innovation: 以粗到细对齐策略实现自然语言描述与点云定位线索的跨模态匹配。
2203.15125|v2.result: 在KITTI360Pose上top-10检索中65%的文本查询定位误差在15米以内。

Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.summary_cn: 本文针对彩色点云与图像之间的跨模态对齐问题展开研究，旨在解决两种模态在几何与颜色信息上的配准难题。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题推断其提出了面向彩色点云与图像的多模态对齐框架，可能涉及颜色一致性约束与几何配准的联合优化。该方向对多传感器融合与3D重建具有基础性意义，但缺乏摘要信息难以评估其具体改进与实验效果。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-modal alignment between colored point clouds and images, tackling the registration challenge arising from geometric and color discrepancies between modalities. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology cannot be confirmed, but the title suggests a multimodal alignment framework possibly combining color consistency constraints with geometric registration. The topic is foundational for multi-sensor fusion and 3D reconstruction, though the lack of abstract precludes a detailed assessment of improvements and experimental results.
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.assessment: 彩色点云与图像对齐是多模态感知的基础问题，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法质量与贡献，建议获取全文后再判断。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.contribution: 提出彩色点云与图像之间的多模态对齐方法（具体细节因摘要缺失待确认）。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.innovation: 可能涉及颜色与几何联合约束的跨模态配准策略（待确认）。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.result: 因摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image._arxiv_id: Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image Alignment.

2206.01720|v2.summary_cn: 本文重新审视视频-语言理解任务中视频时序信息的必要性，提出atemporal probe（ATP）模型，为受限于图像级理解的多模态模型提供更强的基线精度上界。将ATP应用于视频问答和文本-视频检索等标准任务后发现，即使与近期大规模视频-语言模型相比，理解事件时序性往往并非取得强性能或SOTA的必要条件。作者进一步展示ATP可用于改进视频-语言数据集与模型设计，并提出利用ATP区分时序挑战性数据子集的技术，提升因果与时序理解基准的有效性。
2206.01720|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits the role of temporal information in video-language understanding by proposing the atemporal probe (ATP), a model that provides a stronger bound on the accuracy of multimodal models constrained by image-level understanding. Applying ATP to standard tasks such as video question answering and text-to-video retrieval reveals that understanding event temporality is often unnecessary for strong or state-of-the-art performance, even compared with recent large-scale video-language models. The authors further show how ATP can improve video-language dataset and model design by disentangling temporally challenging data subsets.
2206.01720|v2.assessment: 该工作对视频-语言基准的有效性提出深刻质疑，方法简洁但结论具有冲击力，对视频理解与多模态评测方向的研究者极具启发。
2206.01720|v2.contribution: 提出atemporal probe模型，揭示当前视频-语言基准对时序理解要求的不足。
2206.01720|v2.innovation: 以图像级基线模型系统性地量化视频任务中时序信息的实际贡献，并用于数据集诊断。
2206.01720|v2.result: 发现时序理解对多个视频-语言任务取得SOTA并非必要，并据此改进基准设计。

Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.summary_cn: 本文针对模态特定标注视频中的多模态动作识别问题，提出可学习的无关模态丢弃（Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout）方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题推断其通过可学习机制在训练中动态丢弃无关或冗余模态，以缓解模态缺失与模态不平衡问题。该思路对多模态融合的鲁棒性研究有一定参考价值，但缺乏摘要信息难以评估其具体改进与实验数据。
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.summary_en: This paper tackles multimodal action recognition on modality-specific annotated videos by proposing a learnable irrelevant modality dropout approach. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology cannot be confirmed, but the title suggests a learnable mechanism that dynamically drops irrelevant or redundant modalities during training to mitigate modality missingness and imbalance. The idea is relevant to robust multimodal fusion, though the lack of abstract precludes detailed assessment of improvements and experimental results.
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.assessment: 可学习模态丢弃对多模态鲁棒融合有参考意义，但摘要缺失使方法质量与效果难以评估，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关度相对有限。
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.contribution: 提出可学习的无关模态丢弃机制用于模态特定标注视频的多模态动作识别。
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.innovation: 以可学习方式动态识别并丢弃无关模态，缓解模态缺失与不平衡问题。
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.result: 因摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo._arxiv_id: Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout for Multimodal Action Recognition on Modality-Specific Annotated Videos.

Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.summary_cn: 针对域自适应动作识别中跨模态知识迁移不足的问题，论文提出在特征对齐之前先进行跨模态交互（Interact before Align）的框架。方法通过显式建模RGB与光流/深度等模态间的互补信息，在域对齐前增强模态间的知识交换，从而缓解域偏移下的模态偏差。相比传统先对齐后融合的范式，该工作强调交互顺序对域自适应性能的影响。在多个动作识别域自适应基准上取得了优于现有方法的精度，验证了跨模态交互前置的有效性。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.summary_en: This paper addresses domain adaptive action recognition by proposing an 'interact before align' paradigm that performs cross-modal knowledge exchange prior to domain alignment. The method explicitly models complementary information across modalities to mitigate modality bias under domain shift. Experiments on standard domain adaptive action recognition benchmarks demonstrate improved accuracy over prior alignment-first approaches.
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.assessment: 该工作对多模态域自适应中的交互与对齐顺序提出了有价值的反思，虽与自动驾驶感知直接关联有限，但其跨模态对齐思想对多传感器融合有借鉴意义。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.contribution: 提出先交互后对齐的跨模态域自适应动作识别框架。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.innovation: 将跨模态知识交互置于域对齐之前，缓解模态偏差。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.result: 在多个域自适应动作识别基准上取得优于现有方法的识别精度。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-._arxiv_id: Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-Modal Knowledge for Domain Adaptive Action Recognition.

2204.04588|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP式视觉-语言对比学习无法有效处理网络图文数据中噪声多对多对应关系的问题，论文提出基于渐进自蒸馏与软图文对齐的跨模态对比学习框架。模型在每个minibatch中对部分图文动态生成软对齐目标并蒸馏自身知识来更新参数，无需额外计算开销。在14个基准数据集上，该方法在零样本分类、线性探测迁移和图文检索上均持续优于CLIP，并在ImageNet鲁棒性测试中展现出对自然分布偏移更好的有效鲁棒性。
2204.04588|v2.summary_en: To address the noisy many-to-many correspondences in web-harvested image-text data that undermine CLIP's contrastive objective, this paper introduces a cross-modal contrastive framework with progressive self-distillation and soft image-text alignments. The model dynamically generates soft-alignment targets for a subset of each minibatch and distills its own knowledge to update parameters without added compute. Across 14 benchmarks, it consistently outperforms CLIP in zero-shot classification, linear probing, and retrieval, and shows improved effective robustness to natural distribution shifts.
2204.04588|v2.assessment: 该工作为视觉-语言预训练中的噪声对应问题提供了简洁有效的自蒸馏方案，对多模态感知与VLM预训练具有较高参考价值。
2204.04588|v2.contribution: 提出渐进自蒸馏与软对齐的跨模态对比学习框架。
2204.04588|v2.innovation: 用自蒸馏动态生成软图文对齐目标以处理噪声对应。
2204.04588|v2.result: 在14个基准上零样本分类、线性探测与检索均超越CLIP，且鲁棒性更优。

Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D目标检测中稀疏点云与稠密图像特征难以有效融合的问题，论文提出可变形特征聚合方法用于动态多模态3D检测。方法通过可变形注意力在3D空间中自适应采样并聚合跨模态特征，避免投影带来的信息损失与错位。相比固定投影或体素化融合策略，该方法能动态聚焦于目标相关区域。在自动驾驶3D检测基准上取得了有竞争力的检测精度，验证了可变形聚合在多模态融合中的有效性。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-modal 3D object detection by proposing deformable feature aggregation that adaptively samples and aggregates cross-modal features in 3D space. The approach mitigates projection-induced information loss and misalignment compared with fixed projection or voxelization fusion. It achieves competitive detection accuracy on autonomous driving 3D benchmarks.
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.assessment: 可变形注意力用于多模态3D融合思路清晰，对BEV/多相机与LiDAR融合方向的研究者有直接参考价值。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.contribution: 提出用于动态多模态3D目标检测的可变形特征聚合方法。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.innovation: 在3D空间自适应采样聚合跨模态特征以规避投影损失。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.result: 在自动驾驶3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的精度。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam._arxiv_id: Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynamic Multi-modal 3D Object Detection.

Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.summary_cn: 针对多模态目标检测中不同模态预测置信度校准不一致的问题，论文提出概率集成（Probabilistic Ensembling）方法。方法将各模态检测器的输出建模为概率分布并进行概率化融合，而非简单的分数平均或NMS后处理。相比传统晚期融合策略，该方法能更合理地处理模态间置信度差异与不确定性。在RGB-热成像等多模态检测基准上提升了检测精度，尤其在低照度等挑战场景下表现更稳健。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.summary_en: This paper addresses inconsistent confidence calibration across modalities in multi-modal object detection by proposing probabilistic ensembling. It models each modality's detector outputs as probability distributions and fuses them probabilistically rather than via naive score averaging or post-hoc NMS. Experiments on multi-modal detection benchmarks show improved accuracy, particularly under challenging low-light conditions.
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.assessment: 概率化融合思路对多传感器检测的置信度融合有启发，虽偏通用检测但可迁移至自动驾驶多模态感知。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.contribution: 提出多模态目标检测的概率集成融合方法。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.innovation: 以概率分布建模并融合各模态检测输出以处理置信度不一致。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.result: 在多模态检测基准上提升精度，挑战场景下更稳健。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil._arxiv_id: Multimodal Object Detection via Probabilistic Ensembling.

2210.09615|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中稀疏点云与稠密像素跨模态融合易造成投影信息损失的问题，论文提出同构多模态特征融合与交互方法（HMFI）。方法先通过图像体素提升模块（IVLM）将2D图像特征提升到3D空间生成同构图像体素特征，再用基于自注意力的查询融合机制（QFM）融合点云与图像体素特征，并提出体素特征交互模块（VFIM）增强交互。相比投影式或稀疏-稠密混合融合，该方法避免了投影信息损失。在自动驾驶3D检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
2210.09615|v2.summary_en: To avoid projective information loss in fusing sparse point clouds with dense pixels, this paper proposes Homogeneous Multi-modal Feature Fusion and Interaction (HMFI) for 3D object detection. An Image Voxel Lifter Module lifts 2D image features into 3D to form homogeneous image voxels, a self-attention-based Query Fusion Mechanism fuses point cloud and image voxel features, and a Voxel Feature Interaction Module further enhances cross-modal interaction. It outperforms prior fusion approaches on autonomous driving 3D detection benchmarks.
2210.09615|v2.assessment: 将图像特征提升到LiDAR 3D空间实现同构融合的思路对多模态BEV/3D检测研究者有较强参考价值。
2210.09615|v2.contribution: 提出同构多模态特征融合与交互的3D目标检测方法HMFI。
2210.09615|v2.innovation: 通过图像体素提升与查询融合机制在3D空间实现同构跨模态融合。
2210.09615|v2.result: 在自动驾驶3D检测基准上性能优于现有融合方法。

Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D目标检测中跨模态特征表达不足的问题，论文提出利用局部自注意力增强多模态特征的方法。方法在融合后的多模态特征上引入局部自注意力机制，以在保持计算效率的同时捕获局部区域内的上下文依赖关系。相比全局注意力或纯卷积融合，局部自注意力在精度与效率间取得更好平衡。在自动驾驶3D检测基准上提升了检测性能，验证了局部自注意力对多模态特征增强的有效性。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.summary_en: This paper enhances multi-modal features for 3D object detection using local self-attention. By applying local self-attention on fused multi-modal features, it captures local contextual dependencies while maintaining computational efficiency, striking a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than global attention or pure convolution. Experiments on autonomous driving 3D detection benchmarks show improved performance.
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.assessment: 局部自注意力用于多模态3D特征增强的思路实用，对BEV与多模态检测的效率-精度权衡有参考意义。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.contribution: 提出用局部自注意力增强多模态特征的3D目标检测方法。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.innovation: 在融合特征上引入局部自注意力以兼顾上下文与效率。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.result: 在自动驾驶3D检测基准上提升检测性能。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc._arxiv_id: Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Local Self-attention for 3D Object Detection.

2207.09805|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D标注依赖大量人工、现有自动标注器受点云稀疏性制约的问题，提出端到端多模态Transformer自动标注器MTrans，利用LiDAR与图像从弱2D框生成精确3D框。方法通过图像信息生成新3D点以稠密化稀疏点云，并以多任务设计同时进行前景/背景分割、点云稠密化和3D框回归。相比SOTA自动标注器，在KITTI moderate和hard上3D AP分别提升4.48%和4.03%，扩展用于3D检测时在KITTI hard达到89.45% AP。
2207.09805|v2.summary_en: To reduce the human effort in LiDAR 3D annotation, this paper proposes MTrans, an end-to-end multimodal transformer autolabeler that generates precise 3D boxes from weak 2D boxes using both LiDAR and images. It densifies sparse point clouds by generating new 3D points from 2D image information and jointly performs foreground/background segmentation, densification, and 3D box regression in a multi-task design. It outperforms the state-of-the-art autolabeler by 4.48% and 4.03% 3D AP on KITTI moderate and hard, and reaches 89.45% AP on KITTI hard when extended to 3D detection.
2207.09805|v2.assessment: 将多模态Transformer用于自动标注并显式解决点云稀疏性，对降低3D标注成本有实际价值，实验提升明显。
2207.09805|v2.contribution: 提出利用图像稠密化点云的多模态Transformer自动标注框架MTrans。
2207.09805|v2.innovation: 通过图像生成新3D点缓解稀疏性，并以多任务统一分割、稠密化与3D框回归。
2207.09805|v2.result: KITTI moderate/hard 3D AP分别提升4.48%/4.03%，扩展检测在hard达89.45% AP。
