2203.09510|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督2D与3D目标检测各自独立、未利用图像与点云互补性的问题，提出联合半监督学习框架DetMatch。方法通过识别两个传感器共同检测到的物体生成更干净、更鲁棒的伪标签，抑制单模态错误传播，并利用RGB图像的丰富语义纠正错误的3D类别预测、改善3D框定位。在KITTI和Waymo上优于强半监督基线，并获得更高质量的伪标签。
2203.09510|v2.summary_en: Observing that 2D and 3D semi-supervised pipelines are developed independently despite paired image and point cloud frames, this paper proposes DetMatch, a flexible framework for joint semi-supervised learning on 2D and 3D modalities. It generates cleaner and more robust pseudo-labels by identifying objects detected in both sensors, stymies single-modality error propagation, and uses RGB semantics to rectify 3D class predictions and improve 3D box localization. It improves upon strong semi-supervised baselines on KITTI and Waymo with higher-quality pseudo-labels.
2203.09510|v2.assessment: 首次将多模态融合系统性地引入2D-3D联合半监督检测，伪标签净化思路清晰，在KITTI/Waymo上验证有效。
2203.09510|v2.contribution: 提出联合2D与3D模态的半监督目标检测框架DetMatch。
2203.09510|v2.innovation: 利用双传感器共识生成更干净伪标签，并用RGB语义纠正3D类别与定位。
2203.09510|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上超越强半监督基线，伪标签质量更高。

2203.09855|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景3D相机常产生带缺失数据的360°深度、需要从稀疏深度和全景RGB恢复稠密全景深度的问题，提出全景深度补全（PDC）任务及M³PT多模态掩码预训练方法。预训练时用共享随机掩码同时遮盖全景RGB图像块和稀疏深度，再重建被掩区域的稀疏深度，首次证明掩码预训练在多模态视觉任务中的有效性。该方法与MAE不同，预训练与微调之间无架构差异。
2203.09855|v2.summary_en: This paper formulates panoramic depth completion (PDC), aiming to recover dense 360° depths from raw sparse depths and panoramic RGB images. It proposes M³PT, a multi-modal masked pre-training approach that simultaneously masks patches of panoramic RGB and sparse depth with a shared random mask and reconstructs the sparse depth in masked regions. It is the first to show the effectiveness of masked pre-training in a multi-modal vision task, with no architectural difference between pre-training and fine-tuning, unlike MAE.
2203.09855|v2.assessment: 将掩码预训练拓展到多模态深度补全并定义新任务PDC，思路新颖，但应用场景相对小众。
2203.09855|v2.contribution: 提出全景深度补全任务及多模态掩码预训练方法M³PT。
2203.09855|v2.innovation: 用共享随机掩码同时遮盖RGB与稀疏深度并重建，预训练与微调架构一致。
2203.09855|v2.result: 首次验证掩码预训练在多模态视觉任务中的有效性。

2203.14395|v2.summary_cn: 针对纯图像-文本对比式视觉语言预训练因双流架构仅做全局对齐而忽略细粒度对齐的问题，提出单流架构在全局、patch-token细粒度和概念/语义多个层级对齐图像与语言。方法包含两个新任务：对称跨模态重建（XMM）通过遮盖一个模态的token并用跨模态信息重建，增强细粒度对齐；伪标签关键词预测（PSL）用注意力选择caption关键词，并用动量编码器推荐图像中存在但caption缺失的关键词，训练视觉编码器预测其存在以学习语义概念。
2203.14395|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of fine-grained alignment in dual-stream contrastive vision-language pretraining, this paper proposes a single-stream architecture that aligns images and language at global, fine-grained patch-token, and conceptual/semantic levels. It introduces two tasks: symmetric cross-modality reconstruction (XMM), which masks tokens from one modality and reconstructs them using cross-modal information, and pseudo-labeled key word prediction (PSL), which uses attention to select keywords and a momentum encoder to recommend missing but image-present keywords for the visual encoder to predict. This improves fine-grained alignment and semantic grounding.
2203.14395|v2.assessment: 单流多层级对齐设计合理，XMM与PSL两个预训练任务互补，对视觉语言预训练有参考价值。
2203.14395|v2.contribution: 提出单流多层级对齐的视觉语言预训练框架及XMM、PSL两个任务。
2203.14395|v2.innovation: 在全局、patch-token和语义三个层级对齐，并用伪标签关键词预测增强语义接地。
2203.14395|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在细粒度对齐与语义概念学习上优于双流对比方法。

2111.05759|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中现有Transformer方法用LSTM解码器或手工设计隐状态将时序上下文表示为固定长度向量、难以捕捉长期时序上下文的问题，提出变长记忆多模态Transformer（MTVM）。MTVM通过记忆库直接存储先前激活来跟踪导航轨迹，并引入记忆感知一致性损失，配合随机掩码指令学习更好的时序上下文联合表示。
2111.05759|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation that existing Transformer-based VLN methods represent temporal context as a fixed-length vector via LSTM decoders or manually designed hidden states, this paper introduces Multimodal Transformer with Variable-length Memory (MTVM). MTVM tracks the navigation trajectory by directly storing previous activations in a memory bank and proposes a memory-aware consistency loss with randomly masked instructions to learn a better joint representation of temporal context.
2111.05759|v2.assessment: 变长记忆机制对VLN长期时序建模有针对性改进，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
2111.05759|v2.contribution: 提出带变长记忆的多模态Transformer用于视觉语言导航。
2111.05759|v2.innovation: 用记忆库显式存储历史激活，并设计记忆感知一致性损失。
2111.05759|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称能更好捕捉长期时序上下文。

2210.17322|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言预训练（VLP）模型在流式图像-文本数据上持续学习时出现的灾难性遗忘问题。作者提出伪文本回放（pseudo text replay），基于记忆中的训练图像生成困难负样本文本，以更好地保留已学知识并提升对比损失中负样本的多样性；同时提出图像与文本之间的多模态知识蒸馏，对齐新旧模型的实例级预测。在Conceptual Caption数据集的实例增量和类增量划分上进行增量预训练，实验表明该方法能有效缓解多模态持续学习中的遗忘。
2210.17322|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual vision-language pre-training (VLP) with sequential image-text data. It introduces pseudo text replay that generates hard negative texts conditioned on in-memory training images, preserving learned knowledge and increasing negative sample diversity, along with multi-modal knowledge distillation between images and texts to align instance-wise predictions of old and new models. Incremental pre-training on instance- and class-incremental splits of Conceptual Caption demonstrates effective mitigation of forgetting.
2210.17322|v2.assessment: 将生成式回放与多模态蒸馏结合用于VLP持续学习，思路新颖，对多模态持续学习方向有参考价值。
2210.17322|v2.contribution: 提出伪文本回放与多模态知识蒸馏相结合的持续视觉-语言预训练框架。
2210.17322|v2.innovation: 利用生成式困难负样本文本回放替代真实数据回放，并跨模态对齐新旧模型预测。
2210.17322|v2.result: 在Conceptual Caption增量划分上有效缓解了灾难性遗忘，保持并提升了零样本泛化能力。

2306.14182|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多模态模型结构固定、难以应对输入模态多样性导致的模态不匹配问题。提出Switch-BERT，通过引入可学习的逐层与跨层交互，从一组注意力模式中优化注意力，并能关注不同深度的输出，从而缓解模态不匹配。在视觉问答、图文检索和指代表达理解任务上，Switch-BERT相比ViLBERT、UNITER等固定结构模型能持续取得更好或相当的性能。
2306.14182|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the modality mismatch problem caused by fixed architectures in multimodal learning. It proposes Switch-BERT, which extends BERT with learnable layer-wise and cross-layer interactions, optimizing attention over a set of attention modes and attending to outputs from various depths. Experiments on VQA, image-text retrieval, and referring expression comprehension show consistent better or comparable performance than fixed-structure models such as ViLBERT and UNITER.
2306.14182|v2.assessment: 动态注意力切换机制对多模态交互建模有一定启发，但整体属于对现有架构的增量改进。
2306.14182|v2.contribution: 提出可切换注意力与输入的Switch-BERT，实现动态多模态交互建模。
2306.14182|v2.innovation: 通过可学习的注意力模式选择和跨层输出关注来缓解模态不匹配。
2306.14182|v2.result: 在VQA、图文检索和指代表达理解上取得优于或媲美ViLBERT、UNITER的性能。

2204.08058|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频-音频-文本多模态理解与生成缺乏窄而丰富数据集的问题。作者基于开源游戏CoinRun构建了大规模数据集MUGEN，通过修改游戏引入音频和新交互，训练不同目标的RL智能体与13个物体和角色交互，自动采集375K个3.2秒视频片段并由人工标注文本描述，同时从游戏引擎提取语义图和模板文本。在视频-音频-文本检索与生成任务上对代表性方法进行了基准测试。
2204.08058|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of narrow yet rich datasets for video-audio-text multimodal understanding and generation. It presents MUGEN, a large-scale dataset built on the CoinRun platform game with added audio and interactions, where RL agents interact with 13 objects/characters to automatically collect 375K 3.2s video clips with human text descriptions and engine-extracted semantic maps. Representative approaches are benchmarked on video-audio-text retrieval and generation tasks.
2204.08058|v2.assessment: 数据集构建扎实、标注丰富，为多模态视频-音频-文本研究提供了可控的评测平台。
2204.08058|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模视频-音频-文本多模态数据集MUGEN及配套基准任务。
2204.08058|v2.innovation: 利用游戏引擎自动生成精确语义标注并与人工文本描述结合，兼顾规模与丰富性。
2204.08058|v2.result: 提供375K视频片段及多任务基准，推动多模态理解与生成研究。

2301.06782|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对室外场景下新视角合成与隐式场景重建缺乏大规模多模态基准的问题，构建了一个大规模室外多模态数据集与评测基准。方法上采集了多模态数据（如相机与LiDAR）并提供统一的NVS与隐式重建评测协议。相比已有工作，其改进在于面向室外复杂场景与多模态融合，弥补了现有数据集多为室内或单模态的不足。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但提供了可复现的基准以推动该方向研究。
2301.06782|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multi-modal benchmarks for novel view synthesis and implicit scene reconstruction in outdoor scenarios by introducing a large-scale outdoor multi-modal dataset and benchmark. It provides multi-modal data and a unified evaluation protocol for NVS and implicit reconstruction. Compared with existing indoor or single-modal datasets, it targets complex outdoor scenes and multi-modal fusion, offering a reproducible benchmark to advance the field.
2301.06782|v2.assessment: 对自动驾驶感知中的场景重建与仿真有参考价值，但更偏数据集/基准贡献，方法创新有限。
2301.06782|v2.contribution: 构建了面向室外新视角合成与隐式重建的大规模多模态数据集与基准。
2301.06782|v2.innovation: 将多模态室外数据与统一的NVS/隐式重建评测协议结合。
2301.06782|v2.result: 提供了可复现的基准，摘要未给出具体量化指标。

A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.summary_cn: 该论文针对复杂时空与因果关系下全局实例跟踪（Global Instance Tracking）评测不足的问题，提出了多模态全局实例跟踪基准MGIT。方法上构建了包含多模态数据与复杂时空/因果关系的跟踪基准，并设计相应评测指标。相比已有跟踪基准，其改进在于强调复杂时空与因果推理场景，更贴近真实世界跟踪挑战。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但为跟踪研究提供了新的评测平台。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited evaluation of global instance tracking under complex spatio-temporal and causal relationships by proposing a multi-modal benchmark, MGIT. It constructs a multi-modal tracking benchmark with complex spatio-temporal and causal settings and designs corresponding metrics. Compared with existing tracking benchmarks, it emphasizes complex spatio-temporal and causal reasoning, providing a new evaluation platform for tracking research.
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.assessment: 对跟踪与视频理解方向有参考价值，但偏基准贡献，与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度中等。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.contribution: 提出了多模态全局实例跟踪基准MGIT。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.innovation: 在跟踪基准中引入复杂时空与因果关系评测。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.result: 提供了新的跟踪评测平台，摘要未给出具体量化指标。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B._arxiv_id: A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking Benchmark (MGIT): Better Locating Target in Complex Spatio-temporal and Causal Relationship.

2303.02314|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对虚拟点/伪点基多模态3D检测中虚拟点过密导致冗余计算大、深度补全噪声降低精度的问题，提出了VirConvNet骨干与VirConv算子。VirConv包含随机体素丢弃（StVD）与抗噪子流形卷积（NRConv），分别减少近处冗余体素计算并在2D图像与3D LiDAR空间编码体素特征以抑制噪声。基于VirConv构建了VirConv-L（早融合）、VirConv-T（变换精炼）与VirConv-S（半监督伪标签）三条流水线。在KITTI car 3D检测上取得高精度与效率，摘要提及在KITTI car 3D de...（截断），表明在KITTI上达到领先性能。
2303.02314|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the redundant computation caused by dense virtual points and the precision degradation from noisy depth completion in virtual-point-based multi-modal 3D detection. It proposes VirConvNet with a new VirConv operator consisting of Stochastic Voxel Discard (StVD) and Noise-Resistant Submanifold Convolution (NRConv), which reduces redundant voxels and encodes features in both 2D image and 3D LiDAR space to suppress noise. Three pipelines (VirConv-L, VirConv-T, VirConv-S) are built, achieving strong accuracy and efficiency on KITTI car 3D detection.
2303.02314|v2.assessment: 面向多模态3D检测的实用创新，兼顾效率与精度，对自动驾驶感知有直接价值。
2303.02314|v2.contribution: 提出VirConv算子与VirConvNet骨干，用于虚拟点基多模态3D检测。
2303.02314|v2.innovation: StVD减少冗余体素计算，NRConv在2D/3D空间联合编码以抗深度补全噪声。
2303.02314|v2.result: 在KITTI car 3D检测上取得高精度与效率，摘要提及达到领先性能。

2303.12417|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云缺乏Text-3D配对数据、现有VLM用于3D理解需构造中间2D表示而丢失几何信息的问题，提出了CLIP2（Contrastive Language-Image-Point Cloud Pretraining）。方法上利用2D与3D场景中自然存在的对应关系，构建对齐的、基于实例的文本-图像-点代理，并设计跨模态对比目标学习语义与实例级对齐的点云表示。相比已有工作，其改进在于直接在真实场景中学习可迁移3D表示，避免丢失3D几何信息。在室内与室外场景上的实验表明所学3D表示具有良好迁移能力（摘要截断）。
2303.12417|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of Text-3D pairs and the loss of 3D geometry when adapting 2D VLMs to 3D understanding via intermediate 2D representations. It proposes CLIP2, which exploits naturally existing 2D-3D correspondences to build aligned instance-based text-image-point proxies and a cross-modal contrastive objective for semantic and instance-level aligned point cloud representation. Experiments on indoor and outdoor scenarios show strong transferability of the learned 3D representation.
2303.12417|v2.assessment: 将视觉-语言预训练扩展到点云的开创性尝试，对多模态3D理解有重要参考价值。
2303.12417|v2.contribution: 提出CLIP2，直接从真实场景学习文本-图像-点云对齐表示。
2303.12417|v2.innovation: 利用2D-3D自然对应构建实例级代理，并设计跨模态对比目标。
2303.12417|v2.result: 在室内外场景验证所学3D表示具有良好迁移能力。

3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云场景图预测中缺乏3D空间多模态知识积累的问题，提出了3D空间多模态知识积累方法。方法上通过融合多模态信息在3D空间中积累知识以提升场景图预测。相比已有工作，其改进在于强调3D空间中的多模态知识积累机制。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但为点云场景理解提供了新思路。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of 3D spatial multi-modal knowledge accumulation for scene graph prediction in point clouds. It proposes a method that accumulates multi-modal knowledge in 3D space to improve scene graph prediction. Compared with prior work, it emphasizes multi-modal knowledge accumulation in 3D space, offering a new direction for point cloud scene understanding.
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.assessment: 对3D场景理解与多模态融合有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其方法细节。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.contribution: 提出3D空间多模态知识积累用于点云场景图预测。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.innovation: 在3D空间中融合多模态知识以提升场景图预测。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula._arxiv_id: 3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumulation for Scene Graph Prediction in Point Cloud.

Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态跟踪中如何有效利用视觉提示（Visual Prompt）的问题，提出了视觉提示多模态跟踪方法。方法上通过视觉提示机制引导多模态跟踪，提升跟踪鲁棒性。相比已有工作，其改进在于将视觉提示引入多模态跟踪框架。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但为多模态跟踪提供了新范式。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses how to effectively leverage visual prompts for multi-modal tracking. It proposes a visual prompt multi-modal tracking method that uses visual prompts to guide tracking and improve robustness. Compared with prior work, it introduces visual prompting into the multi-modal tracking framework, offering a new paradigm for multi-modal tracking.
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.assessment: 将视觉提示与多模态跟踪结合，对跟踪与多模态感知有参考价值。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出视觉提示多模态跟踪方法。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将视觉提示机制引入多模态跟踪框架。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标。

2303.08600|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR-only方法在小型和远处物体上分割效果差、多模态方案未被充分探索的问题，本文提出MSeg3D多模态3D语义分割模型。方法上采用联合模态内特征提取与模态间特征融合，包括基于几何的特征融合GF-Phase、跨模态特征补全和基于语义的SF-Phase，并对LiDAR点云与多相机图像分别施加非对称变换以增强多模态数据。相比已有工作，MSeg3D有效缓解了模态异质性、传感器视场交集有限和多模态数据增强三大难题。在nuScenes、Waymo和SemanticKITTI数据集上取得state-of-the-art结果，并在多相机故障和多帧点云输入下保持鲁棒。
2303.08600|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inferior segmentation of small and distant objects in LiDAR-only methods and the under-explored multi-modal solution for 3D semantic segmentation. It proposes MSeg3D with joint intra-modal feature extraction and inter-modal feature fusion, including geometry-based GF-Phase, cross-modal completion, and semantic-based SF-Phase, along with asymmetric multi-modal data augmentation. MSeg3D achieves state-of-the-art results on nuScenes, Waymo, and SemanticKITTI, and remains robust under malfunctioning multi-camera input and multi-frame point clouds.
2303.08600|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了多模态3D语义分割中的核心难题，实验充分且在多数据集上验证，对自动驾驶感知研究者具有重要参考价值。
2303.08600|v2.contribution: 提出MSeg3D多模态3D语义分割框架，统一解决模态异质性、视场交集有限和数据增强三大问题。
2303.08600|v2.innovation: 设计几何与语义两阶段融合及跨模态补全机制，并引入LiDAR与图像的非对称数据增强策略。
2303.08600|v2.result: 在nuScenes、Waymo和SemanticKITTI上达到state-of-the-art，且在相机故障和多帧输入下保持鲁棒。

2306.03932|v2.summary_cn: 针对专业领域VQA数据集规模远小于通用VQA、标注成本高但无标注图像易获取的问题，本文提出SelTDA自教数据增强策略。该方法利用VLM和目标数据集构建教师模型，仅以图像为条件生成问答伪标签，对无标注图像进行标注后与原始数据联合微调。相比已有工作，SelTDA无需额外人工标注即可提升模型对对抗性问题、反事实样本和改写问题的鲁棒性，改善域泛化并更好保留数值推理能力。
2306.03932|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of finetuning large VLMs on small-scale specialized VQA datasets where unlabeled images are available but annotations are scarce. It introduces SelTDA, which builds a teacher model to generate question-answer pseudolabels conditioned on images alone, then finetunes the VLM on the original dataset augmented with pseudolabeled images. SelTDA improves robustness to adversarial questions, counterfactual examples, and rephrasings, enhances domain generalization, and better retains numerical reasoning skills without additional annotation.
2306.03932|v2.assessment: 该工作为数据稀缺场景下的VLM微调提供了简洁有效的自训练方案，对多模态学习研究者有借鉴意义。
2306.03932|v2.contribution: 提出SelTDA自教数据增强策略，利用VLM自身生成伪标签以扩充小规模VQA数据集。
2306.03932|v2.innovation: 构建仅以图像为条件的教师模型生成问答伪标签，实现无额外标注的数据增强。
2306.03932|v2.result: 提升了对对抗问题、反事实样本和改写的鲁棒性，改善域泛化并保留数值推理能力。

2303.02483|v2.summary_cn: 针对时尚领域多种V+L任务各自独立微调导致参数低效且无法利用任务间关联的问题，本文提出FAME-ViL多任务高效学习模型。方法上设计任务通用架构，将交叉注意力适配器和任务特定适配器集成到统一V+L模型中，并提出稳定的多任务训练策略以支持异构数据学习并防止负迁移。相比已有方法，FAME-ViL用单一模型处理多个异构时尚任务，节省61.5%参数。在四个时尚任务上验证了有效性。
2303.02483|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the parameter inefficiency and inability to exploit inter-task relatedness in fashion V+L tasks caused by independent task-specific finetuning. It proposes FAME-ViL, a multi-task efficient learning method with a task-versatile architecture integrating cross-attention adapters and task-specific adapters into a unified V+L model, plus a stable multi-task training strategy preventing negative transfer. FAME-ViL saves 61.5% of parameters over existing approaches and is validated on four fashion tasks.
2303.02483|v2.assessment: 该工作在多任务V+L学习方面提供了参数高效的适配器方案，对多模态多任务研究者有一定参考价值。
2303.02483|v2.contribution: 提出FAME-ViL统一模型，用单一V+L模型高效处理多个异构时尚任务。
2303.02483|v2.innovation: 设计交叉注意力适配器与任务特定适配器集成的任务通用架构及防负迁移的多任务训练策略。
2303.02483|v2.result: 相比已有方法节省61.5%参数，在四个时尚任务上取得良好效果。

2303.14302|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有图像美学评估方法依赖人工标注评分、过度简化人类感知的问题，本文提出从用户评论中学习图像美学，并探索视觉-语言预训练方法。方法上用图像-评论对预训练图像-文本编码器-解码器模型，结合对比和生成目标学习通用美学语义，并提出轻量级基于排序的适配器以文本为锚学习美学排序概念。相比已有工作，该方法在AVA-Captions数据集上的图像美学描述任务中优于先前方法。
2303.14302|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the oversimplification of human aesthetic perception in existing image aesthetic assessment methods that rely on human-labeled rating scores. It proposes learning image aesthetics from user comments via vision-language pretraining, using an image-text encoder-decoder pretrained with image-comment pairs under contrastive and generative objectives, plus a lightweight rank-based adapter using text as an anchor. The pretrained model outperforms prior works on image aesthetic captioning over the AVA-Captions dataset.
2303.14302|v2.assessment: 该工作将VLM预训练引入美学评估，思路新颖，对多模态预训练应用研究者有启发意义。
2303.14302|v2.contribution: 提出从用户评论中学习图像美学的视觉-语言预训练方法及轻量级排序适配器。
2303.14302|v2.innovation: 利用图像-评论对进行对比与生成预训练，并以文本为锚学习美学排序概念。
2303.14302|v2.result: 在AVA-Captions数据集的图像美学描述任务上优于先前方法。

2304.04231|v2.summary_cn: 针对监督式人群计数依赖昂贵人工标注、密集场景标注困难的问题，本文提出无监督框架CrowdCLIP。核心思想基于两点观察：CLIP在下游任务表现优异，且人群图像块与计数文本存在自然映射。训练阶段利用多模态排序损失，构建排序文本提示匹配按大小排序的人群图像块以指导图像编码器学习；测试阶段提出渐进过滤策略先筛选高潜力图像块再映射到语言空间。在五个挑战性数据集上优于先前无监督方法。
2304.04231|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly manual labeling in supervised crowd counting, especially in dense scenes, by proposing an unsupervised framework CrowdCLIP. It exploits CLIP's strong downstream performance and the natural mapping between crowd patches and count text, using a multi-modal ranking loss with ranking text prompts during training and a progressive filtering strategy during testing. Extensive experiments on five challenging datasets show CrowdCLIP outperforms previous unsupervised methods.
2304.04231|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将视觉-语言知识用于人群计数，为无监督计数任务提供了新思路，对VLM应用研究者有参考价值。
2304.04231|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于视觉-语言模型的无监督人群计数框架CrowdCLIP。
2304.04231|v2.innovation: 利用多模态排序损失和渐进过滤策略，将人群图像块与计数文本在语言空间中对齐。
2304.04231|v2.result: 在五个挑战性数据集上优于先前无监督方法。

2301.00182|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频识别中如何高效迁移预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）知识的问题，现有方法对VLM跨模态桥梁的利用仍不充分。本文提出BIKE框架，通过Video Attribute Association机制利用视频到文本知识生成辅助文本属性，并用Temporal Concept Spotting机制以无参数方式从文本到视频知识中捕捉时序显著性。相比已有工作，BIKE双向挖掘跨模态知识而非单向迁移，在Kinetics-400/600、UCF-101、HMDB-51、ActivityNet和Charades六个数据集上于通用、零样本等场景取得SOTA性能。
2301.00182|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored transfer of pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) knowledge to video recognition. It proposes BIKE, a framework that exploits the cross-modal bridge bidirectionally via a Video Attribute Association mechanism for generating textual auxiliary attributes and a parameter-free Temporal Concept Spotting mechanism for capturing temporal saliency. Experiments on six video datasets (Kinetics-400/600, UCF-101, HMDB-51, ActivityNet, Charades) show state-of-the-art results in general and zero-shot recognition.
2301.00182|v2.assessment: 对视频理解与VLM迁移方向有参考价值，双向跨模态知识挖掘思路清晰，实验覆盖广，但与本用户核心的自动驾驶感知方向关联有限。
2301.00182|v2.contribution: 提出BIKE框架，双向利用VLM的跨模态桥梁提升视频识别。
2301.00182|v2.innovation: Video Attribute Association与无参数Temporal Concept Spotting两个机制实现双向跨模态知识探索。
2301.00182|v2.result: 在六个视频数据集上于通用、零样本等场景达到SOTA。

2301.06267|v2.summary_cn: 针对经典少样本学习仅使用单模态样本、难以刻画完整概念类的问题，本文提出跨模态适配策略，利用CLIP等模型将不同模态映射到同一表示空间，把不同模态的样本（如类别名、音频）当作额外的少样本示例。例如将类名作为额外训练样本，把n-shot问题变为(n+1)-shot问题，从而用极简线性分类器取得SOTA结果，并可结合已有方法。
2301.06267|v2.summary_en: This work tackles few-shot learning where single-modality samples are insufficient to characterize a concept class. It proposes a cross-modal adaptation strategy that treats examples from different modalities as additional few-shot examples by leveraging CLIP's shared representation space, trivially converting an n-shot problem into an (n+1)-shot one. This yields state-of-the-art results with simple linear classifiers and composes with existing methods.
2301.06267|v2.assessment: 思路简洁优雅，对多模态少样本学习有启发，但方法偏简单，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
2301.06267|v2.contribution: 提出将不同模态样本视为额外少样本示例的跨模态适配策略。
2301.06267|v2.innovation: 利用CLIP共享表示空间把类名等跨模态信息转化为额外训练样本。
2301.06267|v2.result: 用简单线性分类器在少样本任务上取得SOTA。

Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be assessed; the core idea appears to replace continuous embeddings with finite discrete tokens for multimodal contrastive learning.

2303.07284|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态摘要中未能利用模态间时序对应关系及样本间内在关联的问题，本文提出A2Summ统一多模态Transformer模型，有效对齐并关注多模态输入，并提出两种对比损失建模样本间与样本内相关性。在TVSum、SumMe、Daily Mail和CNN四个数据集上均取得SOTA，并构建了大规模多模态摘要数据集BLiSS。
2303.07284|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal summarization's failure to exploit temporal correspondence across modalities and inter-sample correlations. It proposes A2Summ, a unified multimodal transformer that aligns and attends to multimodal inputs, with two contrastive losses modeling inter- and intra-sample correlations. It achieves state-of-the-art on TVSum, SumMe, Daily Mail, and CNN, and introduces the large-scale BLiSS dataset.
2303.07284|v2.assessment: 多模态摘要方向工作扎实，对比损失设计合理，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2303.07284|v2.contribution: 提出A2Summ统一多模态Transformer及两种对比损失，并构建BLiSS数据集。
2303.07284|v2.innovation: 用双对比损失建模样本间与样本内相关性以对齐多模态输入。
2303.07284|v2.result: 在四个摘要数据集上均达到SOTA。

2303.00601|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于3D点云与RGB图像的多模态工业异常检测中直接拼接特征导致模态间强干扰的问题，本文提出M3DM方法，采用混合融合方案：用patch级对比学习的无监督特征融合促进模态交互，用多记忆库的决策层融合避免信息损失并引入新颖性分类器做最终决策，还提出点特征对齐操作。在MVTec-3D AD数据集上检测与分割精度均超越SOTA。
2303.00601|v2.summary_en: This paper targets multimodal industrial anomaly detection using 3D point clouds and RGB images, where direct feature concatenation causes strong inter-modal disturbance. It proposes M3DM with a hybrid fusion scheme: unsupervised patch-wise contrastive feature fusion for modal interaction, and decision-layer fusion with multiple memory banks plus novelty classifiers. It outperforms state-of-the-art on MVTec-3D AD in both detection and segmentation precision.
2303.00601|v2.assessment: 混合融合与记忆库设计对多模态异常检测有参考价值，但工业异常检测与自动驾驶感知场景差异较大。
2303.00601|v2.contribution: 提出M3DM混合融合多模态工业异常检测方法。
2303.00601|v2.innovation: 结合patch级对比特征融合与多记忆库决策层融合，并引入点特征对齐。
2303.00601|v2.result: 在MVTec-3D AD上检测与分割精度均超越SOTA。

Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.summary_cn: 该论文针对远距离场景理解中视觉感知易受遮挡、光照和恶劣天气影响的问题，提出利用长距离声学波束成形作为补充模态进行多模态场景理解。方法上通过声学波束成形获取远距离目标的空间与语义线索，并与视觉信息融合。相比纯视觉方案，其改进点在于引入声音这一在远距离仍具穿透性的模态，弥补视觉在远距离和恶劣条件下的不足。摘要未提供具体量化结果，效果需结合正文实验判断。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of vision-only perception for long-range scene understanding under occlusion, poor illumination, and adverse weather. It proposes long-range acoustic beamforming as a complementary modality and fuses acoustic spatial/semantic cues with visual information. The key improvement over vision-only approaches is the use of sound, which remains informative at long range and in degraded visual conditions. Quantitative results are not available in the provided abstract.
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.assessment: 将声学传感引入多模态场景理解具有一定新意，对自动驾驶远距离感知有潜在启发，但需关注其实际车载部署可行性与实验充分度。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.contribution: 提出利用长距离声学波束成形进行多模态场景理解的框架。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.innovation: 把远距离声学波束成形作为视觉之外的补充模态用于场景理解。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，效果需参考正文实验。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B._arxiv_id: Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic Beamforming for Multimodal Scene Understanding.

Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.summary_cn: 该论文针对对话情感识别（ERC）任务，重新审视图神经网络在该任务中的建模方式。作者提出多变量、多频率、多模态的建模思路，试图更充分地刻画对话中说话人、上下文与情感之间的复杂依赖。相比已有单一图结构或单频率建模的工作，其改进在于从多变量与多频率角度重构 GNN 表示。摘要未给出具体数据集与量化结果。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.summary_en: This paper targets emotion recognition in conversation (ERC) and rethinks graph neural network modeling for this task. It proposes a multivariate, multi-frequency, and multimodal formulation to better capture speaker, context, and emotion dependencies. The improvement lies in reformulating GNN representation from multivariate and multi-frequency perspectives. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.assessment: 与自动驾驶/视觉感知领域关联较弱，主要价值在对话情感识别方向，对本领域研究者参考意义有限。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.contribution: 提出多变量、多频率、多模态的图神经网络框架用于对话情感识别。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.innovation: 从多变量与多频率角度重新设计对话情感识别的 GNN 建模。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim._arxiv_id: Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multimodal: Rethinking Graph Neural Networks for Emotion Recognition in Conversation.

2306.07646|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对训练时可用辅助模态、推理时仅用主模态的多模态表示学习场景，研究跨模态知识蒸馏。作者指出基于互信息最大化的常用目标会导致弱教师捷径解，即教师退化为与学生同等弱。为此提出引入教师与辅助模态模型之间的互信息项，并最小化给定学生时教师的条件熵以缩小信息差，同时设计基于对比学习和对抗学习的训练方案。在三个多模态基准上，方法在视频识别、视频检索和情感分类上优于多种 SOTA。
2306.07646|v2.summary_en: This paper studies cross-modal knowledge distillation for multimodal representation learning where auxiliary modalities are available only at training. It identifies that mutual-information maximization can yield a short-cut weak-teacher solution, and addresses this by adding a mutual information term between teacher and auxiliary modality model and minimizing the teacher's conditional entropy given the student. Contrastive and adversarial training schemes are designed, and the method outperforms a range of state-of-the-art approaches on three multimodal benchmarks for video recognition, video retrieval, and emotion classification.
2306.07646|v2.assessment: 对知识蒸馏中弱教师捷径问题的分析较有洞察，方法设计合理，但应用场景偏多模态视频/情感，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2306.07646|v2.contribution: 提出防止弱教师捷径的跨模态知识蒸馏目标与训练方案。
2306.07646|v2.innovation: 引入教师-辅助模态互信息与教师条件熵约束，并结合对比与对抗学习优化。
2306.07646|v2.result: 在三个多模态基准的视频识别、检索与情感分类任务上超过多种 SOTA 方法。

SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.summary_cn: 该论文针对 3D 形状补全、重建与生成任务，提出多模态框架 SDFusion。方法基于有符号距离场（SDF）表示，融合多模态条件信息进行 3D 形状的补全、重建与生成。相比已有单模态或单一任务方法，其改进在于统一处理补全、重建与生成三类任务并支持多模态条件输入。摘要未提供具体量化结果，效果需结合正文评估。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.summary_en: This paper targets 3D shape completion, reconstruction, and generation and proposes a multimodal framework, SDFusion. It leverages signed distance field (SDF) representations and fuses multimodal conditioning to handle completion, reconstruction, and generation in a unified manner. The improvement over prior single-modal or single-task methods lies in unified multi-task handling with multimodal conditions. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.assessment: 基于 SDF 的多模态 3D 生成/补全框架对 3D 感知与占据预测有一定参考价值，但与自动驾驶在线感知的实时性需求尚有距离。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.contribution: 提出基于 SDF 的多模态 3D 形状补全、重建与生成统一框架。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.innovation: 以 SDF 表示为载体统一多模态条件下的补全、重建与生成任务。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，效果需参考正文实验。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion._arxiv_id: SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion, Reconstruction, and Generation.

MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.summary_cn: 针对多摄像头多模态跟踪缺乏大规模真实世界基准的问题，论文提出了MTMMC，一个大规模真实世界多模态摄像头跟踪基准。该基准采集了多摄像头、多模态（RGB与热成像等）的同步视频数据，并提供了跨摄像头、跨模态的跟踪标注与评测协议。相比已有单摄像头或单模态跟踪数据集，MTMMC在场景规模、模态多样性和跨摄像头关联难度上均有显著提升。该工作为多摄像头协同感知与跟踪研究提供了标准化评测平台，推动了真实复杂场景下的多目标跟踪研究。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale real-world benchmarks for multi-camera multi-modal tracking, this paper introduces MTMMC, a large-scale real-world multi-modal camera tracking benchmark. It collects synchronized multi-camera, multi-modal video data with cross-camera and cross-modal tracking annotations and evaluation protocols. Compared with existing single-camera or single-modal tracking datasets, MTMMC significantly increases scene scale, modality diversity, and cross-camera association difficulty, providing a standardized platform for multi-camera collaborative perception and tracking research.
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.assessment: 该基准填补了多摄像头多模态跟踪评测的空白，对自动驾驶与多摄像头感知研究具有较高参考价值。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.contribution: 构建了大规模真实世界多摄像头多模态跟踪基准MTMMC。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.innovation: 首次在多摄像头跟踪中系统引入多模态数据与跨模态关联评测。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.result: 为多摄像头多模态跟踪提供了标准化评测平台，推动真实复杂场景跟踪研究。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo._arxiv_id: MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Modal Camera Tracking Benchmark.

MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在专家级多学科理解与推理能力上缺乏系统评测的问题，论文提出了MMMU，一个大规模多学科多模态理解与推理基准。该基准涵盖多个学科领域，包含需要专家知识与复杂推理的多模态问题，用于评估模型在专家级AGI任务上的表现。相比已有偏感知或常识的多模态基准，MMMU更强调学科专业知识与多步推理，难度显著更高。实验表明当前先进多模态模型在该基准上表现有限，揭示了与专家级AGI之间的差距。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.summary_en: To address the lack of systematic evaluation of expert-level multi-disciplinary multimodal understanding and reasoning, this paper proposes MMMU, a massive multi-discipline multimodal understanding and reasoning benchmark. It covers multiple disciplines with expert-level multimodal questions requiring complex reasoning, evaluating models on expert AGI tasks. Compared with existing perception- or commonsense-oriented benchmarks, MMMU emphasizes disciplinary knowledge and multi-step reasoning with much higher difficulty, revealing a substantial gap between current multimodal models and expert-level AGI.
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.assessment: MMMU是评估多模态大模型专家级推理能力的重要基准，对VLM研究具有广泛影响力。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.contribution: 提出了大规模多学科多模态理解与推理基准MMMU。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.innovation: 将多模态评测提升到专家级多学科知识与复杂推理层面。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.result: 揭示了当前先进多模态模型与专家级AGI之间的显著差距。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo._arxiv_id: MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI.

MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在视频理解任务上缺乏全面评测的问题，论文提出了MVBench，一个综合性的多模态视频理解基准。该基准覆盖多种时序理解任务，系统评估模型对视频中时序动态与事件关系的理解能力。相比已有偏静态图像或单一任务的视频基准，MVBench更全面地考察时序推理，并揭示了现有模型在细粒度时序理解上的不足。该工作为多模态视频理解研究提供了标准化评测工具。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.summary_en: To address the lack of comprehensive evaluation for multimodal large language models on video understanding, this paper proposes MVBench, a comprehensive multi-modal video understanding benchmark. It covers diverse temporal understanding tasks and systematically evaluates models' comprehension of temporal dynamics and event relations in videos. Compared with existing image-centric or single-task video benchmarks, MVBench more comprehensively examines temporal reasoning and reveals deficiencies of current models in fine-grained temporal understanding.
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.assessment: MVBench为多模态视频理解提供了系统评测，对视频理解与VLM研究具有较高价值。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.contribution: 提出了综合性多模态视频理解基准MVBench。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.innovation: 系统覆盖多种时序理解任务以全面评测视频理解能力。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.result: 揭示了现有多模态模型在细粒度时序理解上的不足。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid._arxiv_id: MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark.

2402.17553|v2.summary_cn: 针对计算机交互仍高度依赖人工输入、缺乏自主虚拟代理评测的问题，论文提出了OmniACT，首个用于评估代理生成可执行程序完成计算机任务的数据集与基准。该基准覆盖桌面应用与网页场景，任务从简单操作到长时程复杂任务，输入为屏幕图像与视觉 grounding 的自然语言指令，输出为可执行脚本。相比已有偏网页自动化的基准，OmniACT扩展到多样化桌面应用并强调可执行程序生成，为多模态通用代理研究提供了评测基础。
2402.17553|v2.summary_en: To address the reliance on manual input in computer interaction and the lack of evaluation for autonomous virtual agents, this paper introduces OmniACT, the first dataset and benchmark for assessing an agent's capability to generate executable programs for computer tasks. It covers desktop applications and web scenarios with tasks ranging from simple actions to long-horizon goals, taking screen images and visually-grounded instructions as input and producing executable scripts. Compared with web-centric automation benchmarks, OmniACT extends to diverse desktop applications and emphasizes executable program generation.
2402.17553|v2.assessment: OmniACT为多模态通用代理与GUI自动化提供了新评测方向，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2402.17553|v2.contribution: 提出了首个评估代理生成可执行程序完成计算机任务的数据集与基准OmniACT。
2402.17553|v2.innovation: 将多模态代理评测扩展到多样化桌面应用与可执行脚本生成。
2402.17553|v2.result: 为多模态通用自主代理研究提供了标准化评测基础。

MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型安全性缺乏系统评测的问题，论文提出了MM-SafetyBench，一个用于多模态大语言模型安全评估的基准。该基准通过构造图文结合的对抗性查询，系统评估模型在恶意或有害指令下的安全表现。相比已有偏文本的安全评测，MM-SafetyBench揭示了图像模态可被用于绕过模型安全对齐的漏洞。实验表明现有多模态大模型在面对此类攻击时存在显著安全隐患，为多模态安全研究提供了重要参考。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.summary_en: To address the lack of systematic safety evaluation for multimodal large language models, this paper proposes MM-SafetyBench, a benchmark for safety evaluation of multimodal LLMs. It constructs image-text adversarial queries to systematically assess model safety under malicious or harmful instructions. Compared with text-centric safety evaluations, MM-SafetyBench reveals that the image modality can be exploited to bypass safety alignment, showing significant safety risks in current multimodal LLMs.
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.assessment: 该基准揭示了多模态模型的安全漏洞，对VLM安全与对齐研究具有重要价值。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.contribution: 提出了多模态大语言模型安全评估基准MM-SafetyBench。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.innovation: 利用图文对抗查询揭示图像模态绕过安全对齐的风险。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.result: 表明现有多模态大模型存在显著安全隐患。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E._arxiv_id: MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models.

TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.summary_cn: 针对夜间车辆监控缺乏空中多模态基准的问题，论文提出了TrafficNight，一个用于夜间车辆监控的空中多模态基准。该基准采集了无人机视角下的夜间多模态数据，并提供车辆检测与监控相关标注，用于评估夜间复杂光照条件下的感知方法。相比已有白天或地面视角的交通监控数据集，TrafficNight聚焦夜间空中视角与多模态融合，填补了该场景的评测空白。该工作为夜间空中车辆监控与多模态感知研究提供了数据支持。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.summary_en: To address the lack of aerial multimodal benchmarks for nighttime vehicle surveillance, this paper proposes TrafficNight, an aerial multimodal benchmark for nighttime vehicle surveillance. It collects nighttime multimodal data from UAV viewpoints with vehicle detection and surveillance annotations, evaluating perception methods under complex nighttime illumination. Compared with existing daytime or ground-view traffic surveillance datasets, TrafficNight focuses on nighttime aerial views and multimodal fusion, filling the evaluation gap in this scenario.
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.assessment: TrafficNight填补了夜间空中多模态车辆监控基准的空白，对自动驾驶与监控感知有一定参考价值。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.contribution: 构建了夜间空中多模态车辆监控基准TrafficNight。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.innovation: 聚焦夜间无人机视角与多模态融合的车辆监控评测。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.result: 为夜间空中车辆监控与多模态感知研究提供了数据支持。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench._arxiv_id: TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Benchmark for Nighttime Vehicle Surveillance.

2403.10943|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态意图识别中现有基准数据集规模有限、且难以处理多轮对话中出现的域外（out-of-scope）样本的问题，本文提出了MIntRec2.0大规模基准数据集。该数据集包含1,245段对话、15,040个样本，覆盖30个细粒度意图类别，其中9,304个为域内样本、5,736个为多轮语境下的域外样本，并提供了说话人信息。作者还建立了一个支持单轮/多轮数据组织、模态特征提取、多模态融合以及域内分类与域外检测的通用框架，并用经典多模态融合方法和ChatGPT等进行了评测。相比已有基准，其规模更大且首次系统性地引入多轮对话中的域外检测任务。
2403.10943|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MIntRec2.0, a large-scale benchmark dataset for multimodal intent recognition in multi-party conversations, addressing the limited scale of existing benchmarks and their inability to handle out-of-scope samples in multi-turn interactions. It contains 1,245 dialogues with 15,040 samples across 30 fine-grained intent classes, including 9,304 in-scope and 5,736 out-of-scope samples, along with speaker information. A general framework supporting data organization, modality feature extraction, multimodal fusion, and in-scope classification with out-of-scope detection is established and evaluated with classic fusion methods and ChatGPT.
2403.10943|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态对话意图理解提供了更大规模且包含域外检测的基准，对多模态与开放集识别交叉方向的研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2403.10943|v2.contribution: 构建了包含域外样本的大规模多模态多轮对话意图识别基准数据集MIntRec2.0及配套评测框架。
2403.10943|v2.innovation: 首次在多轮多方对话场景中系统性地引入并标注域外意图样本，支持域内分类与域外检测的联合评测。
2403.10943|v2.result: 数据集含1,245段对话、15,040个样本（9,304域内、5,736域外），并给出了经典融合方法与ChatGPT的评测基线。

2402.04788|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）缺乏与人类偏好对齐的评测基准这一问题，本文提出了MLLM-as-a-Judge基准，用于评估MLLM在评分评估、成对比较和批量排序三类任务中的评判能力。研究发现MLLM在成对比较中表现出接近人类的判别力，但在评分评估和批量排序上与人类偏好存在显著偏差，且即使GPT-4V等先进模型也存在偏见、幻觉和不一致等问题。该工作强调了在将MLLM视为可靠评估者之前仍需大量改进与研究。
2402.04788|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MLLM-as-a-Judge, a benchmark to assess the judging capabilities of multimodal large language models across three tasks: Scoring Evaluation, Pair Comparison, and Batch Ranking. The study finds that while MLLMs show human-like discernment in Pair Comparison, they diverge significantly from human preferences in Scoring and Ranking, exhibiting biases, hallucinations, and inconsistencies even in GPT-4V. It highlights the need for further research before MLLMs can be regarded as reliable evaluators.
2402.04788|v2.assessment: 该工作系统揭示了MLLM作为评判者的能力边界与偏差，对使用VLM进行自动评测的研究者有方法论警示意义，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
2402.04788|v2.contribution: 提出了评估多模态大模型作为评判者能力的MLLM-as-a-Judge基准及三类评测任务。
2402.04788|v2.innovation: 将LLM-as-a-Judge范式扩展到多模态场景，并系统分析MLLM评判中的偏见、幻觉与不一致性。
2402.04788|v2.result: 发现MLLM在成对比较中接近人类水平，但在评分与排序任务上显著偏离人类偏好，GPT-4V亦存在明显缺陷。

MMT-Bench: A Comprehensive Multimodal Be.summary_cn: 该论文提出MMT-Bench，一个面向多任务AGI的综合多模态基准，用于评估大型视觉语言模型。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题与定位看，其目标是构建覆盖多任务场景的评测体系以衡量LVLM的通用能力。该工作对多模态大模型评测方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。

2406.05862|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）高阶图像感知能力缺乏系统评测的问题，论文提出了 II-Bench 图像隐含意义理解基准。该基准通过大量实验评估多个 MLLM 对图像隐含语义（如抽象、情感）的理解能力，并与人类表现进行对比。实验发现 MLLM 最高准确率仅 74.8%，而人类平均 90%、峰值 98%，且模型在抽象复杂图像上表现更差；加入情感极性提示后多数模型准确率提升。该工作揭示了 MLLM 在高层语义理解上的显著不足。
2406.05862|v2.summary_en: The paper introduces II-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating higher-order image implication understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Extensive experiments show that the best MLLM reaches only 74.8% accuracy versus human average of 90% (peak 98%), with models performing worse on abstract and complex images. Adding sentiment polarity hints improves most models' accuracy, highlighting deficiencies in high-level semantic comprehension.
2406.05862|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了 MLLM 高阶感知评测的空白，对多模态理解研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2406.05862|v2.contribution: 提出了首个针对图像隐含意义理解的多模态大模型评测基准 II-Bench。
2406.05862|v2.innovation: 聚焦高阶感知与隐含语义理解，并系统对比模型与人类表现。
2406.05862|v2.result: MLLM 最高准确率 74.8%，显著低于人类平均 90%，揭示高层语义理解瓶颈。

2406.10215|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型与儿童语言学习轨迹差异不明的问题，论文提出 DevBench 多模态发展性基准，涵盖词汇、句法、语义三类共七项语言评测任务，并包含儿童与成人行为数据。研究在准确率和反应模式两个维度对比模型与人类，发现模型与人类反应模式的接近程度因任务而异，且任务表现越好的模型越接近人类行为。对 OpenCLIP 训练轨迹的分析表明，训练越充分其反应模式越接近成人。
2406.10215|v2.summary_en: DevBench is a multimodal developmental benchmark with seven language tasks spanning lexical, syntactic, and semantic abilities, accompanied by child and adult behavioral data. Evaluating vision-language models reveals task-dependent similarity to human response patterns, and OpenCLIP's responses approach adult patterns with more training. It provides a framework for comparing models to human language development.
2406.10215|v2.assessment: 该工作从发展心理学视角评测多模态模型，方法新颖，但与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关。
2406.10215|v2.contribution: 构建了包含儿童与成人行为数据的多模态语言发展性评测基准 DevBench。
2406.10215|v2.innovation: 将模型评测从准确率扩展到与人类反应模式的发展性对比。
2406.10215|v2.result: 模型表现越好的任务越接近人类反应模式，OpenCLIP 训练越充分越接近成人模式。

WONDERBREAD: A Benchmark for Evaluating.summary_cn: 该论文提出 WONDERBREAD 基准，用于评估多模态基础模型在业务流程管理（BPM）任务上的能力。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法、改进点与实验数据。从标题判断，其聚焦于将多模态模型应用于企业流程场景的评测。该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联度极低。
WONDERBREAD: A Benchmark for Evaluating.summary_en: WONDERBREAD is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal foundation models on business process management tasks. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and results cannot be summarized. The work targets enterprise workflow scenarios and has minimal relevance to autonomous driving perception.
WONDERBREAD: A Benchmark for Evaluating.assessment: 面向业务流程管理的多模态评测，与自动驾驶感知研究基本无关，信息不完整难以深入评估。
WONDERBREAD: A Benchmark for Evaluating.contribution: 提出了面向业务流程管理任务的多模态基础模型评测基准 WONDERBREAD。
WONDERBREAD: A Benchmark for Evaluating.innovation: 将多模态模型评测拓展到业务流程管理领域。

MultiTrust: A Comprehensive Benchmark To.summary_en: MultiTrust is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the trustworthiness of multimodal large language models across multiple dimensions. Due to the missing abstract, detailed methods and results are unavailable. The work contributes to trustworthy MLLM research but has limited relevance to autonomous driving perception.
MultiTrust: A Comprehensive Benchmark To.assessment: 多模态大模型可信性评测的重要基准，但信息不完整，且与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
MultiTrust: A Comprehensive Benchmark To.contribution: 提出了面向可信多模态大语言模型的综合评测基准 MultiTrust。

2410.08593|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视频语料时刻检索（VCMR）仅支持粗粒度理解、难以精确定位细粒度查询的问题，论文提出更难的细粒度 VCMR 基准及 VERIFIED 自动标注流水线。该方法利用 LLM 和 LMM 结合静态与动态增强描述模块生成多样化细粒度字幕，并通过细粒度感知噪声评估器（微调视频基础模型）过滤幻觉标注。最终构建了包含部分匹配干扰项的更具挑战性的细粒度 VCMR 基准。
2410.08593|v2.summary_en: The paper proposes a challenging fine-grained Video Corpus Moment Retrieval benchmark and VERIFIED, an automatic annotation pipeline using LLMs and LMMs with statics/dynamics enhanced captioning. A fine-granularity aware noise evaluator filters hallucinated annotations by fine-tuning a video foundation model. The resulting benchmark requires localizing the best-matched moment among partially matched candidates.
2410.08593|v2.assessment: 该工作提升了视频时刻检索的细粒度评测难度，标注流水线设计有借鉴意义，与视频理解相关但对自动驾驶感知直接帮助有限。
2410.08593|v2.contribution: 提出了细粒度视频语料时刻检索基准及自动标注流水线 VERIFIED。
2410.08593|v2.innovation: 结合 LLM/LMM 生成细粒度字幕并用噪声评估器过滤幻觉标注。
2410.08593|v2.result: 构建了包含部分匹配干扰项的更具挑战性的细粒度 VCMR 基准。

2406.14515|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统 VideoQA 基准难以覆盖完整视频内容且无法充分评估时序理解的问题，论文提出 MMBench-Video 长视频多镜头综合理解基准。该基准采用 YouTube 长视频和自由形式问题，所有问题按能力分类体系人工标注，并使用 GPT-4 进行自动评估，在准确性和鲁棒性上优于早期基于 LLM 的评估。研究对专有和开源图像/视频 LVLM 进行了全面评测，为视频理解模型评估提供了重要资源。
2406.14515|v2.summary_en: MMBench-Video is a quantitative benchmark for rigorously evaluating LVLMs on long-form, multi-shot video understanding using YouTube videos and free-form human-annotated questions. It employs GPT-4 for automated assessment with superior accuracy and robustness over prior LLM-based evaluations. Comprehensive evaluations of proprietary and open-source LVLMs are conducted.
2406.14515|v2.assessment: 该基准针对长视频时序理解评测，设计严谨，对视频理解研究有较高价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联中等。
2406.14515|v2.contribution: 提出了面向长视频多镜头综合理解的高质量评测基准 MMBench-Video。
2406.14515|v2.innovation: 采用自由形式问题与 GPT-4 自动评估，并基于能力分类体系人工标注。
2406.14515|v2.result: GPT-4 自动评估在准确性和鲁棒性上优于早期 LLM 评估方法。

2407.15754|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频多模态理解缺乏公开评测基准的问题，论文提出 LongVideoBench，包含 3,763 段网络视频及其字幕、最长可达一小时的交错视频-语言输入。作者将核心挑战定义为从长输入中检索并推理细粒度多模态信息，并提出 referring reasoning 任务：问题中包含指向相关视频片段的 referring query，模型需基于被指代上下文进行推理。基于此范式，构建了 6,678 道人工标注多选题、覆盖 17 个细粒度类别，是长视频理解领域较全面的基准之一。
2407.15754|v2.summary_en: LongVideoBench is introduced as a question-answering benchmark for long-context interleaved video-language understanding, featuring 3,763 web videos with subtitles and inputs up to one hour long. The authors formulate a referring reasoning task, where a referring query in the question points to relevant video context over which the model must reason. They curate 6,678 human-annotated multiple-choice questions across 17 fine-grained categories, providing one of the most comprehensive benchmarks for long-form video understanding.
2407.15754|v2.assessment: 为长视频多模态理解提供了系统化评测协议，对 VLM 与视频理解研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2407.15754|v2.contribution: 提出 LongVideoBench 长视频交错多模态理解基准及 referring reasoning 评测范式。
2407.15754|v2.innovation: 以 referring query 显式定位相关视频上下文，将长视频理解拆解为检索加推理。
2407.15754|v2.result: 构建 3,763 段视频、6,678 道人工标注多选题、17 类细粒度任务的综合基准。

Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界人-物交互（HOI）检测问题，即模型需在未见过的交互类别与物体组合上仍能识别交互关系。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题看其采用多模态提示（multi-modal prompts）来注入视觉-语言先验，从而泛化到开放类别。相比封闭集 HOI 检测，其改进点在于摆脱固定交互类别表，借助提示实现零样本/开放词表识别。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.summary_en: This work targets open-world human-object interaction detection, where models must recognize interactions beyond the closed training vocabulary. Based on the title, it leverages multi-modal prompts to inject vision-language priors for generalization to unseen interaction categories. Concrete method details and quantitative results cannot be verified because the abstract is missing.
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.assessment: 开放世界 HOI 是有价值的方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与实验充分度，需查阅全文后再判断。
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.contribution: 提出基于多模态提示的开放世界人-物交互检测框架。
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.innovation: 利用多模态提示将视觉-语言先验引入 HOI 检测以支持开放类别泛化。
Open-World Human-Object Interaction Dete.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体量化效果。

Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo.summary_cn: 论文面向开放词表目标检测（OVD），即检测器需识别训练集中未出现的类别。标题显示其提出场景自适应且区域感知的多模态提示（scene-adaptive and region-aware multi-modal prompt），推测通过为不同场景与不同区域动态生成文本/多模态提示，缓解固定类别提示在跨域与细粒度区域上的泛化不足。相比已有固定 prompt 的 OVD 方法，其改进点在于提示的场景与区域两级自适应。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection, where detectors must recognize categories unseen during training. The title indicates a scene-adaptive and region-aware multi-modal prompting scheme that dynamically conditions prompts on scene and region context. This improves over static prompt-based OVD methods by adapting prompts at both scene and region granularity, though quantitative results cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo.assessment: 场景与区域自适应提示是 OVD 的合理改进方向，与开放集检测主题相关，但缺少摘要难以判断实际增益。
Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo.contribution: 提出场景自适应与区域感知的多模态提示用于开放词表目标检测。
Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo.innovation: 在场景与区域两个层级上动态生成多模态提示以增强开放词表泛化。
Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体量化效果。
Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-mo._arxiv_id: Scene-adaptive and Region-aware Multi-modal Prompt for Open Vocabulary Object Detection.

AlignMiF: Geometry-Aligned Multimodal Im.summary_cn: 论文针对 LiDAR-相机联合合成（joint synthesis）问题，即同时生成几何一致的点云与图像数据。标题显示其提出 AlignMiF，一种几何对齐的多模态隐式场，推测通过将 LiDAR 与相机观测统一到共享的隐式神经场表示中，并在几何层面进行对齐，从而保证跨模态合成结果的一致性。相比单模态或弱对齐的隐式场方法，其改进点在于显式的几何对齐机制。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
AlignMiF: Geometry-Aligned Multimodal Im.summary_en: This work tackles LiDAR-camera joint synthesis, aiming to generate geometrically consistent point clouds and images. The proposed AlignMiF is a geometry-aligned multimodal implicit field that unifies LiDAR and camera observations in a shared neural implicit representation with explicit geometric alignment. This improves over single-modality or weakly aligned implicit-field approaches, though quantitative results cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
AlignMiF: Geometry-Aligned Multimodal Im.assessment: 多模态隐式场与跨模态几何对齐对自动驾驶数据合成与仿真有潜在价值，但需全文确认对齐机制与实验强度。
AlignMiF: Geometry-Aligned Multimodal Im.contribution: 提出几何对齐的多模态隐式场 AlignMiF 用于 LiDAR-相机联合合成。
AlignMiF: Geometry-Aligned Multimodal Im.innovation: 在共享隐式场中显式对齐 LiDAR 与相机的几何表示以实现跨模态一致合成。
AlignMiF: Geometry-Aligned Multimodal Im.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体量化效果。

Draw Step by Step: Reconstructing CAD Co.summary_cn: 论文针对从点云重建 CAD 建模构造序列的问题，即不仅恢复几何形状，还要还原人类建模的操作步骤序列。标题显示其提出基于多模态扩散（multimodal diffusion）的逐步绘制（Draw Step by Step）方法，推测将点云与序列建模结合，用扩散模型逐步生成 CAD 构造操作。相比仅做形状重建的工作，其改进点在于输出可编辑的构造序列而非静态几何。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Draw Step by Step: Reconstructing CAD Co.summary_en: This paper addresses reconstructing CAD construction sequences from point clouds, recovering not only geometry but also the ordered modeling operations. The proposed method uses multimodal diffusion to draw step by step, generating CAD construction operations conditioned on point cloud input. Unlike pure shape reconstruction, it outputs an editable construction sequence, though quantitative results cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
Draw Step by Step: Reconstructing CAD Co.assessment: 逆向工程与 CAD 序列生成有独立价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，且摘要缺失限制评估。
Draw Step by Step: Reconstructing CAD Co.contribution: 提出基于多模态扩散的从点云重建 CAD 构造序列方法。
Draw Step by Step: Reconstructing CAD Co.innovation: 用多模态扩散模型逐步生成 CAD 建模操作序列而非仅重建静态形状。
Draw Step by Step: Reconstructing CAD Co.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体量化效果。
Draw Step by Step: Reconstructing CAD Co._arxiv_id: Draw Step by Step: Reconstructing CAD Construction Sequences from Point Clouds via Multimodal Diffusion.

2503.15024|v2.summary_cn: 针对AIGC时代伪造媒体多样化、缺乏系统评估LVLM伪造检测能力基准的问题，本文提出Forensics-Bench，包含63,292道多选视觉问题，覆盖5个视角下112种伪造检测类型，要求模型具备识别、定位与推理能力。作者对22个开源LVLM及GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Claude等3个闭源模型进行了系统评测。该基准在伪造类型与任务覆盖面上显著超过已有工作，为LVLM取证能力提供了统一评测平台。
2503.15024|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of a comprehensive benchmark for assessing LVLMs' forgery detection capabilities amid increasingly diverse AIGC-generated fake media, this paper presents Forensics-Bench, comprising 63,292 curated multi-choice visual questions covering 112 forgery detection types across five perspectives. Thorough evaluations are conducted on 22 open-source LVLMs and three proprietary models including GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and Claude. The benchmark substantially broadens forgery type and task coverage over prior work, offering a unified evaluation platform for LVLM forensics.
2503.15024|v2.assessment: 作为伪造检测领域的综合性LVLM评测基准，覆盖面广、评测规模大，对多模态取证研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2503.15024|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖112种伪造类型、63,292道问题的LVLM伪造检测综合评测基准Forensics-Bench。
2503.15024|v2.innovation: 从伪造语义、模态、任务、类型与生成模型五个视角系统组织评测维度。
2503.15024|v2.result: 对22个开源与3个闭源LVLM完成系统评测，揭示了现有模型在伪造识别、定位与推理上的能力差距。

Mosaic of Modalities: A Comprehensive Be.summary_cn: 该论文题为《Mosaic of Modalities: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Graph Learning》，旨在为多模态图学习提供综合基准，但所提供的摘要为空，无法获取其具体问题设定、方法设计与实验结论。仅从标题判断，其关注多模态与图结构学习的交叉评测。由于缺乏摘要信息，无法评估其相对已有工作的改进与具体效果数据。

However, the provided abstract is empty, so its problem setting, methodology, and experimental findings cannot be assessed. Based solely on the title, it concerns benchmarking at the intersection of multimodality and graph-structured learning.
Mosaic of Modalities: A Comprehensive Be.assessment: 因摘要缺失无法实质评估，仅从标题看与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限，建议获取全文后再判断。
Mosaic of Modalities: A Comprehensive Be.contribution: （摘要缺失，无法确认）疑似提出多模态图学习的综合评测基准。
Mosaic of Modalities: A Comprehensive Be._arxiv_id: Mosaic of Modalities: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Graph Learning.

2411.01492|v2.summary_cn: 针对LLM/LMM在工程领域能力缺乏系统研究的问题，本文提出EEE-Bench，以电气与电子工程为测试床，包含2860道精心筛选的问题，覆盖模拟电路、控制系统等10个子领域。作者指出工程问题本质上视觉更复杂多样且解不唯一，需要模型严格整合视觉与文本信息。论文提供了大量定量评测与细粒度分析，但摘要未给出具体模型得分数据。
2411.01492|v2.summary_en: To bridge the gap in systematically studying LLMs/LMMs' engineering capabilities, this paper proposes EEE-Bench, a multimodal benchmark using electrical and electronics engineering as a testbed, with 2,860 curated problems spanning 10 subdomains such as analog circuits and control systems. Engineering problems are argued to be intrinsically more visually complex and less deterministic, demanding rigorous integration of visual and textual information. Extensive quantitative evaluations and fine-grained analyses are provided, though specific model scores are not reported in the abstract.

2506.21549|v2.summary_cn: 针对工业制造中单实例3D异常检测与分割（ADS）缺乏多视角多模态基准的问题，提出SiM3D——首个融合多视角与多模态信息、以体素级Anomaly Volume为输出的ADS基准。该基准采集了8类物体共333个实例的12Mpx高分辨率多视角图像与7M点云，并提供CAD模型与人工标注的3D分割GT，同时首次关注从合成训练数据泛化到真实测试数据的场景。作者将主流单视角方法适配到多视角3D ADS任务，并提出基于Anomaly Volume的新评测指标建立基线。该工作为工业3D异常检测提供了标准化评测平台，但任务本身与自动驾驶感知的关联有限。
2506.21549|v2.summary_en: SiM3D is the first benchmark integrating multiview and multimodal information for comprehensive 3D anomaly detection and segmentation (ADS), producing voxel-based Anomaly Volumes. It targets single-instance ADS with synthetic-to-real generalization, providing a novel dataset of 12 Mpx images and 7M-point clouds for 333 instances across 8 object types with CAD models and 3D segmentation GTs. Prominent single-view methods are adapted as baselines and evaluated with new Anomaly-Volume metrics.
2506.21549|v2.assessment: 作为工业3D异常检测的首个多视角多模态基准，数据集规模与标注质量较高，但应用场景偏工业质检，与自动驾驶感知主线相关性中等。
2506.21549|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向单实例、多视角多模态的3D异常检测与分割基准SiM3D及配套评测指标。
2506.21549|v2.innovation: 首次将多视角多模态融合与合成到真实的泛化挑战引入3D ADS基准，并提出体素级Anomaly Volume评测协议。
2506.21549|v2.result: 提供了333个实例、8类物体的高分辨率多视角图像与点云数据集，并建立了单视角方法适配的多视角3D ADS基线。

2408.11817|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有LMM评测基准难度不足、缺乏区分度的问题，提出GRAB——一个面向图分析（graph analysis）的挑战性基准，覆盖均值估计、截距、相关性等分析任务。GRAB以合成数据为主，包含3284个问题、5类任务和23种图属性，保证高质量无噪声。作者评测了20个LMM，最高分模型仅达21.0%，并通过消融分析模型成功与失败的原因，同时发布轻量版GRAB-Lite。该工作揭示了当前LMM在图理解上的显著短板，但与自动驾驶视觉感知关联较弱。
2408.11817|v2.summary_en: GRAB is a challenging graph analysis benchmark for Large Multimodal Models, comprising 3284 predominantly synthetic questions across 5 tasks and 23 graph properties. Evaluating 20 LMMs, the best model achieves only 21.0%, revealing substantial limitations in figure-based reasoning. Ablations analyze where models succeed and fail, and GRAB-Lite is released for lightweight evaluation.
2408.11817|v2.assessment: 基准设计严谨、难度高且区分度好，对LMM能力评估有参考价值，但主题偏图表理解，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性低。
2408.11817|v2.contribution: 构建了高难度、合成数据驱动的图分析基准GRAB及轻量版GRAB-Lite。
2408.11817|v2.innovation: 以合成方式保证无噪声高质量问题，覆盖23种图属性并系统评测20个LMM。
2408.11817|v2.result: 最强LMM在GRAB上仅得21.0%，表明当前模型在图分析任务上仍严重不足。

2406.08035|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视频理解基准多聚焦于一分钟以内短视频、无法满足具身智能长期决策、影评讨论和体育直播等长视频理解需求的问题，提出LVBench——专为长视频理解设计的基准。该数据集由公开视频构成，涵盖多样化任务，旨在考验多模态模型的长期记忆与长程理解能力。广泛评测显示当前多模态模型在这些高难度长视频任务上表现仍不佳。该工作为长视频理解提供了评测平台，与自动驾驶中的长时序视频感知有一定关联。
2406.08035|v2.summary_en: LVBench is a benchmark specifically designed for long video understanding, addressing the gap that existing benchmarks focus on short videos under one minute. Built from publicly sourced videos, it covers diverse tasks requiring long-term memory and extended comprehension. Extensive evaluations show current multimodal models still underperform on these demanding tasks.
2406.08035|v2.assessment: 长视频理解是视频感知的重要前沿方向，LVBench填补了小时级视频评测的空白，对自动驾驶长时序场景理解有间接参考价值。
2406.08035|v2.contribution: 构建了面向小时级长视频理解的多任务评测基准LVBench。
2406.08035|v2.innovation: 聚焦长视频的长期记忆与长程信息抽取能力，突破现有基准的短视频局限。
2406.08035|v2.result: 评测表明当前多模态模型在长视频理解任务上仍显著不足。

2410.10139|v2.summary_cn: 针对交错式多模态理解与生成（模型可任意顺序产生和解读图像与文本）评测不足、现有基准在数据规模、范围和评测深度上受限、评测指标昂贵或有偏的问题，提出MMIE——一个大规模知识密集型基准。MMIE包含2万条精心筛选的多模态查询，覆盖3大类、12个领域、102个子领域（含数学、编程、物理、文学、健康、艺术等），支持交错输入输出，混合选择题与开放式问答。作者还提出基于人工标注数据微调评分模型的可靠自动评测指标，以降低偏差。该工作为LVLM交错多模态能力提供了系统评测方案，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联较弱。
2410.10139|v2.summary_en: MMIE is a large-scale knowledge-intensive benchmark for evaluating interleaved multimodal comprehension and generation in Large Vision-Language Models, comprising 20K curated queries across 3 categories, 12 fields, and 102 subfields. It supports interleaved inputs and outputs with mixed multiple-choice and open-ended formats, and introduces a reliable automated metric based on a scoring model fine-tuned with human annotations to reduce bias.
2410.10139|v2.assessment: 基准规模大、领域覆盖广，并针对评测指标偏差问题提出自动化方案，对LVLM评测有较高价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性有限。
2410.10139|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖102个子领域、2万条查询的交错多模态理解与生成基准MMIE及可靠自动评测指标。
2410.10139|v2.innovation: 同时支持交错输入输出评测，并以人工标注微调的评分模型替代昂贵或有偏的传统指标。
2410.10139|v2.result: 提供了大规模、多领域的交错多模态评测方案，并显著降低评测偏差（摘要未给出具体分数）。

2502.19870|v2.summary_cn: 现有的大模型知识编辑基准主要针对以简单三元组表示的实体级知识，无法刻画真实世界多模态信息的复杂性。本文提出 MMKE-Bench，将编辑任务划分为视觉实体编辑、视觉语义编辑和用户特定编辑三类，并用自由形式的自然语言表示和编辑知识。该基准包含 33 个大类下的 2940 条知识和 8363 张图像，评测问题自动生成并经人工校验，作者在三种主流 LMM 上评估了五种最先进的知识编辑方法。相比已有基准，它在知识表示格式和任务多样性上更贴近真实场景。
2502.19870|v2.summary_en: Existing multimodal knowledge editing benchmarks focus on entity-level knowledge expressed as simple triplets, failing to capture real-world complexity. This paper introduces MMKE-Bench, which defines three editing tasks (visual entity, visual semantic, and user-specific editing) and represents knowledge in free-form natural language. The benchmark contains 2,940 knowledge items and 8,363 images across 33 categories, with automatically generated and human-verified questions, and evaluates five state-of-the-art editing methods on three LMMs.
2502.19870|v2.assessment: 面向多模态知识编辑的评测基准，任务设计比三元组设定更贴近真实应用，对关注 LMM 知识更新的研究者有参考价值。
2502.19870|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖三类编辑任务、采用自由文本知识表示的多模态知识编辑基准 MMKE-Bench。
2502.19870|v2.innovation: 将多模态知识编辑从实体级三元组扩展到视觉语义与用户特定编辑，并采用自然语言作为知识表示格式。
2502.19870|v2.result: 基准含 2940 条知识、8363 张图像、33 个类别，并在三种 LMM 上评测了五种编辑方法。

2408.13257|v2.summary_cn: 现有 MLLM 基准存在数据规模小、依赖模型标注导致质量受限、图像分辨率不足导致任务难度偏低等问题，难以衡量真实世界的挑战。本文提出 MME-RealWorld，从公开数据集和互联网收集 30 余万张图像，经 25 名标注员和 7 名 MLLM 专家筛选出 13366 张高质量图像，构建 29429 个问答对，覆盖 5 个真实场景下的 43 个子任务。该基准是目前规模最大的人工标注基准，分辨率最高且面向真实应用，并对 28 个主流 MLLM 进行了系统评测。
2408.13257|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLM benchmarks suffer from small scale, model-based annotation, and insufficient task difficulty due to limited image resolution. This paper presents MME-RealWorld, built from over 300K collected images with 13,366 high-quality images manually annotated into 29,429 QA pairs covering 43 subtasks across 5 real-world scenarios. It is the largest manually annotated benchmark to date with the highest resolution, and 28 prominent MLLMs are thoroughly evaluated.
2408.13257|v2.assessment: 高分辨率真实场景 MLLM 评测基准，规模与标注质量突出，适合作为多模态模型能力评估的参考。
2408.13257|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大规模、最高分辨率的人工标注真实场景 MLLM 评测基准 MME-RealWorld。
2408.13257|v2.innovation: 以高分辨率图像和人工标注为核心，针对真实世界高难度场景设计 43 个子任务。
2408.13257|v2.result: 包含 13366 张图像、29429 个问答对，覆盖 5 个场景 43 个子任务，并评测了 28 个主流 MLLM。

2410.08474|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在体育场景推理能力缺乏系统评测的问题，作者提出了SPORTU基准，包含SPORTU-text（900道人工标注解释的选择题，考察规则理解与战术推理）和SPORTU-video（7类运动、1701个慢动作视频片段、12048个QA对，覆盖从运动识别到犯规检测与规则应用的多级推理）。评测采用few-shot与CoT提示，GPT-4o在SPORTU-text上取得最高71%准确率但仍低于人类水平。该工作为体育领域的多模态推理提供了细粒度评测工具，但视觉部分与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2410.08474|v2.summary_en: To systematically evaluate multimodal large language models' reasoning in sports scenarios, the authors introduce SPORTU, a benchmark comprising SPORTU-text (900 human-annotated multiple-choice questions on rule comprehension and strategy) and SPORTU-video (1,701 slow-motion clips across 7 sports with 12,048 QA pairs spanning recognition to foul detection and rule application). Evaluated with few-shot and CoT prompting, GPT-4o reaches 71% accuracy on SPORTU-text but remains below human performance. The benchmark offers fine-grained evaluation for sports-domain multimodal reasoning, though its visual component has limited overlap with autonomous driving perception.
2410.08474|v2.assessment: 作为多模态推理评测基准，构建较为系统，但与自动驾驶感知/3D检测方向关联度低，主要价值在于VLM评测方法论参考。
2410.08474|v2.contribution: 提出覆盖文本与视频、多级推理任务的体育多模态理解基准SPORTU。
2410.08474|v2.innovation: 将体育规则理解、犯规检测与战术推理统一到文本与视频双模态评测框架中。
2410.08474|v2.result: GPT-4o在SPORTU-text上最高准确率71%，仍低于人类水平。

2410.09732|v2.summary_cn: 针对AI生成内容泛滥导致真假多模态数据难以区分的问题，作者提出LOKI基准，用于评测大型多模态模型检测合成数据的能力。LOKI覆盖视频、图像、3D、文本、音频五种模态，包含26个子类、18K道精心设计的问题，难度分级明确，并设置粗粒度判断、多选以及细粒度异常定位与解释任务。作者评测了22个开源LMM，系统分析了其在感知、知识与推理层面的表现。该工作为合成数据检测提供了跨模态评测平台，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接相关性有限。
2410.09732|v2.summary_en: To address the challenge of distinguishing authentic from AI-generated multimodal data, the authors propose LOKI, a benchmark for evaluating large multimodal models on synthetic data detection. LOKI spans video, image, 3D, text, and audio modalities with 18K curated questions across 26 subcategories and graded difficulty, including coarse-grained judgment, multiple-choice, and fine-grained anomaly localization and explanation tasks. Twenty-two open-source LMMs are evaluated, offering a cross-modal testbed for synthetic content detection with limited direct relevance to autonomous driving perception.
2410.09732|v2.assessment: 跨模态合成数据检测基准设计较全面，对VLM能力评测有参考价值，但与3D检测/BEV等核心方向关联较弱。
2410.09732|v2.contribution: 提出覆盖五种模态、含细粒度异常定位与解释的合成数据检测基准LOKI。
2410.09732|v2.innovation: 将合成数据检测统一为多模态、多难度、可解释的LMM评测任务。
2410.09732|v2.result: 对22个开源LMM完成系统评测，揭示其在合成数据检测上的感知与推理短板。
