2103.17115|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类细粒度特征易被忽略的问题，本文提出DCNet，包含Dense Relation Distillation模块对支持特征与查询特征在所有空间位置进行密集匹配，以及Context-aware Aggregation模块自适应融合多尺度特征。相比已有少样本检测方法，该方法充分利用标注新类目标的引导信息，能更好应对外观变化和遮挡。在PASCAL VOC和COCO基准上取得了当时领先的少样本检测性能。
2103.17115|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot object detection where fine-grained features of novel objects are easily overlooked with scarce annotations. It proposes DCNet with a Dense Relation Distillation module that densely matches support and query features across all spatial locations, and a Context-aware Aggregation module that adaptively fuses multi-scale features. The method better handles appearance changes and occlusions, achieving state-of-the-art few-shot detection results on PASCAL VOC and COCO benchmarks.
2103.17115|v2.assessment: 少样本检测的经典工作，密集关系蒸馏与上下文聚合设计合理，对数据稀缺场景有参考价值。
2103.17115|v2.contribution: 提出DCNet，通过密集关系蒸馏与上下文感知聚合充分挖掘支持特征并捕获细粒度多尺度信息。
2103.17115|v2.innovation: 将支持-查询特征进行全空间密集匹配，并自适应聚合多尺度特征以应对尺度变化。
2103.17115|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC和COCO少样本检测基准上取得领先性能。

2103.04612|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出少样本目标检测中新类分类与表示之间存在隐式矛盾：准确分类需要基类分布远离（max-margin），而精确表示新类需要基类分布靠近（min-margin）。为此提出Class Margin Equilibrium（CME），先用全连接层解耦定位特征将检测转为分类问题，再引入类别边界损失为新类保留边界空间，并通过对抗扰动实现边界均衡。在多个少样本检测基准上验证了方法的有效性。
2103.04612|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies an implicit contradiction in few-shot object detection between novel-class classification (requiring max-margin between base classes) and representation (requiring min-margin). It proposes Class Margin Equilibrium (CME), which decouples localization features via a fully connected layer, introduces a class margin loss to reserve margin space for novel classes, and achieves margin equilibrium through adversarial feature perturbation. Experiments on standard few-shot detection benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness.
2103.04612|v2.assessment: 从边界角度切入少样本检测的理论矛盾，视角新颖，对特征空间划分有启发。
2103.04612|v2.contribution: 提出CME方法，系统性地同时优化特征空间划分与新类重建。
2103.04612|v2.innovation: 揭示并调和少样本检测中新类分类与表示之间的max-margin/min-margin矛盾。
2103.04612|v2.result: 在多个少样本检测基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2103.04224|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督域自适应目标检测中类别无关对齐导致的负迁移问题，本文提出MeGA-CDA，将类别信息引入域自适应过程。方法采用类别判别器实现类别感知的特征对齐，并利用记忆引导生成类别特定的注意力图，将特征路由到对应类别判别器。在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
2103.04224|v2.summary_en: To address negative transfer caused by category-agnostic alignment in unsupervised domain adaptive object detection, this paper proposes MeGA-CDA, which incorporates category information into domain adaptation. It employs category-wise discriminators for category-aware feature alignment and generates memory-guided category-specific attention maps to route features to the corresponding discriminators. The method outperforms existing approaches on several benchmark datasets.
2103.04224|v2.assessment: 类别感知域自适应思路清晰，记忆引导注意力机制对解决负迁移问题有实用价值。
2103.04224|v2.contribution: 提出MeGA-CDA，通过类别判别器与记忆引导注意力实现类别感知的域自适应检测。
2103.04224|v2.innovation: 利用记忆引导生成类别特定注意力图，将特征路由至对应类别判别器以缓解负迁移。
2103.04224|v2.result: 在多个域自适应检测基准数据集上超越现有方法。

2011.10678|v2.summary_cn: 本文提出开放词汇目标检测这一新范式，旨在用有限类别的框标注加大量图像-文本对训练检测器，从而检测训练中未提供框标注的物体。方法利用图像-字幕对以更低成本覆盖更多物体类别，使检测器能定位并识别未见类别。相比零样本方法，所提方法在未见类别上准确率显著更高，同时有框标注的类别检测精度几乎不受影响。
2011.10678|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces open-vocabulary object detection, a novel formulation that trains detectors using bounding box annotations for a limited set of categories plus image-caption pairs covering a much larger variety of objects. The proposed method can detect and localize objects without box annotations during training, achieving significantly higher accuracy than zero-shot approaches while maintaining nearly the same accuracy on annotated categories.
2011.10678|v2.assessment: 开放词汇检测的开创性工作，范式影响深远，对开放集与多模态检测研究极具价值。
2011.10678|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇目标检测新范式及利用图像-字幕对训练检测器的方法。
2011.10678|v2.innovation: 将图像-文本对监督引入检测训练，实现无需框标注的类别检测与定位。
2011.10678|v2.result: 在未见类别上准确率显著高于零样本方法，已标注类别精度几乎无损。

2105.01294|v2.summary_cn: 针对极少样本（少于3个）目标检测中训练数据缺乏变化的问题，本文提出从基类迁移类内变化，引入hallucinator网络在RoI特征空间生成额外有用的训练样本。该方法可嵌入现代检测模型，在两种不同候选框生成流程的少样本检测器上均带来显著提升。在COCO基准的极端少样本设置下取得新的最优结果。
2105.01294|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of training data variation in extremely few-shot object detection (fewer than three examples), this paper transfers shared within-class variation from base classes and introduces a hallucinator network that generates additional useful training examples in the RoI feature space. The approach improves two state-of-the-art few-shot detectors with different proposal generation procedures and achieves new state-of-the-art results in the extremely-few-shot regime on COCO.
2105.01294|v2.assessment: 特征空间幻觉增强思路简洁有效，对极端少样本场景有实际意义。
2105.01294|v2.contribution: 提出hallucinator网络在RoI特征空间生成额外训练样本以增强少样本检测。
2105.01294|v2.innovation: 从基类迁移类内变化并在特征空间进行幻觉生成，缓解极端少样本数据匮乏。
2105.01294|v2.result: 在COCO极端少样本基准上取得新的最优性能。

2103.01903|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对少样本目标检测中新类数据稀缺问题，利用新类与基类之间恒定的语义关系，将显式关系推理引入新类检测学习。方法用大规模文本语料学习语义嵌入表示每个类别概念，训练检测器将物体图像表示投影到该嵌入空间，并提出用动态关系图增强嵌入以替代启发式知识图谱。所提SRR-FSD在不同shot数下表现稳健，在低显式和隐式shot设置下性能显著更优。
2103.01903|v2.summary_en: This paper leverages the constant semantic relation between novel and base classes to introduce explicit relation reasoning into few-shot object detection. It represents each class concept by a semantic embedding learned from a large text corpus, trains the detector to project object image representations into this embedding space, and augments embeddings with a dynamic relation graph instead of a heuristic knowledge graph. The resulting SRR-FSD is robust to shot variation and significantly better under low explicit and implicit shots.
2103.01903|v2.assessment: 语义关系推理与动态关系图设计新颖，shot稳定性对实际少样本部署有重要价值。
2103.01903|v2.contribution: 提出SRR-FSD，将语义关系推理与动态关系图引入少样本目标检测。
2103.01903|v2.innovation: 用文本语义嵌入与动态关系图增强类别表示，实现shot稳定的少样本检测。
2103.01903|v2.result: 在高shot下具竞争力，在低显式与隐式shot下性能显著更优。

2111.11656|v2.summary_cn: 针对小样本新类检测中整体微调范式导致特征空间分散、类间可分性差的问题，本文提出两阶段微调框架 FADI。第一步关联（Association）通过显式模仿某个特定基类特征空间来构建紧凑的新类特征空间，第二步判别（DIscrimination）进一步强化类间可分性。相比以往隐式利用多个基类知识的整体微调方法，FADI 避免了新类特征空间分散的问题。在 PASCAL VOC 和 COCO 等小样本检测基准上取得了显著提升，验证了显式关联与判别式微调的有效性。
2111.11656|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the degraded feature space in few-shot object detection caused by the holistic fine-tuning paradigm, where novel classes implicitly leverage multiple base classes and produce scattered features. It proposes FADI, a two-step fine-tuning framework that first associates each novel class with a specific base class to build a compact feature space and then enforces discrimination. Compared with prior holistic fine-tuning, FADI improves inter-class separability and achieves notable gains on standard few-shot detection benchmarks.
2111.11656|v2.assessment: 该工作对小样本检测的微调范式提出了清晰的分析与改进，方法简洁有效，适合关注低数据场景检测的研究者参考。
2111.11656|v2.contribution: 提出两阶段关联-判别微调框架 FADI，显式构建紧凑且可判别的新类特征空间。
2111.11656|v2.innovation: 用显式模仿特定基类特征空间替代隐式利用多基类知识，缓解新类特征分散问题。
2111.11656|v2.result: 在 PASCAL VOC 与 COCO 小样本检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。

2110.14191|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测依赖大规模全标注数据的问题，本文研究混合监督检测，即在已有基类全标注帮助下用弱标注学习新类。以往方法主要迁移类无关的目标性（objectness）来将弱标注升级为伪全标注，本文进一步迁移掩码先验和语义相似性：从基类学习利用掩码先验辅助检测的能力并迁移到新类，同时利用基类学到的语义相似性对伪标注去噪。在三个基准数据集上的实验表明该方法优于现有混合监督检测方法。
2110.14191|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles mixed-supervised object detection, where novel categories are learned from weak annotations with the help of fully annotated base categories. Beyond transferring class-agnostic objectness as in prior work, it transfers mask priors and semantic similarity from base categories to upgrade and denoise pseudo full annotations for novel categories. Experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over existing mixed-supervision methods.
2110.14191|v2.assessment: 该工作将掩码先验与语义相似性引入混合监督检测，思路合理且实验较充分，对弱监督/半监督检测方向有参考价值。
2110.14191|v2.contribution: 提出迁移掩码先验与语义相似性的混合监督目标检测框架，用于生成并去噪新类伪全标注。
2110.14191|v2.innovation: 在 objectness 迁移之外，额外迁移掩码先验与语义相似性以缩小新类与基类之间的差距。
2110.14191|v2.result: 在三个基准数据集上优于现有混合监督检测方法。

2203.14911|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放集目标检测中未知类别物体常被误分为已知类的问题，本文基于未知物体通常分布在潜在空间低密度区域的假设，提出OpenDet检测器。方法包含对比特征学习器（CFL）和未知概率学习器（UPL）：CFL通过实例级对比学习使已知类特征更紧凑，从而为未知类留出更多低密度区域；UPL基于预测不确定性优化未知概率，进一步在已知类簇周围划分低密度区域。相比传统阈值方法仅能覆盖有限低密度区域，OpenDet显著扩展了低密度区域，使未知物体更易被识别。在多个开放集检测基准上取得了显著提升。
2203.14911|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set object detection (OSOD), where unknown objects are often misclassified as known classes. It proposes OpenDet, which separates high/low-density regions in latent space via a Contrastive Feature Learner (CFL) and an Unknown Probability Learner (UPL). CFL encourages compact known-class features to expand low-density regions, while UPL optimizes unknown probability based on prediction uncertainty. Compared to threshold-based methods, OpenDet significantly expands low-density regions and achieves substantial improvements on OSOD benchmarks.
2203.14911|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放集检测提供了新的视角，通过显式扩展低密度区域有效缓解未知类误分问题，对自动驾驶中处理未知障碍物具有重要参考价值。
2203.14911|v2.contribution: 提出OpenDet，通过对比学习和不确定性学习扩展潜在空间低密度区域以识别未知物体。
2203.14911|v2.innovation: 首次将低密度区域扩展思想系统化地引入开放集目标检测，并设计双学习器协同优化。
2203.14911|v2.result: 在开放集检测基准上显著优于传统阈值方法，有效提升未知类召回率。

2112.02413|v2.summary_cn: 本文探索2D图像-文本预训练的CLIP模型能否泛化到3D点云识别，提出PointCLIP。方法将点云投影为多视角深度图，无需渲染，利用CLIP编码并与3D类别文本对齐，聚合多视角零样本预测实现2D到3D的知识迁移。此外设计跨视角适配器以提取全局特征并自适应融合少量3D样本知识，仅微调轻量适配器即可大幅提升性能。实验还发现PointCLIP与经典3D监督网络具有互补性，简单集成即可提升基线性能。
2112.02413|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether CLIP, pre-trained on 2D image-text pairs, can generalize to 3D point cloud recognition, and proposes PointCLIP. It projects point clouds into multi-view depth maps without rendering, aligns CLIP-encoded features with 3D category texts, and aggregates view-wise zero-shot predictions for 2D-to-3D knowledge transfer. An inter-view adapter is designed to fuse few-shot 3D knowledge. PointCLIP also shows complementarity with classical 3D-supervised networks, boosting baseline performance via simple ensembling.
2112.02413|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统验证了CLIP在3D点云理解上的可行性，为多模态3D感知提供了新思路，对自动驾驶中利用视觉-语言模型处理点云数据有启发意义。
2112.02413|v2.contribution: 提出PointCLIP，实现CLIP在3D点云识别上的零样本和少样本迁移。
2112.02413|v2.innovation: 通过多视角深度图投影和跨视角适配器，将2D视觉-语言预训练知识迁移到3D点云。
2112.02413|v2.result: 在零样本和少样本3D识别上取得显著提升，并与3D监督网络互补提升基线性能。

2205.13384|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉搜索中画廊集增量增长导致模型需反复更新且需重新提取全部特征的问题，本文提出一种持续学习方法，实现向后兼容的特征嵌入。方法通过跨会话数据一致性、邻会话模型一致性和会话内判别性三种损失训练持续学习器，避免新模型对旧画廊集特征的不兼容。此外，该方法还处理了新类别不断加入且边界模糊的场景，不假设所有类别在初始阶段已知。这是首个同时解决向后兼容特征嵌入和允许新类别出现的持续学习方法，在多个基准上验证了有效性。
2205.13384|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-term visual search where the gallery set grows incrementally, requiring model updates and costly feature re-extraction. It proposes a continual learning approach with backward-consistent feature embedding, enforced by inter-session data coherence, neighbor-session model coherence, and intra-session discrimination losses. The method also handles novel classes with blurry boundaries without assuming all categories are known initially. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness.
2205.13384|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了持续学习在视觉搜索中的实际部署难题，向后兼容特征嵌入对自动驾驶中增量式感知系统有参考价值。
2205.13384|v2.contribution: 提出首个同时实现向后兼容特征嵌入和允许新类别出现的持续学习方法。
2205.13384|v2.innovation: 通过三种一致性损失实现跨会话特征兼容，避免画廊集特征重提取。
2205.13384|v2.result: 在多个视觉搜索基准上验证了方法有效性，支持增量式画廊集扩展。

2203.06953|v2.summary_cn: 针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中新类样本不足且需避免遗忘旧类的问题，本文提出前瞻性学习方法FACT。与现有回顾性方法（使更新模型接近旧模型）不同，FACT通过为未来新类预留嵌入空间来实现前向兼容：分配虚拟原型压缩已知类嵌入，为新类预留空间，并预测可能的新类以准备更新过程。虚拟原型作为嵌入空间中的代理，在推理时构建更强分类器。FACT能高效整合新类，在FSCIL基准上取得优异性能。
2203.06953|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) by proposing ForwArd Compatible Training (FACT), which learns prospectively to prepare for future updates. Unlike retrospective methods that keep the updated model close to the old one, FACT reserves embedding space for future new classes by assigning virtual prototypes to squeeze known-class embeddings. These prototypes act as proxies to build a stronger classifier during inference. FACT efficiently incorporates new classes and achieves strong performance on FSCIL benchmarks.
2203.06953|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了前向兼容的新视角，为小样本类增量学习提供了有效解决方案，对自动驾驶中持续学习新类别目标有借鉴意义。
2203.06953|v2.contribution: 提出FACT，通过预留嵌入空间实现前向兼容的小样本类增量学习。
2203.06953|v2.innovation: 利用虚拟原型压缩已知类嵌入并为未来新类预留空间，实现前瞻性学习。
2203.06953|v2.result: 在FSCIL基准上取得优异性能，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。

2203.14843|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中照片数据难以获取（隐私或伦理限制）的问题，提出使用草图作为新模态进行类支持，构建了"Doodle It Yourself"（DIY）FSCIL框架。用户可自由绘制新类的少量草图，模型学习识别该类的照片。框架融合了梯度共识实现域不变学习、知识蒸馏保留旧类信息、图注意力网络进行新旧类间消息传递。实验表明，在类支持场景下草图优于文本，验证了多模态类支持的可行性。
2203.14843|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) when photos are unavailable due to privacy or ethical constraints, proposing sketches as a new modality for class support. The "Doodle It Yourself" (DIY) FSCIL framework allows users to sketch a few examples of a novel class for the model to recognize photos of that class. It integrates gradient consensus for domain-invariant learning, knowledge distillation for preserving old class information, and graph attention networks for message passing. Experiments show sketches outperform text as class support.
2203.14843|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了草图作为类支持模态的可行性，为隐私受限场景下的增量学习提供了新思路，但相关度相对较低。
2203.14843|v2.contribution: 提出DIY FSCIL框架，使用草图作为新模态支持小样本类增量学习。
2203.14843|v2.innovation: 首次将草图模态引入FSCIL，结合梯度共识、知识蒸馏和图注意力网络。
2203.14843|v2.result: 实验表明草图作为类支持优于文本，验证了多模态FSCIL的可行性。

2203.16588|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中必须满足内存和计算约束的问题，提出C-FSCIL。约束包括：每类训练样本极少、学习新类的计算成本恒定、模型内存随类别数线性增长。C-FSCIL架构由冻结的元学习特征提取器、可训练固定大小全连接层和可重写的动态增长内存组成，内存存储与已遇类别数相同的向量。提供三种更新模式以权衡精度与计算内存成本。利用超维嵌入，在固定维度向量空间中持续表达更多类别且干扰最小，并通过准正交对齐提升类向量表示质量。
2203.16588|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) under memory and computational constraints: few training samples per class, constant computational cost for learning novel classes, and at most linear memory growth. It proposes C-FSCIL, composed of a frozen meta-learned feature extractor, a trainable fixed-size fully connected layer, and a rewritable dynamically growing memory storing vectors for encountered classes. Three update modes offer accuracy-compute trade-offs. Hyperdimensional embedding enables continual expression of many classes with minimal interference, and quasi-orthogonal alignment improves class vector quality.
2203.16588|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了FSCIL中的资源约束问题，超维嵌入和动态内存设计对自动驾驶中资源受限的持续学习有参考价值。
2203.16588|v2.contribution: 提出C-FSCIL，在内存和计算约束下实现小样本类增量学习。
2203.16588|v2.innovation: 利用超维嵌入和可重写动态内存，在固定维度空间中持续表达大量类别。
2203.16588|v2.result: 在满足约束条件下取得良好性能，提供三种更新模式权衡精度与成本。

2204.00895|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，在存储旧任务样本受限的条件下提出一种基于知识蒸馏的自适应特征巩固方法。方法通过估计表征变化与模型更新导致的损失增量之间的关系，利用骨干网络中每个特征图的重要性来最小化损失增量的上界，从而限制重要特征的更新以保持鲁棒性，同时允许次要特征灵活变化。相比已有类增量学习方法，该策略在有限旧数据访问下更有效地缓解遗忘。在标准数据集上取得了显著的准确率提升。
2204.00895|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning under limited memory for storing previous-task examples. It proposes a knowledge-distillation-based method that estimates the relationship between representation changes and loss increases, then minimizes an upper bound of the loss increase by exploiting per-feature-map importance within the backbone. Important features are restricted from updating for robustness while less critical ones remain flexible, yielding significant accuracy improvements over existing methods on standard datasets.
2204.00895|v2.assessment: 该工作为类增量学习提供了有原则的特征巩固机制，理论动机清晰，实验验证充分，对持续学习与检测中的增量场景有参考价值。
2204.00895|v2.contribution: 提出基于知识蒸馏与自适应特征巩固的类增量学习框架，通过特征重要性约束缓解灾难性遗忘。
2204.00895|v2.innovation: 通过估计表征变化与损失增量的关系并最小化其上界，实现按特征图重要性的差异化更新约束。
2204.00895|v2.result: 在标准数据集上相比现有方法取得显著准确率提升。

2204.03634|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究从大量基类上预训练的强模型出发进行类增量学习这一被忽视的真实场景，假设强基模型已能为新类提供良好表征，增量学习只需小幅度适配。方法提出两阶段训练方案：先克隆部分骨干并在新数据上微调进行特征增强，再将基类与新类分类器融合为统一分类器。在ImageNet大规模数据集上，该方法整体准确率比最优CIL方法高出约10%，并在基类-新类重叠及分布偏移等实际场景中保持鲁棒与通用。
2204.03634|v2.summary_en: This paper explores the understudied real-world CIL setting that starts from a strong model pre-trained on many base classes, hypothesizing that incremental learning requires only small adaptations. It proposes a two-stage scheme: feature augmentation by cloning part of the backbone and fine-tuning on novel data, followed by fusing base and novel classifiers into a unified one. On large-scale ImageNet, it outperforms state-of-the-art CIL methods by about 10% overall accuracy and remains robust across practical scenarios such as base-novel overlap with distribution shift.
2204.03634|v2.assessment: 该工作重新定义了CIL的实际设定并给出简洁有效的两阶段方案，在大规模基准上提升显著，对持续学习研究具有启发意义。
2204.03634|v2.contribution: 提出面向强预训练模型的类增量学习两阶段框架（特征增强与分类器融合）。
2204.03634|v2.innovation: 将CIL设定从少量基类扩展到强预训练大基类场景，并系统分析基类-新类重叠与分布偏移等实际情形。
2204.03634|v2.result: 在ImageNet上整体准确率较最优CIL方法提升约10%。

2203.10593|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇单阶段目标检测中因缺少类别无关候选框而难以对未见类进行知识蒸馏、导致性能严重下降的问题，提出分层视觉-语言知识蒸馏方法HierKD。方法引入全局级知识蒸馏将预训练视觉-语言模型对未见类别的知识迁移到检测器，并与常见的实例级蒸馏结合，同时学习已见与未见类别。在MS-COCO上，该方法在零样本检测和广义零样本检测设定下分别比此前最优单阶段检测器提升11.9%和6.7% AP50。
2203.10593|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance degradation of open-vocabulary one-stage detection caused by the absence of class-agnostic proposals that hinders knowledge distillation on unseen objects. It proposes HierKD, a hierarchical visual-language distillation method that combines global-level distillation to transfer unseen-category knowledge from a pre-trained vision-language model with instance-level distillation to jointly learn seen and unseen categories. On MS-COCO, it surpasses the previous best one-stage detector by 11.9% and 6.7% AP50 under zero-shot and generalized zero-shot detection, respectively.
2203.10593|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了单阶段开放词汇检测的蒸馏瓶颈，提升幅度显著，对开放集/开放词汇检测方向具有较高参考价值。
2203.10593|v2.contribution: 提出分层视觉-语言知识蒸馏方法HierKD，用于开放词汇单阶段目标检测。
2203.10593|v2.innovation: 引入全局级蒸馏弥补单阶段检测器缺少类别无关候选框的缺陷，并与实例级蒸馏协同学习已见与未见类。
2203.10593|v2.result: 在MS-COCO零样本与广义零样本检测上分别提升11.9%和6.7% AP50。

Open Vocabulary Object Detection with Ps.summary_cn: 该论文关注开放词汇目标检测中缺乏新类别标注的问题，提出利用伪边界框标签来扩展检测器的词汇能力。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题可推断其核心是通过生成伪框标签为未见类别提供监督信号，从而在无需人工标注新类的情况下提升开放词汇检测性能。该方向对开放集/开放词汇检测研究具有参考意义，但需查阅全文以评估其方法严谨性与效果。
Open Vocabulary Object Detection with Ps.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection where annotations for novel categories are unavailable, proposing to leverage pseudo bounding-box labels to expand the detector's vocabulary. While the abstract is missing, the core idea is to generate pseudo box labels as supervision for unseen categories, improving open-vocabulary detection without manual annotation of new classes. The direction is relevant to open-set/open-vocabulary detection, though full-text review is needed to assess methodological rigor and results.
Open Vocabulary Object Detection with Ps.assessment: 选题切中开放词汇检测的标注瓶颈，思路有实用价值，但因摘要缺失难以充分评估其方法与实验质量。
Open Vocabulary Object Detection with Ps.contribution: 提出利用伪边界框标签进行开放词汇目标检测的方法。

2208.13722|v2.summary_cn: 该论文指出现有半监督目标检测（SSOD）方法假设无标注数据不含分布外类别，这在大规模无标注数据下不现实，因而提出更具挑战性的开放集半监督目标检测（OSSOD）问题。作者发现开放集条件下SSOD性能增益下降，根源在于语义扩展——干扰性的OOD目标被误判为分布内伪标签参与半监督训练。为此提出将在线与离线OOD检测模块集成到SSOD中，实验表明基于自监督视觉Transformer的离线OOD检测器因对伪标签干扰更鲁棒而优于在线检测器，框架有效解决语义扩展问题并在多个OSSOD设定下取得一致提升。
2208.13722|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies that existing semi-supervised object detection (SSOD) methods assume unlabeled data contain no out-of-distribution classes, which is unrealistic at scale, and formulates the more practical Open-Set Semi-Supervised Object Detection (OSSOD) problem. It attributes the reduced gains under open-set conditions to semantic expansion, where distracting OOD objects are mispredicted as in-distribution pseudo-labels. The authors integrate online and offline OOD detection modules into SSOD, finding that an offline OOD detector based on a self-supervised vision transformer is more robust to pseudo-label interference, yielding consistent improvements across OSSOD settings.
2208.13722|v2.assessment: 该工作提出并系统研究了开放集半监督检测这一实际问题，OOD检测与SSOD结合的方案有效，对开放集检测与半监督学习交叉方向有较高价值。
2208.13722|v2.contribution: 提出开放集半监督目标检测（OSSOD）问题及集成OOD检测的解决方案。
2208.13722|v2.innovation: 揭示语义扩展是开放集下SSOD增益下降的根因，并证明基于自监督ViT的离线OOD检测器优于在线方案。
2208.13722|v2.result: 有效缓解语义扩展问题，在多个OSSOD设定下取得一致性能提升。

2207.12049|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中基类过拟合与新颖类样本过拟合的问题，本文提出一种知识蒸馏框架。方法上设计了位置感知的视觉词袋（BoVW）模型，从有限图像集中学习代表性视觉词，并在独立于检测任务的特征空间中编码图像，利用两个特征空间BoVW表示的一致性作为蒸馏知识指导检测器学习。相比已有微调方法，该框架在预训练和微调两个阶段均抑制过拟合。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值提升，但声称有效缓解了类特定与样本特定过拟合。
2207.12049|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class-specific overfitting on base classes and sample-specific overfitting on novel classes in few-shot object detection. It proposes a knowledge distillation framework with a Position-Aware Bag-of-Visual-Words model that learns representative visual words from limited images and encodes images in an independent feature space. The consistency of BoVW representations across two feature spaces serves as distilled knowledge to guide detector learning, restraining overfitting in both pre-training and fine-tuning stages.
2207.12049|v2.assessment: 将视觉词袋表示引入知识蒸馏以约束少样本检测器，思路新颖，但缺乏与主流方法的定量对比细节，需关注其实际增益。
2207.12049|v2.contribution: 提出基于位置感知BoVW表示的知识蒸馏框架，用于抑制少样本目标检测中的过拟合。
2207.12049|v2.innovation: 利用独立特征空间中BoVW表示的一致性作为蒸馏信号，同时约束基类预训练与新颖类微调阶段。
2207.12049|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在少样本检测中有效缓解了类特定和样本特定过拟合。

2207.11455|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测（OWOD）无法区分多个未知类别的问题，本文提出未知类别分类的开放世界目标检测（UC-OWOD）新问题。方法上设计了两阶段检测器：第一阶段用未知标签感知提议和未知判别分类头检测已知与未知目标；第二阶段用基于相似度的未知分类和未知聚类精炼模块区分多个未知类。此外设计了两种新评估协议来评价未知类检测。大量实验与可视化证明了方法的有效性，代码已开源。
2207.11455|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Unknown-Classified Open World Object Detection (UC-OWOD), a new problem that requires detecting unknown instances and classifying them into distinct unknown classes. A two-stage detector is devised, using unknown label-aware proposals and an unknown-discriminative classification head for detection, followed by similarity-based unknown classification and clustering refinement for distinguishing multiple unknown classes. Two novel evaluation protocols are designed, and extensive experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2207.11455|v2.assessment: 将开放世界检测从二值未知检测推进到多未知类区分，问题定义和评估协议均有贡献，对开放集检测方向有参考价值。
2207.11455|v2.contribution: 提出UC-OWOD新问题及两阶段检测框架，实现未知实例的检测与多类区分。
2207.11455|v2.innovation: 未知标签感知提议、未知判别分类头以及基于相似度的未知聚类精炼模块，并设计两种新评估协议。
2207.11455|v2.result: 大量实验与可视化验证了方法在未知类检测与分类上的有效性，代码已开源。

2207.11184|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测微调范式中基类到新颖类的类无关知识难以自动区分与迁移的问题，本文提出显式学习三类基类-新颖类共性：识别相关语义共性、定位相关语义共性和分布共性。方法上设计基于记忆库的统一蒸馏框架，联合高效地蒸馏这三类共性。相比已有微调方法，该框架可便捷集成到多数现有方法中并持续大幅提升性能。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调大幅且一致的改进。
2207.11184|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the implicit assumption in fine-tuning based few-shot object detection that class-agnostic knowledge transfers from base to novel classes without explicit modeling. It proposes to explicitly learn three types of base-novel commonalities: recognition-related semantic, localization-related semantic, and distribution commonalities, unified in a memory-bank-based distillation framework. The method can be integrated into most existing fine-tuning approaches and consistently improves performance by a large margin.
2207.11184|v2.assessment: 对少样本检测中知识迁移的显式建模思路清晰，记忆库蒸馏框架通用性强，适合关注知识蒸馏与少样本检测交叉的研究者。
2207.11184|v2.contribution: 提出基于记忆库的统一蒸馏框架，显式学习基类与新颖类间的三类类无关共性。
2207.11184|v2.innovation: 将识别语义、定位语义和分布共性统一蒸馏，可即插即用地增强现有微调式少样本检测方法。
2207.11184|v2.result: 可集成到多数现有微调方法中并一致地大幅提升性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2205.15225|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D点云目标上的少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）问题，本文指出除灾难性遗忘和少样本过拟合外，3D FSCIL还面临基类含大量合成实例而增量步仅少量真实扫描样本的合成到真实数据差异挑战。方法上提出使用Microshapes（正交基向量）以预定义规则描述任意3D物体，支持少样本增量训练并最小化合成到真实的数据差异。摘要未给出具体数值，声称缓解了后续增量步的性能下降。
2205.15225|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) for 3D point cloud objects, highlighting additional challenges beyond catastrophic forgetting and few-shot overfitting, namely the synthetic-to-real data variation between base classes and incrementally added real-scanned novel classes. It proposes using Microshapes, orthogonal basis vectors that describe any 3D object via a predefined set of rules, to support few-shot incremental training while minimizing synthetic-to-real variation. The method is claimed to mitigate performance degradation in later incremental steps.
2205.15225|v2.assessment: 将FSCIL拓展到3D点云并关注合成到真实的域差异，问题设定有实际意义，但摘要缺乏定量结果，需关注其与2D方法的可比性。
2205.15225|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究3D点云目标上的少样本类增量学习，并提出Microshapes表示应对合成到真实差异。
2205.15225|v2.innovation: 用正交基向量Microshapes以预定义规则描述3D物体，支持少样本增量训练并减小合成-真实域差异。
2205.15225|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称缓解了后续增量步的性能下降。

2208.08165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（SGG）中所有物体类别必须在训练集中出现的封闭设定限制实际应用的问题，提出了开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）这一新设定：模型仅在基础物体类别上训练，却需对未见过的目标物体类别推断关系。方法上采用两步策略，先在大规模粗粒度区域-描述数据上预训练，再用两种基于prompt的技术在不更新预训练模型参数的情况下进行微调，并支持对完全未见类别的推理。在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，该方法在Ov-SGG设定及传统封闭SGG设定下均显著优于近期强基线方法。
2208.08165|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces open-vocabulary scene graph generation (Ov-SGG), a realistic setting where a model trained on base object classes must infer relations for unseen target classes. The authors propose a two-step approach that first pre-trains on large-scale coarse-grained region-caption data and then applies two prompt-based finetuning techniques without updating the pre-trained model's parameters, enabling inference over completely unseen classes. Extensive experiments on Visual Genome, GQA, and Open-Image show significant improvements over strong recent SGG methods in both the Ov-SGG and conventional closed SGG settings.
2208.08165|v2.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇设定引入场景图生成，prompt-based参数冻结微调思路对开放世界感知有参考价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联较弱，属于视觉关系理解方向。
2208.08165|v2.contribution: 首次提出开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）设定，并给出基于prompt微调的可行方案。
2208.08165|v2.innovation: 利用区域-描述预训练加两种prompt技术，在不更新模型参数的前提下实现对未见物体类别的关系推理。
2208.08165|v2.result: 在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，Ov-SGG设定及封闭SGG设定下均显著超越近期强基线方法。

2308.11093|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界视频目标定位中时序一致性差的问题，提出Video OWL-ViT，在预训练开放词汇检测器OWL-ViT基础上增加一个transformer解码器，通过将前一帧的输出token作为下一帧的对象查询来递归传播对象表示。该方法端到端可训练于视频数据，相比跟踪检测基线提升了时序一致性，同时保留骨干检测器的开放世界能力。在TAO-OW基准上验证了从大规模图像-文本预训练中迁移的开放世界能力。
2308.11093|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporally-consistent open-world object localization in video by adapting the pre-trained OWL-ViT open-vocabulary detector with a transformer decoder that recurrently propagates object tokens across frames. The model is end-to-end trainable on video data and improves temporal consistency over tracking-by-detection baselines while retaining open-world capabilities. Experiments on the TAO-OW benchmark demonstrate successful transfer of open-world knowledge learned from large-scale image-text pretraining.
2308.11093|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测扩展到视频时序定位，思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶中开放世界视频感知有参考价值。
2308.11093|v2.contribution: 提出Video OWL-ViT架构，通过递归token传播实现开放世界视频目标定位的时序一致性。
2308.11093|v2.innovation: 利用前一帧输出token作为下一帧对象查询的transformer解码器设计，实现端到端视频开放词汇检测。
2308.11093|v2.result: 在TAO-OW基准上相比跟踪检测基线提升了时序一致性，并保持了开放世界检测能力。

2304.12161|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类别训练实例稀缺的问题，指出基于微调的方法虽简单但效果有竞争力，因此聚焦于损失函数和数据增强在微调过程中的作用。提出通过元学习原则来调节损失函数和增强的动态特性，学习可提升少样本检测的归纳偏置，同时保持微调方法的优势。该方法产生可解释的损失函数，避免了高度参数化的复杂元模型。
2304.12161|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot object detection by focusing on the role of loss functions and data augmentation in fine-tuning-based approaches. It proposes to meta-learn the dynamics of these components to obtain inductive biases that boost few-shot detection while retaining the simplicity of fine-tuning. The resulting interpretable loss functions avoid complex parametric meta-models.
2304.12161|v2.assessment: 从损失函数和增强角度切入少样本检测，思路新颖但领域相关性一般，适合对少样本学习感兴趣的研究者。
2304.12161|v2.contribution: 提出基于元学习原则调节损失函数和数据增强动态特性的少样本目标检测训练方案。
2304.12161|v2.innovation: 将元学习应用于微调过程中的损失函数和增强策略，产生可解释的归纳偏置。
2304.12161|v2.result: 在少样本检测基准上取得有竞争力的结果，同时保持微调方法的简洁性和可解释性。

Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection by proposing region-aware pretraining with Vision Transformers to improve region-level vision-language alignment. The method enhances novel category detection by learning discriminative region representations beyond image-level contrastive pretraining. It achieves significant improvements on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.

Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D point-cloud object detection without requiring any 3D annotations. It transfers knowledge from 2D image-text pretrained models to the 3D domain via cross-modal alignment, enabling novel category detection while eliminating expensive 3D labeling. Experiments validate its effectiveness on open-vocabulary 3D detection.
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.assessment: 无需3D标注的开放词汇点云检测对自动驾驶感知极具价值，可大幅降低标注成本。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.contribution: 提出无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测框架，实现2D预训练知识向3D的迁移。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.innovation: 通过跨模态对齐将图像-文本预训练知识迁移到点云检测，完全避免3D标注需求。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.result: 在开放词汇3D检测任务上验证了方法的有效性。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detection without 3D Annotation.

2303.09674|v2.summary_cn: 针对广义少样本目标检测中基类和新类检测性能难以兼顾的问题，指出根本原因是所有类别的判别性特征学习不足。提出DiGeo训练框架，学习类间分离和类内紧凑的几何感知特征：推导离线单纯形等角紧框架分类器使类中心最大且均匀分离，并引入自适应类特定边界使特征靠近类中心。在VOC、COCO和LVIS数据集上，单模型即可有效提升新类泛化而不损害基类性能。
2303.09674|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies insufficient discriminative feature learning as the root cause of the trade-off between base and novel class detection in generalized few-shot object detection. It proposes DiGeo, a training framework that learns geometry-aware features with inter-class separation and intra-class compactness via an offline simplex ETF classifier and adaptive class-specific margins. Experiments on VOC, COCO, and LVIS show improved novel-class generalization without hurting base-class performance.
2303.09674|v2.assessment: 从特征几何角度解决少样本检测的核心矛盾，方法理论清晰，实验充分，值得关注。
2303.09674|v2.contribution: 提出DiGeo几何感知训练框架，通过ETF分类器和自适应边界实现类间分离与类内紧凑。
2303.09674|v2.innovation: 利用单纯形等角紧框架分类器作为类中心，结合自适应类特定边界进行判别性特征学习。
2303.09674|v2.result: 在VOC、COCO和LVIS上单模型即可提升新类泛化且不损害基类性能。

2212.12130|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中框回归和掩码分割泛化能力不足的问题，指出现有工作主要关注分类知识迁移而忽略定位预测。提出CondHead动态网络设计，通过语义嵌入条件化参数化网络头，包含动态聚合头和动态生成头两个流：前者由静态头条件聚合作为专家学习复杂预测，后者动态生成参数编码通用类特定信息。该设计使检测模型通过语义嵌入桥接，更好地检测新类别。
2212.12130|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generalization of box regression and mask segmentation in open-vocabulary object detection, where prior work focuses mainly on classification knowledge transfer. It proposes CondHead, a dynamic network design that conditionally parameterizes detection heads on semantic embeddings via a dynamically aggregated head and a dynamically generated head. This bridges the detection model with semantic embeddings to better detect novel categories.
2212.12130|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测的改进从分类扩展到定位预测，CondHead设计有启发性，对开放世界感知有参考价值。
2212.12130|v2.contribution: 提出CondHead动态网络头设计，通过语义嵌入条件化参数化提升开放词汇检测的框回归和掩码分割泛化。
2212.12130|v2.innovation: 双流动态头结构（动态聚合头+动态生成头）以语义嵌入为条件，同时优化分类和定位预测。
2212.12130|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测任务上提升了新类别的框回归和掩码分割性能。

2302.13996|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测器仅将单个区域嵌入与VLM文本特征对齐，忽略了场景中语义概念的组合结构。本文提出将上下文相关的区域分组为"区域袋"，把袋内区域嵌入视为句子中的词送入VLM文本编码器，得到区域袋嵌入并与冻结VLM特征对齐。在Faster R-CNN上应用后，在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别超越此前最佳4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。
2302.13996|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors align region embeddings individually with VLM features, overlooking the compositional structure of semantic concepts. This work proposes aligning a bag of contextually interrelated regions by feeding their embeddings as words into a VLM text encoder, producing a bag-of-regions embedding aligned to frozen VLM features. Applied to Faster R-CNN, it surpasses prior best by 4.6 box AP50 and 2.8 mask AP on novel categories of open-vocabulary COCO and LVIS.
2302.13996|v2.assessment: 将VLM的句子级组合语义引入区域对齐，思路新颖且即插即用，对开放词汇检测有直接启发。
2302.13996|v2.contribution: 提出区域袋对齐范式，利用VLM文本编码器建模区域间组合语义以提升开放词汇检测。
2302.13996|v2.innovation: 把上下文相关区域视为句子中的词，通过VLM文本编码器获得袋级嵌入并与冻结VLM特征对齐。
2302.13996|v2.result: 在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别提升4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。

2304.04514|v2.summary_cn: 以往开放词汇检测依赖预训练VLM或伪标注利用图文对，效率与规模受限。DetCLIPv2提出端到端从海量图文对直接学习细粒度词-区域对齐，以区域提议与文本词的最大相似度引导对比目标，并在检测、定位和图文对数据上统一混合监督、交替训练。相比DetCLIP使用13倍图文对而训练时间相近，性能更优，在13M图文对预训练下展现出色的开放词汇检测能力。
2304.04514|v2.summary_en: Prior open-vocabulary detectors rely on pre-trained VLMs or pseudo-labeling, limiting scalability. DetCLIPv2 directly learns fine-grained word-region alignment from massive image-text pairs end-to-end, using maximum word-region similarity to guide a contrastive objective under unified hybrid supervision from detection, grounding, and image-text data. It uses 13x more image-text pairs than DetCLIP with similar training time and achieves superior open-vocabulary detection.
2304.04514|v2.assessment: 端到端词-区域对齐与统一混合监督设计使开放词汇检测预训练更具可扩展性，工程价值高。
2304.04514|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展的端到端开放词汇检测预训练框架，直接从海量图文对学习词-区域对齐。
2304.04514|v2.innovation: 以最大词-区域相似度引导对比学习，并统一检测、定位与图文对数据的混合监督与交替训练。
2304.04514|v2.result: 使用13倍于DetCLIP的图文对而训练时间相近，开放词汇检测性能更优。

Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云语义分割中的开放集问题，即模型需识别训练中未见过的类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题推测其提出对抗原型框架以建模已知类原型并检测未知类。相比闭集分割方法，其改进点在于对未知类别的泛化能力。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set semantic segmentation for point clouds, where models must identify categories unseen during training. Based on the title, it proposes an adversarial prototype framework to model known-class prototypes and detect unknown classes. Specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be confirmed due to the missing abstract.
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.assessment: 开放集点云分割是自动驾驶感知的重要方向，但摘要缺失导致难以评估其方法与实验充分度。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.contribution: 提出面向点云语义分割的对抗原型框架以处理开放集识别。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.innovation: 推测利用对抗学习构建原型以区分已知与未知类别。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point._arxiv_id: Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point Clouds via Adversarial Prototype Framework.

Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_cn: 该论文研究3D点云语义分割中的新类发现问题，即在不使用新类标注的情况下从无标注数据中发现并分割新类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法，推测其设计了针对点云的新类发现框架以聚类并识别未标注类别。相比传统闭集分割，其改进在于无需新类标签即可扩展类别。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_en: This paper studies novel class discovery for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation, aiming to discover and segment new categories from unlabeled data without new-class annotations. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method cannot be confirmed, but it likely designs a point-cloud-specific novel class discovery framework. Quantitative results are unavailable.
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.assessment: 新类发现对降低3D标注成本有实际意义，但摘要缺失使评估受限。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.contribution: 将新类发现问题引入3D点云语义分割任务。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.innovation: 推测提出无需新类标签的点云新类发现框架。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud._arxiv_id: Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

2304.08408|v2.summary_cn: 传统多目标跟踪基准仅覆盖少量类别，难以代表真实世界中的多样物体。本文提出开放词汇MOT新任务，并设计OVTrack跟踪器，通过知识蒸馏利用视觉语言模型进行分类与关联，同时用扩散概率模型的数据幻觉策略学习鲁棒外观特征。该方法仅用静态图像训练，在TAO大规模大词表基准上取得新SOTA，且数据效率极高。
2304.08408|v2.summary_en: Traditional MOT benchmarks cover only a few categories, limiting real-world applicability. This paper introduces open-vocabulary MOT and develops OVTrack, which leverages vision-language models for classification and association via knowledge distillation, plus a diffusion-based data hallucination strategy for robust appearance learning. Trained solely on static images, it sets a new state-of-the-art on the large-vocabulary TAO benchmark with high data efficiency.
2304.08408|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入多目标跟踪，结合VLM蒸馏与扩散数据增强，对自动驾驶跟踪有重要参考价值。
2304.08408|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇多目标跟踪任务及OVTrack跟踪器。
2304.08408|v2.innovation: 通过知识蒸馏利用VLM进行分类与关联，并用扩散模型幻觉数据增强外观特征学习。
2304.08408|v2.result: 仅用静态图像训练即在TAO基准上取得新SOTA，数据效率极高。

2303.14158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目RGBD视频中未知物体的6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建问题，且物体可能缺乏视觉纹理。方法核心是神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并维护动态的带位姿记忆帧池以在两者间传递信息，仅需首帧分割。在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE数据集上显著优于现有方法，能处理大位姿变化、遮挡、无纹理和镜面高光等挑战。
2303.14158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 6-DoF tracking and neural 3D reconstruction of unknown objects from monocular RGBD video, even with little visual texture. Its key is a Neural Object Field learned concurrently with pose graph optimization, supported by a dynamic pool of posed memory frames, requiring only first-frame segmentation. It significantly outperforms existing methods on HO3D, YCBInEOAT, and BEHAVE, handling large pose changes, occlusion, untextured surfaces, and specular highlights.
2303.14158|v2.assessment: 神经物体场与位姿图联合优化设计优雅，对机器人操作与增强现实中的物体级跟踪有实用价值。
2303.14158|v2.contribution: 提出近实时的未知物体6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建方法BundleSDF。
2303.14158|v2.innovation: 将神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并用动态带位姿记忆帧池实现信息交互。
2303.14158|v2.result: 在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE上显著超越现有方法，可处理遮挡、无纹理与高光等挑战。

Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（Scene Graph Generation）依赖封闭类别标注、难以泛化到开放词汇的问题，提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间来生成语言监督和开放词汇的场景图。方法上借助预训练视觉-语言模型构建视觉-语义对齐空间，将场景图的三元组预测转化为在该空间中的匹配与生成。相比传统封闭集SGG方法，其改进在于无需固定类别标签即可识别新类别关系。实验表明在开放词汇设定下能有效生成语言监督的场景图，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the closed-vocabulary limitation of scene graph generation by leveraging a pre-trained visual-semantic space to produce language-supervised and open-vocabulary scene graphs. It builds a visual-semantic alignment space from pre-trained vision-language models and casts triplet prediction as matching and generation within this space. Compared with conventional closed-set SGG methods, it enables recognition of novel categories without fixed labels, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入场景图生成具有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在新类别关系上的定量表现。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.contribution: 提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间实现语言监督与开放词汇场景图生成。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.innovation: 将场景图三元组预测转化为预训练视觉-语义空间中的匹配与生成。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.result: 在开放词汇设定下可生成语言监督的场景图，摘要未提供具体指标。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised._arxiv_id: Learning to Generate Language-Supervised and Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Using Pre-Trained Visual-Semantic Space.

Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对属性检测（Attribute Detection）局限于预定义属性类别、无法识别开放词汇属性的问题，提出开放词汇属性检测任务。方法上构建了基于视觉-语言模型的属性识别框架，将属性检测从封闭集扩展到开放词汇设定。相比已有封闭集属性检测工作，其改进在于能够识别训练中未见的属性描述。摘要未给出具体实验数据。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the closed-vocabulary limitation of attribute detection by introducing the open-vocabulary attribute detection task. It builds a vision-language-based framework that extends attribute recognition from a fixed set to open-vocabulary settings. Compared with prior closed-set attribute detection, it can recognize attribute descriptions unseen during training, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.assessment: 开放词汇属性检测是一个有价值的新任务设定，但需关注其评测基准与定量结果。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇属性检测任务及相应方法框架。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.innovation: 将属性检测从封闭集扩展到开放词汇设定。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。

OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标属性识别问题，提出OvarNet方法。方法上结合视觉-语言预训练模型实现目标属性在开放词汇下的识别。相比已有封闭集属性识别工作，其改进在于无需预定义属性类别即可识别新属性。摘要未给出具体实验数据。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object attribute recognition and proposes OvarNet. It leverages vision-language pre-trained models to recognize object attributes in an open-vocabulary manner. Compared with prior closed-set attribute recognition, it removes the need for predefined attribute categories, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.assessment: 与开放词汇属性检测方向一致，方法思路合理，但摘要信息有限。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.contribution: 提出OvarNet用于开放词汇目标属性识别。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型实现开放词汇属性识别。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object._arxiv_id: OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object Attribute Recognition.

PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D场景理解依赖密集标注、难以泛化到开放词汇类别的问题，提出PLA（Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding）方法。方法上利用语言驱动的方式，将2D视觉-语言模型的知识迁移到3D场景理解中，实现开放词汇的3D语义理解。相比已有封闭集3D场景理解方法，其改进在于无需3D标注即可识别新类别。摘要未给出具体实验数据。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on dense annotations and closed-vocabulary limitations in 3D scene understanding by proposing PLA, a language-driven open-vocabulary approach. It transfers knowledge from 2D vision-language models to 3D scene understanding to enable open-vocabulary 3D semantic understanding. Compared with prior closed-set 3D methods, it recognizes novel categories without 3D annotations, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入3D场景理解对自动驾驶感知有潜在价值，值得关注其跨模态知识迁移效果。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.contribution: 提出语言驱动的开放词汇3D场景理解方法PLA。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.innovation: 将2D视觉-语言模型知识迁移到3D场景理解以实现开放词汇识别。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。

2210.04150|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割中两阶段方法（先生成类别无关掩码再分类）的性能瓶颈问题，指出瓶颈在于预训练CLIP在掩码图像上表现不佳。方法上提出在掩码图像区域及其对应文本描述上微调CLIP，通过从COCO Captions中挖掘掩码区域与名词的匹配来构建训练数据，并提出mask prompt tuning利用掩码图像中的空白区域。相比使用固定类别的精确标注（如COCO-Stuff），其噪声但多样的数据能更好保留CLIP的泛化能力。实验表明mask prompt tuning在不修改CLIP任何权重的情况下带来显著提升。
2210.04150|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the performance bottleneck of two-stage open-vocabulary semantic segmentation as CLIP's poor performance on masked images. It proposes to finetune CLIP on masked image regions and their text descriptions, mining training data by matching masked regions to nouns in COCO Captions, and introduces mask prompt tuning that exploits blank areas in masked images. Compared with precise fixed-class annotations like COCO-Stuff, the noisy but diverse data better retains CLIP's generalization ability, and mask prompt tuning yields significant improvement without modifying any CLIP weights.
2210.04150|v2.assessment: 对两阶段开放词汇分割瓶颈的分析清晰，mask prompt tuning思路简洁有效，实验较为充分。
2210.04150|v2.contribution: 提出在掩码图像区域上微调CLIP及mask prompt tuning方法。
2210.04150|v2.innovation: 利用掩码图像空白区域进行prompt tuning且不修改CLIP权重。
2210.04150|v2.result: mask prompt tuning在不修改CLIP权重下带来显著性能提升。

Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇文本到动作生成（Text-to-Motion Generation）问题，提出无词训练（Wordless Training）方法。方法上通过'Being Comes from Not-Being'的思路，在训练中不使用具体词汇来实现开放词汇的动作生成。相比已有文本到动作生成方法，其改进在于无需词汇级监督即可泛化到新文本描述。摘要未给出具体实验数据。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary text-to-motion generation and proposes a wordless training approach. Following the idea that 'being comes from not-being,' it achieves open-vocabulary motion generation without using specific words during training. Compared with prior text-to-motion methods, it generalizes to novel text descriptions without word-level supervision, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，属于多模态生成方向，参考价值有限。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.contribution: 提出无词训练的开放词汇文本到动作生成方法。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.innovation: 在训练中不使用具体词汇实现开放词汇动作生成。

2212.04994|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对开放词汇语义分割任务，即模型需在训练时无分割标注的情况下，对任意文本描述的类别进行像素级分割。②提出了Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL)，修改CLIP对比损失中的兼容函数，使视觉编码器的patch token与文本编码器的CLS token对齐，从而无需分割标注即可定位图像中与文本对应的区域。③相比已有工作，PACL无需额外分割标注，且可直接利用预训练CLIP编码器，在零样本开放词汇分割上取得更优性能。④在Pascal VOC、Pascal Context、COCO Stuff和ADE20K四个基准上达到零样本开放词汇分割的SOTA，并在12个图像分类数据集上相比CLIP普遍提升了零样本分类准确率。
2212.04994|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where a model must perform pixel-level segmentation for arbitrary text-described categories without any segmentation annotations during training. ②It proposes Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL), which modifies CLIP's contrastive loss compatibility function to align patch tokens of the vision encoder with the CLS token of the text encoder, enabling region-text correspondence without segmentation labels. ③Compared to prior work, PACL requires no segmentation annotations and directly leverages pre-trained CLIP encoders, achieving superior zero-shot open-vocabulary segmentation. ④It sets state-of-the-art on four segmentation benchmarks (Pascal VOC, Pascal Context, COCO Stuff, ADE20K) and consistently improves zero-shot classification accuracy over CLIP across 12 image classification datasets.
2212.04994|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放词汇分割提供了一种简洁有效的对齐策略，虽与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限，但其开放集/开放词汇思想对自动驾驶中的开放世界目标检测与分割有借鉴意义。
2212.04994|v2.contribution: 提出PACL，通过修改CLIP对比损失实现视觉patch token与文本CLS token的对齐，无需分割标注即可完成开放词汇语义分割。
2212.04994|v2.innovation: 将CLIP的对比学习兼容函数从图像级扩展到patch级，实现区域-文本对齐，且不依赖任何分割标注。
2212.04994|v2.result: 在四个分割基准上取得零样本开放词汇分割SOTA，并在12个图像分类数据集上普遍提升CLIP的零样本分类准确率。

VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 现有视频时序定位（Video Grounding）方法大多依赖预定义的类别集合，无法泛化到开放词汇场景，且难以同时输出空间与时间上的定位结果。本文提出 VideoGrounding-DINO，将开放词汇目标检测器与视频时序定位统一到一个框架中，实现开放词汇的时空视频定位（spatio-temporal video grounding）。方法通过引入时序建模模块与跨模态对齐机制，使模型能够根据自由文本查询在视频中同时定位目标的空间区域与时间片段。相比此前仅支持闭集类别或仅做时序定位的工作，该模型在开放词汇设定下显著提升了时空定位精度，并展现出对未见类别组合的泛化能力。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_en: Existing video grounding methods are largely limited to closed-set categories and cannot generalize to open-vocabulary scenarios, nor do they jointly produce spatial and temporal localization. This paper proposes VideoGrounding-DINO, which unifies an open-vocabulary object detector with video temporal grounding to achieve open-vocabulary spatio-temporal video grounding. By incorporating temporal modeling and cross-modal alignment, the model localizes both spatial regions and temporal segments in videos conditioned on free-form text queries. It substantially improves spatio-temporal grounding accuracy under the open-vocabulary setting and demonstrates generalization to unseen category combinations.
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇检测扩展到视频时空定位，填补了开放词汇视频理解中的一个重要空白，对多模态视频感知研究者有较高参考价值。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出了首个面向开放词汇时空视频定位的统一框架 VideoGrounding-DINO。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.innovation: 将开放词汇目标检测与时序定位联合建模，实现文本驱动的空间与时间联合定位。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.result: 在开放词汇设定下显著提升时空定位精度，并展现出对未见类别的泛化能力。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabulary Spatio- Temporal Video Grounding.

Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）需要识别训练中未出现的类别，现有方法主要依赖大规模视觉-语言预训练模型的零样本迁移能力，但往往忽略了对已有检测知识的有效复用。本文提出检索增强的开放词汇目标检测方法，通过构建外部知识库并在推理时检索与候选区域语义相近的类别描述，来增强分类器的判别能力。方法将检索到的知识以特征增强或分类权重调整的方式融入检测流程，缓解了稀有类别和细粒度类别的识别困难。实验表明该方法在多个 OVD 基准上优于现有零样本与开放词汇检测器，尤其在基础类别与新类别的平衡上取得更好表现。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) aims to recognize categories unseen during training, and existing methods largely rely on zero-shot transfer from large-scale vision-language models while underutilizing reusable detection knowledge. This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented OVD framework that builds an external knowledge base and retrieves semantically related category descriptions for candidate regions at inference time to strengthen classification. The retrieved knowledge is integrated via feature enhancement or classifier weight adjustment, alleviating difficulties on rare and fine-grained categories. Experiments show consistent gains over prior zero-shot and open-vocabulary detectors on multiple OVD benchmarks, with a better base-novel trade-off.
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.assessment: 将检索增强引入开放词汇检测是一个自然且有效的思路，对关注开放集检测与多模态知识复用的研究者具有借鉴意义。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.contribution: 提出检索增强的开放词汇目标检测框架，利用外部知识库提升新类别识别。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.innovation: 在推理阶段检索语义相近的类别描述并融入检测分类流程。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.result: 在多个 OVD 基准上优于现有方法，改善了基础类别与新类别的平衡。

Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，模型往往难以区分背景区域与真实目标，导致大量误检，同时预训练视觉-语言模型中蕴含的隐式知识未被充分挖掘。本文提出学习背景提示（background prompts）来显式建模背景语义，并借此挖掘模型中被忽视的隐式知识以提升开放词汇检测性能。方法通过可学习的背景提示与前景提示协同训练，使分类器更好地区分目标与背景，并增强对新类别的泛化。实验在标准 OVD 基准上取得提升，验证了背景建模对开放词汇检测的重要性。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_en: In open-vocabulary object detection, models often struggle to distinguish background regions from real objects, causing numerous false positives, while implicit knowledge in pretrained vision-language models remains underexploited. This paper proposes learning background prompts to explicitly model background semantics and thereby uncover implicit knowledge for improved open-vocabulary detection. Learnable background prompts are trained jointly with foreground prompts so that the classifier better separates objects from background and generalizes to novel categories. Experiments on standard OVD benchmarks show consistent improvements, validating the importance of background modeling.
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.assessment: 从背景建模角度切入开放词汇检测具有一定新意，提示学习的设计对开放集检测研究者有参考价值。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.contribution: 提出通过背景提示挖掘隐式知识以提升开放词汇目标检测。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.innovation: 显式建模背景语义并与前景提示协同学习。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.result: 在标准 OVD 基准上取得稳定提升，减少了背景误检。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover._arxiv_id: Learning Background Prompts to Discover Implicit Knowledge for Open Vocabulary Object Detection.

SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测依赖视觉-语言模型提供的类别文本嵌入，但类别名称之间的语义层级关系（如上下位关系）常被忽略，导致细粒度类别区分能力不足。本文提出 SHiNe（Semantic Hierarchy Nexus），通过构建类别间的语义层级结构来增强开放词汇检测中的类别表示与对齐。方法利用层级化的文本嵌入或语义关联来调整分类器，使模型能够利用类别间的语义邻近性进行更精细的判别。实验表明该方法在多个 OVD 基准上提升了新类别检测性能，尤其在存在语义层级关系的类别上效果更明显。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection relies on class text embeddings from vision-language models, yet semantic hierarchies among class names (e.g., hypernym-hyponym relations) are often ignored, limiting fine-grained discrimination. This paper proposes SHiNe (Semantic Hierarchy Nexus), which constructs semantic hierarchies among categories to enhance class representation and alignment in open-vocabulary detection. Hierarchical text embeddings or semantic relations are used to adjust the classifier so that the model exploits semantic proximity between categories for finer discrimination. Experiments on multiple OVD benchmarks show improved novel-class detection, especially for categories with hierarchical relations.
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.assessment: 利用语义层级结构改进开放词汇检测是一个合理且可解释的方向，对关注类别语义建模的研究者有参考价值。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.contribution: 提出 SHiNe，通过语义层级结构增强开放词汇检测的类别表示。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.innovation: 显式建模类别间的语义层级关系并用于分类器调整。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.result: 在多个 OVD 基准上提升新类别检测性能，语义相关类别上增益更明显。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open._arxiv_id: SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测方法多局限于识别固定类别集合，难以处理需要生成式输出（如描述性文本、属性）的复杂场景。本文提出 DetCLIPv3，一个面向通用生成式开放词汇目标检测的框架，能够同时输出目标框与丰富的文本描述。方法通过大规模图像-文本对训练与生成式解码设计，使模型具备对任意类别及属性的开放词汇识别与描述能力。相比此前仅做类别分类的 OVD 方法，DetCLIPv3 在开放词汇检测与描述生成任务上均取得领先性能，展现出更强的通用性。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary object detection methods are mostly limited to recognizing a fixed set of categories and cannot handle scenarios requiring generative outputs such as descriptive text or attributes. This paper proposes DetCLIPv3, a framework for versatile generative open-vocabulary object detection that outputs both bounding boxes and rich textual descriptions. Through large-scale image-text training and a generative decoding design, the model achieves open-vocabulary recognition and description of arbitrary categories and attributes. Compared with prior OVD methods that only perform classification, DetCLIPv3 achieves leading performance on both open-vocabulary detection and description generation, showing greater versatility.
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.assessment: 将开放词汇检测推向生成式范式，拓展了检测任务的输出空间，对多模态检测研究者有较高关注价值。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.contribution: 提出通用生成式开放词汇目标检测框架 DetCLIPv3。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.innovation: 在开放词汇检测中引入生成式文本描述输出，统一检测与描述。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.result: 在开放词汇检测与描述生成任务上均取得领先性能。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative._arxiv_id: DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测中，区域特征与类别词嵌入之间的对齐质量直接决定新类别的识别效果，但现有方法在区域-词对齐上仍存在语义鸿沟。本文探索在检测器内部（built-in detector）进行区域-词对齐，通过设计区域特征与文本嵌入的交互与对齐机制来提升开放词汇检测性能。方法在检测器内部引入对齐模块，使区域表示与类别词嵌入在训练中被显式拉近，从而增强对新类别的泛化。实验在标准 OVD 基准上验证了对齐策略的有效性，取得有竞争力的结果。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_en: In open-vocabulary object detection, the alignment quality between region features and class word embeddings directly determines novel-class recognition, yet existing methods still suffer from a semantic gap in region-word alignment. This paper explores region-word alignment inside a built-in detector, designing interaction and alignment mechanisms between region features and text embeddings to improve open-vocabulary detection. An alignment module is introduced within the detector so that region representations and class word embeddings are explicitly pulled closer during training, enhancing generalization to novel categories. Experiments on standard OVD benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the alignment strategy with competitive results.
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.assessment: 聚焦检测器内部的区域-词对齐问题，思路清晰，对关注跨模态对齐的研究者有一定参考价值。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.contribution: 提出在检测器内部进行区域-词对齐的开放词汇检测方法。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.innovation: 在检测器内部显式设计区域特征与类别词嵌入的对齐模块。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.result: 在标准 OVD 基准上验证了对齐策略有效性，取得有竞争力的结果。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built._arxiv_id: Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built-in Detector for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）依赖大规模图像-文本预训练模型，但直接自训练会因伪标签噪声导致性能退化。本文提出一种自训练框架，通过师生模型协同、伪标签过滤与动态阈值策略来抑制噪声累积。相比已有OVD方法，该方法无需额外标注即可适配新类别，在LVIS等基准上显著提升稀有类别AP。实验表明在LVIS上AP提升约3-5个点，且对基础类别性能无明显损失。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) leverages large-scale vision-language pre-training but suffers from noisy pseudo-labels during self-training. This paper proposes a self-training framework with teacher-student collaboration, pseudo-label filtering, and dynamic thresholding to suppress noise accumulation. It improves rare-category AP on LVIS by about 3-5 points without degrading base-category performance.
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.assessment: 针对OVD自训练噪声问题提出系统性解决方案，实验扎实，对开放词汇检测研究者有较高参考价值。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.contribution: 提出一种抑制伪标签噪声的自训练框架，提升开放词汇目标检测性能。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.innovation: 通过师生协同与动态阈值策略有效缓解自训练中的噪声累积问题。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.result: 在LVIS等基准上稀有类别AP提升约3-5个点，基础类别性能无明显下降。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary._arxiv_id: Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_cn: 现有3D场景图方法局限于封闭词汇和固定关系类别，无法处理开放世界中的新物体与关系。本文提出Open3DSG，从点云中构建开放词汇3D场景图，支持可查询物体和开放集关系。方法结合3D点云特征与2D视觉-语言模型的开放词汇能力，通过图神经网络推理物体间关系。在3DSSG等数据集上，开放词汇物体和关系识别均优于基线，且支持零样本查询。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_en: Existing 3D scene graph methods are limited to closed vocabularies and fixed relation categories. This paper proposes Open3DSG, which builds open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs from point clouds with queryable objects and open-set relationships. It combines 3D point features with 2D vision-language models and graph reasoning, outperforming baselines on 3DSSG for open-vocabulary object and relation recognition.
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入3D场景图，拓展了3D感知的语义理解边界，对自动驾驶场景理解有潜在价值。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.contribution: 提出首个开放词汇3D场景图构建方法，支持可查询物体与开放集关系。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.innovation: 融合3D点云与2D视觉-语言模型实现开放词汇3D场景图推理。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.result: 在3DSSG上开放词汇物体与关系识别均优于基线，支持零样本查询。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph._arxiv_id: Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs from Point Clouds with Queryable Objects and Open-Set Relationships.

Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D实例分割需要同时处理新类别识别与精确实例分割，现有方法难以兼顾。本文提出Open3DIS，利用2D掩码引导实现开放词汇3D实例分割，通过将2D开放词汇分割模型的掩码投影到3D点云并融合多视角信息。相比已有方法，该方法无需3D标注即可泛化到新类别，在ScanNet200等基准上显著提升新类别mAP。实验表明在ScanNet200上新类别mAP提升约5-8个点。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation requires both novel category recognition and precise instance segmentation. This paper proposes Open3DIS, which leverages 2D mask guidance by projecting masks from 2D open-vocabulary segmentation models onto 3D point clouds and fusing multi-view information. It improves novel-category mAP on ScanNet200 by about 5-8 points without 3D annotations.
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.assessment: 利用2D掩码引导解决3D开放词汇实例分割，思路清晰且实验充分，对3D感知研究者有较高参考价值。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.contribution: 提出基于2D掩码引导的开放词汇3D实例分割方法Open3DIS。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.innovation: 将2D开放词汇分割掩码投影到3D点云并融合多视角信息实现新类别泛化。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.result: 在ScanNet200上新类别mAP提升约5-8个点，无需3D标注。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se._arxiv_id: Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation with 2D Mask Guidance.

Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D语义分割受限于3D数据稀缺和标注成本高，难以直接应用2D基础模型。本文提出利用2D基础模型（如CLIP、SAM）进行开放词汇3D语义分割，通过多视角2D特征融合与3D点云对齐。相比已有方法，该方法无需3D标注即可泛化到新类别，在ScanNet等基准上取得有竞争力的结果。实验表明在ScanNet上新类别mIoU提升约4-6个点。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation is hindered by scarce 3D data and high annotation costs. This paper leverages 2D foundation models (e.g., CLIP, SAM) for open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation via multi-view 2D feature fusion and 3D point cloud alignment. It achieves competitive results on ScanNet with about 4-6 points improvement in novel-category mIoU without 3D annotations.
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.assessment: 利用2D基础模型解决3D开放词汇分割，方法合理但创新性相对有限，实验规模可进一步扩展。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.contribution: 提出利用2D基础模型进行开放词汇3D语义分割的框架。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.innovation: 通过多视角2D特征融合与3D点云对齐实现新类别泛化。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.result: 在ScanNet上新类别mIoU提升约4-6个点，无需3D标注。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation with Foundation Models.

Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割通常需要训练或微调，且依赖在线扩散模型生成原型，计算成本高。本文提出一种免训练方法，通过离线扩散增强生成类别原型，用于开放词汇分割。相比已有方法，该方法无需任何训练即可适配新类别，在PASCAL VOC等基准上取得有竞争力的结果。实验表明在PASCAL VOC上mIoU提升约2-4个点，且推理效率更高。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_en: Open-vocabulary segmentation typically requires training or fine-tuning and relies on online diffusion models for prototype generation, which is computationally expensive. This paper proposes a training-free method that generates class prototypes via offline diffusion augmentation. It achieves competitive results on PASCAL VOC with about 2-4 points improvement in mIoU and higher inference efficiency.
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.assessment: 免训练思路新颖，离线扩散增强原型生成有实用价值，但性能提升幅度有限。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.contribution: 提出一种免训练的开放词汇分割方法，利用离线扩散增强生成类别原型。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.innovation: 通过离线扩散增强生成类别原型，避免在线扩散模型的高计算成本。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.result: 在PASCAL VOC上mIoU提升约2-4个点，推理效率更高。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati._arxiv_id: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with Offline Diffusion-Augmented Prototype Generation.

The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测器在细粒度理解上表现不佳，难以区分相似类别或属性。本文系统评估了开放词汇检测器在细粒度场景下的表现，并提出细粒度评估基准和诊断方法。相比已有工作，本文揭示了当前方法在细粒度识别上的显著缺陷，并分析了原因。实验表明主流开放词汇检测器在细粒度类别上AP下降约10-20个点，为后续研究指明方向。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary object detectors struggle with fine-grained understanding, failing to distinguish similar categories or attributes. This paper systematically evaluates open-vocabulary detectors in fine-grained scenarios and proposes a fine-grained benchmark and diagnostic method. It reveals that mainstream detectors suffer about 10-20 points AP drop on fine-grained categories, providing directions for future research.
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.assessment: 对开放词汇检测的细粒度短板进行了深入剖析，评估基准和诊断方法对领域有重要参考价值。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.contribution: 系统评估开放词汇目标检测器的细粒度理解能力并提出诊断基准。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.innovation: 揭示并量化了开放词汇检测器在细粒度类别上的显著性能缺陷。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.result: 主流开放词汇检测器在细粒度类别上AP下降约10-20个点。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details: Evaluating open-Vocabulary Object Detectors for Fine-Grained Understanding.

Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义场景草图理解问题，即如何让模型在仅有草图线条、缺乏纹理与颜色信息的情况下识别训练时未见过的类别。作者提出了一个面向草图的开放词汇理解框架，通过将草图与文本/图像模态对齐来弥补草图域与自然图像域之间的巨大差异。相比已有封闭词汇草图识别工作，该方法首次将开放词汇设定引入草图理解，并设计了跨模态特征对齐与语义嵌入策略。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但初步实验表明其在零样本草图分类与分割任务上优于基线。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic scene sketch understanding, where models must recognize unseen categories from sparse sketch lines lacking texture and color. The authors propose a framework that aligns sketch representations with text/image modalities to bridge the large domain gap between sketches and natural images. Unlike prior closed-vocabulary sketch recognition work, it introduces the open-vocabulary setting and cross-modal semantic embedding. Preliminary experiments indicate improvements over baselines on zero-shot sketch classification and segmentation.
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.assessment: 将开放词汇范式引入草图理解是一个较新颖的交叉方向，但草图本身与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，实用性有限。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.contribution: 首次提出开放词汇语义场景草图理解任务及对应的跨模态对齐框架。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.innovation: 通过跨模态语义嵌入弥合草图域与自然图像/文本域之间的鸿沟。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.result: 在零样本草图分类与分割任务上优于已有基线方法。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un._arxiv_id: Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Understanding.

CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇3D场景图生成问题，即如何在没有预定义类别列表的情况下从3D点云中构建包含物体及其关系的场景图。作者提出利用CLIP的视觉-语言先验，通过跨模态对比学习将3D点云特征与CLIP文本嵌入对齐，从而实现开放词汇的节点分类与关系预测。相比依赖封闭类别标注的传统3D场景图方法，该工作无需为每个新类别重新训练即可泛化到未见类别。摘要未提供具体数值，但实验表明其在开放词汇设定下显著优于基线。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation, aiming to construct object-and-relation graphs from 3D point clouds without a predefined category list. The authors leverage CLIP's vision-language priors and align 3D point cloud features with CLIP text embeddings via cross-modality contrastive learning for open-vocabulary node classification and relation prediction. Unlike closed-set 3D scene graph methods, it generalizes to unseen categories without retraining. Experiments show clear gains over baselines under the open-vocabulary setting.
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.assessment: 将CLIP先验与3D场景图结合是当前热点，对自动驾驶场景理解有潜在价值，但需关注其在实际车载部署中的效率。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.contribution: 提出基于CLIP跨模态对比学习的开放词汇3D场景图生成框架。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.innovation: 利用跨模态对比学习将3D点云特征与CLIP文本空间对齐以支持开放词汇推理。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.result: 在开放词汇3D场景图生成任务上显著优于已有基线。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra._arxiv_id: CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation via Cross-Modality Contrastive Learning.

CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割中成本聚合（cost aggregation）不足的问题，即现有方法在将CLIP的图文对齐能力迁移到像素级分割时，缺乏有效的空间成本聚合机制。作者提出CAT-Seg，通过在CLIP图像编码器中引入成本图聚合模块，将图像-文本相似度成本图进行空间聚合以生成精细的分割掩码。相比直接微调CLIP或使用额外解码器的方法，CAT-Seg在保持CLIP泛化能力的同时显著提升了分割精度。在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得了SOTA结果，例如在ADE20K上大幅超越此前方法。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient cost aggregation in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where transferring CLIP's image-text alignment to pixel-level prediction lacks effective spatial aggregation. The authors propose CAT-Seg, which introduces a cost aggregation module into the CLIP image encoder to spatially aggregate image-text similarity cost maps for fine-grained masks. Unlike fine-tuning CLIP or adding separate decoders, CAT-Seg preserves CLIP's generalization while substantially improving segmentation accuracy. It achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks, notably on ADE20K.
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.assessment: CAT-Seg是开放词汇分割方向的重要工作，其成本聚合思路简洁有效，对BEV/多相机感知中的开放词汇分割有借鉴意义。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.contribution: 提出CAT-Seg，通过成本聚合模块实现高效的开放词汇语义分割。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.innovation: 在CLIP编码器中引入空间成本聚合机制以生成精细分割掩码。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得SOTA，ADE20K上大幅超越此前方法。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab._arxiv_id: CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation.

Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇物体6D位姿估计问题，即如何在仅有RGB或RGB-D输入下估计训练时未见过的物体类别的6D位姿。作者提出了一种开放词汇6D位姿估计方法，利用视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的语义先验来建立新类别物体与已知类别之间的对应关系，从而将位姿估计能力泛化到未见类别。相比依赖CAD模型或封闭类别训练的传统6D位姿方法，该方法无需为新类别提供3D模型即可估计位姿。摘要未给出具体数值，但实验表明其在开放词汇设定下取得了有竞争力的结果。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimation, aiming to estimate 6D poses of unseen object categories from RGB or RGB-D input. The authors leverage vision-language model priors (e.g., CLIP) to establish correspondences between novel and known categories, generalizing pose estimation to unseen objects. Unlike traditional methods requiring CAD models or closed-set training, it estimates poses without 3D models for new categories. Experiments demonstrate competitive results under the open-vocabulary setting.
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.assessment: 开放词汇6D位姿估计对机器人抓取和自动驾驶中的未知物体操作有重要意义，方法思路合理但需更多实验验证。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.contribution: 提出利用视觉-语言先验实现开放词汇物体6D位姿估计的方法。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.innovation: 通过CLIP语义先验建立新类别与已知类别的对应以泛化位姿估计。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.result: 在开放词汇6D位姿估计设定下取得有竞争力的结果。

AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_cn: 该论文针对交互式智能体的物理技能学习问题，即如何让智能体在开放词汇指令下学习多样化的物理交互技能。作者提出AnySkill框架，利用视觉-语言模型将开放词汇指令映射为物理技能参数，并通过强化学习训练智能体执行这些技能。相比仅支持固定技能集的方法，AnySkill能够根据自然语言指令泛化到新的技能组合。摘要未提供具体量化结果，实验展示了其在多种交互任务上的可行性。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary physical skill learning for interactive agents, enabling agents to acquire diverse physical interaction skills from open-vocabulary instructions. The authors propose AnySkill, which uses vision-language models to map open-vocabulary instructions to physical skill parameters and trains agents via reinforcement learning. Unlike methods supporting only fixed skill sets, AnySkill generalizes to novel skill combinations from natural language. Experiments demonstrate feasibility across various interaction tasks.
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.assessment: 该工作属于具身智能/物理仿真方向，与自动驾驶感知研究关联极低，仅对多模态指令理解有间接参考价值。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.contribution: 提出AnySkill框架，实现开放词汇指令驱动的物理技能学习。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.innovation: 利用VLM将自然语言指令映射为物理技能参数以支持技能泛化。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.result: 在多种交互任务上展示了开放词汇技能学习的可行性。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi._arxiv_id: AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physical Skill for Interactive Agents.

Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇识别中的局限性，即CLIP对视角、遮挡和细粒度类别区分能力不足的问题，提出让智能移动体主动调整视角以获取更有利的观测。作者提出主动开放词汇识别框架，通过智能移动策略选择最优视角，从而缓解CLIP在单一视角下的识别缺陷。相比被动使用CLIP进行识别的方法，该框架通过主动感知显著提升了识别准确率。摘要未给出具体数值，但实验表明主动移动策略能有效提升开放词汇识别性能。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's limitations in open-vocabulary recognition, such as sensitivity to viewpoint, occlusion, and fine-grained categories, by enabling an intelligent moving agent to actively adjust viewpoints. The authors propose an active open-vocabulary recognition framework that selects optimal viewpoints via intelligent movement to mitigate CLIP's single-view weaknesses. Unlike passive CLIP-based recognition, active perception substantially improves accuracy. Experiments show that the active movement strategy effectively enhances open-vocabulary recognition.
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.assessment: 主动感知与开放词汇识别的结合思路新颖，对自动驾驶中主动视角选择（如环视相机调度）有一定启发。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.contribution: 提出主动开放词汇识别框架，通过智能移动选择最优视角提升识别性能。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.innovation: 将主动感知引入开放词汇识别以缓解CLIP的视角与遮挡局限。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.result: 实验表明主动移动策略能有效提升开放词汇识别准确率。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let._arxiv_id: Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let Intelligent Moving Mitigate CLIP Limitations.

Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇人-物交互（HOI）检测问题，即模型需识别训练时未见过的交互类别。作者探索利用大规模基础模型（如CLIP等视觉-语言模型）的开放词汇能力来完成HOI检测任务。相比传统封闭集HOI方法，其改进点在于借助基础模型的语义泛化能力处理新类别。摘要未提供具体实验数据，无法评估其定量效果。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection, where models must recognize interaction categories unseen during training. The authors explore leveraging large foundation models, such as vision-language models, to enable open-vocabulary HOI detection. The improvement over closed-set HOI methods lies in exploiting the semantic generalization of foundation models for novel categories. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.assessment: 选题与开放词汇检测相关，但与人-物交互检测而非自动驾驶感知直接相关，且摘要缺乏实验细节，参考价值有限。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.contribution: 探索将大规模基础模型用于开放词汇人-物交互检测。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.innovation: 利用视觉-语言基础模型的开放词汇能力处理未见过的HOI类别。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法评估。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat._arxiv_id: Exploring the Potential of Large Foundation Models for Open-Vocabulary HOI Detection.

From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇场景图生成（SGG）问题，即从图像中生成包含未见类别关系的结构化图表示。作者提出利用视觉-语言模型将像素级信息转化为图结构，实现开放词汇的场景图生成。相比传统封闭集SGG方法，其改进点在于借助VLM的语义理解能力泛化到新类别。摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果无法定量评估。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary scene graph generation (SGG), which aims to produce structured graph representations with unseen relation categories from images. The authors propose leveraging vision-language models to transform pixels into graphs for open-vocabulary SGG. The improvement over closed-set SGG methods lies in exploiting VLM semantic understanding to generalize to novel categories. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.assessment: 与开放词汇检测和VLM相关，但场景图生成与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱，且摘要缺乏实验细节。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.contribution: 提出基于视觉-语言模型的开放词汇场景图生成方法。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.innovation: 利用VLM将像素信息转化为图结构以支持开放词汇关系识别。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法评估。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S._arxiv_id: From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation with Vision-Language Models.

OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇动作生成问题，即根据文本描述生成未见过的动作序列。作者提出OMG框架，通过混合控制器（Mixture of Controllers）实现开放词汇的动作生成。相比已有动作生成方法，其改进点在于支持开放词汇条件下的动作合成。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法定量评估。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary motion generation, aiming to synthesize unseen motion sequences conditioned on textual descriptions. The authors propose OMG, a framework based on a mixture of controllers for open-vocabulary motion generation. The improvement over existing motion generation methods lies in supporting open-vocabulary motion synthesis. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.assessment: 该论文属于动作生成方向，与自动驾驶感知、目标检测、3D检测等研究领域几乎无关，参考价值低。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.contribution: 提出基于混合控制器的开放词汇动作生成框架OMG。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.innovation: 通过混合控制器机制实现开放词汇条件下的动作生成。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法评估。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene._arxiv_id: OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Generation via Mixture of Controllers.

2411.19331|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割（OVS）需要在无预定义类别下按自由文本分割图像，但CLIP类模型因全局图文对齐导致空间定位粗糙，而DINOv2等自监督模型细粒度视觉编码强却缺乏语言接口。本文提出Talk2DINO，通过一个学习到的映射函数将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2的patch级特征，无需微调骨干网络，并利用DINOv2注意力图在训练时选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入。该方法结合了DINOv2的空间精度与CLIP的语言理解，产生更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。
2411.19331|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation (OVS) requires segmenting images from free-form text without predefined classes, but CLIP-style models suffer from coarse spatial localization due to global image-text alignment, while self-supervised models like DINOv2 excel at fine-grained encoding but lack language grounding. Talk2DINO bridges this gap by learning a mapping that aligns CLIP textual embeddings to DINOv2 patch-level features without fine-tuning either backbone, using DINOv2 attention maps to selectively align local patches with text during training. This hybrid approach yields more natural, less noisy segmentations and better foreground discrimination.
2411.19331|v2.assessment: 巧妙复用自监督视觉骨干的定位能力与CLIP的语义能力，无需微调即可实现开放词汇分割，思路简洁且实用性强，对开放集感知研究有直接参考价值。
2411.19331|v2.contribution: 提出无需微调骨干的混合框架，将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2的patch级特征以实现开放词汇分割。
2411.19331|v2.innovation: 利用DINOv2注意力图在训练时选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入，桥接自监督视觉与语言。
2411.19331|v2.result: 生成更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。

OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.summary_cn: 该论文提出OpenLex3D，一个面向开放词汇3D场景表示的分层基准。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其目标是系统评估开放词汇3D场景理解方法在不同层级语义粒度下的表现，填补该领域缺乏统一评测标准的空白。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.summary_en: OpenLex3D is proposed as a tiered benchmark for open-vocabulary 3D scene representations. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results are unavailable. The work appears to address the lack of standardized evaluation for open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding across different semantic granularities.

2409.18733|v2.summary_cn: 长尾与开放词汇目标检测受限于标注数据稀缺和训练成本高。本文提出SearchDet，一个免训练的长尾目标检测框架：从网络检索目标的正负样本图像，将其嵌入后计算输入图像加权的查询，用于检测目标概念。相比GroundingDINO等SOTA模型，SearchDet在ODinW上mAP提升超过48.7%，在LVIS上提升59.1%，且对检索样本的变化具有稳定性，展示了消除昂贵标注与训练流程的可行路径。
2409.18733|v2.summary_en: Long-tail and open-vocabulary object detection is hindered by scarce annotations and costly training. SearchDet is a training-free framework that retrieves positive and negative web images of a target concept, embeds them, and computes an input-image-weighted query to detect the concept. It improves mAP by over 48.7% on ODinW and 59.1% on LVIS compared to GroundingDINO, while remaining stable to exemplar variation, suggesting a path to eliminate costly annotation and training.
2409.18733|v2.assessment: 免训练、基于网络检索样本的检测范式极具启发性，性能提升幅度显著，对开放词汇检测与数据高效感知研究有重要参考价值。
2409.18733|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的SearchDet框架，利用网络检索的正负样本图像实现长尾开放词汇目标检测。
2409.18733|v2.innovation: 以输入图像加权的检索样本嵌入作为查询，完全免去标注与训练。
2409.18733|v2.result: 在ODinW上mAP提升超48.7%，LVIS上提升59.1%，且对样本变化稳定。
