2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在GPU硬件上因堆叠自注意力/交叉注意力块而难以加速部署的问题，提出充分利用GPU友好的2:4细粒度结构化稀疏与量化的压缩方案GPUSQ-ViT。先用2:4结构化剪枝将稠密模型转为稀疏模型（FP16），再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化训练转为定点模型，并采用混合策略知识蒸馏贯穿剪枝与量化过程。该方案支持监督与无监督学习，实验显示模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，取得SOTA压缩效果。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: GPUSQ-ViT targets the difficulty of accelerating ViT deployment on GPUs by exploiting GPU-friendly 2:4 fine-grained structured sparsity and quantization. It first prunes a dense model into a 2:4 sparse FP16 model, then quantizes it into a fixed-point model via sparse-distillation-aware quantization-aware training, with mixed-strategy knowledge distillation throughout. It supports supervised and unsupervised learning, achieving state-of-the-art compression with 6.4-12.7× model size reduction.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 面向GPU实际部署的稀疏+量化联合压缩方案工程性强，对ViT高效推理有参考价值。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出结合2:4结构化稀疏与量化的GPU友好ViT压缩方案GPUSQ-ViT。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 将2:4稀疏、量化感知训练与混合策略知识蒸馏统一到压缩流程中。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，达到SOTA压缩效果。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT剪枝方法不可解释、忽略内部单元与目标类别关系而导致性能次优的问题，提出可解释剪枝框架X-Pruner。该方法设计可解释性感知掩码，端到端学习以衡量每个可剪单元对预测各目标类别的贡献，并基于掩码值自适应搜索区分剪除与保留单元的层级阈值以确定逐层剪枝率。在DeiT和Swin Transformer上进行了验证，仿真结果显示其有效性。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: X-Pruner addresses the unexplainable nature of prior ViT pruning methods that overlook the relationship between internal units and target classes. It learns an explainability-aware mask end-to-end to measure each prunable unit's contribution to predicting each class, and adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds to determine pruning rates. Experiments on DeiT and Swin Transformer demonstrate its effectiveness.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 将可解释性引入ViT剪枝准则的思路有新意，对结构化压缩研究有参考价值。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出可解释性感知的ViT剪枝框架X-Pruner。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 用端到端学习的可解释性掩码衡量单元对目标类别的贡献并自适应定阈值。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT与Swin Transformer上验证了剪枝有效性。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: 半监督语义分割中，伪标签在低密度区域往往不可靠，导致确认偏差。本文提出密度引导的对比学习（Density-Guided Contrastive Learning），利用特征空间密度估计区分高密度可靠区域与低密度模糊区域，并对不同密度区域施加差异化的对比约束。相比已有半监督分割方法，该方法显式建模了类别密度分布，缓解了低密度区域的错误传播。在 Pascal VOC 和 Cityscapes 等基准上取得了优于现有半监督方法的 mIoU。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation suffers from unreliable pseudo-labels in low-density regions, causing confirmation bias. This paper proposes Density-Guided Contrastive Learning, which estimates feature-space density to distinguish reliable high-density regions from ambiguous low-density ones and applies differentiated contrastive constraints accordingly. It explicitly models class density distributions to mitigate error propagation and achieves superior mIoU over existing semi-supervised methods on Pascal VOC and Cityscapes.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 将密度估计引入半监督分割的对比学习框架，思路新颖，对自动驾驶场景下的标注稀缺问题有参考价值。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导的对比学习框架，利用特征空间密度区分可靠与模糊区域以改进半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 首次将特征空间密度估计与对比学习结合，对高/低密度区域施加差异化约束以抑制确认偏差。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 在 Pascal VOC 和 Cityscapes 等基准上取得优于现有半监督分割方法的 mIoU。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 基于样本回放的类增量学习（CIL）受限于内存预算，旧类只能保留少量样本（few-shot），导致灾难性遗忘。本文提出类增量掩码（CIM），通过 CAM 生成 0-1 判别性像素掩码，对非判别像素下采样以压缩样本，从而在固定内存中存储"many-shot"压缩样本。CIM 通过双层优化与 CIL 模型交替训练，自适应地为不同类别学习最优阈值，解决了 CAM 阈值在覆盖度与样本数量间的权衡问题。在多个 CIL 基准上显著优于现有回放方法。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: Exemplar-based class-incremental learning (CIL) is constrained by the memory budget, retaining only few-shot exemplars of old classes and suffering catastrophic forgetting. This paper proposes Class-Incremental Masking (CIM), which generates 0-1 masks on discriminative pixels from CAM to downsample non-discriminative pixels, storing many-shot compressed exemplars within a fixed memory. CIM is optimized via bilevel optimization with the CIL model to adaptively resolve the coverage-quantity trade-off across classes, substantially outperforming existing replay methods on CIL benchmarks.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 以像素级压缩突破 CIL 的 few-shot 内存瓶颈，思路简洁有效，双层优化设计合理，对持续学习研究者有较高参考价值。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出类增量掩码 CIM，通过 CAM 驱动的判别性像素压缩在固定内存中存储 many-shot 样本。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 用双层优化自适应学习各类别 CAM 阈值，将 few-shot 回放扩展为 many-shot 压缩回放。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个 CIL 基准上显著优于现有基于回放的方法。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: 结构化剪枝因参数分组模式随架构而异，现有方法依赖手工设计的架构特定分组方案，难以泛化到新架构。本文提出依赖图（DepGraph），显式建模层间依赖关系并自动全面地对耦合参数分组，实现任意架构（CNN、RNN、GNN、Transformer）的通用结构化剪枝。DepGraph 解决了结构耦合导致的层间同步剪枝与参数一致性移除难题，无需人工设计分组方案。在 ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet 及 ViT 等多种架构和任务上验证了通用性与有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: Structural pruning is hindered by architecture-specific parameter grouping, making existing pruners non-generalizable to new architectures. This paper proposes Dependency Graph (DepGraph), which explicitly models inter-layer dependencies and automatically groups coupled parameters for pruning, enabling general structural pruning of arbitrary architectures including CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. DepGraph addresses structural coupling without manual grouping design and is extensively validated on ResNe(X)t, DenseNet, MobileNet, and ViT across multiple tasks.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: 通用结构化剪枝的重要工作，DepGraph 抽象优雅且实用性强，对模型压缩与部署研究者价值很高。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出依赖图 DepGraph，实现任意架构的通用、全自动结构化剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 用依赖图显式建模层间耦合关系，自动分组参数，摆脱架构特定手工分组方案。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在 ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet、ViT 等多种架构和任务上验证了通用性与有效性。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: 通道剪枝在 2D CNN 上成果丰富，但直接迁移到 3D 点云网络（PNN）会因表示差异与架构差异导致性能下降。本文提出 CP3，一个面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件，包含坐标增强的通道重要性度量以刻画维度信息与通道特征的相关性，并回收 PNN 采样过程中丢弃的点以利用其潜在独有信息增强剪枝鲁棒性。在多种 PNN 架构上验证了有效性，实现了精度与效率的良好平衡。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: Channel pruning has succeeded on 2D CNNs but rarely extends to 3D point-based neural networks (PNNs), where direct transfer degrades performance due to representation and architecture disparities. This paper proposes CP3, a channel pruning plug-in for PNNs, featuring a coordinate-enhanced channel importance metric that captures the correlation between dimensional information and channel features, and recycling discarded points from PNN sampling to enhance pruning robustness. Experiments on various PNN architectures demonstrate effectiveness.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 填补了点云网络通道剪枝的空白，坐标增强重要性与点回收设计贴合点云特性，对 3D 感知模型压缩有实用价值。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件 CP3，使 2D 通道剪枝方法适配 PNN。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 设计坐标增强的通道重要性度量，并回收采样丢弃点以增强剪枝鲁棒性。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种 PNN 架构上实现精度与效率的良好平衡。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: 特征匹配中的对应关系剪枝需要区分内点与外点，现有方法在邻域一致性建模上不够充分。本文提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘（Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining），通过逐步扩展邻域范围并迭代挖掘一致性信息来剔除错误匹配。相比已有方法，该方法在保持内点的同时更有效地抑制外点，提升了对应关系剪枝的鲁棒性。在标准匹配基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: Correspondence pruning requires distinguishing inliers from outliers, yet existing methods insufficiently model neighborhood consistency. This paper proposes Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining, which progressively expands neighborhood ranges and iteratively mines consistency cues to remove mismatches. It preserves inliers while more effectively suppressing outliers, improving robustness, and achieves competitive results on standard matching benchmarks.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 邻域一致性渐进挖掘思路清晰，对特征匹配与对应关系剪枝方向有参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 通过逐步扩展邻域并迭代挖掘一致性信息来剔除错误匹配。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 在标准匹配基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: 深度网络容易依赖数据中的偏差特征（如背景、纹理）进行预测，导致在分布偏移下泛化性差。本文提出对比权重剪枝（Contrastive Weight Pruning），通过对比学习目标引导子网络训练，识别并剪除与偏差相关的权重，从而得到去偏子网络。相比已有去偏方法，该方法在保持精度的同时提升了模型在偏差数据集上的鲁棒性。在多个偏差基准上验证了去偏效果。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: Deep networks tend to rely on biased features such as background and texture, degrading generalization under distribution shifts. This paper proposes Contrastive Weight Pruning, which trains subnetworks guided by a contrastive objective to identify and prune bias-related weights, yielding debiased subnetworks. It improves robustness on biased datasets while maintaining accuracy, as validated on multiple bias benchmarks.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 将权重剪枝与去偏学习结合，视角新颖，对提升模型鲁棒性与公平性有启发，但与视觉感知主线关联中等。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝方法，通过剪除偏差相关权重训练去偏子网络。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 用对比学习目标引导权重剪枝以识别并移除偏差相关参数。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在多个偏差基准上提升鲁棒性并保持精度。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督学习在分布外（OOD）数据下鲁棒性不足的问题，指出伪标签在遇到OOD样本时会产生严重确认偏差。作者提出了一种基于语义剪枝的框架，通过识别并剪除与任务无关的语义通道来抑制OOD样本的干扰，从而提升半监督学习的鲁棒性。相比已有方法，该工作首次将剪枝思想引入OOD鲁棒半监督学习，在多个基准上取得了更优的OOD检测与分类性能。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness of semi-supervised learning under out-of-distribution (OOD) data, where pseudo-labels suffer from confirmation bias. The authors propose a semantic pruning framework that identifies and removes task-irrelevant semantic channels to suppress OOD interference. Compared with existing methods, it is the first to introduce pruning into OOD-robust semi-supervised learning, achieving improved OOD detection and classification performance on multiple benchmarks.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 将剪枝与OOD鲁棒半监督学习结合有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验规模。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出了一种基于语义剪枝的OOD鲁棒半监督学习框架。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 首次将语义通道剪枝用于抑制OOD样本对半监督学习的干扰。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在多个基准上提升了OOD检测与分类的鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算量大的问题，提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法。作者将剪枝参数与网络权重进行联合双层优化，在保持分割精度的同时显著降低计算量，以适应边缘端部署。相比传统剪枝方法，该方法能更灵活地搜索稀疏结构，在边缘设备上实现了更优的精度-效率权衡。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper targets efficient semantic segmentation on edge devices by proposing a pruning parameterization with bi-level optimization. The authors jointly optimize pruning parameters and network weights in a bi-level manner to reduce computation while preserving segmentation accuracy. Compared with conventional pruning, it enables more flexible sparse structure search and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off on edge devices.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 双层优化用于剪枝参数化思路合理，但语义分割与边缘部署场景与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出了面向边缘语义分割的双层优化剪枝参数化方法。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 将剪枝参数与网络权重进行联合双层优化以搜索稀疏结构。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在边缘设备上实现了更优的分割精度与计算效率权衡。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: 该论文针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图计算量巨大的问题，提出利用时空稀疏性来加速处理。作者通过在高分辨率输入中识别并仅处理关键区域，结合时间维度的稀疏传播，大幅降低计算开销。相比已有抠图方法，该方法在保持抠图质量的同时显著提升了超高分辨率下的处理效率。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of ultrahigh-resolution image/video matting by exploiting spatio-temporal sparsity. The authors identify and process only key regions in high-resolution inputs and propagate sparsely across time to reduce computation. Compared with existing matting methods, it maintains matting quality while significantly improving efficiency at ultrahigh resolutions.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 抠图任务与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但时空稀疏性思路对高效视频处理有参考价值。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出了利用时空稀疏性的超高分辨率图像/视频抠图方法。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 通过关键区域识别与时间稀疏传播降低超高分辨率抠图计算量。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在保持抠图质量的同时显著提升超高分辨率处理效率。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习在系统异构性下通信与计算效率低的问题，提出了自适应通道稀疏化方法。作者根据各客户端的计算能力动态调整通道稀疏度，在保证模型精度的同时减少通信和计算负担。相比固定稀疏度方法，该方法能更好地适应异构设备，提升了联邦学习的整体效率。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper tackles system heterogeneity in federated learning by proposing adaptive channel sparsity. The authors dynamically adjust channel sparsity per client based on computational capability, reducing communication and computation while preserving accuracy. Compared with fixed-sparsity methods, it better adapts to heterogeneous devices and improves overall federated learning efficiency.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 联邦学习与自动驾驶感知领域关联很弱，通道稀疏化思路对模型压缩有间接参考。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出了面向系统异构联邦学习的自适应通道稀疏化方法。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据客户端计算能力动态调整通道稀疏度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 在异构设备下提升了联邦学习的通信与计算效率。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频超分辨率模型计算量大的问题，提出了结构化稀疏学习方法。作者通过结构化剪枝去除冗余通道和层，在保持超分质量的同时加速推理。相比非结构化稀疏，结构化稀疏更利于硬件加速，在视频超分任务上实现了更好的效率-质量平衡。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper targets efficient video super-resolution by proposing structured sparsity learning. The authors apply structured pruning to remove redundant channels and layers, accelerating inference while maintaining super-resolution quality. Compared with unstructured sparsity, structured sparsity is more hardware-friendly and achieves a better efficiency-quality balance for video super-resolution.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 视频超分与自动驾驶感知关联有限，但结构化稀疏对高效视频模型设计有参考意义。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出了面向视频超分的结构化稀疏学习方法。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 通过结构化剪枝去除冗余通道和层以加速视频超分。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 在保持超分质量的同时提升了推理效率。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中生成器与判别器协同优化不足的问题，提出了判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法。作者利用判别器的中间特征图作为额外监督信号来指导学生生成器，从而在压缩GAN的同时保持生成质量。相比仅使用生成器蒸馏的方法，该工作通过判别器协同提升了压缩后GAN的生成保真度。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses GAN compression by proposing discriminator-cooperated feature map distillation. The authors leverage intermediate feature maps from the discriminator as additional supervision to guide the student generator, preserving generation quality under compression. Compared with generator-only distillation, the discriminator cooperation improves the fidelity of compressed GANs.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 判别器协同蒸馏思路新颖，对生成模型压缩有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联有限。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出了判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器中间特征图作为额外监督信号指导学生生成器。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 在压缩GAN的同时提升了生成保真度。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对紧凑型3D检测器知识蒸馏（KD）中教师与学生中间特征表示差异过大的问题，指出传统KD方法仅在师生特征表示相似时有效，而3D点云的稀疏性和不规则性加剧了这种表示差异。作者提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法，从信息瓶颈（IB）视角出发，最小化师生在候选区域对上的特征与logits差异。在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，甚至超越教师模型，同时仅需42%的FLOPs。该工作为极端紧凑3D检测器的蒸馏提供了有效方案。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the representation disparity issue in knowledge distillation (KD) for compact 3D detectors, where existing KD methods are effective only when teacher and student share similar intermediate features, a condition violated by the sparsity and irregularity of 3D point clouds. The authors propose Representation Disparity-aware Distillation (RDD), which from an information bottleneck perspective minimizes the disparity of proposal region pairs between student and teacher in both features and logits. On nuScenes, RDD boosts CP-Voxel-S to 57.1% mAP, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs, demonstrating clear superiority over existing KD methods.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该工作切中3D检测蒸馏中师生表示差异这一关键痛点，信息瓶颈视角新颖，且在nuScenes上以极低计算量超越教师，对自动驾驶感知的模型压缩具有实际价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD）方法，从信息瓶颈角度解决3D检测中师生特征表示差异过大的问题。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 首次从信息瓶颈视角建模并最小化师生在候选区域对上的特征与logits差异，实现极端紧凑3D检测器的高效蒸馏。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上使CP-Voxel-S达到57.1% mAP，超越教师模型且仅需42% FLOPs。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大、现有token剪枝方法忽略多模态对齐的问题，提出MADTP，通过多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝来加速VLT。方法上先对齐视觉与文本token的表示，再基于对齐后的重要性动态决定剪枝比例，从而在保持跨模态语义一致性的同时减少冗余token。相比固定比例或单模态启发式的剪枝策略，MADTP在多个VLT模型和下游任务上实现了更高的压缩率与精度保持。实验表明在保持相近精度下可显著降低FLOPs与推理时延，为多模态Transformer的高效部署提供了新思路。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of vision-language Transformers (VLTs) and the limitation of existing token pruning methods that overlook multimodal alignment. It proposes MADTP, a multimodal alignment-guided dynamic token pruning framework that first aligns visual and textual token representations and then dynamically determines pruning ratios based on alignment-aware importance. Compared with fixed-ratio or unimodal heuristic pruning, MADTP achieves higher compression while preserving cross-modal semantics, yielding substantial FLOPs and latency reductions with comparable accuracy across multiple VLT models and downstream tasks.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 将多模态对齐显式引入token剪枝，思路新颖，对多模态模型加速有实际参考价值。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架MADTP，用于加速视觉-语言Transformer。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 用跨模态对齐信号驱动token重要性评估与动态剪枝比例分配。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个VLT模型上实现显著FLOPs与时延下降，同时保持相近精度。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉-语言模型剪枝方法依赖特定下游任务、泛化性差的问题，提出MULTIFLOW，实现任务无关的视觉-语言剪枝。方法通过在多模态流之间进行结构化剪枝与权重流动/重分配，使剪枝后的模型无需针对具体任务重新设计即可迁移到多种下游任务。相比任务特定的剪枝方案，MULTIFLOW在多个视觉-语言任务上取得更均衡的性能，减少了对任务标签和微调的依赖。实验显示其在保持压缩率的同时，跨任务平均性能优于现有任务特定剪枝基线。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: This paper tackles the task-specificity of existing vision-language pruning methods by proposing MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic pruning framework for vision-language models. It performs structured pruning with cross-modal flow and weight redistribution so that the pruned model transfers to diverse downstream tasks without task-specific redesign. Compared with task-specific baselines, MULTIFLOW achieves more balanced performance across multiple vision-language tasks while maintaining compression, reducing reliance on task labels and fine-tuning.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝对多模态基础模型部署很有意义，方法设计合理，实验覆盖多任务。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝框架MULTIFLOW。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 通过跨模态流式权重重分配实现无需任务定制的剪枝。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在多个视觉-语言任务上以相近压缩率取得优于任务特定基线的平均性能。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）结构化剪枝中缺乏细粒度误差度量的问题，提出MoPE-CLIP，引入模块级剪枝误差度量来指导CLIP类模型的高效压缩。方法将剪枝误差分解到不同模块（如视觉编码器、文本编码器、跨模态交互），据此分配剪枝预算，从而更精准地保留关键模块容量。相比统一或粗粒度的重要性度量，MoPE-CLIP在相同压缩率下取得更高的零样本与下游任务精度。实验表明其在CLIP系列模型上实现了更好的精度-效率权衡。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of fine-grained error metrics in structured pruning of vision-language models by proposing MoPE-CLIP, which introduces a module-wise pruning error metric to guide efficient compression of CLIP-style models. The pruning error is decomposed across modules (e.g., vision encoder, text encoder, cross-modal interaction) to allocate pruning budgets more precisely. Compared with uniform or coarse importance measures, MoPE-CLIP achieves higher zero-shot and downstream accuracy at the same compression ratio, improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off on CLIP-family models.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 模块级误差度量对多模态剪枝有较强解释性，方法简洁且实验扎实。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量MoPE-CLIP，用于CLIP类视觉-语言模型的结构化剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 将剪枝误差按模块分解并据此分配剪枝预算。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.result: 在相同压缩率下取得更高的零样本与下游任务精度。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: 针对多模态训练数据规模庞大、冗余样本多导致训练成本高的问题，提出Sieve，利用图像描述模型进行多模态数据集剪枝。方法借助预训练图像描述模型评估图文样本的信息量与对齐质量，筛除低价值或噪声样本，从而在减少数据量的同时保持甚至提升下游性能。相比随机采样或基于简单启发式的数据筛选，Sieve在多个多模态基准上以更少数据取得更优或相当的精度。实验显示其能显著降低训练开销并提升数据效率。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: This paper targets the high training cost caused by massive and redundant multimodal datasets by proposing Sieve, a dataset pruning method that leverages image captioning models. It uses pretrained captioning models to assess the informativeness and image-text alignment of samples, filtering out low-value or noisy data while preserving downstream performance. Compared with random sampling or simple heuristics, Sieve achieves better or comparable accuracy on multiple multimodal benchmarks with less data, improving data efficiency and reducing training cost.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 数据剪枝方向实用性强，利用caption模型做筛选的思路简单有效，但方法新颖性一般。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述模型的多模态数据集剪枝方法Sieve。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 用预训练caption模型评估样本信息量与图文对齐质量进行数据筛选。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 在多个多模态基准上以更少数据取得更优或相当的精度。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer压缩中重要性搜索与稀疏度搜索通常分阶段进行、效率低且次优的问题，提出Once for Both，在单一阶段内同时完成重要性与稀疏度搜索。方法将通道/结构重要性与目标稀疏度统一建模，通过一次搜索过程直接得到压缩配置，避免了多阶段搜索的误差累积与额外开销。相比两阶段或分离式压缩方法，该方法在多个ViT骨干和任务上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。实验表明在相同压缩率下精度更高，且搜索成本显著降低。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and suboptimality of separate importance and sparsity searches in Vision Transformer compression by proposing Once for Both, which performs both searches in a single stage. It jointly models structural importance and target sparsity to directly obtain a compression configuration, avoiding error accumulation and overhead of multi-stage pipelines. Compared with two-stage or decoupled methods, it achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off across ViT backbones and tasks, with higher accuracy at equal compression and substantially lower search cost.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 单阶段联合搜索思路清晰，对ViT压缩的工程落地有参考价值。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合重要性与稀疏度搜索的ViT压缩方法Once for Both。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 将重要性与稀疏度搜索统一到一次搜索过程中完成。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.result: 在相同压缩率下精度更高，且搜索开销显著降低。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: 针对少样本条件下视觉Transformer压缩困难、数据需求大的问题，提出Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples。方法在极少样本下通过密集压缩策略（如结构化剪枝与权重共享/重建）实现ViT的高效压缩，缓解了数据稀缺导致的过拟合与重要性估计不准问题。相比需要大量校准数据的压缩方法，该方法在few-shot设定下仍能保持较高精度。实验表明在极少样本下取得优于现有压缩基线的精度-效率表现。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of compressing Vision Transformers under few-sample regimes by proposing a dense ViT compression method with few samples. It employs dense compression strategies such as structured pruning with weight sharing/reconstruction to enable efficient ViT compression with minimal calibration data, mitigating overfitting and inaccurate importance estimation. Compared with compression methods requiring large calibration sets, it maintains higher accuracy in few-shot settings, outperforming existing baselines in the accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本压缩是实际部署中的痛点，方法针对性强，实验设定有现实意义。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本条件下的密集视觉Transformer压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 在极少校准样本下通过密集压缩与权重重建实现ViT高效压缩。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 在极少样本下取得优于现有压缩基线的精度-效率表现。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像压缩模型在持续学习新数据/新码率时容易遗忘旧知识、且压缩格式向后兼容性难以保持的问题，提出了一种向后兼容的持续学习图像压缩框架。方法上通过约束潜在表示与码流结构，使新模型解码器仍能解码旧模型产生的码流，同时在新数据上继续优化压缩性能。相比已有持续学习方法主要面向分类任务、忽略压缩码流兼容性，该工作将兼容性显式建模为优化目标。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称在保持旧码流可解码的同时提升了新域压缩效率。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and backward compatibility in continual learning for image compression, where updated codecs must still decode bitstreams produced by earlier models. It proposes a framework that constrains latent representations and bitstream structure so that new decoders remain compatible with old encodings while continuing to improve compression on new data. Unlike prior continual learning work focused on classification, it explicitly models bitstream compatibility as an optimization objective, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 将持续学习与图像压缩的向后兼容性问题结合，问题设定新颖，但摘要信息有限，需看实验细节判断实际价值。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出面向图像压缩的向后兼容持续学习框架，使新模型可解码旧码流并持续提升压缩性能。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将码流向后兼容性显式建模为持续学习优化目标，而非仅关注分类任务的知识保持。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在保持旧码流可解码的同时提升了新域压缩效率。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: 该论文针对StyleGAN压缩中通道剪枝容易导致生成多样性下降的问题，提出了多样性感知的通道剪枝方法。方法通过分析通道对生成样本多样性的贡献，设计多样性度量并据此分配剪枝预算，从而在压缩模型的同时保留生成分布的多样性。相比仅以重建损失或FID为导向的剪枝方法，该工作显式优化多样性指标。摘要未提供具体压缩率与FID数值，但声称在同等压缩率下多样性优于基线。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the degradation of generation diversity in StyleGAN compression caused by conventional channel pruning. It proposes a diversity-aware channel pruning method that measures each channel's contribution to sample diversity and allocates pruning budgets accordingly, preserving the generative distribution while compressing the model. Unlike pruning guided solely by reconstruction loss or FID, it explicitly optimizes diversity, though the abstract lacks specific compression ratios and FID numbers.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 关注生成模型压缩中的多样性保持，角度较新，但属于生成模型压缩而非感知任务，与自动驾驶视觉相关性有限。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法用于StyleGAN压缩，在压缩同时保持生成多样性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 以通道对生成多样性的贡献作为剪枝准则，而非仅依赖重建损失或FID。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在同等压缩率下生成多样性优于基线方法。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离、剪枝策略难以自适应的问题，提出通过可学习智能体引导与对齐来联合训练和剪枝CNN。方法引入强化学习或可学习控制器作为智能体，动态决定剪枝动作，并通过对齐机制使剪枝后的网络与原始网络表示保持一致。相比两阶段剪枝方法，该工作实现了训练与剪枝的端到端联合优化。摘要未给出具体数据集与精度数值，但声称在多个基准上取得更优的精度-压缩权衡。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation between training and pruning in CNN compression by jointly optimizing both via learnable agent guidance and alignment. A learnable agent decides pruning actions dynamically, and an alignment mechanism keeps the pruned network's representations consistent with the original. Unlike two-stage pruning pipelines, it performs end-to-end joint training and pruning, claiming better accuracy-compression trade-offs on multiple benchmarks, though no specific numbers are given in the abstract.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 联合训练与剪枝的思路合理，智能体引导与对齐机制有一定新意，但属于通用压缩方法，与感知任务关联较弱。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出基于可学习智能体引导与对齐的CNN联合训练与剪枝框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 用可学习智能体动态决定剪枝动作，并通过表示对齐保持剪枝前后一致性。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在多个基准上取得更优的精度-压缩权衡。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习中不同设备算力异构、难以统一剪枝的问题，提出了按设备划分的联邦网络剪枝方法。方法为每个设备或设备组学习独立的剪枝掩码/子网络，在联邦聚合时协调各子网络参数，从而在满足各设备资源约束的同时保持全局模型性能。相比对所有设备使用统一剪枝率的联邦学习方法，该工作实现了设备感知的个性化压缩。摘要未给出具体精度与通信开销数值，但声称在异构设备下优于统一剪枝基线。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper targets heterogeneous device capabilities in federated learning by proposing device-wise federated network pruning. It learns per-device or per-group pruning masks and sub-networks, coordinating their parameters during federated aggregation to satisfy each device's resource constraints while maintaining global model performance. Unlike federated learning with a uniform pruning ratio, it enables device-aware personalized compression, claiming improvements over uniform-pruning baselines on heterogeneous devices without reporting specific numbers.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 将剪枝与联邦学习结合并考虑设备异构性，问题设定实用，但与自动驾驶视觉感知的直接相关性较低。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出设备感知的联邦网络剪枝方法，为异构设备学习个性化子网络。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 在联邦聚合中协调各设备独立剪枝掩码，实现设备级个性化压缩。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在异构设备场景下优于统一剪枝基线。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有通道剪枝方法中动态剪枝与静态剪枝各自局限的问题，提出了BilevelPruning统一框架。方法将动态剪枝（输入相关）与静态剪枝（结构固定）建模为双层优化问题，上层学习剪枝策略、下层更新网络权重，从而兼顾推理效率与自适应能力。相比单一动态或静态剪枝方法，该工作统一了两类范式。摘要未给出具体压缩率与精度数值，但声称在多个网络上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of dynamic and static channel pruning by proposing BilevelPruning, a unified framework that formulates both as a bilevel optimization problem. The upper level learns pruning policies while the lower level updates network weights, combining inference efficiency with input adaptivity. Unlike methods restricted to either dynamic or static pruning, it unifies both paradigms, claiming better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across networks, though specific numbers are absent from the abstract.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 统一动态与静态剪枝的双层优化视角有一定理论新意，但属于通用压缩方法，与感知任务关联有限。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出统一动态与静态通道剪枝的双层优化框架BilevelPruning。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 将动态与静态剪枝建模为双层优化问题，上层学策略、下层更新权重。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在多个网络上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: 该论文针对CapsNet中路由计算开销大、特征冗余的问题，提出了OrthCaps——一种带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet。方法通过正交约束使胶囊表示解耦，采用稀疏注意力路由替代传统动态路由以降低计算量，并引入剪枝去除冗余胶囊。相比原始CapsNet，该工作在保持或提升分类精度的同时显著降低参数量与计算量。摘要未给出具体数据集与精度数值，但声称在多个基准上优于CapsNet基线。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper tackles the high routing cost and feature redundancy of CapsNets by proposing OrthCaps, an orthogonal CapsNet with sparse attention routing and pruning. It enforces orthogonality to disentangle capsule representations, replaces conventional dynamic routing with sparse attention routing to cut computation, and prunes redundant capsules. Compared with the original CapsNet, it claims comparable or better classification accuracy with substantially fewer parameters and FLOPs, though no specific numbers are provided.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 对CapsNet的路由与冗余问题提出正交约束与稀疏注意力方案，思路清晰，但CapsNet在主流感知任务中应用有限。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet（OrthCaps），降低路由开销与特征冗余。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 用正交约束解耦胶囊表示，并以稀疏注意力路由替代传统动态路由。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在多个基准上以更少参数与计算量取得优于CapsNet基线的精度。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: 联邦学习场景下动态剪枝面临客户端内存开销大和通信成本高的问题。FedMef 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架，通过只维护子网络的梯度/参数更新并设计稀疏感知的聚合与再生长机制，避免在客户端保存完整模型。相比已有联邦剪枝方法，它降低了峰值内存占用并减少了通信量。在多个基准上实现了与集中式剪枝接近的精度，同时显著降低客户端内存与通信开销。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: Federated dynamic pruning suffers from high client memory and communication costs. FedMef introduces a memory-efficient federated dynamic pruning framework that maintains only subnetwork updates with sparsity-aware aggregation and regrowth. It reduces peak memory and communication while matching centralized pruning accuracy on several benchmarks.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 对边缘端联邦学习部署有实用价值，但与本领域（自动驾驶视觉感知）关联较弱。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架 FedMef。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 通过子网络级更新与稀疏聚合避免客户端保存完整模型。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 在降低客户端内存与通信开销的同时保持接近集中式剪枝的精度。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: 大模型微调阶段计算与显存开销巨大，现有剪枝方法多针对推理而非微调。该工作提出面向微调的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法，在微调过程中动态识别并移除冗余结构以降低训练成本。相比静态剪枝或仅推理剪枝，它兼顾了微调效率与下游精度。实验表明在保持或略微提升下游任务性能的同时显著减少微调所需的计算与内存。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: Finetuning large models is computationally and memory intensive, while most pruning targets inference. This work proposes resource-efficient Transformer pruning for finetuning, dynamically removing redundant structures during finetuning. It reduces finetuning cost while preserving downstream accuracy compared with static or inference-only pruning.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 对大模型高效微调有参考意义，但与视觉感知任务本身关系有限。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向微调阶段的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 在微调过程中动态剪枝以降低训练开销。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.result: 在保持下游精度的同时显著降低微调计算与内存。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: 彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）中寻找稀疏子网络通常依赖昂贵的迭代训练或对数据不敏感的剪枝准则。该工作提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝（spectral foresight pruning），利用损失曲面的谱信息在训练前预测重要连接。相比传统前瞻剪枝，它更充分地利用数据分布信息。在视觉模型上找到的彩票 ticket 在稀疏度较高时仍能保持甚至超过原模型精度。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: Finding lottery tickets typically requires costly iterative training or data-agnostic criteria. This paper proposes data-driven spectral foresight pruning that predicts important connections before training using spectral information of the loss landscape. The resulting tickets retain or exceed dense accuracy at high sparsity on vision models.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 对剪枝理论与彩票假设研究有启发，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝以寻找视觉模型中的彩票 ticket。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用损失曲面谱信息在训练前预测重要连接。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 在高稀疏度下找到的 ticket 仍保持或超过原模型精度。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: RGB-D 6DoF 物体位姿估计中，2D-3D 对应关系构建与误匹配剔除是关键瓶颈。HiPose 提出层次化二值表面编码与对应剪枝，将物体表面编码为层次化二值特征以实现高效准确的 2D-3D 匹配。相比基于稠密特征或 RANSAC 的方法，它在遮挡和杂乱场景下更鲁棒。在 LineMOD 与 YCB-Video 等基准上取得领先精度，并保持较高推理效率。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: Building and pruning 2D-3D correspondences is a bottleneck in RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation. HiPose introduces hierarchical binary surface encoding and correspondence pruning for efficient and accurate matching. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on LineMOD and YCB-Video while remaining efficient.
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 对机器人抓取与自动驾驶中的物体位姿感知有直接参考价值，方法设计扎实。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出层次化二值表面编码与对应剪枝的 RGB-D 6DoF 位姿估计方法 HiPose。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 用层次化二值编码实现高效准确的 2D-3D 对应与剪枝。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在 LineMOD 与 YCB-Video 上取得领先精度并保持高效推理。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: 源自由（source-free）场景下模型知识产权保护困难，现有水印方法易被微调或剪枝破坏。该工作提出 MAsk-Pruning（MAP），通过掩码剪枝在模型中嵌入可验证的指纹以实现知识产权保护。相比传统参数水印，它对微调和剪枝更鲁棒。实验表明在多种攻击下仍能可靠验证模型归属，同时对下游性能影响很小。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: Protecting model intellectual property in source-free settings is challenging, as existing watermarks are fragile to finetuning or pruning. This paper proposes MAsk-Pruning (MAP), embedding verifiable fingerprints via mask pruning. It remains robust under various attacks with minimal impact on downstream performance.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 对模型版权保护有实际意义，但与视觉感知任务本身关联较弱。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出基于掩码剪枝的源自由模型知识产权保护方法 MAP。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 通过掩码剪枝嵌入对微调与剪枝鲁棒的指纹。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 在多种攻击下仍可可靠验证归属且对性能影响很小。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: Vision Transformer 推理中大量 token 冗余导致计算浪费，现有 token 剪枝多需微调或额外训练。Zero-TPrune 提出零样本 token 剪枝，利用预训练 Transformer 的注意力图在无需训练的情况下评估 token 重要性。相比需要重训练的方法，它即插即用且计算开销低。在 ImageNet 等任务上大幅减少 FLOPs 的同时保持甚至提升精度。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: Token redundancy in Vision Transformers wastes computation, and existing token pruning often requires finetuning. Zero-TPrune performs zero-shot token pruning by leveraging the attention graph of pretrained Transformers without training. It substantially reduces FLOPs while maintaining or improving accuracy on ImageNet.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 对高效 ViT 推理有直接价值，可迁移到自动驾驶中的 Transformer 感知骨干。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出利用注意力图的零样本 token 剪枝方法 Zero-TPrune。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 无需训练即可基于注意力图评估并剪除冗余 token。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.result: 在 ImageNet 上大幅降低 FLOPs 的同时保持或提升精度。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: 针对从零训练（training-from-scratch）场景下网络剪枝难以确定各层稀疏度的问题，本文提出 Auto-Train-Once（ATO），用控制器网络引导自动剪枝。方法在训练过程中由控制器动态分配各层稀疏预算，避免人工设定逐层稀疏率，并可与从零训练联合优化。相比依赖预训练权重或手工稀疏配置的剪枝方法，ATO 在保持精度的同时获得更高压缩率，在 CIFAR/ImageNet 等基准上以更少 FLOPs 达到与稠密模型相当甚至更优的精度。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses automatic network pruning in the training-from-scratch setting, where per-layer sparsity is hard to specify. It proposes Auto-Train-Once (ATO), a controller network that dynamically allocates layer-wise sparsity budgets during training and jointly optimizes them with the backbone. Compared with hand-crafted or pretrained-weight-dependent pruning, ATO achieves higher compression with comparable or better accuracy on CIFAR/ImageNet benchmarks.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 把逐层稀疏度搜索与从零训练统一到一个控制器框架中，思路清晰，对边缘部署的模型压缩有实用价值。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出控制器网络引导的从零训练自动剪枝框架 ATO。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 用可学习控制器在训练中动态分配逐层稀疏预算，免除人工稀疏配置与预训练依赖。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 在多个图像分类基准上以更高压缩率保持与稠密模型相当或更优的精度。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: 针对数据集剪枝中样本重要性随训练进程动态变化、单一时刻打分不稳定的问题，本文提出时序双深度打分（TDDS）。方法在训练轨迹上从两个深度/时间尺度评估样本贡献，融合早期与后期的打分信号来筛选核心子集。相比静态打分或单阶段准则，TDDS 在多个数据集与网络结构上以更小的子集取得更优或相当的精度，验证了跨训练阶段信息的价值。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper tackles dataset pruning, where sample importance varies across training and single-shot scores are unstable. It proposes Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS), which evaluates sample contributions at two temporal depths along the training trajectory and fuses early- and late-stage signals for subset selection. TDDS outperforms static or single-stage criteria, achieving better or comparable accuracy with smaller coresets across datasets and architectures.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 从训练动力学角度重新审视数据剪枝，方法简单但视角有价值，对数据高效训练有参考意义。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出跨训练阶段的时序双深度样本打分准则用于数据集剪枝。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 利用训练轨迹上两个时间尺度的打分融合，缓解单时刻样本重要性估计的偏差。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 在多个数据集与网络上以更小核心集取得更优或相当的精度。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: 针对深度补全中稀疏深度图密度差异大、固定传播策略难以适应的问题，本文提出掩码空间传播网络（Masked Spatial Propagation Network）。方法用掩码机制控制空间传播的邻域与步长，使网络能根据输入稀疏度自适应地细化深度，并可与 RGB 引导联合训练。相比固定传播核的深度补全方法，该网络在不同稀疏度下更鲁棒，在 KITTI 等深度补全基准上降低了 RMSE 等误差指标。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper targets depth completion with highly varying sparsity, where fixed propagation kernels fail to adapt. It proposes a Masked Spatial Propagation Network that uses masking to control propagation neighborhoods and steps, enabling sparsity-adaptive depth refinement with optional RGB guidance. Compared with fixed-kernel propagation, it is more robust across sparsity levels and reduces RMSE on KITTI-style depth completion benchmarks.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 稀疏度自适应传播对自动驾驶深度感知有直接价值，方法设计合理，实验覆盖不同稀疏条件。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出掩码空间传播网络实现稀疏度自适应的深度补全细化。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 用可学习掩码动态调节空间传播的邻域与步长，替代固定传播核。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 在 KITTI 等深度补全基准上降低 RMSE，并在不同稀疏度下保持鲁棒。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: 针对结构化稀疏对抗攻击中扰动难以迁移、组稀疏约束不易精确满足的问题，本文提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构稀疏攻击方法。方法在训练阶段显式施加组稀疏约束，学习可迁移的稀疏扰动模式，再迁移到黑盒模型上生成结构化扰动。相比逐像素稀疏攻击，该方法在保持稀疏结构的同时提升了跨模型攻击成功率，在主流分类/检测网络上验证了迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper addresses transferable structured sparse adversarial attacks, where group-sparsity constraints are hard to satisfy exactly and perturbations transfer poorly. It proposes an exact group-sparsity training scheme that learns transferable sparse perturbation patterns for black-box attacks. Compared with pixel-wise sparse attacks, it improves cross-model attack success while preserving structured sparsity on mainstream classification/detection networks.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 把精确组稀疏优化引入对抗攻击训练，对感知系统的鲁棒性评测有参考价值。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出精确组稀疏训练驱动的可迁移结构稀疏对抗攻击方法。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 在训练中显式施加精确组稀疏约束以学习可迁移的结构化扰动。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 在保持结构化稀疏的同时提升跨模型攻击成功率。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: 针对 N:M 结构化稀疏中固定稀疏模式限制精度、难以兼顾不同硬件约束的问题，本文提出 MaxQ 多轴查询机制用于 N:M 稀疏网络。方法通过多轴查询在权重块内搜索更优的稀疏掩码分配，使 N:M 模式在训练中自适应优化。相比固定掩码或单轴打分方法，MaxQ 在相同 N:M 约束下取得更高精度，在 ImageNet 等基准上缩小了与稠密模型的差距。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper targets N:M structured sparsity, where fixed sparsity patterns limit accuracy under hardware constraints. It proposes MaxQ, a multi-axis query mechanism that searches better mask assignments within weight blocks and adapts the N:M pattern during training. Compared with fixed-mask or single-axis scoring, MaxQ achieves higher accuracy under identical N:M constraints on ImageNet-scale benchmarks.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: N:M 稀疏是 GPU 加速推理的关键技术，多轴查询思路对稀疏训练有实际意义。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询机制 MaxQ 优化 N:M 稀疏网络的掩码分配。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 在权重块内进行多轴查询搜索，使 N:M 稀疏模式在训练中自适应。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 在相同 N:M 约束下取得更高精度，缩小与稠密模型的差距。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: 针对训练后稀疏化（post-training sparsity）中不同稀疏粒度方法各自为政、精度损失大的问题，本文提出统一框架 UniPTS。方法将剪枝与量化等训练后稀疏操作统一建模，通过统一的权重重构/补偿机制在无需微调的情况下恢复精度。相比单一粒度的训练后剪枝方法，UniPTS 在多种稀疏率与网络上取得更低的精度损失，验证了统一建模的有效性。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses post-training sparsity, where different granularity-specific methods are fragmented and incur large accuracy drops. It proposes UniPTS, a unified framework that models pruning and related post-training sparsification operations and applies a unified weight reconstruction/compensation scheme without fine-tuning. Compared with single-granularity post-training pruning, UniPTS achieves lower accuracy loss across sparsity ratios and networks.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 统一训练后稀疏化范式对低成本模型压缩部署有吸引力，框架化思路便于扩展到不同粒度。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的训练后稀疏化框架 UniPTS。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 将多种稀疏粒度统一建模并用统一权重补偿机制免微调恢复精度。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 在多种稀疏率与网络上取得比单粒度方法更低的精度损失。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时计算和存储开销大的问题，提出DeepCompress-ViT压缩框架。方法上结合了结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，在保持注意力结构的前提下压缩模型。相比已有ViT压缩工作，该方法更注重边缘部署的实际效率约束。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需进一步验证。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational and memory overhead of deploying Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing DeepCompress-ViT, a compression framework that combines structured pruning with knowledge distillation. It aims to preserve attention structure while reducing model size, targeting practical edge deployment constraints. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: ViT压缩在边缘部署中具有实用价值，但需关注其与检测/自动驾驶任务的结合程度。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出面向边缘部署的ViT压缩框架DeepCompress-ViT。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 结合结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏以保持注意力结构。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: 现有目标检测方法多基于sRGB输入，而sRGB由ISP从RAW压缩而来，在复杂光照和天气下会丢失关键信息。本文提出AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率真实RAW图像、135,601个标注实例、62个类别，覆盖9种光照和天气条件。基于该数据集建立RAW与sRGB检测基准，发现sRGB预训练因域差距限制RAW检测性能，进而提出直接在RAW域预训练并从sRGB预训练模型蒸馏知识，在多样和恶劣条件下取得显著提升且无需额外预处理模块。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: Existing detectors operate on sRGB inputs compressed from RAW via ISP, losing crucial information under complex light and weather. The authors introduce AODRaw, a dataset of 7,785 high-resolution real RAW images with 135,601 annotated instances across 62 categories and 9 conditions, and build a comprehensive benchmark. They show sRGB pre-training limits RAW detection due to domain gap, and propose direct RAW-domain pre-training with knowledge distillation from an sRGB-pretrained model, achieving substantial gains under diverse and adverse conditions without extra pre-processing modules.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: RAW域检测是自动驾驶感知中极具潜力的方向，该工作提供了大规模数据集和有效预训练策略，值得关注。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建大规模RAW目标检测数据集AODRaw并建立基准。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 提出RAW域直接预训练结合sRGB知识蒸馏的检测范式。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样和恶劣条件下取得显著提升，无需额外预处理模块。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: 持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）需在连续域偏移下在线适配源预训练检测器，但现有方法忽视计算效率。本文观察到并非所有源特征都有益，部分域敏感通道会损害目标域性能，据此提出敏感度引导的通道剪枝策略，在图像和实例级别量化通道对域差异的敏感度，并通过加权稀疏正则化抑制和剪枝敏感通道，聚焦于不变通道的适配。此外引入随机通道重激活机制恢复被剪枝通道，在三个基准上取得优越性能。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: Continual test-time adaptive object detection (CTTA-OD) adapts a source detector online under continuous domain shifts, but existing methods overlook computational efficiency. Observing that some domain-sensitive channels harm target performance, the authors propose sensitivity-guided channel pruning that quantifies channel sensitivity at image and instance levels, applies weighted sparsity regularization to suppress sensitive channels, and introduces stochastic channel reactivation to recover pruned channels. Experiments on three benchmarks show superior performance.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 将剪枝引入CTTA-OD以提升效率，思路新颖，对资源受限的自动驾驶部署有参考价值。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出基于敏感度引导剪枝的高效持续测试时自适应目标检测方法。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 利用域敏感通道剪枝与随机重激活机制实现高效在线适配。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上取得优越性能。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: 针对学习式点云属性压缩中高斯和拉普拉斯熵模型未能充分利用熵参数信息的问题，提出广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更准确估计隐变量概率。同时指出现有方法在算术编码中使用固定似然区间限制性能，提出均值误差判别器（MED）动态调整似然区间。在三个VAE-based点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能，并可推广至图像和视频压缩。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: To better exploit entropy parameters in learned point cloud attribute compression, this paper introduces a generalized Gaussian entropy model that controls tail shape via a shape parameter for more accurate latent probability estimation. It also proposes a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) to dynamically adjust likelihood intervals during arithmetic coding, replacing fixed intervals. Experiments show significant rate-distortion improvements on three VAE-based models, with applicability to image and video compression.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 属于点云压缩方向，与目标检测/自动驾驶感知关联较弱，但压缩技术对车载传输有间接价值。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出广义高斯熵模型与动态似然区间用于点云属性压缩。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 通过形状参数控制尾部形状并引入MED动态调整似然区间。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在三个VAE-based模型上显著提升率失真性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: 针对八叉树结构点云几何压缩，提出TopNet——一种Transformer高效占用预测网络。摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推测其利用Transformer进行占用预测以提升点云几何压缩效率。与目标检测/自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network for octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. The abstract is missing, so specific methods and experimental results cannot be assessed. Based on the title, it leverages Transformers for occupancy prediction to improve point cloud geometry compression efficiency.
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.assessment: 点云几何压缩方向，与检测/自动驾驶感知关联较弱，且摘要缺失难以评估质量。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出面向八叉树点云几何压缩的Transformer占用预测网络TopNet。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.innovation: 将Transformer用于八叉树占用预测以提升压缩效率。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.result: 摘要缺失，无法评估具体效果。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: 针对文本驱动3D场景编辑中2D扩散模型忽视多视图信息导致多视图不一致，以及3DGS编辑优化效率低的问题，提出EditSplat框架。方法包括多视图融合引导（MFG），将多视图信息融入扩散过程并结合无分类器引导与3DGS几何结构；以及注意力引导修剪（AGT），利用3DGS显式表示选择性修剪和优化3D高斯。通过定性和定量实验验证了多视图一致性和局部编辑效果。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: To address multi-view inconsistency in text-driven 3D scene editing caused by 2D diffusion models ignoring multi-view information, and inefficient 3DGS editing, this paper proposes EditSplat. It integrates Multi-view Fusion Guidance (MFG) to inject multi-view information into the diffusion process with classifier-free guidance and 3DGS geometry, and Attention-Guided Trimming (AGT) to selectively prune and optimize 3D Gaussians. Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate improved consistency and local editing.
2412.11520|v2.assessment: 3D场景编辑与自动驾驶感知关联有限，但多视图一致性与3DGS优化思路对BEV/多相机感知有借鉴意义。
2412.11520|v2.contribution: 提出结合多视图融合引导与注意力引导修剪的文本驱动3D场景编辑框架EditSplat。
2412.11520|v2.innovation: 利用3DGS几何结构实现多视图一致性与高效局部编辑。
2412.11520|v2.result: 定性和定量实验验证了多视图一致性和局部编辑效果。

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM在高分辨率图像下视觉编码器延迟高、视觉token数量大的效率瓶颈，论文系统分析了图像分辨率、视觉延迟、token数与LLM规模之间的权衡关系，提出FastVLM及新型混合视觉编码器FastViTHD。FastViTHD通过混合架构显著减少输出token数并降低高分辨率编码时间，仅靠缩放输入图像即可在视觉token数与分辨率之间取得最优平衡，无需额外的token剪枝，简化了模型设计。相比已有方法，FastVLM在延迟、模型大小与精度之间实现了更优的折中。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of VLM vision encoders at high input resolutions, where ViTs produce excessive tokens and incur high encoding latency. It introduces FastVLM with FastViTHD, a hybrid vision encoder that outputs fewer tokens and drastically reduces encoding time for high-resolution images. Unlike prior methods, FastVLM achieves an optimal balance between visual token count and image resolution solely by scaling the input image, eliminating extra token pruning and simplifying the design.
2412.13303|v2.assessment: 对VLM效率优化有直接参考价值，混合编码器设计与token-分辨率权衡分析对多模态感知系统部署有启发。
2412.13303|v2.contribution: 提出FastVLM及混合视觉编码器FastViTHD，实现高分辨率下低延迟、少token的高效VLM。

2503.17142|v2.summary_cn: 论文探究VLM图像嵌入空间是否也像文本空间一样具有组合性结构，但视觉数据的噪声与稀疏性使该分析困难。为此提出Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE)框架，用几何感知的组合结构近似图像表示。实验表明预训练VLM的视觉嵌入确实呈现组合性排列，GDE在组合分类上优于假设线性几何的对比方法，在组鲁棒性任务上尤其有效，取得更高结果。
2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This work investigates whether the visual embedding space of VLMs exhibits compositional structure akin to the text space, addressing challenges from noise and sparsity in visual data. It proposes Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE), a framework approximating image representations with geometry-aware compositional structures. GDE outperforms a linear-geometry counterpart in compositional classification and is notably effective for group robustness.
2503.17142|v2.assessment: 对理解VLM视觉表征结构有理论意义，但与应用型感知任务关联较弱。
2503.17142|v2.contribution: 提出GDE框架，揭示并利用预训练VLM视觉嵌入的组合性结构。
2503.17142|v2.innovation: 用几何感知的可分解嵌入近似图像表示，突破线性几何假设。
2503.17142|v2.result: 在组合分类上优于线性方法，在组鲁棒性任务上取得更高结果。

2501.02955|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基准缺乏对VLM细粒度运动理解的评估，论文提出MotionBench，涵盖六类运动导向问题类型并采集多来源真实视频数据。实验显示现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现很差。为在有限LLM序列长度下提升运动感知，论文系统实验了面向视频特征压缩的VLM架构，提出高效的Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion方法。结果表明更高帧率输入与TE Fusion能提升运动理解，但仍有很大提升空间。
2501.02955|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MotionBench, a benchmark evaluating fine-grained motion comprehension of video VLMs across six motion-oriented question types with diverse real-world data, revealing poor performance of existing VLMs. To improve motion perception under limited LLM sequence length, it reviews video feature compression architectures and proposes an efficient Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion method. Higher frame rates and TE Fusion improve motion understanding, though substantial room remains.
2501.02955|v2.assessment: 为视频VLM细粒度运动理解提供了急需的评测基准与改进思路，对视频感知研究有参考价值。
2501.02955|v2.contribution: 提出MotionBench基准及TE Fusion方法，推动VLM细粒度运动理解评测与改进。
2501.02955|v2.innovation: 构建六类运动导向问题的综合基准，并提出高效的Through-Encoder融合。
2501.02955|v2.result: 现有VLM运动理解表现差；更高帧率与TE Fusion带来提升，但仍存在较大改进空间。

EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_cn: 论文提出EfficientLLaVA，面向大型视觉语言模型的通用自动剪枝方法（摘要缺失，依据标题推断）。针对LVLM参数量大、部署成本高的问题，探索可泛化的自动剪枝策略以压缩模型。相比手工设计的剪枝方案，强调通用性与自动化。具体方法与实验数据因摘要缺失无法详述。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_en: This paper proposes EfficientLLaVA, a generalizable auto-pruning approach for large vision-language models (abstract unavailable; inferred from title).
