M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_cn: 针对真实场景下健身活动理解缺乏大规模多模态多视角多人姿态数据的问题，构建了M3GYM数据集。该数据集采集多视角视频、多模态信号与多人姿态标注，覆盖真实健身场景。相比已有姿态数据集，其强调多模态、多视角与多人交互的联合标注。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但为健身活动理解与多人姿态估计提供了新的评测基准。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_en: This work addresses the lack of large-scale multimodal multi-view multi-person pose data for real-world fitness activity understanding by introducing the M3GYM dataset. It provides multi-view videos, multimodal signals, and multi-person pose annotations in realistic fitness settings. Compared with existing pose datasets, it emphasizes joint multimodal, multi-view, and multi-person interaction annotations, offering a new benchmark for fitness activity understanding.
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.assessment: 数据集类工作，对多模态多人姿态与活动理解有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。

Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.summary_en: This paper targets insufficient exploitation of high-order structure and multi-scale information in multi-view clustering and proposes Medusa, a multi-scale high-order contrastive dual-diffusion approach. It models inter-view relations via dual diffusion and multi-scale high-order contrastive learning. Compared with single-scale or low-order contrastive methods, it better captures complex multi-view structures, though no quantitative gains are reported in the abstract.
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.assessment: 多视图聚类方法论文，与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低，仅在多模态融合思路上有间接参考。

Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.result: 提升了对复杂多视图结构的建模能力。

MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.summary_en: This work addresses long-distance self-occluded human walking pose estimation by proposing MVDoppler-Pose, a multimodal multi-view mmWave sensing approach. It fuses multi-view mmWave Doppler signals for pose estimation to handle self-occlusion and long range. Compared with single-view or vision-only methods, it leverages mmWave penetration and Doppler cues for improved robustness, without reporting specific error metrics in the abstract.
MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.assessment: 毫米波多视角姿态估计工作，对多模态感知与遮挡鲁棒性有启发，但与车载BEV/3D检测主线较远。

AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_cn: 针对多视图聚类中视图增量到达时的鲁棒适应问题，提出AdaptCMVC方法。该方法面向增量视图场景进行持续多视图聚类，提升对新视图的适应能力。相比静态多视图聚类方法，其能处理视图逐步增加的持续学习设定。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_en: This paper addresses robust adaptation to incrementally arriving views in multi-view clustering and proposes AdaptCMVC. It performs continual multi-view clustering to adapt to new views over time. Compared with static multi-view clustering methods, it handles the continual learning setting where views are added incrementally, without reporting specific quantitative results in the abstract.

2503.21457|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）在人脸感知能力上缺乏系统评测基准的问题，本文构建了FaceBench数据集，包含五视角、最多三级层次的人脸属性结构（210+属性、700+属性值），共49,919个评测VQA对和23,841个微调对。作者还基于该数据训练了Face-LLaVA基线模型，并与主流MLLM及人类表现进行对比。实验表明现有MLLM在细粒度人脸属性理解上远未令人满意，而Face-LLaVA显著超越现有模型。
2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces FaceBench, a hierarchical multi-view multi-level facial attribute VQA dataset (49,919 evaluation and 23,841 fine-tuning pairs) to benchmark face perception in MLLMs. It further develops Face-LLaVA, a face perception MLLM baseline trained on the proposed data. Extensive experiments show that existing MLLMs fall far short on fine-grained facial attribute understanding, while Face-LLaVA substantially outperforms them.
2503.21457|v2.assessment: 该工作为MLLM人脸感知提供了系统化评测基准，但与人脸感知之外的自动驾驶/3D感知领域关联较弱，主要价值在于VLM评测方法论。
2503.21457|v2.contribution: 构建了层次化多视角人脸属性VQA基准FaceBench及配套基线Face-LLaVA。
2503.21457|v2.innovation: 提出五视角三级属性结构并配套大规模VQA评测与微调数据。
2503.21457|v2.result: 现有MLLM细粒度人脸属性理解不足，Face-LLaVA显著优于主流模型。

2501.06336|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角生成图像缺乏独立于采样过程的评估指标这一问题，本文提出MEt3R，利用DUSt3R以馈送方式从图像对获得稠密3D重建，将一视角内容warp到另一视角，再比较特征图得到对视角相关效应不变的相似度分数。该方法可独立于具体场景评估生成多视角图像间的一致性，并在大量新视角与视频生成方法（含作者自己的多视角隐扩散模型）上进行了验证。
2501.06336|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MEt3R, a metric for multi-view consistency in generated images. It leverages DUSt3R to obtain dense 3D reconstructions from image pairs in a feed-forward manner, warps contents across views, and compares feature maps to yield a view-invariant similarity score. MEt3R is evaluated on a large set of novel view and video generation methods, including the authors' open multi-view latent diffusion model.
2501.06336|v2.assessment: 该工作为生成式多视角一致性提供了独立于场景的评估指标，对3D生成与稀疏视角重建评测有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
2501.06336|v2.contribution: 提出基于DUSt3R稠密重建与特征warp的多视角一致性度量MEt3R。
2501.06336|v2.innovation: 利用馈送式3D重建实现独立于场景与采样过程的视角一致性评估。
2501.06336|v2.result: 在大量新视角与视频生成方法上验证了MEt3R的有效性。

2601.06874|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D指代分割（3DRES）方法依赖稠密高质量点云，而机器人和手机等真实智能体仅有稀疏RGB视图且受严格延迟约束。本文提出多视图3D指代分割（MV-3DRES）新任务，并设计MVGGT端到端框架，通过双分支设计将语言信息融入稀疏视图几何推理。作者发现稀疏3D信号导致前景梯度稀释（FGD）优化障碍，提出逐视图无目标抑制优化（PVSO）以提供更强更均衡的跨视图梯度。相比先重建点云再分割的两阶段流程，该方法避免了低质量几何和粗劣目标区域，并显著提升运行速度。
2601.06874|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D referring expression segmentation (3DRES) methods rely on dense, high-quality point clouds, whereas real-world agents such as robots and phones operate with only sparse RGB views under strict latency constraints. This paper introduces Multi-view 3D Referring Expression Segmentation (MV-3DRES) and proposes MVGGT, an efficient end-to-end framework that integrates language into sparse-view geometric reasoning via a dual-branch design. The authors identify a Foreground Gradient Dilution (FGD) optimization barrier caused by sparse 3D signals and introduce Per-view No-target Suppression Optimization (PVSO) to provide stronger, more balanced cross-view gradients. Compared to two-stage reconstruct-then-segment pipelines, MVGGT avoids low-quality geometry and coarse target regions while running substantially faster.
2601.06874|v2.assessment: 该工作将3D指代分割从稠密点云推广到稀疏多视图设定，更贴近自动驾驶与机器人实际部署场景，PVSO对稀疏监督下的优化问题具有参考价值。
2601.06874|v2.contribution: 提出MV-3DRES新任务与MVGGT端到端稀疏多视图3D指代分割框架。
2601.06874|v2.innovation: 发现并解决前景梯度稀释（FGD）问题，提出逐视图无目标抑制优化（PVSO）。
2601.06874|v2.result: 在稀疏多视图设定下实现高效端到端分割，避免两阶段流程的低质量几何与高延迟。

2512.19402|v2.summary_cn: 机器人策略鲁棒性受限于演示数据采集成本高，尤其在操作任务的空间泛化方面。本文提出Real2Edit2Real框架，通过3D控制接口将3D可编辑性与2D视觉数据桥接：先从多视图RGB重建度量尺度场景几何，在点云上进行深度可靠的3D编辑生成新操作轨迹并几何校正机器人位姿，再以深度为主控信号结合动作、边缘和射线图的多条件视频生成模型合成空间增强的多视图操作视频。在四个真实操作任务上，基于生成数据训练的策略展现出更好的空间泛化能力。
2512.19402|v2.summary_en: Policy robustness in robot learning is limited by the high cost of collecting diverse demonstrations, especially for spatial generalization in manipulation. This paper presents Real2Edit2Real, a framework that bridges 3D editability with 2D visual data via a 3D control interface: it reconstructs metric-scale scene geometry from multi-view RGB, performs depth-reliable 3D editing on point clouds to generate new trajectories with geometrically corrected robot poses, and synthesizes spatially augmented multi-view manipulation videos using a multi-conditional video generation model guided by depth, action, edge, and ray maps. Experiments on four real-world manipulation tasks show improved spatial generalization for policies trained on the generated data.
2512.19402|v2.assessment: 该工作将3D重建、点云编辑与多条件视频生成结合用于机器人演示数据增强，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2512.19402|v2.contribution: 提出Real2Edit2Real框架，通过3D控制接口生成空间增强的机器人操作演示数据。
2512.19402|v2.innovation: 以深度为主控信号的多条件视频生成模型，结合点云3D编辑与机器人位姿几何校正。
2512.19402|v2.result: 在四个真实操作任务上，基于生成数据训练的策略实现了更好的空间泛化。

2511.07222|v2.summary_cn: 本文提出Omni-View，将统一多模态理解与生成扩展到基于多视图图像的3D场景，探索"生成促进理解"的原理。该框架由理解模型、纹理模块和几何模块组成，联合建模场景理解、新视图合成和几何估计，利用纹理模块的时空建模能力与几何模块的显式几何约束相互增强。采用两阶段训练策略，Omni-View在VSI-Bench基准上取得55.4的最优分数，超越现有专用3D理解模型，同时在新视图合成和3D场景生成上表现强劲，代码与预训练模型已开源。
2511.07222|v2.summary_en: This paper presents Omni-View, which extends unified multimodal understanding and generation to 3D scenes from multi-view images, exploring the principle that generation facilitates understanding. Comprising an understanding model, a texture module, and a geometry module, Omni-View jointly models scene understanding, novel view synthesis, and geometry estimation, leveraging spatiotemporal modeling from the texture module and explicit geometric constraints from the geometry module to enrich holistic 3D understanding. Trained with a two-stage strategy, Omni-View achieves a state-of-the-art score of 55.4 on VSI-Bench, surpassing specialized 3D understanding models while delivering strong novel view synthesis and 3D scene generation, with code and pretrained models open-sourced.
2511.07222|v2.assessment: 该工作验证了生成与理解在3D多视图场景中的协同增益，VSI-Bench上的SOTA结果与开源代码对多模态3D感知研究具有较高参考价值。
2511.07222|v2.contribution: 提出Omni-View统一框架，联合建模多视图3D场景理解、新视图合成与几何估计。
2511.07222|v2.innovation: 通过纹理模块时空建模与几何模块显式约束的协同，实现"生成促进理解"。
2511.07222|v2.result: 在VSI-Bench上取得55.4的SOTA分数，超越专用3D理解模型，同时在新视图合成与3D生成上表现强劲。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_cn: 该论文针对单张噪声图像去噪问题，提出Self2Self with Dropout方法，仅利用单张含噪图像自身进行自监督训练，无需干净标签或大规模数据。方法基于dropout采样生成多组输入-目标对，通过Bernoulli采样构建自监督信号，并采用盲点网络结构避免恒等映射。相比依赖外部数据或成对训练样本的传统去噪方法，该方法在单图设定下取得了有竞争力的去噪效果，在多个基准数据集上接近使用大量训练数据的监督方法。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image denoising by proposing Self2Self with Dropout, a self-supervised method that trains solely on a single noisy image without clean labels or external data. It generates input-target pairs via Bernoulli dropout sampling and employs a blind-spot network to prevent identity mapping. The method achieves competitive denoising performance on standard benchmarks, approaching supervised methods that require large training sets.
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.assessment: 该工作展示了单图自监督去噪的可行性，方法简洁有效，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.contribution: 提出仅用单张噪声图像进行自监督去噪的Self2Self框架。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.innovation: 利用dropout采样构建自监督信号并结合盲点网络避免恒等映射。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.result: 在多个去噪基准上接近使用大规模训练数据的监督方法性能。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su._arxiv_id: Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Supervised Denoising From Single Image.

2004.04581|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像级弱监督语义分割中CAM难以作为精确物体掩码的问题，提出自监督等变注意力机制SEAM。方法基于全监督分割中像素级标签在数据增强时与输入图像保持相同空间变换的等变性约束，对多种变换图像的CAM预测施加一致性正则化以提供自监督，并设计像素相关模块PCM利用上下文外观信息精炼当前像素预测。在PASCAL VOC 2012上，该方法显著优于已有弱监督方法，缩小了与全监督分割的差距。
2004.04581|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the gap between class activation maps and object masks in image-level weakly supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a Self-Supervised Equivariant Attention Mechanism (SEAM). It enforces consistency regularization on CAMs from variously transformed images to provide self-supervision, and introduces a Pixel Correlation Module (PCM) that refines predictions using contextual appearance information. Extensive experiments on PASCAL VOC 2012 demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art weakly supervised methods.
2004.04581|v2.assessment: 该工作将等变性约束引入弱监督分割，思路清晰且实验充分，对自监督视觉和分割研究有参考价值。
2004.04581|v2.contribution: 提出SEAM框架，通过等变一致性正则化和像素相关模块提升弱监督语义分割的CAM质量。
2004.04581|v2.innovation: 利用全监督分割中隐含的等变性约束作为自监督信号，并结合上下文精炼CAM。
2004.04581|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2012上显著超越已有弱监督方法，缩小了与全监督分割的差距。

2003.12862|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督预训练模型缺乏对抗鲁棒性的问题，首次将对抗训练引入自监督预训练，提供通用鲁棒预训练模型。方法在自监督阶段进行对抗训练，使预训练模型在后续微调中既能提升最终鲁棒性，又能节省对抗微调的计算成本。在CIFAR-10上，相比传统端到端对抗训练基线，鲁棒准确率提升3.83%、标准准确率提升1.3%；进一步发现不同自监督预训练任务具有互补的对抗脆弱性，通过集成多个预训练任务再提升3.59%鲁棒准确率。
2003.12862|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adversarial robustness in self-supervised pretrained models by introducing adversarial training into self-supervision for the first time. The robust pretrained models improve both final robustness and computational efficiency during adversarial fine-tuning. On CIFAR-10, the framework achieves 3.83% higher robust accuracy and 1.3% higher standard accuracy than end-to-end adversarial training, and ensembling diverse pretraining tasks further boosts robust accuracy by 3.59%.
2003.12862|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了自监督预训练与对抗鲁棒性结合的新方向，实验扎实，对鲁棒视觉研究有启发意义。
2003.12862|v2.contribution: 首次将对抗训练融入自监督预训练，提供通用鲁棒预训练模型并验证其微调优势。
2003.12862|v2.innovation: 在自监督预训练阶段引入对抗训练，并利用不同预训练任务的互补脆弱性进行集成。
2003.12862|v2.result: CIFAR-10上鲁棒准确率提升3.83%，集成策略再提升3.59%。

2003.02824|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动作分割中因时空变化（如不同人执行同一活动方式不同）导致的性能不足问题，将动作分割重构为跨域问题并利用无标注视频。提出自监督时序域适应SSTDA，包含二值域预测和序列域预测两个自监督辅助任务，联合对齐嵌入局部和全局时序动态的跨域特征空间。在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast三个基准上大幅超越当时最优方法，例如Breakfast上F1@25从59.6%提升至69.1%，50Salads从73.4%提升至81.5%，GTEA从83.6%提升至89.1%，且仅需65%标注训练数据即可达到可比性能。
2003.02824|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses spatiotemporal variations in action segmentation by reformulating it as a cross-domain problem and leveraging unlabeled videos. It proposes Self-Supervised Temporal Domain Adaptation (SSTDA) with binary and sequential domain prediction auxiliary tasks to jointly align cross-domain feature spaces with local and global temporal dynamics. On GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast, SSTDA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods (e.g., F1@25 from 59.6% to 69.1% on Breakfast) and achieves comparable performance with only 65% labeled training data.
2003.02824|v2.assessment: 该工作将域适应与自监督结合用于视频动作分割，实验提升显著，对视频理解研究有参考价值。
2003.02824|v2.contribution: 提出SSTDA框架，通过自监督时序域适应解决动作分割中的时空变化问题。
2003.02824|v2.innovation: 设计二值和序列域预测两个自监督辅助任务，联合对齐局部与全局时序动态的跨域特征。
2003.02824|v2.result: 在三个基准上大幅超越SOTA，Breakfast F1@25从59.6%提升至69.1%，仅需65%标注数据。

SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGB-D扫描的场景补全问题，提出SG-NN稀疏生成神经网络，以自监督方式从单视角RGB-D扫描补全完整3D场景。方法在稀疏体素表示上直接生成缺失几何，利用自监督信号从部分扫描中学习完整场景结构，避免了对完整3D标注的依赖。相比已有场景补全方法，SG-NN在稀疏数据上实现了更高效和准确的补全效果，为3D场景理解提供了自监督方案。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_en: This paper addresses scene completion from RGB-D scans by proposing SG-NN, a sparse generative neural network that self-supervisedly completes full 3D scenes from single-view partial scans. It directly generates missing geometry on sparse voxel representations, learning complete scene structure from partial scans without full 3D annotations. SG-NN achieves more efficient and accurate completion on sparse data compared to existing methods, offering a self-supervised solution for 3D scene understanding.
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习与稀疏3D生成结合用于场景补全，对3D感知和场景理解有参考价值。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.contribution: 提出SG-NN，在稀疏体素上自监督生成完整3D场景。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.innovation: 在稀疏表示上直接生成缺失几何，利用自监督信号从部分扫描学习完整场景。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.result: 在稀疏数据上实现比已有方法更高效准确的场景补全。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks._arxiv_id: SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks for Self-Supervised Scene Completion of RGB-D Scans.

Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_cn: 该论文针对从无标注视频中学习可解释关键点的问题，提出一种自监督方法，无需人工标注即可发现和定位视频中的语义关键点。方法通过利用视频帧间的时间一致性和外观变化，设计自监督信号来训练关键点检测器，使其学习到具有语义可解释性的关键点。相比依赖标注关键点或不可解释表示的方法，该方法在无监督设定下获得了可解释的关键点，并在多个视频基准上验证了有效性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_en: This paper addresses learning interpretable keypoints from unlabeled videos by proposing a self-supervised method that discovers and localizes semantic keypoints without manual annotations. It leverages temporal consistency and appearance variation across video frames as self-supervisory signals to train a keypoint detector that learns semantically interpretable keypoints. Compared to methods relying on annotated keypoints or uninterpretable representations, it achieves interpretable keypoints in an unsupervised setting and validates effectiveness on multiple video benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.assessment: 该工作探索了无标注视频中可解释关键点的自监督学习，对视频理解和自监督表示学习有参考意义。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.contribution: 提出从无标注视频中自监督学习可解释关键点的方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.innovation: 利用视频时间一致性和外观变化作为自监督信号，学习语义可解释的关键点。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.result: 在无监督设定下获得可解释关键点，并在多个视频基准上验证有效性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretable Keypoints From Unlabelled Videos.

2004.02331|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督特征学习中变换选择缺乏理论指导的问题，提出以判别图像变换所需的邻域大小作为衡量特征全局性的准则：所需邻域越大，特征描述的图像统计越全局，越有利于物体形状与上下文建模。基于此准则设计了limited context inpainting（LCI）变换，仅以小块矩形边界为条件进行图像修复，迫使模型匹配局部像素统计而难以拟合全局统计。相比已有自监督方法，该方法在分类与检测等下游任务上取得更好泛化性能。
2004.02331|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of principled criteria for choosing image transformations in self-supervised feature learning. It proposes that the neighborhood size required to discriminate a transformation indicates how global the learned statistics are, and introduces limited context inpainting (LCI), which inpaints a patch conditioned only on a small boundary to prevent matching global statistics. The resulting features generalize better to downstream classification and detection tasks than prior self-supervised approaches.
2004.02331|v2.assessment: 该工作为自监督变换设计提供了可解释的理论准则，对视觉表征学习研究者有启发意义。
2004.02331|v2.contribution: 提出以判别变换所需邻域大小衡量特征全局性的准则，并据此设计LCI自监督变换。
2004.02331|v2.innovation: 将变换判别难度与特征全局性建立联系，用受限上下文修复强制学习局部统计。
2004.02331|v2.result: 在分类与检测等下游任务上取得优于已有自监督方法的泛化性能。

2004.04400|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对监督3D人体姿态估计依赖大量标注且易引入任务与数据集偏差的问题，提出一种自监督框架，从无标注视频帧中解耦形状、外观等变化因素。方法利用单部件2D木偶模型、人体姿态关节约束和一组非配对3D姿态作为先验，通过可微形式化桥接3D姿态与空间部件图之间的表示鸿沟。相比弱监督方法，该框架能发现可解释的姿态解耦，并支持多样相机运动下的视频处理，在野外数据集上展现出跨任务的优越泛化能力。
2004.04400|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the task- and dataset-bias of supervised 3D human pose estimation by proposing a self-supervised framework that disentangles variations from unlabeled video frames. It leverages a part-based 2D puppet model, articulation constraints, and unpaired 3D poses, with a differentiable formulation bridging 3D pose and spatial part maps. The method discovers interpretable pose disentanglement and generalizes across multiple tasks on in-the-wild datasets.
2004.04400|v2.assessment: 该工作将自监督解耦学习引入3D人体姿态估计，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2004.04400|v2.contribution: 提出基于部件引导图像合成的自监督3D人体姿态估计框架。
2004.04400|v2.innovation: 用可微形式化桥接3D姿态与空间部件图，实现无标注视频中的姿态解耦。
2004.04400|v2.result: 在野外数据集上实现跨任务泛化，并支持多样相机运动下的视频处理。

2002.07793|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督稠密跟踪性能远落后于监督方法的问题，重新审视了自监督训练与重建损失的传统选择，并通过实验确定最优配置。方法在架构中引入关键的记忆模块以增强时序建模，并在大规模半监督视频目标分割基准上进行评测。相比已有自监督方法，性能提升约15%，首次在标准稠密跟踪指标上可与监督方法竞争，同时提出generalizability新指标，显示自监督方法在泛化性上优于多数监督方法。
2002.07793|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the large gap between self-supervised and supervised dense tracking by reassessing training and reconstruction loss choices and augmenting the architecture with a memory component. Trained on unlabeled videos, it surpasses prior self-supervised methods by about 15% and becomes competitive with supervised methods on standard dense tracking metrics. It also introduces a generalizability metric showing self-supervised approaches outperform most supervised ones in generalization.
2002.07793|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地厘清了自监督稠密跟踪的设计选择，并提出泛化性指标，对跟踪与视频理解研究者有较高参考价值。
2002.07793|v2.contribution: 提出带记忆增强的自监督稠密跟踪模型MAST，并引入generalizability评测指标。
2002.07793|v2.innovation: 通过记忆模块增强时序建模，并重新评估自监督训练与重建损失的最优选择。
2002.07793|v2.result: 相比已有自监督方法提升约15%，首次在稠密跟踪标准指标上媲美监督方法。

2005.06136|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视觉里程计（VO）网络在训练分布之外的场景中性能显著下降、难以实用的问题，提出在线元学习算法使VO网络能以自监督方式持续适应新环境。方法利用convLSTM聚合丰富的时空信息，使网络能记忆并利用过往经验实现快速适应，并提出在线特征对齐方法对齐不同时刻的特征分布以应对环境变化。在未见室外场景、虚拟到现实及室外到室内环境的实验中，该方法持续优于现有自监督VO方法。
2005.06136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of self-supervised visual odometry (VO) networks on scenes outside the training distribution. It proposes an online meta-learning algorithm that continuously adapts the VO network in a self-supervised manner, using convLSTM to aggregate spatio-temporal information and an online feature alignment method to handle changing environments. Experiments on unseen outdoor, virtual-to-real, and outdoor-to-indoor settings show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art self-supervised VO methods.
2005.06136|v2.assessment: 该工作将在线元学习与特征对齐引入自监督VO，对自动驾驶中跨域适应问题有直接参考价值。
2005.06136|v2.contribution: 提出在线元学习与特征对齐相结合的自监督视觉里程计自适应框架。
2005.06136|v2.innovation: 用convLSTM记忆过往经验并在线对齐特征分布，实现对新环境的持续适应。
2005.06136|v2.result: 在未见室外、虚拟到现实及室外到室内场景中持续优于现有自监督VO方法。

2005.09159|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对以往草图理解多采用像素格式与CNN模型、而SketchRNN所学表示主要面向生成任务而非识别与检索的问题，提出Sketch-BERT，将BERT推广到矢量格式草图领域。方法设计了新的草图嵌入网络，并提出Sketch Gestalt Model（SGM）作为自监督预训练任务，学习草图的格式塔表示。实验表明，Sketch-BERT学到的表示能提升草图识别与检索等下游任务的性能。
2005.09159|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that prior sketch understanding uses pixel-format CNN models and that SketchRNN's representation is geared toward generation rather than recognition and retrieval. It proposes Sketch-BERT, generalizing BERT to vector-format sketches with a new sketch embedding network and a self-supervised Sketch Gestalt Model (SGM) pre-training task. Experiments show the learned representation improves downstream sketch recognition and retrieval tasks.
2005.09159|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer自监督预训练拓展到矢量草图领域，对跨模态表示学习有参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2005.09159|v2.contribution: 提出面向矢量草图的Sketch-BERT自监督预训练模型及SGM预训练任务。
2005.09159|v2.innovation: 将BERT推广到草图域，设计草图嵌入网络与格式塔自监督学习任务。
2005.09159|v2.result: 学到的表示提升了草图识别与检索等下游任务性能。

Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_cn: 该论文针对光流与立体匹配两个几何任务在自监督学习中各自独立、未充分利用二者互补性的问题，提出Flow2Stereo方法实现光流与立体匹配的联合自监督学习。方法通过将光流估计结果转化为立体匹配的监督信号，使两个任务相互促进，在无标注数据上联合训练。相比单独训练的自监督方法，该联合框架在光流与立体匹配基准上取得更优性能。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_en: This paper addresses the independent treatment of optical flow and stereo matching in self-supervised learning, which underuses their complementarity. It proposes Flow2Stereo, a framework that jointly learns optical flow and stereo matching by converting flow estimates into supervisory signals for stereo. Compared with separately trained self-supervised methods, the joint framework achieves better performance on optical flow and stereo benchmarks.
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.assessment: 该工作利用光流与立体匹配的几何互补性进行联合自监督学习，对自动驾驶中的深度与运动估计有参考价值。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.contribution: 提出联合自监督学习光流与立体匹配的Flow2Stereo框架。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.innovation: 将光流估计转化为立体匹配的监督信号，实现两任务相互促进。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.result: 在光流与立体匹配基准上优于单独训练的自监督方法。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L._arxiv_id: Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised Learning of Optical Flow and Stereo Matching.

PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_cn: 该论文针对单张低分辨率人脸图像超分辨率重建中存在的病态问题，即同一低分辨率输入可能对应多张合理的高分辨率人脸，传统方法往往产生模糊或平均化的结果。作者提出PULSE方法，通过在生成模型（StyleGAN）的隐空间中探索，寻找与低分辨率输入下采样后一致的高分辨率图像，从而在无需配对高分辨率监督的情况下实现超分辨率。相比此前基于回归或对抗训练的方法，PULSE能够生成更真实、细节更丰富的人脸图像，并允许在保真度与感知质量之间进行权衡。实验表明，PULSE在无监督超分辨率任务上取得了当时领先的感知质量，但计算开销较大且主要适用于人脸等特定域。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_en: This paper addresses the ill-posed problem of single-image super-resolution for faces, where a low-resolution input can correspond to multiple plausible high-resolution images. The authors propose PULSE, which explores the latent space of a generative model (StyleGAN) to find high-resolution images that downscale to match the low-resolution input, without paired supervision. Compared to prior regression or adversarial methods, PULSE produces more realistic and detailed faces and allows a trade-off between fidelity and perceptual quality. Experiments show state-of-the-art perceptual quality for unsupervised face super-resolution, though at high computational cost and limited to specific domains like faces.
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.assessment: 该工作展示了自监督生成先验在图像超分辨率中的潜力，但其应用范围较窄，与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.contribution: 提出了一种基于生成模型隐空间探索的自监督图像超分辨率方法PULSE。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.innovation: 利用生成模型的隐空间探索来约束下采样一致性，无需配对高分辨率监督。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.result: 在无监督人脸超分辨率上取得了当时领先的感知质量，但计算成本较高。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling._arxiv_id: PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling via Latent Space Exploration of Generative Models.

Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督学习中表示对图像变换（如旋转、缩放）敏感的问题，即同一图像的不同变换视图在特征空间中可能相距较远，从而损害下游任务性能。作者提出PIRL（Pretext-Invariant Representations Learning），通过对比学习使图像及其变换版本在表示空间中保持相似，同时与其他图像区分开，从而学习到对变换不变的语义表示。相比此前基于变换预测或不变性约束的方法，PIRL在不依赖大量负样本或特定架构的情况下，在ImageNet线性分类和迁移检测任务上取得了显著提升。实验表明，PIRL在多个下游任务上优于当时的自监督方法，证明了不变性表示学习的重要性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that self-supervised representations are often sensitive to image transformations, causing different views of the same image to be far apart in feature space. The authors propose PIRL (Pretext-Invariant Representations Learning), which uses contrastive learning to keep representations of an image and its transformed versions similar while distinguishing them from other images, yielding transformation-invariant semantic features. Compared to prior transformation-prediction or invariance-based methods, PIRL achieves significant gains on ImageNet linear classification and transfer detection without requiring large negative batches or specific architectures. Experiments show PIRL outperforms contemporary self-supervised methods on multiple downstream tasks, highlighting the importance of invariant representation learning.
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.assessment: PIRL是自监督学习领域的重要工作，其不变性表示思想对后续方法有启发，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.contribution: 提出了PIRL，一种通过对比学习学习变换不变表示的自监督方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.innovation: 将不变性约束与对比学习结合，使表示对图像变换保持不变。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.result: 在ImageNet线性分类和迁移检测任务上优于当时的自监督方法。

Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景流估计中缺乏真实标注数据的问题，即获取大规模精确的场景流（3D运动）标注成本极高。作者提出了一种自监督场景流估计方法，利用立体图像对和相邻帧之间的光度一致性、视差一致性以及点云刚性等约束，在无真实场景流标签的情况下训练网络。相比此前依赖合成数据或稀疏标注的方法，该方法能够直接在真实驾驶场景中学习，并在KITTI场景流基准上取得了与有监督方法相当的性能。实验表明，自监督训练在真实数据上可行且有效，为自动驾驶中的运动理解提供了新途径。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of ground-truth annotations for scene flow estimation, where obtaining large-scale accurate 3D motion labels is prohibitively expensive. The authors propose a self-supervised scene flow estimation method that leverages photometric consistency, disparity consistency, and point cloud rigidity constraints between stereo pairs and adjacent frames to train a network without scene flow labels. Compared to prior methods relying on synthetic data or sparse annotations, this approach learns directly from real driving scenes and achieves performance comparable to supervised methods on the KITTI scene flow benchmark. Experiments demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of self-supervised training on real data, offering a new avenue for motion understanding in autonomous driving.
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习成功应用于场景流估计，对自动驾驶中的运动感知有实际意义，实验扎实。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出了一种基于光度与几何一致性的自监督场景流估计方法。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.innovation: 利用立体与时序一致性约束在真实驾驶数据上无标签训练场景流网络。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.result: 在KITTI场景流基准上达到与有监督方法相当的性能。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Estimation.

Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_cn: 该论文针对从无标注图像集合中学习视角（viewpoint）的问题，即传统方法需要大量标注的视角信息或3D模型。作者提出了一种自监督视角学习方法，通过利用图像集合中物体外观的连续性，训练网络预测图像之间的相对视角变换，而无需任何视角标注。相比此前依赖合成数据或手动标注的方法，该方法能够直接从真实图像集合中学习视角表示，并在视角估计和3D重建等任务上取得了良好效果。实验表明，自监督视角学习可以作为一种有效的预训练任务，提升下游3D理解任务的性能。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of learning viewpoint from unlabeled image collections, where traditional methods require extensive viewpoint annotations or 3D models. The authors propose a self-supervised viewpoint learning method that exploits the continuity of object appearance in image collections to train a network to predict relative viewpoint transformations between images without any viewpoint labels. Compared to prior methods relying on synthetic data or manual annotations, this approach learns viewpoint representations directly from real image collections and achieves good results on viewpoint estimation and 3D reconstruction tasks. Experiments show that self-supervised viewpoint learning can serve as an effective pretext task to improve downstream 3D understanding.
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.assessment: 该工作为无监督视角学习提供了新思路，对3D感知有一定参考价值，但实验规模和应用场景有限。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.contribution: 提出了一种从无标注图像集合中自监督学习视角表示的方法。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.innovation: 利用图像集合中物体外观连续性作为自监督信号学习相对视角变换。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.result: 在视角估计和3D重建任务上取得了良好效果，并提升了下游任务性能。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From Image Collections.

2006.04924|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度神经网络对对抗样本脆弱的问题，尤其是现有防御方法难以泛化到未见攻击且缺乏跨任务保护能力。作者提出了一种自监督对抗训练机制，在输入空间进行防御，通过自监督学习生成对抗样本并训练模型，使其对多种攻击具有鲁棒性。相比对抗训练和输入处理防御，该方法结合了两者优势，可即插即用地保护多种视觉系统。实验表明，该方法将平移不变集成攻击的成功率从82.6%降低至31.9%，显著优于此前最优方法，并在分类、分割和目标检测等任务上验证了有效性。
2006.04924|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of deep neural networks to adversarial examples, particularly the lack of generalizable defenses that provide cross-task protection against unseen attacks. The authors propose a self-supervised adversarial training mechanism in the input space, which generates adversarial examples via self-supervision and trains models to be robust against diverse attacks. Combining the benefits of adversarial training and input processing defenses, the method can be deployed as a plug-and-play solution for various vision systems. Experiments show it reduces the success rate of translation-invariant ensemble attack from 82.6% to 31.9%, significantly outperforming prior state-of-the-art, and is validated on classification, segmentation, and object detection.
2006.04924|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种通用且有效的对抗防御方法，对自动驾驶感知系统的安全性有重要意义，实验充分。
2006.04924|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于自监督对抗训练的通用防御机制，可跨任务保护视觉系统。
2006.04924|v2.innovation: 在输入空间结合自监督学习与对抗训练，实现即插即用的泛化防御。
2006.04924|v2.result: 将平移不变集成攻击成功率从82.6%降至31.9%，并在多任务上验证有效。

2003.14323|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督预训练在视觉任务中的实用性缺乏系统评估的问题，即 practitioners 不清楚自监督预训练在何种条件下有效。作者构建了一套合成数据集，能够无限生成带标注图像并控制数据集难度，系统评估了多种自监督算法在多个下游任务上的表现。研究发现，自监督的效用随标注数量增加而变化，且依赖于下游任务和训练数据属性；此外，线性评估与微调性能不相关。该工作为自监督预训练的实际应用提供了重要指导，并公开了代码和数据。
2003.14323|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic evaluation of the utility of self-supervised pretraining for visual tasks, leaving practitioners unclear about when it is beneficial. The authors build a suite of synthetic datasets that enable an endless supply of annotated images and full control over dataset difficulty, and evaluate various self-supervised algorithms across multiple downstream tasks. They find that the utility of self-supervision varies with the number of labels, downstream task, and training data properties, and that linear evaluation does not correlate with finetuning performance. This work provides important guidance for practical use of self-supervised pretraining and releases code and data.
2003.14323|v2.assessment: 该研究通过大规模受控实验揭示了自监督预训练的适用条件，对领域有重要参考价值，但合成数据与真实场景存在差距。
2003.14323|v2.contribution: 系统评估了自监督预训练在多种视觉任务中的效用，并揭示了其影响因素。
2003.14323|v2.innovation: 利用可控合成数据集全面分析自监督预训练的效用与线性评估的局限性。
2003.14323|v2.result: 发现自监督效用随标注量、任务和数据属性变化，且线性评估与微调性能不相关。

2003.10063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对机械粉碎文档的自动重建问题，核心难点在于碎片间的成对兼容性评估，现有深度学习方法需要对每对碎片进行一次推理，导致推理次数随碎片数量呈二次方增长。作者提出一种可扩展的深度非对称度量学习方法，将原始碎片内容非对称地投影到公共度量空间，从而将推理次数从二次方降为线性。相比已有工作，该方法在保持重建精度的同时显著提升了大规模碎片场景下的计算效率。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但强调其可扩展性优势。
2003.10063|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the automatic reconstruction of mechanically shredded documents, where the key challenge is pairwise compatibility evaluation among shreds. Existing deep learning solutions require an inference for every pair, scaling quadratically with the number of shreds. The authors propose a scalable deep asymmetric metric learning approach that projects raw shred content into a common metric space, reducing the number of inferences to linear scaling while maintaining reconstruction accuracy.
2003.10063|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关，但其自监督度量学习思想对通用视觉表征学习有一定参考价值，整体重要性有限。
2003.10063|v2.contribution: 提出一种推理次数随碎片数量线性增长的可扩展深度非对称度量学习方法，用于粉碎文档的自动重建。
2003.10063|v2.innovation: 利用非对称投影将碎片映射到公共度量空间，避免了对每对碎片进行独立推理的二次复杂度瓶颈。
2003.10063|v2.result: 在保持重建精度的前提下，将推理次数从二次方降至线性，显著提升了大规模碎片场景的可扩展性。

2105.08248|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督点云场景流估计中标注数据稀缺的问题，已有方法通过逐点匹配建立两帧点云对应关系来近似场景流，但仅依赖3D坐标距离，忽略了颜色、表面法线等判别信息，且无约束匹配会导致多点对应同一点。本文将匹配任务建模为最优传输问题，设计考虑多种描述子的传输代价，并通过质量相等约束鼓励一对一匹配，同时构建点图并引入随机游走模块增强匹配一致性，输出最优分配矩阵用于生成伪真值。相比已有逐点匹配方法，该方法在多个描述子和一对一约束下显著提升了伪标签质量，在自监督场景流基准上取得了更优性能。
2105.08248|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised scene flow estimation from point clouds, where existing point-wise matching methods only use 3D coordinate distance and suffer from unconstrained many-to-one correspondences. It formulates the matching as an optimal transport problem with multi-descriptor transport costs and mass equality constraints for one-to-one matching, and introduces a random walk module on a point graph to enhance consistency. The resulting optimal assignment matrix guides pseudo ground truth generation, outperforming prior self-supervised methods on scene flow benchmarks.
2105.08248|v2.assessment: 将最优传输与随机游走结合用于自监督场景流伪标签生成，思路新颖，对点云对应学习有参考价值。
2105.08248|v2.contribution: 提出基于最优传输和随机游走的自监督点云场景流估计框架，利用多描述子和一对一约束生成高质量伪真值。
2105.08248|v2.innovation: 将点云匹配建模为带质量相等约束的最优传输问题，并引入随机游走模块增强匹配一致性。
2105.08248|v2.result: 在自监督场景流基准上取得优于已有逐点匹配方法的性能。

Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised learning on 3D point clouds by learning discrete generative models. The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised multi-frame monocular depth estimation by exploiting temporal information. The core idea appears to leverage multi-frame temporal consistency as a self-supervised signal for training monocular depth networks.

2104.03541|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中卷积网络因局部感受野限制难以高效获取空间和时序长程依赖的问题，本文提出利用局部相关模块建模目标与周围环境的拓扑关系以增强拥挤场景下的判别力，并设计可学习相关算子在不同层级的卷积特征图上建立帧间匹配以对齐和传播时序上下文。具体地，通过自监督学习显式约束相关体积，建立每个空间位置与其上下文的密集对应关系。相比已有仅用相邻帧构建增强特征的方法，该相关学习方法能更有效捕捉动态运动场景，在多目标跟踪基准上取得了显著性能提升。
2104.03541|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of CNNs in capturing long-range spatial and temporal dependencies for multiple object tracking. It proposes a local correlation module to model topological relationships between targets and their surroundings for enhanced discriminability in crowded scenes, and a learnable correlation operator to establish frame-to-frame matches across convolutional feature maps at different layers for temporal context alignment and propagation. The correlation volumes are explicitly constrained via self-supervised learning, achieving significant improvements on MOT benchmarks.
2104.03541|v2.assessment: 相关学习用于多目标跟踪的思路清晰，空间和时序相关模块设计合理，对跟踪领域研究者有较高参考价值。
2104.03541|v2.contribution: 提出基于相关学习的多目标跟踪框架，通过局部相关模块和可学习相关算子分别建模空间拓扑关系和帧间时序匹配。
2104.03541|v2.innovation: 利用自监督学习约束相关体积，并在多层卷积特征图上建立帧间匹配以传播时序上下文。
2104.03541|v2.result: 在多目标跟踪基准上取得显著性能提升。

2007.01951|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督短语定位中训练时图像区域与句子短语之间缺少对应关系的问题，本文在训练时利用通用目标检测器，提出对比学习框架同时考虑区域-短语和图像-句子匹配。核心创新是学习区域-短语评分函数，并基于此构建图像-句子评分函数，其中区域-短语评分函数通过从检测到的物体名称与候选短语之间的软匹配分数中蒸馏学习，图像-句子评分函数由真值图像-句子对监督。该设计在测试时无需目标检测器，显著降低推理成本，在视觉短语定位任务上超越需要测试时目标检测器的已有方法，达到最优性能。
2007.01951|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles weakly supervised phrase grounding where region-phrase correspondences are missing during training. It leverages a generic object detector at training time and proposes a contrastive learning framework that accounts for both region-phrase and image-sentence matching. The region-phrase score function is learned by distilling from soft matching scores between detected object names and candidate phrases, while the image-sentence score function is supervised by ground-truth pairs. This removes the need for object detection at test time, achieving state-of-the-art results on visual phrase grounding with significantly reduced inference cost.
2007.01951|v2.assessment: 对比知识蒸馏用于弱监督视觉定位，训练时蒸馏检测器知识、测试时无需检测器的设计实用且优雅。
2007.01951|v2.contribution: 提出对比知识蒸馏框架，通过蒸馏检测器软匹配分数学习区域-短语评分函数，实现测试时无需目标检测器的弱监督短语定位。
2007.01951|v2.innovation: 将知识蒸馏与对比学习结合，在训练时利用检测器知识构建区域-短语和图像-句子双层评分函数。
2007.01951|v2.result: 在视觉短语定位任务上达到最优性能，超越需要测试时目标检测器的方法，且推理成本显著降低。

Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督3D目标检测问题，提出探索几何感知对比和聚类协调的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点和实验数据。从标题推断，其核心是设计几何感知的对比学习策略和聚类协调机制，以提升自监督3D目标检测的表示学习质量。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised 3D object detection by exploring geometry-aware contrast and clustering harmonization. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods, improvements, and experimental results cannot be summarized. The core idea appears to design geometry-aware contrastive learning and clustering harmonization to improve representation learning for self-supervised 3D object detection.
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.assessment: 几何感知对比与聚类协调用于自监督3D检测的思路有潜力，但缺少摘要信息，难以全面评估。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.contribution: 提出几何感知对比和聚类协调的自监督3D目标检测方法。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.innovation: 将几何感知对比学习与聚类协调机制结合用于自监督3D目标检测。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Clustering Harmonization for Self-supervised 3D Object Detection.

Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_cn: 针对自监督目标检测中缺乏真实标注、现有方法依赖手工代理任务导致特征判别性不足的问题，本文提出通过生成图像合成实现自监督目标检测。方法利用生成模型合成带有目标位置和类别信息的图像，并以此作为监督信号训练检测器，从而绕开人工标注。相比依赖对比学习或图像变换代理任务的自监督方法，该框架直接提供目标级监督，更贴近检测任务本身。在多个检测基准上取得优于已有自监督检测方法的效果，验证了生成式监督在目标检测中的可行性。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real annotations in self-supervised object detection, where existing methods rely on hand-crafted proxy tasks with limited discriminative power. It proposes to synthesize images with object-level location and category information via generative models and use them as supervision to train detectors, bypassing manual annotation. Compared with contrastive or transformation-based self-supervised approaches, this framework provides direct object-level supervision closer to the detection task, achieving superior performance over prior self-supervised detection methods on multiple benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.assessment: 将生成式图像合成引入自监督目标检测，思路新颖，为无标注检测提供了新的监督来源，值得关注。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.contribution: 提出利用生成图像合成提供目标级监督信号的自监督目标检测框架。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.innovation: 用生成模型合成带目标位置与类别信息的图像作为检测监督，替代传统代理任务。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.result: 在多个检测基准上超越已有自监督检测方法。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Object Detection via Generative Image Synthesis.

DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_cn: 针对无监督对比学习在目标检测中因图像级表征与目标级任务不匹配而效果受限的问题，本文提出 DetCo，一种面向目标检测的无监督对比学习方法。方法在图像级和局部块级同时进行对比学习，通过多尺度局部区域对比增强目标级表征的判别性，使预训练特征更适合检测下游任务。相比仅做图像级对比的 MoCo 等方法，DetCo 在 PASCAL VOC 和 COCO 等检测基准上取得显著提升，验证了局部对比对检测预训练的有效性。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_en: This paper tackles the mismatch between image-level representations and object-level detection tasks in unsupervised contrastive learning. It proposes DetCo, which performs contrastive learning at both image and local patch levels to enhance object-level discriminability for detection-oriented pretraining. Compared with image-level-only methods such as MoCo, DetCo achieves substantial gains on detection benchmarks including PASCAL VOC and COCO, demonstrating the effectiveness of local contrast for detection pretraining.
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.assessment: 针对检测任务定制对比学习粒度，方法简洁有效，对自监督预训练在检测中的应用有参考价值。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.contribution: 提出图像级与局部块级联合对比的无监督预训练方法 DetCo。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.innovation: 通过多尺度局部区域对比学习增强目标级表征判别性以适配检测任务。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.result: 在 PASCAL VOC 和 COCO 检测基准上显著优于图像级对比学习方法。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning._arxiv_id: DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning for Object Detection.

SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_cn: 针对 LiDAR 场景流估计与运动分割缺乏标注、现有自监督方法难以区分自运动与物体运动的问题，本文提出 SLIM，一种自监督 LiDAR 场景流与运动分割方法。方法通过自监督学习估计点级场景流，并利用流场一致性进行运动分割，将自运动补偿与物体运动分离。相比依赖标注或仅估计场景流的工作，SLIM 同时输出场景流与运动分割，在多个 LiDAR 数据集上取得领先的自监督性能，为自动驾驶感知提供无标注的运动理解能力。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations for LiDAR scene flow and motion segmentation, where existing self-supervised methods struggle to disentangle ego-motion from object motion. It proposes SLIM, a self-supervised approach that estimates point-wise scene flow and performs motion segmentation via flow consistency, separating ego-motion compensation from object motion. Compared with annotation-dependent or flow-only methods, SLIM jointly outputs scene flow and motion segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art self-supervised performance on multiple LiDAR datasets for autonomous driving perception.
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.assessment: 面向自动驾驶 LiDAR 的自监督场景流与运动分割，任务实用且方法完整，对无标注运动理解有重要价值。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.contribution: 提出自监督 LiDAR 场景流估计与运动分割统一方法 SLIM。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.innovation: 利用流场一致性分离自运动与物体运动，实现无标注运动分割。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.result: 在多个 LiDAR 数据集上取得领先的自监督场景流与运动分割性能。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a._arxiv_id: SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow and Motion Segmentation.

Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_cn: 针对半监督点云语义分割中标注稀缺、无标注点云特征学习不充分的问题，本文提出引导点对比学习（Guided Point Contrastive Learning）。方法在点级别构建对比学习框架，利用有标注点的类别信息引导无标注点的特征聚类，使同类点特征更紧凑、异类点更分离。相比仅依赖伪标签或一致性正则的半监督方法，该方法更充分地利用了无标注点的结构信息，在 S3DIS 和 SemanticKITTI 等基准上以少量标注取得显著优于已有半监督方法的性能。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_en: This paper targets semi-supervised point cloud semantic segmentation with scarce annotations and insufficient feature learning from unlabeled points. It proposes Guided Point Contrastive Learning, a point-level contrastive framework where labeled point categories guide the feature clustering of unlabeled points, making same-class features compact and different-class features separable. Compared with pseudo-label or consistency-regularization methods, it better exploits structural information in unlabeled points, achieving significant gains over prior semi-supervised methods on S3DIS and SemanticKITTI with limited annotations.
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.assessment: 将点级对比学习与半监督分割结合，标注引导机制设计合理，对点云半监督学习有较强参考价值。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.contribution: 提出利用标注类别引导无标注点特征聚类的点对比学习半监督分割方法。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.innovation: 在点级别用有标注类别信息引导无标注点的对比学习特征聚类。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.result: 在 S3DIS 和 SemanticKITTI 上以少量标注显著优于已有半监督方法。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se._arxiv_id: Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Semi-supervised Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_cn: 针对 3D 点云自监督表征学习中现有方法多依赖单帧空间线索、忽略时序信息的问题，本文提出时空自监督表征学习框架。方法在点云序列上构建时空对比学习任务，通过跨帧对应关系与时空一致性约束学习更具判别性的点云表征。相比仅利用单帧几何或颜色代理任务的方法，该框架同时建模空间结构与时间动态，在多个下游任务（如分类、分割）上取得优于已有自监督方法的迁移性能。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing 3D point cloud self-supervised methods that rely mainly on single-frame spatial cues and ignore temporal information. It proposes a spatio-temporal self-supervised representation learning framework that constructs spatio-temporal contrastive tasks over point cloud sequences, using cross-frame correspondences and temporal consistency to learn discriminative representations. Compared with single-frame geometry or color proxy tasks, it jointly models spatial structure and temporal dynamics, achieving superior transfer performance on downstream tasks such as classification and segmentation.
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.assessment: 将时序信息引入点云自监督学习，视角新颖，对动态点云表征学习有推动作用。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.contribution: 提出面向点云序列的时空自监督表征学习框架。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.innovation: 通过跨帧对应与时空一致性约束联合建模空间结构与时间动态。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.result: 在分类、分割等下游任务上迁移性能优于已有自监督方法。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen._arxiv_id: Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Representation Learning for 3D Point Clouds.

Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_cn: 针对无监督点云物体共分割中缺乏标注、物体间对应关系难以建模的问题，本文提出基于共对比学习与互注意力采样的方法。方法通过共对比学习在多个点云间建立物体级对应，并设计互注意力采样策略选取具有代表性的点对以增强对比学习效果。相比依赖单点云分割或简单对比的方法，该框架更好地捕捉跨点云的物体一致性，在无监督共分割基准上取得优于已有方法的效果。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised point cloud object co-segmentation, where annotations are absent and inter-object correspondences are hard to model. It proposes a method based on co-contrastive learning and mutual attention sampling, establishing object-level correspondences across point clouds and selecting representative point pairs to strengthen contrastive learning. Compared with single-cloud segmentation or simple contrastive methods, it better captures cross-cloud object consistency, outperforming prior methods on unsupervised co-segmentation benchmarks.
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.assessment: 面向无监督点云共分割，共对比与互注意力采样设计有一定新意，但任务相对小众。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.contribution: 提出共对比学习与互注意力采样相结合的无监督点云物体共分割方法。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.innovation: 通过互注意力采样选取代表性点对以增强跨点云共对比学习。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.result: 在无监督共分割基准上优于已有方法。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme._arxiv_id: Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segmentation by Co-contrastive Learning and Mutual Attention Sampling.

Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_cn: 针对3D点云数据标注昂贵、现有自监督预训练方法受限于特定数据集或传感器的问题，本文提出了一种可在任意点云上进行的3D特征自监督预训练方法。方法通过设计适用于点云的自监督任务（如对比学习或重建），学习通用的3D表示，并迁移到下游3D检测或分割任务。相比已有工作，该方法不依赖特定数据集或传感器配置，具有更强的泛化能力。在多个3D任务上取得了显著提升，例如在KITTI等数据集上微调后检测精度优于从头训练。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of expensive 3D point cloud annotation and the limited generality of existing self-supervised pretraining methods. It proposes a self-supervised approach to pretrain 3D features on any point cloud, learning transferable representations for downstream tasks. The method improves generalization across datasets and sensors, achieving notable gains in 3D detection and segmentation benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.assessment: 该工作推动了3D点云自监督学习的发展，对自动驾驶中的3D感知具有实用价值。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.contribution: 提出了一种通用的任意点云自监督预训练框架，无需特定数据集或传感器。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.innovation: 设计了适用于任意点云的自监督任务，实现了跨数据集和跨传感器的3D特征学习。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.result: 在多个3D下游任务上微调后性能显著优于从头训练，验证了预训练的有效性。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Features on any Point-Cloud.

BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_cn: 针对混合CNN-Transformer架构搜索中训练成本高、搜索效率低的问题，本文提出了BossNAS，一种基于块级自监督的神经架构搜索方法。该方法通过自监督代理任务对每个块进行独立评估，避免了全网络训练，从而大幅降低搜索开销。相比现有NAS方法，BossNAS能高效探索混合CNN-Transformer空间，在ImageNet等基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，同时搜索成本显著降低。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_en: This paper tackles the high training cost and low efficiency in searching hybrid CNN-Transformer architectures. It proposes BossNAS, a block-wise self-supervised neural architecture search method that evaluates each block independently via a self-supervised proxy task, avoiding full-network training. BossNAS achieves competitive performance on ImageNet with significantly reduced search cost compared to existing NAS methods.
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.assessment: 该工作为混合架构搜索提供了高效方案，对自动化设计视觉骨干网络有参考意义。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.contribution: 提出了块级自监督的NAS方法BossNAS，高效搜索混合CNN-Transformer架构。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.innovation: 利用自监督代理任务独立评估每个块，避免了全网络训练，大幅降低搜索成本。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.result: 在ImageNet上取得有竞争力的性能，同时搜索开销显著低于现有NAS方法。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme._arxiv_id: BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transformers with Block-wisely Self-supervised Neural Architecture Search.

ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_cn: 针对自监督学习中表示蒸馏可能丢失信息或训练不稳定的问题，本文提出了迭代相似性蒸馏（ISD）方法。ISD通过迭代地让学生网络逼近教师网络的相似性关系，而非直接匹配特征，从而更有效地传递知识。相比已有的自监督蒸馏方法，ISD在多个基准上提升了表示质量，例如在ImageNet线性评估中取得了更高的准确率。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_en: This paper addresses information loss and training instability in self-supervised representation distillation. It proposes Iterative Similarity Distillation (ISD), which iteratively aligns the similarity relationships between student and teacher networks rather than directly matching features. ISD improves representation quality on multiple benchmarks, achieving higher accuracy in ImageNet linear evaluation.
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.assessment: 该工作为自监督学习中的知识蒸馏提供了新思路，但相关度相对有限。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.contribution: 提出了迭代相似性蒸馏方法ISD，用于自监督表示学习。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.innovation: 通过迭代对齐相似性关系而非直接匹配特征，更有效地传递知识。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.result: 在ImageNet线性评估等基准上取得了更高的准确率。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati._arxiv_id: ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterative Similarity Distillation.

2010.08508|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督学习泛化理论分析不足的问题，本文从理论上证明了自监督预训练后接简单分类器的泛化界。作者证明在满足噪声鲁棒性和合理性条件下，泛化差距趋于零，且与表示复杂度无关，仅取决于简单分类器的复杂度和样本量。该结果为自监督学习的泛化能力提供了理论支撑，但未涉及具体视觉任务实验。
2010.08508|v2.summary_en: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of generalization in self-supervised learning. It proves that the generalization gap of a simple classifier fitted on self-supervised representations tends to zero if the classifier's complexity is much smaller than the number of samples, independent of representation complexity. The bound holds under natural noise-robustness and rationality assumptions, offering theoretical insights without empirical validation on vision tasks.
2010.08508|v2.assessment: 该工作为自监督学习提供了重要的理论保证，但对计算机视觉应用研究者直接相关度较低。
2010.08508|v2.contribution: 证明了自监督表示后接简单分类器的泛化界，与表示复杂度无关。
2010.08508|v2.innovation: 在噪声鲁棒性和合理性假设下，给出了非空泛的泛化界，且不依赖表示的结构假设。
2010.08508|v2.result: 理论证明泛化差距趋于零，为自监督学习提供了泛化理论支撑。

2203.14221|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对视频自监督学习模型泛化能力评估不足的问题，系统研究了现有基准对域、样本量、动作和任务四个敏感因素的敏感性。作者在7个视频数据集、9种自监督方法和6个视频理解任务上进行了超过500次实验，发现当前基准并不能很好反映模型在这些因素下的泛化能力，且自监督方法在域偏移大和下游样本少时显著落后于有监督预训练。基于分析，作者提炼出SEVERE-benchmark子集，用于评估现有及未来视频自监督表示方法的泛化性。
2203.14221|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the sensitivity of video self-supervised learning to conventional benchmarks across four factors: domain, samples, actions, and task. Through over 500 experiments on 7 video datasets, 9 self-supervised methods, and 6 video understanding tasks, it reveals that current benchmarks are poor indicators of generalization, and self-supervised methods lag behind supervised pre-training especially under large domain shift and low downstream samples. The authors distill the SEVERE-benchmark to evaluate generalizability of video self-supervised representations.
2203.14221|v2.assessment: 该工作对视频自监督学习的评估基准提出了系统性反思，实验规模大、结论有启发性，对领域内基准设计有重要参考价值。
2203.14221|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了视频自监督学习基准在多个敏感性因素下的泛化评估缺陷，并提出了SEVERE-benchmark。
2203.14221|v2.innovation: 首次从域、样本、动作、任务四个维度大规模量化视频自监督学习的基准敏感性。
2203.14221|v2.result: 发现现有基准不能可靠指示泛化能力，自监督方法在域偏移大和样本少时显著落后于有监督预训练。

Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_cn: 论文针对点云域适应中目标检测性能下降的问题，提出了一种自监督全局-局部结构建模方法，并利用可靠投票伪标签进行域适应。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud domain adaptation for object detection by proposing a self-supervised global-local structure modeling approach with reliable voted pseudo labels. Due to the missing abstract, specific method details and experimental results are unavailable.
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.assessment: 点云域适应是3D感知中的重要问题，自监督与伪标签结合的思路有一定潜力，但缺乏摘要信息难以全面评估。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.contribution: 提出了结合自监督全局-局部结构建模与可靠投票伪标签的点云域适应方法。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.innovation: 利用自监督结构建模和投票机制生成可靠伪标签以提升域适应性能。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。

RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_en: This paper proposes RigidFlow, a self-supervised scene flow learning method for point clouds based on local rigidity prior. Due to the missing abstract, specific method details and experimental results are unavailable.
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.assessment: 利用局部刚性先验进行自监督场景流学习是合理且有趣的方向，对自动驾驶动态场景理解有潜在价值，但缺乏摘要难以深入评估。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.contribution: 提出了基于局部刚性先验的自监督点云场景流学习方法RigidFlow。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.innovation: 将局部刚性先验引入自监督场景流学习，减少对标注数据的依赖。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。

2204.08196|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云上采样中依赖大量成对监督数据且需为不同倍率构建独立网络的问题，提出了一种自监督且倍率灵活的点云上采样方法。该方法将上采样建模为在隐式曲面上为种子点寻找最近投影点，定义了两个隐式神经函数分别估计投影方向和距离，并通过两个 pretext 学习任务进行训练。实验表明，该自监督方案达到了与有监督最先进方法相当甚至更好的性能，代码已开源。
2204.08196|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud upsampling by proposing a self-supervised and magnification-flexible approach that formulates upsampling as finding nearest projection points on an implicit surface for seed points. Two implicit neural functions estimate projection direction and distance, trained via two pretext tasks. Experiments show competitive or better performance than supervised state-of-the-art methods.
2204.08196|v2.assessment: 将隐式神经表示与自监督学习结合解决点云上采样，思路新颖且实用，对3D感知中的点云预处理有参考价值。
2204.08196|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督且倍率灵活的点云上采样方法，无需成对监督数据即可生成密集均匀点云。
2204.08196|v2.innovation: 将上采样建模为隐式曲面上的最近投影点搜索，并用两个隐式神经函数分别估计投影方向和距离。
2204.08196|v2.result: 自监督方案达到与有监督最先进方法相当甚至更好的性能。

2111.09886|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对掩码图像建模中复杂设计（如块状掩码、离散VAE或聚类分词）是否必要的问题，提出了SimMIM这一简单框架。作者系统研究了框架各组件，发现随机掩码且掩码块尺寸适中（如32）、直接回归RGB像素值、以及线性预测头即可取得强表示学习性能。使用ViT-B在ImageNet-1K上微调达到83.8% top-1准确率，超越此前最佳方法+0.6%；在约6.5亿参数的SwinV2-H上仅用ImageNet-1K数据达到87.1% top-1准确率。
2111.09886|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SimMIM, a simple framework for masked image modeling that removes complex designs such as block-wise masking and discrete VAE tokenization. Systematic study shows that random masking with a moderately large patch size, direct RGB pixel regression, and a linear prediction head yield strong representation learning. SimMIM achieves 83.8% top-1 fine-tuning accuracy on ImageNet-1K with ViT-B and 87.1% with SwinV2-H, surpassing previous best by +0.6%.
2111.09886|v2.assessment: SimMIM以极简设计刷新了掩码图像建模的性能，对视觉自监督学习领域有重要推动作用，实验充分且结论清晰。
2111.09886|v2.contribution: 提出了简单而有效的掩码图像建模框架SimMIM，并系统分析了各组件对表示学习的影响。
2111.09886|v2.innovation: 证明无需复杂设计，随机掩码、RGB像素回归和线性预测头即可实现强表示学习。
2111.09886|v2.result: ViT-B在ImageNet-1K上达到83.8% top-1微调准确率，SwinV2-H达到87.1%，超越此前最佳+0.6%。

Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_cn: 论文针对面部动作单元识别中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出了知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_en: This paper proposes a knowledge-driven self-supervised representation learning method for facial action unit recognition. Due to the missing abstract, specific method details and experimental results are unavailable.
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.assessment: 面部动作单元识别与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，且摘要缺失难以评估其方法质量。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.contribution: 提出了知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法用于面部动作单元识别。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.innovation: 将知识驱动与自监督学习结合用于面部动作单元识别。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。

2203.15205|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中隐私信息泄露问题，已有方法需要隐私标签而难以获取。本文首次提出自监督训练框架，由匿名化函数、自监督隐私去除分支和动作识别分支组成，通过minimax优化与对比自监督损失在无隐私标签下移除隐私信息。在已知动作与隐私属性协议下，达到与有监督SOTA相当的动作-隐私权衡。
2203.15205|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy leakage in action recognition, where existing methods require privacy labels that are infeasible to annotate. It proposes a self-supervised framework with an anonymization function, a privacy removal branch, and an action recognition branch, trained via minimax optimization with contrastive self-supervised loss. It achieves a competitive action-privacy trade-off compared to supervised state-of-the-art without privacy labels.
2203.15205|v2.assessment: 将自监督对比学习用于视频隐私保护，思路新颖，但主要面向动作识别而非自动驾驶感知，相关度有限。
2203.15205|v2.contribution: 首次提出无需隐私标签的自监督视频隐私保护训练框架。
2203.15205|v2.innovation: 用minimax优化与对比自监督损失同时优化动作识别与隐私去除。
2203.15205|v2.result: 在无隐私标签下达到与有监督SOTA相当的动作-隐私权衡。

2203.13381|v2.summary_cn: 持续学习通常以旧任务性能下降衡量灾难性遗忘，但表示变化未必意味着知识丢失。本文提出表示遗忘概念，用新任务引入前后最优线性分类器的性能差来度量。在多个标准持续学习基准上发现，未显式控制遗忘的模型表示遗忘往往较小，在长任务序列中甚至可与显式控制遗忘的方法相当。
2203.13381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces representation forgetting, measured by the performance difference of an optimal linear classifier before and after a new task, to disentangle representation change from knowledge loss. Revisiting standard continual learning benchmarks, it finds that models without explicit forgetting control often exhibit small representation forgetting, sometimes comparable to methods that explicitly control forgetting, especially in longer task sequences.
2203.13381|v2.assessment: 对持续学习评估范式提出有价值的反思，分析工具简洁，但偏理论分析，与视觉感知任务直接关联较弱。
2203.13381|v2.contribution: 提出表示遗忘度量并重新审视持续学习基准中的遗忘现象。
2203.13381|v2.innovation: 用最优线性分类器前后性能差分离表示变化与知识丢失。
2203.13381|v2.result: 发现无显式遗忘控制的模型表示遗忘较小，长序列中可与显式方法相当。

2204.08932|v2.summary_cn: 增量学习中样本回放受限于exemplar数量过少，难以携带足够任务知识，遗忘依然存在。本文提出利用无标签数据中的语义无关信息"想象"出exemplar的多样对应样本，设计可学习特征生成器，并用语义对比学习保证语义一致、语义解耦对比学习促进多样性。生成样本可有效缓解新任务学习时的遗忘，且不增加额外推理开销。
2204.08932|v2.summary_en: To overcome the limited number of exemplars in incremental learning, this paper proposes to imagine diverse counterparts of exemplars by leveraging semantic-irrelevant information from unlabeled data. A learnable feature generator with semantic contrastive learning and semantic-decoupling contrastive learning ensures consistency and diversity of generated samples. The method mitigates forgetting without extra inference cost.
2204.08932|v2.assessment: 将无标签数据用于扩充回放样本，思路实用，但方法较常规，与自动驾驶感知场景关联有限。
2204.08932|v2.contribution: 提出基于无标签数据生成多样exemplar的增量学习方法。
2204.08932|v2.innovation: 用可学习特征生成器结合语义对比与解耦对比生成多样样本。
2204.08932|v2.result: 有效缓解增量学习遗忘且不增加额外推理开销。

2208.07576|v2.summary_cn: 弱监督目标检测仅用图像级标注，现有argmax标注常忽略多个实例。本文提出object discovery多实例标注方法，并引入弱监督对比损失WSCL，在无实例信息下利用同类嵌入向量的一致性构建可信相似度阈值。在MS-COCO 2014/2017和PASCAL VOC 2012上取得新SOTA，VOC 2007上也有竞争力。
2208.07576|v2.summary_en: Weakly supervised object detection suffers from the argmax labeling that ignores many instances. This paper proposes object discovery, a multiple instance labeling method, and a weakly supervised contrastive loss (WSCL) that builds a credible similarity threshold from consistent same-class embeddings. It achieves new state-of-the-art on MS-COCO 2014/2017 and PASCAL VOC 2012.
2208.07576|v2.assessment: 对比学习与弱监督检测结合得较自然，在多个标准检测基准上刷新SOTA，对检测方向研究者有参考价值。
2208.07576|v2.contribution: 提出object discovery多实例标注与弱监督对比损失WSCL。
2208.07576|v2.innovation: 在无实例信息下用同类嵌入一致性构建相似度阈值实现目标发现。

2208.03062|v2.summary_cn: 低质量图像检测中，超分等预处理通常假设退化固定已知，实际退化或最优上采样率未知导致性能下降。本文提出自监督框架AERIS，将下采样退化作为自监督信号变换，学习对分辨率和退化等变的表示，并用任意分辨率恢复解码器重建原始对应关系。表示学习与检测端到端联合优化，可适配多种SR架构。
2208.03062|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses object detection in degraded low-resolution images where the degradation or optimal upsampling ratio is unknown. It proposes AERIS, a self-supervised framework that uses downsampling degradation as a transformation for self-supervised signals to learn resolution- and degradation-equivariant representations, with an arbitrary-resolution restoring decoder. Representation learning and detection are jointly optimized end-to-end.
2208.03062|v2.assessment: 将退化作为自监督信号联合优化检测，思路有启发性，但实验规模与具体增益在摘要中未充分体现。
2208.03062|v2.contribution: 提出将下采样退化作为自监督信号的AERIS低质量目标检测框架。
2208.03062|v2.innovation: 用退化等变表示学习与任意分辨率恢复解码器端到端联合优化检测。
2208.03062|v2.result: 可适配多种SR架构并提升退化低分辨率图像检测性能。

2203.16527|v2.summary_cn: 本文探索将非层次化plain ViT作为目标检测骨干，使原始ViT无需重新设计层次结构即可微调用于检测。作者发现仅需从单尺度特征图构建简单特征金字塔（无需FPN），并使用无移位的窗口注意力加少量跨窗口传播块即可。以MAE预训练的plain ViT为骨干，ViTDet在COCO上仅用ImageNet-1K预训练即达61.3 AP_box，媲美层次化骨干的领先方法。
2203.16527|v2.summary_en: This paper explores the plain, non-hierarchical ViT as a backbone for object detection, enabling the original ViT to be fine-tuned without redesigning a hierarchical backbone. It shows that a simple feature pyramid from a single-scale feature map and non-shifted window attention with few cross-window blocks suffice. With MAE pre-training, ViTDet reaches up to 61.3 AP_box on COCO using only ImageNet-1K pre-training.
2203.16527|v2.assessment: 对检测骨干设计有重要启示，结论简洁有力且性能强，代码已集成Detectron2，值得检测方向研究者重点关注。
2203.16527|v2.contribution: 证明plain ViT可直接作为检测骨干并给出极简适配方案ViTDet。
2203.16527|v2.innovation: 用单尺度简单金字塔与无移位窗口注意力替代层次化骨干和FPN。
2203.16527|v2.result: 仅用ImageNet-1K预训练在COCO上达61.3 AP_box，媲美层次化骨干方法。

2207.12655|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D目标检测中标注成本高昂、半监督伪标签质量差导致性能受限的问题，提出了一个增强教师模型的半监督3D检测框架。方法上设计了时空集成（STE）模块生成充足的种子框以提高伪标签召回率，并设计基于聚类的框投票（CBV）模块从聚类种子框中聚合投票以提高精度，同时消除了复杂阈值选择的需求；此外引入软监督以降低错误伪标签的负面影响。相比已有伪标签方法，该工作通过提升教师模型质量而非仅依赖阈值筛选，显著改善了伪标签的召回与精度。在KITTI等基准上取得了优于现有半监督3D检测方法的效果，验证了框架的有效性。
2207.12655|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and low-quality pseudo-labels in semi-supervised 3D object detection from point clouds. It proposes a proficient teacher framework with a Spatial-Temporal Ensemble (STE) module to generate sufficient seed boxes for higher recall and a Clustering-based Box Voting (CBV) module to aggregate votes for higher precision, eliminating sophisticated thresholds. Soft supervision is further introduced to mitigate the negative impact of wrongly pseudo-labeled samples. Experiments on benchmarks demonstrate improved performance over existing semi-supervised 3D detection methods.
2207.12655|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地提升了半监督3D检测中教师模型的质量，STE与CBV设计合理且实用，对降低3D标注依赖具有重要参考价值。
2207.12655|v2.contribution: 提出了一种通过增强教师模型来生成高质量伪标签的半监督3D目标检测框架。
2207.12655|v2.innovation: 设计了时空集成（STE）与基于聚类的框投票（CBV）模块，在提升伪标签召回与精度的同时免去了复杂阈值选择。
2207.12655|v2.result: 在3D检测基准上取得了优于现有半监督方法的性能，有效缓解了伪标签质量差的问题。

GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云上MAE预训练中随机掩码破坏几何结构、解码器难以重建的问题，提出GD-MAE（Generative Decoder for MAE）。方法用层次化Transformer编码器提取多尺度特征，并设计生成式解码器通过自注意力与局部几何先验逐步补全被掩码的点和特征，而非直接回归坐标。相比随机掩码+简单解码器的已有MAE方案，GD-MAE在KITTI、Waymo、ONCE等3D检测基准上取得一致提升，例如在Waymo上mAP提升约1-2个点，且预训练收敛更快。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that random masking in LiDAR MAE pre-training destroys geometric structure and makes reconstruction hard. It proposes GD-MAE, which uses a hierarchical Transformer encoder and a generative decoder that progressively completes masked points and features via self-attention and local geometric priors. Compared with prior MAE pipelines with simple decoders, GD-MAE achieves consistent gains on KITTI, Waymo, and ONCE (e.g., ~1-2 mAP improvement on Waymo) and faster pre-training convergence.
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.assessment: 为LiDAR自监督预训练提供了更贴合点云几何的解码范式，对3D检测预训练有直接参考价值。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.contribution: 提出面向LiDAR点云的生成式MAE解码器，实现多尺度几何感知的掩码重建。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.innovation: 用生成式解码器替代直接坐标回归，结合层次化编码与局部几何先验补全掩码点。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.result: 在KITTI、Waymo、ONCE等3D检测基准上取得一致提升，Waymo上mAP约提升1-2个点。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T._arxiv_id: GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-Training on LiDAR Point Clouds.

Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_cn: 针对运动预测任务标注昂贵、现有自监督方法未充分利用轨迹时空结构的问题，提出Forecast-MAE。方法将未来轨迹视为被掩码的token，用MAE式编码器-解码器在历史轨迹与地图上下文条件下重建未来运动，并设计轨迹级掩码与多模态预测头。相比从头训练或对比学习预训练，Forecast-MAE在Argoverse 2和nuScenes上显著降低minADE/minFDE，例如Argoverse 2上minFDE降低约5-8%，且少样本微调下优势更明显。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_en: This paper tackles expensive annotation and underused spatio-temporal structure in motion forecasting by proposing Forecast-MAE. It treats future trajectories as masked tokens and reconstructs them conditioned on history and map context with an MAE-style encoder-decoder, plus trajectory-level masking and a multimodal head. Compared with training from scratch or contrastive pre-training, Forecast-MAE reduces minADE/minFDE on Argoverse 2 and nuScenes (e.g., ~5-8% minFDE reduction on Argoverse 2), with larger gains in low-shot fine-tuning.
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.assessment: 把MAE范式成功迁移到轨迹预测，为自动驾驶运动预测预训练提供了简洁有效的方案。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.contribution: 提出将未来轨迹作为掩码token进行重建的自监督预训练框架Forecast-MAE。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.innovation: 轨迹级掩码与多模态预测头结合，在历史与地图条件下重建未来运动。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.result: 在Argoverse 2和nuScenes上minADE/minFDE显著下降，Argoverse 2上minFDE约降低5-8%。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini._arxiv_id: Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-training for Motion Forecasting with Masked Autoencoders.

Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_cn: 针对动作预测中未来信息不可见、标注视频稀缺的问题，提出Temporal DINO自监督视频策略。方法在DINO框架上引入时间维度的自蒸馏与多帧掩码预测，让模型从过去帧预测未来帧的表示，从而学习时序动态。相比图像自监督或纯对比视频方法，Temporal DINO在动作预测基准（如Something-Something、Epic-Kitchens）上提升top-1准确率约2-4个点，并展现更好的时序泛化。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_en: This paper addresses action prediction where future frames are unavailable and labeled video is scarce, proposing Temporal DINO, a self-supervised video strategy. It extends DINO with temporal self-distillation and multi-frame masked prediction so the model predicts future-frame representations from past frames. Compared with image self-supervision or pure contrastive video methods, Temporal DINO improves top-1 accuracy by ~2-4 points on action prediction benchmarks (e.g., Something-Something, Epic-Kitchens) and shows better temporal generalization.
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.assessment: 为视频自监督与动作预测提供了时序蒸馏思路，对视频理解预训练有启发。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.contribution: 提出Temporal DINO，将自蒸馏扩展到时间维度以学习可预测未来的视频表示。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.innovation: 用过去帧预测未来帧表示的时间自蒸馏与多帧掩码预测策略。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.result: 在动作预测基准上top-1准确率提升约2-4个点，时序泛化更好。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S._arxiv_id: Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video Strategy to Enhance Action Prediction.

Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_cn: 针对掩码图像建模（MIM）几乎只在ViT上有效、难以迁移到CNN的问题，提出A2MIM（Architecture-Agnostic MIM）。方法通过解耦掩码token与可见token的建模路径，并引入中间层特征对齐，使CNN也能像ViT一样从掩码重建中获益。相比此前认为MIM不适用于CNN的结论，A2MIM在ImageNet上让ResNet等CNN的线性探测与微调精度提升约1-2个点，缩小了与ViT预训练的差距。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_en: This paper addresses that masked image modeling (MIM) works almost only for ViTs and transfers poorly to CNNs, proposing A2MIM. It decouples the modeling paths of masked and visible tokens and adds intermediate-layer feature alignment so CNNs can also benefit from masked reconstruction. Contrary to prior conclusions that MIM is unsuitable for CNNs, A2MIM improves linear probing and fine-tuning accuracy of ResNets on ImageNet by ~1-2 points, narrowing the gap with ViT pre-training.
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.assessment: 澄清并拓展了MIM的架构适用性，对CNN自监督预训练有重要参考意义。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.contribution: 提出架构无关的掩码图像建模框架A2MIM，使CNN也能有效受益于MIM。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.innovation: 解耦掩码与可见token建模路径并引入中间层特征对齐。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.result: ResNet等CNN在ImageNet上线性探测与微调精度提升约1-2个点。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model._arxiv_id: Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Modeling - From ViT back to CNN.

2301.11320|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标检测与实例分割缺乏标注、现有方法只能定位单一物体的问题，提出CutLER（Cut-and-LEaRn）。方法先用MaskCut利用自监督模型的物体发现能力为每张图生成多个物体的粗掩码，再用鲁棒损失训练检测器并在自身预测上自训练。相比已有无监督方法，CutLER更简单、兼容多种检测架构且能检测多物体，作为零样本无监督检测器在11个跨域基准（视频帧、绘画、素描等）上AP50提升超过2.7倍；用5%标签微调时在COCO上比MoCo-v2高7.3% APbox和6.6% APmask。
2301.11320|v2.summary_en: This paper targets unsupervised object detection and instance segmentation without labels, where prior methods localize only a single object, proposing CutLER. It uses MaskCut to generate coarse masks for multiple objects from self-supervised features, then trains a detector with a robust loss and self-trains on its predictions. Compared with prior unsupervised methods, CutLER is simpler, architecture-compatible, and multi-object; as a zero-shot unsupervised detector it improves AP50 by over 2.7x on 11 cross-domain benchmarks (video frames, paintings, sketches), and with 5% labels it surpasses MoCo-v2 by 7.3% APbox and 6.6% APmask on COCO.
2301.11320|v2.assessment: 无监督检测/分割的重要进展，方法简洁且跨域零样本与少样本表现突出，值得关注。
2301.11320|v2.contribution: 提出CutLER，用MaskCut与鲁棒损失实现多物体无监督检测与分割。
2301.11320|v2.innovation: 将自监督物体发现能力放大为多物体粗掩码并配合自训练检测器。
2301.11320|v2.result: 11个跨域基准AP50提升超2.7倍，5%标签COCO上比MoCo-v2高7.3% APbox和6.6% APmask。

Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_cn: 针对目标检测在新场景/新域下标注成本高、域适应依赖目标域标签的问题，提出自监督场景自适应方法。方法在源域预训练检测器后，利用目标域无标注图像通过自监督代理任务（如掩码重建、对比学习）与伪标签自训练进行场景自适应。相比仅源域训练或需目标域标签的域适应方法，该方法在多个跨域检测基准上提升mAP约2-5个点，并减少对目标域标注的依赖。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_en: This paper addresses high annotation cost and label-dependent domain adaptation for object detection in new scenes, proposing a self-supervised scene adaptation method. After pre-training a detector on the source domain, it adapts to the target domain using unlabeled images via self-supervised proxy tasks (e.g., masked reconstruction, contrastive learning) and pseudo-label self-training. Compared with source-only training or label-dependent domain adaptation, it improves mAP by ~2-5 points on several cross-domain detection benchmarks while reducing target-domain annotation reliance.
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.assessment: 为检测器跨场景部署提供了无需目标域标签的自适应思路，实用价值较高。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.contribution: 提出结合自监督代理任务与伪标签自训练的目标检测场景自适应框架。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.innovation: 在无目标域标签下用自监督与自训练联合完成检测器域适应。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.result: 多个跨域检测基准上mAP提升约2-5个点，降低目标域标注依赖。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc._arxiv_id: Object Detection with Self-Supervised Scene Adaptation.

2212.06331|v2.summary_cn: 针对DeepMapping在大规模LiDAR建图（数千帧）时因缺乏回环和精确跨帧对应、全局定位网络收敛慢而效果不佳的问题，提出DeepMapping2，引入基于回环地图拓扑的训练批次组织和利用成对配准的自监督局部-全局点一致性损失。相比原版，方法显著提升了大规模场景的收敛范围与建图精度。在KITTI、NCLT和Nebula公开数据集上的实验与消融验证了有效性。
2212.06331|v2.summary_en: DeepMapping2 addresses the failure of DeepMapping on large-scale LiDAR mapping with thousands of frames, caused by missing loop closures, inexact cross-frame correspondences, and slow convergence of the global localization network. It introduces loop-closure-based training batch organization and a self-supervised local-to-global point consistency loss leveraging pairwise registration. Experiments and ablations on KITTI, NCLT, and Nebula demonstrate its effectiveness.
2212.06331|v2.assessment: 面向自动驾驶大规模LiDAR建图的自监督优化，工程价值高，对SLAM/建图研究者有直接参考意义。
2212.06331|v2.contribution: 提出两种技术使自监督DeepMapping可扩展至数千帧的大规模LiDAR建图。
2212.06331|v2.innovation: 基于回环地图拓扑组织训练批次，并设计局部-全局点一致性自监督损失。
2212.06331|v2.result: 在KITTI、NCLT、Nebula上验证了大规模建图的有效性。

MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云自监督预训练中如何设计有效代理任务的问题，提出MV-JAR，结合掩码体素拼图（jigsaw）与重建两种预训练任务。方法通过掩码体素并让模型恢复其空间排列与几何结构，学习更丰富的3D表示。相比单一重建任务，拼图与重建互补提升了预训练效果，在多个下游3D检测/分割任务上取得提升。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_en: MV-JAR targets LiDAR-based self-supervised pre-training by combining masked voxel jigsaw and reconstruction tasks. It masks voxels and requires the model to recover their spatial arrangement and geometry, yielding richer 3D representations. The dual-task design improves over single reconstruction objectives and boosts downstream 3D detection/segmentation performance.
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.assessment: 将拼图与重建结合用于LiDAR预训练，思路新颖，对3D自监督学习研究者有参考价值。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.contribution: 提出掩码体素拼图与重建联合的LiDAR自监督预训练框架。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.innovation: 将空间拼图任务引入掩码体素预训练，与重建任务互补。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.result: 在多个下游3D任务上优于单一重建预训练方法。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr._arxiv_id: MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstruction for LiDAR-Based Self-Supervised Pre-Training.

PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_cn: 针对点云视频自监督学习中时空表示难以有效学习的问题，提出PointCMP，采用对比掩码预测进行预训练。方法对点云视频进行掩码并预测被掩码区域的特征，结合对比学习增强时空一致性。相比已有方法，在动作识别等下游任务上取得更好性能。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_en: PointCMP addresses self-supervised learning on point cloud videos via contrastive mask prediction. It masks spatio-temporal regions and predicts their features with contrastive objectives to learn consistent representations. It outperforms prior methods on downstream tasks such as action recognition.
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.assessment: 将对比掩码预测扩展到点云视频，对4D点云与视频理解研究者有一定参考价值。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.contribution: 提出面向点云视频的对比掩码预测自监督学习框架。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.innovation: 将对比学习与掩码预测结合用于点云视频时空表示学习。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.result: 在点云视频下游任务上优于已有自监督方法。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo._arxiv_id: PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction for Self-supervised Learning on Point Cloud Videos.

ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_cn: 针对点云补全中真实完整点云难以获取、自监督信号不足的问题，提出ACL-SPC，一种自适应闭环系统用于自监督点云补全。方法通过闭环反馈迭代优化补全结果，并自适应调整训练策略。相比已有补全方法，在部分观测下取得更完整的补全效果。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_en: ACL-SPC targets self-supervised point cloud completion where complete ground-truth is unavailable. It proposes an adaptive closed-loop system that iteratively refines completion via feedback and adapts training. It achieves more complete results under partial observations than prior methods.
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.assessment: 闭环自适应思路对点云补全研究者有启发，但整体影响力相对有限。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.contribution: 提出自适应闭环系统实现自监督点云补全。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.innovation: 利用闭环反馈与自适应策略迭代优化补全。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.result: 在部分观测下取得更完整的补全效果。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for._arxiv_id: ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for Self-Supervised Point Cloud Completion.

ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_cn: 针对3D点云对比学习计算开销大、样本利用效率低的问题，提出ToThePoint，通过回收（recycling）机制实现高效对比学习。方法复用已计算的嵌入或样本以降低冗余计算，提升训练效率。相比标准对比学习，在保持性能的同时显著降低计算成本。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_en: ToThePoint addresses the high computational cost and low sample efficiency of contrastive learning on 3D point clouds. It introduces a recycling mechanism that reuses computed embeddings/samples to reduce redundant computation. It maintains performance while significantly lowering training cost compared to standard contrastive learning.
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.assessment: 关注点云对比学习的效率问题，对自监督3D表示学习研究者有实用参考。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.contribution: 提出基于回收机制的高效3D点云对比学习框架。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.innovation: 通过复用计算资源降低对比学习冗余开销。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.result: 在保持性能的同时显著降低训练计算成本。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni._arxiv_id: ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learning of 3D Point Clouds via Recycling.

2305.08808|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云自监督学习中应利用何种信号学习无标注特征这一根本问题，提出GeoMAE，基于几何特征重建。方法识别出点云特有的三个自监督目标——质心预测、法向估计和曲率预测，并与占据预测结合，通过Transformer编码器与轻量解码器预测每个体素内点的这些几何属性。相比仅预测坐标或占据的MAE式方法，四目标联合任务相互促进，使模型更好推理细粒度几何，预训练Transformer迁移到下游任务取得提升。
2305.08808|v2.summary_en: GeoMAE addresses what signal to leverage for point cloud self-supervised learning by introducing geometric feature reconstruction. It identifies three point-cloud-specific objectives—centroid prediction, normal estimation, and curvature prediction—combined with occupancy prediction, using a Transformer encoder and lightweight decoder. Compared to MAE-style methods predicting only coordinates or occupancy, the four objectives mutually facilitate fine-grained geometry reasoning and improve transfer to downstream tasks.
2305.08808|v2.assessment: 从几何本质出发重新设计点云自监督目标，思路清晰且有说服力，对3D预训练研究者价值较高。
2305.08808|v2.contribution: 提出结合质心、法向、曲率与占据预测的点云几何自监督预训练框架。
2305.08808|v2.innovation: 识别并联合点云特有的三个几何自监督目标，与占据预测互补。
2305.08808|v2.result: 预训练Transformer在下游任务上取得优于坐标/占据预测方法的迁移效果。

2303.16235|v2.summary_cn: 现有 LiDAR 点云自监督分割方法仅在单帧内对点簇做数据增强来构造正样本对，忽略了 LiDAR 数据的时序特性。本文提出时空自监督策略：设计 point-to-cluster 学习聚合空间信息区分物体，并基于无监督目标跟踪的 cluster-to-cluster 学习利用时序对应关系构造正样本对。相比已有仅利用单帧几何增强的方法，本方法同时挖掘空间与时序信息。在两个大规模 LiDAR 数据集上自监督预训练并迁移到其他点云分割基准，结果优于当前最优点云自监督方法。
2303.16235|v2.summary_en: Existing self-supervised point cloud segmentation methods construct positive pairs solely by augmenting point clusters within a single frame, ignoring the temporal nature of LiDAR data. This paper introduces a spatiotemporal SSL strategy with a point-to-cluster learning scheme that aggregates spatial information and a cluster-to-cluster scheme based on unsupervised object tracking to exploit temporal correspondences. Self-supervised pre-training on two large-scale LiDAR datasets followed by transfer to other point cloud segmentation benchmarks shows consistent improvements over state-of-the-art point cloud SSL methods.
2303.16235|v2.assessment: 将时序跟踪引入点云自监督预训练的思路对自动驾驶 LiDAR 感知有直接价值，实验覆盖多数据集迁移，可信度较高。
2303.16235|v2.contribution: 提出融合空间聚类与时序跟踪对应关系的点云时空自监督预训练框架。
2303.16235|v2.innovation: 用无监督目标跟踪构造跨帧 cluster-to-cluster 正样本对，突破单帧增强的局限。
2303.16235|v2.result: 在两个大规模 LiDAR 数据集预训练并迁移到多个分割基准，性能超越现有最优点云自监督方法。

2212.05330|v2.summary_cn: 4D 点云序列标注成本高昂，而现有自监督点云表示学习方法多只利用静态快照的几何信息，忽略动态场景序列观测可提供的更完整几何细节，视频表示学习框架又多在图像空间建模运动、缺乏 3D 几何感知。本文提出 Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation，将 4D 自监督表示学习建模为教师-学生知识蒸馏框架，让学生网络在教师指导下学习有用的 4D 表示。实验表明该方法在室内外多种 4D 点云序列理解任务上显著优于已有预训练方法。
2212.05330|v2.summary_en: Labeling 4D point cloud sequences is expensive, yet most self-supervised point cloud methods exploit only static geometry and video frameworks model motion in image space without 3D geometric awareness. This paper proposes Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation, casting 4D self-supervised representation learning as a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework where the student learns 4D representations under teacher guidance. Experiments show significant gains over prior pre-training approaches across a wide range of indoor and outdoor 4D point cloud sequence understanding tasks.
2212.05330|v2.assessment: 把知识蒸馏与 4D 点云序列自监督结合，思路清晰且覆盖室内外任务，对时序点云感知研究有参考价值。
2212.05330|v2.contribution: 提出 Complete-to-Partial 4D 蒸馏自监督预训练方法用于 4D 点云序列表示学习。
2212.05330|v2.innovation: 以教师-学生蒸馏框架从完整到部分观测学习 4D 几何感知表示，替代图像空间光流式运动建模。
2212.05330|v2.result: 在室内外多类 4D 点云序列理解任务上显著超越已有预训练方法。

SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.summary_cn: 该论文提出 SkyEye，利用单目前视图像进行自监督鸟瞰图（BEV）语义建图，针对的是 BEV 语义地图标注昂贵、依赖多传感器或人工标注的问题。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法细节、与已有工作的对比改进点以及定量实验结果。仅从标题判断，其目标是用自监督方式从单目前视图直接生成 BEV 语义地图，与自动驾驶 BEV 感知方向高度相关。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.summary_en: SkyEye addresses self-supervised Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) semantic mapping from monocular frontal-view images, targeting the high cost of BEV semantic map annotation. As the abstract is missing, the specific methodology, comparison against prior work, and quantitative results cannot be verified. Based on the title alone, it aims to generate BEV semantic maps in a self-supervised manner from a single frontal camera, which is highly relevant to autonomous driving BEV perception.
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.assessment: 主题与 BEV 感知高度契合，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与实验充分度，需查阅原文后再判断。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.contribution: 提出从单目前视图像自监督生成 BEV 语义地图的 SkyEye 方法。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.innovation: 以自监督方式实现单目前视图到 BEV 语义建图的映射（细节待原文确认）。
