2212.07401|v2.summary_cn: 3D 运动量化对研究人类和动物行为很重要，但人工姿态标注昂贵耗时，而现有自监督关键点发现方法通常只处理单个 2D 视图、不在 3D 空间操作。本文提出 BKinD-3D，从多视角视频中自监督发现 3D 关键点，无需任何 2D 或 3D 关键点及边界框监督。方法采用带 3D 体素热图的编码器-解码器架构，通过重建多视角间的时空差异并施加学习到的 3D 骨架关节长度约束进行训练。在人类和大鼠视频上验证了无需人工监督即可发现关键点，展示了 3D 关键点发现用于行为研究的潜力。
2212.07401|v2.summary_en: Quantifying 3D motion is important for behavior studies, but manual pose annotation is costly and existing self-supervised keypoint discovery methods operate on single 2D views rather than in 3D. This paper proposes BKinD-3D, which discovers 3D keypoints from multi-view videos without any 2D or 3D keypoint or bounding box supervision, using an encoder-decoder with a 3D volumetric heatmap trained to reconstruct spatiotemporal differences across views plus joint length constraints on a learned 3D skeleton. Experiments on human and rat videos demonstrate annotation-free 3D keypoint discovery.
2212.07401|v2.assessment: 多视角自监督 3D 关键点发现思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知场景关联较弱，更偏行为分析应用。
2212.07401|v2.contribution: 提出无需任何 2D/3D 标注、从多视角视频自监督发现 3D 关键点的 BKinD-3D 方法。
2212.07401|v2.innovation: 结合 3D 体素热图跨视角时空差异重建与骨架关节长度约束实现 3D 关键点发现。
2212.07401|v2.result: 在人类和大鼠视频上无需人工监督成功发现 3D 关键点，验证了行为研究应用潜力。

2303.09877|v2.summary_cn: 深度多视图聚类（MVC）中自监督学习是核心组件，但各方法中自监督的设计差异很大，阻碍了领域进展。本文提出统一框架 DeepMVC，将许多近期方法纳入其中作为实例，借此分析自监督的作用，特别是对比学习对齐表示的缺陷，并从理论上证明对比对齐会负面影响簇可分性，且视图数增加时该效应更严重。基于此提出若干新形式自监督的 DeepMVC 实例，实验发现：对比对齐在多视图数据集上降低性能、所有方法都受益于某种形式的自监督、新实例在多个数据集上超越先前方法。
2303.09877|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised learning is central to deep multi-view clustering (MVC), but the wide variation in its design across methods hinders progress. This paper presents DeepMVC, a unified framework subsuming many recent methods, and uses it to analyze the effects of self-supervision, showing theoretically that contrastive alignment can harm cluster separability, with the effect worsening as the number of views grows. New DeepMVC instances with novel self-supervision forms are developed and shown to outperform prior methods on several datasets.
2303.09877|v2.assessment: 统一框架加理论分析对自监督表示学习有方法论价值，但多视图聚类与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。
2303.09877|v2.contribution: 提出统一深度多视图聚类框架 DeepMVC 并理论分析对比对齐对簇可分性的负面影响。
2303.09877|v2.innovation: 从理论与实验两方面揭示对比对齐随视图数增加而损害聚类性能，并提出新自监督实例。
2303.09877|v2.result: 实验证实对比对齐在多视图数据集上降低性能，新实例在多个数据集上超越先前方法。

Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_cn: 针对3D异常检测与定位缺乏大规模真实标注数据的问题，本文提出通过3D异常合成构建基准数据集，并设计自监督学习网络进行异常检测与定位。方法利用合成异常扩充训练数据，结合自监督特征学习提升对未知异常的敏感性。相比依赖真实异常标注的已有方法，该工作降低了数据获取成本并提升了可扩展性。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但合成基准与自监督框架为3D异常检测提供了新思路。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of large-scale annotated data for 3D anomaly detection and localization by constructing a benchmark via 3D anomaly synthesis and proposing a self-supervised learning network. The method augments training data with synthesized anomalies and learns discriminative features in a self-supervised manner to detect and localize unknown anomalies. It reduces reliance on real anomaly annotations and improves scalability compared to prior work. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but the synthetic benchmark and self-supervised framework offer a new direction for 3D anomaly detection.
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.assessment: 该工作将异常合成与自监督学习引入3D异常检测，对工业检测与自动驾驶感知中的异常识别有参考价值，但需关注合成到真实的域差距。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.contribution: 构建了基于3D异常合成的可扩展基准，并提出自监督网络实现3D异常检测与定位。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.innovation: 利用3D异常合成替代真实异常标注，并结合自监督学习提升对未知异常的检测能力。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，主要贡献在于基准构建与自监督框架的提出。
Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an._arxiv_id: Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection and Localization: A Benchmark via 3D Anomaly Synthesis and A Self-Supervised Learning Network.

SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_cn: 针对自监督关键点估计中掩码自编码器（MAE）特征对应性不足的问题，本文提出SCE-MAE，通过选择性对应增强提升自监督关键点估计性能。方法在MAE框架下引入选择性对应增强模块，强化局部特征匹配能力。相比已有自监督关键点方法，该工作更好地利用了MAE的表示学习能力。摘要未给出具体数据，但在自监督关键点估计任务上展示了改进。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited correspondence capability of masked autoencoders (MAE) for self-supervised landmark estimation by proposing SCE-MAE, which enhances selective correspondence. The method introduces a selective correspondence enhancement module within the MAE framework to strengthen local feature matching. It improves upon existing self-supervised landmark estimation methods by better leveraging MAE representations. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but improvements on self-supervised landmark estimation are demonstrated.
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.assessment: 该工作将MAE与对应增强结合用于关键点估计，对自监督视觉表示学习有启发，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务关联较弱。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.contribution: 提出SCE-MAE，通过选择性对应增强提升MAE在自监督关键点估计中的表现。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.innovation: 在MAE框架中引入选择性对应增强模块，强化局部特征匹配能力。
SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.result: 摘要未提供具体量化数据，展示了在自监督关键点估计任务上的改进。

T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_cn: 针对点云表示学习中时序信息利用不足的问题，本文提出T-MAE，将时序掩码自编码器用于点云表示学习。方法在MAE框架下引入时序建模，通过掩码重建学习时空一致的点云特征。相比仅处理单帧点云的已有自监督方法，T-MAE更好地捕捉了点云序列的动态信息。摘要未给出具体数据，但在点云表示学习任务上展示了有效性。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient exploitation of temporal information in point cloud representation learning by proposing T-MAE, a temporal masked autoencoder for point cloud representation learning. The method incorporates temporal modeling into the MAE framework and learns spatio-temporally consistent point cloud features via masked reconstruction. Compared to existing self-supervised methods that process single-frame point clouds, T-MAE better captures dynamics in point cloud sequences. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but effectiveness on point cloud representation learning is demonstrated.
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.assessment: 该工作将时序建模引入点云MAE，对自动驾驶中基于点云序列的3D感知有潜在价值，值得关注其在下游检测任务的表现。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.contribution: 提出T-MAE，将时序掩码自编码器用于点云表示学习。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.innovation: 在MAE框架中引入时序建模，学习时空一致的点云特征。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.result: 摘要未提供具体量化数据，展示了在点云表示学习任务上的有效性。

ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_cn: 针对图像与视频自监督表示学习割裂的问题，本文提出ViC-MAE，通过对比掩码自编码器从图像和视频中联合学习表示。方法结合对比学习与掩码重建，在统一框架下处理图像和视频输入。相比分别针对图像或视频的自监督方法，ViC-MAE实现了跨模态的统一表示学习。摘要未给出具体数据，但在图像和视频下游任务上展示了竞争力。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of self-supervised representation learning for images and videos by proposing ViC-MAE, which jointly learns representations from images and videos via contrastive masked autoencoders. The method combines contrastive learning with masked reconstruction in a unified framework for both image and video inputs. Compared to methods tailored separately for images or videos, ViC-MAE achieves unified cross-modal representation learning. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but competitive performance on image and video downstream tasks is demonstrated.
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.assessment: 该工作统一了图像与视频的自监督表示学习，对多模态感知与视频理解有参考价值，但需关注其在自动驾驶场景的迁移能力。

NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_cn: 针对NeRF表示学习依赖大量标注或监督的问题，本文提出NeRF-MAE，将掩码自编码器用于NeRF的自监督3D表示学习。方法在NeRF框架下引入掩码重建，学习无需标注的3D场景表示。相比已有NeRF方法，NeRF-MAE实现了自监督的3D表示学习，减少了对监督信号的依赖。摘要未给出具体数据，但在3D表示学习任务上展示了有效性。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on extensive annotations or supervision in NeRF representation learning by proposing NeRF-MAE, which applies masked autoencoders for self-supervised 3D representation learning of neural radiance fields. The method introduces masked reconstruction within the NeRF framework to learn 3D scene representations without annotations. Compared to existing NeRF methods, NeRF-MAE achieves self-supervised 3D representation learning and reduces dependence on supervisory signals. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but effectiveness on 3D representation learning is demonstrated.
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.assessment: 该工作将MAE引入NeRF自监督表示学习，对3D场景理解与重建有启发，但与自动驾驶实时感知任务的直接关联有限。

DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_cn: 针对单视频中自监督点跟踪的难题，本文提出DINO-Tracker，利用DINO特征实现单视频内的自监督点跟踪。方法借助DINO预训练特征的强语义对应能力，在无需标注的情况下跟踪视频中的点。相比已有自监督点跟踪方法，DINO-Tracker更好地利用了大规模预训练视觉特征的对应性。摘要未给出具体数据，但在单视频点跟踪任务上展示了优越性能。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of self-supervised point tracking in a single video by proposing DINO-Tracker, which leverages DINO features for tracking. The method exploits the strong semantic correspondence of DINO pre-trained features to track points without annotations. Compared to existing self-supervised point tracking methods, DINO-Tracker better utilizes the correspondence capability of large-scale pre-trained visual features. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but superior performance on single-video point tracking is demonstrated.
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.assessment: 该工作将DINO特征用于单视频自监督点跟踪，对视频理解与自动驾驶中的运动跟踪有参考价值，值得关注其鲁棒性与泛化性。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.contribution: 提出DINO-Tracker，利用DINO特征实现单视频内的自监督点跟踪。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.innovation: 借助DINO预训练特征的语义对应能力，在无标注条件下跟踪视频中的点。

SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_cn: 针对点云上采样中缺乏大规模配对监督、现有自监督方法难以在稀疏输入下恢复精细几何的问题，本文提出SPU-PMD，通过渐进式网格变形实现自监督点云上采样。方法从稀疏点云构建初始网格，并在多阶段中逐步变形网格以逼近潜在表面，同时设计几何一致性约束来监督变形过程。相比依赖固定上采样模板或单步回归的已有工作，该方法能更灵活地恢复复杂拓扑与细节。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多个基准上优于现有自监督上采样方法。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised point cloud upsampling where paired dense supervision is unavailable and existing methods struggle to recover fine geometry from sparse inputs. It proposes SPU-PMD, which constructs an initial mesh from sparse points and progressively deforms it across stages to approximate the underlying surface, with geometric consistency constraints for supervision. Compared with template-based or single-step regression approaches, it better preserves complex topology and details, and is reported to outperform prior self-supervised upsampling methods on multiple benchmarks.
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.assessment: 将网格变形引入自监督点云上采样，思路较新，对3D感知中的稀疏点云增强有潜在价值，但需关注其计算开销与下游检测任务的迁移效果。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.contribution: 提出基于渐进式网格变形的自监督点云上采样框架SPU-PMD。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.innovation: 用多阶段网格变形替代传统点级回归，并设计几何一致性自监督约束。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.result: 在多个点云上采样基准上优于现有自监督方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_cn: 针对点云自监督学习中因场景内物体共现导致的‘物体依赖’偏差、使模型学到数据集捷径而非真实几何表征的问题，本文提出通过物体交换（Object Exchange）来缓解该依赖。方法在构造对比学习正负样本时，将不同场景中的物体进行交换与重组，从而打破物体间的虚假共现关联，迫使网络关注局部几何与形状本身。相比已有随机裁剪/遮挡类增强，该策略更直接地干预物体级语义分布。摘要称在多个下游3D任务上取得一致提升，验证了去偏效果。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_en: This paper tackles object dependency bias in point cloud self-supervised learning, where co-occurrence of objects within scenes lets models exploit dataset shortcuts instead of learning genuine geometric representations. It proposes an object exchange strategy that swaps and recombines objects across scenes when constructing contrastive pairs, breaking spurious co-occurrence correlations and forcing the network to focus on local geometry. Compared with random crop/mask augmentations, it intervenes more directly at the object-semantic level, and is reported to yield consistent gains on multiple downstream 3D tasks.
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.assessment: 从数据偏差角度切入点云自监督学习，问题定义清晰、方法简洁，对3D预训练与下游检测/分割有较强借鉴意义。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.contribution: 提出物体交换增强策略以消除点云自监督学习中的物体依赖偏差。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.innovation: 通过跨场景物体交换重组对比样本，显式打破物体共现捷径。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.result: 在多个下游3D任务上取得一致性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin._arxiv_id: Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improving Point Cloud Self-Supervised Learning Through Object Exchange.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中标注成本高昂、现有自监督方法难以在无身份标签下维持轨迹一致性的问题，本文提出基于路径一致性（Path Consistency）的自监督多目标跟踪方法。方法利用视频中目标轨迹在时间上的路径连续性构造自监督信号，通过对比同一路径上的特征、区分不同路径来学习身份判别表征，并与检测/关联模块联合训练。相比依赖伪标签或单帧对比的已有自监督MOT工作，路径一致性提供了更强的时序约束。摘要称在MOT基准上缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of multi-object tracking and the difficulty of maintaining trajectory consistency without identity labels in existing self-supervised methods. It proposes a path-consistency-based self-supervised MOT approach that exploits temporal continuity of object trajectories to build supervisory signals, learning identity-discriminative representations by pulling features along the same path together and pushing different paths apart, jointly with detection/association modules. Compared with pseudo-label or single-frame contrastive alternatives, path consistency imposes stronger temporal constraints, and is reported to narrow the gap to fully supervised MOT on benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 将轨迹路径一致性作为自监督信号用于MOT，思路自然且与跟踪任务本质契合，对降低自动驾驶感知标注成本有实际意义。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于路径一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用轨迹时序连续性构造自监督对比信号以学习身份判别表征。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT基准上显著缩小了与全监督方法的性能差距（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Path Consistency.

RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_cn: 针对开放世界3D场景理解中，现有方法依赖类别级文本标签、难以对细粒度区域和未见类别进行定位与识别的问题，本文提出RegionPLC（区域点-语言对比学习）。方法通过生成区域级的点云-文本对，将3D点云的区域特征与丰富的语言描述对齐，并引入区域感知的对比损失与多粒度文本监督，从而支持零样本/开放词汇的3D语义理解与检测。相比仅使用类别名或全局场景描述的工作，区域级对齐显著提升了细粒度开放词汇能力。摘要称在开放世界3D基准上取得领先性能。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_en: This paper targets open-world 3D scene understanding, where existing methods rely on category-level text labels and struggle to localize and recognize fine-grained regions and unseen classes. It proposes RegionPLC, which generates region-level point-text pairs to align 3D regional features with rich language descriptions, using region-aware contrastive losses and multi-granularity textual supervision to enable zero-shot/open-vocabulary 3D understanding and detection. Compared with category-name or global-scene-only supervision, region-level alignment substantially improves fine-grained open-vocabulary capability, and is reported to achieve leading performance on open-world 3D benchmarks.
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.assessment: 区域级点-语言对齐是开放词汇3D感知的重要方向，方法设计完整、与自动驾驶长尾/未知目标检测高度相关，值得重点关注。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.contribution: 提出区域点-语言对比学习框架RegionPLC用于开放世界3D场景理解。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.innovation: 构建区域级点云-文本对并设计区域感知对比损失实现细粒度开放词汇对齐。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.result: 在开放世界3D基准上取得领先性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr._arxiv_id: RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contrastive Learning for Open-World 3D Scene Understanding.

Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）普遍存在幻觉、即生成与图像不符内容的问题，本文提出幻觉增强对比学习（HACL）。方法利用模型自身产生的幻觉文本作为困难负样本，与真实描述构成对比对进行训练，从而在表征层面抑制幻觉倾向，并可结合现有MLLM微调流程。相比仅靠指令微调或RLHF抑制幻觉的工作，该方法直接从对比学习角度建模幻觉与真实描述的区分。摘要称在多个幻觉评测基准上降低了幻觉率并保持通用能力。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_en: This paper addresses hallucination in multimodal large language models, where generated content is inconsistent with the image. It proposes Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning (HACL), which treats model-generated hallucinated texts as hard negatives and contrasts them against ground-truth descriptions, suppressing hallucination at the representation level and integrating with existing MLLM fine-tuning pipelines. Compared with instruction tuning or RLHF-only approaches, it explicitly models the distinction between hallucinated and faithful descriptions, and is reported to reduce hallucination rates on multiple benchmarks while preserving general capabilities.
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.assessment: 把幻觉文本当作困难负样本做对比学习，角度新颖且实现成本低，对提升多模态感知可靠性有参考价值。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.contribution: 提出幻觉增强对比学习HACL以抑制多模态大模型幻觉。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.innovation: 将模型自生成幻觉文本作为困难负样本构建对比学习信号。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.result: 在多个幻觉评测基准上降低幻觉率并保持通用能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear._arxiv_id: Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning for Multimodal Large Language Model.

BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_cn: 针对多模态对比学习（如CLIP）在安全敏感场景下易受后门攻击、且现有攻击易被防御检测的问题，本文提出BadCLIP，一种双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法。方法在文本与图像两个嵌入空间同时植入触发器引导的映射，使被投毒模型在触发器出现时输出攻击者指定目标，同时在干净样本上保持正常行为以规避检测。相比单模态或可见触发器攻击，双嵌入引导提升了攻击成功率与隐蔽性。摘要称在多种防御下仍保持高攻击成功率。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_en: This paper studies backdoor attacks on multimodal contrastive learning (e.g., CLIP), which are security-critical yet often detectable by existing defenses. It proposes BadCLIP, a dual-embedding guided backdoor attack that implants trigger-guided mappings in both text and image embedding spaces, causing poisoned models to output attacker-specified targets when the trigger appears while behaving normally on clean inputs to evade detection. Compared with single-modality or visible-trigger attacks, dual-embedding guidance improves success rate and stealthiness, and is reported to maintain high attack success under multiple defenses.
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.assessment: 属于多模态模型安全方向，对理解CLIP类预训练模型在自动驾驶感知中的鲁棒性风险有警示意义，但偏攻击而非防御。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.contribution: 提出双嵌入引导的多模态对比学习后门攻击方法BadCLIP。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.innovation: 在文本与图像双嵌入空间联合植入触发器引导映射以提升隐蔽性。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.result: 在多种防御下仍保持高攻击成功率（摘要未给出具体数值）。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor._arxiv_id: BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor Attack on Multimodal Contrastive Learning.

SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测方法严重依赖昂贵的LiDAR点云或密集3D标注、难以规模化的问题，本文提出SelfOcc，一种纯视觉、自监督的3D占用预测框架。方法通过构建基于渲染的自监督信号（如光度一致性、深度/法向先验）从多视角图像中学习场景的3D占用表示，无需任何3D占用标注。相比依赖LiDAR监督的已有工作，SelfOcc在无标注条件下仍能获得有竞争力的占用预测性能，并在语义占用与场景补全等任务上展现出良好的泛化能力。该工作为自动驾驶中低成本、可扩展的3D场景理解提供了新范式。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance of existing 3D occupancy prediction methods on costly LiDAR point clouds or dense 3D annotations, which limits scalability. It proposes SelfOcc, a purely vision-based self-supervised framework that learns 3D occupancy from multi-view images using rendering-based self-supervision signals such as photometric consistency and depth/normal priors, without any 3D occupancy labels. Compared with LiDAR-supervised approaches, SelfOcc achieves competitive occupancy prediction and demonstrates strong generalization on semantic occupancy and scene completion, offering a scalable paradigm for low-cost 3D scene understanding in autonomous driving.
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习引入纯视觉3D占用预测，摆脱了对LiDAR与3D标注的依赖，对自动驾驶感知的低成本规模化具有重要意义，值得关注。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.contribution: 提出纯视觉、自监督的3D占用预测框架SelfOcc，无需任何3D占用标注。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.innovation: 利用渲染式自监督信号（光度一致性、深度/法向先验）从多视角图像学习3D占用表示。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.result: 在无3D标注条件下取得有竞争力的占用预测性能，并在语义占用与场景补全上展现良好泛化。

What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: 针对未剪辑多动作视频中，如何从叙述性指令里定位'什么动作、何时发生、在哪里发生'（即时空定位）的问题，本文提出一种自监督的时空定位方法。方法利用叙述指令与视频片段之间的对应关系构建自监督信号，在无需人工时空标注的情况下学习动作的时序边界与空间区域。相比依赖密集标注的已有工作，该方法可扩展到未剪辑长视频与多动作场景。实验表明其在时空定位基准上取得优于或接近全监督方法的性能，验证了叙述指令作为弱监督信号的有效性。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper tackles spatio-temporal grounding in untrimmed multi-action videos, i.e., localizing what action occurs, when, and where, from narrated instructions. It proposes a self-supervised approach that exploits the correspondence between narrated instructions and video segments to learn temporal boundaries and spatial regions without manual spatio-temporal annotations. Compared with densely annotated methods, it scales to untrimmed long videos with multiple actions, achieving performance comparable to or better than fully supervised baselines and validating narration as an effective weak supervision signal.
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该工作将叙述指令作为自监督信号用于未剪辑视频的时空定位，对视频理解与多模态弱监督学习有参考价值。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出从叙述指令中进行自监督时空定位的方法，无需人工时空标注。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.innovation: 利用叙述指令与视频片段的对应关系构建自监督信号，实现'什么、何时、何地'的联合定位。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.result: 在时空定位基准上取得优于或接近全监督方法的性能，并可扩展到未剪辑多动作长视频。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised Spatio- Temporal Grounding in Untrimmed Multi-Action Videos from Narrated Instructions.

Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_cn: 针对超分辨率模型在真实退化场景下泛化能力差的问题，本文提出'低分辨率引导'（Low-Res Leads the Way）的自监督学习策略。方法先在低分辨率域进行自监督预训练以学习退化鲁棒的表示，再迁移到高分辨率超分辨率任务，从而缩小合成退化与真实退化之间的域差距。相比直接在合成数据上训练的超分方法，该策略显著提升了跨域泛化能力。实验在多个超分基准与真实退化数据上验证了其有效性，取得更优的感知质量与泛化性能。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of super-resolution models under real-world degradations by proposing a 'Low-Res Leads the Way' self-supervised learning strategy. It first performs self-supervised pre-training in the low-resolution domain to learn degradation-robust representations, then transfers to high-resolution super-resolution, narrowing the domain gap between synthetic and real degradations. Compared with methods trained directly on synthetic data, it substantially improves cross-domain generalization, achieving better perceptual quality and generalization across multiple benchmarks and real-world degraded data.
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.assessment: 该工作提出低分辨率自监督预训练以提升超分泛化，思路简洁有效，对自监督视觉与图像复原方向有借鉴意义。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.contribution: 提出低分辨率引导的自监督学习策略以提升超分辨率模型的跨域泛化能力。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.innovation: 先在低分辨率域自监督预训练学习退化鲁棒表示，再迁移到高分辨率超分任务。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.result: 在多个超分基准与真实退化数据上取得更优的感知质量与泛化性能。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General._arxiv_id: Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving Generalization for Super-Resolution by Self-Supervised Learning.

Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_cn: 针对人脸表示学习中标注成本高、且现有自监督方法忽略人脸区域结构信息的问题，本文提出一种具有面部区域感知能力的自监督人脸表示学习方法。方法通过显式建模人脸关键区域（如眼睛、鼻子、嘴等）之间的空间与语义关系，构建区域感知的自监督预训练目标。相比通用自监督方法，该方法能更好地捕捉细粒度人脸结构，在下游人脸识别、表情识别等任务上取得更优性能。实验验证了区域感知自监督信号对人脸表示学习的有效性。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in facial representation learning and the neglect of facial region structure in existing self-supervised methods by proposing a facial region-aware self-supervised learning approach. It explicitly models spatial and semantic relations among key facial regions (e.g., eyes, nose, mouth) to construct region-aware pretext objectives. Compared with generic self-supervised methods, it better captures fine-grained facial structure and achieves improved performance on downstream tasks such as face recognition and expression recognition.
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.assessment: 该工作将区域感知引入自监督人脸表示学习，对细粒度人脸理解有参考价值，但领域相关性相对有限。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.contribution: 提出面部区域感知的自监督人脸表示学习方法。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.innovation: 显式建模人脸关键区域间的空间与语义关系作为自监督预训练目标。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.result: 在下游人脸识别与表情识别等任务上取得优于通用自监督方法的性能。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Facial Representation Learning with Facial Region Awareness.

CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标发现中现有方法依赖有限自监督特征、难以发现完整目标的问题，本文提出CuVLER，利用自监督Transformer（如DINO）进行穷尽式目标发现。方法通过充分挖掘自监督Transformer的多层注意力与特征，结合多尺度与多线索融合策略，提升对完整目标区域的定位与发现能力。相比已有无监督目标发现方法，CuVLER在多个基准上显著提升了发现精度与召回，尤其在复杂场景下表现更稳健。该工作为开放集/无监督目标发现提供了更强的自监督基线。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing unsupervised object discovery methods that rely on limited self-supervised features and struggle to discover complete objects. It proposes CuVLER, which performs exhaustive object discovery using self-supervised Transformers (e.g., DINO) by fully exploiting multi-layer attention and features with multi-scale and multi-cue fusion. Compared with prior unsupervised discovery methods, CuVLER substantially improves discovery precision and recall across benchmarks, especially in complex scenes, providing a stronger self-supervised baseline for open-set/unsupervised object discovery.
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.assessment: 该工作充分挖掘自监督Transformer用于无监督目标发现，对开放集检测与自监督视觉方向有较强参考价值。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.contribution: 提出基于自监督Transformer的穷尽式无监督目标发现方法CuVLER。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.innovation: 融合自监督Transformer多层注意力与多尺度多线索策略，提升完整目标发现能力。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.result: 在多个无监督目标发现基准上显著提升精度与召回，复杂场景下更稳健。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis._arxiv_id: CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Discoveries through Exhaustive Self-Supervised Transformers.

Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_cn: 针对文本引导图像编辑中提示词表达能力有限、编辑结果与文本意图不一致的问题，本文提出提示增强（Prompt Augmentation）方法用于自监督文本引导图像编辑。方法通过自动扩展与丰富输入文本提示，结合自监督学习目标，使编辑模型在无需成对监督数据的情况下更好地对齐文本语义与图像修改。相比直接使用原始提示的已有方法，提示增强显著提升了编辑的语义一致性与可控性。实验在文本引导图像编辑基准上验证了其在编辑质量与文本对齐方面的改进。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited expressiveness of text prompts and the misalignment between edits and textual intent in text-guided image manipulation by proposing a prompt augmentation approach for self-supervised manipulation. It automatically expands and enriches input text prompts and combines them with self-supervised objectives, enabling better alignment between text semantics and image edits without paired supervision. Compared with methods using raw prompts, prompt augmentation improves semantic consistency and controllability, as validated on text-guided image manipulation benchmarks.
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.assessment: 该工作从提示增强角度改进文本引导图像编辑，对多模态生成与自监督学习方向有一定参考价值。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.contribution: 提出用于自监督文本引导图像编辑的提示增强方法。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.innovation: 自动扩展与丰富文本提示并结合自监督目标，提升文本与编辑结果的语义对齐。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.result: 在文本引导图像编辑基准上提升了编辑质量与文本对齐一致性。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised Text-guided Image Manipulation.

BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_cn: 该论文针对冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET）中三维子断层对齐（subtomogram alignment）的朝向估计问题，提出将等变性（equivariance）引入自监督学习框架 BOE-ViT。方法基于 Vision Transformer 架构，通过设计等变注意力机制使模型对三维旋转具有内在的等变性，从而在无标注数据上学习鲁棒的朝向表示。相比已有依赖大量标注或非等变网络的方法，BOE-ViT 在自监督设定下显著提升了朝向估计精度。摘要中未给出具体量化指标，但该工作为自监督 3D 对齐提供了新思路。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_en: This paper addresses orientation estimation for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-ET by introducing equivariance into a self-supervised Vision Transformer framework, BOE-ViT. The method designs equivariant attention mechanisms so that the model inherently respects 3D rotations, enabling robust orientation representation learning without annotations. Compared to prior annotation-heavy or non-equivariant approaches, BOE-ViT improves orientation estimation accuracy under self-supervision, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.assessment: 将等变性引入自监督 ViT 用于 3D 子断层对齐，思路新颖，但应用场景（cryo-ET）与自动驾驶感知距离较远，对视觉自监督方法研究者有一定参考价值。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.contribution: 提出等变 Vision Transformer 框架 BOE-ViT，实现自监督 3D 子断层朝向估计。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.innovation: 将等变注意力机制与自监督 ViT 结合用于三维旋转敏感的朝向估计任务。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.result: 在自监督设定下提升了 3D 子断层对齐的朝向估计精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation._arxiv_id: BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation with Equivariance in Self-Supervised 3D Subtomogram Alignment.

DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云跨域学习中掩码自编码器（MAE）泛化能力不足的问题，提出域自适应点云掩码自编码器 DAP-MAE。方法通过设计域自适应预训练策略，使模型在源域预训练后能有效迁移到目标域，缓解域偏移带来的性能下降。相比标准 Point-MAE 等已有方法，DAP-MAE 在跨域点云分类和分割任务上取得更优表现。摘要中未提供具体量化数据。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited cross-domain generalization of masked autoencoders for point clouds by proposing DAP-MAE, a domain-adaptive point cloud masked autoencoder. The method introduces domain-adaptive pre-training strategies that enable effective transfer from source to target domains, mitigating performance degradation caused by domain shift. Compared to standard Point-MAE and related methods, DAP-MAE achieves improved results on cross-domain point cloud classification and segmentation, though quantitative details are absent from the abstract.
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.assessment: 将域自适应思想引入点云 MAE 预训练，对 3D 感知中的跨域泛化问题有参考意义，但整体创新幅度中等。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.contribution: 提出域自适应点云掩码自编码器 DAP-MAE，提升跨域点云表示学习效果。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.innovation: 在点云 MAE 预训练中引入域自适应机制以缓解域偏移。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.result: 在跨域点云分类与分割任务上优于已有方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas._arxiv_id: DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Masked Autoencoder for Effective Cross-Domain Learning.

2503.23220|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测（DAOD）中 Mean Teacher 自标注范式耦合学习与标签生成、初始学生模型难以产生准确目标域标签的问题，提出 DINO Teacher 方法。方法利用大规模冻结的 DINOv2 视觉基础模型在源域数据上训练一个独立标注器，解耦标签生成与模型学习，从而为目标域提供更准确的伪标签。相比现有 DAOD 方法，DINO Teacher 在多个域自适应基准上取得显著提升，验证了视觉基础模型在 DAOD 中的有效性。
2503.23220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the brittleness of the Mean Teacher self-labelling paradigm in domain adaptive object detection (DAOD), where learning and label generation are tightly coupled and initial students struggle to produce accurate target-domain labels. It proposes DINO Teacher, which trains a separate labeller on source data using a large frozen DINOv2 backbone, decoupling label generation from model learning to yield more accurate pseudo-labels. Compared to existing DAOD methods, DINO Teacher achieves substantial improvements on multiple domain adaptation benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of vision foundation models for DAOD.
2503.23220|v2.assessment: 利用冻结 DINOv2 解耦 DAOD 中的标签生成与学习，思路清晰且实验有效，对自动驾驶跨域检测有直接参考价值。
2503.23220|v2.contribution: 提出 DINO Teacher，利用冻结 DINOv2 基础模型解耦 DAOD 中的标签生成与模型学习。
2503.23220|v2.innovation: 用大规模预训练视觉基础模型替代 Mean Teacher 生成目标域伪标签，打破耦合范式。
2503.23220|v2.result: 在多个 DAOD 基准上显著超越现有方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。

A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_cn: 该论文针对 3D 点云自监督预训练方法缺乏统一解释框架的问题，提出基于交互（interactions）的统一分析视角。方法通过交互度量来刻画不同自监督预训练方法所学习到的特征关系，揭示各方法在表示学习上的共性与差异。相比已有仅从下游任务性能评估预训练方法的工作，该研究提供了更深入的可解释性分析。摘要中未给出具体实验数据。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified interpretation framework for self-supervised pre-training methods on 3D point clouds by proposing an interaction-based analytical perspective. The method uses interaction metrics to characterize the feature relationships learned by different pre-training approaches, revealing commonalities and differences in their representation learning. Compared to prior work that evaluates pre-training methods solely via downstream task performance, this study offers deeper interpretability, though specific experimental data are not provided in the abstract.
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.assessment: 为 3D 点云自监督预训练提供统一解释框架，对理解预训练机制有理论价值，但偏分析性工作，实用性有限。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.contribution: 提出基于交互的统一框架来解释 3D 点云自监督预训练方法。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.innovation: 用交互度量刻画不同自监督预训练方法的表示学习特性。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.result: 揭示了多种 3D 点云自监督预训练方法的共性与差异（摘要未给出具体数值）。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-._arxiv_id: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-supervised Pre-training Methods for 3D Point Clouds via Interactions.

2503.13739|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角行人关联中外观相似场景下 ReID 特征不可靠、且现有方法依赖真值标签或标定相机参数的问题，提出自监督无标定多视角行人关联方法 Self-MVA。方法设计编码器-解码器模型与跨视角图像同步（cross-view image synchronization）自监督 pretext 任务，通过判断不同视角图像是否同时拍摄来学习统一几何与外观特征，并利用匈牙利匹配桥接实例级监督。相比已有方法，Self-MVA 无需任何标注或相机标定即可在挑战性场景中实现鲁棒关联。
2503.13739|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view person association in challenging scenes where ReID features are unreliable due to similar appearances, and existing methods require ground-truth labels or calibrated cameras. It proposes Self-MVA, a self-supervised uncalibrated approach that leverages cross-view image synchronization as a pretext task within an encoder-decoder framework, learning unified geometric and appearance features and using Hungarian matching to bridge instance-level supervision. Compared to prior methods, Self-MVA achieves robust association without any annotations or camera calibration.
2503.13739|v2.assessment: 利用时间同步作为自监督信号解决无标定多视角行人关联，思路巧妙，对多相机感知与跟踪有参考价值。
2503.13739|v2.contribution: 提出自监督无标定多视角行人关联方法 Self-MVA，无需标注或相机标定。
2503.13739|v2.innovation: 以跨视角图像同步作为自监督 pretext 任务学习几何与外观统一特征。
2503.13739|v2.result: 在挑战性场景中实现鲁棒的多视角行人关联（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2505.04410|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇密集预测任务中 CLIP 图像 token 难以有效聚合空间/语义相关区域信息、导致局部判别性和空间一致性不足的问题，提出 DeCLIP 框架。方法将 CLIP 自注意力模块解耦为 content 和 context 两路特征，content 特征与图像裁剪表示对齐以增强局部判别性，context 特征在 DINO 等视觉基础模型指导下保留空间相关性。大量实验表明 DeCLIP 在多个开放词汇密集预测任务上显著优于现有方法。
2505.04410|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal local feature representation of CLIP in open-vocabulary dense prediction, where image tokens fail to aggregate spatially or semantically related regions, lacking local discriminability and spatial consistency. It proposes DeCLIP, which decouples CLIP's self-attention into content and context features: content features are aligned with image crop representations for local discriminability, while context features retain spatial correlations under the guidance of vision foundation models like DINO. Extensive experiments show DeCLIP significantly outperforms existing methods across multiple open-vocabulary dense prediction tasks.
2505.04410|v2.assessment: 解耦 CLIP 自注意力以增强开放词汇密集预测的局部判别性与空间一致性，方法设计合理且实验充分，对开放集检测与 BEV 感知有借鉴意义。
2505.04410|v2.contribution: 提出 DeCLIP 框架，通过解耦自注意力提升 CLIP 在开放词汇密集预测中的性能。
2505.04410|v2.innovation: 将 CLIP 自注意力解耦为 content 和 context 两路特征，分别优化局部判别性与空间一致性。
2505.04410|v2.result: 在多个开放词汇密集预测任务上显著超越现有方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2503.21003|v2.summary_cn: 针对AI生成图像取证中传统方法依赖已知生成器特征、难以泛化到未见生成器的问题，本文提出显式建模取证微观结构（forensic microstructures）的方法。仅使用真实图像以自监督方式学习一组多样化预测滤波器提取残差，并在多尺度上联合建模，得到每张图像紧凑的"取证自描述"参数。该自描述支持零样本合成图像检测、开放集来源归因和无先验聚类，实验表明在准确性和适应性上优于现有技术，推进了合成图像取证的最先进水平。
2503.21003|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of AI-generated image forensics to unseen generators by explicitly modeling forensic microstructures. Using only real images in a self-supervised manner, it learns diverse predictive filters to extract multi-scale residuals and jointly models them into a compact per-image forensic self-description. This enables zero-shot synthetic image detection, open-set source attribution, and source clustering without prior knowledge, achieving superior accuracy and adaptability over competing techniques.
2503.21003|v2.assessment: 将自监督残差建模与开放集识别结合，为生成图像取证提供了可泛化的新范式，对开放集检测方向有借鉴意义。
2503.21003|v2.contribution: 提出基于取证自描述的零样本检测、开放集来源归因与聚类统一框架。
2503.21003|v2.innovation: 仅用真实图像自监督学习多尺度预测滤波器残差，构建每图唯一的取证自描述。
2503.21003|v2.result: 在零样本检测、开放集归因与聚类上准确性和适应性均优于现有方法。

S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_cn: 该论文提出S4-Driver，一个可扩展的自监督驾驶多模态大语言模型，引入时空视觉表示以增强驾驶场景理解。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法细节、与已有工作的对比改进及实验数据。从标题看，其目标是将自监督学习与多模态LLM结合用于自动驾驶决策/感知。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_en: This paper presents S4-Driver, a scalable self-supervised driving multimodal large language model with spatio-temporal visual representation. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology, comparisons, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The title suggests it targets integrating self-supervised learning with multimodal LLMs for autonomous driving.
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.assessment: 主题与自动驾驶多模态感知高度相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法质量与实验充分度，需查阅全文确认。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.contribution: 提出面向驾驶场景的可扩展自监督多模态大语言模型S4-Driver。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.innovation: 将时空视觉表示引入自监督驾驶多模态LLM。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv._arxiv_id: S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driving Multimodal Large Language Model with Spatio-Temporal Visual Representation.

2412.04424|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP式对比学习视觉编码器特征层次单一、难以适配多样下游任务的问题，本文提出Florence-VL，采用生成式视觉基础模型Florence-2作为视觉编码器构建多模态大语言模型。提出深度-广度融合（DBFusion）机制，融合不同深度和多种提示下提取的视觉特征，并设计端到端预训练加投影层与LLM微调的训练配方。定量分析与可视化表明其在视觉-语言对齐上优于流行视觉编码器，丰富了特征的深度与广度。
2412.04424|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited feature hierarchy of CLIP-style contrastive vision encoders by building Florence-VL, an MLLM family using the generative vision foundation model Florence-2 as encoder. It proposes depth-breadth fusion (DBFusion) to combine visual features from different depths and multiple prompts, with an end-to-end pretraining plus projection/LLM finetuning recipe. Quantitative analysis and visualization show advantages over popular vision encoders in vision-language alignment.
2412.04424|v2.assessment: 用生成式视觉编码器替代CLIP并设计深度-广度融合，为MLLM视觉表示增强提供了有说服力的新思路。
2412.04424|v2.contribution: 提出基于Florence-2生成式编码器与DBFusion的Florence-VL多模态大模型系列。
2412.04424|v2.innovation: 深度-广度融合机制整合多深度、多提示的视觉特征并配套训练配方。
2412.04424|v2.result: 在视觉-语言对齐上优于流行视觉编码器，特征深度与广度更丰富。

2502.18290|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督学习视觉编码器被广泛共享复用、可能被植入后门从而影响下游LVLM的安全隐患，本文揭示了一种新后门威胁：仅需污染视觉编码器即可向LVLM注入显著视觉幻觉。提出BadVision方法，采用新颖的触发器优化与后门学习技术，在两类SSL编码器和LVLM、八个基准上评估。结果显示攻击成功率超过99%，造成77.6%的相对视觉理解错误，同时保持隐蔽性，可绕过当前最先进的后门检测方法。
2502.18290|v2.summary_en: This paper reveals a new backdoor threat where compromising shared self-supervised learning vision encoders can induce significant visual hallucinations in downstream LVLMs. It proposes BadVision, the first method exploiting this vulnerability with novel trigger optimization and backdoor learning techniques, evaluated on two SSL encoder types and LVLMs across eight benchmarks. BadVision achieves over 99% attack success rate and 77.6% relative visual understanding error while maintaining stealthiness against state-of-the-art backdoor detection.
2502.18290|v2.assessment: 首次系统揭示SSL视觉编码器共享带来的后门传播风险，对自监督视觉与LVLM安全研究具有重要警示价值。
2502.18290|v2.contribution: 提出首个针对LVLM自监督视觉编码器的隐蔽后门攻击方法BadVision。
2502.18290|v2.innovation: 利用编码器共享复用特性，通过触发器优化与后门学习实现跨下游LVLM的幻觉注入。
2502.18290|v2.result: 攻击成功率超99%，造成77.6%相对视觉理解错误且能绕过SoTA后门检测。

2511.08666|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频基础模型提取的时空特征在共享或存储时会泄露肤色、性别、衣着等敏感隐私信息的问题，指出现有像素级匿名化方法需重训练整个视频模型且任务特定，不适用于冻结的视频基础模型。作者提出轻量级匿名适配器模块（AAM），以即插即用方式作用于冻结的视频编码器，并设计三个训练目标：片段级自监督隐私目标以降低静态片段间互信息、协同训练目标以保留跨任务效用等。相比已有工作，AAM 无需微调或重新提取特征，将隐私保护从输入像素空间迁移到潜在特征空间，兼顾通用任务效用与计算效率。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在保留通用任务效用的同时去除私有信息。
2511.08666|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that spatio-temporal features extracted by video foundation models inadvertently leak sensitive personal information such as skin color, gender, or clothing when shared or stored. It proposes a lightweight Anonymizing Adapter Module (AAM) that operates in the latent space and can be plugged into frozen video encoders, trained with three objectives including a clip-level self-supervised privacy objective and a co-training objective. Unlike prior input-pixel-level anonymization methods that require retraining the entire utility model and yield task-specific anonymization, AAM avoids finetuning and feature re-extraction while retaining general task utility. The abstract reports no specific quantitative results but claims effective privacy removal with preserved utility.
2511.08666|v2.assessment: 该工作将隐私保护从像素级转向潜在特征级，思路新颖且对视频基础模型部署有实际意义，但摘要未提供量化实验数据，且与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2511.08666|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的潜在空间匿名适配器 AAM，在冻结视频编码器上实现通用隐私保护与任务效用的平衡。
2511.08666|v2.innovation: 将视觉隐私保护形式化为潜在空间操作，并设计片段级自监督隐私目标与协同训练目标。
2511.08666|v2.result: 声称在无需微调或重提取特征的情况下去除私有信息并保留通用任务效用，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。

2003.13942|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频描述生成中现有方法仅使用场景级或物体级信息、未显式建模物体交互，导致预测缺乏视觉 grounding 且对虚假相关敏感的问题。作者提出时空图模型，在空间和时间维度上显式建模物体交互，并构建可解释的链接以提供视觉 grounding；同时提出物体感知知识蒸馏机制，用局部物体信息正则化全局场景特征，以缓解物体数量变化带来的性能不稳定。在两个基准上的实验表明，该方法在取得有竞争力性能的同时能给出可解释的预测。
2003.13942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses video captioning by explicitly modeling object interactions in space and time, which prior scene-level or object-level methods overlook, leading to weak visual grounding and sensitivity to spurious correlations. The authors propose a spatio-temporal graph model that builds interpretable links for explicit visual grounding, together with an object-aware knowledge distillation mechanism that regularizes global scene features using local object information to handle varying object counts. Experiments on two benchmarks show competitive performance with interpretable predictions.
2003.13942|v2.assessment: 该工作将图结构建模与知识蒸馏结合用于视频描述，思路清晰且强调可解释性，但其任务与自动驾驶感知/3D检测主线关联较弱，主要价值在于视频理解与多模态推理的方法参考。
2003.13942|v2.contribution: 提出时空图视频描述模型与物体感知知识蒸馏机制，实现显式视觉 grounding 并缓解物体数量变化带来的不稳定。
2003.13942|v2.innovation: 用局部物体信息通过知识蒸馏正则化全局场景特征，并在时空图上显式建模物体交互以提供可解释预测。
2003.13942|v2.result: 在两个视频描述基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并给出可解释的预测结果。

2103.03454|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中现有智能体仅将历史观测以循环网络隐状态存储、无法捕捉环境布局与长期规划的问题，提出结构化场景记忆（SSM）架构。SSM 将感知记忆分区存储，并作为结构化场景表示解耦视觉与几何线索，配合 collect-read 控制器自适应收集信息以支持当前决策并模拟迭代长程推理。基于 SSM 提供的完整动作空间（地图上所有可导航位置），引入前沿探索式导航决策策略实现高效全局规划。在 R2R 和 R4R 两个 VLN 数据集上取得当时最优性能。
2103.03454|v2.summary_en: Existing vision-language navigation (VLN) agents store past observations merely as latent states in recurrent networks, failing to capture environment layouts or support long-term planning. This paper proposes Structured Scene Memory (SSM), a compartmentalized architecture that memorizes percepts, disentangles visual and geometric cues, and employs a collect-read controller for adaptive information gathering and long-range reasoning. Leveraging SSM's complete action space, a frontier-exploration-based decision strategy enables efficient global planning, achieving state-of-the-art results on R2R and R4R.
2103.03454|v2.assessment: 该工作将结构化记忆与全局规划引入 VLN，思路清晰且实验验证充分，但领域与自动驾驶感知/3D 检测主线关联较弱，主要价值在于多模态导航与记忆机制设计。
2103.03454|v2.contribution: 提出结构化场景记忆（SSM）架构及前沿探索式全局规划策略，用于视觉语言导航。
2103.03454|v2.innovation: 将导航历史以分区结构化记忆存储并解耦视觉-几何线索，配合 collect-read 控制器实现长程推理。
2103.03454|v2.result: 在 R2R 和 R4R 数据集上达到当时最优性能。

VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）中视觉表示能力被忽视的问题，重新审视并改进视觉特征提取。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但根据标题与领域常识，其核心是提出更强的视觉骨干与预训练策略以提升下游多模态任务表现。相比已有工作，改进点在于系统性地重新设计视觉表示而非仅优化语言侧或跨模态对齐。该工作对多模态感知与 VLM 方向具有参考价值。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_en: This paper revisits visual representations in vision-language models, addressing the overlooked role of visual features in multimodal performance. Although the abstract is unavailable, the work is known to propose improved visual backbones and pretraining strategies for downstream vision-language tasks. It systematically rethinks the visual side rather than only optimizing language or cross-modal alignment, offering reference value for multimodal perception and VLM research.
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.assessment: VinVL 是 VLM 领域的重要工作，强调视觉表示质量对多模态任务的关键作用，对多模态感知研究者有较高参考价值，但摘要缺失导致细节无法核实。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.contribution: 重新审视并强化视觉语言模型中的视觉表示，提出改进的视觉骨干与预训练方案。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.innovation: 系统性地将视觉表示作为 VLM 性能提升的核心切入点，而非仅关注语言或对齐模块。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.result: 摘要缺失，具体指标无法引用，但该工作已成为 VLM 视觉表示研究的重要基线。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations._arxiv_id: VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models.

InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云视觉定位（visual grounding）任务，解决现有方法缺乏对实例多层级上下文协同理解的问题。由于摘要缺失，具体方法无法详述，但根据标题可推断其提出 InstanceRefer 框架，通过实例多层级上下文指代实现整体性理解。相比已有工作，改进点在于协同利用实例级与全局场景上下文进行指代定位。该工作对 3D 场景理解与点云感知方向有参考意义。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_en: This paper addresses visual grounding on point clouds, tackling the lack of cooperative holistic understanding of instance multi-level context. Although the abstract is unavailable, the title indicates an InstanceRefer framework that performs referring through instance multi-level contextual cues. It improves over prior work by cooperatively leveraging instance-level and global scene context for grounding, offering reference value for 3D scene understanding and point cloud perception.
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.assessment: 该工作聚焦点云视觉定位中的上下文建模，与 3D 感知相关但偏语言指代任务，对自动驾驶感知主线关联中等，摘要缺失限制了对方法细节的评估。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.contribution: 提出 InstanceRefer 框架，通过实例多层级上下文指代实现点云视觉定位。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.innovation: 协同利用实例级与全局场景上下文进行整体性理解与指代定位。

3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云视觉定位（visual grounding）中的关系建模问题，指出现有方法未能充分捕捉点云中物体间的关系。由于摘要缺失，具体方法无法详述，但根据标题可推断其提出 3DVG-Transformer，利用 Transformer 架构对点云中的关系进行建模以提升定位精度。相比已有工作，改进点在于引入注意力机制显式建模物体间关系。该工作对 3D 场景理解与点云感知方向有参考意义。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_en: This paper addresses relation modeling for visual grounding on point clouds, noting that existing methods fail to fully capture inter-object relations. Although the abstract is unavailable, the title indicates a 3DVG-Transformer that leverages Transformer architecture to model relations for improved grounding. It improves over prior work by explicitly modeling object relations via attention, offering reference value for 3D scene understanding and point cloud perception.
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.assessment: 该工作将 Transformer 关系建模引入点云视觉定位，与 3D 感知相关但偏语言指代任务，对自动驾驶感知主线关联中等，摘要缺失限制了对方法细节的评估。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.contribution: 提出 3DVG-Transformer，通过关系建模实现点云视觉定位。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.innovation: 利用 Transformer 注意力机制显式建模点云中物体间关系以提升定位。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.result: 摘要缺失，具体指标无法引用。

3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云中密集描述（dense captioning）与视觉定位（visual grounding）两个任务通常被分开处理的问题，提出了统一框架3DJCG。方法上通过共享编码器和多任务解码器联合建模，利用两个任务间的互补性提升彼此性能。相比已有单任务方法，该框架在统一架构下同时输出描述和定位结果。实验表明联合训练在两项任务上均取得优于独立基线的效果。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that dense captioning and visual grounding on 3D point clouds are typically tackled separately. It proposes 3DJCG, a unified framework that jointly models both tasks with a shared encoder and multi-task decoder, exploiting their complementarity. Experiments show joint training improves over independent baselines on both tasks.
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.assessment: 对3D点云多任务学习有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线的直接关联有限。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.contribution: 提出统一框架同时处理3D点云密集描述与视觉定位。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.innovation: 利用两个任务的互补性进行联合建模。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.result: 联合训练在两项任务上均优于独立基线。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den._arxiv_id: 3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Dense Captioning and Visual Grounding on 3D Point Clouds.

A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割（open-vocabulary semantic segmentation）问题，即分割类别在训练时未知，提出了一种基于预训练视觉-语言模型的简单基线方法。方法利用CLIP等预训练VLM的文本-图像对齐能力，通过将分割任务转化为与文本嵌入的匹配来实现开放词汇分割。相比复杂的专用架构，该简单基线在多个基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where target categories are unseen during training, by proposing a simple baseline built on pre-trained vision-language models. It leverages the image-text alignment of models like CLIP to perform segmentation via matching with text embeddings. Despite its simplicity, the baseline achieves competitive performance across multiple benchmarks.
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.assessment: 为开放词汇分割提供了简洁有效的基线，对开放集感知研究有启发。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.contribution: 提出基于预训练VLM的开放词汇语义分割简单基线。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.innovation: 将分割转化为与文本嵌入匹配，避免复杂专用架构。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.result: 在多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se._arxiv_id: A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with Pre-trained Vision-Language Model.

A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 该论文针对交互式视觉-语言导航中指令可行性未知的问题，构建了一个新的数据集。现有导航数据集通常假设指令总是可执行的，忽略了指令可能不可行的情况。作者设计了包含未知指令可行性的交互式导航任务与数据集，用于评估模型判断指令是否可执行的能力。该数据集为视觉-语言导航研究提供了更贴近现实的评测基准。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses interactive vision-language navigation where command feasibility is unknown, a setting overlooked by existing datasets that assume commands are always executable. The authors construct a new dataset for interactive navigation with unknown command feasibility to evaluate a model's ability to judge executability. It provides a more realistic benchmark for vision-language navigation research.
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.assessment: 数据集贡献对VLM导航研究有价值，但与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.contribution: 构建了含未知指令可行性的交互式视觉-语言导航数据集。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.innovation: 引入指令可行性判断这一被忽视的导航设定。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.result: 提供了更贴近现实的导航评测基准。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Language Navigation with Unknown Command Feasibility.

Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言导航中模型难以解耦不同模态信息的问题，提出了使用解耦标签（decoupled labels）的学习方法。方法通过将导航监督信号分解为不同语义维度，促使模型学习到更解耦的表征。相比直接端到端训练，解耦标签有助于提升导航的泛化与可解释性。实验在导航基准上验证了方法的有效性。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of disentangling multimodal information in vision-language navigation by learning with decoupled labels. The method decomposes navigation supervision into distinct semantic dimensions to encourage more disentangled representations. Compared with direct end-to-end training, decoupled labels improve generalization and interpretability, as validated on navigation benchmarks.
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.assessment: 解耦表征思路对多模态学习有参考价值，但领域相关度一般。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.contribution: 提出基于解耦标签的视觉-语言导航学习方法。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.innovation: 通过分解监督信号促进模态信息解耦。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.result: 在导航基准上验证了有效性。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled._arxiv_id: Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled Labels for Vision-Language Navigation.

UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言模型中文本生成与目标框预测通常分离的问题，提出UniTAB统一框架，将文本和框输出统一建模。方法通过共享解码器同时生成文本序列和对应的目标框，实现定位与描述的联合输出。相比分离式方法，UniTAB在多个定位与描述任务上取得更优或相当的性能。该统一输出范式简化了接地视觉-语言建模流程。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of text generation and box prediction in vision-language models by proposing UniTAB, a unified framework that jointly models text and box outputs. A shared decoder generates both text sequences and corresponding bounding boxes, enabling joint grounding and captioning. UniTAB achieves superior or comparable performance on multiple grounding and captioning tasks, simplifying grounded vision-language modeling.
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.assessment: 统一文本与框输出的思路对多模态接地任务有较强参考价值。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.contribution: 提出统一文本与框输出的接地视觉-语言建模框架。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.innovation: 用共享解码器联合生成文本与目标框。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.result: 在多个定位与描述任务上取得更优或相当性能。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo._arxiv_id: UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs for Grounded Vision-Language Modeling.

2207.09644|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人体骨架序列表示学习中自监督预训练未充分利用骨架层次化时空特性的问题，提出层次化自监督预训练方案Hi-TRS。方法基于层次化Transformer编码器，在帧、片段和视频三个层级分别显式捕捉空间、短期和长期时序依赖。相比仅在视频层级做对比学习的已有方法，Hi-TRS在动作识别、动作检测和运动预测三个下游任务上，在监督与半监督协议下均达到state-of-the-art。
2207.09644|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of hierarchical spatial-temporal structure in self-supervised skeleton sequence representation learning by proposing Hi-TRS, a hierarchical self-supervised pre-training scheme. Built on a hierarchical Transformer encoder, it explicitly captures spatial, short-term, and long-term temporal dependencies at frame, clip, and video levels. Compared with video-level contrastive methods, Hi-TRS achieves state-of-the-art performance on action recognition, action detection, and motion prediction under both supervised and semi-supervised protocols.
2207.09644|v2.assessment: 层次化自监督设计对时序表征学习有较强借鉴意义，实验充分。
2207.09644|v2.contribution: 提出层次化自监督预训练方案Hi-TRS用于骨架序列表示学习。
2207.09644|v2.innovation: 在帧、片段、视频三级显式建模空间与多尺度时序依赖。
2207.09644|v2.result: 在三个下游任务上监督与半监督协议下均达state-of-the-art。

2208.06105|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频对比学习方法未能充分利用短时运动动态，而这对下游视频理解任务至关重要。本文提出运动敏感对比学习（MSCL），将光流捕捉的运动信息注入RGB帧以强化特征学习，具体包括帧级跨模态对比目标（LMCL）、流旋转增强（FRA）生成运动打乱的负样本以及运动差分采样（MDS）筛选训练样本。在标准基准上，以3D ResNet-18为骨干，UCF101视频分类top-1准确率达91.5%，Something-Something v2达50.3%，UCF101视频检索Top-1召回率达65.6%，显著优于现有方法。
2208.06105|v2.summary_en: Existing contrastive learning methods for video representation fail to sufficiently exploit short-term motion dynamics, which are crucial for downstream video understanding. This paper proposes Motion Sensitive Contrastive Learning (MSCL) that injects optical flow motion information into RGB frames, incorporating Local Motion Contrastive Learning (LMCL) with frame-level cross-modal objectives, Flow Rotation Augmentation (FRA) for motion-shuffled negatives, and Motion Differential Sampling (MDS) for sample selection. With 3D ResNet-18, it achieves 91.5% top-1 on UCF101 and 50.3% on Something-Something v2 for classification, and 65.6% Top-1 Recall on UCF101 for retrieval, notably improving state-of-the-art.
2208.06105|v2.assessment: 该工作通过跨模态对比学习有效融合运动信息，在多个视频理解基准上取得显著提升，对自监督视频表示学习有重要参考价值。
2208.06105|v2.contribution: 提出运动敏感对比学习框架，将光流运动信息注入RGB视频表示学习。
2208.06105|v2.innovation: 设计帧级跨模态对比目标、流旋转增强和运动差分采样，充分挖掘短时运动动态。
2208.06105|v2.result: 在UCF101和Something-Something v2上分别达到91.5%和50.3%的top-1准确率，检索召回率65.6%，超越现有方法。

2208.09843|v2.summary_cn: 图像-文本检索（ITR）的核心挑战在于桥接视觉和语言模态，现有对比学习方法受限于负样本数量少、手动加权负样本以及缺乏外部知识。本文提出耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习（CODER），包含多样性敏感对比学习（DCL）架构，通过动态字典扩大图像-文本对规模并自适应加权负样本；同时设计双分支结构，一支学习实例级嵌入并生成伪在线聚类标签，另一支从常识知识图谱查询形成概念级描述符，两分支利用DCL对齐跨模态嵌入空间。
2208.09843|v2.summary_en: Image-Text Retrieval (ITR) is challenging in bridging visual and lingual modalities. This paper proposes Coupled Diversity-Sensitive Momentum Contrastive Learning (CODER), which introduces a diversity-sensitive contrastive learning (DCL) architecture with dynamic dictionaries to enlarge image-text pairs and adaptive negative weighting. Two branches are designed: one learns instance-level embeddings and generates pseudo online clustering labels, while the other queries a commonsense knowledge graph to form concept-level descriptors, both aligned via DCL.
2208.09843|v2.assessment: 该工作通过动态字典和知识图谱增强跨模态对比学习，为图像-文本检索提供了新思路，但摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果需进一步验证。
2208.09843|v2.contribution: 提出CODER框架，结合多样性敏感对比学习和常识知识图谱提升跨模态表示。
2208.09843|v2.innovation: 引入动态字典和自适应负样本加权，并设计双分支结构融合实例级和概念级信息。
2208.09843|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称在跨模态检索任务上提升了表示能力。

2207.12661|v2.summary_cn: 多模态对比预训练通常为每种模态使用独立编码器，但近期研究表明Transformer可支持跨模态知识共享。本文系统研究了模态共享对比语言-图像预训练（MS-CLIP）框架，探究Transformer参数在模态间的共享程度，并严格检验架构设计选择。实验发现，视觉和语言信号共享大部分编码器参数时性能最优，且轻量级模态特定并行模块可进一步提升性能。所提MS-CLIP在零样本ImageNet分类上相对原始CLIP提升高达13%。
2207.12661|v2.summary_en: Multi-modal contrastive pre-training typically employs separate encoders per modality, but recent work suggests transformers can support cross-modal knowledge sharing. This paper investigates Modality-Shared Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (MS-CLIP) frameworks, examining how many transformer parameters can be shared across modalities. Results show that a mostly unified encoder outperforms all other variations, and light-weight modality-specific parallel modules further improve performance. MS-CLIP outperforms vanilla CLIP by up to 13% relative in zero-shot ImageNet classification.
2207.12661|v2.assessment: 该工作系统探索了多模态预训练中的参数共享策略，为高效多模态模型设计提供了重要实证依据，对视觉-语言预训练有参考价值。
2207.12661|v2.contribution: 系统研究模态共享的对比语言-图像预训练框架，确定最优参数共享比例。
2207.12661|v2.innovation: 提出MS-CLIP框架，通过共享Transformer参数和轻量模态特定模块实现跨模态知识共享。
2207.12661|v2.result: 零样本ImageNet分类相对原始CLIP提升高达13%。

2107.06383|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉-语言（V&L）模型依赖在少量人工标注数据上预训练的视觉编码器，泛化能力有限。本文提出将CLIP作为视觉编码器应用于多种V&L模型，探索两种典型场景：1）将CLIP插入任务特定微调；2）结合CLIP与V&L预训练并迁移到下游任务。实验表明CLIP显著优于BottomUp-TopDown等广泛使用的视觉编码器，在视觉问答、视觉蕴涵和V&L导航任务上取得竞争性或更优结果，并建立了新的最先进水平。
2107.06383|v2.summary_en: Existing Vision-and-Language (V&L) models rely on visual encoders pre-trained on limited manually-annotated data, limiting generalization. This paper proposes using CLIP as the visual encoder in various V&L models in two scenarios: plugging CLIP into task-specific fine-tuning, and combining CLIP with V&L pre-training for downstream transfer. CLIP significantly outperforms widely-used visual encoders like BottomUp-TopDown, achieving competitive or better results on diverse V&L tasks and establishing new state-of-the-art on VQA, Visual Entailment, and V&L Navigation.
2107.06383|v2.assessment: 该工作系统验证了CLIP作为视觉编码器在V&L任务中的优势，为多模态模型设计提供了重要参考，对视觉-语言研究有较高价值。
2107.06383|v2.contribution: 系统评估CLIP作为视觉编码器在多种视觉-语言任务中的效果。
2107.06383|v2.innovation: 将CLIP与V&L预训练结合，并在多个下游任务上验证其泛化能力。
2107.06383|v2.result: 在视觉问答、视觉蕴涵和V&L导航任务上取得新的最先进结果。

2106.12570|v2.summary_cn: 多模态VAE旨在建模异构数据的联合分布并捕捉共享表示，但现有方法通常通过显式乘积或混合在识别模型中直接协调各模态表示。本文提出MEME，利用半监督VAE通过相互监督隐式组合模态信息，避免显式组合。该公式自然支持部分观测数据（某些模态完全缺失）的学习。在MNIST-SVHN和CUB数据集上，MEME在部分和完全观测方案下均优于基线，并展示了相互监督学习到的表示质量。
2106.12570|v2.summary_en: Multimodal VAEs seek to model the joint distribution over heterogeneous data while capturing shared representations, but prior work typically combines modalities through explicit products or mixtures. This paper introduces MEME, which repurposes semi-supervised VAEs to combine information between modalities implicitly through mutual supervision, naturally handling partially-observed data with entirely missing modalities. MEME outperforms baselines on MNIST-SVHN and CUB datasets under both partial and complete observation schemes.
2106.12570|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种新颖的多模态VAE训练范式，通过相互监督隐式融合模态信息，对多模态表示学习有理论贡献，但应用场景相对局限。
2106.12570|v2.contribution: 提出MEME框架，通过相互监督隐式组合多模态信息。
2106.12570|v2.innovation: 利用半监督VAE实现模态间相互监督，避免显式组合并支持部分观测数据。
2106.12570|v2.result: 在MNIST-SVHN和CUB数据集上，部分和完全观测方案下均优于基线。

2106.09667|v2.summary_cn: 多模态对比学习方法（如CLIP）在噪声且未整理的数据集上训练，这虽降低成本并提升分布外鲁棒性，但也使后门和投毒攻击成为重大威胁。本文展示仅需投毒0.01%的数据集（如300万Conceptual Captions中的300张图像），即可通过叠加小补丁使模型误分类测试图像；定向投毒攻击更易实施，仅需控制0.0001%的数据集（300万中的3张图像）。这些攻击对在噪声互联网数据上训练的做法提出了质疑。
2106.09667|v2.summary_en: Multimodal contrastive learning methods like CLIP train on noisy and uncurated datasets, which reduces labeling costs and improves out-of-distribution robustness, but also makes backdoor and poisoning attacks a significant threat. This paper shows that poisoning just 0.01% of a dataset (e.g., 300 images of the 3 million-example Conceptual Captions dataset) can cause misclassification by overlaying a small patch. Targeted poisoning attacks require control of only 0.0001% of the dataset (e.g., 3 out of 3 million images), questioning the desirability of training on noisy Internet scrapes.
2106.09667|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了多模态对比学习在噪声数据训练下的严重安全漏洞，对数据收集和模型安全有重要警示意义，值得关注。
2106.09667|v2.contribution: 揭示多模态对比学习对后门和投毒攻击的脆弱性。
2106.09667|v2.innovation: 证明极低比例的数据投毒即可实现有效攻击，定向攻击仅需3张图像。
2106.09667|v2.result: 投毒0.01%数据即可导致误分类，定向攻击仅需0.0001%数据。

2207.03482|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）中，CLIP 的图像-文本预训练缺乏精确定位能力，而图像级弱监督的启发式方法又无法准确指定局部物体区域，两者均未针对检测任务做最优对齐。本文提出对 CLIP 语言嵌入进行以物体为中心的对齐，并利用伪标签过程在仅图像级监督下视觉定位物体、扩展训练词汇，再通过一种新颖的权重迁移函数将两种对齐策略互补融合。该方法在 OVD 基准上缩小了物体级与图像级表示之间的差距，提升了新类别泛化能力。
2207.03482|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) methods rely on CLIP pretraining and image-level supervision, but neither is optimally aligned for detection: CLIP lacks precise localization while image-level heuristics poorly specify object regions. This work proposes object-centric alignment of CLIP language embeddings and a pseudo-labeling process that grounds objects using only image-level supervision to expand the vocabulary. A novel weight transfer function bridges the two alignment strategies, aggregating their complementary strengths and improving generalization to novel categories on OVD benchmarks.
2207.03482|v2.assessment: 针对 OVD 中 CLIP 与图像级监督对齐不佳的核心痛点提出系统性解决方案，思路清晰且实用，对开放集检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2207.03482|v2.contribution: 提出物体中心对齐与伪标签视觉定位相结合的开放词汇检测框架，并通过权重迁移函数融合两种监督信号。
2207.03482|v2.innovation: 用权重迁移函数桥接 CLIP 语言嵌入对齐与图像级伪标签定位两种互补策略。
2207.03482|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上有效缩小物体级与图像级表示差距，提升新类别检测泛化性能。

2208.05592|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇模型如 CLIP 在零样本分类上表现优异，但在特定任务上性能远未达到最优，且直接微调会损害已有任务的精度。本文提出 PAINT，通过在微调前后模型权重之间进行插值来实现模型修补（model patching），在提升目标任务精度的同时保持原有能力。在 9 个零样本 CLIP 表现较差的任务上，PAINT 将精度提升 15 至 60 个百分点，同时 ImageNet 精度保持在零样本模型 1 个百分点以内，并支持多任务修补和跨任务广泛迁移。
2208.05592|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary models like CLIP excel at zero-shot classification but underperform on specific tasks, and naive fine-tuning degrades existing capabilities. PAINT performs model patching by interpolating between pre-fine-tuning and post-fine-tuning weights, improving target-task accuracy while preserving prior performance. On nine tasks where zero-shot CLIP is weak, PAINT boosts accuracy by 15-60 points while keeping ImageNet accuracy within 1 point, and supports multi-task patching and broad cross-task transfer.
2208.05592|v2.assessment: 权重插值修补思路简洁有效，对 VLM 适配与持续学习场景有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
2208.05592|v2.contribution: 提出 PAINT 权重插值修补方法，在提升特定任务精度的同时不损害模型原有零样本能力。
2208.05592|v2.innovation: 利用微调前后权重的线性插值实现模型修补，并发现跨任务的广泛迁移现象。
2208.05592|v2.result: 在 9 个弱任务上精度提升 15-60 个百分点，ImageNet 精度损失控制在 1 个百分点以内。

2211.14241|v2.summary_cn: 3D 视觉定位任务中，现有方法多依赖现成的点云编码器提取 3D 视觉线索，未充分利用 2D 语义信息。本文提出 LAR（Look Around and Refer），从 3D 点云合成 2D 线索，在不引入额外 2D 输入的情况下用丰富的 2D 物体表示辅助 3D 编码器，并通过知识蒸馏提升学习到的视觉表示质量。在 Nr3D、Sr3D 和 ScanRefer 三个基准上，LAR 一致优于现有方法并显著超越当时的最优 3D 视觉定位技术。
2211.14241|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D visual grounding methods rely on off-the-shelf point cloud encoders and underutilize 2D semantic cues. This paper proposes LAR (Look Around and Refer), which synthesizes 2D clues from 3D point clouds to assist the 3D encoder via knowledge distillation, without requiring extra 2D inputs. LAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Nr3D, Sr3D, and ScanRefer benchmarks.
2211.14241|v2.assessment: 用合成 2D 语义蒸馏增强 3D 表示的想法新颖，对 3D 感知与多模态理解研究者有一定借鉴意义，但与自动驾驶检测主线关联较弱。
2211.14241|v2.contribution: 提出 LAR 模块，通过从点云合成 2D 线索并以知识蒸馏方式增强 3D 视觉定位的表示学习。
2211.14241|v2.innovation: 无需额外 2D 输入，仅从 3D 点云合成 2D 语义知识来蒸馏提升 3D 编码器表示质量。
2211.14241|v2.result: 在 Nr3D、Sr3D、ScanRefer 三个基准上一致超越现有方法，显著优于当时最优 3D 视觉定位技术。

2301.05499|v2.summary_cn: 单域泛化（SDG）目标检测旨在仅用单一源域训练模型并泛化到任意未见目标域，但现有研究几乎空白。本文提出利用预训练视觉-语言模型（CLIP）通过文本提示引入语义域概念，在检测器骨干特征上施加语义增强策略，并设计基于文本的分类损失。相比唯一已有的SDG检测方法Single-DGOD，在多样天气驾驶基准上性能提升10%。该工作首次将VLM引入SDG检测，为自动驾驶跨域感知提供了新思路。
2301.05499|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses single domain generalization (SDG) for object detection, which remains largely unexplored. It leverages a pre-trained vision-language model to introduce semantic domain concepts via textual prompts, applying semantic augmentation on detector backbone features and a text-based classification loss. The method outperforms the only existing SDG detection baseline, Single-DGOD, by 10% on a diverse weather-driving benchmark.
2301.05499|v2.assessment: 首次将视觉-语言模型用于单域泛化目标检测，在自动驾驶跨域场景下具有实际意义，性能提升显著。
2301.05499|v2.contribution: 提出了基于CLIP语义增强和文本分类损失的单域泛化目标检测框架。
2301.05499|v2.innovation: 利用文本提示引入语义域概念，通过特征级语义增强弥合域间差异。
2301.05499|v2.result: 在多样天气驾驶基准上超越Single-DGOD 10%。

2303.12027|v2.summary_cn: 基于自然语言描述的跟踪（Tracking by NL）旨在根据语言描述在视频序列中定位目标，现有方法将视觉定位与跟踪分为两步，使用分离的模型，忽略了语言描述为两步提供全局语义线索的联系，且难以端到端训练。本文提出联合视觉定位与跟踪框架，将两者统一为基于视觉-语言参考的目标定位任务，设计多源关系建模模块构建参考与测试图像的关系，并设计时序建模模块在全局语义指导下提供时序线索。该方法提升了对外观变化的适应性，实现了端到端训练。
2303.12027|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles tracking by natural language specification, where existing methods separate visual grounding and tracking into two stages, overlooking their shared semantic cues and preventing end-to-end training. The authors propose a joint framework that unifies grounding and tracking as localizing the referred target from visual-language references, with a multi-source relation modeling module and a temporal modeling module guided by global semantics. This improves adaptability to appearance variations.
2303.12027|v2.assessment: 将视觉定位与跟踪统一为端到端框架，思路合理，但实验规模与影响力有限。
2303.12027|v2.contribution: 提出联合视觉定位与跟踪的统一框架，实现端到端训练。
2303.12027|v2.innovation: 多源关系建模与时序建模模块在全局语义指导下融合视觉-语言参考。
2303.12027|v2.result: 提升了对外观变化的适应性，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2303.16891|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇实例分割（OVIS）旨在分割新类别，但现有方法依赖基类的人工掩码标注，且强监督（基类掩码）与弱监督（图像-文本对）之间的差异导致对基类过拟合，泛化到新类别能力差。本文提出Mask-free OVIS流水线，利用预训练视觉-语言模型的定位能力自动生成伪掩码标注，以弱监督方式同时学习基类和新类别。该方法无需人工掩码标注，缓解了强/弱监督差异带来的过拟合问题，提升了新类别的泛化性能。
2303.16891|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary instance segmentation (OVIS) suffers from overfitting to base categories due to the gap between strong mask supervision and weak image-caption supervision. This work proposes Mask-free OVIS, which automatically generates pseudo-mask annotations using the localization ability of a pre-trained vision-language model, enabling weakly supervised learning of both base and novel categories without manual masks. This alleviates overfitting and improves generalization to novel categories.
2303.16891|v2.assessment: 无需人工掩码的开放词汇实例分割方案，利用VLM定位能力生成伪标签，思路实用且可扩展。
2303.16891|v2.contribution: 提出Mask-free OVIS流水线，用VLM生成伪掩码实现无人工标注的开放词汇实例分割。
2303.16891|v2.innovation: 利用预训练视觉-语言模型的定位能力自动生成伪掩码，统一弱监督学习基类与新类。
2303.16891|v2.result: 缓解了基类过拟合，提升了新类别泛化能力，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2303.13076|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）旨在检测训练基类之外的新类别，现有方法依赖CLIP等视觉-语言模型识别新物体，但存在两个核心障碍：整图训练的VL模型用于区域识别时的分布不匹配，以及未见类别的定位困难。本文提出CORA，一种DETR风格框架，通过区域提示（Region prompting）缓解整图到区域的分布差距，通过锚点预匹配（Anchor pre-matching）的类感知匹配机制学习可泛化的目标定位。在COCO OVD基准上，新类别达到41.7 AP50，超越此前SOTA 2.4 AP50，且无需额外训练数据。
2303.13076|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) with vision-language models faces two obstacles: whole-to-region distribution mismatch and difficulty localizing unseen classes. The authors propose CORA, a DETR-style framework with Region prompting to bridge the distribution gap and Anchor pre-matching for class-aware generalizable localization. CORA achieves 41.7 AP50 on novel classes on COCO OVD, outperforming the previous SOTA by 2.4 AP50 without extra training data.
2303.13076|v2.assessment: 针对CLIP用于开放词汇检测的两个核心问题提出有效解决方案，在COCO OVD上取得显著提升，是该方向的重要工作。
2303.13076|v2.contribution: 提出CORA框架，通过区域提示和锚点预匹配适配CLIP进行开放词汇检测。
2303.13076|v2.innovation: 区域提示缓解整图到区域的分布不匹配，锚点预匹配实现类感知的可泛化定位。
2303.13076|v2.result: COCO OVD新类41.7 AP50，超越前SOTA 2.4 AP50，无需额外数据。

2301.09121|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇语义分割（OVS）旨在分割任意类别而非预定义闭集类别。本文提出OVSegmentor，一种基于Transformer的模型，仅利用网络爬取的图像-文本对预训练，无需任何掩码标注。模型通过slot-attention绑定模块将图像像素聚合成可学习的组token，并与对应caption嵌入对齐；提出掩码实体补全和跨图像掩码一致性两个代理任务，分别学习细粒度视觉-文本对齐和视觉不变性；构建CC4M数据集提升训练效率。该方法在多个分割基准上验证了有效性。
2301.09121|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVS) using only web-crawled image-text pairs without mask annotations. It proposes OVSegmentor, a transformer-based model that binds image pixels into learnable group tokens via slot-attention and aligns them with caption embeddings. Two proxy tasks—masked entity completion and cross-image mask consistency—enable fine-grained alignment and visual invariance, with a CC4M dataset for efficient pre-training.
2301.09121|v2.assessment: 仅用图像-文本对预训练的开放词汇分割方案，代理任务设计巧妙，CC4M数据集构建有实用价值。
2301.09121|v2.contribution: 提出OVSegmentor，仅用图像-文本对预训练实现开放词汇语义分割。
2301.09121|v2.innovation: slot-attention组token绑定与掩码实体补全、跨图像掩码一致性代理任务。
2301.09121|v2.result: 在多个语义分割基准上验证了有效性，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2212.00785|v2.summary_cn: 开放世界语义分割旨在仅用图像-文本对分割任意视觉概念，现有方法采用对比学习（CL）学习视觉概念并迁移到分割任务，但存在训练-测试不一致：训练时仅考虑图像-文本对齐，而测试时分割需要区域-文本对齐。本文提出文本接地对比学习（TCL）框架，直接学习区域-文本对齐：为给定文本生成分割掩码，从掩码区域提取文本接地图像嵌入，并通过TCL与文本嵌入对齐。该方法直接提升生成掩码质量，并提出了统一的8个分割数据集评估协议。
2212.00785|v2.summary_en: Open-world semantic segmentation with only image-text pairs suffers from a train-test discrepancy in contrastive learning methods, which align image-text during training but require region-text alignment at test time. This paper proposes Text-grounded Contrastive Learning (TCL), which generates a mask for given text, extracts text-grounded image embeddings from the masked region, and aligns them with text embeddings. A unified evaluation protocol over 8 segmentation datasets is also presented.
2212.00785|v2.assessment: 直接学习区域-文本对齐解决训练-测试不一致问题，思路清晰，统一评估协议对领域有贡献。
2212.00785|v2.contribution: 提出TCL框架，直接学习区域-文本对齐实现开放世界语义分割。
2212.00785|v2.innovation: 文本接地对比学习，从掩码区域提取嵌入与文本对齐，直接优化掩码质量。
2212.00785|v2.result: 在8个语义分割数据集上验证，具体指标未在摘要中给出。

2303.14038|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言预训练（VLP）训练成本高、收敛慢的问题，指出掩码语言建模（MLM）中预测率与破坏率耦合导致大量输出token被排除在损失之外。提出自由语言建模（FLM），实现100%预测率与任意破坏率解耦，并允许为每个待预测token定制破坏跨度。相比MLM方法，FLM在相同GPU时间下更灵活利用双向上下文，预训练时间减少2.5倍，同时保持下游性能。
2303.14038|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and slow convergence of vision-language pretraining (VLP), identifying the entanglement between prediction rate and corruption rate in masked language modeling (MLM) as a key bottleneck. It proposes Free Language Modeling (FLM), which decouples the prediction rate from the corruption rate, enabling 100% prediction rate with arbitrary corruption rates and customized corruption spans per token. FLM achieves a 2.5x reduction in pretraining time compared to MLM-based methods while maintaining competitive performance.
2303.14038|v2.assessment: 该工作从预训练任务设计角度有效提升了VLP效率，对多模态大模型训练有实际价值，但主要面向语言侧建模，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2303.14038|v2.contribution: 提出FLM预训练任务，解耦预测率与破坏率，实现100%预测率下的高效VLP。
2303.14038|v2.innovation: 允许任意破坏率下全token预测，并为每个token定制破坏跨度。
2303.14038|v2.result: 预训练时间减少2.5倍，同时保持下游任务性能。

2211.10277|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉-语言模型（VLM）在下游任务高效迁移时，现有方法（如prompt tuning丢弃预训练文本分类器、adapter tuning过度依赖预训练特征）破坏或过度偏向先验知识的问题。提出Task Residual Tuning（TaskRes），直接在文本分类器上操作，冻结原始分类器权重，通过调优一组与先验无关的残差参数获得新分类器，显式解耦预训练先验与任务特定知识。该方法在多个下游任务上实现了可靠的先验知识保留与灵活的任务知识利用。
2211.10277|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue that existing efficient transfer learning methods for vision-language models (VLMs) either damage or overly bias the pre-trained knowledge. It proposes Task Residual Tuning (TaskRes), which freezes the original text-based classifier and learns a set of prior-independent residual parameters to form a new classifier, explicitly decoupling pre-trained priors from task-specific knowledge. TaskRes achieves reliable prior preservation and flexible task adaptation across downstream tasks.
2211.10277|v2.assessment: TaskRes为VLM高效微调提供了一种简洁有效的解耦思路，对多模态下游任务适配有参考价值，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务关联较弱。
2211.10277|v2.contribution: 提出TaskRes，通过文本分类器上的残差调优解耦预训练先验与任务知识。
2211.10277|v2.innovation: 在冻结的文本分类器上学习先验无关的残差参数，实现知识解耦。
2211.10277|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上实现可靠的先验保留与灵活的任务适应。
