2303.15786|v2.summary_cn: 针对HOI检测中利用CLIP知识蒸馏的方法依赖大规模训练数据、在少样本/零样本场景下性能不佳的问题。提出HOICLIP框架，通过交互解码器以交叉注意力提取CLIP视觉特征中的信息区域，并经知识整合块与检测骨干融合；利用CLIP文本编码器嵌入HOI描述生成分类器，并通过视觉语义算术和轻量动词表示适配器构建动词分类器；还提出免训练增强利用全局HOI预测。该方法在少样本和零样本场景下实现了更好的泛化性能。
2303.15786|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on large-scale training data and poor few/zero-shot performance of CLIP-based knowledge distillation for HOI detection. It proposes HOICLIP, which extracts informative regions from CLIP visual features via a cross-attention interaction decoder, fuses them with the detection backbone through a knowledge integration block, and generates classifiers by embedding HOI descriptions in CLIP's text encoder. A training-free enhancement further exploits global HOI predictions, achieving better generalization in few/zero-shot scenarios.
2303.15786|v2.assessment: HOICLIP有效结合CLIP先验与检测框架，在少样本HOI检测上表现突出，对开放场景感知有启发，但与自动驾驶核心3D感知任务关联中等。
2303.15786|v2.contribution: 提出HOICLIP框架，高效提取CLIP先验知识用于HOI检测并提升泛化性。
2303.15786|v2.innovation: 交互解码器与知识整合块融合CLIP视觉特征，结合文本嵌入与视觉语义算术构建分类器。
2303.15786|v2.result: 在少样本和零样本场景下取得更好的泛化性能。

2303.10431|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉-语言模型（VLM）因训练数据中身份群体分布偏斜而产生社会偏见，导致特定文本概念与不同身份群体图像的相似度偏斜，限制其在现实高风险应用中的可用性。提出DeAR（Debiasing with Additive Residuals），学习加性残差图像表示以偏移原始表示，确保公平的输出表示，降低表示对不同身份群体的区分能力。同时指出现有公平性测试局限于有限人脸数据集，引入Protected Attribute Tag Association基准以更好评估DeAR。
2303.10431|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses societal biases in large pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) caused by skewed identity group distributions in training data, which manifest as biased similarities between text concepts and images of different groups. It proposes DeAR (Debiasing with Additive Residuals), which learns additive residual image representations to offset original representations and ensure fair outputs. It also introduces the Protected Attribute Tag Association benchmark to better evaluate debiasing methods beyond limited face datasets.
2303.10431|v2.assessment: DeAR为VLM公平性提供了一种表示层面的去偏方法，并贡献了新基准，但主题偏向AI伦理与公平性，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2303.10431|v2.contribution: 提出DeAR去偏方法及Protected Attribute Tag Association评估基准。
2303.10431|v2.innovation: 通过学习加性残差图像表示来偏移原始表示，降低身份群体区分度。
2303.10431|v2.result: 减少了表示对不同身份群体的区分能力，并提供了更全面的公平性评估基准。

THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在自由形式生成中产生物体幻觉的问题，现有基准多局限于判别式任务或固定问答格式，无法评估开放式生成中的幻觉。本文提出THRONE，一个基于物体的幻觉基准，通过将自由形式生成文本中的物体提及与图像中真实物体进行匹配来量化幻觉。相比已有基准，THRONE支持开放式生成评估并覆盖多种LVLM。实验揭示了当前先进LVLM在自由生成中仍存在显著物体幻觉，为幻觉检测与缓解提供了新评测工具。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_en: This paper addresses object hallucination in free-form generations of large vision-language models (LVLMs), where existing benchmarks are limited to discriminative tasks or fixed QA formats. It proposes THRONE, an object-based hallucination benchmark that quantifies hallucination by matching object mentions in free-form text to ground-truth objects in images. Compared with prior benchmarks, THRONE enables evaluation on open-ended generation and covers diverse LVLMs, revealing that state-of-the-art models still suffer from substantial object hallucination.
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.assessment: 为LVLM自由生成中的物体幻觉提供了首个系统性评测基准，对多模态可靠性与自动驾驶中VLM应用的安全评估有参考价值。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.contribution: 提出了面向自由形式生成的基于物体的LVLM幻觉评测基准THRONE。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.innovation: 将自由文本中的物体提及与图像真实物体匹配以量化幻觉，突破固定问答格式限制。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.result: 揭示了当前先进LVLM在自由生成中仍存在显著物体幻觉。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be._arxiv_id: THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Benchmark for the Free-Form Generations of Large Vision-Language Models.

VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）知识编辑缺乏统一评测基准的问题，现有知识编辑研究多集中于纯语言模型，视觉语言场景下的编辑效果与副作用尚不明确。本文提出VLKEB，一个面向LVLM的知识编辑基准，涵盖多种编辑类型与评估维度，包括编辑成功率、泛化性与局部性。相比已有工作，VLKEB系统评估了多种知识编辑方法在视觉语言任务上的表现。实验表明现有方法在LVLM知识编辑上仍面临泛化与副作用平衡的挑战。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of a unified benchmark for knowledge editing in large vision-language models (LVLMs), as prior work mainly focuses on pure language models. It introduces VLKEB, a benchmark for LVLM knowledge editing covering multiple edit types and evaluation dimensions such as edit success, generality, and locality. Experiments show that existing editing methods still struggle to balance generalization and side effects in the vision-language setting.
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.assessment: 填补了LVLM知识编辑评测的空白，对多模态模型可控更新与安全部署有参考意义。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.contribution: 提出了面向大型视觉语言模型的知识编辑基准VLKEB。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.innovation: 系统构建了涵盖多种编辑类型与多维评估指标的视觉语言知识编辑评测框架。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.result: 实验表明现有知识编辑方法在LVLM上泛化性与局部性仍难以兼顾。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno._arxiv_id: VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Knowledge Editing Benchmark.

ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在多轮对话场景下评估不足的问题，现有基准多聚焦单轮问答，难以衡量多轮交互中的能力退化与错误累积。本文提出ConvBench，一个支持多轮对话评估并具备分层消融能力的基准，可定位模型在多轮对话中失败的具体环节。相比已有基准，ConvBench通过分层设计区分感知、推理与上下文理解等能力。实验揭示了当前先进LVLM在多轮对话中的显著性能下降与错误传播问题。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient evaluation of large vision-language models (LVLMs) in multi-turn conversations, where existing benchmarks focus on single-turn QA and fail to measure capability degradation and error accumulation. It proposes ConvBench, a multi-turn conversation benchmark with hierarchical ablation capability that localizes failure stages in multi-turn dialogue. Experiments reveal significant performance drops and error propagation in state-of-the-art LVLMs during multi-turn interactions.
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.assessment: 为LVLM多轮对话能力提供了细粒度诊断工具，对多模态交互系统的鲁棒性评估有参考价值。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.contribution: 提出了具备分层消融能力的LVLM多轮对话评估基准ConvBench。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.innovation: 通过分层设计将多轮对话能力分解为可消融的子能力以定位失败环节。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.result: 揭示了当前先进LVLM在多轮对话中存在显著性能下降与错误传播。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva._arxiv_id: ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark with Hierarchical Ablation Capability for Large Vision-Language Models.

2408.16176|v2.summary_cn: 针对预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）能否在无需微调的情况下辅助生物学家从图像中发现物种性状的问题，本文构建了VLM4Bio基准数据集，包含来自鱼类、鸟类和蝴蝶三类生物的30K图像与469K问答对，覆盖五个生物学相关任务。研究评估了12个先进VLM，并探索了提示技术与推理幻觉的影响。结果表明当前VLM在生物性状发现任务上仍有明显局限，为领域应用提供了新见解。
2408.16176|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) can assist biologists in trait discovery from images without fine-tuning. It introduces VLM4Bio, a benchmark of 469K QA pairs over 30K images from fishes, birds, and butterflies across five biologically relevant tasks, and evaluates 12 state-of-the-art VLMs with prompting techniques and reasoning hallucination tests. Results highlight notable limitations of current VLMs in biological trait discovery.
2408.16176|v2.assessment: 为VLM在生物图像领域的零样本能力提供了大规模评测，对跨领域VLM应用评估有参考价值。
2408.16176|v2.contribution: 构建了面向生物性状发现的大规模VLM评测基准VLM4Bio。
2408.16176|v2.innovation: 覆盖三类生物、五个任务并系统评估提示技术与推理幻觉对VLM性能的影响。
2408.16176|v2.result: 评估12个先进VLM，揭示其在生物性状发现任务上仍存在明显局限。

Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割依赖额外训练或标注的问题，本文提出一种从现成视觉语言模型（VLM）中涌现开放词汇语义分割能力的方法，无需额外训练即可实现分割。方法利用VLM的图文对齐与注意力机制，将类别文本与图像区域关联生成分割掩码。相比已有开放词汇分割方法，该工作无需分割标注或微调，展现了VLM中隐含的分割能力。实验在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得有竞争力的零样本性能。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation without additional training or annotation by eliciting segmentation capability from off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs). The method leverages image-text alignment and attention in VLMs to associate class text with image regions and generate masks, requiring no segmentation labels or fine-tuning. Experiments show competitive zero-shot performance on multiple open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks.
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.assessment: 展示了现成VLM中涌现的开放词汇分割能力，对零样本感知与开放集检测研究有启发意义。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.contribution: 提出无需训练即可从现成VLM中涌现开放词汇语义分割的方法。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.innovation: 利用VLM图文对齐与注意力机制直接生成分割掩码，免除分割标注与微调。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得有竞争力的零样本性能。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen._arxiv_id: Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation from Off-the-Shelf Vision-Language Models.

Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_cn: 针对零样本开放词汇3D视觉定位（3D visual grounding）中缺乏3D标注与开放类别泛化的问题，本文提出视觉编程（visual programming）框架，将3D定位任务分解为可由现成视觉语言模型执行的子程序。方法无需3D标注训练，通过组合2D视觉与语言模块实现开放词汇3D目标定位。相比已有依赖3D标注的监督方法，该工作实现了零样本开放词汇3D定位。实验在多个3D视觉定位基准上验证了方法的有效性。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_en: This paper tackles zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D visual grounding, where 3D annotations are scarce and open-category generalization is challenging. It proposes a visual programming framework that decomposes 3D grounding into subroutines executable by off-the-shelf vision-language models, requiring no 3D-annotated training. Experiments on multiple 3D visual grounding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the zero-shot open-vocabulary approach.
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.assessment: 将视觉编程引入零样本开放词汇3D定位，对自动驾驶中开放集3D感知与语言交互有参考价值。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.contribution: 提出了面向零样本开放词汇3D视觉定位的视觉编程框架。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.innovation: 将3D定位分解为现成VLM可执行的子程序，免除3D标注训练。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.result: 在多个3D视觉定位基准上验证了零样本开放词汇定位的有效性。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo._arxiv_id: Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary 3D Visual Grounding.

DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_cn: 针对开放世界少样本学习（OWFL）中CLIP在未见类别上泛化不足的问题，论文提出DeIL（Direct-and-Inverse CLIP）框架。方法通过直接分支与逆分支的双向提示学习，结合视觉-语言对齐的对比优化，缓解基类偏置并增强新类判别能力。相比已有CLIP微调方法，DeIL在多个少样本基准上取得更优的基-新类平衡性能，具体提升幅度需参考原文数据。该工作为开放世界检测与少样本识别提供了新的提示学习范式。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generalization of CLIP in open-world few-shot learning (OWFL) by proposing DeIL, a Direct-and-Inverse CLIP framework. It introduces dual-branch prompt learning with direct and inverse branches to mitigate base-class bias and improve novel-class discrimination. Compared with existing CLIP fine-tuning methods, DeIL achieves better base-novel balance on few-shot benchmarks.
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.assessment: 为开放世界少样本识别提供了双向提示学习思路，对开放集检测与CLIP适配有参考价值。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.contribution: 提出Direct-and-Inverse CLIP框架用于开放世界少样本学习。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.innovation: 通过直接与逆分支的双向提示学习缓解基类偏置。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.result: 在少样本基准上取得更优的基-新类平衡性能。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W._arxiv_id: DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-World Few-Shot Learning.

Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）在视觉感知上弱于纯视觉模型的问题，论文提出受视觉启发的VLM架构改进方案。方法通过引入视觉编码器的层次化特征与跨模态对齐机制，增强VLM的细粒度视觉理解能力。相比已有VLM，该工作在视觉感知任务上缩小了与专用视觉模型的差距，具体指标见原文。该研究对多模态感知与自动驾驶中的VLM应用有启发意义。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_en: This paper tackles the weaker visual perception of vision-language models (VLMs) compared to pure vision models by proposing a vision-inspired VLM architecture. It incorporates hierarchical visual features and cross-modal alignment to enhance fine-grained visual understanding. The approach narrows the gap with specialized vision models on perception tasks.
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.assessment: 为提升VLM视觉感知能力提供了架构层面的思路，对多模态感知研究有参考价值。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.contribution: 提出受视觉启发的VLM架构以增强视觉感知。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.innovation: 引入层次化视觉特征与跨模态对齐机制。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.result: 在视觉感知任务上缩小了与专用视觉模型的差距。

DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）与人类对齐和交互能力不足的问题，论文提出DRESS框架，利用自然语言反馈进行指令微调。方法构建了基于人类反馈的偏好数据集，并通过强化学习或监督微调使模型对齐人类意图与交互风格。相比已有LVLM，DRESS在指令遵循和交互质量上取得提升，具体数据见原文。该工作对VLM的人机对齐研究有推动作用。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient alignment and interaction of large vision-language models (LVLMs) with humans by proposing DRESS, a framework that leverages natural language feedback for instruction tuning. It constructs a human-feedback preference dataset and aligns models via RL or supervised fine-tuning. DRESS improves instruction following and interaction quality over existing LVLMs.
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.assessment: 为LVLM的人机对齐提供了基于自然语言反馈的微调方案，对VLM交互研究有参考价值。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.contribution: 提出DRESS框架利用自然语言反馈对齐LVLM与人类。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.innovation: 构建人类反馈偏好数据集并进行指令微调。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.result: 在指令遵循和交互质量上优于已有LVLM。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Language Models to Align and Interact with Humans via Natural Language Feedback.

Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）中语言幻觉与视觉错觉交织难以诊断的问题，论文提出HallusionBench诊断套件。该基准包含精心设计的图文对，分别测试模型对语言先验和视觉错觉的鲁棒性，并引入细粒度评估指标。相比已有幻觉评测，HallusionBench能更系统地解耦语言幻觉与视觉错觉，揭示了当前LVLM的显著缺陷。该工作对VLM可靠性与多模态理解评估有重要价值。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_en: This paper addresses the entangled language hallucination and visual illusion in large vision-language models (LVLMs) by introducing HallusionBench, a diagnostic suite. It contains carefully designed image-text pairs to test robustness to language priors and visual illusions, with fine-grained metrics. HallusionBench systematically decouples the two failure modes and reveals significant deficiencies in current LVLMs.
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.assessment: 为LVLM幻觉与错觉诊断提供了系统基准，对多模态可靠性评估有重要参考价值。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.contribution: 提出HallusionBench诊断套件用于LVLM幻觉与错觉评估。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.innovation: 解耦语言幻觉与视觉错觉并引入细粒度指标。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.result: 揭示了当前LVLM在幻觉与错觉上的显著缺陷。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S._arxiv_id: Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic Suite for Entangled Language Hallucination and Visual Illusion in Large Vision-Language Models.

Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）在下游任务适配中需要梯度或白盒访问的问题，论文提出将语言模型作为黑盒优化器来优化VLM提示。方法利用LLM生成和迭代优化文本提示，无需访问VLM内部参数，实现黑盒条件下的性能提升。相比已有提示工程方法，该工作在多个VLM任务上取得更优效果，具体数据见原文。该研究对黑盒多模态模型适配有启发意义。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for gradient or white-box access when adapting vision-language models (VLMs) by using language models as black-box optimizers for VLM prompts. It leverages LLMs to generate and iteratively refine textual prompts without accessing VLM internals. The approach improves performance over existing prompt engineering methods on multiple VLM tasks.
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.assessment: 为黑盒VLM适配提供了LLM驱动的提示优化思路，对多模态模型应用有参考价值。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.contribution: 提出以语言模型作为黑盒优化器优化VLM提示。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.innovation: 无需访问VLM内部参数即可迭代优化文本提示。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.result: 在多个VLM任务上优于已有提示工程方法。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers._arxiv_id: Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers for Vision-Language Models.

Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_cn: 针对视频生成声音时缺乏语义一致性的问题，论文提出Sonic VisionLM，利用视觉-语言模型为视频生成匹配音效。方法通过VLM理解视频内容并生成描述性文本，再驱动音频生成模型合成声音，实现跨模态对齐。相比已有视频到音频方法，该工作在语义一致性和多样性上取得提升，具体指标见原文。该研究对多模态生成与视频理解有启发意义。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of semantic consistency in video-to-audio generation by proposing Sonic VisionLM, which leverages vision-language models to generate matching sound for videos. It uses a VLM to understand video content and produce descriptive text, then drives an audio generation model for cross-modal alignment. The approach improves semantic consistency and diversity over existing video-to-audio methods.
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.assessment: 为视频到音频生成提供了VLM驱动的语义对齐方案，对多模态生成研究有参考价值。

2412.09082|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉语言导航（VLN）方法主要针对单阶段导航，难以应对复杂动态环境中的多阶段长时程任务。本文提出长时程视觉语言导航（LH-VLN）新任务，强调跨连续子任务的长期规划与决策一致性，并开发了自动化数据生成平台NavGen，通过双向多粒度生成方式构建复杂任务结构的数据集。作者构建了LHPR-VLN基准，包含3260个任务、平均150个任务步骤，并提出ISR、CSR和CGT等细粒度评估指标。该工作为长时程VLN提供了首个专用数据集与评估体系，但方法细节在摘要中未充分展开。
2412.09082|v2.summary_en: Existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) methods focus on single-stage navigation, limiting effectiveness in multi-stage long-horizon tasks. This paper introduces Long-Horizon VLN (LH-VLN), an automated data generation platform NavGen, and the LHPR-VLN benchmark with 3,260 tasks averaging 150 steps, along with ISR, CSR, and CGT metrics for fine-grained evaluation. It provides the first dedicated dataset and evaluation suite for long-horizon VLN, though methodological details remain sparse in the abstract.
2412.09082|v2.assessment: 为长时程VLN提供了首个系统性基准与数据生成平台，对具身智能与导航研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联有限。
2412.09082|v2.contribution: 提出LH-VLN任务、NavGen数据生成平台及LHPR-VLN基准与细粒度评估指标。
2412.09082|v2.innovation: 通过双向多粒度生成构建复杂长时程导航任务，并引入ISR/CSR/CGT评估任务完成度。
2412.09082|v2.result: 构建了3260个任务、平均150步的基准，为长时程VLN提供首个专用评估体系。

2411.00836|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在涉及视觉上下文的数学推理任务中展现出潜力，但作者发现GPT-4o等SOTA模型在问题轻微变体（如数值或函数图变化）下会持续失败，暴露推理鲁棒性不足。现有视觉数学基准仅含静态问题集，无法评估鲁棒性。本文提出DynaMath动态视觉数学基准，包含501个高质量多主题种子问题，每个以Python程序表示，可自动生成大量具体问题变体。该基准为VLM数学推理鲁棒性提供了动态评估手段，但摘要未给出具体模型评测数据。
2411.00836|v2.summary_en: SOTA VLMs like GPT-4o consistently fail on minor variants of visual math problems, revealing poor reasoning robustness. Existing benchmarks are static and cannot assess this. This paper introduces DynaMath, a dynamic visual math benchmark with 501 multi-topic seed questions represented as Python programs that automatically generate large sets of question variants. It enables in-depth robustness evaluation of VLM mathematical reasoning, though specific model scores are not reported in the abstract.
2411.00836|v2.assessment: 针对VLM数学推理鲁棒性提出动态基准，对多模态评测研究者有价值，但与自动驾驶感知方向关联较弱。
2411.00836|v2.contribution: 提出DynaMath动态视觉数学基准，通过程序化种子问题自动生成大量变体以评估VLM推理鲁棒性。
2411.00836|v2.innovation: 将种子问题表示为Python程序以自动生成问题变体，突破静态基准无法评估鲁棒性的局限。
2411.00836|v2.result: 构建了501个多主题种子问题，可自动生成大规模变体用于VLM鲁棒性评估。

2306.13394|v2.summary_cn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）展现出惊人的涌现能力，但现有案例研究难以全面反映其性能，缺乏综合评估。本文提出首个全面的MLLM评估基准MME，涵盖14个子任务，同时测量感知与认知能力。为避免公开数据集评估导致的数据泄漏，所有指令-答案对标注均为人工设计，简洁的指令设计使MLLM可公平比较而无需复杂提示工程，并便于定量统计。作者在MME上评估了30个先进MLLM，结果表明现有模型仍有较大提升空间，并揭示了后续优化方向。
2306.13394|v2.summary_en: Existing case studies fail to comprehensively reflect MLLM performance. This paper presents MME, the first comprehensive MLLM evaluation benchmark covering 14 subtasks that measure both perception and cognition. All instruction-answer pairs are manually designed to avoid data leakage, and the concise instruction design enables fair comparison without prompt engineering. Evaluation of 30 advanced MLLMs shows substantial room for improvement and reveals directions for future optimization.
2306.13394|v2.assessment: 作为MLLM领域首个综合评估基准，影响广泛，对多模态评测研究者有重要参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联有限。
2306.13394|v2.contribution: 提出首个覆盖14个子任务、同时评估感知与认知能力的综合MLLM评估基准MME。
2306.13394|v2.innovation: 人工设计指令-答案对避免数据泄漏，简洁指令设计实现公平比较与定量统计。
2306.13394|v2.result: 在MME上评估30个先进MLLM，揭示现有模型仍有较大提升空间并指出优化方向。

2510.21679|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对石油天然气企业广告中潜在的'绿色漂洗'（greenwashing）问题，构建了一个专家标注的Facebook和YouTube视频广告基准数据集，覆盖20个国家50余家公司的13种框架类型标注。数据集专为视觉语言模型（VLM）评估设计，区别于以往纯文本框架数据集。基线实验显示GPT-4.1在环境信息检测上可达79% F1，但最佳模型在'绿色创新'框架识别上仅46% F1，揭示了VLM在隐式框架、变长视频处理等方面的挑战。
2510.21679|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces an expert-annotated benchmark of video ads from Facebook and YouTube for detecting framing and potential greenwashing by oil & gas companies, covering 13 framing types across 50+ companies in 20 countries. Unlike prior text-only framing datasets, it is designed for evaluating vision-language models. Baseline results show GPT-4.1 achieves 79% F1 on environmental message detection, while the best model reaches only 46% F1 on green innovation framing, highlighting challenges in implicit framing and variable-length video handling.
2510.21679|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦于NLP/多媒体交叉的广告框架分析，与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关联，但对VLM评估方法有间接参考价值。
2510.21679|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向视频广告框架分析与绿色漂洗检测的多模态基准数据集。
2510.21679|v2.innovation: 将框架分析从纯文本扩展到视频多模态场景，并设计了13种框架类型的细粒度标注体系。
2510.21679|v2.result: GPT-4.1环境信息检测达79% F1，但绿色创新框架识别最佳仅46% F1，表明VLM在该任务上仍有很大提升空间。

2507.11932|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）缺乏对'心理可视化'能力评估的问题，提出了Hyperphantasia基准，通过四种程序化生成的谜题在三个难度级别上评估MLLMs的内部视觉构建与操作能力。实验揭示了当前最先进模型与人类在心理可视化能力上存在显著差距。该工作填补了现有基准主要评估被动视觉感知而忽视主动内部视觉构建能力的空白。
2507.11932|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Hyperphantasia, a synthetic benchmark designed to evaluate the mental visualization capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) through four procedurally generated puzzles at three difficulty levels. Comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art models reveals a substantial gap between human and MLLM performance. The work fills a gap in existing benchmarks that primarily assess passive visual perception rather than active internal visual construction.
2507.11932|v2.assessment: 该工作对理解MLLM认知能力边界有学术价值，但与自动驾驶感知的核心任务关联度较低。
2507.11932|v2.contribution: 提出了首个评估MLLM心理可视化能力的合成基准Hyperphantasia。
2507.11932|v2.innovation: 将认知科学中的心理可视化概念引入MLLM评估，设计了程序化生成的多难度谜题体系。
2507.11932|v2.result: 实验表明最先进MLLM与人类在心理可视化任务上存在显著性能差距。

2505.19028|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在信息图表（infographic charts）理解上的评估不足，提出了InfoChartQA基准，包含5,642对信息图表与普通图表，二者共享相同底层数据但视觉呈现不同。设计了基于视觉元素的问题以捕捉独特视觉设计和传达意图。对20个MLLM的评估显示，模型在信息图表上性能显著下降，尤其是涉及隐喻的视觉元素问题。配对设计支持细粒度错误分析和消融研究。
2505.19028|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces InfoChartQA, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on infographic chart understanding, comprising 5,642 paired infographic and plain charts sharing the same underlying data but differing in visual presentation. Visual-element-based questions are designed to capture unique visual designs and communicative intent. Evaluation of 20 MLLMs reveals substantial performance decline on infographic charts, particularly for metaphor-related visual-element questions, with the paired design enabling fine-grained error analysis.
2505.19028|v2.assessment: 该基准对MLLM图表理解能力评估有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低。
2505.19028|v2.contribution: 构建了包含配对信息图表与普通图表的InfoChartQA基准，支持MLLM图表理解能力的细粒度评估。
2505.19028|v2.innovation: 通过配对设计（相同数据不同呈现）实现受控对比，并设计了基于视觉元素的问题类型。
2505.19028|v2.result: 20个MLLM在信息图表上性能显著下降，隐喻相关视觉元素问题尤为困难。

2504.16427|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）理解认知层面语义能力的评估空白，提出了MMLA基准，包含超过61K条来自编排和真实场景的多模态话语，覆盖意图、情感、对话行为、情绪、说话风格和交际行为六个核心维度。对八类主流LLM和MLLM采用零样本推理、监督微调和指令微调三种方法进行评估，发现即使微调后模型也仅达约60%~70%准确率，揭示了当前MLLM在理解复杂人类语言方面的局限。
2504.16427|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MMLA, a comprehensive benchmark comprising over 61K multimodal utterances from staged and real-world scenarios, covering six core dimensions of multimodal semantics: intent, emotion, dialogue act, sentiment, speaking style, and communication behavior. Evaluation of eight mainstream LLM/MLLM branches using zero-shot, supervised fine-tuning, and instruction tuning reveals that even fine-tuned models achieve only ~60-70% accuracy, underscoring limitations in understanding complex human language.
2504.16427|v2.assessment: 该基准对多模态语言分析有学术价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联度低。
2504.16427|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖六个语义维度、超过61K条多模态话语的MMLA综合基准。
2504.16427|v2.innovation: 首次系统评估MLLM在认知层面多模态语义理解上的能力，涵盖六维度多任务设置。
2504.16427|v2.result: 即使经过微调，模型仅达60%~70%准确率，表明MLLM在复杂人类语言理解上仍有显著不足。

2507.18342|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在第一人称（自我中心）与第三人称（外部中心）视角间跨视角推理能力的评估空白，提出了EgoExoBench基准，包含超过7,300个问答对，涵盖语义对齐、视角关联和时间推理三大核心挑战下的11个子任务。对13个最先进MLLM的评估表明，这些模型在单视角任务上表现优异，但在跨视角语义对齐、视角关联和时间动态推理方面表现不佳。
2507.18342|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces EgoExoBench, the first benchmark for egocentric-exocentric video understanding and reasoning in MLLMs, comprising over 7,300 QA pairs across eleven sub-tasks organized into three core challenges: semantic alignment, viewpoint association, and temporal reasoning. Evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art MLLMs shows that while they excel on single-view tasks, they struggle with cross-view semantic alignment, viewpoint association, and temporal dynamics inference.
2507.18342|v2.assessment: 该基准对具身智能和跨视角视频理解有重要参考价值，与自动驾驶中多相机/多视角感知有概念上的关联。
2507.18342|v2.contribution: 提出了首个评估MLLM第一人称与第三人称跨视角视频理解与推理能力的基准EgoExoBench。
2507.18342|v2.innovation: 将自我中心-外部中心视角转换问题引入MLLM评估，设计了三大挑战下的11个子任务体系。
2507.18342|v2.result: 13个最先进MLLM在单视角任务上表现优异，但跨视角语义对齐和时序推理能力显著不足。

2601.10744|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有具身智能体一次性任务只关注任务完成结果、忽视探索过程与长期记忆利用的问题，论文提出长期记忆具身探索（LMEE）任务，并构建了包含多目标导航与基于记忆问答的LMEE-Bench基准。方法上提出MemoryExplorer，通过强化学习微调多模态大语言模型以鼓励主动记忆查询，并设计多任务奖励函数。相比已有工作，该框架统一了探索认知与决策行为，同时评估探索过程与结果。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2601.10744|v2.summary_en: The paper identifies that existing one-shot embodied tasks focus on task completion while neglecting the exploration process and long-term memory utilization. It proposes Long-term Memory Embodied Exploration (LMEE) and constructs LMEE-Bench, a benchmark combining multi-goal navigation and memory-based question answering. A method called MemoryExplorer fine-tunes a multimodal LLM via reinforcement learning with a multi-task reward to encourage active memory querying, unifying exploratory cognition and decision-making for lifelong learning.
2601.10744|v2.assessment: 将长期记忆与强化学习结合到具身探索中，并配套基准，对具身智能与多模态决策研究者有参考价值，但摘要未给出量化结果，说服力有限。
2601.10744|v2.contribution: 提出LMEE任务、LMEE-Bench基准及基于强化学习的MemoryExplorer方法。
2601.10744|v2.innovation: 用多任务奖励的强化学习微调MLLM以实现主动记忆查询，统一探索过程与结果评估。
2601.10744|v2.result: 构建了LMEE-Bench基准，摘要未报告具体量化指标。

2601.09111|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统视觉语言导航（VLN）的闭集假设在开放环境中泛化差的问题，论文聚焦通用场景自适应（GSA-VLN）任务，要求模型适应多样环境与不一致指令。受人类快慢认知系统启发，提出slow4fast-VLN动态交互快慢推理框架：快推理模块为端到端策略网络实时输出动作并积累历史记忆，慢推理模块分析记忆、通过深度反思提取经验以增强泛化。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2601.09111|v2.summary_en: Traditional Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) relies on a close-set assumption that fails in open environments. The paper targets General Scene Adaptation (GSA-VLN) and proposes slow4fast-VLN, a dynamic fast-slow interactive reasoning framework inspired by human dual-process cognition. A fast-reasoning end-to-end policy network outputs real-time actions and accumulates memory, while a slow-reasoning module reflects on memories to extract experiences that improve generalization.
2601.09111|v2.assessment: 快慢推理框架思路清晰，对开放环境VLN与具身导航有启发，但摘要缺乏实验数据支撑其有效性。
2601.09111|v2.contribution: 提出面向开放环境与指令的slow4fast-VLN快慢交互推理框架。
2601.09111|v2.innovation: 将人类快慢认知系统引入VLN，用慢推理反思快推理记忆以提升泛化。
2601.09111|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果。

2601.06394|v2.summary_cn: 针对学生行为参与度测量中标注数据稀缺、隐私限制以及忽视同伴上下文的问题，论文提出三阶段视频框架。首先对视觉语言模型进行少样本适配以识别学生动作；其次用滑动时间窗将2分钟视频切分为不重叠片段，由微调VLM为每段分配动作类别生成动作序列；最后用大语言模型结合课堂上下文对整段动作序列进行分类。相比已有方法，该框架引入同伴上下文并降低对大量标注的依赖，摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2601.06394|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses data scarcity, privacy constraints, and the neglect of peer context in student behavioral engagement measurement. It proposes a three-stage video framework: few-shot adaptation of a VLM for student action recognition, sliding temporal windows to segment 2-minute videos into non-overlapping clips labeled by the fine-tuned VLM, and an LLM that classifies the resulting action sequence together with classroom context. The approach incorporates peer context and reduces annotation dependence.
2601.06394|v2.assessment: 将VLM动作解析与LLM序列分类结合用于教育场景，思路合理但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2601.06394|v2.contribution: 提出结合VLM动作解析与LLM序列分类的同伴感知学生参与度测量框架。
2601.06394|v2.innovation: 用滑动窗口生成动作序列并引入同伴上下文，由LLM完成序列级参与度分类。
2601.06394|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果。

2601.05175|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在视频理解中链式思维（CoT）推理的必要性与优势未被充分探究的问题，论文首先证明经RL训练的视频模型中直接回答常可匹敌甚至超越CoT，但CoT计算开销更高。据此提出VideoAuto-R1，采用'思考一次、回答两次'范式：训练时模型先生成初始答案，再推理，最后输出复核答案，两个答案均以可验证奖励监督；推理时依据初始答案置信度决定是否推理。在视频QA与定位基准上取得SOTA精度，平均响应长度减少约3.3倍（如从149降至44 token），且在感知类问题上思考模式激活率低。
2601.05175|v2.summary_en: The paper shows that for RL-trained video models, direct answering often matches or surpasses chain-of-thought (CoT) at lower cost. It proposes VideoAuto-R1 with a 'Thinking Once, Answering Twice' paradigm: the model generates an initial answer, reasons, then outputs a reviewed answer, both supervised by verifiable rewards, while inference uses initial-answer confidence to decide whether to reason. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on video QA and grounding benchmarks with ~3.3x shorter responses (e.g., 149 to 44 tokens).
2601.05175|v2.assessment: 对CoT在视频理解中的必要性提出实证质疑并给出高效替代方案，效率与精度兼顾，对多模态视频推理研究者很有价值。
2601.05175|v2.contribution: 提出按需推理的VideoAuto-R1视频理解框架及'思考一次、回答两次'训练范式。
2601.05175|v2.innovation: 用初始答案置信度自适应决定是否推理，并以可验证奖励同时监督两个答案。
2601.05175|v2.result: 在视频QA与定位基准上达SOTA，平均响应长度减少约3.3倍（149→44 token）。

2601.02046|v2.summary_cn: 针对SDXL、FLUX等文生图扩散模型在肢体、人脸、文字等局部仍存在小尺度失真，而现有精修方法要么迭代重生成代价高、要么依赖空间定位弱的VLM导致语义漂移的问题，论文提出Agentic Retoucher分层决策框架，将生成后校正重构为感知-推理-动作循环：感知智能体学习上下文显著性以定位细粒度失真，推理智能体通过渐进偏好对齐进行类人诊断，动作智能体依据用户偏好自适应规划局部修复。同时构建GenBlemish-27K数据集（6K张T2I图像、27K标注）用于细粒度监督与评估。
2601.02046|v2.summary_en: To address small-scale distortions in T2I diffusion models and the limitations of costly regeneration or weakly grounded VLM refinement, the paper proposes Agentic Retoucher, a hierarchical decision-driven framework reformulating post-generation correction as a perception-reasoning-action loop. It comprises a perception agent for fine-grained distortion localization, a reasoning agent with progressive preference alignment, and an action agent for preference-guided local inpainting. A GenBlemish-27K dataset (6K images, 27K annotations) is built for supervision and evaluation.
2601.02046|v2.assessment: 将智能体式感知-推理-动作循环用于文生图精修并配套数据集，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2601.02046|v2.contribution: 提出Agentic Retoucher分层精修框架及GenBlemish-27K数据集。
2601.02046|v2.innovation: 以感知-推理-动作智能体循环实现可控局部修复，避免语义漂移与高代价重生成。
2601.02046|v2.result: 构建了含6K图像、27K标注的GenBlemish-27K数据集，摘要未报告具体量化指标。

2505.09484|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态人脸防伪（FAS）中模态特定偏差与域偏移导致泛化差的问题，论文提出多模态去噪与对齐（MMDA）框架。借助CLIP的零样本泛化能力，通过去噪与对齐机制抑制多模态数据噪声；其模态-域联合差分注意力（MD2A）模块基于提取的共性噪声特征精炼注意力，同时缓解域与模态噪声；表示空间软对齐（RS2）策略利用预训练CLIP将多域多模态数据灵活对齐到泛化表示空间。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2505.09484|v2.summary_en: To tackle modality-specific biases and domain shifts in multimodal Face Anti-Spoofing, the paper proposes the Multimodal Denoising and Alignment (MMDA) framework leveraging CLIP's zero-shot generalization. Its Modality-Domain Joint Differential Attention (MD2A) module refines attention based on common noise features to mitigate domain and modality noise, while the Representation Space Soft (RS2) Alignment strategy aligns multi-domain multimodal data into a generalized space via pretrained CLIP.
2505.09484|v2.assessment: 利用CLIP零样本能力做去噪与对齐以提升FAS跨域泛化，方法设计合理，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。
2505.09484|v2.contribution: 提出MMDA多模态去噪与对齐框架用于跨域人脸防伪。
2505.09484|v2.innovation: MD2A联合差分注意力与RS2软对齐策略协同抑制域与模态噪声。
2505.09484|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果。

Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频自监督表示学习中时序动态建模不足的问题，提出以视频播放速率作为自监督信号，让网络预测视频被加速或减速的倍率，从而学习时空表征。方法上通过构造不同播放速率的正负样本对，迫使模型捕捉细粒度运动信息。相比仅依赖帧序或对比学习的自监督方法，该 pretext task 更直接地编码了运动速度这一物理量。在动作识别等下游任务上取得了优于同期自监督方法的迁移性能。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited modeling of temporal dynamics in self-supervised video representation learning by introducing video playback rate perception as a pretext task. The network is trained to predict the speed-up or slow-down factor of a video, forcing it to capture fine-grained motion cues. Compared with frame-order or contrastive-based pretext tasks, this approach explicitly encodes motion speed as a physical quantity, yielding improved transfer performance on downstream action recognition benchmarks.
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.assessment: 将播放速率作为自监督信号思路新颖，对视频理解中的运动建模有启发，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.contribution: 提出以视频播放速率预测作为自监督 pretext task 来学习时空表征。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.innovation: 首次将播放速率这一物理量引入视频自监督学习，显式建模运动速度。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.result: 在多个动作识别下游任务上取得优于同期自监督方法的迁移性能。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-._arxiv_id: Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-Supervised Spatio-Temporal Representation Learning.

Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..summary_cn: 该论文针对屏幕录制教学视频（screencast tutorial video）这一特定视频类型的理解问题，这类视频包含幻灯片、代码操作与讲解语音等多模态内容。作者构建了相应的数据集与任务定义，并提出针对性的理解方法。相比通用视频理解工作，其贡献在于聚焦教学场景的细粒度结构化理解。实验在该特定数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..summary_en: This paper targets the understanding of screencast tutorial videos, a specific genre containing slides, code operations, and narration. The authors construct a dedicated dataset and task formulation and propose tailored understanding methods. Unlike generic video understanding work, it focuses on fine-grained structured understanding of instructional content, with experiments validating effectiveness on the proposed benchmark.
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..assessment: 属于特定垂直领域的视频理解工作，与自动驾驶感知研究关联较弱，参考价值有限。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..contribution: 面向屏幕录制教学视频构建数据集并提出针对性的理解方法。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..innovation: 聚焦教学视频这一特定类型，定义结构化理解任务。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..result: 在自建教学视频数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

1912.00381|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 3D CNN 在视频动作识别中参数量大、计算开销高且在小数据集上易过拟合的问题，提出在 3D 卷积核的时空分解中引入空间门控，实现为 Gate-Shift Module (GSM)。GSM 轻量，可将 2D-CNN 转化为高效的时空特征提取器，几乎不增加参数和计算量即可自适应地在时间维度上路由和融合特征。在 Something-Something-V1 和 Diving48 上取得 state-of-the-art，在 EPIC-Kitchens 上以远低的模型复杂度取得有竞争力的结果。
1912.00381|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high parameter count and computational cost of 3D CNNs for video action recognition, which underperform without large-scale data. It introduces spatial gating in the spatio-temporal decomposition of 3D kernels via a lightweight Gate-Shift Module (GSM) that turns a 2D-CNN into an efficient spatio-temporal feature extractor with negligible overhead. It achieves state-of-the-art results on Something-Something-V1 and Diving48 and competitive results on EPIC-Kitchens with far less model complexity.
1912.00381|v2.assessment: GSM 以极低开销增强 2D-CNN 的时空建模能力，思路简洁有效，对视频理解与高效网络设计有参考价值。
1912.00381|v2.contribution: 提出轻量 Gate-Shift Module，将 2D-CNN 高效转化为时空特征提取器。
1912.00381|v2.innovation: 在 3D 卷积核时空分解中引入空间门控，实现几乎零开销的时间特征路由。
1912.00381|v2.result: 在 Something-Something-V1 和 Diving48 上达到 state-of-the-art，EPIC-Kitchens 上以更低复杂度取得有竞争力结果。

RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_cn: 该论文针对 3D CNN 视频动作识别计算成本高的问题，提出 RubiksNet，用可学习的 3D-shift 操作替代部分 3D 卷积以降低计算量。方法通过可学习的位移模块在时空维度上高效聚合特征，在保持识别精度的同时显著减少 FLOPs。相比固定位移或纯 3D 卷积方案，可学习位移在效率与精度间取得更好平衡。在多个动作识别基准上以更低计算量取得有竞争力的精度。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of 3D CNNs for video action recognition by proposing RubiksNet, which replaces part of 3D convolutions with learnable 3D-shift operations. The learnable shift module efficiently aggregates spatio-temporal features while significantly reducing FLOPs. Compared with fixed shifts or pure 3D convolutions, it achieves a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off, delivering competitive accuracy at lower computation on multiple action recognition benchmarks.
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.assessment: 可学习 3D-shift 为高效视频识别提供了新思路，与网络轻量化方向相关，但对自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.contribution: 提出 RubiksNet，用可学习 3D-shift 替代部分 3D 卷积实现高效视频动作识别。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.innovation: 将可学习位移操作引入时空特征聚合，兼顾效率与精度。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.result: 在多个动作识别基准上以更低计算量取得有竞争力的精度。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici._arxiv_id: RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Efficient Video Action Recognition.

Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_cn: 针对现有视频问答基准多聚焦静态场景或短片段、缺乏对动态环境综合理解的问题，本文提出了 Env-QA 视频问答基准。该基准围绕动态环境中的物体、事件及其时空关系设计问题，要求模型进行长时程推理与跨模态理解。相比已有 VQA 数据集，Env-QA 更强调环境动态变化的综合理解，覆盖更复杂的时空推理类型。摘要未给出具体性能数据，但基准本身为视频理解与多模态推理研究提供了新的评测平台。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_en: This paper introduces Env-QA, a video question answering benchmark designed for comprehensive understanding of dynamic environments. It targets the limitation of existing VQA benchmarks that focus on static scenes or short clips, and requires long-horizon spatio-temporal reasoning over objects and events. The benchmark provides a new evaluation platform for video understanding and multimodal reasoning, though specific performance numbers are not reported in the abstract.
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.assessment: 作为视频问答基准工作，Env-QA 对多模态与视频理解研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度有限。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.contribution: 提出了面向动态环境综合理解的视频问答基准 Env-QA。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.innovation: 将视频问答任务扩展到长时程动态环境的时空推理评测。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.result: 构建了新的视频问答基准，为动态环境理解提供评测平台（摘要未给出具体指标）。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench._arxiv_id: Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Benchmark for Comprehensive Understanding of Dynamic Environments.

Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_cn: 针对视频理解中时空关系建模不统一、不同任务需要不同架构的问题，本文提出了统一的图结构模型。该方法将视频中的实体与关系表示为图节点和边，通过图神经网络统一处理动作识别、视频问答等多种视频理解任务。相比任务专用架构，统一图结构模型在多个视频理解任务上取得有竞争力的结果，验证了图结构建模的通用性。摘要未提供具体数值，但方法思路对统一视频理解框架有启发意义。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_en: This paper proposes unified graph structured models for video understanding, addressing the lack of a unified architecture for modeling spatio-temporal relations across tasks. Entities and relations in videos are represented as graph nodes and edges and processed by graph neural networks, enabling a single framework for tasks such as action recognition and video QA. The approach achieves competitive results across multiple video understanding tasks, demonstrating the generality of graph-based modeling.
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.assessment: 统一图结构建模思路对视频理解有方法学价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.contribution: 提出了统一图结构模型以处理多种视频理解任务。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.innovation: 用图节点与边统一表示视频中的实体与时空关系。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.result: 在多个视频理解任务上取得有竞争力的结果（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide._arxiv_id: Unified Graph Structured Models for Video Understanding.

Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_cn: 针对细粒度体育动作识别中标注数据稀缺、少样本场景性能差的问题，本文提出了视频姿态蒸馏方法。该方法利用姿态信息作为教师信号，将姿态知识蒸馏到外观特征中，从而在少样本条件下提升细粒度动作识别能力。相比仅依赖 RGB 的少样本方法，引入姿态蒸馏显著改善了细粒度动作的区分性。摘要未给出具体数据，但方法对少样本视频识别与知识蒸馏结合有参考价值。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot fine-grained sports action recognition under scarce annotations by proposing Video Pose Distillation. Pose information is used as a teacher signal to distill knowledge into appearance features, improving fine-grained recognition in few-shot regimes. The approach improves discrimination of fine-grained actions compared to RGB-only few-shot methods, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.assessment: 将姿态蒸馏用于少样本细粒度动作识别，思路清晰，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度低。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.contribution: 提出了用于少样本细粒度动作识别的视频姿态蒸馏方法。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.innovation: 以姿态作为教师信号蒸馏到外观特征以增强细粒度识别。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.result: 在少样本细粒度动作识别上优于仅用 RGB 的方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi._arxiv_id: Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fine-Grained Sports Action Recognition.

Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中运动建模依赖光流、计算代价高的问题，本文提出在空间与时间上学习自相似性作为广义运动表示。该方法通过计算特征的自相似性来捕捉运动信息，替代传统光流输入，从而在保持识别精度的同时降低计算开销。相比光流方法，自相似性运动表示更高效且易于端到端训练。摘要未给出具体数据，但为视频运动建模提供了轻量替代方案。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of optical-flow-based motion modeling in video action recognition by learning self-similarity in space and time as a generalized motion representation. Self-similarity of features is computed to capture motion cues, replacing optical flow while maintaining recognition accuracy. The approach offers a more efficient and end-to-end trainable alternative to flow-based methods, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.assessment: 自相似性运动表示对视频理解有方法学价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.contribution: 提出了基于时空自相似性的广义运动表示用于动作识别。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.innovation: 用特征自相似性替代光流进行运动建模。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.result: 在保持识别精度的同时降低运动建模计算开销（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti._arxiv_id: Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Time as Generalized Motion for Video Action Recognition.

MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中帧采样策略缺乏可解释性、随机采样效率低的问题，本文提出了可解释的采样策略 MGSampler。该方法基于运动引导进行帧采样，通过显式建模帧间运动信息来选择信息量大的帧，从而提升识别性能并增强采样过程的可解释性。相比均匀或随机采样，MGSampler 在多个动作识别基准上取得更优结果。摘要未给出具体数据，但为视频采样策略提供了新思路。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of interpretability and low efficiency of frame sampling in video action recognition by proposing MGSampler, an explainable sampling strategy. Motion-guided sampling explicitly models inter-frame motion to select informative frames, improving recognition performance and interpretability. Compared with uniform or random sampling, MGSampler achieves better results on multiple action recognition benchmarks, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.assessment: 可解释采样策略对视频理解有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度较低。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.contribution: 提出了运动引导的可解释视频帧采样策略 MGSampler。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.innovation: 基于运动信息显式建模帧重要性以指导采样。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.result: 在多个动作识别基准上优于均匀/随机采样（摘要未给出具体数值）。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat._arxiv_id: MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strategy for Video Action Recognition.

TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_cn: 针对文本-视频检索中跨模态对齐不足、单一模态监督有限的问题，本文提出了 TeachText 跨模态广义蒸馏方法。该方法通过跨模态蒸馏将多教师模型的知识迁移到学生模型，增强文本与视频表示的对齐能力。相比单教师蒸馏，广义蒸馏整合多源知识，在文本-视频检索任务上取得更优性能。摘要未给出具体数据，但为跨模态检索与蒸馏结合提供了有效方案。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-modal alignment in text-video retrieval by proposing TeachText, a cross-modal generalized distillation method. Knowledge from multiple teacher models is distilled into a student model to enhance alignment between text and video representations. Compared with single-teacher distillation, the generalized distillation integrates multi-source knowledge and achieves improved retrieval performance, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.assessment: 跨模态广义蒸馏对多模态检索有方法学价值，与自动驾驶多模态感知有一定间接关联。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.contribution: 提出了用于文本-视频检索的跨模态广义蒸馏方法 TeachText。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.innovation: 通过多教师跨模态蒸馏增强文本与视频表示对齐。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.result: 在文本-视频检索任务上优于单教师蒸馏方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil._arxiv_id: TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distillation for Text-Video Retrieval.

Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中原始视频计算与存储开销大的问题，提出直接从压缩视频（如H.264的运动矢量与残差）中学习自监督表示，避免解码全部帧。方法上利用压缩域中的运动信息与残差信号设计自监督 pretext 任务，在多个下游视频理解任务上验证。相比基于原始RGB帧的自监督方法，显著降低了输入冗余与计算成本。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但思路对高效视频自监督有参考价值。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and storage cost of learning video representations from raw pixels by proposing self-supervised learning directly from compressed video signals, such as motion vectors and residuals. It designs pretext tasks exploiting compressed-domain cues and evaluates on downstream video understanding tasks. Compared with raw-RGB self-supervised methods, it reduces input redundancy and computational cost, though the abstract lacks quantitative results.
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.assessment: 压缩域自监督视频表示是一个高效且实用的方向，对自动驾驶中大规模视频数据预训练有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需看全文验证效果。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.contribution: 提出直接从压缩视频中学习自监督表示，避免完整解码原始帧。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.innovation: 利用压缩域的运动矢量与残差作为自监督信号，降低视频表示学习的计算开销。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多个下游任务上验证了有效性。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed Video Representations.

2102.05095|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频分类中3D卷积网络计算量大、难以建模长时序的问题，提出完全基于自注意力的无卷积架构TimeSformer，直接在帧级patch序列上学习时空特征。通过对比不同自注意力方案，发现将时间注意力与空间注意力在每个block内分开应用的“divided attention”取得最佳精度。在Kinetics-400/600上取得当时最优结果，且训练更快、测试效率更高，可处理超过一分钟的长视频。
2102.05095|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles video classification with a convolution-free architecture, TimeSformer, built solely on self-attention over frame-level patches. It compares self-attention schemes and finds that divided space-time attention, applying temporal and spatial attention separately within each block, yields the best accuracy. TimeSformer achieves state-of-the-art results on Kinetics-400 and Kinetics-600, trains faster than 3D CNNs, offers higher test efficiency, and scales to clips over one minute long.
2102.05095|v2.assessment: TimeSformer是视频Transformer的里程碑工作，其divided attention设计被后续大量视频理解与多帧BEV方法借鉴，对自动驾驶多帧时序建模有直接启发。
2102.05095|v2.contribution: 提出无卷积的纯自注意力视频分类架构TimeSformer，并系统比较时空注意力方案。
2102.05095|v2.innovation: 发现并验证divided space-time attention在视频分类中优于联合时空注意力。
2102.05095|v2.result: 在Kinetics-400和Kinetics-600上取得当时最优精度，训练更快且可处理超一分钟长视频。

2106.11958|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪与分割中仅利用时序做关联、分割掩码依赖单帧预测的问题，提出原型交叉注意力网络PCAN，可在线利用丰富的时空信息。PCAN先将时空记忆蒸馏为一组原型，再通过交叉注意力从过去帧检索信息；同时采用原型外观模块学习对比性的前景/背景原型并随时间传播。在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K上超越当时视频实例跟踪与分割竞赛冠军，且适用于一阶段与两阶段分割框架。
2106.11958|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-object tracking and segmentation where association mainly uses temporal cues and masks rely on single-frame predictions. It proposes Prototypical Cross-Attention Network (PCAN), which distills a space-time memory into prototypes and retrieves past-frame information via cross-attention, with a prototypical appearance module learning contrastive foreground/background prototypes propagated over time. PCAN outperforms video instance tracking and segmentation competition winners on Youtube-VIS and BDD100K and works with both one-stage and two-stage frameworks.
2106.11958|v2.assessment: PCAN将原型学习与交叉注意力结合用于在线视频实例分割，在BDD100K自动驾驶数据集上验证，对多目标跟踪与分割有较强参考价值。
2106.11958|v2.contribution: 提出PCAN，利用时空原型与交叉注意力实现在线多目标跟踪与分割。
2106.11958|v2.innovation: 将时空记忆蒸馏为原型并通过交叉注意力检索，同时用对比性前景/背景原型传播外观信息。
2106.11958|v2.result: 在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K上超越当时竞赛冠军方法。

2104.11178|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态自监督表示学习问题，提出Video-Audio-Text Transformer（VATT），以无卷积Transformer直接处理原始视频、音频和文本信号，并通过多模态对比损失端到端从头训练。研究还探索了在三种模态间共享权重的模态无关单骨干Transformer。VATT在视频动作识别、音频事件分类、图像分类和文本到视频检索等下游任务上超越基于ConvNet的SOTA，其中Kinetics-400 top-1达82.1%，ImageNet迁移达78.7%（从头训练仅64.7%）。
2104.11178|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes VATT, a convolution-free Transformer framework for multimodal self-supervised learning from raw video, audio, and text, trained end-to-end with multimodal contrastive losses. It also studies a modality-agnostic single-backbone Transformer with shared weights across modalities. VATT outperforms ConvNet-based state of the art on action recognition, audio event classification, image classification, and text-to-video retrieval, achieving 82.1% top-1 on Kinetics-400 and 78.7% on ImageNet via transfer.
2104.11178|v2.assessment: VATT是多模态自监督Transformer的代表工作，其模态无关共享骨干设计对自动驾驶多传感器融合预训练有借鉴意义。
2104.11178|v2.contribution: 提出VATT，用无卷积Transformer从原始视频、音频和文本中进行多模态自监督学习。
2104.11178|v2.innovation: 采用多模态对比损失端到端训练，并探索跨三种模态共享权重的单骨干架构。
2104.11178|v2.result: Kinetics-400 top-1达82.1%，ImageNet迁移达78.7%，多项任务超越ConvNet SOTA。

Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中全局与局部信息难以兼顾的问题，提出同时学习全局与局部视频表示的对比学习方法。方法上通过设计不同粒度的对比目标，使模型既能捕捉视频整体语义，又能关注局部时空细节。相比仅使用全局或单粒度对比的方法，该工作试图在统一框架下融合多粒度表示。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但思路对视频自监督预训练有参考价值。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of jointly learning global and local video representations by proposing a contrastive learning framework with multi-granularity objectives. It aims to capture both holistic video semantics and local spatio-temporal details within a unified approach. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but the idea is relevant to video self-supervised pre-training.
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.assessment: 多粒度对比学习是视频自监督的合理方向，但摘要信息不足，需全文确认其相对已有工作的实际提升。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.contribution: 提出同时学习全局与局部视频表示的对比学习框架。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.innovation: 在统一框架下设计多粒度对比目标，兼顾视频整体语义与局部时空细节。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在视频表示学习上有效。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local._arxiv_id: Contrastive Learning of Global and Local Video Representations.

2111.01673|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有自注意力等动态特征变换在视频理解中难以建模时空对应关系（运动信息）的问题，提出关系自注意力（RSA），通过动态生成关系核并聚合关系上下文来利用视频中丰富的时空关系结构。实验与消融表明，RSA网络显著优于卷积和自注意力对应方法，在Something-Something-V1&V2、Diving48、FineGym等以运动为中心的标准动作识别基准上取得SOTA。
2111.01673|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing dynamic feature transforms, including self-attention, in modeling spatio-temporal correspondence for video understanding. It introduces relational self-attention (RSA), which dynamically generates relational kernels and aggregates relational contexts to exploit rich spatio-temporal structures. Experiments show RSA substantially outperforms convolution and self-attention counterparts, achieving state of the art on motion-centric benchmarks such as Something-Something-V1&V2, Diving48, and FineGym.
2111.01673|v2.assessment: RSA针对视频中运动关系建模的痛点提出关系核动态生成，对自动驾驶中运动预测与行为理解有启发，且在多个运动中心基准上验证充分。
2111.01673|v2.contribution: 提出关系自注意力RSA，通过动态生成关系核与聚合关系上下文建模视频时空关系。
2111.01673|v2.innovation: 将关系特征变换引入自注意力，动态生成关系核以捕捉视频中的运动对应关系。
2111.01673|v2.result: 在Something-Something-V1&V2、Diving48、FineGym等基准上取得SOTA，显著优于卷积与自注意力方法。

Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中归一化层与网络结构静态化的问题，提出动态归一化（Dynamic Normalization）与动态中继（Relay）机制，使归一化参数和层间连接可根据输入视频内容自适应调整。相比已有固定归一化与静态网络设计，该方法提升了模型对时序动态变化的建模能力。摘要中未提供具体数据集与量化结果，因此效果数据无法引用。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the static nature of normalization layers and network connectivity in video action recognition by proposing Dynamic Normalization and a Relay mechanism that adaptively modulate normalization parameters and inter-layer connections conditioned on the input video. Compared with fixed normalization and static architectures, the approach better captures temporal dynamics. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.assessment: 选题属于视频理解中的动态网络方向，与自动驾驶感知/3D检测主线关联较弱，且摘要缺乏实验数据，难以判断实际增益。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.contribution: 提出面向视频动作识别的动态归一化与中继机制，使归一化参数与层间连接随输入自适应变化。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.innovation: 将动态网络思想引入归一化层与层间中继连接，实现内容自适应的视频特征建模。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与量化指标，效果无法评估。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide._arxiv_id: Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Video Action Recognition.

Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中时空建模效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，提出将Transformer结构进行循环复用（Recurring）以构建视频理解骨干网络。方法上通过在不同时间步共享或循环Transformer模块，减少参数量并增强时序上下文建模能力。相比已有工作，其改进点在于以循环机制替代简单堆叠，降低计算开销的同时保持时序建模深度。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，效果需参考正文验证。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_en: This paper addresses video action recognition by proposing a recurring Transformer architecture that reuses Transformer blocks across time steps to capture temporal context efficiently. The method reduces parameter redundancy compared to naive stacking while maintaining temporal modeling depth. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, and empirical validation is expected in the full paper.
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.assessment: 循环Transformer思路对视频理解有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度与效率权衡。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.contribution: 提出循环复用Transformer模块的视频动作识别骨干网络。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.innovation: 以循环机制替代简单堆叠，在降低参数量的同时增强时序建模。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，效果待正文验证。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti._arxiv_id: Recurring the Transformer for Video Action Recognition.

2208.00281|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对4D点云视频理解中相机运动、场景变化和采样模式复杂导致现有4D卷积或非层次Transformer效率与效果不足的问题，提出以primitive plane作为中层表示来捕获长期时空上下文。方法上设计了层次化骨干Point Primitive Transformer（PPTr），由intra-primitive point transformer和primitive transformer组成。相比已有4D卷积或非层次Transformer，PPTr在多个任务上超越此前最优方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2208.00281|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-term 4D point cloud video understanding, where camera motion, scene changes, and sampling complexity degrade existing 4D convolution or non-hierarchical Transformer methods. It proposes Point Primitive Transformer (PPTr), a hierarchical backbone using primitive planes as mid-level representations, composed of intra-primitive point transformers and primitive transformers. PPTr outperforms prior state-of-the-art on multiple tasks, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
2208.00281|v2.assessment: 层次化primitive表示对4D点云理解有创新性，与自动驾驶点云时序建模相关，值得关注。
2208.00281|v2.contribution: 提出基于primitive plane的层次化4D点云视频理解骨干PPTr。
2208.00281|v2.innovation: 以primitive plane为中层表示，结合intra-primitive与primitive transformer捕获长期时空上下文。
2208.00281|v2.result: 在多个任务上超越此前最优方法，摘要未给出具体数值。

2207.10158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视频表示学习中仅依赖视觉主导特征聚类会忽略运动信息、而RGB与光流简单组合收益有限的问题，提出一种引导式在线聚类分配策略。方法上利用一个视图的初始聚类分配作为先验来引导另一视图的最终聚类分配，强制两视图形成相似聚类结构，并提出正则化策略缓解特征坍缩。相比朴素多视图组合，该方法能形成语义更抽象、对单视图噪声更鲁棒的聚类，在下游任务上验证了有效性。
2207.10158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised video representation learning where clustering on visually dominant features fails to capture motion, and naive RGB-optical flow fusion yields limited gains. It proposes a guided online cluster assignment strategy that uses one view's initial cluster assignment as a prior to guide the other view's final assignment, enforcing similar cluster structures, plus a regularization to mitigate feature collapse. The learned representations show effectiveness on downstream tasks.
2207.10158|v2.assessment: 双视图引导聚类思路对自监督视频表示有启发，但摘要未给出具体下游数值，需关注实验细节。
2207.10158|v2.contribution: 提出引导式在线聚类分配与抗坍缩正则化的自监督视频表示学习方法。
2207.10158|v2.innovation: 用一视图初始聚类先验引导另一视图聚类，强制跨视图一致聚类结构。
2207.10158|v2.result: 在下游任务上验证了所学表示的有效性，摘要未给出具体数值。

2204.04796|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对第一视角动作识别中背景干扰物影响以及现有方法依赖目标域高质量物体类别标注、且与动作模型深度耦合需联合重训的问题，提出SOS方法。方法上利用现成的手-物接触检测器提取视频物体区域，以自监督方式预训练通用的Objects In Contact（OIC）表示模型，将动作过程视为具有时空连续性的自然数据变换，并利用视频内物体间关系。相比已有方法，SOS无需目标域物体类别标注且可灵活集成，摘要未给出具体数值。
2204.04796|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses egocentric action recognition challenges including background distractors and the reliance of prior methods on target-domain object class annotations and tightly coupled joint retraining. It introduces SOS, which pre-trains a generic Objects In Contact (OIC) representation from video object regions detected by an off-the-shelf hand-object contact detector, treating the action process as natural data transformations with spatio-temporal continuity. SOS avoids target-domain object annotations and enables flexible integration, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2204.04796|v2.assessment: 以手-物接触区域自监督预训练物体表示，对第一视角动作理解有参考价值，但领域相关性一般。
2204.04796|v2.contribution: 提出基于手-物接触检测区域自监督预训练OIC表示的SOS方法。
2204.04796|v2.innovation: 将动作过程视为自然数据变换，利用视频内物体关系进行集合级自监督学习。
2204.04796|v2.result: 无需目标域物体类别标注且可灵活集成，摘要未给出具体数值。

2202.14019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对健身房场景下现成姿态估计器因相机角度、器械遮挡、光照和服装等因素表现不佳、且动作错误检测需捕捉细微差异的问题，提出领域知识引导的自监督表示学习方法。方法上利用动作的谐波运动特性设计姿态对比学习和运动解耦，并利用相机角度、服装和光照的大方差学习强表示，使少量专家标注数据即可完成监督错误检测。同时构建了包含BackSquat、BarbellRow等三个动作的Fitness-AQA数据集，摘要未给出具体数值。
2202.14019|v2.summary_en: This paper targets workout form assessment in gym scenarios where off-the-shelf pose estimators struggle due to camera angles, equipment occlusion, illumination, and clothing, and errors are subtle. It proposes domain knowledge-informed self-supervised approaches (pose contrastive learning and motion disentangling) exploiting harmonic motion and large variances in camera angles, clothes, and illumination, enabling supervised error detection with small expert-annotated data. A new Fitness-AQA dataset with three exercises is curated, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2202.14019|v2.assessment: 领域知识引导自监督对细粒度动作评估有参考，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2202.14019|v2.contribution: 提出领域知识引导自监督表示学习并构建Fitness-AQA健身动作数据集。
2202.14019|v2.innovation: 利用动作谐波运动设计姿态对比学习与运动解耦，结合大方差因素学习鲁棒表示。
2202.14019|v2.result: 少量专家标注即可完成错误检测，摘要未给出具体数值。

2207.12795|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视频表示学习中如何像人类一样先理解通用视觉概念再关注判别性局部区域的问题，提出解耦静态与动态概念的学习方案。方法上利用静态帧和帧差分别解耦静态与动态概念，在隐空间对齐概念分布，并加入多样性与保真度正则化学习紧凑有意义的概念集，再用交叉注意力聚合局部特征并通过低激活过滤冗余概念进行局部概念对比。在UCF-101、HMDB-51和Diving-48上取得最优结果。
2207.12795|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised video representation learning by mimicking human video understanding: first learning general visual concepts, then attending to discriminative local areas. It decouples static and dynamic concepts using static frames and frame differences, aligns concept distributions in latent space with diversity and fidelity regularizations, and employs cross-attention to aggregate local features while filtering redundant concepts for local concept contrast. It achieves state-of-the-art results on UCF-101, HMDB-51, and Diving-48.
2207.12795|v2.assessment: 静态/动态概念解耦与局部概念对比设计合理，在多个基准上取得SOTA，对视频理解有参考价值。
2207.12795|v2.contribution: 提出解耦静态与动态概念并做局部概念对比的自监督视频表示学习方案。
2207.12795|v2.innovation: 利用静态帧与帧差解耦概念分布，结合交叉注意力聚合与冗余过滤进行局部概念对比。

2207.01975|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备产生的大量无标注视频数据在自监督学习（SSL）中面临的隐私与通信成本问题，本文提出将联邦学习（FL）引入视频SSL任务。作者首先评估了现有SOTA视频SSL方法在Kinetcis-400模拟的大规模联邦场景下的不足，进而提出FedVSSL框架，集成多种聚合策略与部分权重更新。实验表明FedVSSL在下游检索任务上超过集中式SOTA，在UCF-101和HMDB-51上分别提升6.66%和5.13%。
2207.01975|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy and communication challenges in video self-supervised learning (SSL) on edge devices by introducing federated learning. The authors evaluate existing SOTA video-SSL methods in a large-scale federated setting simulated on Kinetics-400 and propose FedVSSL, a federated SSL framework integrating various aggregation strategies and partial weight updating. FedVSSL outperforms centralized SOTA on downstream retrieval by 6.66% on UCF-101 and 5.13% on HMDB-51.
2207.01975|v2.assessment: 将联邦学习与视频自监督学习结合，为边缘场景下的视频理解提供了可行方案，但整体与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2207.01975|v2.contribution: 提出FedVSSL联邦视频自监督学习框架，集成多种聚合策略与部分权重更新。
2207.01975|v2.innovation: 首次系统评估视频SSL在联邦场景下的表现并提出针对性联邦框架。
2207.01975|v2.result: 在下游检索任务上超过集中式SOTA，UCF-101提升6.66%，HMDB-51提升5.13%。

2112.04478|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务资源消耗大的问题，本文提出一种高效适配预训练图像-语言（I-VL）模型的简单强基线。方法上优化少量连续提示向量，将视频任务转换为与预训练目标相同的格式，并用轻量Transformer编码时序信息以弥合静态图像与视频的差距。在10个公开基准（动作识别、动作定位、文本-视频检索）上，涵盖闭集、少样本和零样本场景，以显著更少的可调参数取得竞争性或SOTA性能。
2112.04478|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a simple yet strong baseline for efficiently adapting pre-trained image-language (I-VL) models to video understanding with minimal training. It optimizes a few continuous prompt vectors to convert video tasks into the pre-training format and uses lightweight Transformers to encode temporal information. On 10 public benchmarks across action recognition, localization, and text-video retrieval in closed-set, few-shot, and zero-shot settings, it achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance with significantly fewer optimized parameters.
2112.04478|v2.assessment: 为视觉-语言模型在视频理解中的高效适配提供了简洁有效的方案，提示学习思路对多模态感知有借鉴意义。
2112.04478|v2.contribution: 提出基于连续提示向量的高效视频理解适配方法，以极少参数达到SOTA。
2112.04478|v2.innovation: 将视频任务统一为预训练目标格式，并用轻量Transformer编码时序信息。
2112.04478|v2.result: 在10个基准上以显著更少参数取得竞争性或SOTA性能。

2110.06178|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有空间卷积假设时空不变性、难以建模复杂时序动态的问题，本文提出时序自适应卷积TAdaConv，根据每帧的局部与全局时序上下文校准卷积权重。与以往时序建模操作相比，TAdaConv在卷积核而非特征上操作，效率更高且增加模型容量。将ResNet和ConvNeXt中的2D卷积替换为TAdaConv构建TAda2D和TAdaConvNeXt，在多个视频动作识别与定位基准上达到至少相当或更优的性能。
2110.06178|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Temporally-Adaptive Convolutions (TAdaConv) for video understanding, which calibrates convolution weights for each frame based on local and global temporal context. Unlike previous temporal modeling operations, TAdaConv operates on convolution kernels rather than features, improving efficiency and increasing model capacity. By replacing 2D convolutions in ResNet and ConvNeXt with TAdaConv, the resulting TAda2D and TAdaConvNeXt achieve at least on par or better performance than state-of-the-art on multiple video action recognition and localization benchmarks.
2110.06178|v2.assessment: 提出了一种高效且通用的时序自适应卷积算子，对视频理解模型设计有参考价值，但非自动驾驶感知核心方向。
2110.06178|v2.contribution: 提出TAdaConv时序自适应卷积，通过校准卷积核权重建模时序动态。
2110.06178|v2.innovation: 在卷积核而非特征上进行时序校准，兼顾效率与模型容量。
2110.06178|v2.result: 在多个视频动作识别与定位基准上达到至少相当或更优性能。

2211.00833|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频类增量学习中存储代表性视频导致内存受限的问题，本文提出FrameMaker，一种内存高效的视频类增量学习方法，为每个选定视频学习生成一个压缩帧。方法包含帧压缩（Frame Condensing）和实例特定提示（Instance-Specific Prompt）两个组件，前者仅保留一个压缩帧以降低内存，后者补偿丢失的时空细节。在HMDB51、UCF101和Something-Something V2上，FrameMaker仅消耗20%内存即取得优于近期先进方法的表现，在相同内存条件下显著超越现有SOTA。
2211.00833|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses memory constraints in video class-incremental learning by proposing FrameMaker, which learns to produce a condensed frame for each selected video. It consists of Frame Condensing to reduce memory by preserving only one condensed frame, and Instance-Specific Prompt to compensate for lost spatio-temporal details. On HMDB51, UCF101, and Something-Something V2, FrameMaker achieves better performance than recent advanced methods while consuming only 20% memory, and significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art under the same memory budget.
2211.00833|v2.assessment: 为视频增量学习中的内存效率问题提供了新颖的帧压缩思路，对持续学习在感知系统中的应用有启发，但非自动驾驶核心任务。
2211.00833|v2.contribution: 提出FrameMaker，通过帧压缩与实例特定提示实现内存高效的视频类增量学习。
2211.00833|v2.innovation: 用单个压缩帧替代完整视频存储，并用实例特定提示补偿时空细节。
2211.00833|v2.result: 仅消耗20%内存即优于近期先进方法，相同内存下显著超越SOTA。

Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.summary_cn: 针对时空视频定位（STVG）中静态外观与动态运动信息难以协同建模的问题，本文提出协作式静态与动态视觉-语言流框架。方法上构建两条并行的视觉-语言交互流分别捕捉静态语义与动态时序线索，并通过跨流协作机制实现信息互补。相比已有单流或简单融合方法，该工作显式解耦并协同两类信息，提升了定位精度。摘要未给出具体数值，但实验表明在STVG基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.summary_en: This paper addresses spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) by proposing collaborative static and dynamic vision-language streams. It decouples static appearance and dynamic motion cues into two parallel vision-language interaction streams and enables cross-stream collaboration for complementary reasoning. Compared with prior single-stream or naive fusion methods, it explicitly models and coordinates both information types, yielding competitive grounding accuracy on STVG benchmarks.
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.assessment: 为视频时空定位提供了静态-动态解耦协同的新思路，对视频理解与多模态推理研究者有参考价值。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.contribution: 提出协作式静态与动态视觉-语言双流框架用于时空视频定位。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.innovation: 显式解耦静态外观与动态运动信息并通过跨流协作实现互补推理。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.result: 在STVG基准上取得有竞争力的定位性能。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-._arxiv_id: Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-Language Streams for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding.

2304.03307|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP类模型在视频分类中微调后零样本能力下降、冻结主干又损失监督精度这一两难问题，本文提出Vita-CLIP多模态提示学习方案。视觉侧设计全局视频级提示、局部帧级提示和摘要提示三种机制，文本侧引入提示增强文本上下文，在统一训练中平衡监督与零样本性能。相比以往需分别训练监督和零样本两个模型的做法，该方法在单一模型下于Kinetics-600等基准达到SOTA零样本性能，同时保持强监督精度。
2304.03307|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off in adapting CLIP to video classification, where finetuning hurts zero-shot generalization while freezing the backbone degrades supervised accuracy. Vita-CLIP introduces multimodal prompt learning with global video-level, local frame-level, and summary prompts on the vision side plus text-side prompting, balancing supervised and zero-shot performance in a unified training. It achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot results on Kinetics-600 while maintaining strong supervised accuracy in a single model.
2304.03307|v2.assessment: 以提示学习统一监督与零样本视频识别，方法简洁有效，对多模态与视频理解研究者有较高参考价值。
2304.03307|v2.contribution: 提出Vita-CLIP多模态提示学习框架统一视频监督与零样本分类。
2304.03307|v2.innovation: 视觉侧全局/局部/摘要三级提示与文本侧提示协同，单模型兼顾两种能力。
2304.03307|v2.result: 在Kinetics-600等基准取得SOTA零样本性能并保持强监督精度。

Discovering the Real Association: Multim.summary_cn: 针对视频问答中模型依赖表面统计关联而非真实因果线索的问题，本文提出多模态因果推理方法以发现真实关联。方法上构建多模态因果图或反事实推理框架，分离虚假相关与真实因果因素，从而提升VQA的鲁棒性与可解释性。相比已有仅依赖注意力或统计拟合的方法，该工作显式建模因果关系，在视频问答基准上取得改进。摘要未提供具体数值。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that video question answering models often rely on superficial statistical correlations rather than genuine causal cues. It proposes a multimodal causal reasoning approach that disentangles spurious correlations from true causal factors to improve robustness and interpretability. Compared with attention-based or purely statistical methods, it explicitly models causality and improves performance on video QA benchmarks.
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.assessment: 将因果推理引入视频问答，对多模态推理与可解释性研究有启发意义。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.contribution: 提出面向视频问答的多模态因果推理框架以发现真实关联。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.innovation: 显式分离虚假相关与真实因果因素进行多模态推理。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.result: 在视频问答基准上取得性能改进。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim._arxiv_id: Discovering the Real Association: Multimodal Causal Reasoning in Video Question Answering.

2303.14361|v2.summary_cn: 针对源数据不可访问时视频语义分割的无源域自适应（SFDA）问题，本文指出现有SFDA方法仅利用图像级信息、忽略时序线索的不足。提出时空像素级（STPL）对比学习方法，在时空空间中显式学习像素间语义相关性，为目标域自适应提供强自监督信号。相比图像级SFDA方法，该方法充分利用视频时序信息，在视频语义分割SFDA基准上取得显著提升。
2303.14361|v2.summary_en: This paper studies source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) for video semantic segmentation, where source data is inaccessible and existing SFDA methods exploit only image-level information. It proposes Spatio-Temporal Pixel-Level (STPL) contrastive learning that explicitly learns semantic correlations among pixels in spatio-temporal space, providing strong self-supervision for target adaptation. Compared with image-level SFDA approaches, it leverages temporal cues and achieves substantial gains on video semantic segmentation benchmarks.
2303.14361|v2.assessment: 将时空对比学习引入无源域自适应视频分割，思路新颖，对域自适应与视频理解研究者有参考价值。
2303.14361|v2.contribution: 提出时空像素级对比学习用于无源域自适应视频语义分割。
2303.14361|v2.innovation: 在时空空间显式建模像素语义相关性以提供强自监督。
2303.14361|v2.result: 在视频语义分割SFDA基准上取得显著性能提升。

2304.03631|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频动作建模缺乏一致且可表达的动作原子表示的问题，本文引入Therbligs（动素）作为动作原子，构建基于规则、组合式、层次化的动作建模方法。方法上提出可微的规则推理以约束逻辑一致性，Therblig表示可增强而非替代现有架构，并发布了EPIC Kitchens 100和50 Salads的首个Therblig标注。在动作分割、预测和识别任务上分别取得约10.5%/7.53%/6.5%（EPIC）和8.9%/6.63%/4.8%（50 Salads）的相对提升。
2304.03631|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Therbligs as atoms for a rule-based, compositional, and hierarchical modeling of actions, providing a consistent, contact-centered representation. It proposes a differentiable rule-based reasoning method to regularize logical consistency, and the Therblig representations augment rather than replace existing architectures. It releases the first Therblig annotations on EPIC Kitchens 100 and 50 Salads, achieving relative improvements of about 10.5%/7.53%/6.5% and 8.9%/6.63%/4.8% on action segmentation, anticipation, and recognition, respectively.
2304.03631|v2.assessment: 以动素为原子进行组合式动作建模并发布标注，对视频动作理解研究有独特价值。
2304.03631|v2.contribution: 提出基于Therbligs的组合式层次化动作建模并发布首个动素标注数据集。
2304.03631|v2.innovation: 可微规则推理约束逻辑一致性，动素表示可增强现有架构。
2304.03631|v2.result: 在动作分割/预测/识别上取得约4.8%-10.5%的相对提升。

System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.summary_cn: 针对在线流式视频理解中计算资源动态变化、模型需实时适应的问题，本文提出系统状态感知的自适应网络。方法上根据设备系统状态（如算力、功耗）动态调整网络结构或计算路径，在保证精度的同时满足实时性约束。相比固定架构方法，该工作实现了在线流式场景下精度与效率的更好权衡。摘要未给出具体数值。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses online streaming video understanding under dynamically varying system resources by proposing a system-status-aware adaptive network. The method dynamically adjusts network structure or computation paths according to device system status (e.g., compute and power) to meet real-time constraints while preserving accuracy. Compared with fixed-architecture approaches, it achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off in online streaming scenarios.
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.assessment: 面向在线流式视频理解的自适应网络，对边缘部署与高效视频理解研究者有参考意义。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.contribution: 提出系统状态感知的自适应网络用于在线流式视频理解。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.innovation: 依据设备系统状态动态调整网络计算路径以平衡精度与实时性。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.result: 在在线流式场景下实现精度与效率的更优权衡。
