LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频-语言理解任务中各类下游任务（检索、问答、字幕等）通常需要独立架构的问题，提出将多种视频-语言理解任务统一为掩码语言建模（MLM）框架LAVENDER。方法上通过统一的掩码语言建模目标同时处理视频-文本匹配、视频问答、字幕生成等任务，无需任务特定的头部设计。相比已有工作，LAVENDER以单一模型和单一预训练目标实现了多任务统一，简化了架构并提升了泛化性。实验表明该统一框架在多个视频-语言基准上取得了与任务专用模型相当甚至更优的性能。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of video-language understanding tasks, where each downstream task typically requires a task-specific architecture. It proposes LAVENDER, a unified framework that casts video-text matching, video question answering, and captioning as masked language modeling with a single model and training objective. Compared with prior task-specific approaches, LAVENDER achieves comparable or superior performance across multiple video-language benchmarks while simplifying the architecture.
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.assessment: 该工作将视频-语言多任务统一到MLM框架，思路简洁，对多模态视频理解研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.contribution: 提出LAVENDER统一框架，用单一掩码语言建模目标统一多种视频-语言理解任务。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.innovation: 将视频-文本匹配、问答、字幕等异构任务统一为掩码语言建模形式，无需任务特定头部。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.result: 在多个视频-语言基准上以单一模型取得与任务专用方法相当或更优的性能。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders._arxiv_id: LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Understanding as Masked Language Modeling.

2303.14526|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对长视频理解中复杂时空依赖建模效率低的问题，指出S4模型对所有图像token一视同仁会损害效率与精度。提出Selective S4（S5）模型，通过轻量级掩码生成器自适应选择信息量大的图像token，并利用动量更新的S4模型引导避免密集自注意力计算。此外提出长-短掩码对比策略以增强鲁棒性和时间跨度。相比已有token缩减方法，S5在丢弃冗余token的同时保持高效，在长视频理解任务上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。
2303.14526|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of modeling long-form video spatiotemporal dependencies, showing that treating all image tokens equally in S4 harms both efficiency and accuracy. It proposes Selective S4 (S5), which uses a lightweight mask generator to adaptively select informative tokens guided by a momentum-updated S4 model, avoiding dense self-attention. A long-short masked contrastive strategy further improves robustness and temporal horizon, yielding better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on long-form video understanding tasks.
2303.14526|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型与token选择结合用于长视频理解，方法新颖且效率导向明确，对视频理解与高效Transformer研究者有启发。
2303.14526|v2.contribution: 提出Selective S4（S5）模型，通过自适应token选择实现高效准确的长视频时空建模。
2303.14526|v2.innovation: 利用动量更新的S4模型引导轻量掩码生成器选择token，避免密集自注意力并提升长时建模能力。
2303.14526|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务上取得优于S4及已有token缩减方法的精度-效率权衡。

2303.18230|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对教学视频中程序理解任务标注稀缺的问题，提出从无标注视频中提取程序性知识（任务身份、步骤、下一步骤）的方法。核心思想是用程序知识图（PKG）表示步骤及其顺序关系，节点为离散步骤、边连接顺序出现的步骤，并据此生成伪标签训练视频表示。方法结合文本程序知识库与无标注教学视频语料构建PKG，并设计四种新颖的预训练任务生成伪标签。实验表明该程序感知预训练表示能有效泛化到多种下游程序理解任务。
2303.18230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotations for procedure understanding in instructional videos by extracting procedural knowledge from unlabeled videos. It introduces a Procedural Knowledge Graph (PKG) whose nodes are discrete steps and edges encode sequential relations, built from a text-based knowledge base and an unlabeled video corpus, and uses it to generate pseudo-labels via four novel pretraining tasks. The learned representation generalizes effectively to multiple downstream procedure understanding tasks.
2303.18230|v2.assessment: 利用程序知识图进行自监督预训练的思路对教学视频理解有较强创新性，对视频表示学习与多模态研究者有参考价值。
2303.18230|v2.contribution: 提出基于程序知识图（PKG）的预训练框架，从无标注教学视频中学习程序性知识表示。
2303.18230|v2.innovation: 用PKG生成伪标签并设计四种预训练任务，将结构化程序知识注入视频表示。
2303.18230|v2.result: 学到的表示在多种程序理解下游任务上取得有效泛化性能。

2303.15467|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放集动作识别（OSAR）中未知动作拒识问题，指出现有方法仅关注不确定性评分而忽视特征表示的重要性。基于信息瓶颈理论分析特征表示行为，提出扩大特征中的实例特定（IS）与类别特定（CS）信息。为此设计原型相似学习（PSL）框架保留同类内实例方差以保留IS信息，并引入视频打乱学习原始与打乱样本间的时序差异以扩大CS信息。实验表明该方法在开放集动作识别基准上显著优于现有方法。
2303.15467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set action recognition (OSAR), arguing that existing methods focus on uncertainty scores while neglecting feature representations. Based on information bottleneck theory, it proposes to enlarge instance-specific (IS) and class-specific (CS) information, introducing a Prototypical Similarity Learning (PSL) framework to preserve intra-class instance variance and video shuffling to enlarge CS information. Extensive experiments show significant improvements over existing OSAR methods.
2303.15467|v2.assessment: 从信息瓶颈角度重新审视开放集动作识别的特征表示，思路清晰，对开放集检测与视频理解研究者有借鉴意义。
2303.15467|v2.contribution: 提出原型相似学习（PSL）框架，通过扩大实例特定与类别特定信息提升开放集动作识别性能。
2303.15467|v2.innovation: 基于信息瓶颈理论分析特征表示，并用视频打乱扩大类别特定信息以区分相似外观的未知样本。
2303.15467|v2.result: 在开放集动作识别基准上显著优于现有方法。

2303.16268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督动作识别中同时学习静态与运动特征的问题，指出现有方法依赖RGB与光流双模态或双播放速率等硬性输入偏置。提出TimeBalance框架，利用自监督视频表示中的时间不变（temporally-invariant）与时间区分（temporally-distinctive）表示，观察到二者依动作性质互补。方法采用学生-教师半监督框架，从两个教师蒸馏知识，并基于新颖的时间相似度重加权方案动态组合。实验表明该方法在半监督动作识别上取得优于现有方法的性能。
2303.16268|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles semi-supervised action recognition, where existing methods rely on hard input biases such as RGB-optical flow dual modalities or dual playback rates. It proposes TimeBalance, a student-teacher framework that distills knowledge from a temporally-invariant and a temporally-distinctive teacher, dynamically combined via a temporal similarity-based reweighting scheme. Experiments show improved performance over existing semi-supervised action recognition methods.
2303.16268|v2.assessment: 用自监督时间不变与时间区分表示替代硬性多模态输入偏置，思路巧妙，对半监督视频理解研究者有参考价值。
2303.16268|v2.contribution: 提出TimeBalance学生-教师框架，利用时间不变与时间区分表示进行半监督动作识别。
2303.16268|v2.innovation: 基于时间相似度的动态重加权方案组合两个互补教师的知识，避免依赖双模态或双速率输入。
2303.16268|v2.result: 在半监督动作识别基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。

2305.07214|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究第一人称动作识别中的多模态泛化（MMG）新问题，旨在考察当某些模态数据有限甚至完全缺失时系统的泛化能力。定义了两种新场景：推理时缺失训练时存在的模态（缺失模态泛化），以及推理与训练模态完全不相交（跨模态零样本泛化）。为此构建了包含视频、音频和IMU模态的新数据集MMG-Ego4D，基于Ego4D由专家重新标注。在标准监督和少样本设置下评估多种模型并提出改进方法，取得更好的泛化性能。
2305.07214|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Multimodal Generalization (MMG) in egocentric action recognition, examining how systems generalize when certain modalities are limited or entirely missing. It defines two scenarios—missing modality generalization and cross-modal zero-shot generalization—and constructs MMG-Ego4D, a new dataset with video, audio, and IMU modalities re-annotated from Ego4D. It evaluates diverse models under supervised and few-shot settings and proposes methods with improved generalization.
2305.07214|v2.assessment: 提出多模态泛化新问题并构建配套数据集，对多模态感知与鲁棒性研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联有限。
2305.07214|v2.contribution: 定义多模态泛化（MMG）问题并构建MMG-Ego4D多模态第一人称动作识别数据集。
2305.07214|v2.innovation: 提出缺失模态泛化与跨模态零样本泛化两种新场景，并设计改进方法提升泛化能力。
2305.07214|v2.result: 在MMG-Ego4D上评估多种模型并提出改进方法，取得更好的泛化性能。

Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别模型在测试阶段遇到分布偏移时性能下降的问题，提出了视频测试时自适应（Video Test-Time Adaptation）方法。作者将测试时自适应从图像领域扩展到视频领域，设计了针对视频特性的自适应策略，利用时序信息在无标签测试数据上在线更新模型。相比已有的图像级TTA方法，该方法更好地利用了视频的时序冗余性和帧间一致性。实验表明在多种视频损坏和分布偏移场景下，该方法显著提升了动作识别模型的鲁棒性和准确率。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of video action recognition models under distribution shifts at test time by proposing a video test-time adaptation method. The authors extend test-time adaptation from images to videos, designing adaptation strategies that exploit temporal information for online model updates on unlabeled test data. Compared to image-level TTA methods, the approach better leverages temporal redundancy and inter-frame consistency in videos, achieving significant robustness and accuracy improvements under various video corruption and distribution shift scenarios.
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.assessment: 将TTA引入视频动作识别是一个有价值的方向，对自动驾驶中视频感知模型的在线自适应有借鉴意义。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.contribution: 提出了面向视频动作识别的测试时自适应框架，利用时序信息进行无标签在线模型更新。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.innovation: 将图像域TTA扩展到视频域，设计了利用帧间时序一致性的自适应策略。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.result: 在多种视频分布偏移场景下显著提升了动作识别模型的鲁棒性和准确率。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re._arxiv_id: Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Recognition.

A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.summary_cn: 该论文对视频动作识别模型进行了大规模鲁棒性分析，系统评估了现有模型在面对各种视频扰动（如压缩、噪声、遮挡、时序抖动等）时的表现。作者构建了大规模鲁棒性基准，涵盖多种模型架构和数据集，揭示了当前模型在分布偏移下的脆弱性。研究发现模型鲁棒性与架构设计、预训练策略和训练数据密切相关，并提供了提升鲁棒性的实用建议。该工作为视频理解领域的鲁棒性研究提供了重要的基准和洞察。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.summary_en: This paper presents a large-scale robustness analysis of video action recognition models, systematically evaluating their performance under various video perturbations such as compression, noise, occlusion, and temporal jitter. The authors construct a comprehensive robustness benchmark covering multiple architectures and datasets, revealing the fragility of current models under distribution shifts. The study finds that robustness is closely tied to architecture design, pretraining strategy, and training data, providing practical insights for improving model robustness in video understanding.
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.assessment: 系统性鲁棒性分析对理解视频模型在真实自动驾驶场景中的可靠性有重要参考价值。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.contribution: 构建了大规模视频动作识别鲁棒性基准，系统评估了多种模型在扰动下的表现。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.innovation: 首次对视频动作识别模型进行大规模多维度鲁棒性分析，揭示了架构与鲁棒性的关系。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.result: 揭示了现有模型在分布偏移下的脆弱性，并提供了提升鲁棒性的实用建议。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid._arxiv_id: A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Video Action Recognition Models.

SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中标注数据昂贵的问题，提出了SVFormer，一种半监督视频Transformer方法。作者设计了伪标签策略和时序增强机制，使Transformer能够在少量标注视频和大量无标注视频上有效训练。相比已有的半监督方法，SVFormer通过EMA教师模型和强时序增强提升了伪标签质量。在多个视频动作识别基准上，SVFormer以显著更少的标注数据达到了与全监督方法相当的性能。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of labeled data in video action recognition by proposing SVFormer, a semi-supervised video transformer. The authors design pseudo-labeling strategies and temporal augmentation mechanisms to effectively train transformers on limited labeled and abundant unlabeled videos. Compared to existing semi-supervised methods, SVFormer improves pseudo-label quality through an EMA teacher model and strong temporal augmentation, achieving performance comparable to fully supervised methods with significantly less labeled data on multiple benchmarks.
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.assessment: 半监督视频Transformer对降低自动驾驶视频标注成本有实际意义，方法设计合理。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.contribution: 提出了SVFormer半监督视频Transformer框架，通过伪标签和时序增强实现高效半监督学习。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.innovation: 将EMA教师模型与强时序增强结合用于视频Transformer的半监督训练。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.result: 以显著更少的标注数据达到与全监督方法相当的动作识别性能。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor._arxiv_id: SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transformer for Action Recognition.

2303.17285|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGB时序动作检测中双流模型依赖昂贵光流导致推理慢的问题，提出了分解式跨模态蒸馏框架。作者不直接蒸馏，而是分别学习RGB和运动表征，再通过非对称训练目标将运动知识迁移到RGB分支，同时保持RGB信息完整。此外引入局部注意力融合以利用多模态互补性并保持局部判别力。实验表明该框架与骨干网络和检测头无关，在不同模型上均带来一致性能提升。
2303.17285|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the slow inference of two-stream temporal action detection models caused by reliance on expensive optical flow, proposing a decomposed cross-modal distillation framework. Instead of direct distillation, the authors separately learn RGB and motion representations, then transfer motion knowledge to the RGB branch via asymmetric training objectives while preserving RGB information. A local attentive fusion is introduced to exploit multimodal complementarity and maintain local discriminability. Experiments show consistent gains across different backbones and detection heads.
2303.17285|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏消除光流依赖的思路对自动驾驶实时视频感知有参考价值，框架通用性强。
2303.17285|v2.contribution: 提出了分解式跨模态蒸馏框架，使RGB单流检测器获得运动模态知识而无需光流。
2303.17285|v2.innovation: 采用双分支非对称训练目标和局部注意力融合实现有效的运动知识迁移。
2303.17285|v2.result: 框架与骨干和检测头无关，在不同模型上均取得一致的性能提升。

2212.04500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有自监督视频表示学习仅从零开始重建低层像素特征的问题，提出了掩码视频蒸馏（MVD）两阶段框架。第一阶段预训练图像或视频模型恢复掩码块的低层特征，第二阶段将这些特征作为掩码特征建模的目标。作者观察到视频教师擅长时序密集任务而图像教师擅长空间密集任务，据此设计了时空协同教学策略。实验表明预训练的视频Transformer在多个下游任务上取得了显著提升。
2212.04500|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing self-supervised video representation learning that reconstructs only low-level pixel features from scratch, proposing Masked Video Distillation (MVD), a two-stage masked feature modeling framework. The first stage pretrains an image or video model to recover low-level features of masked patches, and the second stage uses these features as targets for masked feature modeling. Observing that video teachers excel at temporally-heavy tasks while image teachers transfer stronger spatial representations, the authors design a spatial-temporal co-teaching method, achieving significant improvements on multiple downstream tasks.
2212.04500|v2.assessment: MVD通过蒸馏预训练特征替代像素重建，为自监督视频表示学习提供了新范式，对自动驾驶视频预训练有启发。
2212.04500|v2.contribution: 提出了掩码视频蒸馏两阶段框架，用预训练特征作为掩码建模目标替代低层像素重建。
2212.04500|v2.innovation: 设计了时空协同教学策略，同时从视频教师和图像教师蒸馏学生模型。
2212.04500|v2.result: 预训练的视频Transformer在多个下游任务上取得显著性能提升。

2309.04422|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中多种异构视觉任务需要分别设计专用网络的问题，提出了Video Task Decathlon（VTD）挑战和统一网络VTDNet。VTD包含十种代表性图像和视频任务，涵盖分类、分割、定位和关联。VTDNet使用单一结构和单套权重处理全部十个任务，通过任务分组和任务交互阶段交换信息。针对多任务联合训练的性能下降问题，作者设计了课程训练、伪标签和微调（CPF）方案。实验表明VTDNet在十个任务上均取得有竞争力的性能。
2309.04422|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for separate specialized networks for heterogeneous visual tasks in autonomous driving by proposing the Video Task Decathlon (VTD) challenge and a unified network, VTDNet. VTD includes ten representative image and video tasks spanning classification, segmentation, localization, and association. VTDNet uses a single structure and a single set of weights for all ten tasks, employing task grouping and interaction stages to exchange information. A Curriculum training, Pseudo-labeling, and Fine-tuning (CPF) scheme is designed to mitigate performance degradation in joint training, achieving competitive performance across all ten tasks.
2309.04422|v2.assessment: 统一多任务网络对自动驾驶感知系统简化部署有重要价值，VTD基准为多任务学习提供了新平台。
2309.04422|v2.contribution: 提出了VTD多任务挑战和VTDNet统一网络，用单套权重处理十种自动驾驶视觉任务。
2309.04422|v2.innovation: 设计了任务分组交互结构和CPF训练方案，实现异构多任务的统一建模。
2309.04422|v2.result: VTDNet在十个代表性图像和视频任务上均取得有竞争力的性能。

TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频异常检测（VAD）中自监督方法可能泄露隐私的问题，提出TeD-SPAD框架，通过时间独特性（temporal distinctiveness）来指导自监督隐私保护。方法上利用时间维度上的独特性来解耦隐私信息与异常检测所需特征，在自监督预训练中抑制隐私敏感表征。相比已有自监督VAD方法，其改进在于显式引入隐私保护目标而不牺牲异常检测性能。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称在隐私保护与检测精度间取得更好平衡。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy leakage in self-supervised video anomaly detection (VAD) by proposing TeD-SPAD, a framework that leverages temporal distinctiveness to guide self-supervised privacy preservation. It decouples privacy-sensitive representations from anomaly-relevant features during self-supervised pre-training. Compared to existing self-supervised VAD methods, it explicitly incorporates a privacy-preserving objective without sacrificing detection performance. While no specific quantitative results are provided in the abstract, it claims a better trade-off between privacy and detection accuracy.
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.assessment: 该工作关注自监督VAD中的隐私保护，角度新颖，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其实际效果。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.contribution: 提出基于时间独特性的自监督隐私保护框架TeD-SPAD，用于视频异常检测。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.innovation: 将时间独特性引入自监督学习，以解耦隐私信息与异常检测特征。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.result: 声称在隐私保护与异常检测精度间取得更好平衡，但未提供具体数据。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S._arxiv_id: TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for Self-supervised Privacy-preservation for video Anomaly Detection.

2309.01380|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于文本的视频问答（VideoQA）任务，分析了NewsVideoQA和M4-ViteVQA两个数据集，探究其所需的视觉理解与多帧推理程度。方法上使用纯文本模型BERT-QA进行实验，发现其性能与原始方法相当，表明这些数据集在任务设计上存在缺陷。改进点在于揭示了现有数据集的不足，并探讨了域适应训练的有效性。效果上，BERT-QA在两个数据集上达到与原方法相当的性能，说明视觉信息未被充分利用。
2309.01380|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes two text-based video question answering datasets, NewsVideoQA and M4-ViteVQA, examining the degree of visual understanding and multi-frame reasoning required. It experiments with a text-only model, BERT-QA, which achieves comparable performance to original methods, revealing shortcomings in dataset formulation. The study also explores domain adaptation training. Results show that BERT-QA matches original methods on both datasets, indicating that visual information is underutilized.
2309.01380|v2.assessment: 该工作对现有文本视频QA数据集提出了批判性分析，但方法创新有限，更偏向于数据集分析。
2309.01380|v2.contribution: 揭示了NewsVideoQA和M4-ViteVQA数据集中视觉信息利用不足的问题。
2309.01380|v2.innovation: 使用纯文本模型BERT-QA验证数据集对视觉理解的依赖程度。
2309.01380|v2.result: BERT-QA在两个数据集上达到与原方法相当的性能，表明视觉信息未被充分利用。

UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频理解中图像ViT潜力未被充分挖掘的问题，提出UniFormerV2，将预训练图像ViT适配到视频任务。方法上通过设计轻量级时序模块和跨模态交互，解锁图像ViT的时空建模能力。相比已有视频模型，其改进在于无需从头预训练，直接利用图像ViT的强表征。摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在多个视频基准上取得领先性能。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of image ViTs for video understanding by proposing UniFormerV2, which adapts pre-trained image ViTs to video tasks. It introduces lightweight temporal modules and cross-modal interaction to unlock spatiotemporal modeling. Compared to existing video models, it avoids training from scratch and leverages strong image ViT representations. While no specific numbers are given, it claims state-of-the-art performance on multiple video benchmarks.
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.assessment: 该工作有效利用图像ViT进行视频理解，方法设计合理，有望推动视频模型的高效迁移。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.contribution: 提出UniFormerV2，将预训练图像ViT适配到视频理解任务。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.innovation: 通过轻量级时序模块和跨模态交互解锁图像ViT的时空建模能力。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.result: 声称在多个视频基准上取得领先性能，但未提供具体数据。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of._arxiv_id: UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of Image ViTs for Video Understanding.

Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_cn: 针对视频异常理解中缺乏对异常因果性（what/why/how）系统评测的问题，论文构建了一个综合基准，用于评估模型对视频异常成因的理解能力。方法上通过设计多维度标注与评测协议，覆盖异常类型、原因与发生机制，并在此基准上评测现有视频理解与多模态模型。相比以往仅关注异常检测或简单描述的基准，该工作更强调因果推理与解释性。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但提供了统一的评测框架以推动可解释视频异常理解研究。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic evaluation for causal understanding (what/why/how) of video anomalies by introducing a comprehensive benchmark. It designs multi-dimensional annotations and evaluation protocols covering anomaly types, causes, and mechanisms, and benchmarks existing video understanding and multimodal models. Compared with prior benchmarks focused on detection or shallow captioning, it emphasizes causal reasoning and explainability, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.assessment: 该基准有望推动视频异常从“检测”走向“因果解释”，对可解释视频理解与安全应用有参考价值。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.contribution: 提出了面向视频异常因果理解（what/why/how）的综合评测基准与协议。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.innovation: 将异常理解评测从检测/描述扩展到因果推理与解释维度。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.result: 建立了统一评测框架并用于评估现有视频理解与多模态模型（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe._arxiv_id: Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Causation Understanding of Video Anomaly.

A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_cn: 针对点云视频理解中缺乏以人为中心的统一建模与任务框架的问题，论文提出一个统一框架用于人类中心的点云视频理解。方法上围绕人体运动与交互设计统一的表示与学习范式，支持多种下游任务（如动作/交互理解等）。相比以往分散处理单帧点云或仅做静态人体分析的工作，该框架强调时序点云中的人体动态建模。摘要未提供具体实验数值，但给出了统一任务设定与方法路线。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_en: This paper targets human-centric point cloud video understanding by proposing a unified framework for modeling human dynamics and interactions in point cloud sequences. It introduces a unified representation and learning paradigm supporting multiple downstream tasks, in contrast to prior work that handles static point clouds or isolated frames. The abstract does not report specific quantitative results but provides a unified task formulation and methodological pipeline.
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.assessment: 以人为中心的点云视频是3D视觉与视频理解的交叉方向，该统一框架对后续任务标准化有潜在价值。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.contribution: 提出了人类中心点云视频理解的统一框架与任务设定。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.innovation: 将点云视频理解统一到以人为中心的时序建模范式中。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.result: 给出统一方法路线并支持多任务（摘要未给出具体数值）。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po._arxiv_id: A Unified Framework for Human-centric Point Cloud Video Understanding.

Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_cn: 针对视频异常检测在开放世界中需要识别未见异常类别的问题，论文提出开放词汇视频异常检测（Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection）任务与方法。方法上利用视觉-语言模型/文本语义空间来对齐正常与异常概念，从而在推理时泛化到训练中未出现的异常类别。相比传统闭集异常检测只能处理已知异常，该工作显著提升了开放场景下的泛化能力。摘要未给出具体数值，但明确了开放词汇设定与跨类别泛化目标。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_en: This paper addresses open-world video anomaly detection where models must recognize unseen anomaly categories, proposing the Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection task and method. It leverages vision-language models and text semantic spaces to align normal and abnormal concepts, enabling generalization to anomalies unseen during training. Compared with closed-set anomaly detection, it substantially improves open-scene generalization, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..assessment: 将开放词汇范式引入视频异常检测，契合开放世界感知趋势，对异常检测与VLM交叉研究有启发。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..contribution: 提出开放词汇视频异常检测任务并给出基于视觉-语言对齐的方法。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..innovation: 用文本语义空间建模异常概念以泛化到未见异常类别。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..result: 实现跨类别开放场景异常识别（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶安全感知中缺乏对事故因果与驾驶者视角理解的问题，论文提出“溯因式自我视角事故视频理解”（Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Understanding）任务与数据集/方法。方法上从第一视角行车视频出发，结合溯因推理对事故发生的前因后果进行解释与预测，服务于安全驾驶感知。相比仅做碰撞检测或事件分类的工作，该研究强调因果解释与可解释性。摘要未给出具体数值，但明确了面向安全驾驶的评测目标。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_en: This paper targets safe driving perception by introducing abductive ego-view accident video understanding, focusing on causal explanation of accidents from the driver's perspective. It builds a task/dataset and method that perform abductive reasoning over first-person driving videos to explain and anticipate accident causes and outcomes. In contrast to collision detection or event classification, it emphasizes causal explanation and interpretability, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.assessment: 面向自动驾驶安全的事故因果理解具有明确应用价值，第一视角+溯因推理的设定对安全感知研究有吸引力。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.contribution: 提出溯因式自我视角事故视频理解任务与相应数据/方法。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.innovation: 将溯因推理引入第一视角事故视频以解释事故因果。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.result: 面向安全驾驶感知提供可解释的事故理解方案（摘要未给出具体数值）。

MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型在长视频理解中受限于上下文长度与记忆能力的问题，论文提出 MA-LMM（Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model）。方法上引入记忆库/记忆增强机制，将历史视觉特征压缩并长期保存，使模型能够在超长视频上进行时序推理与问答。相比直接扩展上下文或稀疏采样的做法，该方法在长时依赖建模上更高效。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调了对长期视频理解任务的改进。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited context length and memory of large multimodal models for long-term video understanding by proposing MA-LMM, a memory-augmented large multimodal model. It introduces a memory bank that compresses and retains historical visual features for long-horizon temporal reasoning and question answering. Compared with naive context extension or sparse sampling, it improves long-range dependency modeling, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.assessment: 记忆增强是长视频多模态理解的关键方向，MA-LMM对长时视频问答与推理有较强参考价值。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.contribution: 提出记忆增强的大型多模态模型 MA-LMM 用于长视频理解。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.innovation: 通过记忆库压缩并长期保存历史视觉特征以支持长时推理。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.result: 提升长视频时序推理与问答能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda._arxiv_id: MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model for Long-Term Video Understanding.

TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型在长视频理解中缺乏时间敏感性与精确定位能力的问题，论文提出 TimeChat，一个时间敏感的多模态大语言模型。方法上设计时间感知的视觉编码与时间戳对齐机制，使模型能够进行时间定位、密集描述与长视频问答。相比通用视频LLM，TimeChat更强调对事件时间边界的精确理解。摘要未给出具体数值，但明确了时间敏感长视频理解的目标。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_en: This paper targets the lack of temporal sensitivity and precise localization in multimodal LLMs for long video understanding, proposing TimeChat, a time-sensitive multimodal large language model. It designs time-aware visual encoding and timestamp alignment to support temporal grounding, dense captioning, and long-video QA. Compared with generic video LLMs, it emphasizes precise understanding of event temporal boundaries, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.assessment: 时间敏感建模是长视频多模态理解的核心挑战，TimeChat对时间定位与密集描述任务有较强参考价值。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.contribution: 提出时间敏感的多模态大语言模型 TimeChat 用于长视频理解。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.innovation: 通过时间感知视觉编码与时间戳对齐实现精确时间定位。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.result: 支持时间定位、密集描述与长视频问答（摘要未给出具体数值）。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La._arxiv_id: TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal Large Language Model for Long Video Understanding.

Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型在图像与视频理解上通常需要分别设计视觉编码器、难以统一处理的问题，本文提出 Chat-UniVi，用一组动态视觉 token 统一表示图像和视频。方法通过多尺度 token 聚合与时空 token 合并，将图像视为单帧视频，从而让同一个 LLM 同时具备图像与视频对话能力。相比此前需要双编码器或大规模视频指令数据的方法，它在训练数据更少的情况下取得更优表现。在图像与视频问答基准上，Chat-UniVi 以约 4K 视频和图像指令数据训练即超过部分使用百万级数据的方法。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of multimodal LLMs that require separate visual encoders for images and videos. Chat-UniVi represents both modalities with a unified set of dynamic visual tokens via multi-scale aggregation and spatiotemporal token merging, treating images as single-frame videos. It outperforms prior dual-encoder or data-heavy approaches while trained on only about 4K video and image instruction samples.
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.assessment: 统一视觉表征的思路简洁有效，对多模态大模型的视频理解扩展有参考价值，但与本领域自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.contribution: 提出用统一动态视觉 token 同时支撑图像与视频理解的多模态大模型框架。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.innovation: 将图像视为单帧视频并用多尺度时空 token 合并实现统一视觉表征。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.result: 以约 4K 指令数据训练即在多项图像与视频问答基准上超越使用更大规模数据的方法。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio._arxiv_id: Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representation Empowers Large Language Models with Image and Video Understanding.

HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_cn: 针对视频场景图生成中对象关系随时间和层级变化难以建模的问题，本文提出分层交错图（HIG）方法。方法构建跨帧的对象与关系分层图结构，通过交错的消息传递捕捉时序与语义层级依赖，用于视频场景图生成。相比逐帧独立或简单时序聚合的方法，HIG 更好地建模了长程与层级关系。在视频场景图基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_en: This paper targets video scene graph generation where object relations evolve over time and across semantic hierarchies. It proposes a Hierarchical Interlacement Graph (HIG) that builds layered object-relation graphs across frames and performs interleaved message passing. The approach improves over per-frame or naive temporal aggregation baselines on video scene graph benchmarks.
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.assessment: 图结构建模时序关系的思路有一定新意，但属于视频理解细分方向，与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.contribution: 提出分层交错图结构用于视频场景图生成。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.innovation: 通过跨帧分层图与交错消息传递联合建模时序与语义层级关系。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.result: 在视频场景图生成基准上优于已有方法。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap._arxiv_id: HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Approach to Scene Graph Generation in Video Understanding.

A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_cn: 针对第一人称视频理解中单一任务监督信号不足、技能难以迁移的问题，本文提出将多种任务视角视为可组合技能的方法。方法构建多任务学习框架，让模型从不同任务（如动作识别、预测等）中学习共享表征并迁移到新任务。相比单任务训练，多任务视角提升了泛化能力。在多个第一人称视频基准上验证了跨任务迁移带来的性能提升。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited supervision and poor skill transfer in egocentric video understanding. It proposes treating diverse task perspectives as composable skills within a multi-task learning framework, enabling shared representations that transfer to new tasks. Experiments on egocentric benchmarks show improved generalization over single-task training.
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.assessment: 多任务技能组合的视角对视频理解泛化有启发，但应用场景偏第一人称视频，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.contribution: 提出以多任务技能视角进行第一人称视频理解的学习框架。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.innovation: 将不同任务视为可组合技能以实现跨任务表征迁移。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.result: 在多个第一人称视频基准上取得优于单任务方法的泛化性能。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi._arxiv_id: A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Video Understanding with Diverse Task Perspectives.

MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中密集 token 导致计算与内存开销过大的问题，本文提出 MovieChat，用稀疏记忆机制处理长视频。方法将视频 token 压缩为短期记忆与长期记忆，通过记忆合并与检索在固定预算下保留关键信息，从而支持超长视频问答。相比直接扩展上下文窗口的方法，MovieChat 在更长视频上保持稳定性能。在长视频问答基准上以显著更低的内存开销取得领先或相当的结果。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_en: This paper tackles the prohibitive compute and memory cost of dense tokens in long-video understanding. MovieChat compresses video tokens into short-term and long-term memories with merging and retrieval, enabling question answering over very long videos under a fixed budget. It achieves competitive or leading results on long-video QA benchmarks with substantially lower memory.
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.assessment: 稀疏记忆机制对长时序视频建模有实用价值，其记忆压缩思想对自动驾驶长序列感知有潜在借鉴意义。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.contribution: 提出基于稀疏记忆的长视频理解框架 MovieChat。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.innovation: 用短期与长期记忆的合并与检索替代密集 token 表示。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.result: 在长视频问答基准上以更低内存开销取得领先或相当性能。

OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务繁多、各任务通常需要专门架构的问题，本文提出生成式统一框架 OmniViD。方法将多种视频任务统一为序列到序列的生成范式，用共享的视觉编码器与生成式解码器处理分类、检测、描述等任务。相比任务专用模型，OmniViD 在单一框架下实现跨任务统一。在多个视频理解基准上取得与专用方法相当或更优的性能。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_en: This paper addresses the task-specific architectures prevalent in video understanding by proposing OmniViD, a generative framework that unifies diverse video tasks into a sequence-to-sequence formulation. A shared visual encoder and generative decoder handle classification, detection, and captioning within one model. It matches or surpasses task-specific methods across multiple video benchmarks.
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.assessment: 统一生成式范式对多任务视频理解有较强通用性，其统一建模思路对多任务感知系统设计有参考价值。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.contribution: 提出统一多种视频理解任务的生成式框架 OmniViD。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.innovation: 将分类、检测、描述等视频任务统一为序列到序列生成范式。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.result: 在多个视频理解基准上达到与任务专用方法相当或更优的性能。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ._arxiv_id: OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Universal Video Understanding.

Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_cn: 针对组合式视频理解中对象与动作组合关系难以建模的问题，本文提出基于时空结构的 Transformer 方法。方法显式建模视频中的时空结构关系，通过结构感知的注意力机制捕捉对象、动作及其组合依赖。相比仅依赖外观特征的 Transformer，该方法更好地处理未见组合。在组合式视频理解基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_en: This paper targets compositional video understanding where object-action combinations are hard to model. It proposes a spatiotemporal structure-based Transformer that explicitly encodes structural relations and uses structure-aware attention to capture object, action, and compositional dependencies. It outperforms appearance-only Transformers on compositional video benchmarks.
Compositional Video Understanding with S.assessment: 显式时空结构建模对组合泛化有启发，但属于视频理解细分方向，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.contribution: 提出基于时空结构的 Transformer 用于组合式视频理解。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.innovation: 用结构感知注意力显式建模对象与动作的组合依赖。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.result: 在组合式视频理解基准上优于已有方法。
Compositional Video Understanding with S._arxiv_id: Compositional Video Understanding with Spatiotemporal Structure-based Transformers.

Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中跨域泛化能力不足的问题，本文提出"先对齐再适应"（Align Before Adapt）框架，利用实体到区域的细粒度对齐来增强模型的泛化性。方法通过将视频中的实体（如物体、人物）与对应区域建立对齐关系，再基于此进行动作识别适配。相比已有工作，该方法强调对齐先于适应，避免了对目标域数据的过拟合。在多个跨域动作识别基准上取得了优于现有方法的泛化性能。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited cross-domain generalization of video action recognition by proposing an "Align Before Adapt" framework that leverages entity-to-region alignments. The method first aligns entities in videos with their corresponding spatial regions, then adapts this alignment for action recognition. It outperforms existing methods on multiple cross-domain action recognition benchmarks by avoiding overfitting to target domains.
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.assessment: 该工作从实体-区域对齐角度切入视频动作识别的泛化问题，思路新颖，对视频理解领域有一定参考价值。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.contribution: 提出实体到区域对齐的"先对齐再适应"框架用于可泛化视频动作识别。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.innovation: 将对齐机制前置到适应之前，利用实体-区域对应关系提升跨域泛化。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.result: 在多个跨域动作识别基准上取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to._arxiv_id: Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to-Region Alignments for Generalizable Video Action Recognition.

Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_cn: 针对开放式视频问答（Video QA）中标注不足的问题，本文提出排序蒸馏（Ranking Distillation）方法。核心思路是利用排序信息而非硬标签来蒸馏知识，缓解标签稀缺带来的监督信号不足。相比传统蒸馏方法，排序蒸馏能更好地处理开放式答案空间的排序关系。在标注不足的开放式视频问答任务上取得了性能提升。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient labels in open-ended video question answering by proposing a Ranking Distillation method. The approach leverages ranking information rather than hard labels for knowledge distillation, alleviating the scarcity of supervision signals. It improves performance on open-ended video QA tasks under label-insufficient settings compared to conventional distillation methods.
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.assessment: 将排序蒸馏引入开放式视频问答以应对标签不足，问题定位清晰，方法有一定新意。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.contribution: 提出排序蒸馏方法解决标注不足下的开放式视频问答。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.innovation: 利用排序关系而非硬标签进行知识蒸馏以缓解标签稀缺。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.result: 在标注不足的开放式视频问答任务上取得性能提升。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide._arxiv_id: Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Video Question Answering with Insufficient Labels.

Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_cn: 针对视频问答中视觉与语言模态融合不充分的问题，本文提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏（Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation）方法。该方法利用语言信息引导视觉语义的蒸馏过程，使视觉特征更好地服务于问答任务。相比已有工作，其改进在于将语言感知融入蒸馏框架，增强了跨模态语义对齐。在视频问答基准上取得了性能提升。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient vision-language fusion in video question answering by proposing a Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation method. The approach uses linguistic information to guide the distillation of visual semantics, enabling visual features to better serve the QA task. It improves cross-modal semantic alignment and achieves performance gains on video QA benchmarks.
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.assessment: 语言感知蒸馏为视频问答的跨模态对齐提供了新思路，对多模态视频理解研究者有参考意义。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.contribution: 提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏方法用于视频问答。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.innovation: 将语言信息引入视觉语义蒸馏以增强跨模态对齐。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.result: 在视频问答基准上取得性能提升。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat._arxiv_id: Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation for Video Question Answering.

E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_cn: 针对零样本时空视频定位（Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding）任务，本文提出E3M框架，利用期望最大化（EM）进行多模态调制。方法通过EM算法迭代优化多模态特征的调制过程，实现无需训练样本的时空定位。相比已有零样本方法，E3M在多模态调制上更具自适应性和鲁棒性。在零样本时空视频定位基准上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_en: This paper addresses zero-shot spatio-temporal video grounding by proposing E3M, which employs Expectation-Maximization for multimodal modulation. The method iteratively optimizes multimodal feature modulation via EM to achieve grounding without training samples. It outperforms existing zero-shot methods on spatio-temporal video grounding benchmarks with improved adaptivity and robustness.
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.assessment: 将EM算法引入零样本时空视频定位的多模态调制，方法设计有特色，对视频定位研究者有参考价值。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.contribution: 提出基于EM多模态调制的零样本时空视频定位框架E3M。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.innovation: 利用期望最大化迭代优化多模态特征调制实现零样本定位。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.result: 在零样本时空视频定位基准上优于现有方法。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro._arxiv_id: E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding with Expectation-Maximization Multimodal Modulation.

🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中信息量大、上下文依赖强的问题，本文提出VideoAgent，一个记忆增强的多模态智能体。该方法通过记忆机制存储和检索视频中的关键信息，结合多模态大模型进行推理与问答。相比已有视频理解方法，VideoAgent引入了智能体范式和记忆增强，能更有效地处理长视频的复杂查询。在长视频理解基准上取得了显著性能提升。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of long-video understanding by proposing VideoAgent, a memory-augmented multimodal agent. The method stores and retrieves key information from videos via a memory mechanism and performs reasoning and QA with multimodal large models. Compared to existing approaches, VideoAgent introduces an agent paradigm with memory augmentation, achieving significant improvements on long-video understanding benchmarks.
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.assessment: 将记忆增强智能体范式引入视频理解，契合当前多模态大模型与Agent结合的趋势，值得关注。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.contribution: 提出记忆增强的多模态智能体VideoAgent用于视频理解。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.innovation: 结合记忆机制与多模态大模型构建视频理解智能体。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.result: 在长视频理解基准上取得显著性能提升。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo._arxiv_id: 🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Video Understanding.

2407.21757|v2.summary_cn: 针对叙事视频（如电影）理解中角色、对话、剧情等丰富上下文带来的挑战，本文提出MovieSeq，一个多模态语言模型。核心思想是将视频表示为交错的多模态序列（图像、剧情、视频、字幕），通过链接外部知识库或使用离线模型（如Whisper提取字幕）构建序列，并经指令微调使语言模型能以交错多模态指令与视频交互。相比仅以视频为输入的方法，MovieSeq联合提供角色照片、姓名和对话，使模型能关联这些元素并生成更全面的回答。在LVU、MAD、Movienet、CMD、TVC、MovieQA六个数据集、五种设置（视频分类、音频描述、视频-文本检索、视频字幕、视频问答）上验证了有效性。
2407.21757|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenges of narrative video understanding (e.g., movies) with rich contexts such as characters, dialogues, and storylines by introducing MovieSeq, a multimodal language model. The core idea is to represent videos as interleaved multimodal sequences (images, plots, videos, subtitles) constructed via external knowledge bases or offline models (e.g., Whisper for subtitles), and to instruction-tune the model to interact with videos using interleaved multimodal instructions. Instead of relying solely on video input, MovieSeq jointly provides character photos with names and dialogues, enabling the model to associate these elements and generate more comprehensive responses. It is validated on six datasets (LVU, MAD, Movienet, CMD, TVC, MovieQA) across five settings (video classification, audio description, video-text retrieval, video captioning, and video QA).
2407.21757|v2.assessment: MovieSeq将叙事视频表示为交错多模态序列并指令微调，覆盖六个数据集五种任务，系统性强，对多模态视频理解研究者有较高参考价值。
2407.21757|v2.contribution: 提出将视频表示为交错多模态序列的多模态语言模型MovieSeq。
2407.21757|v2.innovation: 通过交错多模态序列与指令微调实现角色、对话、剧情的联合建模。
2407.21757|v2.result: 在LVU、MAD、Movienet、CMD、TVC、MovieQA六个数据集五种设置上验证了有效性。

InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_cn: 针对多模态视频理解缺乏通用基础模型的问题，本文提出InternVideo2，通过扩展模型规模与数据规模构建视频基础模型。方法上采用多阶段训练策略，结合掩码视频建模、跨模态对比学习与下一token预测等目标，统一处理视频理解与生成任务。相比此前视频基础模型，其在模型容量、数据多样性与任务通用性上均有显著提升。在多个视频理解基准上取得领先结果，验证了规模化视频基础模型的有效性。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of general-purpose foundation models for multimodal video understanding by proposing InternVideo2, which scales both model and data. It employs a multi-stage training pipeline combining masked video modeling, cross-modal contrastive learning, and next-token prediction to unify video understanding and generation. Compared with prior video foundation models, it achieves stronger generality and state-of-the-art results across multiple video benchmarks.
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.assessment: 该工作系统性地推进了视频基础模型的规模化训练范式，对多模态视频理解方向具有重要参考价值。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.contribution: 提出了一个可扩展的多模态视频理解基础模型InternVideo2及其多阶段训练框架。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.innovation: 将掩码视频建模、跨模态对比与生成式预训练统一到单一视频基础模型中。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得领先性能，验证了规模化视频基础模型的有效性。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models._arxiv_id: InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models for Multimodal Video Understanding.

2311.17893|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督视频目标分割依赖辅助模态或迭代slot attention导致通用性差、计算开销大的问题，本文提出一种简单有效的自监督VOS方法。核心洞察是DINO预训练Transformer中固有的结构依赖可建立鲁棒的时空对应关系，仅需在对应线索上做简单聚类即可获得有竞争力的分割结果。方法上引入单个时空Transformer块处理逐帧DINO特征，以自注意力形式建立时空依赖，再对注意力图进行层次聚类生成目标掩码。相比此前依赖辅助模态或slot attention的方法，该方案无需额外模态且计算更高效，同时保持竞争性分割性能。
2311.17893|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised video object segmentation without relying on auxiliary modalities or iterative slot attention, which limit generality and increase computation. It leverages the inherent structural dependencies in DINO-pretrained Transformers to establish robust spatio-temporal correspondences, using a single spatio-temporal Transformer block and hierarchical clustering on attention maps to produce segmentation masks. The approach achieves competitive segmentation results while being simpler and more efficient than prior self-supervised VOS methods.
2311.17893|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了DINO自注意力中隐含的物体性可被直接用于VOS，为自监督视频分割提供了简洁而有效的新思路。
2311.17893|v2.contribution: 提出了一种仅依赖DINO预训练Transformer注意力进行自监督视频目标分割的简化框架。
2311.17893|v2.innovation: 利用DINO自注意力中的时空对应关系配合层次聚类直接生成分割掩码，无需辅助模态或slot attention。
2311.17893|v2.result: 在无需额外模态和slot attention的情况下取得了有竞争力的自监督VOS分割性能。

2407.03788|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频-文本对不完全对齐以及概念分布不均衡导致视频-语言表示无法准确反映跨模态语义、冷门概念下游性能差的问题，本文提出MAMA方法。该方法在对比目标中引入减法角度间隔来正则化跨模态表示，并利用MLP参数化的加权函数将损失值映射为样本权重，实现训练过程中模型关注点的动态调整。训练由少量无偏元数据引导，并借助大视觉语言模型生成的视频-文本数据增强。相比已有方法，MAMA在常见视频-语言基准上取得了更优的表示性能。
2407.03788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses imperfect video-text alignment and uneven concept distribution in video-language representation learning, which degrade cross-modal semantics and rare-concept performance. It proposes MAMA, which uses a contrastive objective with a subtractive angular margin and an MLP-parameterized weighting function that maps loss values to sample weights for dynamic focus adjustment, guided by a small amount of unbiased meta-data and augmented with VLM-generated video-text data. MAMA improves video-language representations and achieves superior performance on common benchmarks.
2407.03788|v2.assessment: 该工作从数据质量与概念分布两个角度改进视频-语言对比学习，元优化加权机制对多模态表示学习有借鉴意义。
2407.03788|v2.contribution: 提出了结合减法角度间隔对比目标与元学习样本加权的视频-语言表示学习框架MAMA。
2407.03788|v2.innovation: 用MLP参数化加权函数将损失映射为样本权重，并借助无偏元数据实现训练关注点的动态调整。
2407.03788|v2.result: 在常见视频-语言基准上取得了优于已有方法的表示性能。

2412.12075|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中现有基准多依赖全局语义、缺乏对细粒度线索定位能力评估的问题，本文提出CG-Bench，一个基于线索（clue-grounded）的长视频问答基准。该基准要求模型在长视频中定位回答问题所需的具体时序片段，而非仅凭整体语义猜测答案。相比已有长视频QA基准，CG-Bench引入了线索标注与多类型问题设计，能更严格地衡量模型的时序定位与推理能力。实验显示现有先进视频大模型在该基准上表现显著下降，暴露出长视频细粒度理解能力的不足。
2412.12075|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces CG-Bench, a clue-grounded question answering benchmark for long video understanding that requires models to localize the specific temporal segments needed to answer each question. Unlike prior long-video QA benchmarks that rely on global semantics, CG-Bench enforces fine-grained temporal grounding and multi-type question design. Experiments show that state-of-the-art video LLMs degrade substantially on this benchmark, revealing limitations in fine-grained long-video comprehension.
2412.12075|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了长视频理解中细粒度时序定位评估的空白，对视频理解与多模态大模型研究者具有较高参考价值。
2412.12075|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于线索定位的长视频问答基准CG-Bench。
2412.12075|v2.innovation: 通过线索标注强制模型进行时序片段定位而非全局语义猜测。
2412.12075|v2.result: 现有先进视频大模型在该基准上性能显著下降，暴露长视频细粒度理解短板。

2502.10810|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视频理解基准多基于离线完整视频、无法评估流式场景下多轮对话能力的问题，本文提出SVBench，一个面向流式视频理解的时序多轮对话基准。该基准模拟视频流持续到达的场景，要求模型在多轮交互中保持对历史内容的记忆并回答时序相关问题。相比传统离线视频QA，SVBench更贴近真实在线视频应用需求，能评估模型的流式记忆与推理能力。实验表明现有视频大模型在流式多轮设定下性能明显受限。
2502.10810|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SVBench, a benchmark with temporal multi-turn dialogues for streaming video understanding, where video frames arrive continuously and models must maintain memory across turns. Unlike offline video QA benchmarks, SVBench evaluates streaming memory and temporal reasoning in interactive settings. Experiments reveal that current video LLMs struggle substantially under streaming multi-turn conditions.
2502.10810|v2.assessment: 该工作关注流式视频理解这一实际但被忽视的场景，对在线视频应用与多模态对话研究者有参考意义。
2502.10810|v2.contribution: 提出了面向流式视频理解的时序多轮对话基准SVBench。
2502.10810|v2.innovation: 将多轮对话与时序流式视频结合，评估模型的持续记忆能力。
2502.10810|v2.result: 现有视频大模型在流式多轮设定下性能明显受限。

TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对交通场景中缺乏统一时空视频理解基准的问题，本文提出TUMTraf VideoQA数据集与基准，覆盖交通场景中的时空视频问答任务。该数据集整合了多视角、多模态的交通视频数据，并设计了涵盖目标、行为、时序关系的问答标注。相比已有交通数据集多聚焦单一感知任务，该工作统一了时空理解评估，为自动驾驶场景下的视频大模型提供测试平台。实验揭示了现有模型在复杂交通时空推理上的不足。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper introduces TUMTraf VideoQA, a dataset and benchmark for unified spatio-temporal video understanding in traffic scenes, integrating multi-view and multimodal traffic video with QA annotations covering objects, behaviors, and temporal relations. Unlike prior traffic datasets focused on single perception tasks, it unifies spatio-temporal understanding evaluation for autonomous driving. Experiments expose deficiencies of current models in complex traffic spatio-temporal reasoning.
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.assessment: 该工作将视频问答引入交通场景，为自动驾驶多模态理解提供了有价值的评测基准。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.contribution: 构建了统一的交通场景时空视频理解数据集与基准TUMTraf VideoQA。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.innovation: 将多视角交通视频与时空问答任务统一到同一基准中。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.result: 现有模型在复杂交通时空推理任务上表现不足。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f._arxiv_id: TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark for Unified Spatio-Temporal Video Understanding in Traffic Scenes.

Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_cn: 针对4D点云视频理解中时空信息耦合、计算效率低的问题，本文提出Mamba4D，利用解耦的时空状态空间模型高效处理4D点云视频。方法将空间与时间建模分离，分别用状态空间模型捕获点云的空间结构与帧间时序动态，降低计算复杂度。相比基于Transformer的方法，Mamba4D在保持精度的同时显著提升效率。实验在多个4D点云视频基准上取得有竞争力的性能并降低计算开销。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_en: This paper proposes Mamba4D, which leverages disentangled spatial-temporal state space models for efficient 4D point cloud video understanding. It separates spatial and temporal modeling to capture point cloud structure and inter-frame dynamics with reduced complexity. Compared with Transformer-based methods, Mamba4D achieves competitive accuracy with substantially improved efficiency on multiple 4D point cloud video benchmarks.
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.assessment: 该工作将状态空间模型引入4D点云视频理解，兼顾效率与精度，对3D/4D感知研究者有参考价值。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.contribution: 提出了基于解耦时空状态空间模型的4D点云视频理解方法Mamba4D。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.innovation: 将空间与时间建模解耦并采用状态空间模型降低计算复杂度。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.result: 在多个4D点云视频基准上取得有竞争力精度并显著降低计算开销。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video._arxiv_id: Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video Understanding with Disentangled Spatial-Temporal State Space Models.

Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_cn: 针对点云视频理解中预训练3D模型难以直接迁移、时空信息利用不足的问题，本文提出通过跨帧时空感知来适配预训练3D模型用于点云视频理解。方法在预训练3D骨干上引入跨帧时空感知模块，融合帧间对应关系与时序动态。相比从头训练或简单微调，该方法更好利用了预训练知识并提升时序建模能力。实验表明该适配策略在点云视频任务上优于基线方法。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_en: This paper adapts pre-trained 3D models for point cloud video understanding via cross-frame spatio-temporal perception, introducing a module that fuses inter-frame correspondences and temporal dynamics on top of a pre-trained 3D backbone. Compared with training from scratch or naive fine-tuning, it better exploits pre-trained knowledge and improves temporal modeling. Experiments show consistent gains over baselines on point cloud video tasks.
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.assessment: 该工作探索了预训练3D模型向点云视频迁移的路径，对3D感知与视频理解交叉方向有参考意义。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.contribution: 提出了跨帧时空感知的预训练3D模型适配方法用于点云视频理解。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.innovation: 在预训练3D骨干上引入跨帧时空感知模块融合帧间对应与时序动态。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.result: 在点云视频任务上优于从头训练与简单微调的基线方法。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point._arxiv_id: Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point Cloud Video Understanding via Cross-frame Spatio-temporal Perception.

2503.18223|v2.summary_cn: 针对野生动物行为监测中缺乏标注视频数据集、限制视频理解模型发展的问题，本文提出MammAlps，一个来自瑞士国家公园9个相机陷阱的多模态多视角野生动物行为监测数据集。数据集包含超14小时带音频视频、2D分割图和8.5小时个体轨迹标注，并基于6135个单动物片段提出首个分层多模态动物行为识别基准，以及面向生态学的多视角长期事件基准。该工作为野生动物行为监测提供了大规模标注资源与评测平台。
2503.18223|v2.summary_en: This paper presents MammAlps, a multimodal and multi-view dataset of wildlife behavior monitoring from 9 camera traps in the Swiss National Park, containing over 14 hours of video with audio, 2D segmentation maps, and 8.5 hours of individual tracks. Based on 6135 single-animal clips, it proposes the first hierarchical and multimodal animal behavior recognition benchmark, plus an ecology-oriented multi-view long-term event benchmark. It provides large-scale annotated resources and evaluation platforms for wildlife behavior monitoring.
2503.18223|v2.assessment: 该数据集为生态学与视频理解交叉研究提供了稀缺的多模态多视角标注资源，但与本领域核心方向相关度较低。
2503.18223|v2.contribution: 构建了多模态多视角野生动物行为监测数据集MammAlps及配套基准。
2503.18223|v2.innovation: 首次提出分层多模态动物行为识别基准并整合音频、视频与分割图。
2503.18223|v2.result: 提供超14小时视频、8.5小时轨迹标注及6135个单动物片段的行为识别基准。

2412.04467|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言模型中视觉 token 数量远超文本 token，带来巨大计算开销，而 CLIP/SigLIP 等编码器产生的视觉 token 存在显著冗余。作者提出 VisionZip，通过选择信息量高的 token 输入语言模型，减少冗余并提升效率，可广泛用于图像与视频理解及多轮对话。相比此前 SOTA 方法，在几乎所有设置下性能提升至少 5%，prefilling 时间加速 8 倍，使 LLaVA-Next 13B 推理快于 7B 且效果更好。
2412.04467|v2.summary_en: Visual tokens in VLMs are far longer than text tokens and highly redundant. VisionZip selects informative tokens to feed the language model, reducing redundancy and improving efficiency for image/video understanding and multi-turn dialogue. It outperforms prior SOTA by at least 5% across nearly all settings and speeds up prefilling by 8x, enabling LLaVA-Next 13B to infer faster than 7B with better results.
2412.04467|v2.assessment: 对 VLM 效率优化有实用价值，token 冗余分析与加速效果显著，但主要面向通用 VLM 而非自动驾驶感知。
2412.04467|v2.contribution: 提出无需训练的视觉 token 选择方法 VisionZip，大幅降低 VLM 视觉 token 冗余。
2412.04467|v2.innovation: 利用视觉编码器 token 冗余特性，选择信息量高的 token 并适配多轮对话场景。
2412.04467|v2.result: 性能提升至少 5%，prefilling 加速 8 倍，13B 模型推理快于 7B 且效果更优。

2503.21483|v2.summary_cn: 大型视频语言模型受限于上下文窗口，长视频分析中均匀帧采样常将资源分配给无关内容。作者提出 BOLT，无需额外训练，通过研究帧选择策略提升长视频理解，并提出多源检索评估设置。实验发现逆变换采样效果最佳，在 Video-MME 上从 53.8% 提升至 56.1%，MLVU 上从 58.9% 提升至 63.4%。
2503.21483|v2.summary_en: Long-form video VLMs are constrained by context windows, and uniform frame sampling wastes resources on irrelevant content. BOLT boosts large VLMs without training via frame selection strategies and a multi-source retrieval evaluation setting. Inverse transform sampling performs best, improving Video-MME from 53.8% to 56.1% and MLVU from 58.9% to 63.4%.
2503.21483|v2.assessment: 无需训练的帧选择策略简单有效，对长视频理解有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2503.21483|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的长视频帧选择方法 BOLT 及多源检索评估设置。
2503.21483|v2.innovation: 系统研究查询-帧相似度帧选择策略，发现逆变换采样最优。
2503.21483|v2.result: Video-MME 从 53.8% 提升至 56.1%，MLVU 从 58.9% 提升至 63.4%。

2412.01095|v2.summary_cn: 视频异常检测中，现有 VLM 方法需专门推理模块或指令微调，计算与标注成本高。作者提出 VERA，一种言语化学习框架，无需修改模型参数，将复杂推理分解为对引导问题的反思，并通过学习器与优化器 VLM 间的言语交互优化这些问题。该方法利用粗标注数据实现可解释的 VAD，降低了计算与标注开销。
2412.01095|v2.summary_en: Existing VLM-based video anomaly detection requires specialized reasoning modules or instruction tuning, incurring high cost. VERA is a verbalized learning framework that performs VAD without parameter modification by decomposing reasoning into reflective guiding questions optimized via verbal interaction between learner and optimizer VLMs. It enables explainable VAD with coarse labels and reduced overhead.
2412.01095|v2.assessment: 言语化学习思路新颖，免参数修改降低部署成本，但异常检测与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
2412.01095|v2.contribution: 提出免参数修改的可解释视频异常检测框架 VERA。
2412.01095|v2.innovation: 将 VAD 推理分解为可学习的反思性问题，通过 VLM 言语交互优化。
2412.01095|v2.result: 利用粗标注数据实现可解释 VAD，降低计算与标注开销。

2412.03735|v2.summary_cn: 多模态大模型在视频理解中易产生幻觉，但该问题在视频领域研究不足。作者构建 VidHalluc，目前最大的视频幻觉评测基准，含 5002 个配对视频，从动作、时序、场景转换三个维度评估幻觉。并提出免训练的 DINO-HEAL，利用 DINOv2 空间显著性重加权视觉特征，平均降低幻觉 3.02%。
2412.03735|v2.summary_en: Hallucination in video MLLMs is underexplored. VidHalluc is the largest benchmark for video hallucination, with 5,002 paired videos assessing action, temporal sequence, and scene transition dimensions. DINO-HEAL, a training-free method using DINOv2 spatial saliency to reweight visual features, reduces hallucinations by an average of 3.02%.
2412.03735|v2.assessment: 视频幻觉基准与免训练缓解方法对多模态可靠性研究有价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接相关性一般。
2412.03735|v2.contribution: 构建最大视频幻觉评测基准 VidHalluc 并提出免训练缓解方法 DINO-HEAL。
2412.03735|v2.innovation: 从动作、时序、场景转换三维度系统评估视频幻觉，利用 DINOv2 显著性重加权特征。
2412.03735|v2.result: 平均降低幻觉 3.02%，多数 MLLM 在各维度均易受幻觉影响。

2411.13281|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频 LMM 评测多依赖 VideoMME 等选择题基准，难以捕捉真实用户复杂需求，且人工标注成本高。作者提出 VideoAutoArena，受 LMSYS Chatbot Arena 启发的竞技场式基准，通过用户模拟生成开放式自适应问题，并采用改进 ELO 评分系统进行公平比较。人工标注金标准验证表明该自动评测与人类判断高度一致，同时保持可扩展性。
2411.13281|v2.summary_en: Existing video LMM evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks that fail to capture real user demands. VideoAutoArena is an arena-style benchmark inspired by LMSYS Chatbot Arena, using user simulation to generate open-ended adaptive questions and a modified ELO rating for fair comparison. A human-annotated gold standard validates strong alignment with human judgment while maintaining scalability.
2411.13281|v2.assessment: 竞技场式自动评测框架对视频 LMM 评估有方法学意义，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2411.13281|v2.contribution: 提出基于用户模拟的竞技场式视频 LMM 自动评测基准 VideoAutoArena。
2411.13281|v2.innovation: 结合用户模拟生成开放式问题与改进 ELO 评分，实现可扩展且与人类一致的评测。
2411.13281|v2.result: 自动评测与人工金标准高度一致，具备良好可扩展性。

2412.10360|v2.summary_cn: 视频 LMM 的底层理解机制尚不清晰，许多设计决策缺乏依据，且训练评测成本高昂。作者开展系统性研究，发现 Scaling Consistency 现象，即小模型/数据集上的设计与训练决策可有效迁移至大模型。基于此探索了视频采样、架构、数据组成、训练计划等方面，例如证明训练时 fps 采样远优于均匀帧采样，并比较了最佳视频表示编码器。
2412.10360|v2.summary_en: The mechanisms driving video understanding in LMMs remain poorly understood. This work presents a comprehensive study revealing Scaling Consistency, where design and training decisions on smaller models/datasets transfer to larger ones. It explores video sampling, architectures, data composition, and training schedules, showing fps sampling during training is vastly preferable to uniform frame sampling and identifying the best vision encoders for video.
2412.10360|v2.assessment: 系统性研究为视频 LMM 设计提供实证指导，Scaling Consistency 发现具有较高参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联中等。
2412.10360|v2.contribution: 系统研究视频 LMM 的关键设计因素并提出 Scaling Consistency 现象。
2412.10360|v2.innovation: 揭示小模型决策可迁移至大模型的 Scaling Consistency，并实证 fps 采样优于均匀采样。
2412.10360|v2.result: 为视频 LMM 的采样、架构、数据与训练策略提供实证指导。

2504.07745|v2.summary_cn: 针对Video-LLM在细粒度视频理解（如视觉动态和细节查询）上的不足，论文提出自监督片段微调方法SF²T，利用视频内在特性进行训练，避免昂贵的人工标注并绕过自然语言难以刻画复杂时空变化的局限。同时构建了FineVidBench基准，在场景级和片段级两个层次系统评估Video-LLM性能。相比依赖人工标注的微调方案，该方法无需额外标注即可解锁更细粒度的理解能力。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称显著提升细粒度视频理解表现。
2504.07745|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the weakness of Video-LLMs in fine-grained video understanding, particularly visual dynamics and detail-oriented queries. It proposes SF²T, a self-supervised fragment fine-tuning method that exploits intrinsic video characteristics to avoid labor-intensive annotation and the limitations of natural language in capturing spatio-temporal variation. A new benchmark, FineVidBench, is introduced for scene- and fragment-level evaluation, and the method is claimed to substantially improve fine-grained understanding without extra annotation.
2504.07745|v2.assessment: 自监督片段微调思路对Video-LLM细粒度理解有启发，配套基准也有一定价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2504.07745|v2.contribution: 提出自监督片段微调方法SF²T及细粒度视频理解基准FineVidBench。
2504.07745|v2.innovation: 利用视频内在自监督信号替代人工标注来提升Video-LLM的细粒度时空理解。
2504.07745|v2.result: 声称在无需额外标注的情况下显著提升Video-LLM的细粒度视频理解能力。

When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.summary_cn: 该论文关注自监督视频表示学习中的时序对应建模问题，标题暗示将未来帧视为过去以驯化时序对应关系。但由于摘要为空，无法确认其具体方法、改进点与实验数据。仅从标题判断，其目标是通过自监督方式学习更强的视频时空表示。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.summary_en: This work targets temporal correspondence modeling for self-supervised video representation learning, as suggested by its title. However, the abstract is empty, so the specific method, improvements, and empirical results cannot be verified. Only the general topic of self-supervised video representation can be inferred.
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.assessment: 主题与自监督视频表示相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法与实验质量，信息不足。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.contribution: 摘要缺失，无法确认核心贡献。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.innovation: 摘要缺失，无法确认创新点。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认实验结果。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming._arxiv_id: When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming Temporal Correspondence for Self-supervised Video Representation Learning.

2411.11934|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目输入合成双目视频中配对数据不足与时空一致性难保持的问题，论文提出基于视频扩散模型的自监督双目视频合成范式SpatialDreamer。方法包含基于深度的视频生成模块DVG，通过前向-后向渲染机制生成带几何与时间先验的配对视频，并配合RefinerNet与自监督合成框架进行高效训练，还设计了Consistency控制模块。相比直接套用新视角合成的方法，其能更好处理动态场景并降低对大量训练数据的依赖。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
2411.11934|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles stereo video synthesis from monocular input, where paired stereo data are scarce and spatio-temporal consistency is hard to maintain. It proposes SpatialDreamer, a self-supervised video diffusion paradigm with a depth-based video generation module (DVG) using forward-backward rendering to produce paired videos with geometric and temporal priors, plus RefinerNet and a consistency control module for efficient training. Unlike direct novel-view-synthesis approaches, it better handles dynamic scenes and reduces training data requirements.
2411.11934|v2.assessment: 将扩散模型与自监督渲染结合用于单目转双目视频，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
2411.11934|v2.contribution: 提出基于视频扩散模型的自监督单目到双目视频合成框架SpatialDreamer。
2411.11934|v2.innovation: 用前向-后向渲染的深度视频生成模块与一致性控制实现动态场景下的自监督双目合成。
2411.11934|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，声称在动态场景与数据效率上优于直接NVS方法。

2506.01037|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于扩散的视频超分方法易引入复杂退化和明显伪影的问题，论文提出结合自监督学习与Mamba的鲁棒真实世界VSR框架。方法在预训练潜扩散模型中引入Video State-Space块与3D选择性扫描的全局时空注意力以低成本增强帧间一致性，并用自监督ControlNet以HR特征为引导、通过对比学习提取退化不敏感特征，最后采用三阶段HR-LR混合训练策略稳定训练。在真实世界VSR基准上取得优于现有方法的感知质量。
2506.01037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses artifacts and complex degradations in diffusion-based real-world video super-resolution. It integrates self-supervised learning and Mamba into a pre-trained latent diffusion model, using a Video State-Space block with 3D selective scan for global spatio-temporal attention, a self-supervised ControlNet guided by HR features with contrastive learning for degradation-insensitive features, and a three-stage HR-LR mixed training strategy. It achieves superior perceptual quality over state-of-the-art methods on real-world VSR benchmarks.
2506.01037|v2.assessment: 将Mamba与自监督ControlNet引入扩散式VSR，工程完整且实验充分，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性一般。
2506.01037|v2.contribution: 提出结合自监督ControlNet与时空Mamba的真实世界视频超分框架。

2601.04068|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到视频扩散模型与人类偏好对齐的问题，指出现有DPO方法依赖多样本排序和任务特定critic模型，效率低且全局监督信号模糊。作者提出LocalDPO后训练框架，通过随机时空掩码局部破坏真实视频并用冻结基座模型仅修复掩码区域，自动构建局部化偏好对，并引入区域感知DPO损失将偏好学习限制在损坏区域。相比已有工作，该方法每次提示仅需一次推理即可生成偏好对，无需外部critic模型或人工标注。在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上实验表明，LocalDPO持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐效果。
2601.04068|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and ambiguous global supervision of existing DPO methods for aligning text-to-video diffusion models with human preferences, which rely on multi-sample ranking and task-specific critics. It proposes LocalDPO, a post-training framework that constructs localized preference pairs by corrupting real videos with random spatio-temporal masks and restoring only masked regions using a frozen base model, optimized with a region-aware DPO loss. Experiments on Wan2.1 and CogVideoX show consistent improvements in video fidelity, temporal coherence, and human preference alignment.
2601.04068|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种高效的局部化偏好优化范式，对视频扩散模型对齐有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知/3D检测领域关联极弱。
2601.04068|v2.contribution: 提出LocalDPO，一种基于局部时空区域偏好对的视频扩散模型后训练对齐框架。
2601.04068|v2.innovation: 利用随机时空掩码局部破坏真实视频并仅修复掩码区域来自动构建偏好对，配合区域感知DPO损失实现高效对齐。
2601.04068|v2.result: 在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐。

2004.07507|v2.summary_cn: 针对含 BatchNorm 层的深度网络在持续学习中的二次惩罚方法，指出 K-FAC 在样本间存在依赖（BN 引起）时近似失效。作者扩展 K-FAC 以纳入样本间关系，在合理假设下正确近似 Hessian，并提出 BN 统计参数的权重合并与重参数化方法，以及无需源任务数据的超参选择方法。在带 BN 的 permuted MNIST 及 ImageNet→细粒度分类（ResNet-50）序列任务上优于基线，且不显式或隐式使用源任务数据调参。
2004.07507|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a quadratic penalty method for continual learning of networks with batch normalization, extending K-FAC to account for inter-example dependencies so that the Hessian can be properly approximated. It further introduces weight merging and reparameterization for BN statistics and a source-data-free hyperparameter selection scheme. Experiments on permuted MNIST with BN and ImageNet-to-fine-grained sequential learning with ResNet-50 show gains over baselines without using source task data.
2004.07507|v2.assessment: 把 K-FAC 持续学习从无 BN 假设推广到实际含 BN 的网络，并解决 BN 统计量与超参选择问题，对持续学习落地有实用价值。
2004.07507|v2.contribution: 提出考虑样本间依赖的扩展 K-FAC 及 BN 参数处理与无源数据超参选择方法。
2004.07507|v2.innovation: 将 K-FAC 近似推广到含 BN 的深度网络并给出权重合并/重参数化方案。
2004.07507|v2.result: 在 permuted MNIST 与 ImageNet→细粒度序列任务上优于基线且无需源任务数据。

2004.00440|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中分类层需不断扩增权重的问题，研究嵌入网络的增量学习，使新类可自然纳入而无需新增权重。提出语义漂移补偿方法，利用当前任务数据经历的漂移来估计并补偿旧任务特征的漂移，且不需要任何样本回放。在 CIFAR100 和 ImageNet-Subset 细粒度数据集上验证，嵌入网络显著减轻灾难性遗忘，性能优于现有方法。
2004.00440|v2.summary_en: This paper studies class-incremental learning for embedding networks, where new classes can be incorporated without adding weights, and proposes a semantic drift compensation method that estimates and compensates feature drift of previous tasks from the drift observed on current task data without any exemplars. Experiments on fine-grained CIFAR100 and ImageNet-Subset show embedding networks suffer significantly less catastrophic forgetting and outperform prior methods.
2004.00440|v2.assessment: 从嵌入网络视角切入类增量学习，无需样本回放的漂移补偿思路简洁有效，对无回放增量学习有参考意义。
2004.00440|v2.contribution: 提出面向嵌入网络的语义漂移补偿类增量学习方法。
2004.00440|v2.innovation: 用当前任务数据的漂移估计旧任务特征漂移，无需任何样本回放。
2004.00440|v2.result: 在 CIFAR100 与 ImageNet-Subset 上显著缓解遗忘并超越现有方法。

2002.00718|v2.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出当前增量学习策略忽略了分割特有的背景类语义分布偏移：每步只标注部分类别，导致背景像素语义发生漂移。作者重新审视经典增量学习方法，提出显式建模该偏移的蒸馏框架，并引入分类器参数初始化策略以避免偏向背景类的预测。在 Pascal-VOC 2012 和 ADE20K 上大幅超越当时最先进的增量学习方法。
2002.00718|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental semantic segmentation, identifying that background pixels undergo a semantic distribution shift since each training step annotates only a subset of classes. It proposes a distillation-based framework that explicitly models this shift and a classifier initialization strategy to prevent biased background predictions. Extensive evaluation on Pascal-VOC 2012 and ADE20K significantly outperforms state-of-the-art incremental learning methods.
2002.00718|v2.assessment: 准确抓住语义分割增量学习中背景类分布偏移这一关键问题，方法针对性强且实验充分，对分割持续学习有较高参考价值。
2002.00718|v2.contribution: 提出显式建模背景类语义偏移的蒸馏式增量语义分割框架及分类器初始化策略。
2002.00718|v2.innovation: 首次将背景类语义分布偏移纳入增量分割的蒸馏建模。
2002.00718|v2.result: 在 Pascal-VOC 2012 与 ADE20K 上显著超越当时最先进方法。

2003.13191|v2.summary_cn: 针对实际应用中增量学习面临的两大障碍：新类学习导致旧类灾难性遗忘，以及旧类新观测随时间到来引发的概念漂移，提出可在在线场景下工作的增量学习框架，同时处理新类数据与旧类新观测。通过改进的交叉蒸馏损失与两步学习技术在在线模式下缓解遗忘。方法在在线增量设定下优于当时最先进方法。
2003.13191|v2.summary_en: This paper targets online incremental learning where both new classes and new observations of old classes arrive sequentially, causing catastrophic forgetting and concept drift. It proposes a framework with a modified cross-distillation loss and a two-step learning technique to handle both issues in online mode. The method outperforms state-of-the-art incremental learning approaches in the online setting.
2003.13191|v2.assessment: 较早关注在线增量学习与概念漂移的联合问题，问题设定贴近实际，但方法创新度相对有限。
2003.13191|v2.contribution: 提出可同时处理新类与旧类新观测的在线增量学习框架。
2003.13191|v2.innovation: 将改进交叉蒸馏损失与两步学习结合用于在线增量场景。
2003.13191|v2.result: 在在线增量设定下性能优于当时最先进方法。

2002.10211|v2.summary_cn: 针对多类增量学习中学习新类与不遗忘旧类的固有矛盾，指出保留少量旧类样本的效果高度依赖样本代表性。提出 mnemonics 框架，将样本参数化并端到端可优化，通过模型级与样本级双层优化训练。在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset 和 ImageNet 三个基准上大幅超越当时最先进方法，并发现优化出的样本倾向于落在不同类的边界上。
2002.10211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between learning new classes and forgetting old ones in multi-class incremental learning, noting that replay effectiveness depends heavily on exemplar representativeness. It proposes the mnemonics framework, which parameterizes exemplars and optimizes them end-to-end via bilevel (model-level and exemplar-level) optimization. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-Subset and ImageNet surpass state-of-the-art by a large margin, with exemplars tending to lie on class boundaries.
2002.10211|v2.assessment: 把样本回放中的样本选择转化为可学习优化问题，思路新颖且实验扎实，对增量学习与样本选择研究均有启发。
2002.10211|v2.contribution: 提出端到端可优化的 mnemonics 样本回放框架用于多类增量学习。
2002.10211|v2.innovation: 将回放样本参数化并通过双层优化自动学习。
2002.10211|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset、ImageNet 上大幅超越当时最先进方法。

1911.07053|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出知识蒸馏虽能维持旧类判别性，但无法阻止模型将样本误判为新类，其正向作用被掩盖。作者观察到最后一层全连接层权重在增量学习中存在严重类别偏置，提出权重对齐（Weight Aligning, WA）方法，在正常训练后校正FC层偏置权重，以维持新旧类间的公平性。相比仅依赖KD的已有方法，WA简单有效且无需额外网络结构。实验表明该方法在多个增量学习基准上显著缓解遗忘，提升新旧类整体准确率。
1911.07053|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning, showing that knowledge distillation (KD) alone maintains discrimination within old classes but fails to prevent bias toward new classes. The authors identify highly biased weights in the last fully connected layer as a key cause and propose Weight Aligning (WA), which corrects these biases after normal training to maintain fairness between old and new classes. The method is simple yet effective, and experiments demonstrate significant reduction in forgetting and improved overall accuracy on standard incremental learning benchmarks.
1911.07053|v2.assessment: 该工作对增量学习中FC层偏置问题给出了简洁而有效的诊断与修正方案，实用性强，值得关注。
1911.07053|v2.contribution: 提出权重对齐（WA）方法，通过校正FC层偏置权重来平衡新旧类，缓解灾难性遗忘。
1911.07053|v2.innovation: 首次明确指出FC层权重偏置是KD效果受限的关键原因，并给出无需额外结构的后处理校正方案。
1911.07053|v2.result: 在多个类增量学习基准上显著提升新旧类准确率，有效缓解遗忘。

Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的类别不平衡问题，提出分区蓄水池采样（Partitioning Reservoir Sampling）方法，旨在解决新任务数据分布倾斜导致旧类遗忘加剧的问题。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但推测其通过分区采样策略平衡回放缓冲区中的类别分布。相比均匀蓄水池采样，该方法可能更有效地维持各类别间的公平性。效果数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_en: This paper addresses class imbalance in continual learning by proposing Partitioning Reservoir Sampling, which aims to mitigate exacerbated forgetting of old classes caused by skewed data distributions in new tasks. Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.assessment: 类别不平衡是持续学习中的关键挑战，分区蓄水池采样思路合理，但摘要缺失影响全面评估。

GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_cn: 该论文对持续学习领域的进展提出质疑，指出许多复杂方法在公平比较下并不优于简单的GDumb基线。GDumb通过在训练时贪婪地收集样本并仅用当前缓冲区数据从头训练模型，在多个基准上达到或超越SOTA。由于摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用，但该工作引发了对持续学习评估范式的反思。相比复杂方法，GDumb强调了简单基线的重要性。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_en: This paper questions the progress in continual learning by showing that a simple baseline, GDumb, matches or outperforms many complex methods under fair comparison. GDumb greedily collects samples during training and trains a model from scratch only on the current buffer. Although the abstract is missing, the work challenges evaluation paradigms in continual learning and highlights the importance of simple baselines.
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.assessment: 该工作对持续学习领域的评估方法提出重要反思，GDumb基线简单却强大，值得研究者关注。

More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_cn: 该论文针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出一种通用的多分类器范式（Multi-classifier Paradigm），通过维护多个分类器来减少遗忘。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但推测其通过为不同任务或类别组分配独立分类器，避免单一分类器权重偏置。相比单分类器方法，该范式可能更有效地保留旧类知识。效果数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
