PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中小任务场景下灾难性遗忘严重的问题，本文提出PODNet，通过池化输出蒸馏（Pooled Outputs Distillation）在多个网络层级上对齐新旧任务的特征统计量（空间维度的池化），并结合表征的宽-深因子分解来提升可塑性与稳定性。相比LwF、iCaRL等仅蒸馏最终logits或分类层的方法，PODNet在中间特征层面施加更强的约束，同时用因子化卷积减少参数冗余。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet等小增量任务协议上取得当时SOTA，显著优于LUCIR等基线，且参数量与计算开销增加有限。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_en: PODNet addresses catastrophic forgetting in small-task incremental learning by distilling pooled intermediate feature statistics across multiple network stages, combined with a factorized wide-and-deep representation. Unlike prior methods that only distill final logits or classifier outputs, it enforces stronger constraints at intermediate layers while reducing parameter redundancy. It achieves state-of-the-art results on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet small-task incremental protocols, outperforming baselines such as LUCIR with limited overhead.
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.assessment: 该工作是增量学习特征蒸馏方向的代表性方法，池化输出蒸馏思路简洁有效，被后续大量工作引用与对比，值得关注。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.contribution: 提出基于多层级池化输出蒸馏的增量学习方法，并配合宽-深因子化表征缓解遗忘。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.innovation: 在中间层对空间池化后的特征统计量进行蒸馏，而非仅蒸馏最终输出。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.result: 在CIFAR-100/ImageNet小增量任务协议上取得当时最优性能，明显超越LUCIR等基线。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for._arxiv_id: PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for Small-Tasks Incremental Learning.

Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中回放旧样本需要存储大量原始数据、内存开销大的问题，本文提出特征自适应（Feature Adaptation）方法，将旧任务特征映射到新特征空间，从而只需存储压缩后的特征而非原始图像。方法通过自编码器式的特征变换对齐新旧特征分布，在保持分类性能的同时大幅降低内存占用。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等基准上，该方法在相同内存预算下优于直接存储原始样本或herding样本选择的回放策略。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_en: This paper tackles the memory overhead of replay-based incremental learning by storing compact features instead of raw images and adapting old features to the evolving feature space. A feature adaptation module aligns old and new feature distributions, preserving classification performance under tight memory budgets. On CIFAR-100 and ImageNet, it outperforms raw-sample replay and herding-based selection at equal memory cost.
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.assessment: 从内存效率角度切入增量学习，特征回放思路实用，对资源受限场景有参考价值。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.contribution: 提出通过特征自适应实现内存高效增量学习的回放框架。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.innovation: 用可学习的特征变换替代原始样本存储，实现特征级回放。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.result: 在同等内存预算下，CIFAR-100/ImageNet上性能优于原始样本回放与herding选择。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Through Feature Adaptation.

Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中特征空间随新类加入而发生拓扑结构破坏、导致旧类特征混淆的问题，本文提出拓扑保持（Topology-Preserving）类增量学习方法，通过约束新旧类特征之间的拓扑关系（如类间距离与邻接结构）来维持特征空间的几何一致性。方法在训练新类时引入拓扑正则项，防止旧类特征被过度挤压或漂移。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-subset等基准上，该方法在多个增量设置下优于iCaRL、LUCIR等基线。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the disruption of feature-space topology in class-incremental learning, where adding new classes distorts the geometric relations among old classes. It introduces a topology-preserving regularization that maintains inter-class distance and neighborhood structure during new-class training. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet subsets show consistent gains over iCaRL and LUCIR across incremental settings.
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.assessment: 从特征空间几何结构角度缓解遗忘，视角新颖，对类增量学习研究有启发意义。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.contribution: 提出保持特征空间拓扑结构的类增量学习正则化方法。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.innovation: 显式约束新旧类特征间的拓扑关系以抑制表征漂移。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.result: 在CIFAR-100与ImageNet子集上多个增量设置中优于iCaRL、LUCIR等基线。

Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习场景中数据流类别分布严重不均衡（长尾）导致模型偏向多数类、遗忘少数类的问题，本文提出面向不平衡数据的在线持续学习方法，通过重采样/重加权与记忆管理策略在单遍数据流中平衡各类学习。方法在严格在线（单次遍历、无任务边界）设定下评估，并构建了不平衡的在线持续学习基准。实验表明该方法在多个不平衡比例下优于现有在线持续学习基线。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_en: This paper studies online continual learning from class-imbalanced data streams, where models tend to bias toward majority classes and forget minority ones. It proposes a method combining re-sampling/re-weighting with memory management to balance learning in a single pass without task boundaries. Evaluated on newly constructed imbalanced online CL benchmarks, it outperforms existing online CL baselines across imbalance ratios.
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.assessment: 将不平衡学习与在线持续学习结合，问题设定贴近真实数据流，基准构建有实用价值。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.contribution: 提出面向不平衡数据流的在线持续学习方法并建立相应基准。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.innovation: 在单遍无任务边界的在线设定下联合处理类别不平衡与遗忘。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.result: 在多种不平衡比例下优于现有在线持续学习基线。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning from Imbalanced Data.

Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_cn: 针对神经主题模型在动态文档流中需要不断适应新主题、同时保留旧主题知识的问题，本文将终身学习（lifelong learning）引入神经主题建模，提出可增量扩展主题的模型，通过知识蒸馏与主题对齐机制在加入新主题时避免旧主题退化。方法在多个文档集合的持续学习设定下评估，相比从头重训或简单微调能更好地保持旧主题质量并学习新主题。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_en: This paper brings lifelong learning to neural topic modeling, enabling models to acquire new topics from streaming documents while retaining previously learned ones. It employs knowledge distillation and topic alignment to prevent degradation of old topics when expanding the topic set. Experiments on multiple document collections show better retention of old topics and effective acquisition of new ones compared with retraining or naive fine-tuning.
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.assessment: 将持续学习拓展到NLP主题建模，跨领域思路有一定新意，但与视觉感知领域关联较弱。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.contribution: 提出面向神经主题模型的持续终身学习框架。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.innovation: 用知识蒸馏与主题对齐实现主题集合的增量扩展。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.result: 在持续文档流设定下旧主题保持与新主题学习均优于重训/微调基线。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif._arxiv_id: Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lifelong Learning.

Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_cn: 本文从理论角度分析持续学习的最优性问题，证明在一般设定下实现最优持续学习需要完美记忆（perfect memory），且该问题是NP-hard的。作者形式化了持续学习任务并给出归约证明，说明在有限资源下不存在能同时最优处理所有任务序列的高效算法。该结论为理解持续学习中遗忘与容量之间的根本权衡提供了理论依据，并讨论了其对现有方法（如正则化、回放）的启示。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_en: This paper provides a theoretical analysis of optimal continual learning, proving that optimal performance requires perfect memory and that the problem is NP-hard in general. The authors formalize the continual learning setting and give reduction-based proofs showing no efficient algorithm can optimally handle all task sequences under bounded resources. The results offer a fundamental justification for the trade-off between forgetting and capacity, with implications for regularization- and replay-based methods.
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.assessment: 为持续学习的固有困难提供理论刻画，虽不直接面向视觉任务，但对领域方法论有指导意义。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.contribution: 证明最优持续学习需要完美记忆且为NP-hard问题。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.innovation: 以形式化归约给出持续学习最优性的理论下界。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.result: 理论上表明有限资源下不存在对所有任务序列均最优的高效持续学习算法。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M._arxiv_id: Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect Memory and is NP-hard.

Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘与在线任务快速适应难以兼顾的问题，本文提出 Look-ahead Meta Learning（La-MAML）方法，将元学习与在线更新结合，通过前瞻式梯度更新优化任务间参数共享。相比传统基于经验回放或正则化的方法，La-MAML 在在线持续学习设定下实现了更快的任务适应与更小的遗忘。在多个基准上取得了优于已有在线持续学习方法的准确率，同时保持较低的计算开销。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between catastrophic forgetting and fast online adaptation in continual learning by proposing Look-ahead Meta Learning (La-MAML), which combines meta-learning with online updates via look-ahead gradient steps. Compared with replay- or regularization-based methods, it achieves better adaptation-forgetting balance in online settings. Experiments on standard benchmarks show improved accuracy over prior online continual learning approaches with modest computational cost.
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.assessment: 将元学习引入在线持续学习是一个有价值的方向，方法简洁且实验较充分，对关注持续学习的研究者有参考意义。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.contribution: 提出 Look-ahead Meta Learning 框架，实现持续学习中的快速在线适应与遗忘缓解。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.innovation: 通过前瞻式元梯度更新在在线设定下联合优化任务适应与参数共享。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上取得优于已有方法的准确率并降低遗忘。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L._arxiv_id: Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual Learning.

Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_cn: 针对持续学习与流式数据中经验回放缓冲区选择困难的问题，本文提出基于双层优化的 coreset 选择方法，将 coreset 构造建模为双层优化问题，从而选出对当前任务最有代表性的样本。相比随机采样或启发式选择，该方法在持续学习和流式学习中均能更有效地利用有限存储。实验表明在多个基准上提升了持续学习与流式学习的性能，验证了双层优化选择 coreset 的有效性。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of selecting replay buffers in continual learning and streaming by formulating coreset construction as a bilevel optimization problem. Compared with random or heuristic selection, the proposed method identifies more representative samples under limited memory. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate improved performance in both continual and streaming settings.
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.assessment: 将 coreset 选择与双层优化结合思路新颖，对持续学习和流式学习均有启发，但领域相关度相对有限。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.contribution: 提出基于双层优化的 coreset 选择方法用于持续学习与流式学习。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.innovation: 将 coreset 构造形式化为双层优化问题以提升样本代表性。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.result: 在持续学习与流式学习基准上取得优于随机/启发式选择的性能。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co._arxiv_id: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming.

Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_cn: 针对通用持续学习（General Continual Learning）中任务边界模糊、分布漂移等现实问题，本文提出 Dark Experience Replay（DER/DER++），通过回放模型在旧样本上的 logits 并施加一致性约束来缓解遗忘。相比仅回放样本或仅用正则化的方法，DER 在任务边界不清晰、类别增量等设定下更稳健。在多个通用持续学习基准上，DER++ 以简单结构取得了与复杂方法相当甚至更优的性能，成为强基线。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_en: This paper targets general continual learning with blurred task boundaries and distribution shifts, proposing Dark Experience Replay (DER/DER++), which stores past logits and enforces consistency to mitigate forgetting. Compared with sample-replay or regularization-only methods, DER is more robust under unclear boundaries and class-incremental settings. On several general continual learning benchmarks, DER++ achieves strong performance with a simple design, establishing a solid baseline.
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.assessment: 方法简单有效且实验扎实，作为通用持续学习的强基线具有较高参考价值，值得关注。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.contribution: 提出 Dark Experience Replay，通过回放 logits 与一致性约束缓解通用持续学习中的遗忘。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.innovation: 利用模型历史 logits 作为回放信号，在任务边界模糊设定下提升稳健性。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.result: 在多个通用持续学习基准上以简单结构取得与复杂方法相当或更优的性能。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le._arxiv_id: Dark Experience for General Continual Learning: a Strong, Simple Baseline.

Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_cn: 针对在线快速适应与新知识积累难以兼顾的问题，本文提出 OSAKA 方法，将在线适应与知识积累解耦，通过任务推断与参数更新策略在无任务边界信息下持续学习。相比传统持续学习方法，OSAKA 更贴近真实在线场景，能在任务切换时快速适应并保留旧知识。实验表明在在线持续学习基准上取得优于已有方法的性能，验证了其解耦设计的有效性。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of combining fast online adaptation with knowledge accumulation, proposing OSAKA, which decouples adaptation and accumulation under unknown task boundaries. Compared with conventional continual learning methods, OSAKA better matches realistic online scenarios by adapting quickly while retaining prior knowledge. Experiments on online continual learning benchmarks show improved performance over prior methods.
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.assessment: 问题设定贴近实际在线场景，方法设计合理，对关注在线持续学习的研究者有参考价值。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.contribution: 提出 OSAKA 框架，解耦在线快速适应与新知识积累。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.innovation: 在无任务边界信息下通过任务推断与参数更新实现适应与积累的分离。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.result: 在在线持续学习基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc._arxiv_id: Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation (OSAKA): a New Approach to Continual Learning.

Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中参数更新导致旧任务性能下降的问题，本文提出在低秩正交子空间中学习新任务，通过将任务更新投影到与旧任务正交的低秩子空间来减少干扰。相比全参数微调或简单正则化，该方法在保持旧知识的同时提升了新任务学习能力。实验在多个持续学习基准上验证了低秩正交子空间的有效性，取得优于已有方法的性能。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in continual learning by learning new tasks in low-rank orthogonal subspaces, projecting updates to be orthogonal to previous tasks. Compared with full fine-tuning or simple regularization, it better preserves old knowledge while learning new tasks. Experiments on multiple continual learning benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the low-rank orthogonal subspace approach.
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.assessment: 子空间正交化思路在持续学习中较有代表性，方法清晰，对相关研究者有参考意义。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.contribution: 提出在低秩正交子空间中学习新任务以缓解持续学习中的遗忘。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.innovation: 将任务更新约束在与旧任务正交的低秩子空间内以减少干扰。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.result: 在多个持续学习基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona._arxiv_id: Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces.

Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中遗忘严重的问题，本文提出实例感知参数化方法，为不同实例动态选择或调制参数子集，从而在在线更新中减少对旧知识的破坏。相比统一参数更新或固定正则化，该方法能更细粒度地平衡新旧任务。实验表明在在线持续学习基准上有效缓解遗忘并提升整体性能。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_en: This paper addresses severe forgetting in online continual learning by proposing instance-aware parameterization, which dynamically selects or modulates parameter subsets per instance to reduce interference with old knowledge. Compared with uniform updates or fixed regularization, it balances old and new tasks more finely. Experiments on online continual learning benchmarks show reduced forgetting and improved overall performance.
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.assessment: 实例级参数化思路在在线持续学习中较新颖，方法合理，对关注在线持续学习的研究者有参考价值。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.contribution: 提出实例感知参数化方法以缓解在线持续学习中的遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.innovation: 按实例动态选择或调制参数子集，实现更细粒度的新旧任务平衡。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.result: 在在线持续学习基准上有效缓解遗忘并提升整体性能。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua._arxiv_id: Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continual Learning via Instance-Aware Parameterization.

2103.17230|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中任务边界模糊（blurry boundary）、任务间共享类别这一更现实但研究不足的设定，指出episodic memory中样本多样性对缓解遗忘的关键作用。②提出Rainbow Memory（RM）记忆管理策略，基于每样本分类不确定性并结合数据增强来挑选和存储多样化样本。③相比传统假设任务类别不相交的方法，RM更适配模糊边界场景且实现简单。④在MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100和ImageNet上大幅超越当时SOTA，验证了样本多样性对模糊持续学习的重要性。
2103.17230|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the realistic yet under-studied continual learning setting with blurry task boundaries where tasks share classes, and argues for the importance of sample diversity in episodic memory. It proposes Rainbow Memory (RM), a memory management strategy that selects and stores diverse samples based on per-sample classification uncertainty and data augmentation. Despite its simplicity, RM substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods on MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet under blurry continual learning setups.
2103.17230|v2.assessment: 该工作将持续学习从人为的disjoint-class设定推向更贴近现实的blurry边界设定，问题定义有价值，方法简单有效，对持续学习研究者有较强参考意义。
2103.17230|v2.contribution: 提出基于样本不确定性与数据增强的Rainbow Memory记忆管理策略，用于模糊任务边界的持续学习。
2103.17230|v2.innovation: 首次系统论证episodic memory中样本多样性对模糊边界持续学习的重要性，并给出简单有效的实现。
2103.17230|v2.result: 在MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100、ImageNet上大幅超越SOTA，显著提升模糊持续学习准确率。

2105.04444|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中严重遗忘与高昂内存开销的问题，从信息论视角分析遗忘成因。②观察到遗忘源于学习新任务时参数上来自旧任务的information gain损失，据此提出Bit-Level Information Preserving（BLIP），通过参数量化在bit级别更新参数，估计每个参数由任务数据提供的信息增益并冻结相应bit以防遗忘。③相比以往方法，BLIP在bit粒度上保留信息增益，兼顾抗遗忘与内存效率。④在分类到强化学习等多类任务上取得优于或持平于已有方法的结果。
2105.04444|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning through an information-theoretic lens and observes that forgetting stems from the loss of information gain on parameters from previous tasks. It proposes Bit-Level Information Preserving (BLIP), which trains a quantized network on the new task and then estimates per-parameter information gain to decide which bits to freeze, thereby preventing forgetting at the bit level. Extensive experiments from classification to reinforcement learning show BLIP matches or outperforms prior methods.
2105.04444|v2.assessment: 从信息论角度解释遗忘并落到bit级参数冻结，视角新颖且实现可行，对持续学习与模型压缩交叉方向有启发。
2105.04444|v2.contribution: 提出基于信息增益的bit级参数冻结方法BLIP以缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
2105.04444|v2.innovation: 将遗忘归因于参数信息增益损失，并借助参数量化在bit粒度上保留信息。
2105.04444|v2.result: 在分类与强化学习任务上取得优于或持平于已有方法的表现。

2103.16597|v2.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘，并进一步扩展到测试集含训练集未见类别的task incremental generalized zero-shot learning设定。②提出基于权重校正（weight rectification）与仿射变换的方法，用极少参数将旧任务学到的权重校正以适配新任务，并对网络输出施加仿射变换以更好适配新任务。③该方法同时适用于zero-shot与非zero-shot的任务增量学习设定，参数开销小。④在多个数据集的两种设定下实验表明其有效性。
2103.16597|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses task incremental learning and its generalized zero-shot variant where test classes are unseen during training. It proposes weight rectifications and affine transformations with very few parameters to adapt network weights and outputs to sequentially arriving tasks. Experiments on several datasets in both zero-shot and non zero-shot settings demonstrate its effectiveness.
2103.16597|v2.assessment: 将任务增量学习与广义零样本结合的问题设定较有新意，方法参数高效，但整体影响力与实验规模相对有限。
2103.16597|v2.contribution: 提出基于权重校正与仿射变换的参数高效任务增量学习方法，兼容广义零样本设定。
2103.16597|v2.innovation: 用极少量参数对旧任务权重进行校正并配合输出仿射变换来适配新任务。
2103.16597|v2.result: 在多个数据集的zero-shot与非zero-shot任务增量设定下验证了有效性。

Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，从梯度角度探索逐层优化策略。②提出Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decomposition方法，通过对梯度进行分解实现逐层的参数更新约束，以在学新任务时保护旧任务知识。③相比整体统一约束的方法，逐层梯度分解能更精细地平衡新旧任务。④摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning via a layerwise optimization perspective. It proposes decomposing gradients to constrain parameter updates layer by layer, thereby protecting knowledge from previous tasks while learning new ones. The abstract is unavailable, so specific quantitative results cannot be cited.
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.assessment: 逐层梯度分解的思路对持续学习有参考价值，但缺少摘要信息，难以评估其完整贡献与实验充分度。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.contribution: 提出基于梯度分解的逐层优化方法用于持续学习。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.innovation: 将梯度分解引入逐层参数更新约束以缓解遗忘。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法具体说明。
Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decom._arxiv_id: Layerwise Optimization by Gradient Decomposition for Continual Learning.

Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中判别式与生成式任务并存的需求，探索统一的高效适配方案。②提出Efficient Feature Transformations方法，通过对特征进行高效变换来适配顺序到达的任务，兼顾判别与生成两类持续学习场景。③相比为每类任务单独设计的方法，该方案参数高效且通用。④摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.summary_en: This paper targets continual learning for both discriminative and generative tasks. It proposes efficient feature transformations to adapt to sequentially arriving tasks in a parameter-efficient and unified manner. The abstract is unavailable, so quantitative results cannot be cited.
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.assessment: 同时覆盖判别式与生成式持续学习具有一定价值，但缺少摘要，方法细节与实验强度难以判断。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.contribution: 提出面向判别式与生成式持续学习的高效特征变换方法。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.innovation: 用高效特征变换统一适配判别与生成两类持续学习任务。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法具体说明。
Efficient Feature Transformations for Di._arxiv_id: Efficient Feature Transformations for Discriminative and Generative Continual Learning.

Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，从特征空间角度研究参数更新对新旧任务的影响。②提出在特征协方差的零空间（null space）中训练网络，使新任务的参数更新不干扰旧任务已学到的特征表示，从而缓解遗忘。③相比仅约束输出或梯度的做法，该方法在特征协方差零空间内更新参数，理论上更直接地保护旧任务特征。④摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting by training networks within the null space of the feature covariance. By constraining new-task parameter updates to directions that do not disturb previously learned feature representations, it mitigates interference with old tasks. The abstract is unavailable, so specific quantitative results cannot be cited.
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.assessment: 从特征协方差零空间约束参数更新的思路理论清晰，是持续学习中较有代表性的正交子空间方法，值得关注。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.contribution: 提出在特征协方差零空间中训练网络以缓解持续学习遗忘。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.innovation: 利用特征协方差零空间约束新任务参数更新，保护旧任务特征表示。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法具体说明。
Training Networks in Null Space of Featu._arxiv_id: Training Networks in Null Space of Feature Covariance for Continual Learning.

ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督持续学习（Semi-Supervised Continual Learning）中增量无标签数据难以有效利用的问题，提出 ORDisCo 框架。方法上结合了持续学习与半监督学习，通过在线再放（replay）与一致性正则化，在仅有少量标注样本和大量无标签增量数据的场景下缓解灾难性遗忘。相比已有持续学习工作仅关注有标签数据，该工作显式建模了无标签增量数据的利用效率。在多个基准上取得了优于现有半监督持续学习方法的性能，并兼顾了计算效率。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised continual learning where incremental unlabeled data are abundant but labeled data are scarce. ORDisCo integrates online replay with consistency regularization to effectively exploit unlabeled incremental samples while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. It outperforms prior semi-supervised continual learning methods on standard benchmarks with improved efficiency.
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.assessment: 对持续学习与半监督学习的交叉问题给出了实用方案，适合关注增量学习与数据高效利用的研究者参考。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.contribution: 提出 ORDisCo 框架，有效利用增量无标签数据进行半监督持续学习。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.innovation: 将在线再放与一致性正则化结合以同时处理标注稀缺与灾难性遗忘。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.result: 在多个基准上优于现有半监督持续学习方法并保持高效。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o._arxiv_id: ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage of Incremental Unlabeled Data for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning.

Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本增量学习（Few-Shot Incremental Learning）中因样本极少导致的灾难性遗忘问题，提出持续演化分类器（Continually Evolved Classifiers, CEC）方法。核心思想是将特征表示学习与分类器解耦，通过图模型在增量任务间持续演化分类器，避免因新类样本不足导致的分类边界偏移。相比已有方法在特征与分类器联合更新时易过拟合新类，CEC 在 CIFAR100、ImageNet 等基准上显著提升了增量学习性能。实验表明该方法在多个小样本增量设置下达到当时最优。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot incremental learning where catastrophic forgetting is exacerbated by scarce samples per new class. It proposes Continually Evolved Classifiers (CEC), which decouples representation learning from classifier evolution using a graph model to adapt classifiers across incremental tasks. CEC achieves state-of-the-art results on CIFAR100 and ImageNet under various few-shot incremental settings.
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.assessment: 解耦特征与分类器的思路清晰有效，是小样本增量学习方向的重要参考工作。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.contribution: 提出持续演化分类器框架，解耦特征学习与分类器更新以缓解小样本增量遗忘。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.innovation: 利用图模型在增量任务间持续演化分类器，避免新类样本不足导致的分类边界偏移。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.result: 在 CIFAR100、ImageNet 等基准上取得当时最优的小样本增量学习性能。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Continually Evolved Classifiers.

Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_cn: 该论文针对图像去雨（Image De-Raining）任务中模型需适应不同雨型且避免遗忘旧雨型的问题，提出基于持续学习的去雨方法。方法上将不同雨型视为增量任务，利用持续学习策略在顺序学习新雨型时保留对旧雨型的去雨能力。相比传统去雨模型仅针对单一雨型训练，该工作提升了模型在多雨型场景下的泛化与持续适应能力。实验在合成与真实去雨数据集上验证了方法在缓解遗忘方面的有效性。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..summary_en: This paper addresses image de-raining under sequentially arriving rain types, framing it as a continual learning problem to avoid forgetting previously learned rain patterns. It adapts continual learning strategies to preserve de-raining capability across rain types. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate reduced forgetting compared to single-task de-raining models.
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..assessment: 将持续学习引入低层视觉去雨任务，思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..contribution: 提出基于持续学习的图像去雨方法，缓解多雨型顺序学习中的遗忘。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..innovation: 将不同雨型视为增量任务并引入持续学习策略进行去雨。
Image De-Raining via Continual Learning..result: 在合成与真实去雨数据集上验证了缓解遗忘的有效性。

2104.08572|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出现有基于知识蒸馏的方法仅最小化当前与旧响应的逐点差异，忽略了响应流形的几何结构。作者提出构建旧响应与当前响应的低维流形，并沿连接两流形的测地线（geodesic）最小化响应差异，从而实现更平滑、更鲁棒的知识蒸馏。相比已有蒸馏方法，该方法在多个增量学习基准上取得了更优的抗遗忘性能，验证了几何视角下蒸馏的有效性。
2104.08572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning, arguing that existing distillation methods only minimize point-wise response differences and ignore the geometry of response manifolds. It proposes to construct low-dimensional manifolds for previous and current responses and minimize their dissimilarity along the geodesic connecting them, yielding smoother and more robust knowledge distillation. Experiments on standard incremental learning benchmarks show improved anti-forgetting performance over prior distillation methods.
2104.08572|v2.assessment: 从流形几何角度重新审视知识蒸馏，理论动机清晰，对增量学习与蒸馏方向均有启发。
2104.08572|v2.contribution: 提出基于测地线的知识蒸馏方法，沿响应流形间测地线最小化差异以缓解遗忘。
2104.08572|v2.innovation: 首次构建响应低维流形并沿测地线进行蒸馏，获得更平滑的抗遗忘特性。
2104.08572|v2.result: 在多个增量学习基准上取得优于已有蒸馏方法的抗遗忘性能。

2107.08918|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中表示优化与原型重组监督不足的问题，提出一种增量原型学习方案。方法包含随机片段选择策略，使特征表示适应多种增量片段以增强可扩展性；以及自提升原型精炼机制，通过动态关系投影模块在共享嵌入空间中计算类间关系矩阵，并以此引导原型更新。在三个基准数据集上分别以 13%、17%、11% 的幅度超越当时最优方法。
2107.08918|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) where representation optimization and prototype reorganization suffer from limited supervision. It proposes an incremental prototype learning scheme with random episode selection to enhance feature extensibility and a self-promoted prototype refinement mechanism that uses a dynamic relation projection module to compute class relation matrices for bootstrapping prototype updates. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 13%, 17%, and 11% on three benchmark datasets.
2107.08918|v2.assessment: 原型精炼与关系投影的设计对小样本增量学习有较强实用价值，性能提升显著。
2107.08918|v2.contribution: 提出增量原型学习方案，结合随机片段选择与自提升原型精炼解决 FSCIL。
2107.08918|v2.innovation: 设计动态关系投影模块，利用类间关系矩阵引导原型更新。
2107.08918|v2.result: 在三个基准数据集上分别以 13%、17%、11% 的幅度超越当时最优方法。

2103.04059|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中样本极少导致标准增量学习技术无法直接适用的问题，提出一种语义感知知识蒸馏算法。方法利用词嵌入作为廉价易得的语义信息辅助蒸馏，并设计基于注意力机制的多并行视觉嵌入对齐方法，将视觉向量与语义向量对齐，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。在 MiniImageNet、CUB200、CIFAR100 数据集上取得新的最优结果，超越现有方法。
2103.04059|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) where scarce samples prevent direct application of standard incremental learning techniques. It introduces a semantic-aware knowledge distillation algorithm that leverages word embeddings as cheap semantic information and employs an attention mechanism over multiple parallel visual embeddings to align visual and semantic vectors, reducing catastrophic forgetting. It establishes new state-of-the-art results on MiniImageNet, CUB200, and CIFAR100.
2103.04059|v2.assessment: 将语义信息引入 FSCIL 蒸馏过程，思路新颖且实验充分，对该方向研究者有较高参考价值。
2103.04059|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知知识蒸馏算法，利用词嵌入与视觉-语义对齐解决 FSCIL。
2103.04059|v2.innovation: 使用注意力机制对齐多并行视觉嵌入与语义向量以缓解遗忘。
2103.04059|v2.result: 在 MiniImageNet、CUB200、CIFAR100 上取得新的最优结果。

Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，指出数据本身对模型更新的因果效应未被显式建模。作者提出将数据对网络参数的影响分解为因果效应与非因果效应，并通过因果蒸馏的方式在增量阶段保留旧类知识。相比传统知识蒸馏或回放方法，该方法从因果推断视角重新解释了增量学习中的偏差来源。在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 等基准上取得了优于 LwF、iCaRL 等方法的准确率，验证了因果建模的有效性。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning by modeling the causal effect of data on model updates. It proposes a causal distillation framework that separates causal from non-causal effects to preserve old-class knowledge during incremental training. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet show consistent improvements over knowledge-distillation and replay baselines.
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.assessment: 从因果推断角度重新审视增量学习中的知识保持问题，视角新颖，对持续学习研究者有启发。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.contribution: 提出基于因果效应分解的数据蒸馏框架，用于缓解类增量学习中的遗忘。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.innovation: 将数据对参数更新的影响拆分为因果与非因果部分，并据此设计蒸馏损失。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas.result: 在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 上取得优于 LwF、iCaRL 等方法的增量学习准确率。
Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Clas._arxiv_id: Distilling Causal Effect of Data in Class-Incremental Learning.

Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中固定网络结构难以适应新类的问题，提出自适应聚合网络（Adanet），在增量阶段动态扩展和聚合网络分支。方法通过可学习的聚合权重将旧分支与新分支组合，从而在保持旧类性能的同时提升新类学习能力。相比固定架构的增量学习方法，Adanet 在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 等基准上取得了更优的准确率，并缓解了稳定性-可塑性权衡问题。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.summary_en: This paper tackles class-incremental learning by proposing Adaptive Aggregation Networks (Adanet), which dynamically expands and aggregates network branches during incremental training. Learnable aggregation weights combine old and new branches to balance stability and plasticity. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet demonstrate improved accuracy over fixed-architecture incremental learning methods.
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.assessment: 通过动态网络扩展与聚合缓解稳定性-可塑性权衡，是增量学习中结构自适应方向的代表性工作。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.contribution: 提出自适应聚合网络 Adanet，通过动态分支扩展与聚合实现类增量学习。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.innovation: 在增量阶段动态扩展网络分支并学习聚合权重，而非依赖固定架构。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-.result: 在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 上取得优于固定架构增量学习方法的准确率。
Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-._arxiv_id: Adaptive Aggregation Networks for Class-Incremental Learning.

2011.14593|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度网络在增量学习中因黑盒优化导致的灾难性遗忘问题，提出基于 rate reduction 原理的白盒网络架构，每层显式计算而无需反向传播。方法在给定预训练网络和新类数据时，可证明地构造出等价于联合训练所有旧类与新类的新网络。在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上，该方法分类性能衰减显著小于现有最先进方法，验证了白盒算法在复杂图像增量学习中的可行性。
2011.14593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning by proposing a white-box architecture derived from the principle of rate reduction, where each layer is explicitly computed without backpropagation. Given a pre-trained network and new classes, the method provably constructs a new network emulating joint training over all past and new classes. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 show significantly less performance decay, outperforming state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.
2011.14593|v2.assessment: 从白盒架构与 rate reduction 理论出发，为增量学习提供了可证明的构造性方案，理论深度突出。
2011.14593|v2.contribution: 提出基于 rate reduction 的白盒增量学习框架，可证明地构造等价于联合训练的新网络。
2011.14593|v2.innovation: 摒弃反向传播，采用逐层显式计算的白盒架构实现增量学习。
2011.14593|v2.result: 在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 上分类性能衰减显著小于现有最先进方法。

Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习中旧类样本不可用导致的遗忘问题，提出原型增强与自监督相结合的方法。方法通过为旧类生成增强原型来近似旧类分布，并引入自监督学习提升特征表示的泛化能力。相比仅依赖知识蒸馏或回放的方法，该策略在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 等基准上取得了更优的增量学习准确率，缓解了数据不平衡带来的偏差。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning where old-class samples are unavailable, by combining prototype augmentation with self-supervision. Augmented prototypes approximate old-class distributions, while self-supervised learning improves feature generalization. Experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet show improved incremental accuracy over distillation-only and replay-based methods.
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.assessment: 原型增强与自监督的结合为无旧样本增量学习提供了有效方案，思路简洁且实用。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出原型增强与自监督联合框架，用于类增量学习中的旧类知识保持。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.innovation: 利用增强原型近似旧类分布，并引入自监督提升特征泛化。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis.result: 在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 上取得优于蒸馏与回放方法的增量学习准确率。
Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: Prototype Augmentation and Self-Supervision for Incremental Learning.

Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实世界中在线持续目标检测的挑战，提出 Wanderlust 基准与方法，解决检测器在流式数据下对新类别的适应与旧类别遗忘问题。方法结合在线持续学习策略与目标检测框架，在动态环境中进行类别增量检测。相比离线增量检测方法，Wanderlust 在真实场景数据上取得了更好的持续检测性能，并揭示了在线持续检测中的关键难点。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual object detection in the real world by introducing the Wanderlust benchmark and method, tackling adaptation to new classes and forgetting of old ones under streaming data. It integrates online continual learning strategies with object detection frameworks for class-incremental detection in dynamic environments. Experiments show improved continual detection performance over offline incremental detection methods and highlight key challenges in online continual detection.
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.assessment: 将持续学习拓展到在线真实世界目标检测，基准与方法兼具，对自动驾驶感知的持续学习有直接参考价值。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.contribution: 提出 Wanderlust 在线持续目标检测基准与方法，推动真实场景下的持续检测研究。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.innovation: 面向流式真实数据的在线持续目标检测设定与配套学习策略。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete.result: 在真实场景数据上取得优于离线增量检测方法的持续检测性能。
Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Dete._arxiv_id: Wanderlust: Online Continual Object Detection in the Real World.

Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中的类增量学习问题，研究如何在不断新增动作类别时保持旧类识别能力。方法将类增量学习策略引入视频动作识别框架，结合时序特征提取与增量学习机制。相比直接微调或静态模型，该方法在视频动作识别基准上取得了更优的增量识别准确率，缓解了视频域中的灾难性遗忘。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental learning for action recognition in videos, aiming to retain old-class recognition ability while incrementally adding new action classes. It adapts class-incremental learning strategies to video action recognition with temporal feature extraction. Experiments on video action recognition benchmarks show improved incremental accuracy and reduced catastrophic forgetting in the video domain.
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.assessment: 将类增量学习引入视频动作识别，填补了视频域持续学习的研究空白，对视频理解与持续学习交叉方向有参考意义。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.contribution: 提出面向视频动作识别的类增量学习框架，缓解视频域灾难性遗忘。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.innovation: 将类增量学习策略与时序视频特征提取相结合。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re.result: 在视频动作识别基准上取得更优的增量识别准确率。
Class-Incremental Learning for Action Re._arxiv_id: Class-Incremental Learning for Action Recognition in Videos.

Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习（online continual learning）中数据分布自然漂移的问题，指出现有持续学习研究多基于人为构造的、分布平稳的基准，无法反映真实场景。作者构建了基于大规模视觉数据（如 ImageNet、CORe50 等）的在线持续学习实验框架，系统评估了经验回放、正则化等方法在自然分布漂移下的表现。实验发现，在自然分布漂移下，现有方法的性能显著下降，且回放缓冲区大小和更新频率对结果影响巨大。该工作为持续学习在真实非平稳数据流下的研究提供了重要的实证基准和洞见。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning under natural distribution shifts, arguing that existing benchmarks rely on artificially constructed stationary data streams. The authors build an empirical study framework on large-scale visual data (e.g., ImageNet, CORe50) and systematically evaluate replay and regularization methods under natural non-stationary shifts. They find that existing methods degrade significantly, and that buffer size and update frequency critically affect performance, providing a realistic benchmark and insights for continual learning.
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.assessment: 该工作揭示了现有持续学习基准与真实分布漂移之间的鸿沟，为后续研究提供了更贴近实际的评估协议，值得关注。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.contribution: 构建了基于自然分布漂移的大规模在线持续学习实证基准，并系统评估了现有方法。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.innovation: 首次系统研究自然分布漂移下的在线持续学习，而非人为构造的平稳数据流。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D.result: 实验表明现有方法在自然分布漂移下性能显著下降，回放缓冲区大小和更新频率是关键影响因素。
Online Continual Learning with Natural D._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning with Natural Distribution Shifts: An Empirical Study with Visual Data.

Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出将对比学习（contrastive learning）引入持续学习框架，称为 Co2L。方法在回放缓冲区中的样本上应用对比损失，通过拉近同类样本、推远异类样本的表征，增强模型对旧任务的记忆保持能力。相比仅使用交叉熵回放的方法，Co2L 在多个持续学习基准上显著缓解了遗忘。实验在 CIFAR-10/100、TinyImageNet 等数据集上验证，在类别增量设置下平均准确率提升明显，且与多种回放策略兼容。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by integrating contrastive learning into the replay framework, termed Co2L. It applies contrastive loss on buffered samples to pull same-class representations together and push different-class ones apart, enhancing memory retention. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 and TinyImageNet show consistent improvements over cross-entropy-only replay, with notable gains in class-incremental settings and compatibility with various replay strategies.
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 将对比学习与持续学习回放机制结合，思路简洁有效，为缓解遗忘提供了新视角，实验充分。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出 Co2L，将对比学习损失引入持续学习回放框架以缓解灾难性遗忘。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 利用对比学习增强回放样本的表征判别性，从而更好地保持旧任务知识。
Co2L: Contrastive Continual Learning.|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-10/100、TinyImageNet 等基准上，类别增量设置下平均准确率相比交叉熵回放有显著提升。

Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中数据流含有噪声标签的问题，提出自净化回放（Self-Purified Replay, SPR）方法。方法在回放缓冲区中利用模型自身的预测置信度对样本标签进行净化，过滤或修正噪声标签，从而避免噪声在持续学习过程中累积。在多个含噪持续学习基准上，SPR 相比标准回放方法在准确率上有稳定提升，尤其在噪声率较高时优势更明显。该工作填补了持续学习与噪声标签学习交叉领域的研究空白。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning on noisy data streams by proposing Self-Purified Replay (SPR). SPR leverages model prediction confidence to purify labels in the replay buffer, filtering or correcting noisy labels to prevent error accumulation. On multiple noisy continual learning benchmarks, SPR consistently outperforms standard replay, with larger gains at higher noise rates, filling a gap at the intersection of continual learning and noisy-label learning.
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.assessment: 关注持续学习中噪声标签这一实际问题，方法实用，但创新性相对有限，适合作为该交叉方向的参考。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.contribution: 提出自净化回放方法，在持续学习回放缓冲区中过滤和修正噪声标签。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.innovation: 将噪声标签净化机制嵌入持续学习回放流程，防止噪声在任务序列中累积。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams.result: 在含噪持续学习基准上，SPR 相比标准回放准确率稳定提升，高噪声率下优势更明显。
Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams._arxiv_id: Continual Learning on Noisy Data Streams via Self-Purified Replay.

Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本学习与持续学习中的任务干扰问题，提出注意力独立机制（Attentive Independent Mechanisms, AIM）。方法通过为每个任务学习独立的注意力模块，并在任务间进行选择性激活，减少不同任务间的参数干扰。在 few-shot 和持续学习基准上，AIM 相比标准微调或独立网络方法在准确率和参数效率上取得更好平衡。该工作为小样本与持续学习的联合场景提供了有效的架构设计思路。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.summary_en: This paper addresses task interference in few-shot and continual learning by proposing Attentive Independent Mechanisms (AIM). AIM learns task-specific attention modules with selective activation across tasks to reduce parameter interference. On few-shot and continual learning benchmarks, AIM achieves a better trade-off between accuracy and parameter efficiency than fine-tuning or independent networks, offering an effective architectural design for joint few-shot and continual learning.
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.assessment: 将注意力机制用于任务隔离，思路合理，但实验规模较小，影响力有限。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.contribution: 提出注意力独立机制 AIM，通过任务特定注意力模块减少任务间干扰。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.innovation: 利用任务特定注意力模块的选择性激活实现参数隔离，兼顾小样本与持续学习。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att.result: 在 few-shot 和持续学习基准上，AIM 在准确率与参数效率间取得优于微调和独立网络的平衡。
Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Att._arxiv_id: Few-Shot and Continual Learning with Attentive Independent Mechanisms.

RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_cn: 该论文针对语义分割中的持续学习问题，提出 RECALL 方法，基于回放机制缓解灾难性遗忘。方法在回放缓冲区中存储旧任务的图像与标签，并在训练新任务时混合回放，同时结合知识蒸馏约束旧任务输出。在多个语义分割持续学习基准（如 PASCAL VOC、ADE20K）上，RECALL 相比现有方法在旧任务保持和新任务学习上均取得更优的 mIoU。该工作将回放式持续学习有效扩展到密集预测任务。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning in semantic segmentation with RECALL, a replay-based method. It stores old-task images and labels in a buffer, mixes them during new-task training, and applies knowledge distillation to constrain old-task outputs. On benchmarks such as PASCAL VOC and ADE20K, RECALL achieves higher mIoU on both old and new tasks than prior methods, effectively extending replay-based continual learning to dense prediction.
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.assessment: 将回放式持续学习成功应用于语义分割这一密集预测任务，实验扎实，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习有参考价值。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.contribution: 提出 RECALL，基于回放与知识蒸馏的语义分割持续学习方法。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.innovation: 将图像级回放与输出蒸馏结合，有效缓解分割任务中的灾难性遗忘。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning.result: 在 PASCAL VOC、ADE20K 等基准上，新旧任务 mIoU 均优于现有持续学习分割方法。
RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning._arxiv_id: RECALL: Replay-based Continual Learning in Semantic Segmentation.

Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸呈现攻击检测（face presentation attack detection, PAD）中新型攻击不断出现的问题，提出检测并持续学习新型呈现攻击的框架。方法首先通过开集检测识别未知攻击类型，然后以持续学习方式将新攻击类型增量纳入模型，避免遗忘旧攻击。在多个 PAD 基准上，该方法在检测已知攻击的同时能有效识别并适应新攻击，相比标准开集检测和持续学习方法取得更好的综合性能。该工作对安全相关的开集检测与持续学习结合具有借鉴意义。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.summary_en: This paper addresses the emergence of novel face presentation attacks by proposing a framework that detects and continually learns new attack types. It first identifies unknown attacks via open-set detection, then incrementally incorporates them through continual learning without forgetting old attacks. On multiple PAD benchmarks, the method effectively detects known attacks while adapting to new ones, outperforming standard open-set and continual learning baselines, offering insights for combining open-set detection with continual learning in security applications.
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.assessment: 将开集检测与持续学习结合用于人脸防伪，问题设定新颖且实用，对开集检测方向有参考价值。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.contribution: 提出检测并持续学习新型人脸呈现攻击的框架，结合开集检测与增量学习。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.innovation: 在 PAD 场景中联合开集检测与持续学习，实现对新攻击的识别与增量适应。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove.result: 在多个 PAD 基准上，该方法在检测已知攻击的同时有效识别并适应新攻击，综合性能优于开集检测和持续学习基线。
Detection and Continual Learning of Nove._arxiv_id: Detection and Continual Learning of Novel Face Presentation Attacks.

2203.11684|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在持续学习中直接应用CNN方法会导致严重性能退化的问题，本文提出MEAT（Meta-Attention），即对自注意力进行注意力掩码，仅对预训练ViT的部分参数进行任务特定掩码以适应新任务。与Piggyback等对所有参数加掩码的方法不同，MEAT利用ViT特性仅掩码部分参数，更高效且有效。实验表明该方法在多个持续学习基准上优于现有方法，同时保持已学任务性能。
2203.11684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of ViTs when CNN-based continual learning methods are directly applied. It proposes MEAT (Meta-Attention), which masks only a portion of parameters in a pre-trained ViT via attention to self-attention, adapting to new tasks without forgetting. Unlike Piggyback-style full-parameter masking, MEAT is more efficient and effective, achieving superior performance on continual learning benchmarks.
2203.11684|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究ViT-backed持续学习，提出的部分参数掩码策略兼顾效率与性能，对视觉Transformer与持续学习交叉领域有启发。
2203.11684|v2.contribution: 提出MEAT方法，通过元注意力机制对ViT部分参数进行任务特定掩码，实现高效持续学习。
2203.11684|v2.innovation: 利用ViT特性仅掩码部分参数，而非对所有参数加掩码，提升效率与效果。
2203.11684|v2.result: 在持续学习基准上优于现有方法，同时保持已学任务性能。

2201.09381|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频领域持续学习研究不足、现有工作存在任务间类别分布不均衡或数据集不适用的问题，本文提出vCLIMB，一个标准化的视频类增量持续学习基准，任务间类别数均匀分布。通过深入评估现有CL方法，发现视频数据中两个独特挑战：帧级记忆选择和非修剪训练数据影响帧采样策略。提出时序一致性正则化，可叠加在基于记忆的CL方法上，在非修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。
2201.09381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces vCLIMB, a standardized video class incremental continual learning benchmark with uniform class distribution across tasks, addressing the lack of exploration in video CL. It identifies two unique challenges: frame-level memory selection and the impact of untrimmed data on frame sampling. A temporal consistency regularization is proposed, improving baselines by up to 24% on untrimmed continual learning.
2201.09381|v2.assessment: 填补了视频持续学习基准的空白，提出的时序一致性正则化有效应对视频数据特有挑战，对视频理解与持续学习交叉研究有重要价值。
2201.09381|v2.contribution: 提出vCLIMB视频类增量持续学习基准，并设计时序一致性正则化方法。
2201.09381|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析视频持续学习中的帧级记忆选择和非修剪数据挑战，并提出相应正则化。
2201.09381|v2.result: 在非修剪持续学习任务上比基线提升高达24%。

2204.02136|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中直接微调导致灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出弹性响应蒸馏（ERD），专注于从分类头和回归头弹性学习响应。方法传递类别知识的同时保留定位信息，并通过弹性响应选择（ERS）策略评估所有位置的质量并提供有价值的响应。进一步阐明不同响应在增量蒸馏中应赋予不同重要性。在MS COCO上的实验表明该方法有效缓解遗忘。
2204.02136|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental object detection by proposing Elastic Response Distillation (ERD), which focuses on learning responses from classification and regression heads. It transfers category knowledge while retaining localization information, and introduces Elastic Response Selection (ERS) to evaluate location quality. Experiments on MS COCO demonstrate effectiveness in mitigating forgetting.
2204.02136|v2.assessment: 针对增量目标检测中响应信息利用不足的问题，提出弹性响应蒸馏与选择策略，对自动驾驶感知中的持续学习有直接应用价值。
2204.02136|v2.contribution: 提出ERD方法，通过弹性学习分类和回归头的响应来缓解增量目标检测中的灾难性遗忘。
2204.02136|v2.innovation: 引入弹性响应选择策略评估位置质量，并区分不同响应的重要性。
2204.02136|v2.result: 在MS COCO上有效缓解遗忘，提升增量检测性能。

2112.08654|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出L2P（Learning to Prompt），一种新的持续学习范式，无需测试时任务身份即可训练更简洁的记忆系统。方法学习动态提示预训练模型，提示为小可学习参数，维护在记忆空间中，优化以指导模型预测并显式管理任务不变和任务特定知识。在多个图像分类基准上，L2P持续优于先前SOTA，甚至无需回放缓冲区即可与基于回放的方法竞争。
2112.08654|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes L2P (Learning to Prompt), a new continual learning paradigm that dynamically prompts a pre-trained model without requiring task identity at test time. Prompts are small learnable parameters maintained in a memory space, optimized to manage task-invariant and task-specific knowledge. L2P consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art on image classification benchmarks, even without a rehearsal buffer.
2112.08654|v2.assessment: 提出基于提示的持续学习新范式，无需回放缓冲区且不依赖测试时任务身份，对持续学习与预训练模型结合有重要启发。
2112.08654|v2.contribution: 提出L2P框架，通过动态学习提示实现持续学习，无需回放缓冲区或测试时任务身份。
2112.08654|v2.innovation: 将提示学习引入持续学习，显式管理任务不变和任务特定知识。
2112.08654|v2.result: 在多个图像分类基准上持续优于先前SOTA，甚至无需回放缓冲区即可与基于回放的方法竞争。

Continual Learning with Lifelong Vision.assessment: 摘要缺失，无法评估其具体贡献与质量，但主题与持续学习和ViT相关，可能值得关注。
Continual Learning with Lifelong Vision._arxiv_id: Continual Learning with Lifelong Vision Transformer.

2203.15355|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中数据流标签模糊且含噪声的实际问题，本文提出一种统一策略，通过标签噪声感知的多样性采样和半监督鲁棒学习来管理记忆，平衡样本多样性与纯度。在CIFAR10/100、mini-WebVision和Food-101N四个数据集上，该方法显著优于先前方法。
2203.15355|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online continual learning from blurry data streams with corrupted labels. It proposes a unified strategy combining label noise-aware diverse sampling and semi-supervised robust learning to balance diversity and purity in episodic memory. Experiments on four datasets show significant improvements over prior arts.
2203.15355|v2.assessment: 针对现实世界中标签噪声和模糊任务边界的持续学习问题，提出实用的记忆管理策略，对鲁棒持续学习有参考价值。
2203.15355|v2.contribution: 提出标签噪声感知的多样性采样与半监督鲁棒学习相结合的记忆管理策略。

2111.11326|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中深度网络难以在不遗忘旧任务的情况下学习新任务的问题，本文提出 DyTox，一种基于专用编码器/解码器框架的 Transformer 架构，编码器与解码器在所有任务间共享，通过对特殊 token 的动态扩展使解码器每次前向传播专注于某一任务分布。相比已有动态架构方法，DyTox 无需测试时任务标识、无需复杂超参调优来平衡参数增长，且参数扩展受严格控制，内存与时间开销可忽略。在 CIFAR100 和 ImageNet 上取得优异结果，其中 ImageNet 上达到当时最优性能。
2111.11326|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, this paper proposes DyTox, a transformer architecture with a dedicated encoder/decoder framework where the encoder and decoder are shared across all tasks and task specialization is achieved through dynamic expansion of special tokens. Unlike prior dynamic-architecture methods, DyTox requires no task identifier at test time and no hyperparameter tuning to control parameter growth, keeping memory and time overhead negligible. It achieves excellent results on CIFAR100 and state-of-the-art performance on large-scale ImageNet.
2111.11326|v2.assessment: 该工作将动态 token 扩展与 Transformer 共享编码器/解码器结合，在持续学习设定下兼顾了可扩展性与低开销，对关注持续学习与 Transformer 架构的研究者有参考价值。
2111.11326|v2.contribution: 提出基于共享编码器/解码器与动态 token 扩展的持续学习 Transformer 框架 DyTox。
2111.11326|v2.innovation: 通过特殊 token 的动态扩展实现任务特化，无需任务标识与超参调优即可扩展到大量任务。
2111.11326|v2.result: 在 CIFAR100 上表现优异，在 ImageNet 上取得当时最优性能。

2203.03970|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中训练与测试数据分布不一致这一更现实的场景，本文研究域偏移下的持续学习，要求模型能泛化到未见域。方法上为分类器配备基于马氏相似度计算的类相似度度量作为可学习参数，以促进语义特征学习，并将骨干表示与这些额外参数端到端联合训练；同时提出基于参数指数移动平均的知识蒸馏策略。实验表明现有持续学习算法在多种分布下大多无法处理遗忘问题，而所提方法在域偏移下学习新任务时能提升准确率。
2203.03970|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning under domain shifts, a more realistic scenario where the model must generalize to unseen domains. It equips the classifier with class similarity metrics computed via Mahalanobis similarity as learnable parameters, trains the backbone and these parameters end-to-end, and further proposes an exponential moving average of parameters for better knowledge distillation. Experiments show that existing continual learning algorithms largely fail under multiple distributions, while the proposed approach boosts accuracy when learning new tasks under domain shift.
2203.03970|v2.assessment: 该工作将域泛化与持续学习结合，指出已有方法在分布偏移下的失效问题，对关注持续学习鲁棒性的研究者有参考意义。
2203.03970|v2.contribution: 提出面向域偏移持续学习的马氏相似度分类器参数与 EMA 蒸馏方法。
2203.03970|v2.innovation: 将类相似度度量作为可学习参数端到端训练，并结合参数指数移动平均进行知识蒸馏。
2203.03970|v2.result: 在域偏移持续学习场景下相比现有方法提升了准确率。

2111.11210|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出 Gradient Coreset Replay (GCR)，一种基于精心设计优化准则的 replay buffer 选择与更新策略。具体而言，GCR 选择并维护一个 coreset，使其在当前模型参数下尽可能逼近所有已见数据的梯度，并讨论了在持续学习设定下有效应用该策略的关键要点。在离线持续学习设定下相比当时最优方法取得 2%-4% 的绝对提升，在在线/流式持续学习设定下取得最高 5% 的提升，并展示了监督对比学习的价值。
2111.11210|v2.summary_en: To mitigate catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, this paper proposes Gradient Coreset Replay (GCR), a replay buffer selection and update strategy based on a carefully designed optimization criterion. GCR maintains a coreset that closely approximates the gradient of all seen data with respect to current model parameters, with key strategies discussed for effective use in continual learning. It achieves 2%-4% absolute gains over the state of the art in offline continual learning and up to 5% gains in online/streaming settings, and demonstrates the value of supervised contrastive learning.
2111.11210|v2.assessment: 该工作从梯度近似角度重新审视 replay buffer 选择，方法简洁且增益稳定，对持续学习与数据高效训练方向的研究者有较高参考价值。
2111.11210|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度 coreset 的 replay buffer 选择与更新策略 GCR。
2111.11210|v2.innovation: 以逼近全部已见数据梯度为准则维护 coreset，并适配离线与在线持续学习设定。
2111.11210|v2.result: 离线设定下提升 2%-4%，在线/流式设定下最高提升 5%。

2203.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本类增量学习（旧类样本不可保存）中表示优化与特征保持只能依赖新类监督的难题，本文提出一种自维持表示扩展方案。该方案包含结构重组策略，融合主分支扩展与侧分支更新以保持旧特征，并采用主分支蒸馏方案迁移不变知识；此外提出原型选择机制，通过有选择地将新样本纳入蒸馏过程来增强新旧类之间的判别性。在三个基准上取得显著增量性能，分别超越当时最优方法 3%、3% 和 6%。
2203.06359|v2.summary_en: To address non-exemplar class-incremental learning, where old-class samples cannot be stored and representation optimization and feature retention must rely solely on new-class supervision, this paper proposes a self-sustaining representation expansion scheme. It combines a structure reorganization strategy fusing main-branch expansion and side-branch updating to preserve old features, a main-branch distillation scheme to transfer invariant knowledge, and a prototype selection mechanism that selectively incorporates new samples into distillation to enhance old/new class discrimination. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks outperform the state of the art by 3%, 3%, and 6%, respectively.
2203.06359|v2.assessment: 该工作针对无样本类增量学习这一受限设定，通过结构重组与原型选择在保持旧特征与增强判别性之间取得平衡，实验增益明显，值得关注。
2203.06359|v2.contribution: 提出面向无样本类增量学习的自维持表示扩展方案。
2203.06359|v2.innovation: 融合主分支扩展与侧分支更新的结构重组策略，以及选择性纳入新样本的原型选择机制。
2203.06359|v2.result: 在三个基准上分别超越当时最优方法 3%、3% 和 6%。

2112.01882|v2.summary_cn: ①针对语义分割模型难以增量学习新类别、且像素级标注昂贵的问题，本文提出弱增量语义分割框架，仅用图像级标签学习分割新类。②方法用图像级标签训练辅助分类器并由分割模型正则化，在线生成软伪标签进行增量更新，避免离线伪标签生成。③相比已有离线弱监督方法，本文在线伪监督更适应增量场景并缓解噪声。④在Pascal VOC和COCO上超越离线弱监督方法，性能接近全监督增量学习方法。
2112.01882|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly incremental learning for semantic segmentation, where new classes must be learned from cheap image-level labels. It proposes an online pseudo-supervision framework using an auxiliary classifier regularized by the segmentation model, with soft labels to handle noise. Experiments on Pascal VOC and COCO show it outperforms offline weakly-supervised methods and is comparable to fully-supervised incremental learning.
2112.01882|v2.assessment: 将弱监督与增量分割结合，在线伪标签思路对标注受限的自动驾驶场景有参考价值。
2112.01882|v2.contribution: 提出仅用图像级标签的弱增量语义分割框架，实现在线伪监督更新。
2112.01882|v2.innovation: 用分割模型正则化的辅助分类器在线生成软伪标签，替代离线伪标签生成。
2112.01882|v2.result: 在Pascal VOC和COCO上超越离线弱监督方法，接近全监督增量学习性能。

2203.14952|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中参数更新导致旧任务潜在表示错位、从而引发遗忘的问题，本文提出ELI能量基潜在对齐器。②方法学习潜在表示的能量流形，使旧任务潜表示低能量、当前任务高能量，以此对抗表示漂移，可作为即插即用模块。③相比现有增量学习方法，ELI通过隐式正则缓解表示偏移，通用性强。④在CIFAR-100、ImageNet子集、ImageNet 1k和Pascal VOC上一致提升三种类增量方法，用于SOTA增量目标检测器时提升超过5%。
2203.14952|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting in incremental learning caused by latent representation mismatch between old and new tasks. It proposes ELI, an energy-based latent aligner that learns an energy manifold to regularize representation shift and can be plugged into existing methods. Experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet subsets, ImageNet 1k, and Pascal VOC show consistent gains, including over 5% improvement on a state-of-the-art incremental object detector.
2203.14952|v2.assessment: 即插即用且验证到增量目标检测，对自动驾驶持续学习场景有直接参考价值。
2203.14952|v2.contribution: 提出能量基潜在对齐器ELI，通过能量流形正则化缓解增量学习中的表示漂移。
2203.14952|v2.innovation: 用能量流形区分新旧任务潜表示，以隐式正则实现即插即用的抗遗忘。
2203.14952|v2.result: 在多个基准上一致提升三种类增量方法，用于增量目标检测器提升超5%。

2110.07905|v2.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中可塑性-稳定性权衡问题，且在不允许存储旧任务数据的设定下，本文提出简单线性连接器方法。②方法利用损失景观中的模式连通性，连接旧任务的零空间投影解与当前任务的SGD解，从而在保留旧知识与学习新任务间取得平衡。③相比依赖旧样本回放的方法，本方法无需任何旧样本，并提供了控制权衡的新视角。④在多个基准上取得显著提升，10-split-CIFAR-100上达到79.79%准确率。
2110.07905|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the plasticity-stability dilemma in incremental learning without storing previous samples. It proposes a simple linear connector that leverages mode connectivity in loss landscapes, connecting the null-space projection optimum for old tasks and the SGD optimum for the current task. Experiments show notable improvements, achieving 79.79% accuracy on 10-split-CIFAR-100.
2110.07905|v2.assessment: 无需旧样本的简洁方案，模式连通性视角对隐私受限的持续学习有启发。
2110.07905|v2.contribution: 提出基于模式连通性的简单线性连接器，在无旧样本下平衡可塑性与稳定性。
2110.07905|v2.innovation: 将损失景观模式连通性用于连接旧任务零空间解与当前任务SGD解。
2110.07905|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升，10-split-CIFAR-100达到79.79%准确率。

Geometry and Uncertainty-Aware 3D Point.summary_en: This paper addresses class-incremental semantic segmentation on 3D point clouds, where geometric cues and predictive uncertainty are underexploited. It proposes a geometry- and uncertainty-aware framework that explicitly models spatial geometry and estimates uncertainty to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. The main improvement over prior class-incremental segmentation methods lies in integrating geometric priors and uncertainty regularization into the incremental learning pipeline.

2304.00426|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中基类训练使用交叉熵损失导致类间表征分离不足、进而影响新类泛化的问题。提出语义感知虚拟对比模型（SAVC），通过预定义变换生成虚拟类并引入监督对比学习，使虚拟类充当未见类的占位符以促进基类与新类的分离。相比朴素SCL仅能略微改善基类间分离，SAVC能更好地分离基类与新类。摘要未给出具体数值，但在FSCIL基准上验证了有效性。
2304.00426|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), where cross-entropy training in the base session yields poor class separation and degrades novel-class generalization. It proposes Semantic-Aware Virtual Contrastive model (SAVC), which introduces virtual classes generated via predefined transformations into supervised contrastive learning to serve as placeholders for unseen classes. Unlike naive SCL that only slightly improves base-class separation, SAVC better separates base and new classes.
2304.00426|v2.assessment: 从表征分离角度切入FSCIL，虚拟类对比思路清晰，对小样本增量学习有启发。
2304.00426|v2.contribution: 提出语义感知虚拟对比模型SAVC用于小样本类增量学习。
2304.00426|v2.innovation: 用预定义变换生成的虚拟类作为未见类占位符增强对比学习。
2304.00426|v2.result: 在FSCIL设置下优于朴素SCL与基线方法，摘要未提供具体数值。

2211.13218|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无回放的持续学习中，现有基于预训练ViT的提示方法其key-query机制未端到端训练，导致可塑性下降、新任务精度受损且无法利用扩展参数容量的问题。提出CODA-Prompt，学习一组提示组件并通过输入条件权重组装成输入条件提示，形成端到端的注意力key-query方案。相比现有SOTA提示方法，其改进在于端到端训练与参数容量可扩展性。实验表明在多个无回放持续学习基准上超越当前SOTA。
2211.13218|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses rehearsal-free continual learning with pre-trained ViTs, where existing prompting methods rely on a key-query mechanism not trained end-to-end, reducing plasticity and preventing benefit from expanded parameter capacity. It proposes CODA-Prompt, which learns a set of prompt components assembled with input-conditioned weights to form input-conditioned prompts via an end-to-end attention-based key-query scheme. Experiments show it outperforms the current state of the art on rehearsal-free continual learning benchmarks.
2211.13218|v2.assessment: 端到端可学习提示组件设计合理，在无回放持续学习上取得SOTA，对基于ViT的持续学习有较高参考价值。
2211.13218|v2.contribution: 提出CODA-Prompt，一种基于注意力分解的端到端无回放持续学习提示方法。
2211.13218|v2.innovation: 用输入条件权重组装提示组件，实现端到端key-query提示生成。
2211.13218|v2.result: 在无回放持续学习基准上超越当前SOTA方法。

2304.10177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中基于回放的方法在样本选择时仅最大化当前轮次效用、忽视连续选择轮次间干扰的问题。基于影响函数框架剖析顺序选择步骤的交互，识别出一类会逐步放大回放缓冲区偶然偏差的二阶影响。提出新的选择目标以正则化二阶效应，并给出高效实现。在多个持续学习基准上优于现有SOTA方法，代码已开源。
2304.10177|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles replay-based continual learning, where existing sample selection schemes maximize only the utility of the current selection and overlook interference across successive selection rounds. Built on influence functions, it identifies a new class of second-order influences that amplify incidental bias in the replay buffer, and proposes a novel selection objective to regularize these effects with an efficient implementation. Experiments on multiple continual learning benchmarks demonstrate advantages over state-of-the-art methods.
2304.10177|v2.assessment: 从影响函数角度分析回放样本选择的二阶效应，理论视角新颖，实验充分，对持续学习回放策略研究有较高价值。
2304.10177|v2.contribution: 提出正则化二阶影响的回放样本选择目标用于持续学习。
2304.10177|v2.innovation: 基于影响函数识别并正则化连续选择轮次间的二阶干扰。
2304.10177|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上优于现有SOTA方法。

CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_cn: 该论文针对语义分割与全景分割中的持续学习问题，即模型在连续学习新类别或新任务时对旧类别分割能力的遗忘。提出CoMFormer方法，将持续学习扩展到语义与全景分割两种任务设定。相比已有仅针对分类或语义分割的持续学习方法，其改进在于统一处理语义与全景分割的增量学习。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法面向更复杂的密集预测持续学习场景。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning in semantic and panoptic segmentation, where models forget previously learned categories when sequentially learning new ones. It proposes CoMFormer, extending continual learning to both semantic and panoptic segmentation settings. The improvement over prior continual learning methods, which mainly target classification or semantic segmentation, lies in unified handling of incremental learning for both segmentation tasks.
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.assessment: 将持续学习拓展到全景分割，任务设定更贴近实际感知需求，对密集预测持续学习有参考意义。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.contribution: 提出CoMFormer用于语义与全景分割的持续学习方法。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.innovation: 统一处理语义分割与全景分割的增量学习设定。
CoMFormer: Continual Learning in Semanti.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，但方法覆盖了更复杂的密集预测持续学习任务。

2304.03931|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中数据常呈现非欧几里得几何结构、而欧氏空间难以刻画此类结构导致性能下降的问题，本文从数据几何角度重新审视持续学习。方法上利用混合曲率空间，提出增量搜索方案动态扩展底层空间几何以匹配新数据诱导的几何结构，并引入角度正则损失与邻域鲁棒损失分别约束全局与局部几何结构的变化。相比在欧氏空间中设计的基线方法，该方法能更好地保持旧数据的几何结构从而缓解遗忘。实验表明其性能优于欧氏空间基线，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2304.03931|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning from a data-geometry perspective, arguing that Euclidean space cannot capture the non-Euclidean structures of real data streams. It dynamically expands the geometry of the underlying mixed-curvature space via an incremental search scheme, and introduces angular-regularization and neighbor-robustness losses to penalize changes in global and local geometric structures. Experiments show consistent gains over Euclidean-space baselines.
2304.03931|v2.assessment: 将非欧几何引入持续学习是一个有新意的视角，但摘要缺乏定量结果，实际增益需看正文验证。
2304.03931|v2.contribution: 提出基于混合曲率空间几何扩展的持续学习框架及两种几何正则损失。
2304.03931|v2.innovation: 用动态扩展的混合曲率空间编码持续增长的几何结构，并以角度与邻域鲁棒损失约束几何漂移。
2304.03931|v2.result: 在实验中优于欧氏空间设计的基线方法，但摘要未报告具体指标。

2303.14595|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，现有特征空间知识蒸馏方法直接约束新特征匹配旧特征，忽视了可塑性需求。本文提出 Backward Feature Projection (BFP)，允许新特征在旧特征的可学习线性变换范围内变化，从而在保持旧类线性可分性的同时为新类留出新的特征方向。BFP 可与现有经验回放方法结合并显著提升性能，同时使表示空间在持续学习过程中保持良好线性可分性，线性探测即可获得高分类精度。代码已开源。
2303.14595|v2.summary_en: To improve the stability-plasticity trade-off in continual learning, this paper proposes Backward Feature Projection (BFP), which allows new features to deviate from old ones only up to a learnable linear transformation, thereby preserving linear separability of old classes while admitting new feature directions. BFP integrates with experience replay and yields significant gains, and it produces a representation space where linear probing attains high accuracy.
2303.14595|v2.assessment: 思路简洁且与回放方法正交，线性可分性视角对类增量学习有实际指导意义，值得关注。
2303.14595|v2.contribution: 提出 BFP，用可学习线性变换约束新旧特征关系以兼顾稳定性与可塑性。
2303.14595|v2.innovation: 将特征蒸馏从硬性匹配放宽为线性变换下的投影，显式保留旧类线性可分性。
2303.14595|v2.result: 与经验回放结合后性能显著提升，并支持高精度线性探测。

2305.14657|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出类增量学习中除灾难性遗忘外还存在被忽视的挑战——跨任务类判别（CTCD），即在新任务数据到达时如何在新旧类之间建立决策边界。回放方法虽隐式部分处理该问题，但作者认为其存在动态训练偏置，削弱了回放数据在解决 CTCD 上的作用。为此提出一种带梯度自适应机制的新优化目标，在在线持续学习过程中动态应对该偏置。实验显示新方法取得明显更好的结果（摘要在此处截断，未给出完整数值）。
2305.14657|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies cross-task class discrimination (CTCD) as an under-addressed challenge in class-incremental learning, beyond catastrophic forgetting, and argues that replay-based methods suffer from a dynamic training bias that limits their effectiveness on CTCD. It proposes a novel optimization objective with a gradient-based adaptive method to handle the bias dynamically during online CL. Experiments show substantially improved results.
2305.14657|v2.assessment: 对回放方法内在偏置的分析具有洞察力，CTCD 的提法对类增量学习研究有启发价值。
2305.14657|v2.contribution: 提出跨任务类判别问题并给出带梯度自适应的优化目标以缓解回放训练偏置。
2305.14657|v2.innovation: 显式建模并动态校正回放过程中的训练偏置，而非仅依赖增加回放数据。
2305.14657|v2.result: 实验表明新方法在在线持续学习设定下取得明显更优结果。

2303.09483|v2.summary_cn: 针对神经网络在顺序学习中稳定性-可塑性权衡仍远未解决、其内在机制理解不足的问题，本文提出 Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL)。该方法为以稳定性为主的持续学习模型附加一个促进可塑性的辅助网络，并具体实现为一个在可塑性与稳定性之间自然插值的正则项。在任务增量与类增量场景下，ANCL 均超越强基线，作者还通过大量分析总结出若干关于稳定性-可塑性权衡的基本原则。
2303.09483|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Auxiliary Network Continual Learning (ANCL), which augments a stability-oriented continual learner with an auxiliary network that promotes plasticity, realized as a regularizer that naturally interpolates between plasticity and stability. ANCL surpasses strong baselines on both task-incremental and class-incremental settings, and the authors derive several principles underlying the stability-plasticity trade-off.
2303.09483|v2.assessment: 辅助网络+插值正则的设计直观有效，且对权衡机制的分析对社区有参考价值。
2303.09483|v2.contribution: 提出 ANCL 框架，用辅助网络与插值正则实现稳定性与可塑性的可控权衡。
2303.09483|v2.innovation: 以辅助网络显式引入可塑性，并通过正则项在两种能力间连续插值。
2303.09483|v2.result: 在任务增量与类增量场景均超过强基线，并总结出若干权衡原则。

Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习（Continual Learning）中模型在异构任务序列上训练时容易发生灾难性遗忘的问题，提出了异构持续学习（Heterogeneous Continual Learning）的设定与方法。作者设计了一种能够适应不同任务分布变化的持续学习框架，通过动态调整模型结构或训练策略来缓解遗忘。相比传统持续学习假设任务同质或数据分布变化有限，该工作强调了任务间异构性带来的额外挑战。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该设定对自动驾驶等动态场景下的模型持续更新具有参考价值。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning when models are trained on heterogeneous task sequences. It proposes a heterogeneous continual learning framework that dynamically adapts model architecture or training strategies to varying task distributions. Unlike traditional CL settings that assume homogeneous tasks, this work highlights the additional challenges posed by inter-task heterogeneity. The setting is relevant for autonomous driving where models must continuously update in dynamic environments.
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一个更贴近实际应用的持续学习设定，对自动驾驶场景下的模型持续更新有启发意义，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其方法有效性。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出了异构持续学习的问题设定与相应框架。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 强调任务间异构性对持续学习的额外挑战并设计自适应策略。
Heterogeneous Continual Learning.|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果有待验证。

Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了双边记忆巩固（Bilateral Memory Consolidation）方法。作者通过双向的记忆巩固机制，在模型学习新任务的同时保护旧任务的知识。相比已有的基于回放或正则化的方法，该工作试图从记忆巩固的双边角度更有效地平衡新旧知识。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但其思路对自动驾驶感知模型的持续学习有潜在借鉴意义。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a bilateral memory consolidation method. It employs a bidirectional memory consolidation mechanism to protect old-task knowledge while learning new tasks. Compared with existing replay-based or regularization-based approaches, this work attempts to balance old and new knowledge from a bilateral memory perspective. The idea may benefit continual learning of autonomous driving perception models.
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.assessment: 双边记忆巩固的思路有一定新意，但摘要信息不足，需关注其在大规模基准上的实际表现。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.contribution: 提出了双边记忆巩固的持续学习方法。
Bilateral Memory Consolidation for Conti.innovation: 从双向记忆巩固角度设计遗忘缓解机制。

2303.11165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习研究中普遍忽略计算预算约束的问题，指出现有方法假设存储受限但计算无限，这在实际系统中不合理。作者构建了大规模基准，在计算受限设定下评估了多种持续学习采样策略、蒸馏损失和部分微调方法，在ImageNet2K和Continual Google Landmarks V2上进行了数据增量、类别增量和时间增量实验，总计超过1500 GPU小时。实验发现，在计算受限条件下，传统持续学习方法无一例外地无法超越一个简单的最小基线。
2303.11165|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked computational budget constraints in continual learning, where existing methods assume unlimited computation but limited storage. The authors build a large-scale benchmark and evaluate various CL sampling strategies, distillation losses, and partial fine-tuning under compute-constrained settings on ImageNet2K and Continual Google Landmarks V2 across data-incremental, class-incremental, and time-incremental scenarios, totaling over 1500 GPU-hours. They find that under compute constraints, traditional CL approaches uniformly fail to outperform a simple minimal baseline.
2303.11165|v2.assessment: 该工作以大规模实验揭示了计算受限下持续学习的真实挑战，对实际部署（如自动驾驶）具有重要警示意义，实验充分且结论扎实。
2303.11165|v2.contribution: 构建了计算受限持续学习的大规模基准并揭示了传统方法的失效。
2303.11165|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在计算预算约束下评估持续学习方法。
2303.11165|v2.result: 传统持续学习方法在计算受限下均无法超越简单基线。

2212.04842|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频数据持续学习中的灾难性遗忘和标注成本高的问题，提出了PIVOT方法。PIVOT利用图像域预训练模型的丰富知识，通过提示（prompting）机制进行持续学习，减少了可训练参数量并缓解了遗忘。与以往方法不同，PIVOT是首个无需域内预训练即可有效使用提示机制进行持续学习的方法。实验表明，在20任务ActivityNet设定上，PIVOT比现有最优方法提升了27%。
2212.04842|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and high annotation costs in video continual learning by proposing PIVOT. PIVOT leverages knowledge from image-domain pre-trained models and employs prompting mechanisms for continual learning, reducing trainable parameters and mitigating forgetting. Unlike previous methods, PIVOT is the first to effectively use prompting for CL without any in-domain pre-training. Experiments show a significant 27% improvement over state-of-the-art on the 20-task ActivityNet setup.
2212.04842|v2.assessment: PIVOT将提示学习引入视频持续学习并取得显著提升，方法简洁有效，对视频理解与持续学习的交叉领域有较高参考价值。
2212.04842|v2.contribution: 提出了首个无需域内预训练的视频持续学习提示方法PIVOT。
2212.04842|v2.innovation: 利用图像域预训练模型和提示机制实现视频持续学习。

MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习在数据损坏（corruption）场景下的鲁棒性问题，提出了MetaMix方法。MetaMix通过时间自适应的数据变换（temporally self-adaptive data transformation）来增强模型对损坏数据的鲁棒性。相比传统持续学习方法未考虑数据损坏的影响，该工作试图在持续学习过程中动态调整数据增强策略。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但其对自动驾驶中传感器噪声等损坏场景有潜在意义。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.summary_en: This paper addresses corruption robustness in continual learning by proposing MetaMix. MetaMix employs temporally self-adaptive data transformation to enhance model robustness against corrupted data. Unlike traditional CL methods that ignore data corruption, this work dynamically adjusts data augmentation during continual learning. The approach may be relevant to autonomous driving where sensor noise and corruption are common.
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.assessment: 将损坏鲁棒性与持续学习结合是一个有价值的方向，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其有效性。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.contribution: 提出了面向损坏鲁棒持续学习的MetaMix方法。
MetaMix: Towards Corruption-Robust Conti.innovation: 采用时间自适应数据变换增强持续学习鲁棒性。
