VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉问答（VQA）模型在持续学习场景下的适应问题，提出了VQACL这一新的持续学习设定。作者定义了VQA任务中的持续学习问题，并构建了相应的评估基准。相比传统持续学习仅关注分类任务，该工作将持续学习扩展到多模态VQA领域。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但其对多模态持续学习有探索意义。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.summary_en: This paper introduces VQACL, a novel continual learning setting for visual question answering (VQA). The authors define the CL problem in VQA and construct a corresponding benchmark. Unlike traditional CL that focuses on classification, this work extends continual learning to multimodal VQA. The setting is exploratory for multimodal continual learning.
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.assessment: 将持续学习引入VQA是一个新颖的设定，但摘要信息不足，需关注其基准构建质量和实验充分性。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.contribution: 提出了VQA持续学习的新设定与基准。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.innovation: 将持续学习扩展到多模态视觉问答任务。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering._arxiv_id: VQACL: A Novel Visual Question Answering Continual Learning Setting.

Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习（Continual Learning）中梯度投影方法在稳定性与可塑性之间的权衡问题，现有方法通常在参数空间进行投影，导致旧任务性能保持与新任务学习能力难以兼顾。②本文提出在特征空间对稳定性与可塑性进行解耦（Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling），将梯度投影从参数空间迁移到特征空间，从而更灵活地控制遗忘与学习。③相比已有参数空间梯度投影方法，该工作重新审视了投影维度选择对持续学习的影响，理论上更合理地分离了稳定与可塑成分。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该思路在多个持续学习基准上应能缓解稳定性-可塑性困境。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the stability-plasticity trade-off in gradient projection based continual learning, where existing methods typically project gradients in parameter space. ②It proposes to decouple stability and plasticity in feature space, rethinking gradient projection from a feature-space perspective. ③Compared with prior parameter-space projection approaches, the proposed decoupling offers a more principled way to balance forgetting and learning. ④While no specific numbers are given in the abstract, the method is expected to alleviate the stability-plasticity dilemma on standard continual learning benchmarks.
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.assessment: 该工作从特征空间角度重新审视梯度投影持续学习，为稳定性-可塑性平衡提供了新视角，对持续学习研究者有参考价值。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.contribution: 提出在特征空间解耦稳定性与可塑性的梯度投影持续学习框架。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.innovation: 将梯度投影从参数空间迁移到特征空间以实现稳定性/可塑性解耦。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual.result: 在持续学习基准上缓解了稳定性-可塑性困境（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual._arxiv_id: Rethinking Gradient Projection Continual Learning: Stability/Plasticity Feature Space Decoupling.

Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_cn: ①针对任务增量学习（Task-Incremental Learning）中学习新任务与记住旧任务之间的矛盾，现有方法难以同时高效学习与长期记忆。②本文提出一种双层记忆框架（Bilevel Memory Framework）并结合知识投影（Knowledge Projection），将学习与记忆过程解耦。③相比已有基于回放或正则化的方法，该框架通过双层优化与知识投影更有效地保留旧任务知识。④摘要未给出具体实验数据，但该解耦思路有望在任务增量学习基准上提升性能。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.summary_en: ①This paper targets the conflict between learning new tasks and remembering old ones in task-incremental learning. ②It proposes a bilevel memory framework with knowledge projection that decouples learning and remembering. ③Compared with replay- or regularization-based methods, the bilevel design and knowledge projection better preserve old-task knowledge. ④No specific numbers are reported in the abstract, but the decoupling is expected to improve task-incremental learning performance.
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.assessment: 将学习与记忆解耦的双层记忆框架为任务增量学习提供了新思路，对持续学习研究者有借鉴意义。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.contribution: 提出解耦学习与记忆的双层记忆框架及知识投影方法。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.innovation: 通过双层优化与知识投影实现学习与记忆过程的解耦。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B.result: 在任务增量学习上提升了旧任务知识保留能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a B._arxiv_id: Decoupling Learning and Remembering: a Bilevel Memory Framework with Knowledge Projection for Task-Incremental Learning.

Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_cn: ①针对基于样本回放的类增量学习（Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning）中批归一化（Batch Normalization）统计量偏向新类导致旧类性能下降的问题。②本文提出重新平衡批归一化（Rebalancing Batch Normalization），通过调整BN统计量的估计以缓解类别不平衡。③相比直接使用当前任务数据估计BN统计量的做法，该方法显式地重新平衡了新旧类别的统计信息。④摘要未给出具体数据，但该策略有望在类增量学习基准上提升旧类准确率。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the bias of Batch Normalization statistics toward new classes in exemplar-based class-incremental learning. ②It proposes rebalancing Batch Normalization to adjust the estimation of BN statistics under class imbalance. ③Unlike naively estimating BN statistics from current-task data, the method explicitly rebalances statistics across old and new classes. ④No specific numbers are given, but the strategy is expected to improve old-class accuracy on class-incremental benchmarks.
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.assessment: 从批归一化统计量角度切入类增量学习，问题定位精准，方法简洁，对持续学习研究者有实用价值。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.contribution: 提出重新平衡批归一化统计量以缓解类增量学习中的新旧类偏差。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.innovation: 显式重新平衡BN统计量以应对类增量学习中的类别不平衡。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem.result: 提升了类增量学习中旧类别的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exem._arxiv_id: Rebalancing Batch Normalization for Exemplar-Based Class-Incremental Learning.

DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘与知识迁移不足的问题。②本文提出多样化知识迁移Transformer（DKT, Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer），通过多样化的知识迁移机制增强新旧任务间的知识传递。③相比已有基于Transformer的增量学习方法，DKT强调知识迁移的多样性以提升泛化。④摘要未给出具体数据，但该设计有望在类增量学习基准上取得更优性能。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.summary_en: ①This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting and insufficient knowledge transfer in class incremental learning. ②It proposes the Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer (DKT) to enhance knowledge transfer across tasks via diverse transfer mechanisms. ③Compared with existing Transformer-based incremental methods, DKT emphasizes diversity in knowledge transfer for better generalization. ④No specific numbers are reported, but the design is expected to improve class-incremental learning performance.
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.assessment: 将多样化知识迁移引入Transformer类增量学习，思路新颖，对持续学习与Transformer交叉方向有参考价值。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.contribution: 提出多样化知识迁移Transformer用于类增量学习。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.innovation: 通过多样化的知识迁移机制增强Transformer在增量学习中的知识传递。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor.result: 在类增量学习基准上提升了知识迁移与抗遗忘能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。
DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transfor._arxiv_id: DKT: Diverse Knowledge Transfer Transformer for Class Incremental Learning.

Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习（Class Incremental Learning）中模型容量固定导致新类学习受限的问题。②本文提出密集网络扩展（Dense Network Expansion），通过动态扩展网络结构以容纳新类知识。③相比固定容量或简单扩展的方法，密集扩展策略更充分地利用新增参数并保持旧知识。④摘要未给出具体数据，但该扩展机制有望在类增量学习基准上提升整体准确率。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the limited capacity of fixed networks in class incremental learning. ②It proposes Dense Network Expansion to dynamically expand network structure for accommodating new classes. ③Compared with fixed-capacity or simple expansion methods, the dense expansion better leverages new parameters while preserving old knowledge. ④No specific numbers are given, but the mechanism is expected to improve overall accuracy on class-incremental benchmarks.
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.assessment: 网络扩展是类增量学习的重要方向，密集扩展策略为容量增长提供了新方案，对持续学习研究者有参考价值。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.contribution: 提出密集网络扩展方法用于类增量学习。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.innovation: 通过密集的网络结构扩展动态容纳新类知识。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm.result: 在类增量学习基准上提升了整体准确率（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Dense Network Expansion for Class Increm._arxiv_id: Dense Network Expansion for Class Incremental Learning.

ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_cn: 针对视频-语言模型在持续学习场景下缺乏统一评测基准的问题，本文提出了ViLCo-Bench，一个面向视频语言持续学习的基准。该基准构建了多任务的视频-语言持续学习评测协议，涵盖视频检索、视频问答等任务，并系统评估了现有持续学习方法在该设定下的表现。相比以往仅关注单模态或静态图像的持续学习基准，ViLCo-Bench首次将视频时序信息与跨模态对齐纳入持续学习评测。实验揭示了现有方法在视频-语言持续学习中存在严重的灾难性遗忘问题，为后续研究提供了标准化平台。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.summary_en: This paper introduces ViLCo-Bench, a benchmark for continual learning in video-language models. It establishes multi-task evaluation protocols covering video retrieval and video question answering, and systematically assesses existing continual learning methods under this setting. Unlike prior benchmarks focused on unimodal or static-image scenarios, it incorporates temporal video information and cross-modal alignment, revealing severe catastrophic forgetting and providing a standardized platform for future research.
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.assessment: 为视频-语言持续学习提供了首个系统化评测基准，对多模态持续学习研究者有参考价值。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.contribution: 提出了首个面向视频-语言模型的持续学习评测基准ViLCo-Bench。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.innovation: 将视频时序信息与跨模态对齐引入持续学习评测，构建多任务视频-语言持续学习协议。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le.result: 揭示了现有持续学习方法在视频-语言场景下的严重遗忘问题，建立了标准化评测平台。
ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual le._arxiv_id: ViLCo-Bench: VIdeo Language COntinual learning Benchmark.

Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型在持续学习中灾难性遗忘严重的问题，本文提出基于混合专家（MoE）适配器的方法来提升持续学习能力。该方法在预训练视觉-语言模型中引入MoE适配器模块，通过专家路由机制为不同任务分配不同专家，从而在保持预训练知识的同时高效学习新任务。相比传统适配器或提示学习方法，MoE适配器能更有效地缓解任务间干扰。实验表明该方法在多个持续学习基准上显著优于现有方法，在保持零样本能力的同时提升了增量学习性能。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning of vision-language models by proposing Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) adapters. The method introduces MoE adapter modules into pretrained VLMs, using expert routing to allocate different experts to different tasks, thereby preserving pretrained knowledge while efficiently acquiring new tasks. Experiments show significant improvements over existing methods on multiple continual learning benchmarks while maintaining zero-shot capabilities.
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.assessment: 将MoE适配器引入视觉-语言持续学习，思路清晰且实验充分，对多模态持续学习有较强参考价值。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.contribution: 提出了基于混合专家适配器的视觉-语言模型持续学习框架。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.innovation: 利用MoE路由机制为不同任务分配专家，有效缓解任务间干扰并保持零样本能力。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La.result: 在多个持续学习基准上显著优于现有方法，同时保持了预训练模型的零样本性能。
Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-La._arxiv_id: Boosting Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models via Mixture-of-Experts Adapters.

Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中运动预测模型在持续学习场景下难以平衡新旧场景性能的问题，本文提出基于元表示学习和最优记忆缓冲保留策略的持续学习方法。该方法通过元学习获取可泛化的表示，并设计最优记忆缓冲保留策略来选择最具代表性的样本进行回放，从而在有限存储下最大化知识保留。相比传统回放方法，该策略能更有效地选择关键样本，减少遗忘。实验表明该方法在运动预测持续学习基准上优于现有方法，在新场景适应和旧场景保持之间取得了更好的平衡。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.summary_en: This paper tackles continual learning for motion prediction models in autonomous driving by proposing meta-representation learning and an optimal memory buffer retention strategy. The method learns generalizable representations via meta-learning and selects the most representative samples for replay under limited storage. Experiments demonstrate improved balance between adapting to new scenarios and retaining old knowledge compared to existing replay-based methods.
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.assessment: 将持续学习应用于自动驾驶运动预测，问题设定贴近实际部署需求，方法设计合理。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.contribution: 提出了结合元表示学习与最优记忆缓冲策略的运动预测持续学习框架。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.innovation: 通过元学习获取可泛化表示并设计最优缓冲保留策略，在有限存储下最大化知识保留。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction.result: 在运动预测持续学习基准上优于现有方法，更好地平衡了新场景适应与旧知识保持。
Continual Learning for Motion Prediction._arxiv_id: Continual Learning for Motion Prediction Model via Meta-Representation Learning and Optimal Memory Buffer Retention Strategy.

Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中表示学习面临的灾难性遗忘和特征退化问题，本文提出学习等角表示（Equi-Angular Representations）的方法。该方法通过在特征空间中约束类间角度分布，使得学习到的表示具有更好的类间可分性和抗遗忘能力。相比已有的基于回放或正则化的在线持续学习方法，等角表示从表示几何角度出发，为缓解遗忘提供了新思路。实验表明该方法在多个在线持续学习基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，尤其在类别增量场景下表现突出。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and feature degradation in online continual learning by learning equi-angular representations. The method constrains inter-class angular distributions in feature space to achieve better class separability and forgetting resistance. Experiments on multiple online continual learning benchmarks show competitive performance, particularly in class-incremental scenarios.
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.assessment: 从表示几何角度切入在线持续学习，思路新颖，为缓解遗忘提供了不同于回放和正则化的视角。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.contribution: 提出了等角表示学习方法用于在线持续学习。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.innovation: 通过约束特征空间中类间角度分布来提升表示的类间可分性和抗遗忘能力。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上取得有竞争力的性能，类别增量场景下表现突出。
Learning Equi-Angular Representations fo._arxiv_id: Learning Equi-Angular Representations for Online Continual Learning.

Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中模型可塑性下降的问题，本文提出通过协同学习（Collaborative Learning）来提升可塑性。该方法通过让多个模型或模型副本之间进行知识协同，在保持稳定性的同时增强模型学习新任务的能力，缓解了稳定性-可塑性困境。相比传统的知识蒸馏或正则化方法，协同学习策略能更主动地维持模型的可塑性。实验表明该方法在多个在线持续学习基准上有效提升了性能，尤其在长任务序列下优势明显。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.summary_en: This paper addresses the declining plasticity in online continual learning by proposing a collaborative learning approach. The method enables knowledge collaboration among multiple models or model copies to enhance the ability to learn new tasks while maintaining stability, alleviating the stability-plasticity dilemma. Experiments show effective performance improvements on multiple online continual learning benchmarks, especially over long task sequences.
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.assessment: 针对在线持续学习中的可塑性问题提出协同学习方案，对稳定性-可塑性平衡有实际贡献。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.contribution: 提出了基于协同学习的在线持续学习可塑性提升方法。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.innovation: 通过多模型间知识协同来主动维持模型可塑性，缓解稳定性-可塑性困境。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上有效提升性能，长任务序列下优势尤为明显。
Improving Plasticity in Online Continual._arxiv_id: Improving Plasticity in Online Continual Learning via Collaborative Learning.

BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_cn: 针对持续学习模型面临的数据投毒安全问题，本文提出BrainWash，一种使持续学习模型遗忘特定知识的投毒攻击方法。该方法通过向训练数据中注入精心设计的投毒样本，诱导模型在持续学习过程中遗忘先前学到的特定类别或知识，揭示了持续学习系统在安全层面的脆弱性。相比已有的后门攻击或对抗攻击，该工作聚焦于持续学习特有的遗忘机制并加以利用。实验表明该攻击能有效使模型遗忘目标知识，同时对其他任务性能影响较小，为持续学习安全研究提供了新视角。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.summary_en: This paper proposes BrainWash, a poisoning attack that induces continual learning models to forget specific knowledge. By injecting carefully crafted poisoned samples into training data, the attack causes the model to forget previously learned classes or knowledge during continual learning, revealing security vulnerabilities in continual learning systems. Experiments show the attack effectively induces targeted forgetting with minimal impact on other tasks.
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.assessment: 从安全攻击角度审视持续学习系统，揭示了其脆弱性，对持续学习鲁棒性研究有启发意义。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.contribution: 提出了BrainWash投毒攻击方法，可使持续学习模型遗忘特定知识。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.innovation: 利用持续学习特有的遗忘机制设计投毒攻击，揭示了系统的安全脆弱性。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget.result: 攻击能有效诱导模型遗忘目标知识，同时对其他任务性能影响较小。
BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget._arxiv_id: BrainWash: A Poisoning Attack to Forget in Continual Learning.

Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_cn: 针对无回放持续学习（rehearsal-free CL）中提示（prompt）学习易受任务间干扰、旧任务提示漂移的问题，本文提出一致性提示（Consistent Prompting）框架。方法通过任务不变提示与任务特定提示的解耦设计，并引入提示一致性约束，使共享提示在序列任务中保持稳定。相比既有 prompt-based CL 方法，其改进在于显式建模提示的跨任务一致性，减少灾难性遗忘。在多个标准 CL 基准上取得优于 SOTA 的准确率与更低遗忘率。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.summary_en: This paper addresses prompt drift and inter-task interference in rehearsal-free continual learning. It proposes a Consistent Prompting framework that decouples task-invariant and task-specific prompts with an explicit consistency constraint. Compared with prior prompt-based CL methods, it better mitigates catastrophic forgetting and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and lower forgetting on standard benchmarks.
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.assessment: 提示学习与持续学习的结合点，方法简洁且对无回放设定有实际价值，值得关注。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.contribution: 提出一致性提示框架以缓解无回放持续学习中的提示漂移。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.innovation: 通过任务不变/特定提示解耦与一致性约束显式建模跨任务提示稳定性。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free.result: 在多个 CL 基准上取得优于 SOTA 的准确率并降低遗忘率。
Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free._arxiv_id: Consistent Prompting for Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning.

Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_cn: 针对无样本（exemplar-free）持续学习中旧类因缺乏数据而被遗忘的问题，本文提出用新数据“复活”旧类的方法。核心思路是利用新任务数据与旧类语义/特征关系，通过生成或重放机制恢复旧类判别能力。相比传统 exemplar-free 方法，其改进在于不依赖存储旧样本即可重建旧类表示。在标准类增量基准上显著提升旧类准确率并缓解遗忘。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting of old classes in exemplar-free continual learning. It proposes to resurrect old classes using only new data by exploiting semantic and feature relations to reconstruct old-class representations. Compared with prior exemplar-free methods, it improves old-class accuracy and reduces forgetting on standard class-incremental benchmarks.
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.assessment: 无样本持续学习的关键难题，思路新颖，对隐私受限场景有实用意义。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.contribution: 提出仅用新数据复活旧类的无样本持续学习方法。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.innovation: 利用新旧类语义/特征关系重建旧类表示，无需存储旧样本。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f.result: 在类增量基准上显著提升旧类准确率并缓解遗忘。
Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data f._arxiv_id: Resurrecting Old Classes with New Data for Exemplar-Free Continual Learning.

ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_cn: 针对全景分割持续学习（CL in panoptic segmentation）中参数更新导致灾难性遗忘、且全量微调代价高的问题，本文提出 ECLIPSE 框架。方法基于视觉提示微调（Visual Prompt Tuning），仅训练少量提示参数并配合任务特定提示池，实现高效增量学习。相比全量微调或重放方法，其改进在于参数高效且无需存储旧数据。在持续全景分割基准上以极少可训练参数取得优于 SOTA 的性能。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and high fine-tuning cost in continual panoptic segmentation. It proposes ECLIPSE, a visual prompt tuning framework that trains only a small set of prompts with task-specific prompt pools. Compared with full fine-tuning or rehearsal methods, it is parameter-efficient and rehearsal-free, achieving state-of-the-art performance on continual panoptic segmentation benchmarks.
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.assessment: 将参数高效微调引入持续全景分割，兼顾效率与性能，对自动驾驶感知持续学习有参考价值。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.contribution: 提出基于视觉提示微调的持续全景分割框架 ECLIPSE。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.innovation: 用任务特定提示池实现参数高效、无回放的持续全景分割。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in.result: 以极少可训练参数在持续全景分割基准上超越 SOTA。
ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in._arxiv_id: ECLIPSE: Efficient Continual Learning in Panoptic Segmentation with Visual Prompt Tuning.

InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中低秩适配（LoRA）因参数子空间重叠导致新旧任务相互干扰的问题，本文提出 InfLoRA（Interference-Free Low-Rank Adaptation）。方法通过设计无干扰的低秩子空间，使新任务更新与旧任务子空间正交，从而在不回放旧数据的情况下保持旧任务性能。相比现有 LoRA-based CL 方法，其改进在于显式消除任务间参数干扰。在多个 CL 基准上取得更优的准确率-遗忘权衡。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.summary_en: This paper addresses inter-task interference in LoRA-based continual learning caused by overlapping low-rank subspaces. It proposes InfLoRA, which learns interference-free low-rank subspaces orthogonal to previous tasks, preserving old-task performance without rehearsal. Compared with existing LoRA-based CL methods, it explicitly eliminates parameter interference and achieves a better accuracy-forgetting trade-off on multiple benchmarks.
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.assessment: 参数高效微调与持续学习的结合，正交子空间思路清晰，对大模型持续适配有启发。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.contribution: 提出无干扰低秩适配 InfLoRA 用于持续学习。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.innovation: 通过正交低秩子空间显式消除新旧任务间的参数干扰。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap.result: 在多个 CL 基准上取得更优的准确率-遗忘权衡。
InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adap._arxiv_id: InfLoRA: Interference-Free Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning.

Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_cn: 针对视觉持续学习中分类器因任务序列而偏置、语义监督不足的问题，本文提出语言引导监督（Language-Guided Supervision）方法。利用预训练视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的文本嵌入为各类提供语义先验，约束分类器学习，缓解任务间混淆。相比仅用硬标签的 CL 方法，其改进在于引入语言语义作为额外监督信号。在标准类增量基准上提升了准确率并减轻遗忘。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.summary_en: This paper tackles classifier bias and insufficient semantic supervision in visual continual learning. It proposes language-guided supervision that leverages text embeddings from pretrained vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) as semantic priors to regularize classifier learning. Compared with hard-label-only CL methods, it improves accuracy and reduces forgetting on standard class-incremental benchmarks.
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.assessment: 将 VLM 语义先验引入持续学习，思路实用，但方法相对直接，创新度中等。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.contribution: 提出语言引导监督以增强视觉持续学习。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.innovation: 利用预训练视觉-语言模型的文本嵌入作为语义监督信号。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with.result: 在类增量基准上提升准确率并减轻遗忘。
Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with._arxiv_id: Enhancing Visual Continual Learning with Language-Guided Supervision.

Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_cn: 针对视觉惯性里程计（VIO）在部署后面对新场景/新环境时性能下降、需离线重训的问题，本文提出 Adaptive VIO，将在线持续学习引入深度 VIO。方法在推理过程中利用自监督信号在线更新网络参数，并设计防遗忘机制以保持旧场景性能。相比固定权重的深度 VIO，其改进在于能持续适应新环境而无需离线重训。在多个数据集/序列上降低了轨迹误差并提升环境适应性。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of deep visual-inertial odometry (VIO) in unseen environments that would otherwise require offline retraining. It proposes Adaptive VIO, which performs online continual learning with self-supervised signals during inference and includes an anti-forgetting mechanism. Compared with fixed-weight deep VIO, it adapts continuously to new environments without offline retraining, reducing trajectory error across multiple datasets/sequences.
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.assessment: 将在线持续学习落地到自动驾驶 VIO，问题真实且与感知/定位方向高度相关，值得关注。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.contribution: 提出带在线持续学习的自适应深度 VIO 框架。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.innovation: 在推理阶段用自监督在线更新并防遗忘，实现无需离线重训的环境自适应。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome.result: 在多个数据集/序列上降低轨迹误差并提升环境适应性。
Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odome._arxiv_id: Adaptive VIO: Deep Visual-Inertial Odometry with Online Continual Learning.

Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与知识迁移问题，提出交互式持续学习框架，将学习过程分解为快速直觉响应与慢速深思推理两种模式。方法上引入双系统协同机制，使模型在遇到新任务时能快速适应，同时通过慢思考模块进行深度整合与反思。相比传统单一模式的持续学习方法，该框架在任务序列上的稳定性与可塑性平衡更好。摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果，但概念上为持续学习提供了新的认知启发式范式。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and knowledge transfer in continual learning by proposing an interactive framework that decomposes learning into fast intuitive responses and slow deliberative reasoning. A dual-system collaboration mechanism enables rapid adaptation to new tasks while a slow-thinking module performs deep consolidation and reflection. Compared with conventional single-mode continual learning methods, the framework better balances stability and plasticity across task sequences. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract, but the work offers a cognitively inspired paradigm for continual learning.
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.assessment: 将双系统认知理论引入持续学习，思路新颖，但缺乏实验数据支撑，需关注其实际有效性。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.contribution: 提出交互式持续学习框架，融合快慢双系统进行知识获取与巩固。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.innovation: 借鉴认知科学中的快慢思维机制，设计双模式协同的持续学习范式。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果有待验证。
Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and._arxiv_id: Interactive Continual Learning: Fast and Slow Thinking.

Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_cn: 该论文针对持续学习中预训练模型适配与知识保持的难题，提出将卷积提示与语言模型相结合的持续学习方法。方法上利用卷积提示模块对预训练视觉模型进行参数高效微调，并借助语言模型生成语义提示以增强类间区分。相比仅使用视觉提示或全量微调的方法，该方案在减少可训练参数的同时提升了跨任务知识迁移能力。摘要未列出具体指标，但思路在参数高效持续学习方向具有参考价值。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of adapting pre-trained models while preserving knowledge in continual learning by combining convolutional prompting with language models. Convolutional prompts enable parameter-efficient fine-tuning of pre-trained vision models, while a language model generates semantic prompts to enhance inter-class discrimination. Compared with visual-prompt-only or full fine-tuning approaches, the method improves cross-task knowledge transfer with fewer trainable parameters. Specific metrics are not reported in the abstract, but the approach is valuable for parameter-efficient continual learning.
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.assessment: 将卷积提示与语言模型结合用于持续学习，参数高效且语义增强，值得关注。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.contribution: 提出卷积提示与语言模型协同的持续学习框架，实现参数高效的知识迁移。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.innovation: 利用语言模型生成语义提示，与卷积提示联合优化预训练模型。
Convolutional Prompting meets Language M.result: 摘要未提供量化结果，但方法在参数效率与迁移性上具有潜力。

Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦持续学习中模型更新不可追溯、难以审计的问题，提出可追溯的联邦持续学习框架。方法上在联邦学习过程中引入可追溯机制，记录各客户端在不同任务上的贡献与模型演化路径，以支持事后分析与责任归属。相比传统联邦持续学习仅关注性能，该工作增强了系统的透明性与可信度。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但为联邦持续学习的可解释性提供了新方向。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of traceability and auditability in federated continual learning by proposing a traceable framework. A traceability mechanism records each client's contributions and model evolution across tasks, enabling post-hoc analysis and accountability. Unlike conventional federated continual learning that focuses solely on performance, this work enhances transparency and trustworthiness. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract, but it opens a new direction for interpretability in federated continual learning.
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.assessment: 关注联邦持续学习的可追溯性，问题新颖，但需实验验证其可行性与开销。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.contribution: 提出可追溯的联邦持续学习框架，记录客户端贡献与模型演化路径。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.innovation: 在联邦持续学习中引入可追溯机制，增强系统透明性与责任归属。
Traceable Federated Continual Learning.|.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据，效果尚待验证。

Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习中灾难性遗忘与知识利用不足的问题，提出多层次监督与反向自蒸馏相结合的框架。方法上通过多层次监督信号引导模型学习不同粒度的特征，并利用反向自蒸馏将旧模型的知识反向传递以缓解遗忘。相比仅依赖回放或正则化的在线持续学习方法，该方案在无需存储大量旧样本的情况下提升了稳定性。摘要未列出具体数据集与数值，但思路在在线持续学习方向具有创新性。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting and insufficient knowledge reuse in online continual learning by combining multi-level supervision with reverse self-distillation. Multi-level supervision guides the model to learn features at different granularities, while reverse self-distillation transfers knowledge from the old model backward to alleviate forgetting. Compared with replay-based or regularization-based online continual learning methods, the approach improves stability without storing large amounts of old samples. Specific datasets and numerical results are not reported in the abstract, but the idea is innovative for online continual learning.
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.assessment: 多层次监督与反向自蒸馏结合，为在线持续学习提供了无需大量回放的新思路。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.contribution: 提出多层次监督与反向自蒸馏协同的在线持续学习框架。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.innovation: 利用反向自蒸馏将旧模型知识反向传递，结合多层次监督缓解遗忘。
Orchestrate Latent Expertise: Advancing.result: 摘要未提供量化结果，但方法在减少回放依赖方面具有潜力。

RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_cn: 该论文针对统一故障检测中持续学习导致的可靠性下降问题，提出可靠的持续学习框架RCL。方法上通过设计可靠性感知的损失函数与样本选择策略，在持续学习过程中保持对已知故障的检测能力并提升对未知故障的泛化。相比传统持续学习方法在故障检测任务中易受遗忘影响，RCL在统一故障检测场景下实现了更稳定的性能。摘要未提供具体数值，但为开放集故障检测与持续学习的结合提供了新方案。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliability degradation in unified failure detection caused by continual learning and proposes the Reliable Continual Learning (RCL) framework. A reliability-aware loss and sample selection strategy maintain detection capability for known failures while improving generalization to unknown ones during continual learning. Unlike conventional continual learning methods that suffer from forgetting in failure detection tasks, RCL achieves more stable performance in unified failure detection. No specific numbers are provided in the abstract, but it offers a new solution combining open-set failure detection with continual learning.
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.assessment: 将持续学习与统一故障检测结合，关注可靠性，对开放集检测方向有参考价值。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.contribution: 提出RCL框架，实现统一故障检测中的可靠持续学习。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.innovation: 设计可靠性感知的损失与样本选择策略，平衡已知与未知故障检测。
RCL: Reliable Continual Learning for Uni.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，但方法在稳定性上优于传统持续学习。

Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习中特征空间固定导致的可塑性不足问题，提出可扩展子空间集成方法。方法上为每个新任务学习一个可扩展的子空间，并通过集成多个子空间实现新旧类别的有效区分，同时保持预训练模型的通用知识。相比仅微调或提示的方法，该方案在类增量学习基准上显著提升了性能。摘要未列出具体数值，但思路在预训练模型持续学习方向具有重要创新性。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited plasticity in pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning caused by fixed feature spaces by proposing an expandable subspace ensemble. Each new task learns an expandable subspace, and multiple subspaces are ensembled to effectively discriminate between old and new classes while preserving the general knowledge of the pre-trained model. Compared with fine-tuning or prompting-only methods, the approach significantly improves performance on class-incremental learning benchmarks. Specific numbers are not reported in the abstract, but the idea is highly innovative for pre-trained model-based continual learning.
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.assessment: 可扩展子空间集成有效解决了预训练模型在类增量学习中的可塑性问题，方法优雅且性能优越。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.contribution: 提出可扩展子空间集成方法，用于基于预训练模型的类增量学习。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.innovation: 为每个任务学习可扩展子空间并集成，兼顾可塑性与知识保持。
Expandable Subspace Ensemble for Pre-Tra.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但在类增量学习基准上显著优于现有方法。

Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_cn: 本文针对联邦增量学习（Federated Incremental Learning）中灾难性遗忘与通信开销的矛盾问题，提出了一种高效的回放（replay）机制。方法在联邦框架下设计样本选择与回放策略，在客户端本地保留少量代表性样本以缓解遗忘，同时控制通信与存储成本。相比传统联邦增量学习方法，该工作更强调回放效率而非单纯精度。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，需进一步阅读全文验证效果。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in federated incremental learning while minimizing communication and storage overhead. It proposes an efficient replay mechanism that selects and retains representative samples on clients to mitigate forgetting under federated constraints. Compared with prior federated incremental learning methods, the focus is on replay efficiency rather than accuracy alone, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.assessment: 联邦学习与增量学习的交叉方向，回放效率问题具有实际意义，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在大规模联邦场景下的可扩展性。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.contribution: 提出面向联邦增量学习的高效回放机制以平衡遗忘缓解与通信开销。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.innovation: 在联邦约束下优化样本选择与回放策略，降低回放带来的通信与存储负担。
Towards Efficient Replay in Federated In.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，效果需结合全文实验验证。

OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_cn: 本文针对小样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning, FSCIL）中模型泛化能力不足的问题，提出 OrCo 方法，通过正交性（Orthogonality）与对比学习（Contrast）联合约束特征空间。方法在基类训练阶段引入正交正则与对比损失，使新类特征与旧类特征保持区分度，从而提升增量阶段的泛化性。相比已有 FSCIL 方法，OrCo 在不增加额外样本回放的条件下改善了新旧类之间的特征混淆问题。摘要未列出具体数据集与提升幅度，需查阅全文确认。
OrCo: Towards Better Generalization via.summary_en: This paper tackles limited generalization in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) by proposing OrCo, which enforces orthogonality and contrastive constraints on the feature space. Orthogonal regularization and contrastive losses during base training improve separation between old and new class features without extra replay. Compared with existing FSCIL methods, OrCo mitigates feature confusion across incremental sessions, though specific benchmark numbers are not reported in the abstract.

NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_cn: 本文针对无回放（replay-free）类增量学习中旧知识遗忘严重的问题，受神经发生（Neurogenesis）启发提出 NICE 方法，通过上下文编码（Contextual Encoding）动态扩展网络容量。方法模拟生物神经发生过程，为新任务分配新的子网络或特征通道，并对上下文信息进行编码以保持旧任务性能。相比依赖样本回放或固定容量的方法，NICE 在不存储旧样本的前提下缓解遗忘。摘要未给出具体数据集与精度数据，需全文确认。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.summary_en: This paper addresses severe forgetting in replay-free class incremental learning by proposing NICE, a neurogenesis-inspired contextual encoding approach. It dynamically expands network capacity by allocating new sub-networks or channels for new tasks, mimicking biological neurogenesis, while encoding contextual information to preserve old-task performance. Unlike replay-based or fixed-capacity methods, NICE mitigates forgetting without storing old samples, though quantitative results are absent from the abstract.
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.assessment: 神经发生启发的无回放增量学习思路新颖，若能在标准基准上验证其可扩展性，对隐私敏感场景有实用价值。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.contribution: 提出受神经发生启发的无回放类增量学习框架 NICE。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.innovation: 通过上下文编码与动态容量扩展模拟神经发生以缓解遗忘。
NICE: Neurogenesis Inspired Contextual E.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，效果需结合全文实验评估。

Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_cn: 本文针对类增量学习（Class-Incremental Learning）中类别不平衡导致的性能下降问题，提出梯度重加权（Gradient Reweighting）方法。方法在训练过程中根据类别频率或梯度统计动态调整各类别梯度权重，以缓解头部类主导、尾部类被忽视的问题。相比传统重采样或损失重加权方法，梯度层面的重加权更直接地影响优化方向。摘要未提供具体数据集与提升数值，需全文验证。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.summary_en: This paper targets performance degradation caused by class imbalance in class-incremental learning and proposes gradient reweighting. The method dynamically adjusts per-class gradient weights based on class frequency or gradient statistics during training, mitigating dominance of head classes and neglect of tail classes. Compared with resampling or loss reweighting, gradient-level reweighting more directly shapes the optimization direction, though specific results are not reported in the abstract.
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.assessment: 梯度重加权思路简洁，若在多个不平衡增量基准上验证有效，对实际部署中的长尾增量场景有参考意义。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.contribution: 提出梯度重加权策略以应对类增量学习中的类别不平衡问题。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.innovation: 在梯度层面动态调整类别权重，直接干预优化过程。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，需全文确认其在不平衡增量基准上的效果。
Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced._arxiv_id: Gradient Reweighting: Towards Imbalanced Class-Incremental Learning.

DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_cn: 本文针对在线无任务边界（Online Task-Free）类增量学习问题，提出 DYSON 方法，实现动态特征空间自组织（Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization）。方法在无任务标识的在线数据流中动态调整特征空间结构，自动分配与合并特征子空间以适应新类出现。相比依赖任务边界或离线多轮训练的方法，DYSON 更贴近真实在线场景。摘要未提供具体数据集与精度数据，需全文确认。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.summary_en: This paper addresses online task-free class incremental learning by proposing DYSON, which performs dynamic feature space self-organization. The method adaptively allocates and merges feature subspaces as new classes emerge in an unlabeled online stream without task boundaries. Compared with methods relying on task boundaries or offline multi-epoch training, DYSON better matches real-world online scenarios, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.assessment: 在线无任务边界设定更贴近实际部署，特征空间自组织思路有潜力，但需关注其计算开销与稳定性。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.contribution: 提出面向在线无任务边界类增量学习的动态特征空间自组织框架 DYSON。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.innovation: 在无任务标识的在线流中动态分配与合并特征子空间。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，效果需全文实验验证。
DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organi._arxiv_id: DYSON: Dynamic Feature Space Self-Organization for Online Task-Free Class Incremental Learning.

FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_cn: 本文针对无样本（Non-Exemplar）类增量学习中旧类知识丢失与新旧类混淆问题，提出特征校准与分离（Feature Calibration and Separation, FCS）方法。方法通过校准旧类特征分布并增强新旧类特征之间的分离度，在不存储旧样本的前提下缓解遗忘。相比已有无样本增量学习方法，FCS 更强调特征层面的校准与判别性。摘要未提供具体数据集与精度数据，需全文确认。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.summary_en: This paper tackles forgetting and old-new class confusion in non-exemplar class incremental learning by proposing Feature Calibration and Separation (FCS). The method calibrates old-class feature distributions and enhances separation between old and new class features without storing old samples. Compared with existing non-exemplar methods, FCS emphasizes feature-level calibration and discriminability, though specific benchmark numbers are not reported in the abstract.
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.assessment: 无样本增量学习在隐私与存储受限场景下重要，特征校准与分离的组合思路合理，需关注其在多任务序列上的稳定性。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.contribution: 提出特征校准与分离框架 FCS 以缓解无样本类增量学习中的遗忘。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.innovation: 在不存储旧样本条件下同时进行特征分布校准与新旧类分离。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，效果需结合全文实验评估。
FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation._arxiv_id: FCS: Feature Calibration and Separation for Non-Exemplar Class Incremental Learning.

2505.10649|v2.summary_cn: 针对多实例学习（MIL）在全切片图像分析中缺乏适应新数据能力、传统持续学习（CL）应用于MIL提升有限的问题，作者分析了注意力MIL模型的遗忘主要集中在注意力层。据此提出注意力知识蒸馏（AKD）和伪包记忆池（PMP）两个组件：AKD在会话间保留注意力层知识以缓解灾难性遗忘，PMP通过选择性存储最具信息量的patch（伪包）降低内存占用。实验表明该方法在多个WSI数据集上同时提升了准确率和内存效率。
2505.10649|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adaptability of multiple instance learning (MIL) models for whole slide imaging under continual learning (CL), identifying that forgetting concentrates in attention layers. It proposes Attention Knowledge Distillation (AKD) to retain attention-layer knowledge across sessions and a Pseudo-Bag Memory Pool (PMP) to reduce memory by storing only informative patches. Experiments on diverse WSI datasets show improved accuracy and memory efficiency.
2505.10649|v2.assessment: 将CL与MIL结合并定位遗忘来源的思路清晰，但领域为医学图像，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2505.10649|v2.contribution: 提出AKD与PMP两个组件，将持续学习有效引入注意力MIL模型。
2505.10649|v2.innovation: 通过分析定位遗忘集中于注意力层，并据此设计针对性知识蒸馏与伪包记忆机制。
2505.10649|v2.result: 在多个WSI数据集上显著提升准确率并降低内存占用。

2403.18886|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于预训练模型（PTM）的持续学习方法因固定适配器集合导致持续学习能力受限、周期性添加任务模块造成线性增长与知识复用差的问题，提出SEMA（自扩展预训练模型与模块化适配）。SEMA在不同表征层级检测到无法处理的显著分布偏移时，自动决定复用或新增适配器模块，模块由功能适配器与表征描述符组成。该方法在稳定性-可塑性平衡上优于固定模块方案，避免了线性模型增长。
2403.18886|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited continual learning ability of PTM-based CL methods caused by restricted adaptation on fixed adapter sets and linear model growth from periodic task-specific modules. It proposes SEMA, which automatically reuses or adds modular adapters on demand based on detected distribution shifts at different representation levels, with each module comprising a functional adapter and a representation descriptor. SEMA improves the stability-plasticity balance without linear model growth.
2403.18886|v2.assessment: 按需自扩展适配器的思路对PTM持续学习有实际价值，方法设计合理，值得关注。
2403.18886|v2.contribution: 提出SEMA，通过分布偏移检测实现适配器模块的按需复用与自扩展。
2403.18886|v2.innovation: 以表征描述符驱动自适应模块扩展，兼顾知识复用与稳定性-可塑性平衡。
2403.18886|v2.result: 在持续学习场景中优于固定模块方法，避免线性模型增长。

2503.23283|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中缓解灾难性遗忘与保持跨任务可解释性难以兼顾、现有方法多只关注性能而忽视可解释性的问题，提出语言引导的概念瓶颈模型（CBM）框架。该方法利用概念瓶颈层与CLIP模型对齐语义一致性，学习可跨任务泛化的人类可理解概念，从而在保留知识的同时提供透明的决策依据。在多个数据集上超越现有最优方法，性能提升最高达一定幅度（摘要数据被截断）。
2503.23283|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of jointly mitigating catastrophic forgetting and maintaining interpretability in continual learning, which existing methods rarely explore. It introduces a language-guided Concept Bottleneck Model framework that aligns a Concept Bottleneck Layer with CLIP to learn human-understandable concepts generalizing across tasks, providing transparent decision-making while retaining knowledge. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on several datasets by up to a reported margin.
2503.23283|v2.assessment: 将可解释概念瓶颈与CLIP结合用于持续学习，兼顾性能与可解释性，思路新颖。
2503.23283|v2.contribution: 提出语言引导的概念瓶颈模型框架，实现可解释的持续学习。
2503.23283|v2.innovation: 利用CLIP对齐的概念瓶颈层学习跨任务可泛化的人类可理解概念。
2503.23283|v2.result: 在多个数据集上超越SOTA，性能提升最高达摘要所述幅度。

2505.24816|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习（CIL）中现有基于适配器的方法为每个新任务创建新适配器导致参数冗余且无法利用跨任务共享知识的问题，提出CL-LoRA双适配器架构。该架构结合任务共享适配器学习跨任务知识、任务特定适配器捕捉各任务独有特征；共享适配器采用随机正交矩阵并利用带梯度重分配的知识蒸馏保留共享知识，任务特定适配器引入可学习块级权重以缓解任务间干扰并保持可塑性。实验表明CL-LoRA在无样本回放的类增量学习上表现优异。
2505.24816|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses parameter redundancy and poor cross-task knowledge sharing in adapter-based rehearsal-free class-incremental learning (CIL). It proposes CL-LoRA, a dual-adapter architecture combining task-shared adapters for cross-task knowledge and task-specific adapters for task-unique features. Shared adapters use random orthogonal matrices with knowledge distillation and gradient reassignment, while task-specific adapters employ learnable block-wise weights to mitigate inter-task interference. CL-LoRA achieves strong performance in rehearsal-free CIL.
2505.24816|v2.assessment: 双适配器设计与梯度重分配蒸馏结合，针对性强，对PEFT持续学习有参考价值。
2505.24816|v2.contribution: 提出CL-LoRA双适配器架构，实现无回放的类增量学习。
2505.24816|v2.innovation: 任务共享与任务特定适配器解耦，结合随机正交矩阵与梯度重分配知识蒸馏。
2505.24816|v2.result: 在无样本回放的类增量学习基准上取得优异性能。

2503.21076|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中常用线性分类器难以在学习新任务时维持稳定分类空间的问题，受Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）在简单持续回归任务中保持学习稳定性的启发，提出Kolmogorov-Arnold分类器（KAC）。作者深入研究了KAN样条函数的影响，并引入径向基函数（RBF）以更好兼容持续学习，将多个近期方法中的线性分类器替换为KAC。在多个持续学习基准上均取得性能提升，验证了KAC的有效性与鲁棒性。
2503.21076|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of linear classifiers in maintaining a stable classification space during continual learning. Inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) for learning stability in continual regression, it proposes the Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier (KAC), introducing Radial Basis Functions (RBF) to improve compatibility with continual learning. Replacing linear classifiers with KAC in several recent methods yields consistent improvements across continual learning benchmarks.
2503.21076|v2.assessment: 将KAN引入持续学习分类器并做RBF适配，作为即插即用组件有一定通用性。
2503.21076|v2.contribution: 提出基于KAN结构的Kolmogorov-Arnold分类器（KAC）用于持续学习。
2503.21076|v2.innovation: 引入RBF改进KAN样条函数以适配持续学习，替换线性分类器。
2503.21076|v2.result: 在多个持续学习基准上替换线性分类器后均取得性能提升。

2503.18371|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文借鉴艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线理论，提出 view-batch 模型来调整学习调度，优化同一批样本重训练的回忆间隔。方法包含两个具体实现：保证最优回忆间隔的回放策略，以及一种自监督学习方式，使网络在足够长的间隔后重新学习同一批数据。相比传统回放方法，该工作从认知科学角度重新设计了重放时序，强调'充分休息'对记忆巩固的作用，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2503.18371|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by drawing on Ebbinghaus' forgetting curve theory. It introduces a view-batch model that adjusts learning schedules to optimize the recall interval between retraining the same samples, implemented via a replay method guaranteeing optimal recall intervals and a self-supervised learning approach. The key idea is to let the network 'rest' sufficiently before re-exposing it to the same data, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2503.18371|v2.assessment: 将认知科学中的遗忘曲线引入持续学习调度设计，视角新颖，但摘要缺乏实验数据支撑，实际效果有待验证。
2503.18371|v2.contribution: 提出基于遗忘曲线理论的 view-batch 学习调度模型用于持续学习。
2503.18371|v2.innovation: 用回忆间隔和'休息'概念重新设计回放时序，结合自监督学习。
2503.18371|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，效果需参考正文实验。

2503.18985|v2.summary_cn: 针对无样本持续学习（EFCL）中特征漂移导致的灾难性遗忘，本文提出 Drift-Resistant Space（DRS），无需显式特征建模或存储旧任务样本即可应对特征漂移。核心方法是 LoRA Subtraction（LoRA-），一种参数高效微调技术：在处理新任务前，从预训练初始权重中减去旧任务的 LoRA 权重以构建 DRS。相比依赖静态特征或过时统计量的现有方法，LoRA- 能捕捉特征空间的动态演化，提升稳定性与效率并简化实现。
2503.18985|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles feature drift in exemplar-free continual learning (EFCL) by proposing Drift-Resistant Space (DRS), which handles drift without explicit feature modeling or storing previous-task samples. The key technique, Low-Rank Adaptation Subtraction (LoRA-), subtracts old-task LoRA weights from the initial pre-trained weights before processing new tasks to construct the DRS. Unlike prior methods relying on static features or outdated statistics, LoRA- captures the dynamic evolution of the feature space, improving stability and efficiency.
2503.18985|v2.assessment: 将 LoRA 减法用于构建抗漂移特征空间，思路简洁且参数高效，对 EFCL 场景有较强实用价值。
2503.18985|v2.contribution: 提出 LoRA Subtraction 构建抗漂移空间以解决无样本持续学习中的特征漂移。
2503.18985|v2.innovation: 通过从预训练权重中减去旧任务 LoRA 权重来动态构建抗漂移特征空间。
2503.18985|v2.result: 摘要称其提升了稳定性与效率并简化实现，具体数值需见正文。

2412.18177|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习（OCL）中现有回放方法忽视模型适应性问题，本文提出即插即用模块 S6MOD，可集成到多数现有方法中直接提升适应性。S6MOD 在骨干网络后增加一个分支，通过离散化混合（mixture of discretization）选择性调整选择性状态空间模型中的参数，丰富选择性扫描模式；并设计类条件路由算法进行基于不确定性的动态调整，配合对比离散化损失优化。实验表明该模块显著增强模型适应性。
2412.18177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked adaptability of models in online continual learning (OCL), where existing replay-based methods focus mainly on memory retention. It proposes S6MOD, a plug-and-play module that adds a branch after the backbone, using a mixture of discretization to selectively adjust parameters in a selective state space model. A class-conditional routing algorithm and contrastive discretization loss further optimize it, and experiments show significant adaptability gains when combined with various models.
2412.18177|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型引入在线持续学习并设计即插即用模块，通用性较好，但摘要未给出具体提升幅度。
2412.18177|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的 S6MOD 模块以提升在线持续学习模型的适应性。
2412.18177|v2.innovation: 用离散化混合与类条件路由增强选择性状态空间模型的自适应扫描模式。
2412.18177|v2.result: 实验显示该模块显著提升模型适应性，具体数值需见正文。

Handling Spatial-Temporal Data Heterogen.summary_cn: 本文关注联邦持续学习中的时空数据异构性问题，提出 Tail Anchor 方法。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点与实验数据。仅从标题可判断其试图在联邦学习框架下处理客户端间数据分布随时间与空间变化的挑战。
Handling Spatial-Temporal Data Heterogen.summary_en: This paper targets spatial-temporal data heterogeneity in federated continual learning and proposes a Tail Anchor approach. As the abstract is empty, specific methodology, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed; only the title indicates an attempt to handle client data distribution shifts across space and time under federated learning.

2503.12053|v2.summary_cn: 针对高频数据流下内存约束多变的在线持续学习场景，本文提出 Ferret 框架，旨在提升在线准确率并动态适应内存预算。Ferret 采用细粒度流水线并行策略结合迭代梯度补偿算法，以低延迟处理高频数据并缓解并行训练中的陈旧梯度问题；同时通过自动化模型划分与流水线规划适应不同内存预算。在 20 个基准和 5 种 OCL 算法上实验，达到相同在线准确率时内存开销最多降低 3.7 倍，并在多种内存预算下持续优于对比方法。
2503.12053|v2.summary_en: This paper presents Ferret, a framework for online continual learning (OCL) under varying memory constraints in high-frequency data streams. Ferret combines fine-grained pipeline parallelism with an iterative gradient compensation algorithm to handle high-frequency data with minimal latency and mitigate stale gradients, while automated model partitioning and pipeline planning adapt to memory budgets. Experiments across 20 benchmarks and 5 OCL algorithms show up to 3.7x lower memory overhead for the same online accuracy and consistent superiority across memory budgets.
2503.12053|v2.assessment: 系统层面工作扎实，实验规模大且指标明确，对实时在线持续学习的工程落地有较高参考价值。
2503.12053|v2.contribution: 提出适应多变内存约束的高效在线持续学习框架 Ferret。
2503.12053|v2.innovation: 细粒度流水线并行结合迭代梯度补偿，并自动化模型划分与流水线规划。
2503.12053|v2.result: 达到相同在线准确率时内存开销最多降低 3.7 倍，并在多种内存预算下优于对比方法。

BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.summary_cn: 本文提出 BiLoRA，旨在为持续学习构建近似正交的参数空间以缓解灾难性遗忘。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点与实验数据。仅从标题可推测其利用双 LoRA 或双向低秩适配构造近似正交的参数子空间，从而减少任务间干扰。
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.summary_en: This paper proposes BiLoRA to construct almost-orthogonal parameter spaces for continual learning, presumably to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. As the abstract is empty, the specific methodology, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed; the title suggests the use of dual or bidirectional LoRA to build near-orthogonal parameter subspaces reducing inter-task interference.
BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.assessment: 正交参数空间是持续学习的热点方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法质量与实际效果。

BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac.innovation: 摘要缺失，创新点无法确认，推测为基于 LoRA 的正交参数子空间构造。

BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spac._arxiv_id: BiLoRA: Almost-Orthogonal Parameter Spaces for Continual Learning.

Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频类增量学习（Video Class-Incremental Learning）中时空表征随任务更新而漂移、旧类别易被遗忘的问题，提出学习条件化的时空提示分布（Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions）。方法通过为不同任务/类别生成条件化的时空 prompt 分布，替代固定 prompt，从而在冻结主干的前提下适配新任务并保留旧知识。相比已有 prompt-based 增量方法，其改进在于将 prompt 从静态参数扩展为条件分布，更好匹配视频中动态的时空模式。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文确认增益幅度。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in video class-incremental learning, where spatio-temporal representations drift as new tasks arrive. It proposes learning conditional space-time prompt distributions that adapt a frozen backbone to each task while preserving prior knowledge. The key advance over static prompt-based incremental methods is modeling prompts as conditional distributions to better capture dynamic spatio-temporal patterns in video. Quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.assessment: 将 prompt 学习从静态参数推广到条件分布，思路对视频增量学习较自然，但摘要信息量有限，需看实验验证其相对 SOTA 的实际增益。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.contribution: 提出条件化时空提示分布用于视频类增量学习。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.innovation: 把增量学习的 prompt 从固定向量扩展为随任务/类别条件的时空分布。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与量化指标。
Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt D._arxiv_id: Learning Conditional Space-Time Prompt Distributions for Video Class-Incremental Learning.

Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于预训练模型的域增量学习（Domain-Incremental Learning）中跨域知识难以兼顾保持与迁移的问题，提出双重巩固（Dual Consolidation）框架。方法通过两条互补的巩固路径（如参数层面与表征层面）在持续适配新域的同时抑制对旧域的遗忘。相比已有基于预训练模型的增量方法，其改进在于同时约束模型参数与特征分布两个维度。摘要未给出具体数值，需正文确认在 DomainNet 等基准上的表现。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.summary_en: This paper targets domain-incremental learning built on pre-trained models, where knowledge must be both retained across domains and transferred to new ones. It proposes a Dual Consolidation framework that consolidates knowledge along two complementary dimensions, e.g., parameters and representations, to mitigate forgetting while adapting to new domains. The advance lies in jointly regularizing both model parameters and feature distributions, though quantitative results are absent from the abstract.
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.assessment: 预训练模型 + 域增量的组合是当前热点，双重巩固的设计合理，但需实验数据支撑其有效性。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.contribution: 提出面向预训练模型域增量学习的双重巩固框架。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.innovation: 从参数与表征两个层面同时进行知识巩固以缓解跨域遗忘。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model._arxiv_id: Dual Consolidation for Pre-Trained Model-Based Domain-Incremental Learning.

2503.17677|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中基于原型的方法表征能力不足、特征重叠严重导致类别混淆的问题，提出 Confusion-REduced AuTo-Encoder 分类器（CREATE）。方法为每个类学习一个轻量自编码器，在隐子空间中构建紧凑流形，使样本仅在语义正确的自编码器上重建良好，并引入混淆感知的隐空间分离损失，拉近同类低维流形分布、推远异类特征分布。相比原型类方法，其改进在于用类专属流形替代单点原型，增强表征稳定性并缓解重叠。摘要未给出具体精度数值。
2503.17677|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles class-wise confusion in class-incremental learning caused by limited representation capacity and overlapping features in prototype-based methods. It proposes CREATE, which learns a compact latent manifold per class via a lightweight auto-encoder so that samples reconstruct well only on the semantically correct auto-encoder, plus a confusion-aware latent space separation loss that pulls same-class features together and pushes others apart. The advance over prototype methods is replacing point prototypes with class-specific manifolds. Numerical results are not given in the abstract.
2503.17677|v2.assessment: 用类专属自编码器流形替代原型是较有新意的思路，混淆感知分离损失设计合理，值得关注其在标准 CIL 基准上的表现。
2503.17677|v2.contribution: 提出基于类专属自编码器流形与混淆感知分离损失的 CIL 分类器 CREATE。
2503.17677|v2.innovation: 以紧凑类流形替代点原型，并用混淆感知损失显式分离重叠特征。
2503.17677|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体精度提升数值。

Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）中新类样本极少导致的多模态表征偏置问题，提出免训练的双层模态校准（Training-Free Bi-Level Modality Calibration）。方法在不额外训练的前提下，从模态层面与层级层面对预训练多模态模型的表征进行校准，缓解新类与基类之间的分布偏移。相比需要微调或额外训练数据的 FSCIL 方法，其改进在于完全免训练、即插即用。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.summary_en: This paper addresses representation bias in few-shot class-incremental learning, where extremely few novel-class samples cause modality-level misalignment. It proposes a training-free bi-level modality calibration that adjusts pre-trained multimodal representations at both modality and hierarchical levels without additional training. The key advantage over existing FSCIL methods is being plug-and-play and requiring no fine-tuning, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.assessment: 免训练校准在 FSCIL 中实用性强，若在多模态基准上确有稳定增益则值得跟进。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.contribution: 提出免训练的双层模态校准方法用于小样本类增量学习。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.innovation: 在不训练的前提下从模态与层级两个层面校准预训练多模态表征。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Lea._arxiv_id: Enhancing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning via Training-Free Bi-Level Modality Calibration.

2412.18219|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中灾难性遗忘与可扩展性难以兼顾、现有方法在推理时间与精度间被迫折衷的问题，提出 ACMap 框架。方法将各任务专属 adapter 合并为单一 adapter，构建共享子空间以对齐任务表征并缓解遗忘，同时用质心原型映射在共享子空间内持续适配表征以保持精度，并引入早停策略限制任务增多时的 adapter 合并规模。相比已有方法，ACMap 在五个基准数据集上达到与 SOTA 相当的精度，同时推理时间与最快方法相当，实现跨任务恒定推理开销。
2412.18219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between inference time and accuracy in exemplar-free class-incremental learning. It proposes ACMap, which merges task-specific adapters into a single adapter to form a shared subspace that aligns task representations and mitigates forgetting, while centroid prototype mapping maintains accuracy within that subspace; an early-stopping strategy bounds adapter merging as tasks grow. On five benchmark datasets ACMap matches state-of-the-art accuracy while keeping inference time comparable to the fastest existing methods, achieving constant inference cost across tasks.
2412.18219|v2.assessment: 同时解决遗忘与可扩展性且给出恒定推理时间，实验覆盖五个基准，工程与学术价值兼具，值得关注。
2412.18219|v2.contribution: 提出免样本的 adapter 合并加质心原型映射框架 ACMap。
2412.18219|v2.innovation: 将多任务 adapter 合并为单一共享子空间 adapter，并用早停控制合并规模以实现恒定推理时间。
2412.18219|v2.result: 在五个基准数据集上精度与 SOTA 相当，推理时间与最快方法相当。

Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于预训练模型的类增量学习（PTM-based CIL）中知识难以有效保留与复用的问题，提出知识记忆与反刍（Knowledge Memorization and Rumination）机制。方法通过显式记忆历史任务知识并在后续任务中反复调用（反刍）来强化旧类表征，缓解遗忘。相比仅依赖 prompt 或 adapter 的 PTM 增量方法，其改进在于引入类似人类记忆巩固的记忆-反刍循环。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.summary_en: This paper targets pre-trained model-based class-incremental learning, where previously acquired knowledge is hard to retain and reuse. It proposes a Knowledge Memorization and Rumination mechanism that explicitly stores past-task knowledge and repeatedly revisits it in later tasks to reinforce old-class representations and reduce forgetting. The advance over prompt- or adapter-only PTM methods is a memory-consolidation-style memorize-and-ruminate loop, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.assessment: 记忆-反刍的类比有启发性，但需实验证明其相对现有 PTM 增量方法的实际优势。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.contribution: 提出知识记忆与反刍机制用于预训练模型类增量学习。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.innovation: 引入记忆巩固式的记忆-反刍循环以复用历史任务知识。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Knowledge Memorization and Rumination fo._arxiv_id: Knowledge Memorization and Rumination for Pre-trained Model-based Class-Incremental Learning.

2503.22163|v2.summary_cn: 本文研究类增量学习中的模型置信度校准问题，现有工作主要关注准确率而忽视了校准置信度，且大多数事后校准方法依赖旧任务的验证集，这在类增量学习中因内存有限而不可行。作者提出T-CIL，一种无需旧任务验证集的温度缩放方法，利用记忆中的样本进行对抗扰动，通过基于特征距离调整扰动方向使旧任务扰动强于新任务，并用新任务验证集确定单一扰动幅度。该方法使从新任务计算的扰动幅度也适用于旧任务，利用了旧任务准确率低于新任务的趋势。
2503.22163|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses model confidence calibration in class-incremental learning, where maintaining calibrated confidence has been largely overlooked. The authors propose T-CIL, a temperature scaling approach that leverages adversarially perturbed exemplars from memory without requiring a validation set for old tasks. By adjusting perturbation direction based on feature distance, the method makes the perturbation magnitude computed from the new task applicable to old tasks, exploiting the tendency that old-task accuracy is lower than that of the new task.
2503.22163|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了类增量学习中置信度校准的空白，提出的无验证集温度缩放策略具有实际意义，但整体影响力受限于领域交叉性。
2503.22163|v2.contribution: 提出了首个无需旧任务验证集的类增量学习温度缩放校准方法T-CIL。
2503.22163|v2.innovation: 利用对抗扰动和特征距离调整，使新任务验证集确定的扰动幅度可迁移至旧任务。
2503.22163|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称有效解决了旧任务验证集不可用时的校准问题。

2502.20032|v2.summary_cn: 类增量学习（CIL）中模型对类别到达顺序高度敏感，尤其当顺序引入的类别间相似度高时，现有方法虽缓解了灾难性遗忘但未解决顺序敏感性问题。本文通过理论分析证明，在增量阶段将低成对相似度的类别分组可显著提高模型对顺序变化的鲁棒性，并据此提出GDDSG方法，利用图着色算法动态将类别划分为相似度约束的组，每组训练独立的CIL子模型并构建元特征进行组识别。实验表明该方法有效解决了类别顺序敏感性问题，在模型准确率和抗遗忘方面均达到最优性能。
2502.20032|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the understudied challenge of class order sensitivity in class-incremental learning, particularly when sequentially introduced classes exhibit high inter-class similarity. The authors theoretically prove that grouping classes with lower pairwise similarity improves robustness to order variations, and propose GDDSG, which employs graph coloring to dynamically partition classes into similarity-constrained groups, training isolated CIL sub-models per group. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness in addressing order sensitivity while achieving optimal accuracy and anti-forgetting performance.
2502.20032|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地研究并解决了CIL中的类别顺序敏感性问题，理论分析与方法设计结合紧密，对提升CIL实际部署鲁棒性有重要价值。
2502.20032|v2.contribution: 揭示了类别顺序敏感性问题，并提出基于图着色动态相似度分组的GDDSG方法。
2502.20032|v2.innovation: 利用图着色算法动态划分相似度约束的类别组，每组训练独立子模型以增强顺序鲁棒性。
2502.20032|v2.result: 实验表明GDDSG在准确率和抗遗忘指标上均达到最优，有效缓解了顺序敏感性问题。

2506.15720|v2.summary_cn: 小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中模型需用少量样本持续学习新概念，但大幅更新易导致对旧概念的遗忘和对新样本的过拟合。现有方法通常将表示学习与分类头解耦，固定基类上训练好的特征提取器，但这限制了模型对新类的适应性。本文提出三方权重空间集成（Tri-WE）方法，在权重空间中对基模型、前一模型和当前模型进行插值，特别是对分类头，从而协同维护基类和前序模型的知识，并解决了从先前模型蒸馏泛化表示的挑战。
2506.15720|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and overfitting in few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), where fixed feature extractors restrict adaptability to new classes. The authors propose Tripartite Weight-Space Ensemble (Tri-WE), which interpolates the base, immediately previous, and current models in weight space, especially for classification heads, to collaboratively maintain knowledge from base and previous models. The method enables seamless updates of the entire model with few examples.
2506.15720|v2.assessment: 该工作挑战了FSCIL中固定特征提取器的常见范式，提出的权重空间集成策略简单有效，为小样本增量学习提供了新思路。
2506.15720|v2.contribution: 提出了三方权重空间集成（Tri-WE）方法，实现FSCIL中全模型的无缝更新。
2506.15720|v2.innovation: 在权重空间中对基、前序和当前模型进行插值，协同保持旧知识并适应新类。
2506.15720|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称有效解决了灾难性遗忘和过拟合问题。

2409.14983|v2.summary_cn: 无样本类增量学习（NECIL）中模型需在不存储旧任务样本的情况下持续学习新类，但旧任务数据缺失加剧了灾难性遗忘。本文提出DIA框架，包含任务特定适配器集成（TSAI）和块级模型对齐两个组件。TSAI通过块级适配器集成策略提升组合性，保持低计算成本；块级模型对齐通过块级蒸馏损失（PDL）和块级特征重建（PFR）维持特征一致性和准确决策边界，其中PDL基于块令牌对新类学习的贡献实现蒸馏，PFR从先前模型重建旧类特征以对齐分类器。
2409.14983|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in non-exemplar class incremental learning (NECIL) without storing old task data. The authors propose DIA, comprising Task-Specific Adapter Integration (TSAI) and Patch-Level Model Alignment. TSAI uses patch-level adapter integration for flexible compositionality at low cost, while Patch-Level Model Alignment employs a distillation loss based on patch token contributions and a feature reconstruction method to maintain feature consistency and accurate decision boundaries.
2409.14983|v2.assessment: 该工作针对NECIL中数据缺失的痛点，提出了细粒度的适配器集成与块级对齐机制，方法设计合理且兼顾效率，对隐私敏感场景下的增量学习有参考价值。
2409.14983|v2.contribution: 提出了DIA框架，通过任务特定适配器动态集成和块级模型对齐解决NECIL中的灾难性遗忘。
2409.14983|v2.innovation: 块级适配器集成策略与基于块令牌贡献的蒸馏损失及特征重建方法相结合。
2409.14983|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称在无旧样本条件下有效缓解了灾难性遗忘。

2106.10456|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签质量不足的问题，本文在teacher-student框架下提出改进方法：采用指数移动平均在线更新teacher，使用大量region proposals和软伪标签作为student训练目标，并设计轻量级检测专用数据集成以生成更可靠的伪标签。相比STAC使用稀疏硬伪标签，本方法让teacher通过软标签向student传递更丰富的信息。在VOC07 val上达到53.04% AP，比STAC高8.4%；在MS-COCO test-dev上以3.1%增益超过全监督ResNet-152 Cascaded R-CNN，达到53.8% AP。
2106.10456|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised object detection by improving pseudo-label quality within a teacher-student framework. It employs exponential moving averaging for online teacher updates, leverages abundant region proposals with soft pseudo-labels as student targets, and introduces a lightweight detection-specific data ensemble for more reliable pseudo-label generation. Compared to STAC which uses sparse hard pseudo-labels, the proposed method achieves 53.04% AP on VOC07 val (8.4% better than STAC) and 53.8% AP on MS-COCO test-dev, surpassing the fully supervised ResNet-152 Cascaded R-CNN by 3.1%.
2106.10456|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地改进了半监督检测中伪标签的利用方式，软标签与数据集成策略实用有效，在多个基准上取得显著提升，对半监督检测研究有较强参考价值。
2106.10456|v2.contribution: 提出基于软伪标签和检测专用数据集的teacher-student半监督目标检测框架。
2106.10456|v2.innovation: 用大量proposals上的软伪标签替代稀疏硬伪标签，并引入轻量级检测专用数据集成提升伪标签可靠性。
2106.10456|v2.result: VOC07 val达53.04% AP（超STAC 8.4%），MS-COCO test-dev达53.8% AP（超全监督基线3.1%）。

2107.04384|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度网络持续学习中灾难性遗忘的理论机制不清晰的问题，本文将teacher-student分析框架从单teacher扩展到多teacher，每个teacher代表一个不同任务，研究任务间关系如何影响遗忘与迁移。研究发现特征相似性只是任务关联的一种方式，通过解耦readout层（隐层到输出权重）和特征层（输入到隐层权重）的相似性，揭示了不同层面的任务相似度对遗忘的差异化影响，并发现中等任务相似度导致最大遗忘。
2107.04384|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates continual learning in the teacher-student setup to understand catastrophic forgetting theoretically. By extending two-layer network analysis to multiple teachers, each representing a distinct task, it disentangles task similarity at the readout (hidden-to-output) and feature (input-to-hidden) levels. The study finds that intermediate task similarity leads to greatest forgetting, and that feature similarity is only one dimension of task relatedness affecting transfer and interference.
2107.04384|v2.assessment: 该工作为持续学习中的任务干扰提供了理论视角，多teacher框架有助于解耦不同层面的任务相似性，但偏理论分析，对实际检测系统的直接指导有限。
2107.04384|v2.contribution: 将teacher-student持续学习分析扩展到多teacher设定，解耦readout与特征层面的任务相似性对遗忘的影响。
2107.04384|v2.innovation: 通过多teacher框架分离任务在readout层和特征层的相似性，揭示中等相似度导致最大遗忘的机制。
2107.04384|v2.result: 发现特征相似性仅为任务关联的一个维度，不同层面相似度对遗忘和迁移有差异化影响。

2110.12724|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中不同位置特征对检测目标贡献不同、导致蒸馏难以平衡的问题，本文提出条件蒸馏框架，引入可学习的条件解码模块，以每个目标实例为query检索teacher表示作为key，通过注意力机制衡量不同特征的贡献，并由定位-识别敏感的辅助任务引导。实验表明，该方法将ResNet-50 RetinaNet从37.4 mAP提升至40.7 mAP（+3.3），在1x schedule下甚至超过ResNet-101 teacher在3x schedule下的40.4 mAP。
2110.12724|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of knowledge distillation for object detection, where representations at different locations contribute unequally to detection targets. It proposes a conditional distillation framework with a learnable conditional decoding module that uses each target instance as a query to retrieve teacher representations as keys, with attention measuring feature contributions guided by a localization-recognition-sensitive auxiliary task. The method boosts RetinaNet with ResNet-50 from 37.4 to 40.7 mAP (+3.3), surpassing the ResNet-101 teacher's 40.4 mAP.
2110.12724|v2.assessment: 该工作针对检测蒸馏中特征贡献不均衡的核心问题提出了优雅的实例条件注意力方案，提升幅度显著且超越teacher，对检测蒸馏研究有重要参考价值。
2110.12724|v2.contribution: 提出实例条件知识蒸馏框架，通过可学习条件解码模块实现实例级知识检索与贡献度量。
2110.12724|v2.innovation: 以目标实例为query、teacher表示为key的注意力机制，配合定位-识别敏感辅助任务引导蒸馏。
2110.12724|v2.result: RetinaNet ResNet-50从37.4提升至40.7 mAP（+3.3），超越ResNet-101 teacher的40.4 mAP。

2201.10207|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对语音预训练中训练成本高和噪声鲁棒性差的问题，提出了SPIRAL方法，在教师-学生框架下学习扰动数据的去噪表示，通过话语内对比损失和位置随机化防止表示坍缩。相比wav2vec 2.0，SPIRAL在BASE和LARGE模型上分别减少80%和65%的训练成本，并达到竞争性或更好的结果。此外，通过多条件预训练（添加多种噪声）提升了噪声鲁棒性。
2201.10207|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and noise robustness issues in speech pre-training by proposing SPIRAL, a teacher-student framework that learns denoising representations of perturbed data with in-utterance contrastive loss and position randomization to prevent collapse. Compared to wav2vec 2.0, SPIRAL reduces training cost by 80% (BASE) and 65% (LARGE) while achieving competitive or better results. Multi-condition pre-training with additive noise further improves noise robustness.
2201.10207|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶视觉感知领域无关，属于语音预训练方向，不建议关注。
2201.10207|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于教师-学生框架和对比学习的语音预训练方法SPIRAL，显著降低了训练成本并提升了噪声鲁棒性。
2201.10207|v2.innovation: 结合话语内对比损失和位置随机化防止表示坍缩，并引入多条件预训练增强噪声鲁棒性。
2201.10207|v2.result: 在BASE和LARGE模型上分别减少80%和65%训练成本，达到与wav2vec 2.0竞争或更好的性能。

2205.15156|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中高级检测器计算开销大的问题，探索知识蒸馏（KD）在高效3D检测器中的应用，聚焦于pillar和voxel基检测器。作者首先从模型压缩和输入分辨率降低角度获得学生模型，然后在Waymo数据集上构建基准评估现有2D KD方法，并提出改进的KD流程：增强的logit KD（仅在教师分类响应的关键位置进行蒸馏）和教师引导学生模型初始化。最佳模型达到65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH，超越教师模型且仅需44%的计算量。
2205.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation overhead of advanced 3D object detectors by exploring knowledge distillation (KD) for efficient pillar- and voxel-based detectors. It first obtains student models via model compression and input resolution reduction, then benchmarks existing 2D KD methods on Waymo and proposes an improved KD pipeline with enhanced logit KD on pivotal positions and teacher-guided initialization. The best model achieves 65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH, surpassing its teacher while requiring only 44% of the computation.
2205.15156|v2.assessment: 该工作系统地将知识蒸馏引入3D检测，提出了有效的改进策略，并在Waymo上验证了其优越性，对自动驾驶感知中的高效部署有重要参考价值。
2205.15156|v2.contribution: 构建了3D检测的知识蒸馏基准，并提出了改进的KD流程，包括关键位置logit蒸馏和教师引导初始化。
2205.15156|v2.innovation: 针对3D检测特点，在关键位置进行logit蒸馏并利用教师权重初始化学生模型，有效传递特征提取能力。
2205.15156|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上达到65.75% LEVEL 2 mAPH，超越教师模型且仅需44%计算量。

2210.04208|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云分析中单一模态表示学习的瓶颈，提出点云跨模态训练（PointCMT）策略，利用视图图像（渲染或投影的2D图像）通过教师-学生框架和知识蒸馏来增强点云分析。PointCMT通过新颖的特征和分类器增强准则消除模态分布差异，避免负迁移，且无需修改网络架构。实验表明，在多个数据集和主流骨干网络上，PointCMT显著提升了点云表示性能。
2210.04208|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the bottleneck of single-modality representation learning in point cloud analysis by proposing PointCMT, a cross-modal training strategy that leverages view images via a teacher-student framework and knowledge distillation. PointCMT eliminates modality discrepancy through feature and classifier enhancement criteria, avoiding negative transfer without architecture modification. Experiments show significant gains on various datasets and backbones.
2210.04208|v2.assessment: 该工作为点云分析提供了跨模态训练思路，虽与自动驾驶3D检测相关但更偏向通用形状分析，对多模态感知有一定启发。
2210.04208|v2.contribution: 提出了PointCMT策略，利用视图图像通过知识蒸馏增强点云表示，无需修改网络架构。
2210.04208|v2.innovation: 通过特征和分类器增强准则消除模态分布差异，有效避免负迁移。
2210.04208|v2.result: 在多个数据集和主流骨干网络上显著提升了点云分析性能。

2208.12262|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言对比预训练（如CLIP）主要关注全局文本相关表示、缺乏局部patch级语义监督的问题，本文提出MaskCLIP框架，将掩码自蒸馏（从完整图像蒸馏表示到掩码图像预测的表示）融入对比语言-图像预训练。掩码自蒸馏聚焦局部patch表示学习，与视觉-语言对比互补，且训练目标一致（均用视觉编码器做特征对齐），从而借助语言间接监督学习局部语义；同时对称地在文本分支引入局部语义监督。在多种下游任务上，MaskCLIP在线性探测、微调等设置下均取得优于CLIP等基线，验证了局部语义监督的有效性。
2208.12262|v2.summary_en: MaskCLIP incorporates masked self-distillation into contrastive language-image pretraining, distilling representations from a full image to those predicted from a masked image. This targets local patch representation learning complementary to vision-language contrastive learning, and symmetrically introduces local semantic supervision into the text branch. Extensive experiments show superior results on linear probing and fine-tuning across various downstream tasks.
2208.12262|v2.assessment: 将掩码自蒸馏与CLIP式对比学习结合，思路简洁有效，为视觉-语言预训练引入局部语义监督提供了新范式，对多模态与自监督视觉研究者有参考价值。
2208.12262|v2.contribution: 提出MaskCLIP框架，将掩码自蒸馏融入对比语言-图像预训练以学习局部语义。
2208.12262|v2.innovation: 利用掩码自蒸馏与视觉-语言对比在训练目标上的一致性，实现语言间接监督下的局部patch表示学习，并对称扩展到文本分支。
2208.12262|v2.result: 在线性探测、微调等多种下游任务上取得优于CLIP等基线的性能。

2302.14250|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱增量语义分割（WILSS）中仅用图像级标签难以定位新类、且易遗忘旧类的问题，本文提出数据高效的FMWISS框架。该方法通过预训练协同分割蒸馏互补基础模型的知识以生成密集伪标签，再用教师-学生架构优化含噪伪掩码（教师用密集对比损失优化），并引入基于记忆的复制粘贴增强以缓解灾难性遗忘。相比已有WILSS方法，FMWISS在图像级监督下显著提升了新类分割精度并保持旧类性能。
2302.14250|v2.summary_en: FMWISS addresses weakly incremental learning for semantic segmentation (WILSS), where image-level labels lack localization details and cause forgetting. It distills complementary foundation models via pre-training based co-segmentation to generate dense pseudo labels, optimizes noisy masks with a teacher-student architecture and dense contrastive loss, and uses memory-based copy-paste augmentation to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. It improves new-class segmentation under image-level supervision while preserving old-class performance.
2302.14250|v2.assessment: 将基础模型知识蒸馏与增量学习结合，为弱监督增量分割提供了数据高效方案，对持续学习与分割研究者有启发。
2302.14250|v2.contribution: 提出FMWISS框架，利用基础模型蒸馏与教师-学生架构实现弱增量语义分割。
2302.14250|v2.innovation: 通过预训练协同分割蒸馏互补基础模型生成密集伪标签，并用密集对比损失与记忆复制粘贴增强优化。
2302.14250|v2.result: 在图像级标签下提升新类分割精度并缓解旧类遗忘。

2311.13930|v2.summary_cn: 针对无源域目标检测（SFOD）中主流均值教师（MT）框架仅用单一教师、在域偏移下教师崩溃导致学生性能骤降的训练不稳定问题，本文提出周期交换教师-学生（PETS）方法。PETS引入由静态教师、动态教师和学生组成的多教师框架：训练中周期性地交换静态教师与学生权重，动态教师则用已交换学生的移动平均更新，从而整合历史知识、减少误差累积。实验表明PETS在SFOD基准上稳定了训练并提升了适应性能。
2311.13930|v2.summary_en: PETS tackles training instability in source-free object detection (SFOD), where a single mean-teacher can collapse under domain shift and degrade the student. It introduces a multiple-teacher framework with a static teacher, a dynamic teacher, and a student, periodically exchanging weights between the static teacher and student while updating the dynamic teacher via moving average. This integrates past knowledge, reduces error accumulation, and stabilizes MT-based training, improving adaptation performance.
2311.13930|v2.assessment: 针对SFOD中均值教师不稳定问题提出简洁的多教师交换机制，实用性强，对域适应检测研究者有参考价值。
2311.13930|v2.contribution: 提出PETS方法，通过周期交换教师-学生权重构建多教师框架以稳定SFOD训练。
2311.13930|v2.innovation: 引入静态教师、动态教师与学生的多教师结构，并周期性交换静态教师与学生权重以整合历史知识。
2311.13930|v2.result: 在SFOD基准上有效减少误差累积、稳定训练并提升适应性能。

Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.summary_cn: 本文针对域自适应目标检测（DAOD）中教师-学生框架的伪标签噪声与域偏移问题，提出掩码重训练教师-学生框架（Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framework）。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题推断其通过掩码重训练策略增强教师-学生自训练的鲁棒性，以提升跨域检测性能。该工作属于DAOD中自训练范式改进方向，对域适应检测研究者有参考意义。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.summary_en: This paper targets domain adaptive object detection (DAOD) and proposes a Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framework to improve the robustness of teacher-student self-training under domain shift. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details cannot be confirmed, but the work falls into the line of improving self-training paradigms for cross-domain detection.
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.assessment: 属于DAOD自训练改进方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估具体方法与实验，信息不足。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.contribution: 提出掩码重训练教师-学生框架用于域自适应目标检测。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.innovation: 通过掩码重训练策略增强教师-学生自训练的鲁棒性（基于标题推断）。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framew._arxiv_id: Masked Retraining Teacher-Student Framework for Domain Adaptive Object Detection.

2308.00398|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端自动驾驶中教师-学生范式下学生模型仍需从零学习规划头、受原始传感器输入冗余噪声与行为克隆因果混淆困扰的问题，本文提出DriveAdapter，探索直接采用强教师模型进行规划、让学生模型专注感知的可能性。方法通过适配器解耦感知与规划，使学生专注于感知特征学习，从而打破感知与规划的耦合壁垒。实验表明该方法在保持甚至提升规划性能的同时显著降低了对学生规划头学习的依赖，提升了端到端驾驶的鲁棒性与数据效率。
2308.00398|v2.summary_en: DriveAdapter addresses the coupling barrier between perception and planning in end-to-end autonomous driving, where the student model must still learn a planning head from scratch under the teacher-student paradigm. It explores directly adopting the strong teacher for planning while letting the student focus on perception via adapters, decoupling the two components. Experiments show improved planning performance and robustness with better data efficiency.
2308.00398|v2.assessment: 直击端到端自动驾驶中感知-规划耦合的核心痛点，思路新颖且对自动驾驶感知研究者高度相关。
2308.00398|v2.contribution: 提出DriveAdapter，通过适配器解耦感知与规划，让学生模型专注感知而由教师负责规划。
2308.00398|v2.innovation: 打破教师-学生范式中学生需从零学习规划头的限制，直接复用强教师规划能力。
2308.00398|v2.result: 在端到端驾驶基准上提升规划性能与鲁棒性，并改善数据效率。

TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.summary_cn: 针对在线签名验证（OSV）任务，本文提出TSOSVNet，采用教师-学生协同知识蒸馏框架。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题推断其通过教师与学生网络协同蒸馏提升签名验证的准确性与鲁棒性。该工作属于知识蒸馏在生物特征验证中的应用，与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.summary_en: TSOSVNet proposes a teacher-student collaborative knowledge distillation framework for online signature verification (OSV). Due to the missing abstract, specific details cannot be confirmed, but the work applies knowledge distillation to biometric verification, which is of limited relevance to autonomous driving perception.
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.assessment: 知识蒸馏在签名验证中的应用，与自动驾驶感知领域相关度低，摘要缺失导致难以评估。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.contribution: 提出TSOSVNet教师-学生协同知识蒸馏框架用于在线签名验证。
TSOSVNet: Teacher-student collaborative.innovation: 将协同知识蒸馏应用于在线签名验证任务（基于标题推断）。
