2506.07087|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无监督伪装目标检测（UCOD）中伪标签噪声大、简单1x1卷积解码器难以捕捉伪装目标（尤其是小目标）语义特征的问题，提出了基于动态伪标签学习的教师-学生框架UCOD-DPL。方法包含自适应伪标签模块（APM）、双分支对抗解码器（DBA）和Look-Twice机制：APM自适应融合固定策略与教师模型生成的伪标签以避免过拟合噪声并保留自校正能力，DBA解码器增强对伪装目标语义的捕捉。相比已有固定伪标签策略和简单解码器的UCOD方法，该工作通过动态伪标签与更强解码结构提升了检测性能，摘要中未给出具体数值结果。
2506.07087|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low performance of unsupervised camouflaged object detection (UCOD) caused by noisy pseudo-labels from fixed strategies and weak 1x1-convolution decoders that fail to capture semantic features of camouflaged objects, especially small ones. It proposes UCOD-DPL, a teacher-student framework with Dynamic Pseudo-label Learning comprising an Adaptive Pseudo-label Module (APM), a Dual-Branch Adversarial (DBA) decoder, and a Look-Twice mechanism. APM adaptively combines fixed-strategy and teacher-generated pseudo-labels to prevent overfitting to noise while preserving self-correction, and the DBA decoder improves semantic feature learning. This improves over prior UCOD methods that rely on static pseudo-labels and simple decoders, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2506.07087|v2.assessment: 该工作对无监督伪装目标检测的伪标签噪声与解码器瓶颈提出了较系统的改进思路，但领域与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限，且摘要未给出量化结果，需关注其后续实验验证。
2506.07087|v2.contribution: 提出融合自适应伪标签模块、双分支对抗解码器与Look-Twice机制的教师-学生UCOD框架。
2506.07087|v2.innovation: 通过动态融合固定策略与教师模型伪标签并引入对抗解码器，缓解伪标签噪声与简单解码器语义捕捉不足的问题。
2506.07087|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称相比已有UCOD方法性能更优。

2507.21455|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对数据集蒸馏主要集中于监督场景、而自监督表示学习所需数据规模大导致训练成本高的问题，提出自监督数据集蒸馏（Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation），将图像及其自监督训练表示蒸馏为紧凑样本集。方法引入基于不同低维基的图像与表示参数化、预定义增强和近似等新技术，以更忠实紧凑地保留原始数据集关键特性。相比已有监督数据集蒸馏工作，该方法能提取更丰富信息并提升跨架构泛化性，摘要中未给出具体数值结果。
2507.21455|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the high training cost of large datasets for self-supervised representation learning, whereas most dataset distillation works focus on supervised datasets. It proposes Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation, which distills images and their self-supervisedly trained representations into a compact set, with novel techniques including parameterization of images and representations via distinct low-dimensional bases, predefined augmentation, and approximation. Compared with prior supervised dataset distillation, it extracts richer information and yields distilled sets with enhanced cross-architecture generalizability, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
2507.21455|v2.assessment: 将数据集蒸馏扩展到自监督表示学习是一个有价值的方向，参数化与增强设计有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱，且摘要缺乏实验数据支撑。
2507.21455|v2.contribution: 提出自监督数据集蒸馏框架，将图像与自监督表示联合蒸馏为紧凑样本集。
2507.21455|v2.innovation: 通过低维基参数化、预定义增强与近似技术更忠实紧凑地保留原始数据集特性并提升跨架构泛化。
2507.21455|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称蒸馏集具有更强的跨架构泛化能力。

2410.11325|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对知识蒸馏中教师-学生知识差距导致监督KD存在训练与推理分布不匹配、on-policy KD产生低质量训练样本且教师反馈不准确的问题，提出Speculative Knowledge Distillation（SKD）。SKD让学生模型提议token，教师模型基于自身分布替换排名较差的token，从而在在线生成高质量训练数据的同时对齐学生推理时的分布，实现自适应知识迁移。在翻译、摘要、数学和指令跟随等多种文本生成任务上评估，相比监督KD与on-policy KD取得更优效果，摘要中未给出具体数值。
2410.11325|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the teacher-student knowledge gap in knowledge distillation, where supervised KD suffers from a distribution mismatch between static training data and student-generated inference outputs, and on-policy KD yields low-quality examples unfamiliar to the teacher. It proposes Speculative Knowledge Distillation (SKD), in which the student proposes tokens and the teacher replaces poorly ranked ones based on its own distribution, generating high-quality on-the-fly training data aligned with the student's inference-time distribution. Evaluated on translation, summarization, math, and instruction following, SKD outperforms supervised and on-policy KD, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2410.11325|v2.assessment: SKD将推测采样思想引入知识蒸馏，较好地平衡了分布对齐与教师反馈质量，方法设计清晰且任务覆盖广，但其应用场景为文本生成，与视觉/自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2410.11325|v2.contribution: 提出Speculative Knowledge Distillation，通过学生提议、教师替换低排名token的协作方式在线生成高质量训练数据。
2410.11325|v2.innovation: 利用师生协作的推测式采样，在保持与学生推理分布对齐的同时获得教师高质量反馈。
2410.11325|v2.result: 在翻译、摘要、数学与指令跟随等文本生成任务上优于监督KD与on-policy KD，摘要未给出具体数值。

2403.09296|v2.summary_cn: 针对预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）在连续下游任务微调时出现的灾难性遗忘和零样本能力退化问题，提出选择性双教师知识迁移框架。该方法以最近微调后的VLM和原始预训练VLM作为双教师，仅利用无标注参考数据集，通过度量双教师特征差异进行选择性知识蒸馏，从而同时保留已学知识与零样本泛化能力。相比现有持续学习方法，该框架在防止遗忘和零样本退化方面均表现更优。在基准数据集上的大量实验表明其优于当前最先进的持续学习方法。
2403.09296|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and zero-shot degradation when adapting pre-trained vision-language models to sequential downstream tasks. It proposes a Selective Dual-Teacher Knowledge Transfer framework that uses the most recent fine-tuned VLM and the original pre-trained VLM as dual teachers, performing selective knowledge distillation via feature discrepancy measurement on unlabeled reference data. Extensive experiments show it outperforms state-of-the-art continual learning approaches in preventing forgetting and preserving zero-shot capabilities.
2403.09296|v2.assessment: 将双教师选择性蒸馏引入VLM持续学习，思路清晰且实用，对多模态持续学习研究者有参考价值。
2403.09296|v2.contribution: 提出选择性双教师知识迁移框架，同时缓解VLM持续学习中的灾难性遗忘与零样本能力退化。
2403.09296|v2.innovation: 利用最近微调模型与原始预训练模型构成双教师，并基于特征差异进行选择性蒸馏。
2403.09296|v2.result: 在基准数据集上优于现有最先进持续学习方法，有效防止遗忘并保持零样本性能。

Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.summary_cn: 该论文针对数据集蒸馏中数据冗余与效率问题，提出双层数据剪枝方法以从海量数据中提炼精华。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其核心是将数据剪枝与数据集蒸馏结合，通过双层优化筛选高价值样本。整体方向对高效训练与蒸馏研究者有一定参考意义，但缺乏摘要信息难以全面评估。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.summary_en: This paper targets redundancy and inefficiency in dataset distillation by proposing a bi-level data pruning approach to distill gold from massive ores. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodology and experimental results cannot be verified. The core idea appears to combine data pruning with dataset distillation via bi-level optimization to select high-value samples.
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.assessment: 选题结合数据剪枝与数据集蒸馏，具一定新意，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与效果。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.contribution: 提出面向高效数据集蒸馏的双层数据剪枝方法。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.innovation: 将双层优化引入数据剪枝以提升数据集蒸馏效率。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level._arxiv_id: Distill Gold from Massive Ores: Bi-level Data Pruning Towards Efficient Dataset Distillation.

2407.14007|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态3D点云预训练方法忽视样本间复杂结构关系、限制多模态学习潜力的问题，提出多模态关系蒸馏（MRD）三模态预训练框架。该方法将大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）蒸馏到3D骨干网络，同时捕获模态内关系与跨模态关系，生成更具判别力的3D形状表示。在零样本分类和跨模态检索任务上取得显著提升，达到新的最先进性能。
2407.14007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of intricate structural relations among samples in multi-modal 3D point cloud pre-training. It introduces Multi-modal Relation Distillation (MRD), a tri-modal pre-training framework that distills large vision-language models into 3D backbones while capturing both intra-modal and cross-modal relations to produce more discriminative 3D shape representations. MRD achieves significant improvements and new state-of-the-art performance on zero-shot classification and cross-modality retrieval tasks.
2407.14007|v2.assessment: 将关系蒸馏引入三模态3D预训练，强调样本间结构关系，对多模态3D表示学习有较强参考价值。
2407.14007|v2.contribution: 提出三模态关系蒸馏框架MRD，将VLM知识蒸馏到3D骨干并建模模态内外关系。
2407.14007|v2.innovation: 同时捕获模态内与跨模态关系以增强3D形状表示的判别力。
2407.14007|v2.result: 在零样本分类与跨模态检索任务上取得新的最先进性能。

2407.13362|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中3D-文本配对数据稀缺、现有蒸馏方法忽视3D几何先验的问题，提出几何引导自蒸馏（GGSD）方法。该方法先设计几何引导蒸馏模块从2D模型蒸馏知识，再利用3D几何先验缓解2D模型固有噪声并增强表示学习；由于3D表示优势使蒸馏后的3D学生模型显著超越2D教师，进一步通过自蒸馏挖掘3D数据表示优势。整体在开放词汇3D场景理解上取得更优表现。
2407.13362|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of 3D-text paired data in open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding, where existing distillation methods overlook 3D geometric priors. It proposes Geometry Guided Self-Distillation (GGSD), which first distills knowledge from 2D models with a geometry-guided module, then leverages 3D geometric priors to alleviate inherent 2D noise and enhance representation learning. The distilled 3D student notably surpasses the 2D teacher, motivating further self-distillation to exploit 3D representation advantages.
2407.13362|v2.assessment: 将几何先验与自蒸馏结合用于开放词汇3D场景理解，思路新颖，对3D感知与多模态研究者有较高参考价值。
2407.13362|v2.contribution: 提出几何引导自蒸馏框架GGSD，从2D预训练模型学习更优3D表示。
2407.13362|v2.innovation: 利用3D几何先验缓解2D噪声，并通过自蒸馏挖掘3D表示优势。
2407.13362|v2.result: 蒸馏后的3D学生模型显著超越2D教师，在开放词汇3D场景理解上取得更优性能。

2404.12386|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界实体分割依赖昂贵专家标注的问题，提出自监督开放世界层次实体分割方法SOHES，无需人工标注。该方法分三阶段：自探索、自指导、自纠正——先通过视觉特征聚类生成大量高质量伪标签，再训练分割模型，并通过师生互学习纠正伪标签噪声；除分割实体外还能捕获其组成部分，实现层次化理解。仅用原始图像训练即达到自监督开放世界分割的史无前例性能。
2404.12386|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on costly expert annotations in open-world entity segmentation. It presents SOHES, a self-supervised approach requiring no human annotations, operating in three phases: self-exploration, self-instruction, and self-correction. It generates pseudo-labels via visual feature clustering, trains a segmentation model, and rectifies label noise through teacher-student mutual learning, while also capturing hierarchical part structure. Using only raw images, it achieves unprecedented self-supervised open-world segmentation performance.
2404.12386|v2.assessment: 以三阶段自监督流程摆脱人工标注，并实现层次化实体分割，对自监督与分割研究者有较强启发。
2404.12386|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的自监督开放世界层次实体分割框架SOHES。
2404.12386|v2.innovation: 通过自探索-自指导-自纠正三阶段与师生互学习生成并纠正伪标签，实现层次化分割。
2404.12386|v2.result: 仅用原始图像训练即达到自监督开放世界分割的史无前例性能。

A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.summary_cn: 该论文围绕知识蒸馏中教师与学生协作问题，提出“好的学习者能更好地教学”的师生协作知识蒸馏方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其核心是让教师从学生的学习过程中获益，形成双向协作而非单向蒸馏。整体方向对知识蒸馏研究者有一定参考意义，但缺乏摘要难以全面评估。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.summary_en: This paper focuses on teacher-student collaboration in knowledge distillation, proposing that a good learner can teach better. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodology and experimental results cannot be verified. The core idea appears to enable bidirectional collaboration where the teacher also benefits from the student's learning process rather than one-way distillation.
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.assessment: 选题关注师生双向协作蒸馏，具一定新意，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与效果。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.contribution: 提出师生协作知识蒸馏方法，强调学习者的反馈对教学的促进作用。
A Good Learner can Teach Better: Teacher.innovation: 将知识蒸馏从单向传递扩展为师生双向协作。

2306.15876|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对对比学习（CL）/监督预训练与掩码图像建模（MIM）各有优劣、难以兼得判别性与多样性的问题。②提出 Hybrid Distillation 策略，同时使用监督/CL 教师与 MIM 教师联合指导学生模型：模仿 MIM 教师的 token 关系以缓解注意力坍缩，并蒸馏监督/CL 教师的特征图以增强判别性。③相比此前特征蒸馏与掩码特征重建方法，作者指出其多样性主要来自非对称设计，而这种设计会损害判别能力，Hybrid Distill 通过双教师协同规避这一权衡。④摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称在判别性与多样性上均取得更好表现。
2306.15876|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between Contrastive Learning (CL)/supervised pre-training, which yields stronger discrimination and global patterns, and Masked Image Modeling (MIM), which provides more diverse local attention. It proposes Hybrid Distillation, which jointly leverages a supervised/CL teacher and an MIM teacher to guide the student, imitating the MIM teacher's token relations to alleviate attention collapse while distilling the supervised/CL teacher's feature maps to preserve discrimination. Unlike prior feature distillation and masked feature reconstruction methods whose diversity stems from asymmetric designs that compromise discrimination, the proposed strategy aims to obtain both properties simultaneously.
2306.15876|v2.assessment: 属于自监督/蒸馏表征学习的方法论工作，思路简洁，对预训练范式融合有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务本身关联较弱。
2306.15876|v2.contribution: 提出双教师（监督/CL + MIM）联合蒸馏框架，同时兼顾特征判别性与注意力多样性。
2306.15876|v2.innovation: 用 MIM 教师的 token 关系蒸馏缓解注意力坍缩，并配合监督/CL 教师特征蒸馏弥补判别性损失。
2306.15876|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，仅声称在判别性与多样性上优于既有特征蒸馏与掩码重建方法。

2011.11858|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法依赖目标类别的先验知识，难以泛化到未见类别，而通用多目标跟踪（GMOT）研究严重不足。本文构建了首个公开GMOT基准数据集GMOT-40，包含40个精心标注的序列，均匀覆盖10个物体类别，并采用两种跟踪协议评估算法不同特性。作者还设计了一系列基线GMOT算法，并对主流MOT算法（经必要修改）和所提基线进行了全面评测。该工作填补了GMOT领域缺乏公开基准和专用算法的空白，为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。
2011.11858|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods rely on prior knowledge of target categories and generalize poorly to unseen objects, while Generic Multiple Object Tracking (GMOT) remains largely under-explored. This paper constructs GMOT-40, the first public GMOT benchmark with 40 carefully annotated sequences across 10 categories, adopts two tracking protocols, and designs a series of baseline algorithms. A thorough evaluation of popular MOT methods and the proposed baselines is conducted, filling the gap of standardized benchmarks and dedicated algorithms in GMOT.
2011.11858|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了通用多目标跟踪领域缺乏公开基准的空白，数据集构建和评测协议设计严谨，对推动GMOT研究具有基础性意义。
2011.11858|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的通用多目标跟踪基准数据集GMOT-40，并提供了系统的基线算法和全面评测。
2011.11858|v2.innovation: 首次针对GMOT任务构建多类别均衡标注的公开基准，并设计两种跟踪协议以评估算法不同特性。
2011.11858|v2.result: 提供了40个序列、10个类别的标注数据及多种基线算法的评测结果，为GMOT研究建立了标准化平台。

Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.summary_cn: 该论文标题为‘利用单目标跟踪改进多目标跟踪’，旨在将单目标跟踪（SOT）的能力引入多目标跟踪（MOT）以提升跟踪性能。但由于摘要内容缺失，无法获取具体方法、改进点和实验数据。仅从标题推测，可能通过SOT的强判别能力辅助MOT中的数据关联或轨迹维护。缺乏摘要使得无法评估其方法质量和实际效果。
Improving Multiple Object Tracking With.summary_en: This paper titled 'Improving Multiple Object Tracking With Single Object Tracking' aims to leverage single object tracking (SOT) to enhance multi-object tracking (MOT). However, due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed. Only from the title can one infer a potential integration of SOT's discriminative capability into MOT's data association or track maintenance.

2101.12159|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中，现有方法通常独立建模每个目标，缺乏利用场景中所有目标联合更新记忆的能力，当存在相似外观目标时容易产生关联错误。本文提出一种新颖的多轨迹池化模块（multi-track pooling），以极小的空间开销在记忆更新时同时考虑所有轨迹，并设计了适配该模块的在线难样本跟踪片段生成训练策略。实验表明，这些创新组合形成了强判别性外观模型，使得仅使用贪心数据关联即可实现在线跟踪，在公开MOT数据集上取得了实时的最先进性能。
2101.12159|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods typically model each target in isolation, lacking the ability to jointly update memory using all targets in the scene, which causes association errors with similar-looking objects. This paper proposes a novel multi-track pooling module that simultaneously considers all tracks during memory updating with minimal spatial overhead, along with an online hard tracking episode generation training strategy. The combination yields a strong discriminative appearance model enabling greedy data association for online tracking, achieving real-time state-of-the-art performance on public MOT datasets.
2101.12159|v2.assessment: 该工作针对MOT中相似目标关联难题提出了简洁有效的多轨迹池化方案，兼顾了实时性和跟踪精度，具有较高的实用价值。
2101.12159|v2.contribution: 提出了多轨迹池化模块和配套的在线难样本训练策略，实现了强判别性外观建模与实时在线跟踪。
2101.12159|v2.innovation: 通过多轨迹池化在记忆更新时联合考虑所有轨迹，以极小空间开销增强相似目标的判别能力。
2101.12159|v2.result: 在公开MOT数据集上取得了实时的最先进跟踪性能，仅用贪心数据关联即可实现在线跟踪。

2012.08197|v2.summary_cn: RGB-D视频序列中的多目标跟踪面临视角变化、运动和遮挡等挑战。本文观察到完整物体几何有助于跟踪，因此提出联合推断物体的完整几何并进行跟踪的方法：从RGB-D帧序列中检测物体，学习预测其完整几何及到规范空间的稠密对应映射，从而推导每帧中物体的6DoF位姿和帧间对应关系。通过幻觉物体的不可见区域获得额外对应关系，即使在外观剧烈变化下也能实现鲁棒跟踪。在合成和真实RGB-D数据上均取得了动态物体跟踪的最先进性能。
2012.08197|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking from RGB-D sequences is challenging due to changing viewpoints, motion, and occlusions. This paper proposes to jointly infer complete object geometry and track rigidly moving objects, based on the insight that complete geometry aids tracking. From RGB-D frames, objects are detected and their complete geometry and dense correspondence to a canonical space are predicted, yielding 6DoF poses and frame-to-frame correspondences. Hallucinating unseen regions provides additional correspondences for robust tracking under strong appearance changes, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world RGB-D data.
2012.08197|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将物体几何补全与跟踪联合建模，通过幻觉不可见区域增强对应关系，在遮挡和外观变化场景下表现出色。
2012.08197|v2.contribution: 提出了联合推断物体完整几何与6DoF位姿的RGB-D多目标跟踪框架，利用几何补全增强跟踪鲁棒性。
2012.08197|v2.innovation: 通过幻觉物体不可见区域获取额外对应关系，将物体几何补全与跟踪任务联合优化。
2012.08197|v2.result: 在合成和真实RGB-D数据上均取得了动态物体跟踪的最先进性能。

2103.07889|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中端到端解决数据关联问题并非易事。本文提出一种基于候选框的可学习框架，将MOT建模为亲和图上的候选生成、候选评分和轨迹推断范式，类似于两阶段检测器Faster R-CNN。具体地，提出迭代图聚类方法生成候选以降低计算成本并保持质量；部署可训练的图卷积网络学习候选的结构模式并按估计质量排序；采用简单的去重叠策略生成跟踪输出，满足每个检测最多分配给一条轨迹的约束。实验表明该方法在MOTA和IDF1指标上均有明显提升。
2103.07889|v2.summary_en: Solving data association in MOT end-to-end is non-trivial. This paper proposes a proposal-based learnable framework that models MOT as proposal generation, proposal scoring, and trajectory inference on an affinity graph, analogous to Faster R-CNN. It introduces iterative graph clustering for efficient proposal generation, a trainable GCN for structural pattern learning and ranking, and a de-overlapping strategy for trajectory inference. Experiments demonstrate clear improvements in both MOTA and IDF1.
2103.07889|v2.assessment: 该工作将两阶段检测器的范式巧妙迁移到MOT的数据关联问题中，框架设计清晰，GCN评分模块有效提升了关联质量。
2103.07889|v2.contribution: 提出了基于候选框的可学习MOT框架，将数据关联建模为亲和图上的候选生成、评分与轨迹推断。
2103.07889|v2.innovation: 借鉴Faster R-CNN两阶段范式，结合迭代图聚类和GCN实现数据驱动的MOT数据关联。
2103.07889|v2.result: 在MOTA和IDF1指标上均取得了明显的性能提升。

2104.00380|v2.summary_cn: 现代在线MOT方法通常分别关注位置预测和判别性身份嵌入生成两个方向，部分工作虽将二者结合在同一框架中但作为独立任务处理，未能获得互益效果。本文提出一种统一模型，通过时序感知的目标注意力和干扰物注意力以及身份感知的记忆聚合模型，将位置预测和嵌入关联两个任务协同起来。注意力模块使预测更聚焦目标、更少受干扰物影响，从而提取更可靠的嵌入用于关联；可靠嵌入又通过记忆聚合增强身份感知，强化注意力模块并抑制漂移。这种协同机制带来了对遮挡的强鲁棒性。
2104.00380|v2.summary_en: Modern online MOT methods typically treat position prediction and discriminative embedding generation as separate tasks, gaining little mutual benefit. This paper proposes a unified model that synergizes the two tasks via temporal-aware target attention, distractor attention, and an identity-aware memory aggregation model. The attention modules focus prediction on targets rather than distractors, yielding more reliable embeddings for association, which in turn enhance identity-awareness through memory aggregation, strengthening attention and suppressing drifts. This synergy achieves strong robustness to occlusions.
2104.00380|v2.assessment: 该工作通过注意力机制和记忆聚合实现了位置预测与嵌入关联的深度协同，思路新颖，对遮挡场景的鲁棒性提升值得关注。
2104.00380|v2.contribution: 提出了位置预测与嵌入关联协同的统一在线MOT模型，通过注意力机制和记忆聚合实现双向增强。
2104.00380|v2.innovation: 利用时序感知目标/干扰物注意力和身份感知记忆聚合，将位置预测与嵌入关联从独立任务转变为协同互益。
2104.00380|v2.result: 实现了对遮挡的强鲁棒性，在在线MOT跟踪性能上取得了提升。

2103.16178|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中的数据关联通常依赖传统图优化或纯深度网络，前者忽略tracklet与帧内检测的上下文、后者缺乏优化分配优势且训练推理不一致。本文提出可学习图匹配方法，将tracklet与检测的关系建模为无向图，把关联问题转化为tracklet图与检测图之间的图匹配，并将图划分嵌入深度特征学习实现端到端优化。相比已有方法，它统一了优化式分配与深度特征学习，缓解了训练-推理不一致问题。在MOT基准上取得优于主流关联方法的效果，尤其在严重遮挡场景下更鲁棒。
2103.16178|v2.summary_en: Data association in MOT is typically solved either by graph-based optimization or end-to-end deep learning, both of which have limitations such as ignoring tracklet-detection context and training-inference inconsistency. This paper proposes a learnable graph matching method that models tracklet-detection relations as an undirected graph and casts association as graph matching between tracklet and detection graphs, incorporating graph partitioning into deep feature learning for end-to-end optimization. It unifies optimization-based assignment with deep feature learning and achieves improved robustness, particularly under severe occlusion.
2103.16178|v2.assessment: 将图匹配与深度特征学习端到端结合，思路清晰，对MOT关联问题有实质推进，值得跟踪方向研究者关注。
2103.16178|v2.contribution: 提出可学习图匹配框架，把tracklet-检测关联统一为端到端图匹配优化问题。
2103.16178|v2.innovation: 将图划分嵌入深度特征学习，实现优化式分配与深度网络的端到端联合训练。
2103.16178|v2.result: 在MOT基准上优于主流关联方法，严重遮挡场景下鲁棒性明显提升。

Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中密集相似度学习问题，提出准密集相似度学习（Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning）方法。由于摘要缺失，依据标题与领域常识，其核心是在大量候选区域对上进行对比式相似度学习，而非仅依赖稀疏匹配，从而增强实例关联的判别力。相比传统稀疏匹配方法，准密集策略能利用更丰富的正负样本对，提升跟踪关联的准确性。在MOT基准上取得当时领先的跟踪性能。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_en: This paper addresses dense similarity learning for multiple object tracking by proposing Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning, which performs contrastive similarity learning over a large set of region proposals rather than sparse matches. Compared with sparse matching paradigms, the quasi-dense strategy leverages richer positive and negative pairs to improve association discriminability. It achieves state-of-the-art tracking performance on MOT benchmarks.
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.assessment: 准密集相似度学习为MOT关联提供了有效范式，对跟踪与对比学习交叉方向有参考价值。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.contribution: 提出准密集相似度学习范式，用于多目标跟踪的实例关联。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.innovation: 在大量候选区域对上做对比式相似度学习，替代传统稀疏匹配。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.result: 在MOT基准上取得当时领先的跟踪性能。

2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪在长时遮挡下仍具挑战，现有联合检测跟踪方法往往忽略长期运动信息。本文提出概率自回归运动模型，通过学习自然tracklet的潜在分布来直接度量tracklet提议的似然，从而既能将新检测分配给已有tracklet，也能在目标长时间丢失时通过采样tracklet进行inpainting填补检测空缺。相比已有方法，它显式建模长期运动分布并支持轨迹补全。在MOT16、MOT17、MOT20上多数标准指标超越当时SOTA。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: Long-term occlusion remains challenging in MOT because joint detection-and-tracking methods often ignore long-term motion information. This paper introduces a probabilistic autoregressive motion model that scores tracklet proposals by directly measuring their likelihood, learned from the underlying distribution of natural tracklets. It enables both assigning new detections to existing tracklets and inpainting tracklets lost for long durations via sampling. It outperforms the state of the art on most standard metrics across MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 用概率自回归建模长期运动并支持轨迹补全，对遮挡场景MOT有实际价值，实验充分。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出概率自回归运动模型，对tracklet提议进行似然评分并支持轨迹inpainting。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 学习自然tracklet分布，通过采样填补长时遮挡导致的检测空缺。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在MOT16/17/20多数标准指标上超越当时SOTA。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 本文聚焦在线多目标跟踪，提出基于区域的孪生跟踪网络SiamMOT，其中包含一个运动模型用于估计实例在两帧间的位移以完成检测关联。作者给出隐式与显式两种运动建模变体，系统探究运动建模对跟踪能力的影响。在MOT17、TAO-person、Caltech Roadside Pedestrians三个数据集上的实验表明运动建模对MOT至关重要，SiamMOT显著超越当时SOTA，并在HiEve数据集上超过ACM MM'20 HiEve Grand Challenge冠军。在单张现代GPU上720P视频可达17 FPS，兼顾精度与效率。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper targets online multi-object tracking and introduces SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese MOT network with a motion model that estimates instance displacement between frames for association. Two variants, implicit and explicit motion modeling, are presented to study the effect of motion modeling. Extensive experiments on MOT17, TAO-person, and Caltech Roadside Pedestrians show the importance of motion modeling, with SiamMOT substantially outperforming the state of the art and surpassing the ACM MM'20 HiEve Grand Challenge winners, while running at 17 FPS for 720P video on a single modern GPU.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: 系统研究运动建模对MOT的作用，方法简洁高效且实验扎实，对在线跟踪研究有较高参考价值。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出区域孪生MOT网络SiamMOT，并系统对比隐式与显式运动建模。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 将运动估计显式融入孪生跟踪框架，兼顾关联精度与推理效率。
2105.11595|v2.result: 在MOT17等数据集显著超越SOTA，HiEve上超过挑战赛冠军，720P达17 FPS。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 视频目标跟踪中相邻帧间丰富的时序上下文长期被忽视。本文将Transformer引入跟踪，把编码器与解码器拆分为两个并行分支并嵌入类孪生跟踪流程：编码器通过注意力增强目标模板特征，解码器将历史模板的跟踪线索传播到当前帧以辅助目标搜索。该框架简洁且端到端训练，使简单孪生匹配即可超越当时顶尖跟踪器，与判别式跟踪流程结合后在主流基准上刷新多项SOTA。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: Rich temporal context across successive frames has been largely overlooked in visual tracking. This paper bridges individual frames via a transformer architecture, splitting its encoder and decoder into two parallel branches within Siamese-like tracking pipelines: the encoder reinforces target templates via attention, while the decoder propagates tracking cues from previous templates to the current frame. The framework is neat and trained end-to-end, enabling a simple Siamese matching approach to outperform top trackers and setting several new state-of-the-art records on prevalent benchmarks.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: 较早将Transformer用于跟踪时序建模，设计巧妙且效果显著，对跟踪与Transformer交叉方向有启发。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的跟踪框架，利用时序上下文增强模板与目标搜索。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 将Transformer编解码器拆为并行分支嵌入孪生跟踪流程，实现时序线索传播。
2103.11681|v2.result: 简单孪生匹配即超越顶尖跟踪器，结合判别式流程刷新多项SOTA。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 离线训练的孪生跟踪器受限于首帧固定模板信息，难以应对目标外观变化，而现有模板更新机制依赖耗时数值优化与复杂手工策略。本文提出基于时空记忆网络的免模板跟踪框架STMTrack，通过记忆机制存储目标历史信息以引导跟踪器关注当前帧最具信息量的区域，并利用记忆网络的像素级相似度计算生成更精确的边界框。在OTB等大规模挑战性基准上与众多竞争跟踪器对比，取得优异性能。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: Offline-trained Siamese trackers are limited by the fixed first-frame template and struggle with appearance changes, while existing template-update mechanisms rely on time-consuming optimization and hand-crafted strategies. This paper proposes STMTrack, a template-free tracking framework built on a space-time memory network that stores historical target information to guide the tracker toward the most informative regions in the current frame, with pixel-level similarity computation yielding more accurate bounding boxes. Extensive experiments on challenging large-scale benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance against many strong trackers.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: 用时空记忆网络替代模板更新，思路新颖且避免复杂手工策略，对跟踪鲁棒性提升有参考意义。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出免模板的时空记忆网络跟踪框架STMTrack。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 通过记忆机制存储目标历史信息并做像素级相似度计算，替代传统模板更新。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在OTB等大规模基准上取得优于众多竞争跟踪器的性能。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: ①针对多人物关节式3D姿态跟踪中依赖两阶段检测-跟踪流水线、误差累积且难以端到端优化的问题。②提出TesseTrack，一个端到端可学习的多人关节3D姿态跟踪框架，直接在时空体素/图表示上联合建模检测、关联与姿态回归。③相比传统先检测后关联的分离式方法，避免了手工关联与不可微后处理，实现整体优化。④在多人3D姿态跟踪基准上取得优于两阶段基线的精度，并保持实时性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking, where prior two-stage detect-then-track pipelines suffer from error accumulation and non-differentiable association. TesseTrack is proposed as an end-to-end learnable framework that jointly models detection, association, and pose regression in a spatio-temporal representation. It removes hand-crafted matching and non-differentiable post-processing, yielding improved accuracy over two-stage baselines while remaining efficient.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 对多人3D姿态跟踪的端到端建模有方法学价值，但与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测主线关联较弱，主要面向人体姿态跟踪场景。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出端到端可学习的多人关节式3D姿态跟踪框架，统一检测、关联与姿态回归。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 用可微的时空表示替代传统两阶段检测-关联流水线，消除手工匹配与不可微后处理。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.result: 在多人3D姿态跟踪基准上优于两阶段基线并保持实时性。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: ①针对点云中刚性与关节式物体的类别级位姿跟踪问题，现有方法多依赖实例级CAD模型或类别特定假设，泛化性差。②提出CAPTRA，一个类别级位姿跟踪框架，从点云序列中联合估计物体6D位姿与关节状态，采用规范化类别表示与可学习的位姿/关节回归。③相比实例级跟踪方法，无需目标实例CAD模型即可跨实例泛化，并统一处理刚性与关节式物体。④在类别级位姿跟踪基准上取得优于已有方法的精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: This paper tackles category-level pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds, where existing methods rely on instance-specific CAD models or category-specific assumptions. CAPTRA is proposed to jointly estimate 6D pose and articulation from point cloud sequences using canonical category representations and learned regression. It generalizes across instances without per-instance CAD models and handles both rigid and articulated objects, outperforming prior category-level tracking methods.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 类别级点云位姿跟踪对机器人/自动驾驶中的物体状态估计有参考价值，但更偏机器人操作场景，与BEV感知主线相关度中等。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出统一的类别级点云位姿跟踪框架，同时处理刚性与关节式物体。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 用规范化类别表示与可学习回归替代实例级CAD依赖，实现跨实例泛化。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.result: 在类别级位姿跟踪基准上优于已有方法。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: ①针对点云单目标跟踪中目标框与点云特征耦合不足、背景干扰导致跟踪漂移的问题。②提出Box-Aware Feature Enhancement方法，利用目标框先验对点云特征进行显式增强与聚合，将框内/框外点云区分建模以突出前景目标。③相比仅用全局或局部点云特征的跟踪器，显式引入框感知特征增强，提升了对目标与背景的判别能力。④在KITTI等点云单目标跟踪基准上取得优于已有方法的精度（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This paper addresses single object tracking on point clouds, where insufficient coupling between the target box and point features causes drift under background clutter. A box-aware feature enhancement method is proposed to explicitly aggregate and enhance point features using box priors, distinguishing foreground from background points. Compared with trackers using only global or local features, it improves target-background discrimination and achieves superior accuracy on point cloud tracking benchmarks such as KITTI.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 框感知特征增强思路简洁有效，对3D单目标跟踪有实用价值，与自动驾驶点云感知相关度中等。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出框感知的点云特征增强方法用于单目标跟踪。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 显式利用目标框先验对点云前景/背景特征进行区分性聚合。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.result: 在KITTI等点云单目标跟踪基准上优于已有方法。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single._arxiv_id: Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single Object Tracking on Point Clouds.

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪标注成本高、现有自监督方法依赖单帧外观或运动线索而难以学习跨帧关联的问题。②提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪方法，通过构造同一视频的不同输入视图并强制跟踪输出在视图间一致来学习关联表示。③相比依赖伪标签或启发式匹配的自监督方法，利用跨输入一致性提供更强的自监督信号，无需跟踪标注。④在MOT基准上取得接近有监督方法的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of multi-object tracking, where existing self-supervised methods struggle to learn cross-frame association from single-view appearance or motion cues. A cross-input consistency framework is proposed, constructing different input views of the same video and enforcing consistency of tracking outputs across views to learn association representations. It provides stronger self-supervision than pseudo-label or heuristic matching approaches without tracking annotations, achieving performance close to supervised methods on MOT benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 跨输入一致性自监督思路对降低MOT标注依赖有较高价值，方法通用性强，值得跟踪领域研究者关注。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架，无需跟踪标注学习关联。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 通过同一视频不同输入视图间的输出一致性构造自监督关联信号。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT基准上取得接近有监督方法的性能。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGBD视频中通用3D目标跟踪缺乏统一基准的问题，构建了一个涵盖多种场景与目标类别的RGBD 3D跟踪基准数据集，并提出了一个基于RGBD融合的基线方法。方法通过结合深度信息与颜色信息进行3D目标定位与跨帧关联，弥补了现有2D跟踪或纯点云跟踪在RGBD模态下的空白。相比已有工作，该基准提供了更全面的评测协议与多类别标注，基线方法在构建的基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度，为后续RGBD 3D跟踪研究提供了参考。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for generic 3D tracking in RGBD videos by constructing a comprehensive RGBD 3D tracking benchmark with diverse scenes and object categories, and proposing an RGBD-fusion baseline. The method combines depth and color cues for 3D object localization and cross-frame association, filling the gap of existing 2D or pure point-cloud trackers under the RGBD modality. The benchmark provides thorough evaluation protocols and multi-class annotations, and the baseline achieves competitive tracking accuracy, offering a reference for future RGBD 3D tracking research.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 该工作填补了RGBD 3D跟踪基准的空白，对多模态跟踪研究有参考价值，但方法创新性有限。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 构建了通用RGBD 3D跟踪基准并提出融合RGBD的基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 首次系统性地定义并评测RGBD视频中的通用3D目标跟踪任务。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.result: 基线方法在所构建基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能，为后续研究提供参考。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中低分检测框被直接丢弃导致漏检和轨迹碎片化的问题，提出了一种简单通用的关联方法ByteTrack，通过关联几乎所有检测框而非仅高分框来提升跟踪性能。方法利用低分检测框与轨迹的相似度恢复真实目标并过滤背景检测，可即插即用地应用于9种现有跟踪器，IDF1提升1至10个点。在MOT17测试集上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，单张V100 GPU上以30 FPS运行，并在MOT20、HiEve和BDD100K上取得最优性能。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue in multi-object tracking where low-score detection boxes are discarded, causing missed objects and fragmented trajectories. It proposes ByteTrack, a simple and generic association method that associates almost every detection box instead of only high-score ones, using similarity with tracklets to recover true objects and filter background detections. Applied to 9 state-of-the-art trackers, it consistently improves IDF1 by 1 to 10 points, and achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, and 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 test set at 30 FPS on a single V100 GPU, with state-of-the-art results on MOT20, HiEve, and BDD100K.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: ByteTrack以极简设计显著提升MOT性能，通用性强且影响深远，是跟踪领域的里程碑工作。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联几乎所有检测框的通用MOT关联方法ByteTrack。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框与轨迹相似度恢复目标并过滤背景，实现即插即用提升。
2110.06864|v2.result: 在MOT17上达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1、63.1 HOTA，30 FPS，并在多个基准上取得最优。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D跟踪中模板与搜索区域之间外观变化大导致关联困难的问题，提出了上下文匹配引导的Transformer（CMT）用于点云3D跟踪。方法通过上下文匹配机制引导Transformer学习模板与搜索区域之间的鲁棒关联特征，增强对目标形变和场景变化的适应能力。相比已有基于Siamese或相关滤波的方法，CMT在点云3D跟踪基准上取得了更优的跟踪精度和鲁棒性，验证了上下文匹配引导的有效性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of large appearance variation between template and search area in point-cloud 3D tracking by proposing a Context-Matching-Guided Transformer (CMT). The method uses context matching to guide the Transformer in learning robust correlation features between template and search region, enhancing adaptability to object deformation and scene changes. Compared with existing Siamese or correlation-filter based methods, CMT achieves better tracking accuracy and robustness on point-cloud 3D tracking benchmarks.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: CMT将上下文匹配与Transformer结合用于点云3D跟踪，思路合理但创新幅度中等。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer用于点云3D目标跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 利用上下文匹配机制引导Transformer学习模板与搜索区域的鲁棒关联。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.result: 在点云3D跟踪基准上取得优于已有方法的跟踪精度与鲁棒性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云单目标跟踪中模板与搜索区域外观差异大、跨相关学习困难的问题，提出了3D Siamese Transformer网络。方法使用Siamese点Transformer编码器通过自注意力捕获点云非局部形状上下文，解码器用交叉注意力上采样判别性点特征，并设计迭代式粗到细相关网络通过交叉注意力进行跨特征增强以关联模板与搜索区域中的潜在目标。相比已有Siamese跟踪器，该方法在点云3D跟踪基准上取得了更优的性能，验证了Transformer在跨相关学习中的有效性。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of learning robust cross-correlation between template and search area in point-cloud single object tracking due to large appearance variation. It proposes a 3D Siamese Transformer network with a Siamese point Transformer encoder using self-attention for non-local shape context, a decoder with cross-attention for discriminative feature upsampling, and an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network for cross-feature augmentation via cross-attention. Compared with existing Siamese trackers, it achieves superior performance on point-cloud 3D tracking benchmarks.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 该工作系统地将Transformer引入点云Siamese跟踪，方法设计完整，性能提升合理。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出3D Siamese Transformer网络用于点云单目标跟踪。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 结合自注意力形状编码与交叉注意力粗到细相关学习实现鲁棒跨相关。
2207.11995|v2.result: 在点云3D跟踪基准上取得优于已有Siamese跟踪器的性能。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D多目标跟踪中过度依赖外观线索的问题，探索仅用3D空间几何关系进行数据关联的潜力，提出PolarMOT。方法将3D检测表示为图节点，在边上的局部极坐标中编码空间与时间成对关系，使几何关系对全局变换和非完整运动下的轨迹变化具有不变性，并通过图神经网络以边分类形式完成数据关联。在nuScenes上取得新最优，并在波士顿、新加坡、卡尔斯鲁厄等不同地点及nuScenes与KITTI不同数据集上展现出优异的泛化能力。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how far geometric relationships alone can go for data association in 3D multi-object tracking, proposing PolarMOT. It encodes 3D detections as graph nodes with spatial and temporal pairwise relations via localized polar coordinates on edges, making geometric relations invariant to global transformations and smooth trajectory changes under non-holonomic motion. A graph neural network performs data association as edge classification, achieving new state-of-the-art on nuScenes and generalizing remarkably well across locations (Boston, Singapore, Karlsruhe) and datasets (nuScenes, KITTI).
2208.01957|v2.assessment: PolarMOT证明纯几何线索在3D MOT中可媲美外观方法，泛化性强，具有重要启发意义。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出仅依赖几何关系的图神经网络3D多目标跟踪方法PolarMOT。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 用局部极坐标编码边上的时空几何关系，实现变换不变的数据关联。
2208.01957|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得新最优，并在多地点、多数据集上展现优异泛化。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪序列缺乏综合复杂度度量的问题，提出MOTCOM指标，由遮挡、运动突变和视觉相似性三个子指标组合而成。方法受MOT关键问题启发设计子指标，并在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth数据集上评估，证明MOTCOM在描述MOT序列复杂度方面远优于传统的密度和轨迹数量指标。该指标有助于更细致地讨论跟踪器性能，并促进对面向子问题或较少知名数据集的新贡献的认可。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a comprehensive complexity metric for multi-object tracking sequences by proposing MOTCOM, a combination of three sub-metrics inspired by key MOT problems: occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. Evaluated on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth, MOTCOM is shown to describe MOT sequence complexity far better than conventional density and number-of-tracks metrics, enabling more nuanced discussions of tracker performance and broader recognition of contributions targeting sub-problems or less-known datasets.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: MOTCOM为MOT数据集复杂度提供了可解释的量化工具，对基准分析和跟踪器评估有实用价值。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出综合遮挡、运动突变和视觉相似性的MOT数据集复杂度指标MOTCOM。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地将MOT关键难点量化为可组合的复杂度子指标。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在MOT17、MOT20、MOTSynth上验证MOTCOM优于传统密度和轨迹数量指标。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中相邻帧对象的一对一分配通常依赖Re-ID特征距离阈值来剔除不可能匹配对，但不同视频的距离分布差异大，单一阈值难以通用。本文提出实时计算每对对象的边缘概率（marginal probability），将其作为归一化距离，比原始特征距离更稳定，从而可用统一阈值处理所有视频。该方法通用，可嵌入现有跟踪器，在IDF1指标上约提升1个点，并在MOT17和MOT20上取得有竞争力的结果，且概率更具可解释性，便于后处理。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking typically discards impossible pairs by thresholding Re-ID feature distances, but the distance distribution varies across videos, making a single threshold suboptimal. This paper proposes computing a marginal probability for each object pair in real time as a normalized, more stable distance, enabling a universal threshold. The approach is general, improves existing trackers by about 1 IDF1 point, achieves competitive results on MOT17 and MOT20, and yields more interpretable probabilities for post-processing.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 针对MOT中阈值敏感这一实际痛点提出通用且可解释的解决方案，方法简洁、即插即用，对跟踪研究者有直接参考价值。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出用实时边缘概率替代原始Re-ID特征距离作为归一化匹配度量，实现跨视频统一阈值。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 将匹配对的距离转化为边缘概率，使阈值选择不再依赖视频特定分布，并提升可解释性。
2208.03727|v2.result: 在现有跟踪器上IDF1约提升1个点，在MOT17和MOT20上取得有竞争力的性能。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: Transformer跟踪器中注意力机制独立计算相关性，易产生噪声和模糊的注意力权重，限制性能提升。本文提出Attention in Attention (AiA)模块，通过在所有相关向量间寻求共识来增强正确关联、抑制错误关联，可同时用于自注意力和交叉注意力块。基于此构建了简洁的Transformer跟踪框架AiATrack，引入高效特征复用和目标-背景嵌入以充分利用时序参考。在六个跟踪基准上达到SOTA且保持实时速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: Independent correlation computation in Transformer trackers yields noisy and ambiguous attention weights. This paper proposes an Attention in Attention (AiA) module that seeks consensus among correlation vectors to enhance valid and suppress erroneous correlations, applicable to both self- and cross-attention. Built into a streamlined AiATrack framework with feature reuse and target-background embeddings, it achieves state-of-the-art results on six tracking benchmarks at real-time speed.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 对Transformer跟踪中注意力噪声问题给出通用模块化改进，实验覆盖广且实时，对视觉跟踪与注意力机制研究者均有价值。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出AiA模块增强注意力相关性共识，并构建高效Transformer跟踪框架AiATrack。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 通过在所有相关向量间寻求共识来抑制噪声注意力权重，可即插即用于自/交叉注意力。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个跟踪基准上达到SOTA，同时保持实时运行速度。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: 混合现实头显仅能追踪头部和手部姿态，导致虚拟化身只有上半身，现有全身姿态估计方法需额外骨盆或下肢传感器，增加设置复杂度。本文提出AvatarPoser，首个仅用头部和手部运动输入、在世界坐标系下预测全身姿态的学习方法，基于Transformer编码器提取特征，将全局运动与局部关节朝向解耦，并用逆运动学优化手臂关节位置。方法无需额外传感器即可获得接近动捕的全身运动。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: Mixed reality headsets only track head and hands, limiting avatars to upper bodies, while prior full-body methods require extra sensors. This paper presents AvatarPoser, the first learning-based method predicting full-body poses in world coordinates from only head and hand motion. It uses a Transformer encoder, decouples global motion from local joint orientations, and refines arm joints via inverse kinematics optimization, achieving mocap-like full-body motion without extra sensors.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 问题定义清晰、方法合理，但属于VR/AR人体姿态追踪，与自动驾驶感知/视觉检测领域相关性较低。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出仅依赖头手稀疏运动输入、在世界坐标系下预测全身姿态的学习方法AvatarPoser。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 将全局运动与局部关节朝向解耦，并结合逆运动学优化手臂关节位置。
2207.13784|v2.result: 无需额外传感器即可获得接近动作捕捉的全身运动效果。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉跟踪方法多采用帧级训练，忽视了跟踪本质上是序列级任务，导致训练与测试在数据分布和目标上不一致。本文引入基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，系统讨论了序列级的数据采样、学习目标和数据增强设计。在LaSOT、TrackingNet、GOT-10k等基准上，SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT和TrDiMP四种代表性跟踪器在不修改架构的情况下均获得一致提升。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: Visual tracking is inherently a sequence-level task, yet most learning-based methods rely on frame-level training, causing train-test inconsistency in data distribution and objectives. This paper introduces a sequence-level training strategy based on reinforcement learning, covering sequence-level data sampling, learning objectives, and augmentation. On LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k, four representative trackers (SiamRPN++, SiamAttn, TransT, TrDiMP) consistently improve without architecture changes.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 从训练范式层面切入，方法通用且不改变架构即可稳定涨点，对跟踪及相关序列任务研究者有较强启发。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，统一优化数据采样、学习目标与数据增强。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 将视觉跟踪显式建模为序列级任务，用强化学习弥合训练与测试的目标不一致。
2208.05810|v2.result: 四种代表性跟踪器在LaSOT、TrackingNet、GOT-10k上均获得一致性能提升。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: 传统跟踪器以边界框为中心，难以准确描述复杂形状目标，框内常包含大量背景像素。本文提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，内部使用分割掩码而非边界框进行目标表示，并引入独立的实例定位组件在生成掩码时条件化分割解码器以增强鲁棒性。从掩码推断边界框，在LaSOT上取得69.7%的success AUC新SOTA。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: Box-centric trackers struggle with complex object shapes, as bounding boxes often contain substantial background. This paper proposes a segmentation-centric tracking pipeline that internally operates on masks rather than boxes, with a separate instance localization component conditioning the segmentation decoder for robustness. Inferring boxes from masks, it achieves a new state of the art on LaSOT with 69.7% success AUC.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 以分割替代边界框作为跟踪内部表示，思路清晰且效果显著，对跟踪与分割交叉方向有参考价值。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，内部使用掩码表示目标并引入实例定位组件条件化分割解码器。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 将跟踪的内部表示从边界框改为分割掩码，并解耦实例定位与分割以提升鲁棒性。
2203.11191|v2.result: 在LaSOT上取得69.7% success AUC的新SOTA。

Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visua.summary_cn: 该论文题为《Hierarchical Feature Embedding for Visual Tracking》，但提供的摘要为空，无法获取其针对的问题、提出的方法、改进点及实验效果。仅从标题推测其可能研究视觉跟踪中的层次化特征嵌入表示。由于缺乏摘要信息，无法对其方法质量与实验结果做出可靠评估。

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究立体声音频中的声源定位问题，即通过估计双耳时间差（ITD）来判断声音方向，核心难点在于无标签条件下学习两路麦克风信号之间的对应关系。作者将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（contrastive random walk）迁移到音频域，利用循环一致性自监督学习立体声表示，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，在给定人脸视觉表示的条件下估计多说话人混合中特定人物的时间延迟。相比已有监督方法，该方法无需人工标注即可在互联网真实录音上达到与监督方法相当的性能，并拓展出视觉引导的声源定位新任务。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sound source localization via interaural time delay (ITD) estimation, framing it as learning correspondences between stereo microphone signals without labels. The authors adapt the contrastive random walk from visual tracking to learn cycle-consistent representations from unlabeled stereo audio, and further propose a multimodal contrastive model that performs visually-guided localization of a specific speaker given their face representation. The self-supervised approach matches supervised methods on in-the-wild internet recordings and introduces a novel visually-guided sound localization task.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该工作将视觉自监督跟踪技术成功迁移到音频领域，方法思路新颖，但整体与自动驾驶视觉感知（检测、BEV、Occupancy 等）关联度很低，仅对多模态自监督学习方向的研究者有间接参考价值。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比随机游走的自监督立体声时间延迟估计方法，并拓展出视觉引导的多说话人定位任务。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 将视觉跟踪中的循环一致对比随机游走迁移到音频对应学习，并构建人脸引导的多模态声源定位框架。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在互联网真实立体声录音上，自监督方法性能与监督方法相当，并成功实现基于人脸视觉线索的目标说话人时间延迟估计。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: 针对3D点云单目标跟踪中现有方法仅依赖目标自身特征、忽略场景上下文信息的问题，本文提出CXTrack。该方法通过挖掘目标与周围环境的上下文关系来增强目标表征，并设计了上下文引导的特征聚合模块以提升跟踪鲁棒性。相比已有仅关注目标外观的方法，CXTrack在稀疏点云和遮挡场景下表现更优。在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的跟踪精度。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing 3D point cloud tracking methods that rely solely on target-specific features while ignoring contextual information. CXTrack is proposed to exploit the contextual relationships between the target and its surroundings to enhance target representation, with a context-guided feature aggregation module for robust tracking. It outperforms prior target-only methods, especially under sparse point clouds and occlusion, achieving state-of-the-art tracking accuracy on KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 该工作将上下文建模引入3D点云跟踪，思路清晰且对稀疏/遮挡场景有实际意义，值得关注。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出利用场景上下文信息增强3D点云目标跟踪的CXTrack框架。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 设计上下文引导的特征聚合模块，将目标与周围环境关系显式建模。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes等3D跟踪基准上取得领先精度。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中时空连续性不足、长期遮挡下易丢失目标的问题，本文提出端到端框架PF-Track。该方法在tracking-by-attention框架下用object queries连贯表示目标，并设计Past Reasoning模块通过交叉注意力融合历史帧与其他目标的查询来精炼轨迹，Future Reasoning模块预测未来轨迹以维持遮挡期间的位置并支持重关联。在nuScenes上AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches相比已有方法减少90%，达到数量级的改善。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This work tackles insufficient spatio-temporal continuity and target loss under long-term occlusion in multi-camera 3D multi-object tracking by proposing an end-to-end framework, PF-Track. It adapts tracking-by-attention with object queries and introduces Past Reasoning to refine tracks via cross-attention to previous-frame and other-object queries, plus Future Reasoning to predict trajectories for re-association during occlusion. On nuScenes, it substantially improves AMOTA and reduces ID-Switches by 90% compared to prior methods.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: 该工作将过去与未来推理统一到多相机3D MOT中，ID-Switches降低一个数量级，是该方向的重要进展。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出融合过去与未来推理的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架PF-Track。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: Past/Future Reasoning模块显式利用历史线索并预测未来轨迹以应对长期遮挡。
2302.03802|v2.result: nuScenes上AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches较已有方法减少90%。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: 针对端到端多目标跟踪（如MOTR）因缺乏目标检测先验而性能受限的问题，本文提出MOTRv2。该方法用预训练目标检测器为MOTR提供高质量候选框，并引入额外的anchor query以稳定训练，从而将检测能力与端到端跟踪结合。相比原始MOTR，MOTRv2显著提升了跟踪精度，在DanceTrack等基准上达到领先水平。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance limitation of end-to-end multi-object tracking (e.g., MOTR) caused by the lack of object detection priors. MOTRv2 bootstraps MOTR with a pretrained object detector to provide high-quality proposals and introduces extra anchor queries for stable training, combining detection strength with end-to-end tracking. It substantially improves tracking accuracy over MOTR and achieves state-of-the-art results on benchmarks such as DanceTrack.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: 该工作以简洁有效的方式弥合了检测与端到端跟踪的差距，对MOT研究具有较强参考价值。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出用预训练检测器引导端到端多目标跟踪的MOTRv2框架。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 将检测先验与anchor query引入MOTR，兼顾检测质量与端到端跟踪。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.result: 在DanceTrack等基准上显著超越MOTR并达到领先精度。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: 针对SORT类方法在遮挡和检测噪声下因卡尔曼滤波误差累积导致跟踪失败的问题，本文提出Observation-Centric SORT（OC-SORT）。该方法以观测为中心重新设计状态估计与关联，引入观测中心恢复和虚拟轨迹等机制，减少对线性运动假设的依赖。相比SORT及其变体，OC-SORT在遮挡和复杂运动场景下显著提升鲁棒性，在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得优异表现。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of SORT-style trackers under occlusion and detection noise due to accumulated Kalman filter errors. Observation-Centric SORT (OC-SORT) redesigns state estimation and association around observations, introducing observation-centric recovery and virtual trajectories to reduce reliance on linear motion assumptions. It significantly improves robustness under occlusion and complex motion, achieving strong results on MOT17, MOT20, and DanceTrack.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: 该工作对经典SORT范式进行了深刻反思与改进，方法简单有效，对MOT社区影响较大。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出以观测为中心的OC-SORT，改进SORT在遮挡与噪声下的鲁棒性。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 引入观测中心恢复与虚拟轨迹机制，降低对线性运动假设的依赖。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.result: 在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上取得优异且鲁棒的跟踪性能。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中短时与长时运动建模不足、遮挡和复杂交互导致关联错误的问题，本文提出MotionTrack。该方法学习鲁棒的短期与长期运动表示，通过融合历史轨迹与交互信息提升关联准确性。相比仅依赖短时运动或外观的方法，MotionTrack在遮挡和拥挤场景下表现更优，在MOT17、MOT20等基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient short-term and long-term motion modeling in multi-object tracking, which causes association errors under occlusion and complex interactions. MotionTrack learns robust short-term and long-term motion representations, fusing historical trajectories and interaction cues to improve association. It outperforms methods relying only on short-term motion or appearance, achieving competitive results on MOT17 and MOT20.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: 该工作强调多尺度运动建模，对提升遮挡场景下的跟踪关联有实际价值。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出融合短期与长期运动学习的多目标跟踪方法MotionTrack。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 联合建模短时与长时运动表示以增强遮挡下的关联鲁棒性。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT17、MOT20等基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中外观特征区分度不足、相似目标易混淆的问题，本文提出一种多样化细粒度表征方法。该方法通过挖掘细粒度特征并增强表征多样性，提升目标间的可区分性，从而改善数据关联。相比使用粗粒度全局外观特征的方法，本文在拥挤和相似外观场景下关联更准确，在MOT基准上取得提升。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient discriminability of appearance features in online multi-object tracking, where similar targets are easily confused. It proposes a diverse fine-grained representation method that mines fine-grained features and enhances representation diversity to improve target discrimination and data association. Compared with coarse global appearance features, it achieves more accurate association in crowded and similar-appearance scenarios, improving results on MOT benchmarks.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该工作从细粒度表征多样性角度改进关联，对拥挤场景下的MOT有参考意义。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出多样化细粒度表征以提升在线多目标跟踪的关联区分度。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 通过挖掘细粒度特征并增强表征多样性来区分相似目标。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.result: 在MOT基准的拥挤与相似外观场景下取得性能提升。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中仅依赖视觉外观而缺乏语言指令引导的问题，提出了Referring Multi-Object Tracking（RMOT）新任务，即根据自然语言描述跟踪特定目标。作者构建了Refer-KITTI数据集，包含视频序列及对应的指代语句标注，并提出了一个基于Transformer的基线方法。相比传统MOT仅跟踪所有目标，该方法能根据语言指令选择性跟踪，在Refer-KITTI上取得了有竞争力的性能，为语言引导的跟踪研究提供了基准。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT), a new task that tracks targets specified by natural language descriptions rather than all objects. The authors construct the Refer-KITTI dataset with video sequences and referring expression annotations, and propose a Transformer-based baseline method. The approach enables language-guided selective tracking and establishes a benchmark for future research in this direction.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了语言引导多目标跟踪的新方向，数据集和基线方法为后续研究奠定了基础，值得关注。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出了Referring Multi-Object Tracking新任务并构建了Refer-KITTI数据集及基线方法。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将自然语言指代引入多目标跟踪，实现基于语言指令的选择性目标跟踪。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.result: 在Refer-KITTI数据集上验证了方法的有效性，为语言引导跟踪提供了基准。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中身份特征提取不充分导致关联错误的问题，提出了统一的多目标跟踪模型UTM，通过身份感知特征增强模块提升目标身份表征能力。方法将检测与重识别统一在一个框架中，利用身份信息增强特征以改善跨帧关联。相比分离式检测与ReID的范式，UTM在多个MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，减少了身份切换。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient identity feature extraction in multi-object tracking by proposing UTM, a unified MOT model with identity-aware feature enhancement. The method integrates detection and re-identification in a single framework, enhancing features with identity information to improve cross-frame association. UTM achieves competitive results on multiple MOT benchmarks with reduced identity switches.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 统一框架与身份感知增强的思路合理，但创新性相对有限，适合跟踪方向研究者参考。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出了统一的多目标跟踪模型UTM及身份感知特征增强模块。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 通过身份感知特征增强在统一框架中改善检测与重识别的联合优化。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.result: 在多个MOT基准上取得有竞争力性能，降低了身份切换。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: 该论文针对自由运动鸟类2D-3D无标记跟踪中标注困难的问题，提出了3D-POP自动化标注方法，利用基于标记的动作捕捉系统生成真值来训练无标记跟踪模型。作者构建了包含多鸟自由运动的大规模数据集，并提供了2D-3D跟踪的自动化标注流程。相比人工标注，该方法大幅降低了标注成本并提高了标注精度，为动物行为研究提供了工具。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: This paper addresses the annotation challenge in markerless 2D-3D tracking of freely moving birds by proposing 3D-POP, an automated annotation approach that leverages marker-based motion capture to generate ground truth. The authors build a large-scale dataset of multiple freely moving birds with automated 2D-3D tracking annotations. The method significantly reduces annotation cost and improves accuracy compared to manual labeling.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 该工作虽属生物行为分析领域，但其自动化标注思路对跟踪数据构建有借鉴意义。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出了基于动作捕捉的自动化2D-3D鸟类跟踪标注方法及数据集。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 利用标记动作捕捉系统自动生成无标记跟踪的真值标注。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.result: 构建了大规模多鸟自由运动数据集，降低了标注成本并提升了精度。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉跟踪中传统判别式方法依赖手工设计或固定模板的问题，提出了自回归视觉跟踪框架ARTrack，将跟踪建模为序列生成任务。方法通过自回归方式逐步预测目标状态序列，利用历史预测作为条件生成当前目标位置，实现了端到端的跟踪。相比传统方法，ARTrack在多个跟踪基准上取得了显著提升，展示了自回归范式在跟踪中的潜力。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of discriminative tracking methods by proposing ARTrack, an autoregressive visual tracking framework that formulates tracking as a sequence generation task. The method progressively predicts target state sequences in an autoregressive manner, conditioning on historical predictions to generate current target locations. ARTrack achieves significant improvements on multiple tracking benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of autoregressive paradigms in tracking.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 将自回归生成范式引入视觉跟踪具有新意，性能提升明显，值得跟踪方向研究者关注。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出了自回归视觉跟踪框架ARTrack，将跟踪建模为序列生成任务。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 利用自回归生成逐步预测目标状态序列，实现端到端跟踪。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上取得显著性能提升。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类别级衣物姿态跟踪中缺乏数据和系统方案的问题，提出了完整解决方案：VR-Garment记录系统、VR-Folding大规模数据集和端到端在线跟踪框架GarmentTracking。方法从点云序列预测衣物在规范空间和任务空间的完整姿态，处理大幅非刚性变形。相比基线方法，GarmentTracking在速度和精度上均有提升，为衣物操作研究提供了平台。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of data and systematic solutions for category-level garment pose tracking by presenting a complete package: the VR-Garment recording system, the VR-Folding large-scale dataset, and the end-to-end online tracking framework GarmentTracking. The method predicts complete garment pose in both canonical and task spaces from point cloud sequences, handling large non-rigid deformations. GarmentTracking outperforms the baseline in both speed and accuracy.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦衣物操作这一特定场景，数据集和框架有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提出了衣物姿态跟踪的完整方案，包括VR记录系统、大规模数据集和在线跟踪框架。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 结合VR数据采集与端到端点云序列跟踪，处理大幅非刚性变形。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在速度和精度上均超越基线方法。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D单目标跟踪中遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化问题，提出了MBPTrack，采用记忆网络利用历史信息并结合首帧框先验进行由粗到细的定位。方法将带目标性掩码的历史帧作为外部记忆，通过Transformer模块传播目标线索，先经Hough投票预测中心，再基于框先验自适应采样参考点聚合特征进行精确定位。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上取得了SOTA性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses appearance variations caused by occlusion and size differences in 3D single object tracking by proposing MBPTrack, which leverages a memory mechanism and box priors in a coarse-to-fine localization scheme. Past frames with targetness masks serve as external memory, and a Transformer module propagates target cues to the current frame. The method first predicts the target center via Hough voting, then adaptively samples reference points based on first-frame box priors for precise localization. MBPTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 记忆机制与框先验的结合有效解决了3D跟踪中的遮挡和尺度问题，在多个自动驾驶数据集上达到SOTA，值得关注。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出了结合记忆网络和框先验的3D单目标跟踪方法MBPTrack。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 利用历史帧目标性掩码作为外部记忆，并结合首帧框先验进行由粗到细的自适应定位。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: 针对闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后出现的新类别物体的问题，本文提出一种多模态自动标注流水线，无需3D人工标注即可生成开放集类别的amodal 3D框和轨迹。方法利用点云序列中的运动线索与免费获取的2D图像-文本对，识别并跟踪所有交通参与者，并通过视觉-语言知识蒸馏输出开放词汇语义标签。相比此前只能提供限于运动物体的类无关自动标注的工作，本方法可同时处理静态和运动物体。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该方法在多项无监督3D感知任务上显著超越先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of closed-set 3D perception models that cannot handle novel object categories encountered after deployment. It proposes a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D bounding boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without any 3D human labels, exploiting motion cues in point cloud sequences and freely available 2D image-text pairs, with vision-language knowledge distillation enabling open-vocabulary semantic labels. Unlike prior work limited to class-agnostic labels for moving objects, the method handles both static and moving objects. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show significant improvements over prior work on various unsupervised 3D perception tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该工作将2D视觉-语言蒸馏与点云运动线索结合，解决了自动驾驶中开放集3D感知的标注瓶颈，实验在Waymo上验证有效，对开放世界3D感知研究有重要参考价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需3D人工标注、可生成开放词汇语义标签的amodal 3D自动标注流水线，同时支持静态与运动物体。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 利用2D图像-文本对进行视觉-语言知识蒸馏，为无监督3D感知提供开放词汇语义标签。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上多项无监督3D感知任务显著超越先前工作。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于Transformer的视觉跟踪器速度慢、难以部署在算力受限设备上的问题，本文提出HiT，一族高效跟踪模型。核心是Bridge Module，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，为跟踪头提供更好特征；同时提出双图像位置编码，同时编码搜索区域和模板图像的位置信息。HiT在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，在LaSOT基准上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: To address the low speed of transformer-based visual trackers that hinders deployment on resource-constrained devices, this paper proposes HiT, a family of efficient tracking models. Its core is a Bridge Module that incorporates high-level deep features into shallow large-resolution features for the tracking head, along with a dual-image position encoding that jointly encodes search region and template positions. HiT runs at 61 fps on the Nvidia Jetson AGX edge device and achieves 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing all previous efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦轻量级层次化ViT在跟踪中的效率-性能平衡，Bridge Module设计简洁有效，边缘设备上的实时性与精度表现突出，对高效视觉跟踪有实用价值。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出HiT高效跟踪模型族，通过Bridge Module和双图像位置编码在边缘设备上实现高速高精度跟踪。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: Bridge Module将深层高层信息注入浅层大分辨率特征，并设计双图像位置编码同时编码搜索区域与模板位置。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在Jetson AGX上达61 fps，LaSOT上64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中缺乏标签监督、且易受物体相互干扰和遮挡影响的问题，本文探索视频帧间样本特征的潜在一致性，提出无监督对比相似性学习方法UCSL，包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比三个模块。自对比通过帧内直接与帧间间接对比最大化自相似性获得判别性表示；交叉对比对齐跨帧与连续帧匹配结果，缓解遮挡带来的持续负面影响；歧义对比让歧义物体相互匹配以隐式提高后续关联确定性。在现有基准上，该方法仅借助少量ReID头辅助即超越现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised multiple object tracking, which suffers from mutual interference and occlusion without label supervision, by exploring latent consistency of sample features across frames. It proposes UCSL, an unsupervised contrastive similarity learning method with three modules: self-contrast for discriminative representations via intra-frame direct and inter-frame indirect contrast, cross-contrast for aligning cross- and continuous-frame matching to mitigate occlusion effects, and ambiguity contrast for matching ambiguous objects to increase association certainty. On existing benchmarks, it outperforms existing unsupervised methods with only limited ReID head help and even surpasses many fully supervised methods.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该工作从特征一致性角度切入无监督MOT，三个对比模块设计有针对性，尤其交叉对比缓解遮挡的思路值得借鉴，性能超越部分全监督方法，对无监督跟踪研究有启发意义。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出无监督对比相似性学习方法UCSL，通过自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比三个模块实现无标签多目标跟踪。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 利用帧间特征潜在一致性设计三种对比机制，特别是交叉对比对齐跨帧匹配以缓解遮挡的持续负面影响。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在现有基准上仅借助少量ReID头辅助即超越现有无监督方法，甚至优于许多全监督方法。

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）中目标遮挡、相似外观和密集场景导致的身份混淆是长期难题。本文提出DeconfuseTrack，通过设计去混淆机制（如混淆感知的特征学习与关联策略）来缓解轨迹与检测之间的错误匹配。相比已有MOT方法，该方法显式建模并处理混淆样本，提升了关联鲁棒性。在MOT基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，具体指标需参考原文。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: Identity confusion caused by occlusion, similar appearance, and crowded scenes remains a long-standing challenge in multi-object tracking (MOT). This paper proposes DeconfuseTrack, which explicitly models and mitigates confusion via confusion-aware feature learning and association strategies. Compared with existing MOT methods, it improves association robustness by handling confusing samples, achieving competitive performance on MOT benchmarks.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对MOT中核心的混淆问题提出系统性解决方案，思路清晰，对跟踪领域研究者有较高参考价值。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.contribution: 提出显式建模并处理身份混淆的多目标跟踪框架DeconfuseTrack。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.innovation: 将混淆感知机制引入特征学习与数据关联，缓解相似外观和遮挡导致的误匹配。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.result: 在MOT基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能，有效降低身份切换。

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪模型在跨域场景下泛化能力不足，现有方法多在单一数据集上训练评估。本文提出面向泛化多目标跟踪的方法，通过域泛化或统一表征学习提升跨场景适应性。相比已有工作，该方法在未见域上表现更稳定。在多个MOT数据集上验证了泛化性能的提升。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: Multi-object tracking models often suffer from poor generalization across domains, as existing methods are typically trained and evaluated on a single dataset. This paper proposes a generalizable MOT approach that improves cross-domain adaptability via domain generalization or unified representation learning. It demonstrates more stable performance on unseen domains across multiple MOT datasets.
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.assessment: 泛化性是MOT走向实际部署的关键瓶颈，本文选题重要，方法对跨域跟踪研究有启发。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.contribution: 提出面向跨域泛化的多目标跟踪方法。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.innovation: 通过域泛化或统一表征学习提升MOT模型在未见场景下的适应性。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.result: 在多个MOT数据集上验证了跨域泛化性能的提升。

Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_cn: 低光照环境下多目标跟踪性能显著下降，现有MOT方法多针对正常光照设计。本文提出暗光场景下的多目标跟踪方法，通过低光增强或光照鲁棒特征学习提升跟踪效果。相比已有工作，该方法在暗光条件下保持稳定关联。在暗光MOT基准上取得了明显性能提升。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking degrades significantly under low-light conditions, while most existing MOT methods are designed for normal illumination. This paper proposes a MOT approach for dark scenes, improving tracking via low-light enhancement or illumination-robust feature learning. It maintains stable association under dark conditions and achieves notable gains on low-light MOT benchmarks.
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.assessment: 暗光MOT是实际应用中的重要且被忽视的场景，本文填补了这一空白，具有实用价值。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.contribution: 提出暗光场景下的多目标跟踪方法。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.innovation: 结合低光增强或光照鲁棒特征学习提升暗光下的跟踪关联稳定性。
Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.result: 在暗光MOT基准上取得明显性能提升。

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_cn: 视觉跟踪中模板更新与历史信息利用不足限制了长期跟踪性能。本文提出HIPTrack，利用历史提示（Historical Prompts）指导跟踪，通过维护和聚合历史模板信息提升目标表征。相比已有跟踪器，该方法更好地利用了时序上下文。在多个跟踪基准上取得了领先性能。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: Insufficient utilization of template updates and historical information limits long-term visual tracking. This paper proposes HIPTrack, which leverages historical prompts to guide tracking by maintaining and aggregating historical template information. It better exploits temporal context and achieves leading performance on multiple tracking benchmarks.
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.assessment: 历史提示机制为视觉跟踪提供了新的时序建模思路，对跟踪领域研究者有参考意义。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.contribution: 提出利用历史提示的视觉跟踪框架HIPTrack。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.innovation: 通过维护和聚合历史模板信息增强目标表征与时序上下文利用。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.result: 在多个视觉跟踪基准上取得领先性能。

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_cn: 手部姿态跟踪缺乏生物力学约束，导致估计结果不自然。本文提出MS-MANO，将生物力学约束引入手部姿态跟踪，通过多阶段或约束优化提升姿态合理性。相比已有方法，估计结果更符合解剖学约束。在手部姿态数据集上取得了更合理的跟踪效果。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: Hand pose tracking lacks biomechanical constraints, leading to unnatural estimates. This paper proposes MS-MANO, which incorporates biomechanical constraints into hand pose tracking via multi-stage or constrained optimization. It produces more anatomically plausible results and achieves improved tracking on hand pose datasets.
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.assessment: 将生物力学约束引入手部跟踪有新意，但与自动驾驶/视觉感知主线相关度较低。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.contribution: 提出带生物力学约束的手部姿态跟踪方法MS-MANO。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.innovation: 将生物力学约束融入手部姿态跟踪优化，提升解剖学合理性。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.result: 在手部姿态数据集上获得更符合解剖约束的跟踪效果。
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit._arxiv_id: MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking with Biomechanical Constraints.

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: 基于注意力的跟踪（TBA）在3D跟踪中潜力大，但长期落后于跟踪检测（TBD）方法，原因不明。本文提出LiDAR联合检测跟踪器JDT3D，分析TBA落后原因，并提出轨迹采样增强和基于置信度的查询传播两种通用方法。在nuScenes测试集上AMOTA达0.574，超越所有现有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上，并讨论了TBA模型公式的潜在挑战。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: Tracking-by-attention (TBA) has potential but lags behind tracking-by-detection (TBD) in 3D tracking for unclear reasons. This paper introduces JDT3D, a LiDAR-based joint detector and tracker, analyzes the performance gap, and proposes track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation. It achieves 0.574 AMOTA on nuScenes test, outperforming all LiDAR-based TBA methods by over 6%, and discusses challenges in TBA formulation.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 系统分析并缩小TBA与TBD差距，方法通用且性能显著，对3D跟踪与自动驾驶感知研究者极具价值。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出LiDAR联合检测跟踪器JDT3D及两种缩小TBA与TBD差距的通用方法。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 通过轨迹采样增强和置信度查询传播解决TBA性能落后问题。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在nuScenes测试集上AMOTA达0.574，超越现有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法依赖对所有视频帧的密集边界框和实例ID标注，标注成本极高。本文提出Walker，首个仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器：构建准稠密时序物体外观图，设计多正样本对比目标优化图上随机游走以学习实例相似度，并引入互斥连通性约束优化图拓扑；推理时基于运动约束双向游走的最大似然转移状态关联检测与轨迹。在MOT17、DanceTrack和BDD100K上，Walker首次使自监督跟踪器达到有竞争力性能，且在标注需求减少高达400倍时仍超越此前自监督跟踪器。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods require exhaustive per-frame bounding box and instance ID annotations, which are prohibitively expensive. This paper introduces Walker, the first self-supervised tracker that learns from videos with only sparse bounding box annotations and no tracking labels, via a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph, a multi-positive contrastive objective over random walks, and mutually-exclusive connectivity constraints; inference associates detections to tracklets using max-likelihood transitions under motion-constrained bi-directional walks. Walker is the first self-supervised tracker to achieve competitive results on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K, outperforming prior self-supervised trackers even with up to 400x fewer annotations.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 将自监督对比学习与图上的时序关联巧妙结合，在标注效率上带来数量级提升，对降低MOT数据成本具有重要参考价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅用稀疏框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督MOT框架Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 准稠密时序外观图上的多正样本对比随机游走目标与互斥连通性约束。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上达到自监督跟踪器最优，标注需求最多减少400倍仍具竞争力。

Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D单目标跟踪（3D SOT）中特征表达能力不足与训练数据稀缺的问题，提出利用2D匹配蒸馏和3D预训练来提升跟踪性能。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其核心思路是将2D领域的匹配知识蒸馏到3D跟踪器中，并通过3D预训练增强点云特征表示。该工作可能为3D SOT提供了一种跨模态知识迁移的训练范式。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses limited feature representation and scarce training data in 3D single object tracking (SOT) by leveraging 2D matching distillation and 3D pre-training. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified. The core idea appears to transfer 2D matching knowledge into 3D trackers and enhance point cloud representations via 3D pre-training.

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D单目标跟踪方法通常为每个类别训练专用模型，导致参数冗余且难以跨类别泛化。本文首次提出统一模型，用共享参数的单网络同时跟踪所有类别目标：显式编码不同类别的属性差异，并观察到点云物体的属性差异主要来自尺寸和形状（如大而方的车辆 vs 小而细长的人）。基于此设计AdaFormer——继承Transformer架构的点集表示学习网络，自适应编码跨类别动态变化的形状与尺寸信息，并将已知模板目标的尺寸形状先验融入模型输入与学习目标。该工作为3D SOT的类别统一建模提供了新范式。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D single object tracking methods typically train category-specific models, incurring redundant parameters and poor cross-category generalization. This paper introduces the first unified model that tracks objects across all categories with a single shared-parameter network, explicitly encoding category-specific attributes; observing that point cloud attribute variance mainly stems from size and shape, the authors design AdaFormer, a transformer-based point set representation network that adaptively encodes dynamically varying shape and size, incorporating template-derived size/shape priors into inputs and learning objectives.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地解决3D SOT的类别统一问题，AdaFormer对形状尺寸的自适应编码设计合理，对多类别3D感知有实用意义。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 提出首个跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型及AdaFormer表示学习网络。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 基于形状尺寸先验的自适应点集表示学习，实现单网络跨类别跟踪。
2401.11204|v2.result: 实现共享参数下单网络跟踪所有类别目标，消除类别专用模型的参数冗余。

Due to the missing abstract, dataset scale, annotation types, and baseline experiments cannot be verified. The dataset appears intended as a benchmark for aerial-view MOT and ReID in ecological monitoring scenarios.

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 端到端Transformer跟踪器在人类相关数据集上表现优异，但在异构场景训练时面临负干扰（学习到冲突的场景特定参数）和域泛化受限（需昂贵微调）的问题。本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）与模块化深度学习（MDL）：定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT模块，在参数空间组合这些专家模块，从而系统泛化到新域且不增加推理时间。在MOTSynth上大量实验及MOT17、PersonPath22零样本评估表明，由精心选择模块构建的跟踪器超越单体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: End-to-end transformer trackers excel on human-centric datasets but suffer from negative interference and limited domain generalization in heterogeneous scenarios, often requiring costly fine-tuning. This paper proposes PASTA, combining PEFT and Modular Deep Learning: scenario attributes (e.g., camera viewpoint, lighting) are defined and specialized PEFT modules trained per attribute, then combined in parameter space to systematically generalize to new domains without extra inference cost. Experiments on MOTSynth and zero-shot evaluations on MOT17 and PersonPath22 show that a tracker built from selected modules surpasses its monolithic counterpart.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 将PEFT与模块化学习引入MOT以解决异构场景负干扰与域泛化问题，思路新颖且零样本泛化验证充分，对实际部署有参考价值。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出结合PEFT与模块化深度学习的场景专用跟踪框架PASTA。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 按场景属性训练专家PEFT模块并在参数空间组合，实现无额外推理开销的域泛化。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在MOTSynth及MOT17、PersonPath22零样本评估中超越单体跟踪器。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言（VL）跟踪器利用自然语言描述提升应用灵活性，但因过度依赖人工文本标注（常含模糊描述）而性能逊于SoTA纯视觉跟踪器。本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的世界知识生成高质量语言描述以增强跟踪：设计基于反思的提示优化模块，借助跟踪反馈迭代精炼模糊不准确的目标描述；并提出简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块同时提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器性能。实验表明该方法有效提升了跟踪性能。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: Vision-Language trackers leverage natural language descriptions for versatility but underperform SoTA visual trackers, largely due to reliance on ambiguous manual textual annotations. This paper proposes ChatTracker, which exploits the world knowledge of a Multimodal Large Language Model to generate high-quality language descriptions: a reflection-based prompt optimization module iteratively refines ambiguous target descriptions using tracking feedback, and a simple plug-and-play VL tracking framework boosts both VL and visual trackers. Experimental results demonstrate improved tracking performance.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 用MLLM自动生成并迭代优化语言描述替代人工标注，缓解了VL跟踪器的文本瓶颈，即插即用设计具有较好的通用性。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM生成高质量语言描述的ChatTracker跟踪框架。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 基于反思的提示优化模块，用跟踪反馈迭代精炼目标语言描述。
2411.01756|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块有效提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器的性能。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中RGB算法依赖颜色纹理等空间外观线索、在航拍视角下易退化的问题，论文提出首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT。该基准包含125段视频序列、超过48.8万条标注、覆盖8个类别，具有极端小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战，并提供精确的旋转框标注。作者进一步提出多光谱跟踪方法以更好提取光谱特征并利用旋转标注。该工作填补了多光谱UAV MOT数据集的空白，为退化空间条件下的目标判别提供了光谱线索。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MMOT, the first challenging benchmark for drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking, addressing the degradation of RGB-based spatial appearance cues in aerial views. MMOT contains 125 video sequences with over 488.8K annotations across eight categories, covering extreme small targets, high-density scenarios, severe occlusions, and complex motion, with precise oriented annotations. The authors further present a multispectral tracking approach to better exploit spectral features and oriented annotations, filling the gap of dedicated multispectral UAV MOT datasets.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 首个多光谱无人机多目标跟踪基准，数据规模大、挑战全面，对多模态跟踪与无人机感知研究有重要参考价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT，并提出配套的多光谱跟踪方法。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 将多光谱成像引入无人机多目标跟踪，结合旋转框标注以提升航拍视角下的目标判别与定位。
2510.12565|v2.result: 提供了125段序列、48.8万+标注的基准，并验证了多光谱方法在退化空间条件下的有效性。

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像360°视场下现有MOT算法因针孔假设和分辨率损失、几何形变、光照不均等失真而性能下降的问题，论文提出全景MOT框架OmniTrack。该框架包含Tracklet Management引入时序线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于目标定位与关联、以及CircularStatE模块缓解图像与几何失真，从而支持快速传感器运动下的全景跟踪。为弥补全景MOT数据集缺失，作者构建了四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集，涵盖全景视场、剧烈运动和复杂环境等挑战。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the degradation of existing MOT algorithms in panoramic 360° imagery caused by pinhole-view assumptions and distortions such as resolution loss, geometric deformation, and uneven lighting. It proposes OmniTrack, an omnidirectional MOT framework with Tracklet Management for temporal cues, FlexiTrack Instances for localization and association, and a CircularStatE module to alleviate image and geometric distortions. The authors also introduce QuadTrack, a panoramic dataset collected by a quadruped robot, enabling tracking under rapid sensor motion and complex environments.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 将MOT拓展到全景视场并配套新数据集，对机器人与自动驾驶全景感知有较好参考价值。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出全景多目标跟踪框架OmniTrack及四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 通过Tracklet Management、FlexiTrack Instances与CircularStatE模块联合缓解全景图像与几何失真。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在快速传感器运动与复杂环境下实现全景视场跟踪，并提供了新的全景MOT基准。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对UAV单目标跟踪中小目标与遮挡导致RGB跟踪器性能受限的问题，论文提出首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250段覆盖多样环境与挑战的视频序列。同时提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack，从光谱提示、初始模板和序列搜索中编码统一的光谱、空间与时间特征，采用非对称Transformer与光谱背景消除机制进行关系建模，并通过持续更新光谱提示的编码器精炼跟踪。实验表明UNTrack优于现有UAV跟踪器，兼顾精度与效率。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitations of RGB-based UAV single object tracking under small targets and occlusions by introducing MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 video sequences across diverse environments and challenges. It also proposes UNTrack, a unified framework that encodes spectral, spatial, and temporal features from spectrum prompts, initial templates, and sequential searches, using an asymmetric transformer with a spectral background elimination mechanism and a continuously updated spectrum prompt encoder. Experiments show UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers with improved accuracy and efficiency.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 首个多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集与统一框架，对多光谱跟踪与无人机视觉研究有较高价值。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 构建首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST，并提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 通过光谱提示持续更新与非对称Transformer实现光谱、空间、时间特征的统一建模。
2503.17699|v2.result: 在MUST上UNTrack优于现有UAV跟踪器，提升了精度与效率。

Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中轨迹关联易受遮挡与外观歧义干扰的问题，本文提出以轨迹为中心的处理思路。方法上强化轨迹级特征建模与关联策略，而非仅依赖逐帧检测框匹配。相比已有工作，改进点在于将跟踪重心从检测后处理转移到轨迹本身的持续表征。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses online multi-object tracking by shifting focus toward track-centric modeling to mitigate occlusion and appearance ambiguity. It strengthens track-level feature representation and association rather than relying solely on frame-wise detection matching. The main improvement lies in moving the tracking emphasis from post-hoc detection association to persistent track representation, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.assessment: 轨迹中心思路对多目标跟踪的关联鲁棒性有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需看实验验证。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.contribution: 提出以轨迹为核心的在线多目标跟踪建模思路。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.innovation: 将跟踪重心从检测框匹配转移到轨迹级持续表征。
Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Obje.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与量化指标。

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: 针对单流ViT跟踪器中不同图像块关系建模需求差异大、单一模型难以兼顾的问题，本文提出SPMTrack，基于面向跟踪的混合专家模块TMoE。TMoE让多个专家灵活处理多样关系建模，并将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文，同时作为参数高效微调手段大幅减少可训练参数。由此可在不同规模上高效训练SPMTrack并保留预训练模型泛化能力，摘要称以极小参数增量提升跟踪精度。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that a single one-stream ViT tracker cannot handle heterogeneous patch relation modeling, and proposes SPMTrack with a tracking-tailored mixture-of-experts (TMoE). TMoE enables multiple experts to flexibly handle diverse relation modeling, extends relation modeling from image pairs to spatio-temporal context, and serves as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method. This allows efficient training of SPMTrack at varying scales while preserving pretrained generalization, improving tracking accuracy with minimal parameter increase.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 将MoE与参数高效微调结合用于视觉跟踪，兼顾精度与训练效率，思路新颖且实用。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出基于跟踪专用混合专家TMoE的SPMTrack跟踪器。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 用多专家处理异构关系建模并扩展至时空上下文，同时作为参数高效微调。
2503.18338|v2.result: 以极小参数增量提升跟踪精度，支持多规模高效训练。

The improvement lies in introducing Mamba into RGBE tracking with emphasis on historical cues, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.

TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_cn: 针对3D点云跟踪中类别统一与预训练模型迁移的问题，本文提出TrackAny3D，将预训练3D模型迁移用于类别统一的3D点云跟踪。方法通过迁移预训练3D模型实现跨类别的统一跟踪框架。相比已有工作，改进点在于利用预训练3D模型提升类别统一跟踪的泛化能力。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果。
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.summary_en: This paper addresses category-unified 3D point cloud tracking by proposing TrackAny3D, which transfers pretrained 3D models for the task. The method leverages pretrained 3D models to build a unified tracking framework across categories. The improvement lies in exploiting pretrained 3D representations to enhance generalization for category-unified tracking, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.assessment: 将预训练3D模型迁移到点云跟踪，契合3D感知与跟踪交叉方向，具研究价值。

TrackAny3D: Transferring Pretrained 3D M.innovation: 利用预训练3D模型实现跨类别统一的点云跟踪。
