2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）数据集规模小、类别少、模态单一，难以支撑通用场景下的鲁棒跟踪研究。本文提出GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个物体类别，每个序列同时提供点云、RGB图像和深度三种模态，支持单模态与多模态3D SOT任务，所有帧均经多轮人工标注与精修。作者评估了8个代表性点云跟踪模型，发现它们在GSOT3D上性能大幅下降，表明通用3D跟踪仍有很大提升空间。该基准是目前面向多种通用3D跟踪任务的最大规模数据集。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D single object tracking benchmarks are limited in scale, category diversity, and modality, hindering generic tracking research. This paper introduces GSOT3D, a benchmark with 620 sequences, 123K frames, and 54 object categories, each providing point cloud, RGB, and depth modalities to support single- and multi-modal 3D SOT. All frames are manually annotated with multi-round inspection. Evaluation of eight representative point cloud trackers reveals severe performance degradation, highlighting substantial room for improvement in generic 3D tracking.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了通用3D单目标跟踪基准的空白，多模态标注和大规模类别覆盖对推动鲁棒3D跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大规模、支持多模态与多类别的通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次在同一基准中同时提供点云、RGB和深度三种模态，并覆盖54个物体类别以支持多种3D跟踪任务。
2412.02129|v2.result: 8个代表性点云跟踪模型在该基准上性能显著下降，表明现有方法难以应对通用3D跟踪场景。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）现有方法主要依赖实例级检测与关联，忽略了轨迹信息在关联稳定性和分类准确性中的关键作用，尤其在遮挡和类别模糊场景下表现不佳。本文提出TRACT跟踪器，引入轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略提升目标身份与类别一致性，并设计即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，通过轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和轨迹语义丰富（TSE）充分利用轨迹信息。该方法在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提升了关联稳定性和分类精度，增强了对新类别的适应能力。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OV-MOT) methods rely primarily on instance-level detection and association, overlooking trajectory information that is crucial for association stability and classification under occlusion and category ambiguity. This paper proposes TRACT, which introduces a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement (TCR) strategy and a plug-and-play trajectory classification module TraCLIP with Trajectory Feature Aggregation (TFA) and Trajectory Semantic Enrichment (TSE). The method improves association stability and classification accuracy, enhancing adaptability to novel classes.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地将轨迹信息引入开放词汇多目标跟踪，思路新颖且模块即插即用，对提升OV-MOT鲁棒性有实际意义。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出利用轨迹信息同时改进开放词汇多目标跟踪中目标关联与分类的TRACT框架。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 设计轨迹一致性强化策略与即插即用的TraCLIP轨迹分类模块，通过轨迹特征聚合和语义丰富提升跟踪性能。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提升了关联稳定性和分类准确性，增强了对新类别的适应能力。

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 现有单目3D点跟踪器受深度模糊和遮挡困扰，而多相机方法通常需要20个以上相机且需逐序列优化，实用性差。本文提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，仅需4个相机即可前馈预测3D对应关系，实现鲁棒在线跟踪。方法在已知相机位姿和多视角深度条件下，将多视角特征融合为统一点云，利用k近邻关联和Transformer更新估计长程3D对应关系。在5K合成Kubric序列上训练，在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别取得3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8视角、24-150帧的视频。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: Existing monocular 3D point trackers suffer from depth ambiguity and occlusion, while multi-camera methods require over 20 cameras and tedious per-sequence optimization. This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that directly predicts 3D correspondences using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four), enabling robust online tracking. It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and applies k-NN correlation with a transformer-based update. Trained on 5K synthetic Kubric sequences, it achieves median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, generalizing to 1-8 views and 24-150 frames.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作首次实现数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪，仅需4个相机即可在线运行，实用性强，对多相机感知与跟踪研究有参考价值。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，仅需4个相机即可实现鲁棒在线3D点跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 将多视角特征融合为统一点云，结合k近邻关联与Transformer更新，在少量相机下实现长程3D对应估计。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别取得3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8视角和24-150帧视频。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 多模态数据可提升视觉跟踪鲁棒性，但传感器同步问题常导致模态在时间上不完整，现有跟踪器因架构刚性在缺失模态时性能显著下降。本文首次系统研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪器性能，提出灵活的多模态跟踪框架，通过异构混合专家融合机制（Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts）根据缺失率动态激活计算单元，并结合视频级掩码策略保证时间一致性和空间完整性。该模型不仅能适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度自适应调整，在缺失模态场景下显著优于现有方法。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: Multimodal data improves visual tracking robustness, but sensor synchronization issues often cause temporally incomplete modalities, and existing trackers degrade significantly due to rigid architectures. This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracking with temporally incomplete multimodal data and proposes a flexible framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism that dynamically activates computational units based on missing rates, coupled with a video-level masking strategy for temporal consistency and spatial completeness. The model adapts to varying missing rates and scene complexity, significantly outperforming existing methods under missing modalities.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统研究时间不完整多模态跟踪问题，提出的自适应混合专家框架针对性强，对实际多传感器系统中的模态缺失问题有重要参考价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪问题，并提出自适应多模态跟踪框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 设计异构混合专家融合机制与视频级掩码策略，根据缺失率动态激活计算单元并保证时空一致性。
2507.05899|v2.result: 在模态缺失场景下显著优于现有跟踪器，并能根据缺失率和场景复杂度自适应调整。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中数据关联依赖手工设计启发式规则、难以端到端优化的问题，提出 LA-MOTR，将关联过程建模为可学习的模块，嵌入到基于 Transformer 的端到端跟踪框架中。方法通过可微分关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配或 IoU 阈值策略，使检测、关联与轨迹管理联合优化。相比 MOTR 等端到端方法，LA-MOTR 在关联鲁棒性上有所提升，尤其在遮挡与密集场景下减少 ID switch。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值指标，需查阅正文验证其相对 MOTR/DETR-based 方法的实际增益。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: LA-MOTR addresses the reliance on hand-crafted heuristics for data association in multi-object tracking by introducing a learnable association module within an end-to-end Transformer-based tracking framework. The method replaces traditional Hungarian matching or IoU-based association with a differentiable association predictor, enabling joint optimization of detection, association, and track management. It improves association robustness over prior end-to-end trackers such as MOTR, particularly in crowded and occluded scenes, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 将数据关联从手工规则转为可学习模块是 MOT 端到端化的重要一步，若实验充分则对跟踪社区有参考价值。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习的关联模块，实现检测-关联-轨迹管理的联合端到端优化。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 用可微分关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配或 IoU 阈值策略。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 在遮挡与密集场景下减少 ID switch，关联鲁棒性优于 MOTR 等端到端方法（摘要未给具体数值）。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇 3D 实例分割（OV-3DIS）中现有概念彼此孤立、未有效整合的问题，提出一套将互补概念系统组合并精炼的两阶段方案：3D 提议生成与实例分类。方法采用基于 3D 跟踪的提议聚合生成 3D 提议，并通过迭代合并/移除去除重叠与部分提议；分类阶段用 Alpha-CLIP 替代标准 CLIP，以对象掩码作为 alpha 通道降低背景噪声，并引入标准化最大相似度（SMS）分数归一化文本-提议相似度以过滤假阳性。相比已有 OV-3DIS 方法，该方案在多个基准上取得 SOTA，验证了细节设计对开放词汇 3D 分割的重要性。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS) by observing that existing concepts are complementary rather than mutually exclusive, and proposes a carefully designed two-stage recipe combining 3D proposal generation and instance classification. It employs tracking-based proposal aggregation with iterative merging/removal, replaces CLIP with Alpha-CLIP using object masks as an alpha channel for object-centric representations, and introduces a standardized maximum similarity (SMS) score to normalize text-to-proposal similarity and filter false positives. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on OV-3DIS benchmarks, demonstrating that meticulous design details matter.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 系统性地整合并精炼已有概念，Alpha-CLIP 与 SMS 的设计对开放词汇 3D 感知有直接借鉴意义。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出一套组合并精炼互补概念的 OV-3DIS 两阶段方案，达到 SOTA。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 用 Alpha-CLIP 掩码 alpha 通道获取对象中心表示，并引入 SMS 分数归一化文本-提议相似度。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在 OV-3DIS 基准上取得 SOTA，有效过滤假阳性并提升精度。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶动态城市场景建模与渲染中，高质量方法依赖昂贵人工轨迹标注、而自监督方法难以准确捕捉动态物体运动并正确分解场景导致渲染伪影的问题，提出 AD-GS 自监督框架，从单条日志实现高质量自由视点渲染。核心是可学习运动模型，将局部感知 B 样条曲线与全局感知三角函数结合，实现灵活且精确的动态物体建模；无需完整语义标注，通过简化伪 2D 分割自动分离物体与背景，用动态高斯与双向时序可见性掩码表示物体，并引入可见性推理与物理刚性正则增强鲁棒性。实验表明该无标注模型显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: AD-GS addresses high-quality free-viewpoint rendering of dynamic urban driving scenes without costly manual tracklet annotations, where prior self-supervised methods fail to capture dynamic motion and decompose scenes properly. It introduces a learnable motion model combining locality-aware B-spline curves with global-aware trigonometric functions, automatic object/background separation via simplified pseudo 2D segmentation, dynamic Gaussians with bidirectional temporal visibility masks, and visibility reasoning plus physically rigid regularization. Extensive evaluations show the annotation-free model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art annotation-free methods and is competitive with annotation-dependent ones.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 将 B 样条与高斯泼溅结合用于自监督驾驶场景渲染，对自动驾驶仿真与数据合成有实用价值。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出无标注的自监督 B 样条高斯泼溅框架 AD-GS，实现动态驾驶场景高质量自由视点渲染。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 局部 B 样条与全局三角函数融合的可学习运动模型，配合双向时序可见性掩码与物理刚性正则。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中现有跟踪器受框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立、模态交互不足，导致开放词汇分类与跟踪性能受限的问题，提出 OVTR——首个同时建模运动、外观与类别的端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法设计类别信息传播（CIP）策略，为后续帧建立多个高层类别先验以实现稳定分类与连续跟踪；引入双分支结构增强泛化能力与深度多模态交互，并在解码器中加入保护策略提升性能。实验表明 OVTR 在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越先前跟踪器，同时推理更快并显著减少参数量。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: OVTR targets open-vocabulary multiple object tracking, where existing trackers suffer from rigid framework structures, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modal interactions. It proposes the first end-to-end open-vocabulary tracker that jointly models motion, appearance, and category, featuring a Category Information Propagation (CIP) strategy to establish high-level category priors across frames, a dual-branch structure for generalization and deep multimodal interaction, and protective strategies in the decoder. Results show OVTR surpasses previous trackers on the open-vocabulary MOT benchmark with faster inference and significantly reduced parameters.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器，CIP 策略与双分支设计对开放世界跟踪有明确推进。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个同时建模运动、外观与类别的端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器 OVTR。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播（CIP）策略为后续帧建立高层类别先验，配合双分支泛化结构与解码器保护策略。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越先前跟踪器，推理更快且参数量显著减少。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中像素级、长序列稠密 3D 运动跟踪计算效率低或只能稀疏跟踪的问题，提出 DELTA，可高效跟踪视频中每个像素的 3D 运动。方法在低分辨率下采用联合全局-局部注意力机制进行跟踪，再用基于 Transformer 的上采样器获得高分辨率预测；同时探究深度表示对跟踪性能的影响，发现 log-depth 为最优选择。实验表明 DELTA 比先前方法快 8 倍以上，并在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪任务上均取得新的 SOTA，为需要细粒度长期 3D 运动跟踪的应用提供稳健方案。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: DELTA addresses dense, pixel-level 3D motion tracking from monocular videos over long sequences, where prior methods are limited by computational inefficiency or sparse tracking. It leverages joint global-local attention for reduced-resolution tracking followed by a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions, and identifies log-depth as the optimal depth representation. DELTA runs over 8x faster than previous methods and achieves new state-of-the-art results on both 2D and 3D dense tracking benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 在效率与精度上同时推进稠密 3D 跟踪，log-depth 的发现对深度表示选择有指导意义。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效稠密长程 3D 跟踪方法 DELTA，实现像素级 3D 运动估计。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 联合全局-局部注意力低分辨率跟踪加 Transformer 上采样，并确认 log-depth 为最优深度表示。
2410.24211|v2.result: 比先前方法快 8 倍以上，在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪基准上均取得 SOTA。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对从互联网教学视频中提取被操作物体时序一致的 6D 位姿轨迹这一难题（拍摄条件不可控、物体运动细微且动态、且未知物体精确网格），提出一套无需物体先验知识的 6D 位姿估计方法：先从大规模模型数据库检索相似 CAD 模型，再与输入图像进行 6D 对齐，并基于场景确定物体绝对尺度；随后跨帧跟踪检测物体以提取平滑 6D 轨迹，并通过轨迹优化重定向到机械臂配置空间。在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上进行了充分评估与消融。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles extracting temporally consistent 6D pose trajectories of manipulated objects from Internet instructional videos, where uncontrolled capture conditions, subtle dynamic motions, and unknown object meshes pose challenges. The method estimates 6D pose without prior object knowledge by retrieving a similar CAD model from a large database, aligning it with the input image, and grounding absolute scale, then tracks objects across frames to extract smooth 6D trajectories that are retargeted to a robot manipulator via trajectory optimization. It is thoroughly evaluated and ablated on YCB-V, HOPE-Video, and a new dataset.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 面向机器人操作的互联网视频 6D 位姿跟踪，问题设定新颖，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出无需物体先验的 6D 位姿估计与轨迹提取方法，并将轨迹重定向至机械臂操作空间。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 结合 CAD 模型检索、6D 对齐与绝对尺度定位，从互联网视频提取平滑 6D 轨迹并重定向到机器人。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上完成评估与消融，验证方法有效性。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对复杂场景（如群舞、团队运动、动物群体）中多目标跟踪的难题：目标运动高度协调、频繁互相遮挡、轨迹存在长期依赖，而现有方法难以同时建模轨迹内部的长程依赖、轨迹间的相互依赖以及时序遮挡。作者提出 Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间（selective state-space）来联合处理多条轨迹，自回归预测每条序列的未来 track query 并保持跨轨迹同步的长期记忆表示；将其嵌入 tracking-by-propagation 框架得到 SambaMOTR，并引入处理不确定观测的 MaskObs 技术。相比已有工作，SambaMOTR 首次同时有效应对长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡三类问题，并在 DanceTrack、SportsMOT 等数据集上取得领先性能。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multiple object tracking in highly coordinated scenarios (dance, team sports, animal groups) where objects move in correlated patterns, occlude each other, and exhibit long-term trajectory dependencies, which existing methods struggle to model jointly. It proposes Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces to jointly process tracklets, autoregressively predicting future track queries while maintaining synchronized long-term memory across sequences. Integrated into a tracking-by-propagation framework as SambaMOTR, with a MaskObs technique for uncertain observations, it is the first tracker to effectively address long-range dependencies, tracklet interdependencies, and temporal occlusions, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmarks such as DanceTrack and SportsMOT.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 将 Mamba/状态空间模型引入多目标跟踪并显式建模轨迹间同步依赖，思路新颖且线性复杂度对长序列友好，对自动驾驶中的多目标跟踪与轨迹预测有借鉴价值。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出线性时间的集合序列模型 Samba 及跟踪框架 SambaMOTR，统一建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 用同步的多选择性状态空间对多条轨迹进行联合自回归建模，并配合 MaskObs 处理不确定观测。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在 DanceTrack、SportsMOT 等协调运动跟踪基准上取得领先性能，验证了对长程依赖与遮挡场景的有效性。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）中检测与跟踪通常分阶段进行，且运动模型多依赖线性假设，难以处理非线性运动与遮挡。该论文提出同时检测与跟踪的框架，并引入运动建模（motion modelling）来联合优化检测与轨迹关联。相比已有两阶段方法，其改进在于将运动信息嵌入检测阶段，实现端到端的多目标跟踪。在 MOT 基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，提升了跟踪精度与鲁棒性。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-object tracking (MOT) where detection and tracking are typically performed in separate stages with linear motion assumptions. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework with motion modelling to jointly optimize detection and trajectory association. Compared with existing two-stage methods, it embeds motion information into the detection stage for end-to-end MOT, achieving competitive results on MOT benchmarks with improved tracking accuracy and robustness.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 将运动建模与检测跟踪联合优化，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有实际参考价值。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出同时检测与跟踪并融合运动建模的 MOT 框架。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 将运动信息嵌入检测阶段实现端到端联合优化。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪精度与鲁棒性提升。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: 该论文研究多目标跟踪（MOT）系统在对抗攻击下的脆弱性，指出仅攻击检测模块不足以破坏跟踪。作者提出针对 MOT 的对抗攻击方法，同时干扰检测与数据关联环节。相比仅攻击检测的已有工作，其改进在于揭示了跟踪级联的额外攻击面。实验表明该攻击能显著降低 MOT 性能，说明 MOT 安全性需整体考虑。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper studies the vulnerability of multi-object tracking (MOT) systems under adversarial attacks, arguing that fooling detection alone is insufficient to break tracking. It proposes an adversarial attack targeting both detection and data association in MOT. Compared with prior work that only attacks detection, it reveals additional attack surfaces in the tracking cascade, and experiments show significant MOT performance degradation, highlighting the need for holistic MOT security.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 从对抗安全角度审视 MOT，对自动驾驶感知鲁棒性研究有警示意义。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出同时攻击检测与关联的 MOT 对抗攻击方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 揭示仅攻击检测不足以破坏跟踪的级联攻击面。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 实验显示该攻击显著降低 MOT 性能。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中的轨迹关联可建模为图优化问题，但传统方法难以处理轨迹分裂与合并。该论文提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型，将多目标跟踪转化为带提升结构的不相交路径问题。相比已有图优化方法，其改进在于能更灵活地表达轨迹间的复杂关系。在 MOT 数据集上验证了该模型的有效性，提升了关联质量。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper addresses trajectory association in multi-object tracking, which can be formulated as graph optimization but remains challenging for track splits and merges. It proposes a Lifted Disjoint Paths model that casts MOT as a disjoint path problem with lifted structures. Compared with existing graph optimization methods, it more flexibly represents complex inter-track relations, and experiments on MOT datasets validate improved association quality.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 为 MOT 关联提供新的图优化建模视角，对跟踪算法设计有理论参考价值。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型用于多目标跟踪关联。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 用提升不相交路径结构表达轨迹间复杂关系。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 在 MOT 数据集上验证并提升了关联质量。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT缺乏局部归纳偏置、局部细节建模不足的问题，提出Doubly-Fused ViT，通过双重融合机制将局部表示信息注入ViT。方法在ViT的注意力或特征层面引入局部卷积分支/局部token融合，以增强对细粒度空间结构的感知。相比纯ViT，改进点在于同时从浅层和深层融合局部信息，兼顾全局建模与局部细节。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，效果需结合全文验证。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of local inductive bias in Vision Transformers by proposing Doubly-Fused ViT, which injects local representation information into ViT through a dual fusion mechanism. The method enhances fine-grained spatial modeling while preserving global attention. Compared with plain ViT, it improves local detail perception, though quantitative results are not available in the provided abstract.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 面向ViT局部建模的改进工作，思路直观，但需看实验是否在检测/分割等下游任务上有实质提升。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出双重融合局部表示的ViT架构。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 从两个层面融合局部信息以弥补ViT局部建模不足。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，效果需全文确认。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习依赖像素级伪造位置标注的问题，提出无监督不一致感知方法UIA-ViT。方法仅使用视频级标签，利用ViT自注意力图天然表示patch间一致性关系，设计无监督patch一致性学习（UPCL）和渐进式学习组件。相比需要像素级标注或成对真假图像的方法，UIA-ViT无需额外标注且能捕捉伪造区域特性。摘要未给出具体指标，但声称在泛化性上优于已有方法。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles face forgery detection where learning intra-frame inconsistency typically requires pixel-level annotations, and proposes UIA-ViT, an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method based on ViT. Using only video-level labels, it exploits self-attention maps to represent patch consistency and introduces Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning and a progressive component. It avoids pixel-level or paired-data supervision and is claimed to improve generalization.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 将ViT自注意力用于无监督伪造检测的思路有新意，但领域偏安全/取证，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出仅用视频级标签的无监督不一致感知ViT伪造检测框架。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力图作为patch一致性表示，无需像素级标注。
2210.12752|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称泛化性优于依赖像素标注的方法。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT可解释性差的问题，提出ViT-NeT，将ViT与神经树解码器结合，实现可解释的图像分类。方法在ViT特征之上构建神经决策树，使预测路径可追溯至具体图像区域或语义概念。相比纯ViT的黑盒特性，改进点在于提供结构化、可解释的推理过程。摘要未提供具体数据集与精度数据，效果需全文确认。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor interpretability of ViTs by proposing ViT-NeT, which combines a ViT backbone with a neural tree decoder for interpretable classification. The neural tree provides traceable decision paths linked to image regions or concepts. Compared with black-box ViT, it offers structured interpretability, though quantitative results are not available in the abstract.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 可解释ViT方向的工作，对需要理解模型决策的感知系统有参考价值，但需验证精度是否受损。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出ViT与神经树解码器结合的可解释分类框架。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 用神经树结构为ViT预测提供可追溯的决策路径。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，效果需全文确认。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 该论文针对多尺度ViT骨干在目标检测与实例分割中结构复杂、计算开销大的问题，提出一种简单的单尺度ViT架构。方法去除多尺度层级设计，采用单一尺度ViT并配合适配检测/分割的简单设计，降低复杂度同时保持性能。相比Swin等多尺度ViT，改进点在于结构更简单、更易训练与部署。摘要未给出具体AP数值，但声称在检测与实例分割上具有竞争力。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of multi-scale ViT backbones for object detection and instance segmentation by proposing a simple single-scale ViT architecture. It removes hierarchical multi-scale design and adopts a single-scale ViT with detection/segmentation-friendly adaptations. Compared with multi-scale ViTs such as Swin, it is simpler and easier to train while remaining competitive, though specific AP numbers are not provided in the abstract.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 对自动驾驶感知中骨干网络选型有直接参考价值，单尺度ViT若性能不降则部署优势明显。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出用于检测与实例分割的简单单尺度ViT骨干。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 以单尺度ViT替代多尺度层级设计，简化检测架构。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.result: 摘要未给出具体AP，声称在检测与实例分割上具竞争力。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自注意力随图像尺寸二次增长、难以作为通用视觉骨干的问题，提出多轴注意力（multi-axis attention），由分块局部注意力与空洞全局注意力组成，实现任意分辨率下的线性复杂度全局-局部交互。方法将多轴注意力与卷积融合，构建分层骨干MaxViT，可在整个网络包括高分辨率早期阶段保持全局感受野。在ImageNet-1K上无额外数据达到86.5% top-1，ImageNet-21K预训练后进一步提升，并在分类、检测、分割等多任务上取得领先或竞争性结果。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic scaling of self-attention with image size by introducing multi-axis attention, composed of blocked local and dilated global attention, enabling linear-complexity global-local interactions at arbitrary resolutions. Blending this attention with convolutions yields MaxViT, a hierarchical backbone that maintains global receptive field even in high-resolution stages. It achieves 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 without extra data and strong results across classification, detection, and segmentation.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: MaxViT是视觉骨干的重要工作，线性复杂度全局注意力对高分辨率自动驾驶感知任务尤其有价值，值得深入阅读与复现。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出多轴注意力与MaxViT分层骨干，实现线性复杂度的全局-局部建模。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 分块局部+空洞全局注意力并与卷积融合，全网络保持全局感受野。
2204.01697|v2.result: ImageNet-1K无额外数据86.5% top-1，多任务上达到领先或竞争性性能。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习（online CL）中无任务边界数据流下的灾难性遗忘问题，提出对比视觉Transformer框架CVT。方法设计面向在线CL的外部注意力机制隐式捕获历史任务信息，为每个类别引入可学习focus以累积旧类知识，并基于focus设计焦点对比损失以平衡新旧类对比学习，同时采用双分类器结构解耦当前类学习与已观测类平衡。实验表明在在线CL基准上以更少参数达到SOTA并有效缓解遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning without task boundaries and proposes Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT). It introduces an external attention mechanism to implicitly capture past-task information, learnable per-class focuses to accumulate old-class knowledge, a focal contrastive loss to rebalance new-vs-past contrastive learning, and a dual-classifier structure to decouple current-class learning from balancing observed classes. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters on online CL benchmarks.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 将ViT与对比学习结合用于在线持续学习，对自动驾驶中模型在线更新与长尾场景适应有借鉴意义。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出基于ViT的焦点对比学习在线持续学习框架CVT。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 外部注意力+可学习类别focus+焦点对比损失+双分类器解耦。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在在线CL基准上以更少参数达到SOTA并有效缓解遗忘。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏归纳偏置、训练数据效率低和局部语义表征弱的问题，本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观结构对分层ViT性能的影响，重点分析了token embedding层（即卷积嵌入CE）如何注入归纳偏置。作者将最优CE配置应用于4个最新SOTA ViT并构建了CETNets系列通用骨干网络。在ImageNet-1K上CETNets取得84.9% Top-1准确率，验证了卷积嵌入对分层ViT的显著增益。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how the macro architecture of hybrid CNN/ViT models enhances hierarchical ViTs, focusing on the role of convolutional embedding (CE) in injecting inductive bias. The optimal CE configuration is applied to four recent state-of-the-art ViTs, yielding a family of efficient hybrid backbones named CETNets. CETNets achieve 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K, demonstrating the effectiveness of convolutional embedding for hierarchical ViTs.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 对ViT骨干网络设计有参考价值，卷积嵌入的系统性分析对自动驾驶感知中的高效backbone选型有启发，但未直接涉及3D检测或BEV任务。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了卷积嵌入层为分层ViT注入归纳偏置的机制，并发布了CETNets通用视觉骨干系列。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构层面而非微观CNN模块层面研究混合CNN/ViT的归纳偏置注入方式。
2207.13317|v2.result: CETNets在ImageNet-1K上达到84.9% Top-1准确率，应用于4个SOTA ViT均有效提升性能。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper addresses video object re-identification by proposing CAViT, a Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer. The method aims to enhance feature representation through contextual alignment across frames. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be assessed.
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.assessment: 视频ReID与自动驾驶感知中的跟踪任务有一定关联，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法质量和实验效果。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.contribution: 提出了一种基于上下文对齐的ViT架构用于视频目标重识别。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.innovation: 将上下文对齐机制引入ViT以增强视频ReID中的跨帧特征表达。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.result: 摘要缺失，无法获取具体实验数据。

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: 针对vanilla自注意力机制依赖预定义固定计算维度、缺乏面向上下文的泛化能力的问题，本文提出Scalable Self-Attention（SSA）机制，利用两个缩放因子释放Q/K/V矩阵维度并与输入解绑，同时提出Interactive Window-based Self-Attention（IWSA）通过重新合并独立value token和聚合相邻窗口空间信息建立非重叠区域间的交互。交替堆叠SSA和IWSA构成ScalableViT，在ImageNet-1K上ScalableViT-S比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%、比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) that leverages scaling factors to decouple Q/K/V dimensions from the input, along with Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) that establishes cross-window interaction. Stacking SSA and IWSA yields ScalableViT, which outperforms Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K classification.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 对ViT注意力机制的灵活性改进有学术价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知任务关联较弱，属于通用视觉骨干网络研究。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出了可扩展自注意力SSA和交互窗口自注意力IWSA，构建了ScalableViT通用视觉骨干。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过缩放因子解绑Q/K/V维度与输入，实现面向上下文的泛化并增强目标敏感性。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: This paper proposes a Panoramic Vision Transformer for saliency detection in 360° videos. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological contributions and experimental results cannot be evaluated. The work likely adapts ViT to equirectangular panoramic inputs for saliency prediction.

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT因token-to-token比较导致计算负担大、现有硬丢弃策略在高丢弃率下丢失关键token的问题，本文提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT。具体设计了Token Slimming Module（TSM），通过动态token聚合将冗余token软性整合为少量信息量大的token，避免切断判别性token关系；同时引入Feature Recalibration Distillation（FRD）框架，设计反向TSM（RTSM）以自编码器方式灵活重校准非结构化token。该方法在高瘦身率下仍能保持ViT效率与精度的良好平衡。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes SiT, a self-slimmed learning approach for ViTs that addresses the limitation of hard token dropping. A Token Slimming Module (TSM) dynamically aggregates redundant tokens into fewer informative ones, while a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework with reverse TSM recalibrates unstructured tokens. SiT maintains discriminative token relations even at high slimming ratios, achieving an effective efficiency-accuracy trade-off.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: token压缩与剪枝方向对自动驾驶实时感知部署有实际价值，方法设计较为完整，但实验主要在分类任务上验证。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出了软性token聚合的TSM模块和特征重校准蒸馏FRD框架，实现ViT的自瘦身学习。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 用动态token聚合替代硬丢弃，并通过反向TSM自编码器重校准token，避免高压缩率下的信息损失。
2111.12624|v2.result: 在高瘦身率下仍保持判别性token关系，实现效率与精度的有效平衡。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_cn: 本文提出CrossFormer，一种基于跨尺度注意力（Cross-scale Attention）的通用Vision Transformer。由于摘要为空，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。从标题推断，该方法通过跨尺度注意力机制解决ViT在多尺度特征建模方面的不足，旨在构建适用于多种视觉任务的通用骨干网络。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: This paper proposes CrossFormer, a versatile Vision Transformer hinging on cross-scale attention. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be assessed. The work likely addresses multi-scale feature modeling in ViTs through a cross-scale attention mechanism.
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.assessment: 跨尺度注意力对多尺度目标检测有潜在价值，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献和实验充分度。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.contribution: 提出了基于跨尺度注意力的通用Vision Transformer骨干网络CrossFormer。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.innovation: 通过跨尺度注意力机制增强ViT的多尺度特征建模能力。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.result: 摘要缺失，无法获取具体实验数据。

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉关系推理中实体识别、关系推断与系统性泛化三个难题，论文以 ViT 为基础模型，提出概念特征字典，用概念键在训练时灵活检索图像特征，并设计全局关系推理与局部物体中心对应两个概念引导辅助任务。为评估系统性泛化，作者为 HICO 和 GQA 构建了系统性划分。RelViT 在这些基准上提升了视觉关系推理与组合泛化能力。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: The paper tackles visual relational reasoning, which jointly requires entity identification, semantic relation inference, and systematic generalization to novel object-relation combinations. It introduces a concept-feature dictionary that enables flexible image feature retrieval with concept keys, along with two concept-guided auxiliary tasks: a global relational reasoning task and a local object-centric correspondence task. Systematic splits for HICO and GQA are proposed to evaluate generalization, and RelViT improves relational reasoning performance.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 对视觉关系推理与 ViT 辅助任务设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知/3D 检测的直接关联较弱。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念引导的 ViT 框架 RelViT 及用于系统性泛化评估的 HICO/GQA 划分。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 用概念特征字典和概念引导的全局/局部辅助任务增强 ViT 的关系推理能力。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在 HICO 和 GQA 的系统性划分上提升了视觉关系推理与组合泛化表现。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: 论文发现 ImageNet 训练的 ViT 过度依赖局部纹理、对形状信息利用不足，导致在分布外真实数据上泛化困难。为此作者在 ViT 输入层加入由矢量量化编码器产生的离散 token，与连续像素 token 相比，离散 token 对小扰动不变且单 token 信息量更低，促使模型学习不变的全局信息。在四种架构变体、七个 ImageNet 鲁棒性基准上，鲁棒性最高提升 12%，同时保持 ImageNet 性能。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: The paper identifies that ImageNet-trained ViTs overly rely on local textures and underuse shape information, hurting out-of-distribution generalization. It proposes a simple input-layer modification that adds discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder, which are perturbation-invariant and individually less informative, encouraging globally invariant representations. Across four architecture variants and seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks, robustness improves by up to 12% while maintaining ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 方法简单有效，对提升 ViT 鲁棒性有实用价值，但主要面向图像分类，与自动驾驶 3D 感知关联有限。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出在 ViT 输入层引入矢量量化离散 token 以增强鲁棒性的架构修改。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用离散表示的扰动不变性和低信息量特性，引导 ViT 学习全局不变特征。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在七个 ImageNet 鲁棒性基准上最高提升 12% 鲁棒性，同时保持 ImageNet 性能。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: 针对ViT中自注意力计算复杂度高、缺乏局部归纳偏置的问题，提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention（PaCa），将patch级token聚类为簇并在patch与簇之间进行注意力计算。方法通过可学习的聚类分配降低注意力矩阵规模，同时保留全局与局部信息交互。相比标准全局自注意力，PaCa在保持精度的同时显著降低计算量，在ImageNet等分类基准上取得有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic cost and weak local inductive bias of standard self-attention in Vision Transformers by proposing Patch-to-Cluster Attention (PaCa), which clusters patch tokens and computes attention between patches and cluster centers. The learned clustering reduces the attention matrix size while preserving global-local interaction. Compared with full global attention, PaCa achieves a competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-off on ImageNet classification.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 为ViT注意力效率问题提供了一种聚类式折中方案，思路清晰，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在下游检测/分割任务上的泛化性。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention，将patch与簇之间的注意力作为高效全局建模的替代。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 用可学习聚类把patch级token压缩为簇级表示，降低注意力复杂度。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在ImageNet分类上取得有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: 针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题，提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段将标准自注意力切换为线性角度注意力（linear-angular attention）。方法通过训练时保留标准注意力、推理时替换为线性复杂度模块，实现无需重训练的高效推理。相比纯线性注意力方法，Castling-ViT在保持精度的同时显著降低计算量，为ViT部署提供了一种压缩路径。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: This paper targets the high inference cost of self-attention in Vision Transformers and proposes Castling-ViT, which switches standard self-attention to linear-angular attention at inference time. By training with standard attention and replacing it with a linear-complexity module during inference, the method enables efficient deployment without retraining. Compared with purely linear attention approaches, Castling-ViT maintains accuracy while substantially reducing computation.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 推理时注意力替换的思路对ViT部署有实用价值，但摘要缺失具体实验数据，需核实其精度损失与加速比。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出推理时从标准自注意力切换到线性角度注意力的压缩方案。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 训练-推理注意力解耦，推理阶段用线性角度注意力替代二次复杂度注意力。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 在保持精度的同时降低ViT推理计算量。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时存储与计算开销大、且现有dyadic算术仅适用于CNN同质性条件而无法处理ViT非线性组件的问题，提出I-ViT整数-only量化方案。方法对MatMul、Dense等线性操作沿用dyadic整数流水线，对Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm等非线性操作提出轻量整数近似（如Shiftmax、ShiftGELU、ShiftLayerNorm）。相比已有量化方法，I-ViT实现全整数计算图推理，无需任何浮点运算，在保持精度的同时支持高效边缘部署。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of deploying Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing I-ViT, an integer-only quantization scheme. Linear operations (MatMul, Dense) follow a dyadic integer pipeline, while non-linear operations (Softmax, GELU, LayerNorm) are approximated by lightweight integer-only methods such as Shiftmax, ShiftGELU, and ShiftLayerNorm. Unlike prior quantization approaches, I-ViT enables the entire inference graph to run with integer arithmetic and bit-shifting, achieving efficient edge deployment with maintained accuracy.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 解决了ViT整数-only推理中非线性组件难以量化这一关键工程问题，对边缘端ViT部署有直接价值。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出首个覆盖ViT全计算图的整数-only量化方案I-ViT。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 针对Softmax/GELU/LayerNorm设计轻量整数近似，突破dyadic算术的同质性限制。
2207.01405|v2.result: 实现全整数推理且保持精度，支持高效边缘部署。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段HOI检测器因旧骨干网络和交互分类器缺乏对人类交互感知过程建模而性能低于一阶段方法的问题，提出基于ViT的姿态条件自环图ViPLO。方法设计Masking with Overlapped Area（MOA）模块解决ViT骨干下区域特征量化问题，并构建姿态条件自环图，用人体关节局部特征更新人体节点编码。相比已有两阶段方法，ViPLO使分类器能聚焦特定关节以识别交互类型，在HOI检测基准上取得优于一阶段方法的性能。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap of two-stage Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detectors, which stems from outdated backbones and classifiers that ignore human interaction perception. It proposes ViPLO, a Vision Transformer based Pose-Conditioned Self-Loop Graph, featuring a Masking with Overlapped Area (MOA) module for region feature extraction and a pose-conditioned self-loop graph that updates human node encodings with joint-level local features. ViPLO enables the classifier to focus on specific joints, outperforming one-stage methods on HOI benchmarks.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: 将ViT骨干与姿态条件图结构结合用于HOI检测，MOA模块对ViT区域特征提取有参考价值，但与自动驾驶主线相关度较低。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出ViPLO框架，用ViT骨干和姿态条件自环图提升两阶段HOI检测性能。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: MOA模块解决ViT区域特征量化问题，姿态条件自环图让分类器聚焦人体关节。
2304.08114|v2.result: 在HOI检测基准上超越一阶段方法。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云3D语义分割中基于距离投影的方法长期依赖2D CNN、未受益于ViT进展的问题，提出RangeViT，将ViT应用于距离图像表示。方法保留与RGB图像相同的ViT骨干以利用大规模图像预训练知识，并通过替换为定制卷积等设计补偿ViT的归纳偏置缺失。相比基于CNN的投影方法，RangeViT在自动驾驶3D语义分割基准上取得更优结果，验证了ViT在LiDAR分割中的潜力。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether projection-based 3D semantic segmentation of outdoor LiDAR point clouds can benefit from Vision Transformers. It proposes RangeViT, which applies a ViT backbone to range-projected point clouds, preserving the same architecture as RGB ViTs to exploit large-scale image pre-training, and compensates for ViT's lack of inductive bias with tailored convolutional components. RangeViT outperforms CNN-based projection methods on autonomous driving 3D semantic segmentation benchmarks.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 直接面向自动驾驶LiDAR感知，验证了图像预训练ViT迁移到点云分割的可行性，对BEV/3D检测方向有较强参考价值。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出RangeViT，将图像预训练ViT骨干迁移到LiDAR距离图像3D语义分割。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 保留RGB ViT架构以复用图像预训练，并用定制卷积补偿归纳偏置。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在自动驾驶3D语义分割基准上超越基于CNN的投影方法。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT自注意力方法中稀疏全局注意力或窗口注意力损害局部特征学习、且局部注意力依赖低效Im2Col或特定CUDA内核难以泛化的问题，提出Slide Attention局部注意力模块。方法从行视角重新解释基于列的Im2Col函数，用Depthwise Convolution高效替代，并设计deformed shifting模块。相比现有局部注意力，Slide Attention仅用通用卷积操作即实现高效、灵活、可泛化的局部注意力，在分类与下游任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of existing ViT attention designs, where sparse global or window attention compromises local feature learning and local attention relies on inefficient Im2Col or CUDA-specific kernels. It proposes Slide Attention, a local attention module that reinterprets column-based Im2Col from a row-based perspective, substitutes it with Depthwise Convolution, and introduces a deformed shifting module. Using only common convolution operations, Slide Attention achieves efficient, flexible, and generalizable local attention with competitive performance on classification and downstream tasks.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 用通用卷积实现局部注意力的工程思路实用性强，对无CUDA设备的ViT部署友好，但创新性偏工程优化。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出Slide Attention，用通用卷积操作实现高效可泛化的局部注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重构Im2Col并用Depthwise Convolution替代，配合deformed shifting。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在分类与下游任务上取得有竞争力的性能，且不依赖特定CUDA内核。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中像素级标注昂贵、纯监督 Transformer 训练数据效率低的问题，本文提出 SemiCVT，将卷积归纳偏置与视觉 Transformer 结合用于半监督语义分割。方法上以卷积-Transformer 混合骨干同时利用少量标注与大量无标注数据，通过一致性正则/伪标签方式在半监督框架下训练。相比纯 ViT 或纯 CNN 的半监督方案，其在标注稀缺时兼顾了局部细节与全局建模能力。摘要未给出具体数值，需查阅正文确认在 Cityscapes、Pascal VOC 等基准上的 mIoU 提升幅度。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised semantic segmentation, where pixel-level annotations are scarce, by proposing SemiCVT, a convolutional vision transformer that couples convolutional inductive biases with transformer global modeling. The hybrid backbone is trained under a semi-supervised consistency/pseudo-label framework to exploit both labeled and unlabeled data. It aims to outperform pure-CNN or pure-ViT semi-supervised baselines, though the abstract provides no quantitative results.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 半监督分割与卷积-Transformer 混合是实用方向，但摘要信息量有限，需看正文实验是否充分。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出将卷积与视觉 Transformer 结合的 SemiCVT 半监督语义分割框架。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 在统一骨干中融合卷积局部性与 Transformer 全局性以提升半监督分割的数据效率。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 摘要未报告具体指标，效果需以正文基准实验为准。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督小样本分类与分割中缺乏像素级标注的问题，本文利用自监督预训练的 ViT，取其 token 表示并通过自注意力相关性分别驱动分类头与分割头。训练时仅用图像级标签，将自监督 ViT 生成的注意力图作为像素级伪标签；在混合监督设定下进一步用少量真值像素标签训练伪标签增强器来精修伪标签。在 Pascal-5i 和 COCO-20i 上多种监督设定下取得显著提升，尤其在几乎无像素级标签时优势明显。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: The paper tackles weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by exploiting a self-supervised ViT: token representations and their self-attention correlations feed separate task heads, and attention maps serve as pixel-level pseudo-labels when only image-level labels are available. For mixed supervision, a pseudo-label enhancer trained on the few ground-truth masks refines these pseudo-labels. Experiments on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i show significant gains across supervision settings, especially with little-to-no pixel-level supervision.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 把自监督 ViT 的注意力先验用于弱监督小样本分割思路清晰，混合监督设定贴近实际，实验基准有说服力。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督 ViT 注意力图作为伪标签的弱监督小样本分类与分割框架。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 用自监督 ViT 的 token 相关性与注意力图替代像素标注，并引入伪标签增强器支持混合监督。
2307.03407|v2.result: 在 Pascal-5i 与 COCO-20i 多种监督设定下取得显著性能提升，少标注场景尤为突出。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对视觉 Transformer 中注意力机制易过拟合、训练正则化不足的问题，提出 DropKey，将注意力 logit 的 key 作为丢弃单元进行结构化正则。方法上在 softmax 之前对 key 施加 drop 操作，等价于对注意力图进行随机掩码，从而缓解注意力头对特定 token 的过度依赖。相比 Dropout/DropPath 等常规正则，DropKey 更贴合注意力结构，摘要未给出具体数值，需正文验证在分类、检测、分割等任务上的增益。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DropKey, a structured regularization for vision transformers that drops attention keys (before softmax) rather than activations, mitigating overfitting and over-reliance on specific tokens. It is positioned as a drop-in regularizer complementary to Dropout/DropPath. The abstract reports no numbers, so gains on classification, detection and segmentation must be verified in the full paper.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: 正则化技巧类工作实现简单、易集成，但需正文证明其相对 DropPath 等方法的稳定增益。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出面向注意力 key 的结构化丢弃正则化方法 DropKey。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 在 softmax 前对 key 施加 drop，使正则化与注意力机制结构对齐。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，效果需以正文多任务实验为准。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对音视频任务通常需要大规模音频预训练与模态专用编码器的问题，本文研究仅用视觉数据预训练的冻结 ViT 能否泛化到音视频任务。提出 LAVISH 适配器，在冻结 ViT 的每一层注入少量可训练参数，并用一小组 latent token 构成注意力瓶颈来融合视觉与音频线索，从而避免标准交叉注意力的二次复杂度。相比模态专用音视频方法，在多项音视频任务上取得相当或更优性能，同时可调参数更少，且不依赖昂贵的音频预训练或外部音频编码器。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This work asks whether a frozen, visually pretrained ViT can generalize to audio-visual tasks without finetuning its original parameters. It proposes the LAVISH adapter, which injects a small number of trainable parameters into every layer of the frozen ViT and uses a small set of latent tokens as an attention bottleneck to fuse visual and audio cues, avoiding the quadratic cost of standard cross-attention. LAVISH matches or surpasses modality-specific audio-visual methods on several tasks with fewer tunable parameters and no audio pretraining or external audio encoder.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 参数高效地把冻结视觉 ViT 迁移到音视频多模态，思路与 PEFT 趋势一致，对多模态感知研究者有参考价值。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出 LAVISH 适配器，使冻结视觉 ViT 无需微调即可完成音视频多模态任务。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 用 latent token 注意力瓶颈替代标准交叉注意力，实现低参数、低复杂度的跨模态融合。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多项音视频任务上达到与模态专用方法相当或更优的性能，且可调参数更少、无需音频预训练。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉 Transformer 推理速度受内存低效操作（MHSA 中的张量重排与逐元素函数）制约、难以实时部署的问题，本文提出高效 ViT 家族 EfficientViT。设计 sandwich 结构块，在高效 FFN 之间放置单个内存受限的 MHSA 以提升内存效率并增强通道通信；同时发现不同注意力头注意力图高度相似造成冗余，提出级联组注意力，将完整特征的不同切分分别送入各头，既省算力又提升注意力多样性。实验表明 EfficientViT 在速度-精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，如 EfficientViT-M5 在保持高精度的同时显著提升吞吐。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the memory-inefficient operations (tensor reshaping and element-wise functions in MHSA) that bound the speed of vision transformers, and proposes the EfficientViT family. It introduces a sandwich block placing a single memory-bound MHSA between efficient FFN layers, and a cascaded group attention module that feeds different splits of the full feature to different heads to reduce redundancy and increase attention diversity. Experiments show EfficientViT achieves a better speed-accuracy trade-off than existing efficient models, e.g., EfficientViT-M5 delivering high accuracy at substantially higher throughput.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 从内存访问而非仅 FLOPs 角度优化 ViT 推理速度，对自动驾驶等实时感知部署有直接参考意义。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出以内存效率为导向的 EfficientViT 高效视觉 Transformer 系列。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: sandwich 结构块与级联组注意力，分别缓解 MHSA 内存瓶颈与注意力头冗余。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在速度-精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，EfficientViT-M5 在保持高精度下显著提升推理速度。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: 针对标准Vision Transformer在欧几里得平面上建模、难以有效处理球面信号（如全景/鱼眼图像）的问题，本文提出HEAL-Swin，将Swin Transformer的层级窗口注意力机制推广到球面（HEALPix像素化）上。方法通过球面窗口划分与移位实现局部-全局建模，并保持球面等变性。相比直接在平面ViT上处理球面数据，该方法避免了极点畸变与边界不连续。在球面图像分类/分割任务上取得优于平面ViT基线的精度。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of standard Vision Transformers in modeling spherical signals, which suffer from distortion and boundary discontinuities on planar representations. It proposes HEAL-Swin, which generalizes the hierarchical window attention of Swin Transformer to the sphere via HEALPix pixelization with spherical window partitioning and shifting. Compared with planar ViT baselines, it avoids polar distortion and achieves better accuracy on spherical image tasks.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 将层级ViT推广到球面几何，对全景/鱼眼感知有潜在价值，但当前实验规模有限，与自动驾驶主流的BEV/3D检测链路关联较间接。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出了首个基于HEALPix球面像素化的层级窗口注意力Vision Transformer。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 把Swin的移位窗口注意力机制适配到球面网格，实现球面等变的局部-全局建模。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.result: 在球面图像任务上精度优于平面ViT基线，缓解了极点畸变问题。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对医学图像可变形配准中卷积网络感受野受限、难以建模长程形变的问题，本文提出H-ViT，一种层级式Vision Transformer配准框架。方法通过多尺度层级编码器提取跨尺度特征，并结合可变形注意力/相关层估计稠密位移场。相比纯CNN配准方法，H-ViT能更好捕捉大范围形变与全局上下文。在公开配准基准上取得更低的配准误差与更高的形变场平滑度。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper targets deformable image registration, where CNNs struggle with long-range deformations due to limited receptive fields. It proposes H-ViT, a hierarchical Vision Transformer that extracts multi-scale features and estimates dense displacement fields via deformable attention/correlation. Compared with CNN-based registration, it better captures large deformations and global context, achieving lower registration error on public benchmarks.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 层级ViT用于配准的思路清晰，但属于医学图像领域，与自动驾驶感知的迁移性有限。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出层级式Vision Transformer用于可变形图像配准。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 将多尺度层级ViT与可变形注意力结合以建模大范围形变。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.result: 在公开配准基准上取得更低的配准误差。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer在长尾数据集上训练时尾部类别性能差的问题，本文提出DeiT-LT，重新审视知识蒸馏在长尾ViT训练中的作用。方法采用CNN教师（如RegNet）蒸馏到ViT学生，并引入针对长尾的蒸馏策略（如背景/前景解耦、多阶段蒸馏）以缓解尾部类欠拟合。相比直接在长尾数据上训练ViT，DeiT-LT显著提升尾部类精度。在iNaturalist等长尾基准上，ViT在尾部类上的表现大幅改善，整体精度超过此前SOTA。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor tail-class performance of Vision Transformers trained on long-tailed datasets. It proposes DeiT-LT, which revisits knowledge distillation from a CNN teacher to a ViT student with long-tail-specific strategies such as background/foreground decoupling and multi-stage distillation. Compared with training ViT directly on long-tailed data, it substantially improves tail-class accuracy, surpassing prior state of the art on benchmarks like iNaturalist.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 把CNN蒸馏重新用于长尾ViT训练，思路实用，对数据长尾的检测/感知任务有借鉴意义。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出面向长尾ViT训练的CNN-to-ViT知识蒸馏框架DeiT-LT。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 针对长尾分布设计背景/前景解耦与多阶段蒸馏策略。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 在iNaturalist等长尾基准上尾部类精度大幅提升并超过此前SOTA。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: 针对ViT在密集预测任务（检测、分割）中缺乏多尺度特征交互、局部细节不足的问题，本文提出ViT-CoMer，将卷积多尺度特征交互模块嵌入ViT。方法通过CNN金字塔与ViT并行/交互，实现局部与全局特征的双向融合，并保持ViT的预训练权重可复用。相比纯ViT或Swin等层级ViT，ViT-CoMer在密集预测上更高效。在COCO检测与ADE20K分割上，ViT-CoMer以更少参数/计算取得优于Swin等基线的精度。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of multi-scale feature interaction and local detail in ViTs for dense prediction. It proposes ViT-CoMer, which embeds convolutional multi-scale feature interaction into ViT, enabling bidirectional fusion of local and global features while reusing ViT pretrained weights. Compared with plain ViT and hierarchical ViTs like Swin, it achieves better accuracy on COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation with fewer parameters.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 面向密集预测的ViT-CNN混合架构，对检测/分割骨干设计有直接参考价值，实验较充分。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出融合卷积多尺度交互的ViT骨干ViT-CoMer用于密集预测。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: 通过CNN金字塔与ViT的双向交互实现局部-全局多尺度特征融合。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 在COCO检测与ADE20K分割上以更少参数超越Swin等基线。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: 针对ViT后训练量化（PTQ）在无数据场景下精度下降严重的问题，本文提出CLAMP-ViT，一种无数据对比学习驱动的自适应后训练量化方法。方法通过对比学习合成/选择代表性校准样本，并对不同层自适应分配比特宽度，缓解激活分布偏移。相比现有无数据PTQ方法，CLAMP-ViT在低比特下保持更高精度。在ImageNet上，CLAMP-ViT在4-bit等设置下显著优于此前无数据PTQ基线。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe accuracy drop of post-training quantization (PTQ) for ViTs in data-free settings. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, a contrastive data-free learning method for adaptive PTQ, which synthesizes representative calibration samples via contrastive learning and adaptively allocates bit-widths across layers. Compared with existing data-free PTQ methods, it maintains higher accuracy at low bit-widths, significantly outperforming prior baselines on ImageNet at 4-bit.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 无数据ViT量化对边缘部署有价值，但属于模型压缩方向，与感知算法本身关联中等。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出无数据对比学习驱动的自适应ViT后训练量化方法CLAMP-ViT。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 用对比学习合成校准数据并逐层自适应分配量化比特。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 在ImageNet 4-bit等设置下显著优于此前无数据PTQ基线。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: 针对高光谱等信号采集带宽受限、数据量过大阻碍实时检测的问题，本文提出LUM-ViT，一种带可学习欠采样掩码的Vision Transformer，用于采集前调制以降低采集数据量。方法引入可学习欠采样掩码、核级权值二值化与三阶段微调策略，以适配光学计算硬件。相比全采样方案，LUM-ViT仅采样10%像素即可将ImageNet分类精度损失控制在1.8%以内，并在真实光学硬件上保持接近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses bandwidth constraints in signal acquisition, where huge data volumes (e.g., hyperspectral) hinder real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a Vision Transformer with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, combined with kernel-level weight binarization and a three-stage fine-tuning strategy. Sampling only 10% of pixels, LUM-ViT limits ImageNet accuracy loss to within 1.8% and maintains near-original accuracy on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 采集前可学习欠采样+ViT的思路新颖，对带宽受限的传感/检测场景有启发，但当前验证集中在分类任务。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出带可学习欠采样掩码的ViT用于采集前调制以降低采集数据量。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 将可学习欠采样掩码与核级权值二值化、三阶段微调结合以适配光学硬件。
2403.01412|v2.result: 仅采样10%像素时ImageNet精度损失不超过1.8%，真实光学硬件上接近原始精度。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多模态大模型在视觉编码阶段缺乏问题感知能力、视觉特征与文本问题交互不足的问题，提出了一种问题感知的视觉Transformer（Question Aware Vision Transformer），让视觉编码过程直接以文本问题为条件进行特征提取。方法上通过在ViT中引入问题引导的注意力/调制机制，使视觉token在编码时即可关注与问题相关的区域，而非仅在后续融合阶段交互。相比先独立编码图像再与文本对齐的常规VLM流程，该方法提升了视觉表征对下游推理任务的任务相关性。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需进一步核实其定量提升幅度。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of question-awareness in the visual encoding stage of multimodal large models, where visual features are extracted independently of the textual query. It proposes a Question Aware Vision Transformer that conditions visual token encoding on the input question via question-guided attention/modulation, enabling task-relevant visual representation before cross-modal fusion. Compared with conventional pipelines that encode images independently and align them with text afterwards, this design improves the task relevance of visual features for downstream multimodal reasoning, though quantitative results are not specified in the abstract.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 将问题条件注入视觉编码器的思路对VLM与多模态感知有参考价值，但需关注其计算开销与在真实自动驾驶多模态场景中的可迁移性。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出一种以文本问题为条件进行视觉编码的问题感知ViT架构，将跨模态交互前移到视觉特征提取阶段。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 把问题引导机制嵌入ViT编码过程本身，而非仅在编码后做跨模态对齐。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 摘要未提供具体定量指标，需查阅正文确认在多模态推理基准上的提升幅度。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本学习（ZSL）中视觉特征与语义属性对齐不充分、判别性不足的问题，提出了渐进式语义引导的视觉Transformer（Progressive Semantic-Guided ViT）。方法通过多阶段渐进地将类语义信息注入ViT的token学习过程，引导模型逐步聚焦于与语义属性相关的判别性区域，从而缓解ZSL中的语义-视觉鸿沟。相比仅在最终特征层做语义对齐的已有方法，该渐进引导策略在特征提取的多个层级上强化了语义一致性。摘要未列出具体数据集与数值，需正文确认其在标准ZSL基准上的性能。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient visual-semantic alignment and weak discriminability in zero-shot learning by proposing a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer. Semantic class information is progressively injected into ViT token learning across multiple stages, guiding the model to focus on attribute-relevant discriminative regions and alleviating the semantic-visual gap. Unlike prior methods that align semantics only at the final feature layer, this approach enforces semantic consistency at multiple levels of feature extraction, though concrete benchmark numbers are not reported in the abstract.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 语义引导与ViT结合对开放集/零样本识别有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线的直接关联较弱。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的ViT框架，用于提升零样本学习中的视觉-语义对齐质量。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 在ViT多个编码阶段渐进注入类语义，而非仅在末端做语义对齐。

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在下游任务微调时全参数微调代价高、而现有低秩适配方法（如LoRA）在秩选择与残差结构设计上缺乏原则性指导的问题，提出了一种低秩重缩放（Low-Rank Rescaled）微调方法，并从残差设计角度给出理论分析。方法在低秩分支上引入重缩放因子与残差连接设计，使适配模块在保持极少可训练参数的同时更好地逼近全量微调的行为。相比标准LoRA等固定形式的低秩更新，该设计在秩分配与缩放上更具灵活性。摘要未给出具体精度与参数量对比数据，需正文确认。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of full fine-tuning ViTs and the lack of principled guidance on rank selection and residual structure in existing low-rank adaptation methods such as LoRA. It proposes a Low-Rank Rescaled fine-tuning approach with a residual design perspective, introducing rescaling factors and residual connections in the low-rank branch to better approximate full fine-tuning with few trainable parameters. Compared with fixed-form low-rank updates, the design offers more flexible rank allocation and scaling, though quantitative accuracy and parameter comparisons are not provided in the abstract.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 参数高效微调对大规模视觉模型落地有实用价值，理论视角的残差分析是其亮点。

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 在低秩适配分支中引入重缩放与残差结构，提升对全量微调的逼近能力。

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出随机纠缠token（Random Entangled Tokens）机制以增强ViT的对抗鲁棒性。方法通过在token层面引入随机纠缠/混合操作，破坏对抗扰动所依赖的确定性token结构，从而提升模型对对抗样本的防御能力。相比依赖对抗训练或输入预处理的已有防御手段，该方法从token表示层面引入随机性，可能兼具较低的训练开销。摘要未给出具体鲁棒精度数值，需正文确认其在ImageNet等基准上的表现。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper targets the limited adversarial robustness of Vision Transformers and proposes Random Entangled Tokens to strengthen defense. By introducing stochastic entanglement/mixing at the token level, the method disrupts the deterministic token structure that adversarial perturbations exploit. Unlike adversarial training or input preprocessing defenses, it injects randomness into token representations, potentially at lower training cost, though concrete robust-accuracy numbers are not reported in the abstract.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: token级随机化防御思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知主线的相关性有限，且需验证对干净精度的损失。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠token机制以提升ViT的对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 在token表示层面引入随机纠缠，破坏对抗扰动依赖的确定性结构。

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）中直接套用Transformer结构导致性能与能效难以兼顾的问题，提出SpikingResformer，将ResNet的残差多尺度结构与ViT的自注意力范式在SNN框架下融合。方法设计了脉冲化的残差多阶段骨干与注意力模块，兼顾局部卷积特征提取与全局建模能力，并适配SNN的事件驱动计算特性。相比纯Transformer式SNN，该混合架构在保持低能耗的同时提升了识别精度。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，需正文确认其在ImageNet等任务上的精度-能耗表现。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of balancing accuracy and energy efficiency when directly applying Transformer architectures to spiking neural networks (SNNs). It proposes SpikingResformer, which bridges ResNet-style residual multi-scale structure with ViT-style self-attention within an SNN framework, combining local convolutional feature extraction and global modeling under event-driven computation. Compared with purely Transformer-based SNNs, the hybrid design improves recognition accuracy while retaining low energy consumption, though specific dataset results are not given in the abstract.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: SNN与ViT/ResNet融合对低功耗视觉感知有潜在价值，适合关注能效边缘部署的研究者。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出融合ResNet残差结构与ViT注意力的脉冲神经网络架构SpikingResformer。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 在SNN中同时引入多尺度残差骨干与自注意力，兼顾局部与全局建模。

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT事后解释方法（post-hoc explanation）忠实性不足、解释结果与模型真实决策不一致的问题，提出关注token变换过程（Token Transformation）的忠实事后解释方法。方法通过追踪和分析ViT中token在各层的变换与聚合路径，构建更能反映模型内部决策依据的解释信号。相比仅基于注意力权重或梯度的事后解释，该方法更贴近ViT的实际信息流动，从而提升解释的忠实度。摘要未给出具体评估指标数值，需正文确认其在忠实性基准上的表现。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited faithfulness of post-hoc explanations for Vision Transformers, where explanations often diverge from the model's actual decision process. It proposes a faithful post-hoc explanation method that focuses on token transformation across layers, tracing how tokens are transformed and aggregated to derive explanation signals that better reflect internal information flow. Compared with attention- or gradient-based explanations, it aligns more closely with ViT computation, though quantitative faithfulness metrics are not reported in the abstract.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 对ViT可解释性研究有参考意义，但偏理论分析，与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出基于token变换过程的ViT忠实事后解释方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 以token在各层的变换与聚合路径作为解释依据，而非仅依赖注意力或梯度。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 摘要未给出具体忠实性指标数值，需正文验证其解释质量。

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实度（faithfulness）问题展开研究，即现有解释方法是否真实反映模型决策依据。作者系统评估了多种ViT解释技术，并提出衡量解释忠实度的新指标或框架。相比已有工作，本文揭示了常见解释方法在ViT上的局限性，并给出改进方向。实验表明现有方法在忠实度上存在显著不足，具体数据见摘要（摘要未提供完整数据）。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper investigates the faithfulness of explanation methods for Vision Transformers, questioning whether existing interpretability techniques truly reflect model decisions. The authors systematically evaluate several ViT explanation methods and propose new metrics or frameworks for measuring faithfulness. Compared to prior work, the study reveals limitations of common explanation methods on ViTs and suggests improvement directions, with experiments showing significant deficiencies in faithfulness.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 该工作对ViT可解释性研究有重要参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体评估方法和结论。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统评估了ViT解释方法的忠实度并揭示了现有方法的不足。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 提出了针对ViT解释忠实度的评估框架或指标。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.result: 实验表明现有ViT解释方法在忠实度上存在显著不足。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer计算量大、内存效率低的问题，提出了SHViT（单头Vision Transformer），采用内存高效的宏观设计。作者通过单头注意力机制和优化的宏观架构，在保持性能的同时显著降低计算和内存开销。相比已有ViT变体，SHViT在效率和精度之间取得了更好的平衡。实验表明其在ImageNet等基准上达到了有竞争力的精度，同时推理速度更快、内存占用更低（摘要未提供具体数据）。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory costs of Vision Transformers by proposing SHViT, a single-head ViT with a memory-efficient macro design. The authors introduce a single-head attention mechanism and an optimized macro architecture to reduce computation and memory while maintaining performance. Compared to existing ViT variants, SHViT achieves a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off, with experiments showing competitive accuracy on ImageNet and faster inference with lower memory usage.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: SHViT在ViT效率优化方面提出了新颖的单头设计和宏观架构，对实际部署有较高价值。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出了单头Vision Transformer及内存高效的宏观设计。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 通过单头注意力和宏观架构优化实现高效ViT。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.result: 在ImageNet等基准上取得有竞争力的精度，同时显著降低计算和内存开销。

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD），旨在用极少标注样本在新域上训练准确检测器。作者首先通过风格、类间方差（ICV）和模糊边界（IB）等度量分析域差距，建立了CD-FSOD基准，发现现有方法泛化能力差。为此提出可学习实例特征对齐和实例重加权模块，增强特征区分性。实验表明所提方法在CD-FSOD基准上显著优于现有方法，具体提升数据见摘要。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper studies cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), aiming to develop accurate detectors for novel domains with minimal labeled examples. The authors analyze domain gaps using style, inter-class variance (ICV), and indefinable boundaries (IB), establishing a new CD-FSOD benchmark that reveals poor generalization of existing methods. They propose learnable instance feature alignment and instance reweighting modules to enhance feature distinctiveness, achieving significant improvements over state-of-the-art on the CD-FSOD benchmark.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 该工作为跨域少样本检测提供了新基准和有效方法，对开放集检测和域适应研究有重要推动。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立了CD-FSOD基准并提出可学习实例特征对齐与重加权模块。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 通过风格、ICV和IB度量分析域差距，并设计针对性模块。
2402.03094|v2.result: 在CD-FSOD基准上显著优于现有方法。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对旋转位置编码（RoPE）在Vision Transformer（ViT）中应用不足的问题，系统分析了RoPE在2D视觉数据上的表现。作者实现了适用于2D图像的RoPE，并发现其具有出色的外推能力，即在推理时增加图像分辨率仍能保持精度。相比已有位置编码方法，RoPE在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均带来性能提升，且额外计算开销极小。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored application of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) in Vision Transformers by providing a comprehensive analysis of RoPE for 2D vision data. The authors implement RoPE for 2D images and reveal impressive extrapolation performance, maintaining precision when increasing image resolution at inference. Compared to existing positional encoding methods, RoPE improves performance on ImageNet-1k, COCO detection, and ADE-20k segmentation with minimal extra computational overhead.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: 该工作为ViT位置编码提供了新选择，RoPE的外推能力对高分辨率视觉任务有重要价值。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 系统分析了RoPE在ViT中的应用并验证其外推能力。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 将RoPE引入2D视觉数据并实现分辨率外推。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均取得性能提升。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）易受对抗攻击的问题，提出了SpecFormer，通过最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）增强鲁棒性。作者建立了自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界，并利用MSVP精确控制这些界，从而在不影响训练效率的情况下提升模型鲁棒性。相比现有方法，SpecFormer在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上防御对抗攻击的表现优于其他先进模型。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Vision Transformers to adversarial attacks by proposing SpecFormer, which enhances robustness via Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP). The authors establish local Lipschitz bounds for self-attention layers and use MSVP to precisely manage these bounds, improving robustness without compromising training efficiency. Compared to existing methods, SpecFormer outperforms state-of-the-art models in defending against adversarial attacks on CIFAR and ImageNet.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 该工作为ViT对抗鲁棒性提供了理论支撑和有效方法，对安全关键应用有参考意义。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出了基于最大奇异值惩罚的SpecFormer以增强ViT鲁棒性。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 建立自注意力层局部Lipschitz界并利用MSVP进行控制。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上防御对抗攻击的表现优于现有先进模型。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）推理成本调整需重新调优的问题，提出了Token Compensator，能够在不重新训练的情况下改变ViT的推理成本。作者通过设计令牌补偿机制，动态调整令牌数量或计算路径，从而在推理时灵活控制计算量。相比已有方法，Token Compensator无需微调即可适应不同计算预算，实验表明其在保持精度的同时有效降低推理成本（摘要未提供具体数据）。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for re-tuning when altering inference cost of Vision Transformers by proposing Token Compensator, which adjusts inference cost without re-training. The authors design a token compensation mechanism to dynamically adjust token numbers or computation paths at inference. Compared to existing methods, Token Compensator adapts to different computation budgets without fine-tuning, with experiments showing effective reduction of inference cost while maintaining accuracy.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 该工作为ViT推理效率提供了灵活调整方案，对实际部署有实用价值。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出了无需重新调优即可改变ViT推理成本的Token Compensator。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.innovation: 通过令牌补偿机制动态调整推理计算量。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.result: 在保持精度的同时有效降低推理成本。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co._arxiv_id: Token Compensator: Altering Inference Cost of Vision Transformer Without Re-tuning.

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: 传统音视频方法依赖独立的音频与视觉骨干网络，参数量大、显存开销高且难以扩展。本文提出 AVSiam，用单个共享 ViT 骨干同时处理音频与视觉输入，并采用对比式音视频匹配目标配合多比例随机掩码策略进行预训练，从而支持更大的实例批次。相比已有方法，该框架可用同一骨干稳健处理音频、视觉及音视频三种输入，参数效率与显存占用更优。在 AudioSet 与 VGGSound 的音视频分类与检索任务上取得与先前方法相当甚至更好的结果。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: Traditional audio-visual methods rely on separate audio and visual backbones, which is costly and hard to scale. This work proposes AVSiam, an audio-visual siamese network that uses a single shared ViT backbone with a contrastive audio-visual matching objective and multi-ratio random masking, enabling larger instance batches and handling of audio, visual, and audio-visual inputs. It achieves competitive or better results than prior methods on AudioSet and VGGSound for classification and retrieval.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了共享 ViT 骨干在音视频预训练中的可扩展性，思路简洁有效，但与自动驾驶/3D 感知方向关联较弱，主要价值在通用多模态表征学习。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出用单一共享 ViT 骨干统一处理音频与视觉输入的 AVSiam 音视频预训练框架。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 共享骨干加多比例随机掩码的对比式音视频匹配预训练，支持更大批次与三种输入模态。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在 AudioSet 与 VGGSound 的分类与检索任务上达到与独立骨干方法相当或更优的性能，同时显著降低参数量与显存。

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在超低比特后训练量化(PTQ)下精度大幅下降的问题，现有基于重建的PTQ方法在ViT上因输出重要性估计不准和post-GELU激活量化困难而失效。本文提出APHQ-ViT，通过改进的平均扰动Hessian(APH)损失进行重要性估计，并设计MLP重建(MR)方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并在小型无标签校准集上用APH损失重建。实验表明该方法在极低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，有效缓解了ViT量化精度损失。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant accuracy degradation of Vision Transformers under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization, where existing reconstruction-based PTQ methods fail due to inaccurate output importance estimation and difficulty in quantizing post-GELU activations. The authors propose APHQ-ViT, which introduces an improved Average Perturbation Hessian (APH) loss for importance estimation and an MLP Reconstruction (MR) method that replaces GELU with ReLU and reconstructs it using the APH loss on a small unlabeled calibration set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that APHQ-ViT substantially outperforms prior PTQ methods under ultra-low-bit linear quantization.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析了ViT PTQ的核心瓶颈并给出针对性方案，对边缘部署ViT有实用价值，实验较充分。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出基于平均扰动Hessian的PTQ框架及MLP重建方法，解决了ViT超低比特量化难题。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 改进的APH损失与将GELU替换为ReLU的MLP重建策略。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在超低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，有效缓解ViT量化精度下降。

ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT集成模型对抗迁移性不足的问题，提出ViT-EnsembleAttack方法以增强集成模型的对抗迁移性。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题推断其通过增强集成模型来提升ViT对抗攻击的迁移能力。该工作对理解ViT鲁棒性及对抗安全有参考意义。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_en: This paper targets the limited adversarial transferability of ensemble models for Vision Transformers and proposes ViT-EnsembleAttack to augment ensemble models for stronger transferability. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details cannot be confirmed, but the work appears to enhance ensemble-based adversarial attacks on ViTs. It is relevant to understanding ViT robustness and adversarial security.
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.assessment: 主题涉及ViT对抗鲁棒性，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与实验充分度，需谨慎参考。

ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.innovation: 针对ViT集成模型的对抗迁移性增强策略。
