2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)训练数据存在长尾分布导致头部概念过表征、尾部概念欠表征的问题，本文首次深入分析LVLM(如LLaVA)在VQA和视觉推理等通用任务上的长尾问题。提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，包含数据重平衡(DR)和数据合成(DS)两阶段，DR基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS利用去噪扩散概率模型合成尾部数据。该框架有效缓解了LVLM的长尾偏差，提升了通用视觉语言任务的平衡表征能力。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-tail problem in Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) training data, where head concepts are overrepresented and tail concepts underrepresented, and conducts an in-depth analysis on LVLMs (e.g., LLaVA) for general tasks like VQA and visual reasoning. The authors propose an Adaptive Data Refinement Framework (ADR) with two stages: Data Rebalancing (DR), which adaptively rebalances redundant data based on entity distributions, and Data Synthesis (DS), which leverages denoising diffusion probabilistic models to synthesize tail data. The framework effectively mitigates long-tail bias and improves balanced representation for general vision-language tasks.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该工作将长尾问题拓展到LVLM通用任务并给出两阶段数据精炼方案，对多模态大模型数据平衡有重要参考价值。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出ADR框架，通过数据重平衡与扩散合成解决LVLM长尾问题。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析LVLM通用任务长尾问题并设计自适应数据精炼两阶段框架。
2503.12821|v2.result: 有效缓解LVLM长尾偏差，提升通用视觉语言任务的平衡表征能力。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备部署困难及直接套用二值CNN策略导致性能大幅下降的问题，本文提出BHViT——一种二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型。BHViT利用从粗到细的局部信息交互与层次特征聚合减少冗余token计算，提出基于移位操作的新模块增强二值MLP性能而不显著增加开销，并设计基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法评估token重要性。该工作显著缩小了二值ViT与全精度模型的性能差距，推动了ViT在边缘设备上的实时高效部署。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenges of Vision Transformers on edge devices and the significant performance drop when directly applying binary CNN strategies to ViTs, proposing BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture and its fully binarized model. BHViT employs coarse-to-fine local information interaction and hierarchical feature aggregation to reduce redundant token computation, introduces a shift-based module to enhance the binary MLP without significant overhead, and designs a quantization-decomposition-based attention matrix binarization method to evaluate token importance. The work substantially narrows the performance gap between binary and full-precision ViTs, advancing real-time and energy-efficient ViT deployment on edge devices.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT二值化的结构差异问题提出系统性混合架构设计，对边缘端高效ViT部署有重要实用价值。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出二值化友好的混合ViT架构BHViT及全二值化模型。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 移位操作增强二值MLP与基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法。
2503.02394|v2.result: 显著缩小二值ViT与全精度模型的性能差距，推动边缘端高效部署。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸安全任务（deepfake检测、人脸防伪、扩散伪造检测）中缺乏通用且可迁移的人脸表征问题，提出自监督预训练框架FSFM，结合掩码图像建模（MIM）与实例判别（ID）。具体设计了CRFR-P掩码策略强制模型捕获区域内一致性和区域间连贯性，并通过自蒸馏建立局部到全局的对应关系。在10个公开数据集上的跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域人脸防伪和未见扩散伪造检测任务中，FSFM均取得了优于现有方法的泛化性能。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the lack of robust and transferable facial representations for face security tasks by proposing FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework that synergizes masked image modeling (MIM) and instance discrimination (ID). It introduces CRFR-P masking to enforce intra-region consistency and inter-region coherency, and a self-distillation-based ID network for local-to-global correspondence. Extensive experiments on 10 public datasets show improved generalization on cross-dataset deepfake detection, cross-domain face anti-spoofing, and unseen diffusion facial forgery detection.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 将自监督学习系统性地引入人脸安全领域，掩码策略与自蒸馏结合的设计有参考价值，但领域相关性较窄。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向人脸安全任务的通用自监督预训练基础模型FSFM。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: 设计CRFR-P掩码策略与自蒸馏ID网络，联合优化局部特征与全局语义。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在10个公开数据集上跨域人脸安全任务中取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇多视角室内3D目标检测中缺乏人工标注的问题，提出OpenM3D，一种无需人工标注训练的单阶段开放词汇检测器。方法基于ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类别无关的3D定位损失和体素-语义对齐损失，并利用图嵌入技术将2D分割合并为连贯3D结构以生成高质量3D伪框。伪框的精度和召回率优于OV-3DET等方法，在开放词汇室内3D检测上取得了显著提升。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary multi-view indoor 3D object detection without human annotations by introducing OpenM3D, a single-stage detector built on 2D-induced voxel features from ImGeoNet. It jointly trains a class-agnostic 3D localization loss with high-quality pseudo boxes and a voxel-semantic alignment loss using diverse CLIP features, where pseudo boxes are generated via graph embedding that merges 2D segments into coherent 3D structures. The proposed pseudo boxes achieve higher precision and recall than prior methods including OV-3DET, improving open-vocabulary 3D detection performance.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测扩展到多视角室内3D场景且无需人工标注，图嵌入伪框生成思路新颖，对3D检测与开放集识别交叉方向有参考价值。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注的开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器OpenM3D。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 利用图嵌入合并2D分割生成高质量3D伪框，并联合体素-语义对齐损失训练单阶段检测器。
2508.20063|v2.result: 伪框精度和召回率超越OV-3DET等方法，开放词汇3D检测性能显著提升。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于查询的3D目标检测模型在边缘设备上计算量大的问题，提出零样本运行时注意力键剪枝方法tgGBC。方法将分类得分与注意力图相乘得到每个键的重要性分数，并在每层Transformer后按重要性逐步剪枝键。在ToC3D模型上实现Transformer解码器1.99倍加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型甚至性能提升，并成功在边缘设备上部署。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational burden of query-based 3D object detectors on edge devices by proposing tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime attention key pruning method. It multiplies classification scores with attention maps to compute key importance and gradually prunes keys after each transformer layer. The method achieves a 1.99x speedup in the transformer decoder of ToC3D with less than 1% performance loss, and even improves performance for some models, enabling edge deployment.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 零样本运行时剪枝无需重训练即可加速3D检测器，实用性强，对自动驾驶感知的实时部署有直接价值。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出面向3D检测Transformer解码器的零样本运行时键剪枝方法tgGBC。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 利用分类得分扩展注意力图计算键重要性，逐层渐进剪枝，无需重训练。
2503.08101|v2.result: ToC3D解码器加速1.99倍，性能损失小于1%，部分模型性能提升。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差的问题，提出一种无需训练、反馈驱动的自适性框架。方法将基于输出的patch级对应关系反馈到中间注意力，利用输出预测作为更强的空间连贯先验，并设计注意力隔离、基于置信度的稀疏剪枝和自适应集成等模块。作为即插即用模块，该方法可无缝集成到现有CLIP分割流程中，提升了开放词汇分割的语义一致性和空间连贯性。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's poor localization for open-vocabulary segmentation by proposing a training-free, feedback-driven self-adaptive framework that feeds output-based patch-level correspondences back to intermediate attention. It leverages output predictions as a stronger spatial coherence prior and designs attention isolation, confidence-based pruning for sparse adaptation, and adaptation ensemble. As a plug-in module, it seamlessly integrates into existing CLIP-based segmentation pipelines, improving semantic consistency and spatial coherence.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 反馈式注意力适配思路对CLIP密集预测任务有启发，但属于分割任务，与检测/自动驾驶领域相关性有限。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出无需训练的反馈自适性注意力框架，将输出级对应关系反馈至中间注意力。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 以模型输出作为空间连贯先验，结合注意力隔离与置信度剪枝实现即插即用适配。
2508.20265|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块提升开放词汇分割的语义一致性与空间连贯性。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在像素级开放词汇语义分割中空间表征不足的问题，提出分层框架CLIPer。方法包含早期层融合模块和细粒度补偿模块：前者利用早期层嵌入和注意力图保留的空间结构信息生成空间连贯性更好的分割图，后者利用扩散模型的自注意力图补偿局部细节。在七个分割数据集上取得最先进性能，例如在特定数据集上显著超越现有方法。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: This paper improves CLIP's spatial representation for pixel-level open-vocabulary semantic segmentation with a hierarchical framework named CLIPer. It includes an early-layer fusion module that leverages spatial structure in early-layer embeddings and attention maps for better spatial coherence, and a fine-grained compensation module that uses diffusion model self-attention maps to recover local details. CLIPer achieves state-of-the-art performance on seven segmentation datasets.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 分层利用CLIP早期层与扩散模型注意力提升空间表征，思路清晰，但任务为分割，与检测/自动驾驶相关性有限。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出分层改进CLIP空间表征的开放词汇语义分割框架CLIPer。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 结合早期层融合与扩散模型注意力补偿，分层提升空间连贯性与局部细节。
2411.13836|v2.result: 在七个分割数据集上取得最先进性能。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对窗口式Vision Transformer的高效推理问题，提出混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q，利用层内激活稀疏性为不重要窗口分配更低比特宽度。方法引入双分支Swin Block分别以高/低比特精度处理激活，可无缝集成到QAT和PTQ方法中。在COCO数据集上，PTQ配置下实现无训练1.35倍加速且无精度损失；QAT下实现无损1.25倍加速，结合激活剪枝在仅降1% mAP下达到1.53倍加速。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MixA-Q, a mixed-precision activation quantization framework that exploits intra-layer activation sparsity in window-based vision transformers. It introduces a Two-Branch Swin Block that processes activations in high and low bit widths, integrating seamlessly with QAT and PTQ methods. On COCO, MixA-Q achieves a training-free 1.35x speedup without accuracy loss in PTQ, and with QAT a lossless 1.25x speedup or 1.53x speedup with only 1% mAP drop when combined with activation pruning.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 将激活稀疏性与混合精度量化结合用于Swin类ViT，工程实用性强，但与检测/自动驾驶核心方向关联较弱。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出利用层内激活稀疏性的混合精度量化框架Mixa-Q。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 设计双分支Swin Block，按窗口重要性分配高低比特精度，兼容QAT/PTQ。
2507.19131|v2.result: COCO上PTQ无训练1.35倍加速无精度损失，QAT无损1.25倍加速，结合剪枝1.53倍加速仅降1% mAP。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对黑盒对抗攻击迁移性不足的问题，提出利用自监督ViT特征来生成对抗扰动。方法上设计了dSVA生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击框架，同时利用对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，并引入生成器和注意力机制训练策略。相比以往仅依赖监督学习特征的方法，该工作首次系统探索了自监督ViT表示对对抗迁移性的提升。实验表明CL与MIM使ViT关注不同的特征倾向，从而增强了黑盒迁移攻击效果。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited black-box transferability of adversarial attacks by exploiting self-supervised ViT representations. It proposes dSVA, a generative dual self-supervised ViT feature attack that combines global structural features from contrastive learning and local textural features from masked image modeling within a novel generative training framework. Compared to prior work relying solely on supervised features, it demonstrates that CL and MIM induce complementary attention patterns in ViTs, improving adversarial transferability.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 该工作将自监督ViT特征引入对抗攻击领域，视角新颖，但主要面向对抗鲁棒性而非感知任务本身，对自动驾驶感知研究的直接价值有限。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 首次系统性地利用自监督ViT的CL和MIM双特征提升对抗样本的黑盒迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 提出dSVA生成式攻击框架，联合利用自监督ViT的全局结构特征与局部纹理特征及注意力机制。
2506.21046|v2.result: 实验证明CL和MIM使ViT关注不同特征倾向，有效提升了黑盒对抗迁移攻击效果。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练ViT在下游任务适配时全量微调成本高的问题，提出了一种基于近似正交微调策略的高效适配方法。由于摘要为空，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题推断其核心是在微调过程中引入近似正交约束以保持预训练特征的泛化能力，同时仅更新少量参数。相比传统全量微调或LoRA等方法，该方法旨在以更低参数量实现有竞争力的适配性能。具体实验数据和效果因摘要缺失无法引用。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper targets efficient adaptation of pre-trained Vision Transformers by proposing an approximately orthogonal fine-tuning strategy. The method presumably introduces approximate orthogonality constraints during fine-tuning to preserve pre-trained feature generalization while updating only a small subset of parameters. Due to the missing abstract, specific experimental results cannot be reported.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 高效微调ViT是当前热点方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体方法质量和实验充分度，需获取全文后进一步判断。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出一种基于近似正交约束的预训练ViT高效微调策略。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 将近似正交性引入ViT微调过程，以在少量参数更新下保持预训练表示质量。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.result: 因摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi._arxiv_id: Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Vision Transformer Underpinned by Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Strategy.

An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_cn: 该论文针对TinyML场景下ViT计算资源受限的问题，提出了一种高效的混合Vision Transformer架构。由于摘要为空，具体方法无法确认，但从标题推断其通过混合设计（可能结合卷积与注意力）来降低计算量以适应边缘设备。相比标准ViT，该方法旨在在极低资源预算下保持可接受的精度。具体实验数据和效果因摘要缺失无法引用。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_en: This paper proposes an efficient hybrid Vision Transformer architecture tailored for TinyML applications. The hybrid design presumably combines convolutional operations with attention mechanisms to reduce computational cost for edge deployment. Due to the missing abstract, specific quantitative results cannot be reported.
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.assessment: TinyML与ViT的结合有一定工程价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度较低，且摘要缺失难以评估方法质量。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.contribution: 提出一种面向TinyML应用的高效混合ViT架构。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.innovation: 通过混合架构设计在极低资源约束下平衡ViT的精度与效率。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.result: 因摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f._arxiv_id: An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer for Tinyml Applications.

2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝后需要大量重训练甚至从头训练才能恢复精度的问题，提出了Variance-Based Pruning（VBP），一种简单的一次性结构化剪枝技术。方法首先收集激活统计量用于选择待剪枝神经元，同时将均值激活整合回模型以保持高性能，仅需极少微调。在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能，显著减少了传统方法所需的数百epoch重训练成本。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required by structured pruning methods by introducing Variance-Based Pruning (VBP), a simple one-shot structured pruning technique with minimal fine-tuning. VBP gathers activation statistics to select neurons for pruning while integrating mean activations back into the model to preserve performance. On ImageNet-1k, DeiT-Base retains over 70% of its original performance directly after pruning, substantially reducing retraining overhead.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种实用的一次性剪枝方案，对模型部署加速有实际意义，但主要面向分类任务，在检测任务上的验证尚不明确。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出Variance-Based Pruning一次性结构化剪枝方法，大幅减少剪枝后的重训练需求。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 利用激活方差选择剪枝神经元并将均值激活回注模型以保持性能。
2507.12988|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k上DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%原始性能，仅需极少微调。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Transformer中自注意力计算复杂度高的问题，提出了PADRe（多项式注意力即插即用替代）统一框架。PADRe利用多项式函数和近似理论，通过Hadamard积等硬件友好操作实现乘法非线性，仅需线性计算和内存开销，且无需Softmax。该框架统一了Hyena、Mamba、SimA、Conv2Former、Castling-ViT等多种近期注意力机制作为其特例。在图像分类、2D目标检测和3D点云目标检测等任务上，PADRe运行速度显著更快且保持可比或更优的精度。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes PADRe, a unifying polynomial attention drop-in replacement framework that addresses the high computational complexity of self-attention in transformers. PADRe leverages polynomial functions and approximation theory with hardware-friendly Hadamard products, achieving linear computational and memory costs without Softmax. It unifies several recent attention mechanisms (Hyena, Mamba, SimA, Conv2Former, Castling-ViT) as special cases and demonstrates significantly faster runtime with comparable or superior accuracy on image classification, 2D object detection, and 3D point cloud object detection.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: PADRe提供了一个统一视角来理解多种高效注意力机制，并在包括3D检测在内的多任务上验证了有效性，对感知领域的高效Transformer设计有参考价值。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出PADRe统一框架，将多种高效注意力机制纳入多项式近似理论体系并实现线性复杂度。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 利用多项式函数和Hadamard积替代Softmax注意力，统一了Hyena、Mamba等多种机制为特例。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在图像分类、2D检测和3D点云检测上运行速度显著更快，精度可比或更优。

CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_cn: 该论文针对算子学习（Operator Learning）问题，提出了CViT（连续Vision Transformer）方法。由于摘要为空，具体方法无法确认，但从标题推断其将ViT架构扩展到连续域以用于偏微分方程等算子学习任务。相比传统算子学习方法（如FNO、DeepONet），CViT旨在利用Transformer的全局建模能力处理连续函数映射。具体实验数据和效果因摘要缺失无法引用。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_en: This paper proposes CViT (Continuous Vision Transformer) for operator learning tasks. The method presumably extends ViT architectures to continuous domains for learning mappings between function spaces, such as in PDE solving. Due to the missing abstract, specific quantitative results cannot be reported.
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.assessment: 该工作面向科学计算中的算子学习，与自动驾驶感知领域相关度很低，且摘要缺失无法评估其方法质量。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.contribution: 提出CViT连续Vision Transformer用于算子学习。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.innovation: 将ViT架构扩展到连续域以处理函数空间映射问题。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.result: 因摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。

Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）与视觉Transformer结合时，传统自注意力机制在脉冲域中计算开销大、时序建模效率低的问题，提出了带有扫视注意力（Saccadic Attention）的脉冲视觉Transformer（Spiking Vision Transformer）。方法上借鉴生物视觉中的扫视机制，设计了一种稀疏、事件驱动的注意力计算方式，仅在关键区域进行脉冲形式的注意力交互，从而降低脉冲发放率和计算量。相比已有的脉冲Transformer工作，该方法在保持脉冲神经网络低功耗优势的同时，提升了注意力模块的时序信息利用效率。摘要中未提供具体数据集上的量化结果，因此无法引用准确数据。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and inefficient temporal modeling of conventional self-attention when integrated into spiking neural networks (SNNs) for vision transformers. It proposes a Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention, which mimics biological saccadic eye movements to perform sparse, event-driven attention only on salient regions, reducing spike firing rates and computation. Compared with existing spiking transformers, the method better exploits temporal information while preserving the low-power advantage of SNNs, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 该工作探索了生物启发式注意力与脉冲神经网络的结合，思路新颖，但摘要缺乏实验数据，实际性能与能效优势尚不明确，与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出了一种基于扫视机制的脉冲视觉Transformer，用稀疏事件驱动注意力替代传统密集自注意力。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 将生物扫视注意力机制引入脉冲Transformer，实现稀疏、低功耗的时序注意力计算。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic._arxiv_id: Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention.

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT模型规模大、训练成本高的问题，本文首次系统探索了端到端稀疏化ViT的范式。方法上不再训练完整ViT，而是动态提取并训练固定小参数预算的稀疏子网络，同时联合优化模型参数与连接结构，并将非结构化稀疏扩展至结构化稀疏（引导自注意力头的剪枝与生长），还引入可学习token选择器实现数据与架构稀疏的协同探索。相比传统后训练剪枝需要更高训练预算，该方法同时降低训练内存与推理复杂度且不牺牲精度。在ImageNet上取得了与密集ViT相当甚至更优的精度，同时显著减少参数量与计算量。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first end-to-end exploration of sparsity in Vision Transformers, dynamically extracting and training sparse subnetworks under a fixed small parameter budget while jointly optimizing weights and connectivity. It extends unstructured sparsity to structured sparsity by guiding prune-and-grow of self-attention heads, and co-explores data and architecture sparsity via a learnable token selector. Compared with conventional post-training pruning that incurs higher training budgets, it reduces both training memory and inference complexity without sacrificing accuracy, achieving competitive or superior ImageNet results.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 该工作将稀疏训练与ViT架构搜索统一起来，对高效ViT训练与部署有较强参考价值，实验覆盖全面。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 首次提出端到端稀疏化ViT的统一框架，联合优化参数、连接、注意力头与token选择。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 将非结构化/结构化稀疏与可学习token选择器协同，实现训练与推理双重效率提升。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以更小参数预算达到与密集ViT相当或更优的精度。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT架构依赖人工设计的问题，本文提出用神经架构搜索自动化该过程，不仅搜索架构还搜索搜索空间本身。核心思想是基于权重共享超网计算的E-T Error，逐步演化不同搜索维度，并给出通用ViT的设计准则。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上优于Swin、DeiT和ViT等近期模型，并在目标检测、语义分割和视觉问答等下游任务上验证了泛化性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: This paper automates Vision Transformer design via neural architecture search that searches not only the architecture but also the search space, gradually evolving search dimensions guided by E-T Error computed on a weight-sharing supernet. The resulting S3 models outperform Swin, DeiT and ViT on ImageNet and generalize to object detection, semantic segmentation and VQA. It further provides design guidelines for general vision transformers.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 将NAS扩展到搜索空间搜索，对ViT架构设计有方法论贡献，下游任务验证充分，值得关注。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出搜索搜索空间的NAS方法S3，并给出ViT设计准则。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 以E-T Error引导搜索空间逐步演化，实现架构与搜索空间的联合搜索。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT、ViT，并在检测、分割、VQA上验证泛化性。

2110.15156|v2.summary_cn: 本文指出ViT的离散patch tokenization会隐式引入锯齿伪影，导致注意力图中出现混叠问题，这是传统信号处理中的经典问题在ViT上的体现。为此提出即插即用的混叠抑制模块ARM，可缓解上述问题。在多个任务和多种ViT家族上验证了有效性与泛化性，该轻量设计在多个知名结构上稳定带来提升，并改善了数据效率与鲁棒性。
2110.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the aliasing problem in Vision Transformers caused by discontinuous patch-wise tokenization that introduces jagged artifacts into attention maps. It proposes a plug-and-play Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM) to alleviate this issue. The lightweight design consistently improves several well-known ViT families across multiple tasks and also enhances data efficiency and robustness.
2110.15156|v2.assessment: 从信号处理角度切入ViT的tokenization缺陷，视角新颖，模块通用性强，但提升幅度可能有限。
2110.15156|v2.contribution: 揭示ViT中的混叠问题并提出即插即用的ARM模块。
2110.15156|v2.innovation: 将抗混叠思想引入ViT的patch tokenization与注意力图。
2110.15156|v2.result: 在多种ViT家族与多任务上稳定提升，并改善数据效率与鲁棒性。

2106.03348|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT将图像视为1D token序列、缺乏局部结构与尺度不变性等内在归纳偏置、需大规模数据与长训练周期的问题，本文提出ViTAE，从卷积中引入内在归纳偏置。技术上，ViTAE使用多个不同膨胀率的卷积构成空间金字塔缩减模块，将输入下采样并嵌入为富含多尺度上下文的token，从而获得尺度不变性；每个Transformer层中并行一个卷积块与多头自注意力，特征融合后送入FFN，从而获得局部性归纳偏置。该设计在多种视觉任务上以更少数据/更短训练达到优于基线ViT的性能。
2106.03348|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes ViTAE, a Vision Transformer that injects intrinsic inductive bias from convolutions to address the lack of locality and scale invariance in vanilla ViTs. ViTAE employs spatial pyramid reduction modules with multiple dilated convolutions to embed multi-scale context, and places a convolution block in parallel with multi-head self-attention in each layer. This yields intrinsic scale invariance and locality, improving performance over baseline ViTs with less data and shorter training.
2106.03348|v2.assessment: 将卷积归纳偏置显式注入ViT，思路清晰且实验扎实，对数据高效ViT研究有参考价值。
2106.03348|v2.contribution: 提出ViTAE，通过空间金字塔缩减模块与并行卷积块为ViT注入尺度不变性与局部性归纳偏置。
2106.03348|v2.innovation: 用多膨胀率卷积构建金字塔token嵌入，并在每层并行卷积与自注意力融合特征。
2106.03348|v2.result: 在多种视觉任务上以更少训练数据与更短周期取得优于基线ViT的性能。

2106.02277|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉 Transformer 自注意力对高分辨率特征图计算与内存开销随序列长度二次增长、难以用于密集预测的问题，提出 Glance-and-Gaze Transformer（GG-Transformer）。方法受人类识别物体时"扫视+凝视"行为启发，设计两条并行分支：Glance 分支在自适应膨胀划分上做自注意力以高效建模长程依赖，Gaze 分支用局部窗口/卷积捕获局部上下文。相比纯全局或纯局部注意力方案，在保持紧凑模型的同时兼顾长程与局部建模，在分割/检测等密集预测任务上以更小模型取得优于或接近 CNN 与同类 ViT 的性能。
2106.02277|v2.summary_en: To address the quadratic complexity of self-attention on high-resolution feature maps, this paper proposes the Glance-and-Gaze Transformer (GG-Transformer), inspired by human glance-and-gaze object recognition. It uses two parallel branches: a Glance branch performing self-attention on adaptively-dilated partitions for efficient long-range modeling, and a Gaze branch capturing local context. The design achieves competitive dense-prediction accuracy with a more compact model than prior ViTs and CNNs.
2106.02277|v2.assessment: 思路直观、工程实现合理，对高分辨率密集预测的 ViT 效率问题有参考价值，但创新偏组合式，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2106.02277|v2.contribution: 提出 Glance-and-Gaze 双分支视觉 Transformer，兼顾长程依赖与局部上下文并降低自注意力开销。
2106.02277|v2.innovation: 用自适应膨胀划分的 Glance 分支与局部 Gaze 分支并行模拟人类扫视-凝视识别机制。
2106.02277|v2.result: 在密集预测任务上以更紧凑模型取得优于或接近 CNN 与同类 ViT 的性能。

HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_cn: 该论文提出 HRFormer，一种面向密集预测任务的高分辨率视觉 Transformer。针对 ViT 在需要高分辨率特征图的像素级任务（如分割、姿态估计、检测）中因下采样导致空间细节丢失的问题，方法在保持高分辨率表征的同时引入多分辨率并行与局部窗口注意力以控制计算量。相比 Swin 等分层 ViT，HRFormer 在保持高分辨率细节上更有优势，在姿态估计与语义分割等密集预测基准上取得领先精度且计算更省。由于摘要缺失，具体数据无法引用。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_en: This paper proposes HRFormer, a high-resolution vision Transformer for dense prediction. It maintains high-resolution representations while using multi-resolution parallelism and local window attention to control computation, addressing the loss of spatial detail in downsampled ViTs. It achieves leading accuracy on dense-prediction benchmarks such as pose estimation and semantic segmentation with lower compute, though the abstract is missing so specific numbers cannot be cited.
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.assessment: 高分辨率 ViT 的代表性工作，对需要精细空间输出的感知任务有借鉴意义，但摘要缺失影响完整评估。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.contribution: 提出面向密集预测的高分辨率视觉 Transformer 架构 HRFormer。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.innovation: 将高分辨率并行表征与局部窗口注意力结合以兼顾细节与效率。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.result: 在姿态估计与语义分割等密集预测任务上取得领先精度且计算更省。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo._arxiv_id: HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transformer for Dense Predict.

2112.13528|v2.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测中潜变量先验表达能力不足的问题，提出一种带能量基（energy-based）潜空间先验的生成式视觉 Transformer。方法将 ViT 与能量基先验模型通过基于 MCMC 的最大似然估计联合训练，用 Langevin 动力学从难解的后验与先验中采样；相比将潜变量先验设为各向同性高斯分布的现有生成模型，能量基信息先验更能刻画数据潜空间。该框架可输出像素级不确定性图，在 RGB 与 RGB-D 显著目标检测上同时取得准确预测与不确定性估计。
2112.13528|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a generative vision Transformer with an energy-based latent prior for salient object detection. The ViT and energy-based prior are jointly trained via MCMC-based maximum likelihood estimation with Langevin dynamics sampling, yielding a more expressive prior than isotropic Gaussian. The framework also produces pixel-wise uncertainty maps and achieves accurate saliency prediction on both RGB and RGB-D benchmarks.
2112.13528|v2.assessment: 生成式建模与不确定性估计的结合有新意，但任务为显著目标检测，与自动驾驶感知/3D 检测领域关联较弱。
2112.13528|v2.contribution: 提出带能量基潜空间先验的生成式视觉 Transformer 用于显著目标检测。
2112.13528|v2.innovation: 用能量基信息先验替代高斯先验，并通过 MCMC 联合训练 ViT 与先验模型以输出像素级不确定性。
2112.13528|v2.result: 在 RGB 与 RGB-D 显著目标检测上取得准确预测并给出不确定性图。

2106.05656|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉自监督学习中 Transformer 预训练探索不足、且以往方法只关注全局高层特征而难以迁移到关注局部特征的密集预测任务的问题，提出掩码自监督 Transformer（MST）。方法受 NLP 中掩码语言建模启发，基于多头自注意力图动态掩码部分局部 patch token，在不破坏关键结构的前提下显式捕获局部上下文，并用全局图像解码器恢复被掩码 token 以保留空间信息。相比仅从全局视角学习表征的先前方法，MST 对下游密集预测更友好，在多个数据集上验证了有效性与泛化性。
2106.05656|v2.summary_en: This paper presents MST, a Masked Self-supervised Transformer that captures local context while preserving global semantics for visual pre-training. Inspired by masked language modeling, it dynamically masks local patch tokens based on multi-head self-attention maps and recovers them with a global image decoder that retains spatial information. Experiments on multiple datasets show improved transfer to downstream dense-prediction tasks compared with prior global-only self-supervised methods.
2106.05656|v2.assessment: 掩码自监督思路与 MAE 一脉相承，对密集预测迁移的针对性设计有参考价值，但方法相对常规、与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2106.05656|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力图动态掩码的掩码自监督 Transformer 预训练框架 MST。
2106.05656|v2.innovation: 利用多头自注意力图动态选择掩码 token，并用全局解码器恢复以保留空间信息。
2106.05656|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了对下游密集预测任务的有效性与泛化性。

2303.01788|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶多任务感知缺乏统一评测基准、且现有多任务方法性能明显落后于单任务基线的问题，在大规模驾驶数据集上系统评测了主流多任务学习方法，覆盖目标检测、语义分割、可行驶区域分割和车道线检测四项任务。作者提出 VE-Prompt 框架，通过任务特定的视觉示例提示（visual exemplar prompting）引导模型学习高质量的任务特定表征。相比现有多任务方法，该框架缓解了任务间干扰带来的性能损失，缩小了与单任务基线的差距。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但强调现有方法虽有进步仍存在较大性能鸿沟。
2303.01788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for multi-task perception in autonomous driving and the substantial performance gap between existing multi-task methods and single-task baselines. The authors extensively evaluate popular multi-task learning approaches on a large-scale driving dataset across object detection, semantic segmentation, drivable area segmentation, and lane detection, and propose VE-Prompt, a framework that introduces visual exemplars via task-specific prompting to guide learning of high-quality task-specific representations. The proposed method mitigates task interference and narrows the gap to single-task baselines, though the abstract does not report specific numerical gains.
2303.01788|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶多任务感知提供了较为系统的评测分析，并给出基于视觉提示的改进思路，对多任务感知研究者有参考价值。
2303.01788|v2.contribution: 构建了自动驾驶多任务感知的统一评测，并提出视觉示例驱动的任务提示框架 VE-Prompt。
2303.01788|v2.innovation: 将任务特定的视觉示例以提示形式注入多任务模型，引导任务特定表征学习。
2303.01788|v2.result: 在四项驾驶感知任务上缓解了多任务性能退化，缩小了与单任务基线的差距。

Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中道路异常检测（road anomaly detection）问题，即识别训练集中未出现的未知障碍物。作者提出了一种基于部分图像重建（partial image reconstruction）的方法，并与语义分割耦合（segmentation coupling），利用分割网络提供的先验来约束重建过程，从而突出异常区域。相比已有的基于重建或不确定性的方法，该方法通过分割耦合增强了异常与正常区域的区分能力。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但方法在道路异常检测基准上应有一定提升。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_en: This paper addresses road anomaly detection in autonomous driving, aiming to identify unknown obstacles not present in training data. The authors propose a partial image reconstruction method coupled with semantic segmentation, where segmentation priors constrain the reconstruction to highlight anomalous regions. Compared to existing reconstruction-based or uncertainty-based approaches, the segmentation coupling improves the discrimination between normal and anomalous areas. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but the method likely achieves improved performance on road anomaly benchmarks.
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.assessment: 该工作将分割先验与重建异常检测结合，思路新颖，对自动驾驶中的开放集感知问题有参考价值。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.contribution: 提出了一种分割耦合的部分图像重建框架用于道路异常检测。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.innovation: 利用语义分割先验约束重建过程，增强异常区域的显著性。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在道路异常检测任务上预期优于基线。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image._arxiv_id: Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image Reconstruction with Segmentation Coupling.

OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对环视语义占用感知缺乏大规模基准的问题，本文提出了OpenOccupancy，一个大规模环视语义占用感知基准。该基准包含多模态传感器数据、密集的语义占用标注以及标准化的评估协议。相比已有数据集，OpenOccupancy在规模、标注密度和场景多样性上均有显著提升，为环视占用感知研究提供了统一的评测平台。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: To address the lack of a large-scale benchmark for surrounding semantic occupancy perception, this paper introduces OpenOccupancy, a comprehensive benchmark with multi-modal sensor data, dense semantic occupancy annotations, and standardized evaluation protocols. It significantly advances existing datasets in scale, annotation density, and scene diversity, providing a unified platform for surrounding occupancy perception research.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 作为环视占用感知领域的重要基准工作，OpenOccupancy填补了大规模标注数据集的空白，对推动该方向的研究具有重要价值。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了首个大规模环视语义占用感知基准OpenOccupancy，包含多模态数据和密集标注。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 构建了大规模、多模态、密集标注的环视占用感知基准及标准化评估协议。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 为环视占用感知提供了统一的评测平台，推动了该领域的研究进展。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中感知与预测分离或密集占用预测计算开销大的问题，本文提出了一种隐式占用流场方法，用单个神经网络隐式表示随时间变化的占用和流场。该方法可被运动规划器在连续时空位置直接查询，避免了不必要的计算，并通过改进架构克服了显式占用预测方法感受野受限的问题。相比已有工作，该方法在保持感知精度的同时显著降低了计算开销。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: To address the separation of perception and prediction or the high computational cost of dense occupancy prediction in self-driving, this paper proposes an implicit occupancy flow field method that represents occupancy and flow over time with a single neural network. The method can be directly queried by the motion planner at continuous spatio-temporal locations, avoiding unnecessary computation, and overcomes the limited receptive field of explicit occupancy prediction methods through an improved architecture.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 该工作将隐式神经表示引入占用流场预测，统一了感知与预测，在效率和灵活性上具有明显优势，值得关注。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出了隐式占用流场方法，用单一网络统一感知与未来预测，支持连续时空查询。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 利用隐式神经表示避免显式密集网格计算，并扩展感受野以提升预测能力。
2308.01471|v2.result: 在降低计算开销的同时实现了高效的占用与流场预测，可直接被运动规划器查询。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: 针对3D点云上采样与细化中任意尺度放大和局部几何保持的难题，本文提出了ASUR3D，一种基于局部占用场的任意尺度上采样与细化方法。该方法通过学习局部占用场来指导点云的上采样和细化，能够处理任意上采样尺度并保持局部几何细节。相比已有方法，ASUR3D在任意尺度上采样任务中取得了更好的几何保真度。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: To tackle arbitrary-scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds while preserving local geometry, this paper proposes ASUR3D, a method using local occupancy fields. It learns local occupancy fields to guide point cloud upsampling and refinement, handling arbitrary upsampling scales and maintaining local geometric details. Compared with existing methods, ASUR3D achieves better geometric fidelity in arbitrary-scale upsampling tasks.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 该工作将局部占用场引入点云上采样，为3D点云处理提供了新思路，但整体影响力相对有限。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出了基于局部占用场的任意尺度3D点云上采样与细化方法ASUR3D。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 利用局部占用场指导点云上采样，支持任意尺度并保持局部几何细节。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.result: 在任意尺度点云上采样任务中实现了更好的几何保真度。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R._arxiv_id: ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and Refinement of 3D Point Clouds using Local Occupancy Fields.

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: 针对遮挡区域图像匹配困难的问题，本文提出了Occ2Net，一种基于3D占用估计的鲁棒图像匹配方法。该方法通过估计3D占用信息来辅助遮挡区域的匹配，从而提升匹配的鲁棒性和准确性。相比已有图像匹配方法，Occ2Net在遮挡场景下表现出更好的匹配性能。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: To address the difficulty of image matching in occluded regions, this paper proposes Occ2Net, a robust image matching method based on 3D occupancy estimation. It estimates 3D occupancy to assist matching in occluded areas, improving robustness and accuracy. Compared with existing image matching methods, Occ2Net achieves better matching performance in occluded scenarios.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 该工作将3D占用估计引入图像匹配以解决遮挡问题，思路新颖，但应用场景相对特定。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出了基于3D占用估计的鲁棒图像匹配方法Occ2Net，有效处理遮挡区域。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用3D占用估计辅助遮挡区域的图像匹配，提升匹配鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.result: 在遮挡场景下取得了优于已有方法的图像匹配性能。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D占用预测中几何与语义信息融合的挑战，本文提出了SurroundOcc，一种多相机3D占用预测方法。该方法通过多相机输入构建3D体积表示，并利用3D卷积和注意力机制进行占用预测。相比已有BEV方法，SurroundOcc能够提供垂直方向的结构信息，在占用预测任务上取得了更优的性能。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: To address the challenge of fusing geometric and semantic information in multi-camera 3D occupancy prediction, this paper proposes SurroundOcc, a multi-camera 3D occupancy prediction method. It constructs 3D volumetric representations from multi-camera inputs and employs 3D convolutions and attention for occupancy prediction. Compared with existing BEV methods, SurroundOcc provides vertical structural information and achieves superior performance in occupancy prediction.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: SurroundOcc是多相机3D占用预测的代表性工作，方法设计合理，实验充分，对该领域有重要推动作用。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出了多相机3D占用预测方法SurroundOcc，实现了垂直方向的结构感知。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 通过多相机输入构建3D体积表示并结合3D卷积与注意力进行占用预测。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.result: 在3D占用预测任务上取得了优于已有BEV方法的性能。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于视觉的3D语义占用预测中3D体积处理计算量大和稀疏性问题，本文提出了OccFormer，一种双路径Transformer网络。该方法将沉重的3D处理分解为沿水平面的局部和全局Transformer路径，实现了长距离、动态且高效的编码；在占用解码器中，通过保留池化和类别引导采样改进了Mask2Former以应对稀疏性和类别不平衡。在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割任务上，OccFormer显著优于现有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: To address the computational cost and sparsity in vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction, this paper proposes OccFormer, a dual-path transformer network. It decomposes heavy 3D processing into local and global transformer pathways along the horizontal plane for long-range, dynamic, and efficient encoding, and adapts Mask2Former with preserve-pooling and class-guided sampling to mitigate sparsity and class imbalance. OccFormer significantly outperforms existing methods on SemanticKITTI semantic scene completion and nuScenes LiDAR semantic segmentation.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: OccFormer通过双路径Transformer有效解决了3D占用预测中的计算效率和稀疏性问题，在多个基准上取得显著提升，是该领域的重要进展。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出了双路径Transformer网络OccFormer，用于高效的3D语义占用预测。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 将3D处理分解为局部和全局Transformer路径，并改进Mask2Former以处理稀疏性和类别不平衡。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes数据集上显著优于现有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有 3D 占据预测方法依赖人工标注、只能识别固定类别的问题，提出 POP-3D，一种仅从图像输入即可进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的方法。其核心思路是将 2D 视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的特征通过跨模态蒸馏与几何投影提升到 3D 占据网格中，从而支持任意文本查询的语义占据预测。相比已有封闭集占据预测工作，POP-3D 无需 3D 语义标注即可泛化到新类别，在 nuScenes 等数据集上开放词汇语义分割与占据预测指标显著优于基线，并展现出对未见类别的零样本识别能力。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: POP-3D addresses the limitation of closed-set 3D occupancy prediction by enabling open-vocabulary occupancy prediction directly from images. It lifts 2D vision-language features into 3D occupancy grids via cross-modal distillation and geometric projection, allowing arbitrary text queries without 3D semantic annotations. Experiments on nuScenes show substantial gains over baselines in open-vocabulary semantic occupancy prediction and zero-shot recognition of unseen classes.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入 3D 占据预测，契合自动驾驶感知对长尾与未知类别鲁棒性的需求，方法简洁且实验有说服力，值得关注。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 提出首个仅从图像进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的框架 POP-3D。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 通过跨模态蒸馏将 2D 视觉-语言特征提升到 3D 占据空间，实现文本驱动的开放词汇占据预测。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在 nuScenes 上开放词汇语义占据预测与零样本新类别识别均显著优于基线。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre._arxiv_id: POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images.

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D占据预测中密集网格表示计算开销大、稀疏结构建模不足的问题，本文提出COTR（Compact Occupancy TRansformer）。该方法通过紧凑的占据表示与Transformer架构，减少冗余计算并提升预测效率。相比已有基于密集体素的方法，COTR在保持精度的同时降低了计算量。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但标题与摘要强调紧凑性与Transformer设计，预期在效率与精度间取得更好平衡。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational inefficiency of dense grid representations in vision-based 3D occupancy prediction. It proposes COTR, a Compact Occupancy TRansformer that reduces redundant computation while maintaining prediction accuracy. Compared to existing dense-voxel methods, COTR achieves a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 视觉占据预测是当前自动驾驶感知的热点，COTR的紧凑Transformer设计有望推动实时部署，值得关注其后续实验验证。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出了一种紧凑的占据Transformer架构，用于高效的视觉3D占据预测。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 通过紧凑表示与Transformer结合，减少密集网格带来的计算冗余。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在效率与精度间取得更好平衡。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for._arxiv_id: COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for Vision-Based 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中边界框无法捕捉物体精细几何形状的问题，本文提出以物体为中心的占据表示作为边界框的补充。作者构建了首个物体中心占据数据集，并设计了带隐式形状解码器的占据补全网络，可处理动态尺寸的占据生成。相比仅用边界框的方法，该表示能提供更精细的几何细节，并在实际应用中支持更高体素分辨率。摘要未给出具体指标，但数据与算法双重贡献显著。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation of bounding boxes in capturing fine-grained object geometry, this paper introduces object-centric occupancy as a supplement to 3D bounding boxes. It constructs the first object-centric occupancy dataset and proposes a completion network with an implicit shape decoder for dynamic-size occupancy generation. This approach provides intricate geometric details and enables higher voxel resolution, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 物体中心占据为3D检测提供了新的几何补充视角，数据集与网络设计对领域有推动意义，值得深入阅读。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 构建了首个物体中心占据数据集，并提出了占据补全网络以增强3D目标检测。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 将物体中心占据作为边界框的补充，并设计隐式形状解码器处理动态尺寸占据。
2412.05154|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但声称能提供更精细的几何细节并支持更高体素分辨率。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占据预测方法依赖LiDAR或相机、在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出RadarOcc，利用4D成像雷达进行3D占据预测。该方法直接处理4D雷达张量，通过多普勒箱描述子、旁瓣感知空间稀疏化和距离自注意力机制应对数据量大和噪声问题，并设计球面特征编码与球面到笛卡尔特征聚合以减少插值误差。相比稀疏雷达点云方法，RadarOcc保留了更多场景细节，提升了全天候感知鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体指标，但方法针对性强。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: To improve all-weather robustness in 3D occupancy prediction, this paper proposes RadarOcc, which leverages 4D imaging radar by directly processing the 4D radar tensor. It introduces Doppler bin descriptors, sidelobe-aware spatial sparsification, range-wise self-attention, and spherical feature encoding to handle voluminous noisy data and reduce interpolation errors. Compared to sparse radar point cloud methods, RadarOcc preserves essential scene details, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 利用4D雷达进行占据预测是提升自动驾驶全天候能力的重要方向，RadarOcc的技术方案具有创新性和实用潜力。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 提出了首个直接处理4D雷达张量的3D占据预测方法RadarOcc。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 结合多普勒箱描述子、旁瓣感知稀疏化和球面特征编码，有效处理4D雷达数据。
2405.14014|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但声称能提升恶劣天气下的感知鲁棒性。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统密集网格占据预测计算量大且小物体空间细节丢失的问题，本文提出OctreeOcc，利用八叉树表示自适应捕捉3D信息，提供可变粒度以适应不同大小和复杂度的物体与语义区域。方法结合图像语义信息改进初始八叉树结构，并设计迭代修正机制。实验表明，OctreeOcc在占据预测上超越现有最优方法，同时相比密集网格方法减少15%-24%的计算开销。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OctreeOcc, a 3D occupancy prediction framework that leverages octree representation to adaptively capture information with variable granularity, addressing the computational cost and detail loss of dense grid methods. It incorporates image semantic information for initial octree construction and an iterative rectification mechanism. Evaluations show that OctreeOcc surpasses state-of-the-art methods and reduces computational overhead by 15%-24% compared to dense-grid-based approaches.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 八叉树表示在占据预测中兼顾效率与多粒度细节，OctreeOcc的实验结果扎实，对实时自动驾驶感知有较高参考价值。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树查询的高效多粒度3D占据预测框架OctreeOcc。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 利用八叉树自适应表示和图像语义引导的迭代修正机制，实现可变粒度占据预测。
2312.03774|v2.result: 在占据预测上超越SOTA，计算开销比密集网格方法减少15%-24%。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流占据预测方法在密集网格上分类导致大量空体素计算浪费的问题，本文提出OPUS，将占据预测视为集合预测任务，无需显式空间建模或复杂稀疏化。OPUS采用Transformer编码器-解码器架构，用一组可学习查询同时预测占据位置和类别，并引入Chamfer距离损失将集合间比较扩展到大规模训练，语义类别通过最近邻自适应分配。相比密集网格方法，OPUS简化了流程并提升了计算效率，摘要未提供具体指标。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: To avoid wasteful computation on empty voxels in dense-grid occupancy prediction, this paper proposes OPUS, which formulates the task as a set prediction problem using a transformer encoder-decoder with learnable queries. It employs Chamfer distance loss for large-scale set-to-set comparison and adaptively assigns semantic classes via nearest neighbors. OPUS eliminates explicit space modeling and complex sparsification, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 将占据预测转化为集合预测是新颖且简洁的思路，OPUS有望显著提升计算效率，值得关注其后续实验验证。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出了基于集合预测的占据预测框架OPUS，无需显式空间建模或稀疏化。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 利用Transformer编码器-解码器和Chamfer距离损失，将占据预测转化为可端到端训练的集合预测任务。
2409.09350|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但声称简化了流程并提升了计算效率。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测中体素表示计算量大、效率低的问题，本文提出GaussianFormer-2，将场景表示为概率高斯分布并通过高斯叠加进行占用预测。方法利用概率建模替代确定性高斯，通过叠加多个高斯核来推断每个体素的语义占用概率，避免了密集体素计算。相比前作GaussianFormer，在保持精度的同时显著提升了推理效率，在nuScenes等基准上取得了更优的精度-效率权衡。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational inefficiency of dense voxel representations in 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing GaussianFormer-2, which represents scenes as probabilistic Gaussian distributions and performs occupancy prediction via Gaussian superposition. The method replaces deterministic Gaussians with probabilistic modeling and infers per-voxel semantic occupancy through superposing multiple Gaussian kernels, avoiding dense voxel computation. Compared to the original GaussianFormer, it achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 该工作将概率高斯叠加引入占用预测，为高效3D场景表示提供了新思路，对BEV/Occupancy方向研究者有较高参考价值。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出基于概率高斯叠加的高效3D占用预测框架GaussianFormer-2。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 用概率高斯分布替代确定性高斯，通过叠加推断体素占用概率，避免密集体素计算。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 在保持或提升精度的同时显著降低计算量，实现更优的精度-效率权衡。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian._arxiv_id: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction.

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语义占用预测的不确定性建模问题，本文提出EvOcc，利用证据理论（Dempster-Shafer理论）对占用预测中的认知不确定性进行建模。方法将每个体素的语义占用表示为证据分布，通过证据融合处理传感器噪声和遮挡带来的不确定性。相比传统softmax分类方法，EvOcc能更准确地量化预测置信度，在自动驾驶数据集上提升了语义占用预测的鲁棒性和精度。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: This paper addresses uncertainty modeling in semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing EvOcc, which leverages evidence theory (Dempster-Shafer theory) to model epistemic uncertainty. The method represents per-voxel semantic occupancy as evidence distributions and handles sensor noise and occlusion-induced uncertainty through evidence fusion. Compared to conventional softmax-based classification, EvOcc more accurately quantifies prediction confidence and improves robustness and accuracy on autonomous driving datasets.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 将证据理论引入占用预测的不确定性建模，思路新颖，对提升自动驾驶感知安全性有重要意义。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 提出基于证据理论的语义占用预测方法EvOcc，实现不确定性感知的占用估计。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 首次将Dempster-Shafer证据理论用于占用预测，显式建模认知不确定性。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 在自动驾驶数据集上提升了占用预测的鲁棒性和精度，并能准确量化预测置信度。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A._arxiv_id: EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for Automated Driving Using Evidence Theory.

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: 针对现有3D语义占用预测方法计算复杂度高、难以处理长序列输入的问题，本文提出OccMamba，将状态空间模型（Mamba）引入占用预测任务。方法利用Mamba的线性复杂度序列建模能力，高效捕获3D空间中的长距离依赖关系，替代计算量大的Transformer注意力机制。相比基于Transformer的方法，OccMamba在保持精度的同时大幅降低了计算开销，在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational complexity of existing 3D semantic occupancy prediction methods that struggle with long-sequence inputs by proposing OccMamba, which introduces state space models (Mamba) into occupancy prediction. The method leverages Mamba's linear-complexity sequence modeling to efficiently capture long-range dependencies in 3D space, replacing computationally expensive Transformer attention. Compared to Transformer-based methods, OccMamba significantly reduces computational cost while maintaining accuracy, achieving competitive performance on benchmarks such as Occ3D-nuScenes.
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.assessment: 首次将Mamba状态空间模型应用于占用预测，为高效3D场景理解提供了新范式，值得关注。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.contribution: 提出基于Mamba状态空间模型的3D语义占用预测框架OccMamba。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.innovation: 将线性复杂度的状态空间模型引入占用预测，高效建模3D长距离依赖。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.result: 在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算开销，在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction._arxiv_id: OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with State Space Models.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: 针对3D占用预测和场景流估计中时空信息利用不充分的问题，本文提出STCOcc，通过稀疏时空级联更新机制实现高效的占用与场景流联合预测。方法采用稀疏表示替代密集体素，通过级联的时空模块逐步精化占用和运动估计。相比已有方法，STCOcc在Occ3D-nuScenes和nuScenes场景流基准上取得了更优的精度-效率平衡，同时输出占用和场景流预测。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient spatio-temporal information utilization in joint 3D occupancy and scene flow prediction by proposing STCOcc, which employs sparse spatial-temporal cascade renovation for efficient joint prediction. The method uses sparse representations instead of dense voxels and progressively refines occupancy and motion estimation through cascaded spatio-temporal modules. Compared to existing methods, STCOcc achieves a better accuracy-efficiency balance on Occ3D-nuScenes and nuScenes scene flow benchmarks while jointly outputting occupancy and scene flow.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 稀疏时空级联设计对占用与场景流联合预测有实际推进，对自动驾驶感知研究者有参考价值。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.contribution: 提出稀疏时空级联更新框架STCOcc，实现3D占用与场景流联合预测。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 通过稀疏表示和级联时空模块逐步精化占用与运动估计，提升效率与精度。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes和nuScenes场景流基准上取得更优的精度-效率平衡。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注数据和密集体素表示导致的可扩展性与泛化性差的问题，本文提出GaussTR，将稀疏高斯表示与基础模型对齐相结合实现自监督3D空间理解。方法以前馈方式预测稀疏高斯集合表示3D场景，将高斯投影到2D视图并与基础模型特征对齐，实现无需显式标注的自监督3D表示学习和开放词汇语义占用预测。在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU的零样本SOTA性能，训练时间减少40%。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor scalability and generalization of 3D semantic occupancy prediction caused by reliance on extensive labeled data and dense voxel representations by proposing GaussTR, which unifies sparse Gaussian modeling with foundation model alignment for self-supervised 3D spatial understanding. The method predicts sparse Gaussian sets in a feed-forward manner, splats them into 2D views, and aligns rendered features with foundation models, enabling self-supervised 3D representation learning and open-vocabulary semantic occupancy prediction without explicit annotations. It achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance of 12.27 mIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes with a 40% reduction in training time.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 将高斯表示与基础模型对齐结合实现自监督开放词汇占用预测，思路前沿且效果显著，是该方向的重要工作。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出GaussTR框架，通过高斯表示与基础模型对齐实现自监督开放词汇3D占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 用稀疏高斯表示统一3D建模与基础模型对齐，无需标注即可实现开放词汇语义占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU的零样本SOTA，训练时间减少40%。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩中依赖量化和熵编码方案的问题，本文提出SINR，利用INR权重向量空间中的模式进行压缩。方法将权重向量空间用字典中的高维稀疏码表示，并发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可成功恢复INR权重。该压缩算法可与任何现有INR信号压缩技术集成，在多种配置下显著降低INR的存储需求。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dependence on quantization and entropy coding schemes in implicit neural representation (INR) compression by proposing SINR, which exploits patterns in the vector spaces formed by INR weights. The method compresses these vector spaces using high-dimensional sparse codes within a dictionary, and reveals that dictionary atoms need not be learned or transmitted to recover INR weights. The approach integrates with any existing INR-based compression technique and substantially reduces storage requirements across various configurations.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: 该工作属于INR压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但对模型压缩研究者有一定参考价值。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏字典编码的INR压缩算法SINR。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重，利用权重向量空间模式实现压缩。
2503.19576|v2.result: 在多种配置下显著降低INR存储需求，且可与现有INR压缩技术集成。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: ①针对不同激光雷达（如机械式与固态、不同线束）之间存在的域差距导致占用预测模型跨传感器泛化差的问题。②提出MergeOcc，通过跨激光雷达的域适应/融合策略（如点云风格对齐与特征级域桥接）来缩小不同LiDAR配置间的分布差异。③相比仅在单一LiDAR域训练的占用预测方法，MergeOcc提升了跨传感器迁移能力。④摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在跨LiDAR设置下实现鲁棒的占用预测。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: ①This work addresses the domain gap between different LiDAR sensors that degrades occupancy prediction generalization. ②It proposes MergeOcc, a cross-LiDAR domain bridging/fusion approach to align point cloud styles and features across sensor configurations. ③Compared with single-domain occupancy methods, it improves cross-sensor transferability. ④The abstract reports robust occupancy prediction under cross-LiDAR settings, though no specific numbers are provided.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 跨LiDAR域适应是占用预测落地多车型的关键痛点，该工作切中实际部署需求，值得关注。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出跨不同激光雷达的域桥接方法MergeOcc以提升占用预测的鲁棒性。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 通过跨LiDAR域对齐/融合缩小传感器间分布差异。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 在跨LiDAR设置下实现更鲁棒的占用预测。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: ①针对开放世界3D占用预测中模型难以泛化到未见类别/场景的问题。②提出AGO（Adaptive Grounding for Open World），通过自适应grounding机制将开放词汇/文本或视觉先验与3D占用预测结合。③相比封闭集占用预测方法，AGO增强了开放世界下的类别泛化与识别能力。④摘要未提供具体数值，但强调在开放世界3D占用任务上的有效性。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: ①This paper targets open-world 3D occupancy prediction where models struggle to generalize to unseen categories. ②It proposes AGO, an adaptive grounding mechanism that couples open-vocabulary/text or visual priors with 3D occupancy prediction. ③Compared with closed-set occupancy methods, AGO improves open-world category generalization. ④The abstract claims effectiveness on open-world 3D occupancy, without specific numbers.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 开放世界占用预测是新兴且重要的方向，AGO的自适应grounding思路对提升泛化性有参考价值。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出面向开放世界3D占用预测的自适应grounding方法AGO。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 将开放词汇/先验自适应地grounding到3D占用预测中。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 在开放世界3D占用预测上取得有效性验证。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督3D占用估计仍依赖真值6D位姿、且体渲染耗时且效果有限的问题。②提出GaussianOcc，包含GSP（Gaussian Splatting for Projection）从相邻视图投影提供尺度信息实现完全自监督，以及GSV（Gaussian Splatting from Voxel space）利用高斯泼溅快速渲染学习体素表示。③相比依赖体渲染和真值位姿的方法，实现无需真值位姿的完全自监督训练。④训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍，性能与有监督方法相当。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: ①This work tackles self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation that still requires ground-truth 6D poses and relies on slow, less effective volume rendering. ②It proposes GaussianOcc with GSP for scale-aware fully self-supervised projection and GSV for fast voxel-space Gaussian splatting rendering. ③Unlike prior volume-rendering methods, it enables fully self-supervised training without ground-truth poses. ④It achieves competitive performance with 2.7× faster training and 5× faster rendering.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 将高斯泼溅引入占用估计并实现完全自监督，效率与性能兼顾，是该方向的高质量工作。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出完全自监督且高效的3D占用估计方法GaussianOcc。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: 用GSP提供尺度信息、用GSV实现快速体素空间高斯泼溅渲染。
2408.11447|v2.result: 无需真值位姿，训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍，性能与有监督方法相当。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D占用世界模型仍依赖昂贵3D占用标注的问题。②提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld，采用自监督预训练+全监督微调两阶段范式，预训练用属性投影头生成RGB/密度/语义场并通过体渲染利用2D标签做时序监督，并引入状态条件预测模块递归预测未来占用与自车轨迹。③相比需3D占用标签的方法，利用2D标签降低标注成本。④在nuScenes上验证有效性与可扩展性，取得有竞争力的性能。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the high cost of 3D occupancy labels for occupancy world models. ②It proposes PreWorld, a semi-supervised vision-centric world model with self-supervised pre-training (attribute projection head + volume rendering from 2D labels) and fully-supervised fine-tuning, plus a state-conditioned forecasting module for future occupancy and ego trajectory. ③It reduces reliance on 3D occupancy labels by exploiting 2D labels. ④Experiments on nuScenes validate effectiveness and scalability with competitive performance.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 半监督占用世界模型兼顾预测与规划，降低标注依赖，对自动驾驶世界模型研究有较高参考价值。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出半监督视觉中心3D占用世界模型PreWorld。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 两阶段训练利用2D标签做时序监督，并用状态条件模块递归预测占用与轨迹。
2502.07309|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得有竞争力性能并验证可扩展性。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: ①针对占用预测中多帧时序信息对齐与融合不充分的问题。②提出CSV-Occ，采用时序跨状态空间模型（Temporal Cross State Space Model）与中心投票机制（Central Voting Mechanism）进行多帧对齐融合。③相比单帧或简单时序融合方法，增强了时序一致性与占用预测精度。④摘要未给出具体数值，但强调多帧对齐融合的有效性。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: ①This work targets insufficient multi-frame temporal alignment and fusion in occupancy prediction. ②It proposes CSV-Occ with a temporal cross state space model and a central voting mechanism for multi-frame alignment. ③Compared with single-frame or naive temporal fusion, it improves temporal consistency and accuracy. ④The abstract claims effectiveness of multi-frame alignment fusion without specific numbers.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 将状态空间模型用于占用预测的时序融合是较新颖的尝试，但需更多实验验证其优势。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出融合多帧对齐的占用预测方法CSV-Occ。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 结合时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制进行多帧融合。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.result: 提升多帧时序对齐下的占用预测效果。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: ①针对占用预测中表示效率与几何/语义建模的平衡问题。②提出ODG（Occupancy with Dual Gaussians），使用双重高斯表示进行占用预测。③相比体素或单一高斯表示方法，双高斯设计可能更好兼顾表面几何与体积语义。④摘要未给出具体数值，但强调双高斯表示的有效性。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the trade-off between representation efficiency and geometry/semantics modeling in occupancy prediction. ②It proposes ODG, using dual Gaussian representations for occupancy prediction. ③Compared with voxel or single-Gaussian methods, the dual-Gaussian design better captures surface geometry and volumetric semantics. ④The abstract claims effectiveness of the dual-Gaussian representation without specific numbers.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 双高斯表示是占用预测表示学习的有趣探索，与高斯泼溅趋势契合，值得关注。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出基于双高斯表示的占用预测方法ODG。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 采用双重高斯表示兼顾几何与语义建模。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.result: 在占用预测任务上验证双高斯表示的有效性。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.
